en: After my teacher retired, he/she often goes traveling.

zh: 小说里的爱人经历了很多困难。
pinyin: Xiǎoshuō lǐ de àiren jīnglì le hěnduō kùnnán.
en: The lovers in the novel went through many difficulties.

zh: 工作压力会改变一个人的性格。
pinyin: Gōngzuò yālì huì gǎibiàn yī gè rén de xìnggé.
en: Work pressure can change a person's temperament.

zh: 老头儿每天早上都去公园跑步。
pinyin: Lǎo tóu r měitiān zǎoshang dōu qù gōngyuán pǎobù.
en: The old man goes running in the park every morning.

zh: 两国的代表进行了友好的交流。
pinyin: Liǎng guó de dàibiǎo jìnxíng le yǒuhǎo de jiāoliú.
en: The representatives of the two countries held a friendly exchange.

zh: 这件事发生不久，大家还记得。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì fāshēng bù jiǔ, dàjiā hái jìdé.
en: This happened before too long, and everyone still remembers.

zh: 为了工作，他不得不离开父母。
pinyin: Wèile gōngzuò, tā bùdébù líkāi fùmǔ.
en: For the sake of work, he had to leave his parents.

zh: 为了身体健康，我开始跑步了。
pinyin: Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, wǒ kāishǐ pǎobù bù le.
en: For the sake of health, I started running.

zh: 虽然很累，但我还要继续加油。
pinyin: suī rán hěn lèi, dàn wǒ hái yào jì xù jiā yóu.
en: Although I am tired, I still need to keep working hard.

zh: 首先，我们需要解决这个问题。
pinyin: shǒu xiān, wǒ men xū yào jiě jué zhè gè wèn tí.
en: First, we need to solve this problem.

zh: 你应该关注一些经常发生的小事。
pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi guānzhù yīxiē jīngcháng fāshēng de xiǎoshì.
en: You should pay attention to some small things that happen day-to-day.

zh: 那个警察正在调查这起交通事故。
pinyin: Nàgè jǐngchá zhèngzài diàochá zhè qǐ jiāotōng shìgù.
en: That police officer is investigating this traffic accident.

zh: 他小心地把那本古书放回了书架。
pinyin: Tā xiǎoxīn de bǎ nà běn gǔshū fàng huí le shūjià.
en: He carefully put that ancient book back on the bookshelf.

zh: 这种复杂的玩具一般人不会玩儿。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fùzá de wánjù yībān rén bù huì wánr.
en: Ordinary people don't know how to play with this kind of complex toy.

zh: 这几天气温变化很大，注意温度。
pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān qìwēn biànhuà hěn dà, zhùyì wēndù.
en: The temperature has changed a lot these past few days, pay attention to the temperature.

zh: 他希望将来能去不同的国家旅行。
pinyin: Tā xīwàng jiānglái néng qù bùtóng de guójiā lǚxíng.
en: He hopes to be able to travel to different countries in the future.

zh: 刚才发生的事，他还没反应过来。
pinyin: Gāngcái fāshēng de shì, tā hái méi fǎnyìng guòlái.
en: He hasn't processed what happened just now yet.

zh: 如果你愿意，我们可以一起合作。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yuànyì, wǒmen kěyǐ yīqǐ hézuò.
en: If you are willing, we can cooperate together.

zh: 除了这双鞋以外，我没有别的了。
pinyin: Chúle zhè shuāng xié yǐwài, wǒ méiyǒu bié de le.
en: Except for this pair of shoes, I have no others.

zh: 为了讨论这件事，我们必须开会。
pinyin: wèile tǎolùn zhè jiàn shì, wǒmen bìxū kāihuì.
en: In order to discuss this matter, we must attend a meeting.

zh: 这个地区的气候对身体健康有好处。
pinyin: Zhège dìqū de qìhòu duì shēntǐ jiànkāng yǒu hǎochù.
en: The climate in this region is good for one's physical health.

zh: 我们不要总是拿自己和别人做比较。
pinyin: Wǒmen bùyào zǒng shì ná zìjǐ hé biérén zuò bǐjiào.
en: We should not always compare ourselves with others.

zh: 为了健康，我每天都要吃一个苹果。
pinyin: Wèile jiànkāng, wǒ měitiān dōu yào chī yīgè píngguǒ.
en: For the sake of health, I eat an apple every day.

zh: 通过努力，他终于得到了这个机会。
pinyin: Tōngguò nǔlì, tā zhōngyú dédào le zhège jīhuì.
en: Through hard work, he finally obtained this opportunity.

zh: 他因为那个事故决定告诉那家公司。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi nàge shìgù juédìng gàosù nà jiā gōngsī.
en: Because of that accident, he decided to press charges against that company.

zh: 在这个城市里，我见到了许多老朋友。
pinyin: Zài zhège chéngshì lǐ, wǒ jiàn dào le xǔduō lǎo péngyǒu.
en: In this city, I saw many old friends.

zh: 为了孩子上学，他们决定搬到外地去。
pinyin: Wèile háizi shàngxué, tāmen juédìng bāndào wàidì qù.
en: For the sake of the child's schooling, they decided to move to another part of the country.

zh: 我突然想起有一件重要的事情还没做。
pinyin: Wǒ tūrán xiǎngqǐ yǒu yījiàn zhòngyào de shìqíng hái méi zuò.
en: I suddenly remembered that there is an important thing I haven't done yet.

zh: 老师要求我们准确地读出每一个音节。
pinyin: Lǎo shī yāo qiú wǒ men zhǔn què de dú chū měi yī gè yīn jié.
en: The teacher requires us to pronounce every syllable accurately.

zh: 除了这件衣服以外，其他的我都喜欢。
pinyin: Chú le zhè jiàn yīfu yǐwài, qítā de wǒ dōu xǐhuān.
en: Apart from this piece of clothing, I like all the others.

zh: 北京不仅是中国的首都，还是文化中心。
pinyin: Běijīng bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó de shǒudū, háishì wénhuà zhōngxīn.
en: Beijing is not only the capital of China but also the cultural center.

zh: 我们必须想出一个解决问题的最好方法。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū xiǎng chū yígè jiějué wèntí de zuì hǎo fāngfǎ.
en: We must think of the best method to solve the problem.

zh: 由于工作忙，我很久没和老朋友联系了。
pinyin: Yóuyú gōngzuò máng, wǒ hěnjiǔ méi hé lǎo péngyǒu liánxì le.
en: Due to being busy with work, I haven't been in touch with my old friends for a long time.

zh: 虽然房间里很吵，但我还是听见了你的声音。
pinyin: Suīrán fángjiān lǐ hěn chǎo, dàn wǒ háishì tīngjiàn le nǐ de shēngyīn.
en: Although it was noisy in the room, I still heard your voice.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但他还是坚持骑车去图书馆。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì bù hǎo, dàn tā háishì jiānchí qíchē qù túshūguǎn.
en: Although the weather is bad, he insists on riding his bike to the library.

zh: 在孩子成长的过程中，父母的教育非常重要。
pinyin: Zài háizi chéngzhǎng de guòchéng zhōng, fùmǔ de jiàoyù fēicháng zhòngyào.
en: During a child's growth, parental education is extremely important.

zh: 他为了确保旅行的一路平安，做了很多准备。
pinyin: Tā wèile quèbǎo lǚxíng de yī lù píng ān, zuòle hěnduō zhǔnbèi.
en: He made many preparations to ensure a safe journey.

zh: 为了准备下周的考试，他这两天一直在复习。
pinyin: Wèile zhǔnbèi xià zhōu de kǎoshì, tā zhè liǎng tiān yīzhí zài fùxí.
en: In order to prepare for next week's exam, he has been reviewing these two days.

zh: 虽然他不太喜欢喝啤酒，但他还是喝了一杯。
pinyin: suī rán tā bú tài xǐ huān hē pí jiǔ, dàn tā hái shì hē le yì bēi.
en: Although he doesn't really like to drink beer, he still drank a glass.

zh: 为了买到那本书，他在书店门口排队排了很久。
pinyin: Wèile mǎidào nà běn shū, tā zài shūdiàn ménkǒu páiduì páile hěnjiǔ.
en: In order to buy that book, he lined up at the bookstore entrance for a long time.

zh: 她向我介绍了她的男朋友，他们看起来非常般配。
pinyin: Tā xiàng wǒ jièshàole tā de nán péngyou, tāmen kàn qǐlái fēicháng bānpèi.
en: She introduced her boyfriend to me; they look like a perfect match.

zh: 这只猪又胖又可爱。
pinyin: Zhè zhǐ zhū yòu pàng yòu kě'ài.
en: This pig is both fat and cute.

zh: 修这条道需要很久。
pinyin: Xiū zhè tiáo dào xūyào hū hěn jiǔ.
en: Building this road takes a long time.

zh: 那名男子被警察带走了。
pinyin: Nà míng nánzǐ bèi jǐngchá dàizǒu le.
en: That man was taken away by the police.

zh: 社会普遍关注食品安全。
pinyin: Shèhuì pǔbiàn guānzhù shípǐn ānquán.
en: Society is generally concerned about food safety.

zh: 会议不一定按计划进行。
pinyin: huì yì bù yī dìng àn jì huà jìn xíng.
en: The meeting might not proceed according to the plan.

zh: 现代数字广播技术很先进。
pinyin: xiàndài shùzì guǎngbō jìshù hěn xiānjìn.
en: Modern digital broadcasting technology is very advanced.

zh: 这种运动特别适合年轻人。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yùndòng tèbié shìhé niánqīng rén.
en: This kind of sport is especially suitable for young people.

zh: 目前的计划需要相机调整。
pinyin: Mùqián de jìhuà xūyào xiàngjī tiáozhěng.
en: The current plan needs to be adjusted as the circumstances allow.

zh: 会议的记录必须保持客观。
pinyin: Huìyì de jìlù bìxū bǎochí kèguān.
en: The note-taker of the meeting must remain objective.

zh: 公司需要更多资金来发展。
pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào gèng duō zījīn lái fāzhǎn.
en: The company needs more funds to develop.

zh: 只要努力，愿望终会实现。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǔlì, yuànwàng zhōng huì shíxiàn.
en: As long as you work hard, your wish will eventually come true.

zh: 你应该一直等到结果公布。
pinyin: nǐ yīnggāi yīzhí děng dào jiéguǒ gōngbù.
en: You should wait until the results are announced.

zh: 他以前经常参加各种活动。
pinyin: Tā yǐqián jīngcháng cānjiā gè zhǒng huódòng.
en: He formerly participated in various activities often.

zh: 他常见这种复杂的情况发生。
pinyin: Tā cháng jiàn zhè zhǒng fùzá de qíngkuàng fāshēng.
en: He frequently sees this kind of complex situation occur.

zh: 艺术是表达情感的一种方式。
pinyin: Yìshù shì biǎodá qínggǎn de yī zhǒng fāngshì.
en: Art is a way to express emotions.

zh: 这种观点在现代社会很常见。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng guāndiǎn zài xiàndài shèhuì hěn chángjiàn.
en: This type of point of view is common in modern society.

zh: 只要坚持，以后一定能成功。
pinyin: Zhǐyào jiānchí, yǐhòu yīdìng néng chénggōng.
en: As long as you persist, you will definitely succeed later.

zh: 我们应该利用科技解决问题。
pinyin: wǒ men yīng gāi lì yòng kē jì jiě jué wèn tí.
en: We should use science and technology to solve problems.

zh: 我还没把这件事情调查清楚。
pinyin: Wǒ hái méi bǎ zhè jiàn shìqíng diàochá qīngchu.
en: I have not yet investigated this matter thoroughly.

zh: 这种凉水在夏天非常受欢迎。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng liángshuǐ zài xiàtiān fēicháng shòu huānyíng.
en: This kind of cool water is very popular in summer.

zh: 只有完成任务，我才能放心。
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu wán chéng rèn wù, wǒ cái néng fàng xīn.
en: Only after completing the task can I be at ease.

zh: 这部小说具有很高的文学价值。
pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō jùyǒu hěn gāo de wénxué jiàzhí.
en: This novel possesses high literary value.

zh: 这门课程的报名人数已经满了。
pinyin: zhè mén kè chéng de bào míng rén shù yǐ jīng mǎn le.
en: The number of people signed up for this course is already full.

zh: 这个问题看上去比较容易解决。
pinyin: Zhè gè wèntí kànshangqu bǐjiào róngyì jiějué.
en: This problem looks like it would be relatively easy to solve.

zh: 会议还没结束，提前离开不行。
pinyin: Huìyì hái méi jiéshù, tíqián líkāi bùxíng.
en: The meeting hasn't ended; leaving early won't do.

zh: 他就是因为这个原因才离开的。
pinyin: tā jiù shì yīnwèi zhège yuányīn cái líkāi de.
en: He left for this only reason.

zh: 这是全国范围内最先进的技术。
pinyin: zhè shì quán guó fànwéi nèi zuì xiānjìn de jìshù.
en: This is the most advanced technology nationwide.

zh: 乐团正在专业的工作室里录音。
pinyin: Yuètuán zhèngzài zhuānyè de gōngzuòshì lǐ lùyīn.
en: The orchestra is recording sound in a professional studio.

zh: 这种现象好像在社会上很普遍。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiànxiàng hǎoxiàng zài shèhuìshàng hěn pǔbiàn.
en: This phenomenon seems very common in society.

zh: 他通过努力改变了自己的人生。
pinyin: tā tōngguò nǔlì gǎibiàn le zìjǐ de rénshēng.
en: He changed his life through hard work.

zh: 我们需要打印一份彩色的报告。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào dǎyìn yī fèn cǎisè de bàogào.
en: We need to print a color report.

zh: 当初我们预想的计划并没有实现。
pinyin: dāng chū wǒ men yù xiǎng de jì huà bìng méi yǒu shí xiàn.
en: The plan we originally envisioned did not come to fruition.

zh: 经过努力，他的年级排名提高了。
pinyin: Jīngguò nǔlì, tā de niánjí páimíng tígāo le.
en: Through hard work, his grade ranking has improved.

zh: 医生希望每个人都有健康的一生。
pinyin: Yīshēng xīwàng měi gèrén dōu yǒu jiànkāng de yīshēng.
en: The doctor hopes everyone has a healthy life.

zh: 我们应当对环境问题关注一点点。
pinyin: wǒ men yīng dāng duì huán jìng wèn tí guān zhù yì diǎn diǎn
en: We should pay a little bit of attention to environmental issues.

zh: 这台机器虽然老，但是还可以用。
pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì suīrán lǎo, dànshì hái kěyǐ yòng.
en: Although this machine is old, it can still be used.

zh: 他正在努力提高自己的外文水平。
pinyin: Tā zhèngzài nǔlì tígāo zìjǐ de wàiwén shuǐpíng.
en: He is working hard to improve his foreign language proficiency.

zh: 夏天的午后，阳光总是特别强烈。
pinyin: Xiàtiān de wǔhòu, yángguāng zǒngshì tèbié qiángliè.
en: In the afternoon of summer, the sunlight is always particularly intense.

zh: 收到消息后，他立刻采取了行动。
pinyin: Shōudào xiāoxī hòu, tā lìkè cǎiqǔ le xíngdòng.
en: After receiving the news, he took action immediately.

zh: 中华民族的成员在世界各地生活。
pinyin: Zhōnghuá mínzú de chéngyuán zài shìjiè gèdì shēnghuó.
en: Members of the Chinese people live all over the world.

zh: 旅行社安排我们明天早晨集体出发。
pinyin: Lǚxíngshè ānpái wǒmen míngtiān zǎochen jítǐ chūfā.
en: The travel agency arranged for us to set off as a group tomorrow morning.

zh: 他认为性格的形成受后天影响很大。
pinyin: tā rènwéi xìnggé de xíngchéng shòu hòutiān yǐngxiǎng hěn dà.
en: He believes the formation of personality is greatly influenced by acquired factors.

zh: 为了取得大家的信任，他非常努力。
pinyin: Wèile qǔdé dàjiā de xìnrèn, tā fēicháng nǔlì.
en: In order to gain everyone's trust, he worked very hard.

zh: 这个城市的经济排名在全国很靠前。
pinyin: zhè gè chéng shì de jīng jì pái míng zài quán guó hěn kào qián.

zh: 我们要加强东西部地区的经济合作。
pinyin: wǒ men yào jiā qiáng dōng xī bù dì qū de jīng jì hé zuò.
en: We must strengthen economic cooperation between the eastern and western regions.

zh: 为了适应新的制度，大家都很努力。
pinyin: Wèile shìyìng xīn de zhìdù, dàjiā dōu hěn nǔlì.
en: In order to adapt to the new system, everyone is working hard.

zh: 我们要把会议的重要内容纪录下来。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎ huìyì de zhòngyào nèiróng jìlù xiàlái.
en: We need to record the important content of the meeting.

zh: 这种树主要生长在中国的中部地区。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shù zhǔyào shēngzhǎng zài Zhōngguó de zhōngbù dìqū.
en: This kind of tree mainly grows in the central region of China.

zh: 年轻人对理想对象的标准越来越高。
pinyin: Niánqīng rén duì lǐxiǎng duìxiàng de biāozhǔn yuè lái yuè gāo.
en: Young people's standards for their ideal partners are getting higher and higher.

zh: 公司在年初举行了重要的经济会议。
pinyin: Gōngsī zài niánchū jǔxíngle zhòngyào de jīngjì huìyì.
en: The company held an important economic conference at the beginning of the year.

zh: 为了健康，我们应该少吃加工食品。
pinyin: Wèile jiànkāng, wǒmen yīnggāi shǎo chī jiāgōng shípǐn.
en: For our health, we should eat less processed food.

zh: 搬家的时候，他卖掉了大部分家具。
pinyin: Bānjiā de shíhòu, tā mài diào le dàbùfèn jiājù.
en: When moving house, he sold most of the furniture.

zh: 如果你有不懂的地方，可以随时提问。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu bù dǒng de dìfāng, kěyǐ suíshí tíwèn.
en: If there is anything you don't understand, you can ask questions at any time.

zh: 电视台正在对这次活动进行现场直播。
pinyin: Diànshìtái zhèngzài duì zhè cì huódòng jìnxíng xiànchǎng zhíbòng zhíbō.
en: The television station is conducting a live broadcast of this event.

zh: 他在整理运动包时发现少了一个网球。
pinyin: tā zài zhěnglǐ yùndòng bāo shí fāxiàn shǎole yīgè wǎngqiú.
en: He discovered a tennis ball was missing while organizing his sports bag.

zh: 他总是站在舞台旁边观察演员的表演。
pinyin: Tā zǒngshì zhàn zài wǔtái pángbiān guānchá yǎnyuán de biǎoyǎn.
en: He always stands next to the stage to observe the actors' performance.

zh: 为了方便，我总是带一些现金在身上。
pinyin: Wèile fāngbiàn, wǒ zǒng shì dài yīxiē xiànjīn zài shēnshang.
en: For convenience, I always carry some cash with me.

zh: 这篇文章里的每一个句子我都能看懂。
pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng lǐ de měi yī gè jù zi wǒ dōu néng kàndǒng.
en: I can understand every sentence in this article.

zh: 请你走上去，把那一排书架整理一下。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zǒu shàng qù, bǎ nà yī pái shūjià zhěnglǐ yīxià.
en: Please go up and tidy up that row of bookshelves.

zh: 虽然周末很忙，但我还是想去公园散步。

zh: 我们需要用最简单的方法来解决这个问题。

en: The situations on these two sides are completely different, making it hard to compare.

pinyin: Duìyú zhè jiàn shì, dàjiā dōu tóngyì tā de kànfǎ.
en: Regarding this matter, everyone agrees with his point of view.

zh: 这是一家专门生产环保产品的公司。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī jiā zhuānmén shēngchǎn huánbǎo chǎnpǐn de gōngsī.

zh: 我们需要统计一下参加活动的人数。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào tǒngjì yīxià cānjiā huódòng de rénshù.

zh: 请尽量在午饭时间之前完成这项任务。

zh: 这种新型设备在工业生产中非常有用。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīnxíng shèbèi zài gōngyè shēngchǎn zhōng fēicháng yǒu yòng.

zh: 报告人正在介绍行业未来的发展趋势。

zh: 考虑到考试的难度，他决定提前复习。
pinyin: Kǎolǜ dào kǎoshì de nándù, tā juédìng tíqián fùxí.
en: Considering the difficulty of the exam, he decided to review in advance.

zh: 为了避免迟到，他提前半小时出发了。
pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn chídào, tā tíqián bàn xiǎoshí chūfā le.
en: In order to avoid arriving late, he set off half an hour early.

pinyin: yóu yú tiān qì yuán yúan yīn, jī chǎng qǔ xiāo le suǒ yǒu háng bān.

pinyin: Nà fèn rì bào shàng dēng le yī gè fēicháng yǒuqù de xiāoxi.
en: An interesting piece of news was published in that daily newspaper.

pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de chūzūchē fúwù zhìliàng yīzhí hěn hǎo.

zh: 既然大家都同意，我们就这么决定吧。
pinyin: jì rán dà jiā dōu tóng yì, wǒ men jiù zhè me jué dìng ba.
en: Since everyone agrees, let's decide it this way.

zh: 为了锻炼身体，他坚持每个月去爬山。
pinyin: Wèile duànliàn shēntǐ, tā jiānchí měi gè yuè qù páshān.
en: In order to keep fit, he persists in going hiking every month.

pinyin: Tā zuò zài miànshìguān miànqián, xiǎnde fēicháng yǒu zìxìn.
en: He sat facing the interviewer, appearing very confident.

zh: 虽然去长城的路很远，但是风景很美。
pinyin: Suīrán qù Chángchéng de lù hěn yuǎn, dànshì fēngjǐng hěn měi.
en: Although the road to the Great Wall is very far, the scenery is beautiful.

pinyin: Wúshù de shìshí zhèngmíngle tā de guāndiǎn shì zhèngquè de.
en: Numberless facts prove his point of view is correct.

zh: 为了保护环境，我们应该少用塑料袋。
pinyin: Wèile bǎohù huánjìng, wǒmen yīnggāi shǎo yòng sùliàodài.
en: In order to protect the environment, we should use fewer plastic bags.

zh: 他建议在聚会上提供一些高品质的红酒。
pinyin: Tā jiànyì zài jùhuì shàng tígōng yīxiē gāo pǐnzhì de hóngjiǔ.
en: He suggested providing some high-quality red wine at the party.

zh: 你可以在日历上画个圈，记住那个日子。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài rìlì shàng huà gè quān, jìzhù nàge rìzi.
en: You can draw a circle on the calendar to remember that day.

zh: 既然你已经尽力了，结果如何都没关系。
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ yǐjīng jìnlì le, jiéguǒ rúhé dōu méi guānxi.
en: Since you have already tried your best, it doesn't matter what the result is.

zh: 为了买到更便宜的机票，我提前预订了。

pinyin: Suīrán tā jiěshì le hěnduō, dàn wǒ háishì bù tài lǐjiě.
en: Although he explained a lot, I still don't really understand.

zh: 为了保持清醒，他每天都要喝两杯咖啡。
pinyin: Wèile bǎochí qīngxǐng, tā měitiān dōu yào hē liǎng bēi kāfēi.
en: In order to stay awake, he drinks two cups of coffee every day.

zh: 无论你付出多少努力，成功都需要时间。
pinyin: wú lùn nǐ fù chū duō shǎo nǔ lì, chéng gōng dōu xū yào shí jiān.

pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng fēicháng jīngcǎi, shòudàole dàjiā de huānyíng.

pinyin: Zhè shì yī cì bǎoguì de jiàoxun, xīwàng nǐ yǐhòu zhùyì.

zh: 我洗完澡以后，喜欢用大毛巾擦干身体。
pinyin: wǒ xǐ wán zǎo yǐ hòu, xǐ huān yòng dà máo jīn cā gān shēn tǐ.
en: After I finish bathing, I like to use a big towel to dry my body.

pinyin: Jīnnián wǒmen xuéxiào jǔbànle duō cì wénhuà jiāoliú huódòng.

pinyin: tōng guò diào chá, zhuān jiā dé chū le yī xiē zhòng yào de jié lùn.
en: Through the investigation, experts obtained some important conclusions.

pinyin: Zhèxiē yōuxiù de chuàngzuò fēngfùle wǒmen de wénhuà shēnghuó.

zh: 无论发生什么，我们都要尽力解决问题。
pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme, wǒmen dōu yào jìnlì jiějué wèntí.

pinyin: yóu yú xīng qī rì yǒu zhòng yào huì yì, jīng lǐ bù dé bù jiā bān.

pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔbā de huánjìng fēicháng shūshì, shìhé péngyǒu jùhuì.

zh: 这种行为会严重伤害大家的感情。

zh: 我们必须充分利用一切有利条件。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū chōngfèn lìyòng yīqiè yǒulì tiáojiàn.
en: We must make full use of all advantageous conditions.

zh: 维持社会的保安是每个人的责任。
pinyin: Wéichí shèhuì de bǎo ān shì měi gè rén de zérèn.
en: Maintaining public security is everyone's responsibility.

zh: 该项目成功地应用了先进的材料。
pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù chénggōng de yìngyòngle xiānjìn de cáiliào.
en: The project successfully put advanced materials to use.

zh: 这项工程预计需要半年才能完工。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngchéng yùjì xūyào bàn nián cáinéng wángōng.
en: It is estimated that this project will take half a year to complete.

zh: 他始终保持诚实，所以赢得了信任。
pinyin: Tā shǐzhōng bǎochí chéngshí, suǒyǐ yíngdéyǐ le xìnrèn.
en: He has always remained honest, therefore he won trust.

zh: 会议室里整齐地排列着一排排椅子。
pinyin: Huìyìshì lǐ zhěngqí de páiliè zhe yì pái pái yǐzi.
en: Rows of chairs are arranged neatly in the conference room.

zh: 我们大家都应该积极参与这项比赛。
pinyin: Wǒmen dàjiā dōu yīnggāi jījí cānyù zhè xiàng bǐsài.
en: We should all actively participate in this competition.

zh: 这本词典收录了许多现代汉语词汇。
pinyin: Zhè běn cídiǎn shōulùle xǔduō xiàndài Hànyǔ cíhuì.
en: This dictionary contains many modern Chinese vocabulary words.

zh: 在环保方面，政府采取了积极措施。
pinyin: Zài huánbǎo fāngmiàn, zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ le jījí cuòshī.
en: In terms of environmental protection, the government has taken active measures.

zh: 总理向全国人民发表了重要的讲话。
pinyin: Zǒnglǐ xiàng quánguó rénmín fābiǎo le zhòngyào de jiǎnghuà.
en: The Prime Minister delivered an important speech to the people of the whole country.

zh: 关于未来趋势，专家们有不同观点。
pinyin: Guānyú wèilái qūshì, zhuānjiāmen yǒu bùtóng guāndiǎn.
en: With regard to future trends, experts have different viewpoints.

zh: 如果你老是担心错误，就无法进步。
pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ lǎo shì dān xīn cuò wù jiù wú fǎ jìn bù
en: If you are always worrying about mistakes, you cannot improve.

zh: 他完全依靠自己的能力取得了成功。
pinyin: Tā wánquán yīkào zìjǐ de nénglì qǔdéle chénggōng.
en: He relied entirely on his own ability to achieve success.

zh: 为了实现目标，他一直在努力奋斗。
pinyin: Wèi le shí xiàn mù biāo, tā yī zhí zài nǔ lì fèn dòu.
en: To realize his goal, he has been making an effort to strive.

zh: 无论多晚，统一总会为你提供方便。
pinyin: Wúlùn duō wǎn, Tǒngyī zǒng huì wèi nǐ tígōng fāngbiàn.
en: No matter how late it is, 7-Eleven will always provide convenience for you.

zh: 许多人对未来的科技发展充满好奇。
pinyin: xǔ duō rén duì wèi lái de kē jì fā zhǎn chōng mǎn hào qí.
en: Many people are curious about the future development of technology.

zh: 这个学期的教学任务已经圆满完成。
pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqī de jiàoxué rènwù yǐjīng yuánmǎn wánchéng.
en: The teaching tasks for this term have been successfully completed.

zh: 由于压力，他的心理状态不够正常。
pinyin: Yóuyú yālì, tā de xīnlǐ zhuàngtài bùgòu zhèngcháng.
en: Due to pressure, his mental state is not quite normal.

zh: 会议期间，大家进行了深入的交流。
pinyin: Huìyì qījiān, dàjiā jìnxíngle shēnrù de jiāoliú.
en: During the meeting, everyone had in-depth exchanges.

zh: 这部分数据具有显著的统计学意义。
pinyin: Zhè bùfen shùjù jùyǒu xiǎnzhù de tǒngjìxué yìyì.
en: This part of the data has significant statistical meaning.

zh: 为了提高效率，我们需要重新分组。
pinyin: Wèile tígāo xiàolǜ, wǒmen xūyào chóngxīn fēn zǔ.
en: In order to improve efficiency, we need to regroup.

zh: 他在加油站加满油后继续开车赶路。
pinyin: Tā zài jiāyóuzhàn jiāmǎn yóu hòu jìxù kāichē gǎnlù.
en: After filling up the tank at the gas station, he continued his journey.

zh: 如果你想寄信，就得去邮局买邮票。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng jì xìn, jiù děi qù yóujú mǎi yóupiào.
en: If you want to send a letter, you have to go to the post office to buy stamps.

zh: 为了吸引顾客，他一直在努力创新。
pinyin: Wèile xīyǐn gùkè, tā yīzhí zài nǔlì chuàngxīn.
en: In order to attract customers, he has been working hard to create new ideas.

zh: 每到秋季，公园里的树叶就变黄了。
pinyin: Měi dào qiūjì, gōngyuán lǐ de shùyè jiù biàn huáng le.
en: Every autumn, the leaves in the park turn yellow.

zh: 她穿上那条红色的裙子，显得很漂亮。
pinyin: Tā chuānshàng nà tiáo hóngsè de qúnzi, xiǎnde hěn piàoliang.
en: She looks very beautiful wearing that red skirt.

zh: 由于成绩优秀，他被重点大学录取了。
pinyin: Yóuyú chéngjì yōuxiù, tā bèi zhòngdiǎn dàxué lùqǔ le.
en: Because of excellent grades, he was accepted by a key university.

zh: 他在面临巨大压力的情况下勇敢创业。
pinyin: Tā zài miànlín jùdà yālì de qíngkuàng xià yǒnggǎn chuàngyè.
en: He bravely began his undertaking despite facing immense pressure.

zh: 作者通过生动的语言描写了那个故事。
pinyin: Zuòzhě tōngguò shēngdòng de yǔyán miáoxiě le nàge gùshì.
en: The author described the story through vivid language.

zh: 他虽然已到中年，但依然很努力工作。
pinyin: Tā suīrán yǐ dào zhōngnián, dàn yīrán hěn nǔlì gōngzuò.
en: Although he has reached middle age, he still works very hard.

zh: 多年的合作让他们建立了深厚的感情。
pinyin: Duō nián de hé zuò ràng tā men jiàn lì le shēn hòu de gǎn qíng.
en: Years of cooperation have allowed them to build a deep bond.

zh: 由于准备充分，谈判进展得非常顺利。
pinyin: Yóuyú zhǔnbèi chōngfèn, tánpàn jìnzhǎn de fēicháng shùnlì.
en: Due to sufficient preparation, the negotiations proceeded very smoothly.

zh: 这项建议在会议上引起了激烈的争论。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng jiànyì zài huìyì shàng yǐnqǐle jīliè de zhēnglùn.
en: This proposal sparked heated debate at the meeting.

zh: 他始终把妻子和孩子的利益放在首位。
pinyin: tā shǐ zhōng bǎ qī zi hé hái zi de lì yì fàng zài shǒu wèi
en: He always puts the interests of his wife and children first.

zh: 公司投入了大量的资源来开发新产品。
pinyin: Gōngsī tóurùle dàliàng de zīyuán lái kāifā xīn chǎnpǐn.
en: The company invested a large amount of resources to develop new products.

zh: 经过反复思考，他决定接受这个挑战。
pinyin: Jīngguò fǎnfù sīkǎo, tā juédìng jiēshòu zhè gè tiǎozhàn.
en: After thinking about it repeatedly, he decided to accept this challenge.

zh: 出门前检查一下身上是否带齐了证件。
pinyin: Chūmén qián jiǎnchá yīxià shēnshang shìfǒu dàiqí le zhèngjiàn.
en: Before going out, check if you have your documents with you.

zh: 请检查一下所有的机器是否已经关闭。
pinyin: Qǐng jiǎnchá yīxià suǒyǒu de jīqì shìfǒu yǐjīng guānbì.
en: Please check if all machines have been shut down.

zh: 因为迟到了，他不得不向老师解释原因。
pinyin: Yīnwèi chídào le, tā bù dé bù xiàng lǎoshī jiěshì yuányīn.
en: Because he was late, he had no choice but to explain the reason to the teacher.

zh: 虽然他失败了，但我依然相信他的能力。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shībài le, dàn wǒ yīrán xiāngxìn tā de nénglì.
en: Although he failed, I still believe in his ability.

zh: 为了按时完成计划，大家都在努力工作。
pinyin: Wèile ànshí wánchéng jìhuà, dàjiā dōu zài nǔlì gōngzuò.
en: In order to complete the plan on time, everyone is working hard.

zh: 这位专家亲自主持了这次高难度的手术。
pinyin: Zhè wèi zhuānjiā qīnzì zhǔchí le zhè cì gāo nándù de shǒushù.
en: This expert personally directed this high-difficulty operation.

zh: 我们要保护环境，例如减少使用塑料袋。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎohù huánjìng, lìrú jiǎnshǎo shǐyòng sùliàodài.
en: We must protect the environment, for example, by reducing the use of plastic bags.

zh: 在正式宣布下课之前，请大家保持安静。
pinyin: zài zhèng shì xuān bù xià kè zhī qián, qǐng dà jiā bǎo chí ān jìng.
en: Before officially being dismissed, please remain quiet.

zh: 为了健康，我们应该养成吃早餐的习惯。
pinyin: Wèile jiànkāng, wǒmen yīnggāi yǎngchéng chī zǎocān de xíguàn.
en: For the sake of health, we should develop the habit of eating breakfast.

zh: 政府部门正在对这些食品进行质量检测。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ bùmén zhèngzài duì zhèxiē shípǐn jìnxíng zhìliàng jiǎncè.
en: Government departments are currently conducting quality inspections on these food items.

zh: 这项工程至少需要两年的时间才能完成。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngchéng zhìshǎo xūyào liǎng nián de shíjiān cáinéng wánchéng.
en: This project will require at least two years to complete.

zh: 在多数情况下，这种现象是可以避免的。
pinyin: zài duō shù qíng kuàng xià, zhè zhǒng xiàn xiàng shì kě yǐ bì miǎn de.
en: In the majority of cases, this phenomenon can be avoided.

zh: 为了节省时间，我通常简单地解决中餐。
pinyin: Wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, wǒ tōngcháng jiǎndān de jiějué zhōngcān.
en: In order to save time, I usually settle for a quick lunch.

zh: 因为气候温暖，很多人搬到了南部居住。
pinyin: Yīnwèi qìhòu wēnnuǎn, hěnduō rén bāndào le nánbù jūzhù.
en: Because the climate is warm, many people moved to the southern part to live.

zh: 在这项工程上投入过多资金是一种浪费。
pinyin: Zài zhè xiàng gōngchéng shàng tóurù guòduō zījīn shì yī zhǒng làngfèi.
en: Investing too much capital into this project is a waste.

zh: 离开家乡多年，他依然记得童年的美好。
pinyin: lí kāi jiā xiāng duō nián, tā yī rán jì dé tóng nián de měi hǎo.
en: Having left his hometown for many years, he still remembers the beauty of his childhood.

zh: 她丈夫通过努力工作，终于获得了成功。
pinyin: Tā zhàngfu tōngguò nǔlì gōngzuò, zhōngyú huòdé le chénggōng.
en: Her husband finally achieved success through hard work.

zh: 由于准备充分，这次活动进行得非常完美。
pinyin: Yóuyú zhǔnbèi chōngfèn, zhè cì huódòng jìnxíng de fēicháng wánměi.
en: Due to sufficient preparation, this activity went perfectly.

zh: 妹妹在学术会议上发表了极其精彩的演讲。
pinyin: Mèimei zài xuéshù huìyì shàng fābiǎole jíqí jīngcǎi de yǎnjiǎng.
en: My younger sister gave an extremely wonderful speech at the academic conference.

zh: 在这个复杂环境下，需要保持清醒的头脑。
pinyin: zài zhè gè fù zá huán jìng xià, xū yào bǎo chí qīng xǐng de tóu nǎo.
en: In this complex environment, one needs to keep a clear mind.

zh: 为了改善农村的经济，政府做了很多努力。
pinyin: Wèile gǎishàn nóngcūn de jīngjì, zhèngfǔ zuò le hěnduō nǔlì.
en: In order to improve the economy of rural areas, the government has made many efforts.

zh: 面对这种不公平的待遇，他感到非常难受。
pinyin: miànduì zhè zhǒng bù gōngpíng de dàiyù, tā gǎndào fēicháng nánshòu.
en: Facing such unfair treatment, he finds it hard to bear.

zh: 由于天气原因，所有的航班都停止了起飞。
pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì yuányīn, suǒyǒu de hángbān dōu tíngzhǐ le qǐfēi.
en: Due to weather conditions, all flights have stopped taking off.

zh: 由于大雪封路，车辆在两公里外就停下了。
pinyin: Yóuyú dàxuě fēnglù, chēliàng zài liǎng gōnglǐ wài jiù tíng xiàle.
en: Due to the heavy snow blocking the road, the vehicles stopped two kilometers away.

zh: 这两个国家之间的友好关系一直保持至今。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè guójiā zhī jiān de yǒuhǎo guānxì yīzhí bǎochí zhìjīn.
en: The friendly relations between these two countries have been maintained continuously until now.

zh: 也许在某种程度上，这是一种必然的趋势。
pinyin: Yěxǔ zài mǒu zhǒng chéngdù shàng, zhè shì yī zhǒng bìrán de qūshì.
en: Perhaps to some extent, this is an inevitable trend.

zh: 你先填好这张表格，然后交给办公室的老师。
pinyin: Nǐ xiān tiánhǎo zhè zhāng biǎogé, ránhòu jiāogěi bàngōngshì de lǎoshī.
en: First fill out this form, then hand it to the teacher in the office.

zh: 为了完成这项任务，我们需要找个能干的人。
pinyin: Wèile wánchéng zhè xiàng rènwù, wǒmen xūyào zhǎo gè nénggàn de rén.
en: In order to complete this task, we need to find a competent person.

zh: 这种管理方法在很大程度上提高了工作效率。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng guǎnlǐ fāngfǎ zài hěn dà chéngdù shàng tígāo le gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
en: This management method has greatly improved work efficiency.

zh: 虽然他有很多经验，但是遇到困难还是会紧张。
pinyin: Suīrán tā yǒu hěnduō jīngyàn, dànshì yùdào kùnnán háishì huì jǐnzhāng.
en: Although he has a lot of experience, he still gets nervous when encountering difficulties.

zh: 为了准时到达公司，他每天早上都要倒车两次。
pinyin: Wèile zhǔnshí dàodá gōngsī, tā měitiān zǎoshang dōu yào dǎochē liǎng cì.
en: In order to arrive at the company on time, he has to change buses twice every morning.

zh: 无论天气多么热，他们依然在操场上练习排球。
pinyin: Wúlùn tiānqì duōme rè, tāmen yīrán zài cāochǎng shàng liànxí páiqiú.
en: No matter how hot the weather is, they are still practicing volleyball on the playground.

zh: 经过几年的努力，他在中学阶段取得了优秀的成绩。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ nián de nǔlì, tā zài zhōngxué jiēduàn qǔdéle yōuxiù de chéngjì.
en: After several years of hard work, he achieved excellent results during his middle school years.

zh: 由于工作压力太大，他的身体出现了严重的健康问题。
pinyin: Yóuyú gōngzuò yālì tài dà, tā de shēntǐ chūxiàn le yánzhòng de jiànkāng wèntí.
en: Due to excessive work stress, he has developed serious health problems.

zh: 他不仅汉语水平很高，而且对中国文化也有深入的研究。
pinyin: Tā bùjǐn Hànyǔ shuǐpíng hěn gāo, érqiě duì Zhōngguó wénhuà yě yǒu shēnrù de yánjiū.
en: He not only has a high level of Chinese proficiency but also has deep research into Chinese culture.

zh: 他在国外生活了多年，现在的外语水平已经相当流利了。
pinyin: Tā zài guówài shēnghuó le duōnián, xiànzài de wàiyǔ shuǐpíng yǐjīng xiāngdāng liúlì le.
en: He has lived abroad for many years, and his foreign language proficiency is now quite fluent.

zh: 通过这次实习，我不但积累了经验，还认识了许多朋友。
pinyin: Tōngguò zhè cì shíxí, wǒ bùdàn jīlěi le jīngyàn, hái rènshí le xǔduō péngyǒu.
en: Through this internship, I not only gained experience but also made many friends.

zh: 超市经常处理大量的散装食品。
pinyin: Chāoshì jīngcháng chǔlǐ dàliàng de sànzhuāng shípǐn.
en: The supermarket often handles bulk food products.

zh: 该大楼完全按照环保标准建成。
pinyin: gāi dàlóu wánquánwán ànzhào huánbǎo biāozhǔn jiànchéng.
en: The building was built entirely in accordance with environmental standards.

zh: 预计该项目总投入达到五百万。
pinyin: yùjì gāi xiàngmù zǒng tóurù dádào wǔ bǎi wàn.
en: The total investment for the project is estimated to reach five million.

zh: 球场翻修工程预计下个月完工。
pinyin: Qiúchǎng fānxiū gōngchéng yùjì xià gè yuè wángōng.
en: The renovation project of the sports ground is expected to be completed next month.

zh: 此举表明了公司改善环境的决心。
pinyin: Cǐjǔ biǎomíng le gōngsī gǎishàn huánjìng de juéxīn.
en: This move makes known the company's determination to improve the environment.

zh: 面对危险时，他表现得十分勇敢。
pinyin: miàn duì wēi xiǎn shí, tā biǎo xiàn dé shí fēn yǒng gǎn.
en: When facing danger, he behaved very bravely.

zh: 许多父母为子女的未来感到担心。
pinyin: Xǔduō fùmǔ wèi zǐnǚ de wèilái gǎndào dānxīn.
en: Many parents feel worried about their children's future.

zh: 这项青年人才培养计划意义重大。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng qīngnián réncái péiyǎng jìhuà yìyì zhòngdà.
en: This young talent training program is of great significance.

zh: 他在马拉松比赛中一直保持领先。
pinyin: tā zài mǎ lā sōng bǐ sài zhōng yī zhí bǎo chí lǐng xiān.
en: He has maintained the lead throughout the marathon.

zh: 秘书负责通知相关人员参加会议。
pinyin: Mìshū fùzé tōngzhī xiāngguān rényuán cānjiā huìyì.
en: The secretary is responsible for notifying the relevant personnel to attend the meeting.

zh: 全球化的发展深刻影响了就业结构。
pinyin: Quánqiúhuà de fāzhǎn shēnkè yǐngxiǎng le jiùyè jiégòu.
en: The development of globalization has deeply affected the employment structure.

zh: 为了吸引顾客，超市决定打折促销。
pinyin: Wèile xīyǐn gùkè, chāoshì juédìng dǎzhé cùxiāo.
en: In order to attract customers, the supermarket decided to hold a promotional sale.

zh: 科学研究表明，经济成长需要创新。
pinyin: Kēxué yánjiū biǎomíng, jīngjì chéngzhǎng xūyào chuàngxīn.
en: Scientific research shows that economic growth requires innovation.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但成功不必完全靠运气。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn chénggōng bù bì wánquán kào yùnqì.
en: Although he is busy, success is not necessarily entirely dependent on luck.

zh: 只有完成功课，才能获得优秀的成绩。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu wánchéng gōngkè, cáinéng huòdé yōuxiù de chéngjì.
en: Only by finishing homework can one obtain excellent grades.

zh: 我自觉能力有限，恐怕无法完成任务。

zh: 这项方案能够有效地解决当前的问题。

zh: 他放心地把公司业务交给助理去负责。

zh: 为了改善交通，政府修建了新的地铁线。

zh: 他早就意识到这种做法存在巨大的风险。
pinyin: Tā zǎo jiù yìshí dào zhè zhǒng zuòfǎ cúnzài jùdà de fēngxiǎn.
en: He realized a long time ago that this approach had huge risks.

zh: 为了吸引更多客户，我们决定调整价格。
pinyin: Wèile xīyǐn gèng duō kèhù, wǒmen juédìng tiáozhěng jiàgé.

en: In order to research the new project, he stays in the laboratory almost every day.

zh: 经过多轮面试，他终于获得了这个理想的职位。

en: After several rounds of interviews, he finally obtained this ideal position.

zh: 虽然小时候的生活很艰苦，但他一直努力学习。

zh: 随着生活水平的提高，越来越多的人开始习惯吃西餐。

pinyin: Fùmǔ duì zǐnǚ de qīwàng wǎngwǎng huì gěi tāmen dài lái jùdà de xīnlǐ yālì.

zh: 面对同样的困难，有的员工选择了放弃，有的却坚持到了最后。

en: Faced with the same difficulties, some employees chose to give up, while others persisted to the end.

zh: 我们这样做，一方面是为了节约成本，另一方面是为了提高效率。
pinyin: wǒ men zhè yàng zuò, yī fāng miàn shì wèi le jié yuē chéng běn, lǐng yī fāng miàn shì wèi le tí gāo xié gāo xiào lǜ.
en: We are doing this; on the one hand, to save costs, and on the other, to improve efficiency.

zh: 由于火警，所有出口已被暂时关闭。

en: Due to the fire alarm, all exits have been temporarily closed.

zh: 该企业为所有职工提供了良好的福利待遇。

zh: 我们必须改变这种被动的局面，主动寻求解决方案。

en: To encourage the children to exercise, the school distributed a new soccer ball to each class.

zh: 这种徒劳无益的争论简直没用。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng túláowúyì de zhēnglùn jiǎnzhí méi yòng.
en: This kind of futile argument is simply useless.

zh: 这种精密加工技术处于领先地位。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng jīng mì jiā gōng jì shù chǔ yú lǐng xiān dì wèi 。
en: This precision processing technology is in a leading position.

zh: 现代化的陆军具有极强的战斗力。
pinyin: Xiàn dài huà de lù jūn jù yǒu jí qiáng de zhàn dòu lì.
en: A modernized ground force possesses extremely strong combat capability.

zh: 该企业的核心竞争力已初步形成。
pinyin: Gāi qǐyè de héxīn jìngzhēnglì yǐ chūbù xíngchéng.
en: The core competitiveness of the enterprise has initially taken shape.

zh: 全球变暖导致极端高温天气频发。
pinyin: Quánqiú biànnuǎn dǎozhì jíduān gāowēn tiānqì pínfā.
en: Global warming has led to the frequent occurrence of extreme high-temperature weather.

zh: 会议结束后，经理与每位员工握手。
pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, jīnglǐ yǔ měi wèi yuángōng wòshǒu.
en: After the meeting ended, the manager shook hands with every employee.

zh: 通过理财，我们可以让生活变得更好。
pinyin: Tōngguò lǐcái, wǒmen kěyǐ ràng shēnghuó biàn de gèng hǎo.
en: Through managing wealth, we can make life better.

zh: 为了提高效率，老板决定给员工加薪。
pinyin: wèi le tí gāo xiào lǜ, lǎo bǎn jué dìng gěi yuán gōng jiā xīn.
en: In order to improve efficiency, the boss decided to give the employees a raise.

zh: 志愿者们通过各种方式关爱留守儿童。
pinyin: Zhìyuànzhěmen tōngguò gèzhǒng fāngshì guān'ài liúshǒu értóng.
en: Volunteers care for left-behind children in various ways.

zh: 他们始终一同战斗，为实现理想而奋斗。
pinyin: Tāmen shǐzhōng yītóng zhàndòu, wèi shí, wèi shíxiàn lǐxiǎng ér fèndòu.
en: They fought together from beginning to end, striving to realize their ideals.

zh: 这项科研成果成为了学术界关注的热点。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng kē yán chéng guǒ chéng wéi le xué shù jiè guān zhù de rè diǎn.
en: This scientific research achievement has become a point of interest in the academic community.

zh: 中华艺术博大精深，值得我们深入研究。
pinyin: Zhōnghuá yìshù bódàjīngshēn, zhídé wǒmen shēnrù yánjiū.
en: Zhonghua art is broad and profound, worthy of our in-depth study.

zh: 政府采取的政策促使当地经济迅速发展。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ de zhèngcè cùshǐ dāngdì jīngjì xùnsù fāzhǎn.
en: The policies adopted by the government prompted the local economy to develop rapidly.

zh: 这种管理方式不再适应公司当前的发展。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng guǎn lǐ fāng shì bú zài shì yìng gōng sī dāng qián de fā zhǎn.
en: This management style no longer suits the current development of the company.

zh: 为了吸引更多顾客，商城举办了促销活动。
pinyin: Wèile xīyǐn gèng duō gùkè, shāngchéng jǔbànle cùxiāo huódòng.
en: To attract more customers, the mall held a promotional event.

zh: 由于天气原因，原定起飞的航班被推迟了。
pinyin: yóuyú tiānqì yuányīn, yuándìng qǐfēi de hángbān bèi tuīchí le.
en: Due to the weather, the flight scheduled to take off was delayed.

zh: 为了项目的顺利进行，处长决定调整人员。
pinyin: Wèile xiàngmù de shùnlì jìnxíng, chùzhǎng juédìng tiáozhěng rényuán.
en: For the smooth progress of the project, the department head decided to adjust the personnel.

zh: 为了顺利毕业，你得完成所有的必修任务。
pinyin: Wèile shùnlì bìyè, nǐ děi wánchéng suǒyǒu de bìxiū rènwù.
en: In order to graduate smoothly, you must complete all compulsory tasks.

zh: 我们必须学会接受挑战，并从中积累经验。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū xuéhuì jiēshòu tiǎozhàn, bìng cóngzhōng jīlěi jīngyàn.
en: We must learn to accept challenges and accumulate experience from them.

zh: 通过系统训练，他的专业基础变得扎实了。
pinyin: Tōngguò xìtǒng xùnliàn, tā de zhuānyè jīchǔ biàn de zhāshi le.
en: Through systematic training, his basic professional skills became solid.

zh: 这些古老神话的生存意义在于其哲学价值。
pinyin: Zhèxiē gǔlǎo shénhuà de shēngcún yìyì zàiyú qí zhéxué jiàzhí.
en: The significance of the existence of these ancient myths lies in their philosophical value.

zh: 建筑公司需要大量的水泥来完成这项工程。
pinyin: Jiànzhù gōngsī xūyào dàliàng de shuǐní lái wánchéng zhè xiàng gōngchéng.
en: The construction company needs a large amount of cement to complete this project.

zh: 为了参加比赛，我特意换了一个更轻的球拍。
pinyin: Wèile cānjiā bǐsài, wǒ tèyì huànle yīgè gèng qīng de qiúpāi.
en: In order to participate in the competition, I specifically changed to a lighter racket.

zh: 由于房东要收回房屋，我们不得不仓促搬家。
pinyin: Yóuyú fángdōng yào shōuhuí fángwū, wǒmen bùdébù cāngcù bān jiā.
en: Since the landlord wants to reclaim the property, we have to move house in a hurry.

zh: 尽管面临种种困难，他依然坚持完成了任务。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn miànlín zhǒng zhǒng kùnnán, tā yīrán jiānchí wánchéngle rènwù.
en: Despite facing all kinds of difficulties, he persisted and completed the task.

zh: 上周的招聘会吸引了许多优秀的应届毕业生。
pinyin: Shàng zhōu de zhāopìnhuì xīyǐnle xǔduō yōuxiùxiù de yìngjiè bìyèshēng.
en: Last week's job fair attracted many excellent fresh graduates.

zh: 经过激烈的竞争，最后只剩下三家企业入围。
pinyin: Jīngguò jīliè de jìngzhēng, zuìhòu zhǐ shèngxià sān jiā qǐyè rùwéi.
en: After fierce competition, only three enterprises remain to be shortlisted.

zh: 此次金融危机对全球经济造成了巨大的冲击。
pinyin: cǐ cì jīn róng wēi jī duì quán qiú jīng jì zào chéng le jù dà de chōng jī.
en: This financial crisis has caused a huge shock to the global economy.

zh: 为了提高效率，他决定采取自主研发的策略。
pinyin: Wèi le tí gāo xiào lǜ, tā jué dìng cǎi qǔ zì zhǔ yán fā de cè lüè.
en: In order to improve efficiency, he decided to adopt a strategy of independent research and development.

zh: 为了方便员工，公司在办公楼内设立了食堂。
pinyin: Wèile fāngbiàn yuángōng, gōngsī zài bàngōnglóu nèi shèlìle shítáng.
en: For the convenience of employees, the company established a dining hall inside the office building.

zh: 为了防止青少年吸毒，学校开展了禁毒教育。
pinyin: Wèile fángzhǐ qīngshàonián xī dú, xuéxiào kāizhǎnle jìndú jiàoyù.
en: To prevent teenagers from taking drugs, the school launched anti-drug education.

zh: 他在面对困难时，总是表现出惊人的意志力。
pinyin: Tā zài miànduì kùnnán shí, zǒngshì biǎoxiàn chū jīngrén de yìzhìlì.
en: He always shows amazing willpower when facing difficulties.

zh: 该住宅建筑风格独特，具有很高的艺术价值。
pinyin: Gāi zhùzhái jiànzhù fēnggé dútè, jùyǒu hěn gāo de yìshù jiàzhí.
en: The residential building has a unique architectural style and holds high artistic value.

zh: 由于系统升级，所有的软件都需要重新安装。
pinyin: Yóuyú xìtǒng shēngjí, suǒyǒu de ruǎnjiàn dōu xūyào chóngxīn ānzhuāng.
en: Due to the system upgrade, all software needs to be reinstalled.

zh: 良好的教育往往是一个人事业成功的逻辑起点。

zh: 相比于传统的教育方式，现在的教学更加灵活。
pinyin: Xiāng bǐ yú chuántǒng de jiàoyù fāngshì, xiànzài de jiàoxué gèngjiā línghuó.
en: Compared to traditional teaching methods, current teaching is more flexible.

zh: 面对如此复杂的局面，经理不禁感到有些头疼。
pinyin: Miànduì rúcǐ fùzá de júmiàn, jīnglǐ bùjīn gǎndào yǒuxiē tóuténg.
en: Facing such a complex situation, the manager couldn't help but feel a bit troubled.

zh: 那个男孩儿展现出了超越其年龄的成熟与深沉。
pinyin: Nàge nánháir zhǎnxiàn chū le chāoyuè qí niánlíng de chéngshú yǔ shēnchén.
en: The boy displayed a maturity and depth beyond his years.

zh: 随着经济的发展，大陆的市场吸引了许多外资。
pinyin: suí zhe jīng jì de fā zhǎn, dà lù de shì chǎng xī yǐn le xǔ duō wài zī.
en: With economic development, the mainland China market has attracted a lot of foreign investment.

zh: 相关部门发布了应对气候变化的最新战略方针。
pinyin: Xiāngguān bùmén fābùle yìngduì qìhòu biànhuà de zuìxīn zhànlüè fāngzhēn.
en: The relevant departments have released the latest strategic guidelines for responding to climate change.

zh: 为了提升专业技能，他报名参加了中级培训班。
pinyin: Wèile tíshēng zhuānyè jìnéng, tā bàomíng cānjiāle zhōngjí péixùn bān.
en: In order to improve his professional skills, he enrolled in an intermediate training course.

zh: 由于系统出现故障，我们不得不重新安装软件。
pinyin: Yóuyú xìtǒng chūxiàn gùzhàng, wǒmen bùdébù chóngxīn ānzhuāng ruǎnjiàn.
en: Due to a system failure, we have to reinstall the software.

zh: 请问，针对这项新政策，贵公司持有何种立场？
pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhēnduì zhè xiàng xīn zhèngcè, guì gōngsī chíyǒu hé zhǒng lìchǎng?
en: Excuse me, regarding this new policy, what is your company's position?

zh: 为了扩大市场，这家企业选择与国外机构签约。
pinyin: Wèile kuòdà shìchǎng, zhè jiā qǐyè xuǎnzé yǔ guówài jīgòu qiānyuē.
en: In order to expand the market, this enterprise chose to sign a contract with a foreign institution.

zh: 通过不断完善教材，教育质量得到了显著提升。
pinyin: Tōngguò bùduàn wánshàn jiàocái, jiàoyù zhìliàng dédào le xiǎnzhù tíshēng.
en: By constantly improving teaching materials, the quality of education has been significantly improved.

zh: 为了减少污染，政府限制了城市里的机动车数量。
pinyin: Wèi le jiǎn shǎo wū rǎn, zhèng fǔ xiàn zhì le chéng shì lǐ de jī dòng chē shù liàng.
en: To reduce pollution, the government has limited the number of motor vehicles in the city.

zh: 虽然只是路过，但我对这个美丽的小镇印象深刻。
pinyin: Suīrán zhǐshì lùguò, dàn wǒ duì zhège měilì de xiǎo zhèn yìnxiàng shēnkè.
en: Although I was just passing through, I was deeply impressed by this beautiful small town.

zh: 表演结束后，观众们热烈地鼓掌，掌声响了很久。
pinyin: Biǎoyǎn jiéshù hòu, guānzhòngmen rèliè de gǔzhǎng, zhǎngshēng xiǎng le hěn jiǔ.
en: After the performance ended, the audience applauded enthusiastically, and the applause lasted for a long time.

zh: 直到刚才，我才意识到自己犯了一个严重的错误。

en: Only until just now did I realize that I had made a serious mistake.

zh: 为了扩大业务，总部已经在海外设立了多个分部。
pinyin: wèi le kuò dà yè wù, zǒng bù yǐ jīng zài hǎi wài shè lì le duō gè fēn bù.
en: In order to expand business, the headquarters has already established several branches overseas.

zh: 这款凉鞋的设计风格独特，在市场上非常受欢迎。
pinyin: Zhè kuǎn liángxié de shèjì fēnggé dútè, zài shìchǎng shàng fēicháng shòu huānyíng.
en: The design style of these sandals is unique, and they are very popular in the market.

zh: 为了防止地震造成伤害，我们需要学习避险知识。
pinyin: Wèile fángzhǐ dìzhèn zàochéng shānghài, wǒmen xūyào xuéxí bìxiǎn zhīshi.
en: To prevent harm caused by earthquakes, we need to learn safety knowledge.

zh: 那场规模宏大的音乐会给观众留下了深刻的印象。
pinyin: Nà chǎng guīmó hóngdà de yīnyuèhuì gěi guānzhòng liúxiàle shēnkè de yìnxiàng.
en: That grand-scale concert left a deep impression on the audience.

zh: 去年爆发的金融危机对全球经济造成了严重的冲击。

zh: 对于这个问题的处理，我们应该采取更灵活的态度。
pinyin: Duìyú zhège wèntí de chǔlǐ, wǒmen yīnggāi cǎiqǔ gèng línghuó de tàidù.
en: Regarding the handling of this issue, we should adopt a more flexible attitude.

zh: 这家药店的规模虽然不大，但药品种类却非常齐全。
pinyin: Zhè jiā yàodiàn de guīmó suīrán bú dà, dàn yàopǐn zhǒnglèi què fēicháng qíquán.
en: Although the scale of this pharmacy is not large, the variety of medicines is very complete.

zh: 他礼貌地敲了敲门，听到里面说“请进”才推门而入。
pinyin: Tā lǐmào de qiāo le qiāo mén, tīngdào lǐmiàn shuō “qǐng jìn” cái tuī mén ér rù.
en: He politely knocked on the door, and only entered after hearing "please come in" from inside.

zh: 虽然外面在下大雨，但他还是穿上雨衣骑自行车出发了。
pinyin: Suīrán wàimiàn zài xià dàyǔ, dàn tā háishì chuān shàng yǔyī qí zìxíngchē chūfā le.
en: Although it is raining heavily outside, he still put on a raincoat and set off on his bicycle.

zh: 我们要深刻认识到，现在正是应对全球气候变化的关键时期。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào shēnkè rènshi dào, xiànzài zhèng shì yìngduì quánqiú qìhòu biànhuà de guānjiàn shíqī.
en: We must deeply realize that now is the critical period for addressing global climate change.

zh: 由于不可抗力因素，合同被迫提前终止。
pinyin: Yóuyú bùkěkànglì yīnsù, hétóng bèi pò tíqián zhōngzhǐ.

zh: 无论身处何方，他始终心系祖国的发展。

zh: 严酷的冬季考验着每一位登山者的意志。

zh: 作为一名记者，他经常接到各种各样的任务。

zh: 科技创新是推动人类社会持续进步的核心动力。

en: Technological innovation is the core force pushing forward the continuous progress of human society.

zh: 为了参加婚礼，他特意穿上了一套笔挺的西装。
pinyin: Wèile cānjiā hūnlǐ, tā tèyì chuānshangle yī tào bǐtǐng de xīzhuāng.

zh: 如果双方发生纠纷，应该通过法律途径来解决。

zh: 为了应对市场的变化，公司必须进行快速调整。

en: In order to cope with market changes, the company must make fast adjustments.

zh: 中医不仅注重治病，更强调预防疾病的重要性。
pinyin: Zhōngyī bùjǐn zhùzhòng zhì bìng, gèng qiángdiào yùfáng jíbìng de zhòngyàoxìng.
en: Traditional Chinese medicine not only focuses on treating illness but also emphasizes the importance of preventing disease.

zh: 秋天的校园景色宜人，吸引了许多游客前来参观。
pinyin: Qiūtiān de xiàoyuán jǐngsè yírén, xīyǐnle xǔduō yóukè qiánlái cānguān.
en: The scenery on campus in autumn is pleasant, attracting many tourists to visit.

zh: 商店为了吸引顾客，举办了各种各样的促销活动。
pinyin: Shāngdiàn wèile xīyǐn gùkè, jǔbànle gè zhǒng gè yàng de cùxiāo huódòng.
en: To attract customers, the store held various promotional activities.

zh: 经过重组，这家企业的业务范围变得更加广泛了。
pinyin: Jīngguò chóngzǔ, zhè jiā qǐyè de yèwù fànwéi biàn de gèngjiā guǎngfàn le.
en: After reorganization, the company's scope of business has become much broader.

zh: 企业通过科学的计算来为新研发的技术成果定价。

zh: 经过几年的努力，这支球队终于夺得了联赛冠军。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ nián de nǔlì, zhè zhī qiúduì zhōngyú duódéle liánsài guànjūn.
en: After several years of hard work, this team finally won the league championship.

zh: 为了吸引更多顾客，超市在周末推出了打折活动。

en: In order to attract more customers, the supermarket launched discount activities on the weekend.

zh: 这种新型病毒的传播已经对社会稳定造成了威胁。

zh: 为了保持公共厕所的清洁，请大家自觉维护环境。

en: In order to keep the public toilet clean, please everyone consciously maintain the environment.

zh: 为了提高数学成绩，他不得不利用周末去参加补习。

en: In order to improve his math grades, he has to use his weekends to attend extra lessons.

zh: 作为一名优秀的同事，他总是在关键时刻提供协助。

en: As an excellent colleague, he always provides assistance at critical moments.

zh: 在显微镜下观察，这两个细胞的结构几乎完全相同。

zh: 他为了照顾生病的母亲，特意向公司申请了长期休假。

zh: 有关部门正在对自来水的水质进行严格的监测与评估。

zh: 他富有感情地朗读了这篇文章，深深打动了现场的观众。

en: He read the article aloud with great emotion, deeply moving the audience present.

zh: 由于长期处于巨大的工作压力之下，他逐渐失去了食欲。

en: Due to being under immense work pressure for a long time, he gradually lost his appetite.

zh: 他作为团队的核心，对项目的成功起到了决定性的作用。
pinyin: Tā zuòwéi tuánduì de héxīn, duì xiàngmù de chénggōng qǐ dào le juédìngxìng de zuòyòng.
en: As the core of the team, he played a decisive role in the success of the project.

zh: 由于长期缺乏锻炼，他的身体素质下降，因此经常感冒。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī quēfá duànliàn, tā de shēntǐ sùzhì xiàjiàng, yīncǐ jīngcháng gǎnmào.

zh: 他的演讲充满了真诚的感情，打动了在场的每一位听众。

zh: 随着技术的不断突破，太阳能的转换效率得到了显著提高。

zh: 考虑到当前的紧急状况，他不得不打电话向经理汇报此事。

zh: 由于文化背景的差异，人们有时很难真正理解对方的观点。

zh: 即使这项工程极其复杂，工程师们最终还是克服了重重障碍。
pinyin: jí shǐ zhè xiàng gōng chéng jí qí fù zá, gōng chéng shī men zuì zhōng hái shì kè fú le chóng chóng zhàng ài.

zh: 他是一个很有原则的人，从不因为个人的利益而放弃自己的立场。

zh: 为了保持竞争力，企业必须不断投入高科技创新。

zh: 这段富有创意的商业广告成功提升了品牌的知名度。

zh: 这座古老的教堂建筑风格独特，具有极高的艺术价值。
pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔ lǎo de jiào táng jiàn zhù fēng gé dú tè, jù yǒu jí gāo de yì shù jià zhí.
en: This ancient church's architectural style is unique and holds great artistic value.

zh: 这种现象的出现，或者暗示了某种深层次的社会危机。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng xiàn xiàng de chū xiàn xiàn, huò zhě àn shì le mǒu zhǒng shēn céng cì de shè huì wēi jī.
en: The emergence of this phenomenon possibly implies some deep-seated social crisis.

zh: 为了准备马拉松比赛，他特意购买了一双专业的球鞋。
pinyin: Wèile zhǔnbèi mǎlāsōng bǐsài, tā tèyì gòumǎi le yī shuāng zhuānyè de qiúxié.
en: In order to prepare for the marathon, he specially purchased a pair of professional athletic shoes.

zh: 随着市场的需求变化，传统产业逐渐变为高科技行业。
pinyin: suízhe shìchǎng de xūqiú biànhuà, chuántǒng chǎnyè zhújiàn biàn wéi gāokējì hángyè.
en: As market demand changes, traditional industries gradually turn into high-tech industries.

zh: 我们必须充分考虑顾客的需求，从而提供更优质的服务。

en: We must fully consider the needs of customers so as to provide higher-quality services.

zh: 随着造船技术的进步，轮船的运输效率得到了显著提升。

en: With the advancement of shipbuilding technology, the transport efficiency of steamships has significantly improved.

zh: 这支军队在极其艰苦的条件下依然保持着顽强的战斗力。

en: This army maintains tenacious combat effectiveness under extremely difficult conditions.

zh: 由于该项目涉及复杂的维护工作，因此必须按小时收费。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi xiàngmù shèjí fùzá de wéihù gōngzuò, yīncǐ bìxū àn xiǎoshí shōufèi.
en: Since the project involves complex maintenance work, it must be charged by the hour.

zh: 作为一名艺术评论家，他对这部先锋话剧给予了高度评价。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng yìshù pínglùnjiā, tā duì zhè bù xiānfēng huàjù jǐyǔ le gāodù píngjià.
en: As an art critic, he gave this avant-garde modern drama a high rating.

zh: 尽管西班牙语语法比较复杂，但他还是坚持每天练习听力。
pinyin: jǐnguǎn xībānyáyǔ yǔfǎ bǐjiào fùzá, dàn tā háishì jiānchí měitiān liànxí tīnglì.

zh: 为了赢得这场激烈的竞争，他们不得不采取灵活多变的战术。

en: We must objectively evaluate various factors in order to rank these projects fairly.

zh: 随着生活水平的提高，越来越多的人开始追求高品质的家电产品。

en: Each group must carry out its work strictly according to the established rules and regulations.

zh: 由于该大楼设施老旧，政府决定将其拆除重建。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi dàlóu shèshī lǎojiù, zhèngfǔ juédìng jiāng qí chāichú chóngjiàn.
en: Due to the building's outdated facilities, the government decided to demolish and rebuild it.

pinyin: Qiántiān bàofā de nà chǎng huǒzāi mùqián yǐ bèi xiāofáng bùmén wánquán pūmiè.
en: The fire that broke out the day before yesterday has now been completely extinguished by the fire department.

en: Although this scientific research result is significant, it still contains logical defects.

zh: 为了缓解人口压力，相关部门决定限制城区的建筑规模。

pinyin: Wèile kèfú mùqián de kùnnán, wǒmen yīnggāi tànsuǒ yítào gèng yǒuxiào de yùnzuò fāngfǎ.
en: In order to overcome current difficulties, we should explore a more effective operational method.

zh: 为了避免在取款机前长时间排队，很多人现在更倾向于使用移动支付。

en: In order to avoid long queues at the ATM, many people now prefer using mobile payments.

zh: 尽管现在的技术还不成熟，但只要进步一点点，未来就会有巨大的改变。

pinyin: āi yā, jīntiān tiānqì zhēn hǎo.
en: Oh, the weather is so nice today.

zh: 你看到那个配件了吗？
pinyin: nǐ kàn dào nà ge pèi jiàn le ma?
en: Did you see that part?

zh: 我去火车站送别朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ qù huǒchēzhàn sòngbié péngyǒu.
en: I went to the train station to see my friend off.

zh: 我先吃饭，进而睡觉。
pinyin: Wǒ xiān chīfàn, jìn'ér shuìjiào.
en: I eat first, and then go to sleep.

zh: 上司要我下午去开会。
pinyin: Shàngsi yào wǒ xiàwǔ qù kāihuì.
en: My boss wants me to attend a meeting this afternoon.

zh: 我想去那个产地看看。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù nàge chǎndì kànkan.
en: I want to go see that place of origin.

zh: 我想验一下这个电脑。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yàn yī xià zhè gè diàn nǎo
en: I want to test this computer a bit.

zh: 他在北京成年没回来。
pinyin: Tā zài Běijīng chéng nián méi huílái.
en: He did not come back for the whole year while in Beijing.

zh: 看到他，我未免想笑。
pinyin: kàn dào tā, wǒ wèi miǎn xiǎng xiào.
en: Seeing him, I can't help but want to laugh.

zh: 书橱就在房间的右边。
pinyin: Shūchú jiù zài fángjiān de yòubiān.
en: The bookcase is right on the right side of the room.

zh: 这些衣服通通是新的。
pinyin: Zhèxiē yīfu tōngtōng shì xīn de.
en: These clothes are entirely new.

zh: 电影院里的音响非常大。
pinyin: Diànyǐngyuàn lǐ de yīnxiǎng fēicháng dà.
en: The sound in the cinema is very loud.

zh: 他买了一个新潮的手机。
pinyin: Tā mǎi le yīgè xīncháo de shǒujī.
en: He bought a modern mobile phone.

zh: 他没有穿衣服，是上空。
pinyin: tā méiyǒu chuān yīfu, shì shàngkōng.
en: He is not wearing clothes; he is topless.

zh: 这是难得一见的好天气。
pinyin: Zhè shì nán dé yī jiàn de hǎo tiānqì.
en: This is a rare good weather.

zh: 他认识形形色色的朋友。
pinyin: tā rènshi xíngxíngsèsè de péngyǒu.
en: He knows every kind of friend.

zh: 他太累了，马上酣睡了。
pinyin: tā tài lèi le, mǎshàngshàng hānshuì le.
en: He was so tired that he immediately fell into a deep sleep.

zh: 妈妈爱我是天经地义的。
pinyin: Māma ài wǒ shì tiānjīngdìyì de.
en: It is a matter of course that my mother loves me.

zh: 这是我学习汉语的关头。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ xuéxí Hànyǔ de guāntóu.
en: This is a juncture in my Chinese learning.

zh: 从他的言辞看，他很累。
pinyin: Cóng tā de yáncí kàn, tā hěn lèi.
en: Judging by his expression, he is very tired.

zh: 这里吃的用的应有尽有。
pinyin: zhèlǐ chī de yòng de yīng yǒu jìn yǒu.
en: Everything one needs to eat or use is here.

zh: 医生在医院里东奔西走。
pinyin: Yīshēng zài yīyuàn lǐ dōngbēnxīzǒu.
en: The doctor runs this way and that in the hospital.

zh: 他的学校在遥远的地方。
pinyin: Tā de xuéxiào zài yáoyuǎn de dìfāng.
en: His school is in a distant place.

zh: 你别太累了，慢慢来吧。
pinyin: nǐ bié tài lèi le, màn màn lái ba.
en: Don't overwork yourself, take it easy.

zh: 这是举世无双的好东西。
pinyin: Zhè shì jǔshìwúshuāng de hǎo dōngxi.
en: This is an unrivaled good thing.

zh: 他累了，拄着桌子休息。
pinyin: tā lèi le, zhǔzhe zhuōzi xiūxi.
en: He is tired and is propping himself up on the table to rest.

zh: 这个杯子坏了，丢掉吧。
pinyin: zhège bēizi huài le, diūdiào ba.
en: This cup is broken, discard it.

zh: 今天商店购进很多水果。
pinyin: Jīntiān shāngdiàn gòujìn hěnduō shuǐguǒ.
en: The shop bought in a lot of fruit today.

zh: 请你点评一下我的工作。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ diǎn píng yī xià wǒ de gōng zuò.
en: Please give some comments on my work.

zh: 冒昧问一下，你叫什么？
pinyin: Màomèi wèn yīxià, nǐ jiào shénme?
en: May I take the liberty of asking, what is your name?

zh: 每当看到你，我很高兴。
pinyin: měi dāng kàn dào nǐ, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
en: Whenever I see you, I am very happy.

zh: 他在学校相对的房子住。
pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào xiāngduì de fángzi zhù.
en: He lives in the house opposite the school.

zh: 没人知道他最后的去向。
pinyin: Méiyǒu rén zhīdào tā zuìhòu de qùxiàng.
en: Nobody knows where he went in the end.

zh: 学校是我们学习的去处。
pinyin: xuéxiào shì wǒmen xuéxí de qùchù.
en: School is the destination where we study.

zh: 就在这会儿，请帮帮我。
pinyin: jiù zài zhè huìr, qǐng bāngbāng wǒ.
en: At this very moment, please help me.

zh: 我们坐在圆形的房间里。
pinyin: Wǒmen zuò zài yuánxíng de fángjiān lǐ.
en: We are sitting in a circular room.

zh: 我在这里的演播室工作。
pinyin: Wǒ zài zhèlǐ de yǎnbōshì gōngzuò.
en: I work in the broadcasting studio here.

zh: 他看着天气，愁眉苦脸。
pinyin: tā kàn zhe tiān qì, chóu méi kǔ liǎn.
en: He looks at the weather, looking anxious.

zh: 我们想筹集一些钱买书。
pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎng chóují yīxiē qián mǎi shū.
en: We want to collect some money to buy books.

zh: 我们一鼓作气，跑快点。
pinyin: Wǒmen yī gǔ zuò qì, pǎo kuài diǎn.
en: Let's make a spurt of energy and run a little faster.

zh: 他静止不动地站在那儿。
pinyin: tā jìngzhǐ bù dòng de zhàn zài nà'er.
en: He stood there perfectly still.

zh: 这块面包上有很多芝麻。
pinyin: Zhè kuài miànbāo shàng yǒu hěnduō zhīma.
en: There is a lot of sesame on this piece of bread.

zh: 我白白等了你一个小时。
pinyin: wǒ báibái děng le nǐ yī gè xiǎoshí.
en: I waited for you for an hour in vain.

zh: 这个杯子承载了我的水。
pinyin: Zhège bēizi chéngzài le wǒ de shuǐ.
en: This cup sustains/holds my water.

zh: 老师暗地里帮了我很多。
pinyin: Lǎoshī àndìlǐ bāngle wǒ hěnduō.
en: The teacher secretly helped me a lot.

zh: 我们要实事求是地看书。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào shí shì qiú shì de kànshū.
en: We must seek truth from facts when reading books.

zh: 孩子在妈妈的怀里睡觉。
pinyin: Háizi zài māma de huáilǐ shuìjiào.
en: The child is sleeping in mother's bosom.

zh: 在学校里，他脱颖而出。
pinyin: Zài xuéxiào lǐ, tā tuōyǐng'érchū.
en: In school, he rose above others.

zh: 我们要振奋起来去工作。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhènfèn qǐlái qù gōngzuò.
en: We must stir ourselves up to work.

zh: 他在书上做了一个记号。
pinyin: Tā zài shū shàng zuò le yí gè jì hao.
en: He made a mark in the book.

zh: 他往常在这个时间回来。
pinyin: Tā wǎngcháng zài zhège shíjiān huílái.
en: He customarily returns at this time.

zh: 他极力要在这个地方住。
pinyin: Tā jílì yào zài zhège dìfāng zhù.
en: He wants to live in this place at all costs.

zh: 那个受害的孩子在哪儿？
pinyin: Nàge shòu hài de háizi zài nǎ'er?
en: Where is that injured child?

zh: 工作太忙，免不了会累。
pinyin: Gōngzuò tài máng, miǎnbùliǎo huì lèi.
en: Working too hard, it's unavoidable to feel tired.

zh: 妈妈去学校给弟弟助威。
pinyin: Māma qù xuéxiào gěi dìdi zhùwēi.
en: Mom went to school to boost her younger brother's morale.

zh: 有朝一日，我会去北京。
pinyin: yǒu zhāo yī rì, wǒ huì qù běijīng.
en: One day, I will go to Beijing.

zh: 他在电话里和朋友交谈。
pinyin: tā zài diànhuà lǐ hé péngyǒu jiāotán.
en: He is chatting with a friend on the phone.

zh: 医生认真检察我的身体。
pinyin: Yīshēng rènzhēn jiǎnchá wǒ de shēntǐ.
en: The doctor carefully investigated my body.

zh: 天气太热，我有点烦躁。
pinyin: tiān qì tài rè, wǒ yǒu diǎn fán zào.
en: The weather is too hot, I am a bit jittery.

zh: 老师叫我们要细心写字。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jiào wǒmen yào xìxīn xiězì.
en: The teacher told us to write characters meticulously.

zh: 我不喜欢喝常温的牛奶。
pinyin: wǒ bù xǐhuān hē chángwēn de niúnǎi.
en: I don't like drinking room temperature milk.

zh: 同学们自发去学校读书。
pinyin: Tóngxuémen zìfā qù xuéxiào dúshū.
en: The students spontaneously went to school to study.

zh: 这里人太多，我过不去。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ rén tài duō, wǒ guòbuqù.
en: There are too many people here, I cannot get through.

zh: 我想去便利店买点东西。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù biànlìdiàn mǎi diǎn dōngxi.
en: I want to go to the convenience store to buy some things.

zh: 考试前，他很有自信心。
pinyin: Kǎoshì qián, tā hěn yǒu zìxìnxīn.
en: Before the exam, he had a lot of self-confidence.

zh: 你不罢休，我也不罢休。
pinyin: nǐ bù bà xiū, wǒ yě bù bà xiū.
en: If you don't give up, I won't either.

zh: 妈妈做的饭菜非常可口。
pinyin: Māma zuò de fàncài fēicháng kěkǒu.
en: The food that Mom cooks is very tasty.

zh: 她看见老师，有点害臊。
pinyin: Tā kànjiàn lǎoshī, yǒudiǎn hàisào.
en: She is a bit bashful when she sees the teacher.

zh: 他出人意料地去了学校。
pinyin: tā chū rén yì liào de qù le xuéxiào.
en: He went to school unexpectedly.

zh: 当今很忙，没时间休息。
pinyin: dāng jīn hěn máng, méi shí jiān xiū xi.
en: His Majesty is very busy and has no time to rest.

zh: 他对这次考试胸有成竹。
pinyin: Tā duì zhè cì kǎoshì xiōngyǒuchéngzhú.
en: He is very confident about this exam.

zh: 你对工作太朝三暮四了。
pinyin: Nǐ duì gōngzuò tài zhāosānmùsì le.
en: You are too inconsistent/blow hot and cold regarding your work.

zh: 他工作太忙，以致病了。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò tài máng, yǐzhì bìng le.
en: He was too busy working, to the extent that he got sick.

zh: 这是他生前最喜欢的书。
pinyin: Zhè shì tā shēngqián zuì xǐhuān de shū.
en: This is the book he liked most during his life.

zh: 我有很多话想跟你倾诉。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěnduō huà xiǎng gēn nǐ qīngsù.
en: I have a lot to tell you.

zh: 他在网上看最新的资讯。
pinyin: Tā zài wǎngshàng kàn zuìxīn de zīxùn.
en: He is looking at the latest information on the internet.

zh: 这个名贵的杯子是谁的？
pinyin: zhè gè míng guì de bēi zi shì shuí de?
en: Whose is this famous and valuable cup?

zh: 我们准备了丰盛的午饭。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhǔnbèi le fēngshèng de wǔfàn.
en: We prepared a sumptuous lunch.

zh: 他在网上付款买了衣服。
pinyin: Tā zài wǎngshàng fùkuǎn mǎi le yīfu.
en: He paid online to buy clothes.

zh: 下雨后路上的水很混浊。
pinyin: xià yǔ hòu lù shàng de shuǐ hěn hùn zhuó.
en: The water on the road is muddy after the rain.

zh: 这里现在是十五摄氏度。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ xiànzài shì shíwǔ shèshìdù.
en: It is fifteen degrees Celsius here now.

zh: 这是上天给我们的恩赐。
pinyin: Zhè shì shàngtiān gěi wǒmen de ēncì.
en: This is a gift/bestowal given to us by heaven.

zh: 我用零花钱买了一本书。
pinyin: Wǒ yòng línghuāqián mǎile yī běn shū.
en: I used my pocket money to buy a book.

zh: 今天的天气有很多热气。
pinyin: jīntiān de tiānqì yǒu hěnduō rèqì.
en: There is a lot of heat in the weather today.

zh: 这个床太小，凑合睡吧。
pinyin: Zhège chuáng tài xiǎo, còuhe shuì ba.
en: This bed is too small, just make do with it for sleep.

zh: 书本赋予我们很多知识。
pinyin: Shūběn fùyǔ wǒmen hěnduō zhīshi.
en: Books give us a lot of knowledge.

zh: 学生们无忧无虑地学习。
pinyin: xué shēng men wú yōu wú lǜ de xué xí
en: The students study without worries.

zh: 一瞬间，我看见了朋友。
pinyin: Yī shùnjiān, wǒ kànjiànle péngyǒu.
en: In a split second, I saw my friend.

zh: 他们前赴后继地去工作。
pinyin: tāmen qiánfùhòujì de qù gōngzuò.
en: They work by advancing dauntlessly in wave upon wave.

zh: 妈妈去买农历年的东西。
pinyin: Māma qù mǎi nónglì nián de dōngxi.
en: Mom goes to buy things for the traditional Chinese New Year.

zh: 我很大，你很小，悬殊。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn dà, nǐ hěn xiǎo, xuánshū.
en: I am very big and you are very small; there is a vast difference.

zh: 他工作认真，口碑很好。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò rènzhēn, kǒubēi hěn hǎo.
en: He works hard and has a good public reputation.

zh: 老师叫我去看百科全书。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jiào wǒ qù kàn bǎikē quánshū.
en: The teacher told me to look at the encyclopedia.

zh: 他们得到了国家的抚恤。
pinyin: tā men dé dào le guó jiā de fǔ xù.
en: They received financial support from the state.

zh: 他一大早给医生打电话。
pinyin: tā yī dà zǎo gěi yīshēng dǎ diànhuà.
en: He calls the doctor first thing in the morning.

zh: 你察看这个字，对不对？
pinyin: Nǐ chákàn zhège zì, duì bù duì?
en: You look carefully at this character, is it correct?

zh: 别想太多，顺其自然吧。
pinyin: Bié xiǎng tài duō, shùn qí zì rán ba.
en: Don't think too much, just let nature take its course.

zh: 他给了那个乞丐一些钱。
pinyin: Tā gěile nàge qǐgài yīxiē qián.
en: He gave that beggar some money.

zh: 从今以后，你要多喝水。
pinyin: Cóng jīn yǐ hòu, nǐ yào duō hē shuǐ.
en: From now on, you need to drink more water.

zh: 谁剥夺了你休息的时间？
pinyin: Shéi bōduóle nǐ xiūxi de shíjiān?
en: Who deprived you of your rest time?

zh: 爸爸下班了，我去接班。
pinyin: Bàba xiàbān le, wǒ qù jiēbān.
en: Dad got off work, and I went to take over his shift.

zh: 我想出去，雨偏偏下了。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chūqù, yǔ piānpiān xiàle.
en: I wanted to go out, but unfortunately it started raining.

zh: 老师大公无私，不爱钱。
pinyin: Lǎoshī dàgōngwúsī, bù ài qián.
en: The teacher is impartial and does not love money.

zh: 我们永不忘记这个朋友。
pinyin: Wǒmen yǒng bù wàngjì zhège péngyǒu.
en: We never forget this friend.

zh: 他现在和朋友们绝缘了。
pinyin: Tā xiànzài hé péngyǒumen juéyuán le.
en: He is now out of touch with his friends.

zh: 他是一个辜负朋友的人。
pinyin: Tā shì yīgè gūfù péngyǒu de rén.
en: He is a person who is unworthy of his friends.

zh: 与其在家，与其去学校。
pinyin: Yǔqí zài jiā, yǔqí qù xuéxiào.
en: Rather than staying at home, [I'd prefer] going to school.

zh: 我实话实说，我不喜欢。
pinyin: Wǒ shíhuàshíshuō, wǒ bù xǐhuān.
en: I will tell the truth, I do not like it.

zh: 他不明白什么是精神病。
pinyin: Tā bù míngbái shénme shì jīngshénbìng.
en: He does not understand what psychosis is.

zh: 他一面看书，一面喝茶。
pinyin: Tā yī miàn kànshū, yī miàn hēchá.
en: He is reading and drinking tea at the same time.

zh: 我常回味他说的那些话。
pinyin: Wǒ cháng huíwèi tā shuō de nàxiē huà.
en: I often ponder over what he said.

zh: 弟弟的媳妇在医院工作。
pinyin: Dìdi de xífù zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
en: My younger brother's wife works in a hospital.

zh: 倘若你不去，我也不去。
pinyin: tǎng ruò nǐ bú qù, wǒ yě bú qù.
en: If you don't go, I won't go either.

zh: 谈到这本书，我想看看。
pinyin: Tán dào zhè běn shū, wǒ xiǎng kànkan.
en: Referring to this book, I want to read it.

zh: 你要珍重，多穿点衣服。
pinyin: Nǐ yào zhēnzhòng, duō chuān diǎn chuān yīfu.
en: You must take care of yourself and wear more clothes.

zh: 我们自力更生，去学校。
pinyin: Wǒmen zìlìgēngshēng, qù xuéxiào.
en: We are self-reliant and go to school.

zh: 相对而言，今天的雨小。
pinyin: xiāng duì ér yán, jīn tiān de yǔ xiǎo.
en: Comparatively speaking, today's rain is light.

zh: 拜托，别跟我开玩笑了。
pinyin: Bàituō, bié gēn wǒ kāi wánxiào le.
en: Please, stop joking with me.

zh: 归根到底，他想去中国。
pinyin: guī gēn dào dǐ, tā xiǎng qù zhōngguó.
en: In the final analysis, he wants to go to China.

zh: 妈妈的爱沉浸在饭菜里。
pinyin: Māma de ài chénjìn zài fàncài lǐ.
en: Mother's love permeates the food.

zh: 基于生病，他没去工作。
pinyin: Jīyú shēngbìng, tā méi qù gōngzuò.
en: Because he was sick, he didn't go to work.

zh: 我们要工作，精益求精。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào gōngzuò, jīngyìqiújīng.
en: We must work and strive for perfection.

zh: 我们要有好的工作作风。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào yǒu hǎo de gōngzuò zuòfēng.
en: We must have a good style of work.

zh: 学生们在学校门口集结。
pinyin: Xuéshēngmen zài xuéxiào ménkǒu jíjié.
en: The students assemble at the school gate.

zh: 雨太大，我们退回车里。
pinyin: Yǔ tài dà, wǒmen tuìhuí chēlǐ.
en: The rain is too heavy, we go back into the car.

zh: 慈祥的医生正在帮病人。
pinyin: cí xiáng de yī shēng zhèng zài bāng bìng rén.
en: The benevolent doctor is helping the patient.

zh: 妈妈准备了饭菜给贵宾。
pinyin: Māma zhǔnbèi le fàncài gěi guìbīn.
en: Mom prepared food for the honored guest.

zh: 众人都去商店买东西了。
