zh: 妈妈做的饭，我念念不忘。
pinyin: māma zuò de fàn, wǒ niàn niàn bù wàng.
en: I constantly think about the food my mom makes.

zh: 他挎着一个新书包去学校。
pinyin: Tā kuàzhe yīgè xīn shūbāo qù xuéxiào.
en: He is carrying a new schoolbag and going to school.

zh: 他喜欢随心所欲地去学校。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuān suí xīn suǒ yù de qù xuéxiào.
en: He likes to go to school as he pleases.

zh: 他忙着工作，顾不上吃饭。
pinyin: Tā mángzhe gōngzuò, gùbushàng chīfàn.
en: He is busy with work and cannot attend to eating.

zh: 这个工作方方面面都很忙。
pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò fāngfāngmiànmiàn dōu hěn máng.
en: This job is busy in every aspect.

zh: 这个地方一点儿也不喧闹。
pinyin: Zhège dìfāng yīdiǎnr yě bù xuānnào.
en: This place is not noisy at all.

zh: 商店里人很多，非常拥挤。
pinyin: Shāngdiàn lǐ rén hěn duō, fēicháng yōngjǐ.
en: There are many people in the shop; it is very crowded.

zh: 假使下雨，我就在家看书。
pinyin: jiǎshǐ xiàyǔ, wǒ jiù zài jiā kànshū.
en: In case it rains, I will stay home and read.

zh: 医生预言他很快会好起来。
pinyin: Yīshēng yùyán tā hěn kuài huì hǎo qǐlái.
en: The doctor predicts he will get better soon.

zh: 这几本书的知识容量很大。
pinyin: Zhè jǐ běn shū de zhī shi róng liàng hěn dà.
en: The information capacity (quantitative depth) of these books is very high.

zh: 我的书和你的书大同小异。
pinyin: Wǒ de shū hé nǐ de shū dàtóngxiǎoyì.
en: My book and your book differ only in small points.

zh: 下雨了，我们就地休息吧。
pinyin: Xiàyǔ le, wǒmen jiùdì xiūxi ba.
en: It is raining, let's rest right here on the spot.

zh: 这个杯子有缺口，别用了。
pinyin: zhè ge bēi zi yǒu quē kǒu, bié yòng le.
en: This cup has a nick, don't use it.

zh: 医生印证了我的身体很好。
pinyin: yī shēng yìn zhèng le wǒ de shēn tǐ hěn hǎo.
en: The doctor confirmed that my health is very good.

zh: 他在饭店结识了一个医生。
pinyin: Tā zài fàndiàn jiéshíle yīgè yīshēng.
en: He met a doctor for the first time at a restaurant.

zh: 他死心塌地跟着老师学习。
pinyin: Tā sǐ xīn tā dì gēnzhe lǎoshī xuéxí.
en: He is hell-bent on following the teacher to learn.

zh: 他不去，也就是说我不去。
pinyin: Tā bù qù, yě jiù shì shuō wǒ bù qù.
en: He is not going, in other words, I am not going.

zh: 他告诉了我很多辛酸的事。
pinyin: tā gào sù le wǒ hěn duō xīn suān de shì.
en: He told me many sad things.

zh: 她一心一意要买那个杯子。
pinyin: tā yī xīn yī yì yào mǎi nà gè bēi zi.
en: She is bent on buying that cup.

zh: 他们踏上了去北京的飞机。
pinyin: Tāmen tàshàngle qù Běijīng de fēijī.
en: They set foot on the plane to Beijing.

zh: 那个评论员在电视上说话。
pinyin: Nàge pínglùnyuán zài diànshì shàng shuōhuà.
en: That commentator is speaking on TV.

zh: 时间匆匆，我们要快一点。
pinyin: Shíjiān cōngcōng, wǒmen yào kuài yìdiǎn.
en: Time is passing hurriedly, we need to be a little faster.

zh: 我去学校来回要一个小时。
pinyin: Wǒ qù xuéxiào láihuí yào yīgè xiǎoshí.
en: It takes me an hour to make a round trip to school.

zh: 我住在一个五星级饭店里。
pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài yīgè wǔ xīng jí fàndiàn lǐ.
en: I am staying in a five-star hotel.

zh: 他是学生中鹤立鸡群的人。
pinyin: Tā shì xuéshēng zhōng hèlìjīqún de rén.
en: He is the person who stands out among the students.

zh: 一晃，我在学校住了半年。
pinyin: yī huǎng, wǒ zài xuéxiào zhù le bàn nián.
en: In an instant, I have lived at the school for half a year.

zh: 喝了水，我觉得爽快多了。
pinyin: Hē le shuǐ, wǒ juéde shuǎngkuai duō le.
en: After drinking water, I feel much more refreshed.

zh: 这是我们必不可少的东西。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen bìbùkěshǎo de dōngxi.
en: This is an indispensable thing for us.

zh: 妈妈指手画脚告诉我去哪。
pinyin: Māma zhǐshǒuhuàjiǎo gàosù wǒ qù nǎ.
en: Mom explained where to go using hand gestures.

zh: 学业太忙，我没时间休息。
pinyin: Xuéyè tài máng, wǒ méi shíjiān xiūxí.
en: The schoolwork is too busy, I don't have time to rest.

zh: 他住在一个破旧的房子里。
pinyin: Tā zhù zài yī gè pòjiù de fángzi lǐ.
en: He lives in a shabby house.

zh: 纵观今天，学校里人很多。
pinyin: zòng guān jīn tiān, xué xiào lǐ rén hěn duō.
en: Looking at the day as a whole, there are many people at school.

zh: 看到朋友病了，我很焦急。
pinyin: Kàndào péngyǒu bìng le, wǒ hěn jiāojí.
en: Seeing my friend sick, I am feeling anxious.

zh: 爷爷身体好，真是好福气。
pinyin: Yéye shēntǐ hǎo, zhēnshi hǎo fúqi.
en: Grandpa is in good health, he really has good fortune.

zh: 在这个地方，工作很安逸。
pinyin: zài zhè gè dì fāng, gōng zuò hěn ān yì.
en: In this place, the work is easy.

zh: 请给我科普一下这个知识。
pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ kē pǔ yīxià zhège zhīshì.
en: Please explain this knowledge to me in simple terms.

zh: 这个星期天我们去郊游吧。
pinyin: Zhège xīngqītiān wǒmen qù jiāoyóu ba.
en: Let's go on an excursion this Sunday.

zh: 你怎么竟敢对老师说这个？
pinyin: Nǐ zěnme jìnggǎn duì lǎoshī shuō zhège?
en: How dare you say this to the teacher?

zh: 这是真的吗？我有些疑虑。
pinyin: zhè shì zhēn de ma? wǒ yǒu xiē yí lù.
en: Is this true? I have some doubts.

zh: 名字（附带日期）在这里。
pinyin: Míngzì (fùdài rìqī) zài zhèlǐ.
en: The name (in parentheses, with the date) is here.

zh: 虽说他是我朋友，我不去。
pinyin: suī shuō tā shì wǒ péngyǒu, wǒ bù qù.
en: Though he is my friend, I will not go.

zh: 我提议下午一起去买东西。
pinyin: Wǒ tíyì xiàwǔ yīqǔ yīqǐ qù mǎi dōngxī.
en: I propose we go shopping together this afternoon.

zh: 别再纠缠我了，我不想听。
pinyin: bié zài jiū chán wǒ le, wǒ bù xiǎng tīng.
en: Stop nagging me, I don't want to listen.

zh: 我和他在火车上萍水相逢。
pinyin: Wǒ hé tā zài huǒchē shàng píngshuǐxiāngféng.
en: He and I met by chance on the train.

zh: 我们要去那个共同体工作。
pinyin: wǒmen yào qù nàge gòngtóngtǐ gōngzuò.
en: We are going to work in that community.

zh: 请奠定我们要见面的地点。
pinyin: Qǐng diàndìng wǒmen yào jiànmiàn de dìdiǎn.
en: Please fix the location where we will meet.

zh: 我看了书，其后看了电影。
pinyin: Wǒ kànle shū, qíhòu kànle diànyǐng.
en: I read a book, later I watched a movie.

zh: 他不穿衣服，身体裸露着。
pinyin: Tā bù chuān yīfu, shēntǐ luǒlùzhe.
en: He is not wearing clothes, and his body is exposed.

zh: 下雨了，请防护好你的书。
pinyin: Xià yǔ le, qǐng fánghù hǎo nǐ de shū.
en: It is raining, please protect your books well.

zh: 这家大名鼎鼎的饭店很大。
pinyin: Zhè jiā dà míng dǐng dǐng de fàndiàn hěn dà.
en: This restaurant with a grand reputation is very big.

zh: 要不今天就在家看电影吧。
pinyin: Yào bù jīntiān jiù zài jiā kàn diànyǐng ba.
en: How about staying home to watch a movie today?

zh: 他很好，相比之下我不好。
pinyin: Tā hěn hǎo, xiāngbǐzhīxià wǒ bù hǎo.
en: He is very good; by comparison, I am not.

zh: 他借口没时间，不去工作。
pinyin: Tā jièkǒu méi shíjiān, bù qù gōngzuò.
en: He used not having time as an excuse and did not go to work.

zh: 别提了，今天天气真不好。
pinyin: Bié tí le, jīntiān tiānqì zhēn bù hǎo.
en: Say no more, the weather today is really bad.

zh: 时间到了，我真留恋这里。
pinyin: Shíjiān dàole, wǒ zhēn liúliàn zhèlǐ.
en: Time is up, I hate to have to go.

zh: 他在北京学了地道的中文。
pinyin: tā zài běi jīng xué le dì dao de zhōng wén
en: He learned authentic Chinese in Beijing.

zh: 你别在这里坏事，快走吧。
pinyin: Nǐ bié zài zhèlǐ huàishì, kuài zǒu ba.
en: Don't ruin things here, hurry and leave.

zh: 桌子上横七竖八地放着书。
pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng héngqīshùbā de fàngzhe shū.
en: Books are lying in disorder on the table.

zh: 他工作的时候有很多效应。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò de shíhòu yǒu hěn duō xiàoyìng.
en: He has many effects when he works.

zh: 你知道现在是什么节气吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào xiànzài shì shénme jiéqì ma?
en: Do you know what solar term it is now?

zh: 老师想出了一个新的对策。
pinyin: Lǎoshī xiǎng chūle yīgè xīn de duìcè.
en: The teacher thought of a new countermeasure.

zh: 妈妈帮我缝好了衣服的缝。
pinyin: mā ma bāng wǒ féng hǎo le yī fú de fèng
en: Mom helped me sew the seam of the clothes well.

zh: 很多学生对学习汉语有意。
pinyin: hěnduō xuéshēng duì xuéxí hànyǔ yǒu yì.
en: Many students are interested in learning Chinese.

zh: 请你牢记我们要去的地方。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ láojì wǒmen yào qù de dìfang.
en: Please keep in mind the place we are going.

zh: 今天极少数的商店开了门。
pinyin: Jīntiān jíshǎoshù de shāngdiàn kāi le mén.
en: Extremely few shops are open today.

zh: 我不喜欢自私自利的朋友。
pinyin: wǒ bù xǐ huān zì sī zì lì de péng yǒu.
en: I do not like selfish friends.

zh: 这是我们要做的前台工作。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ men yào zuò de qián tái gōng zuò.
en: This is the foreground work we need to do.

zh: 妈妈生病了，身体很虚弱。
pinyin: mā ma shēng bìng le, shēn tǐ hěn xū ruò.
en: Mom is sick, her body is in poor health.

zh: 迄今为止，我没去过北京。
pinyin: qì jīn wéi zhǐ, wǒ méi qù guò běi jīng.
en: Up to now, I haven't been to Beijing.

zh: 学校吊销了那个学生的课。
pinyin: Xuéxiào diàoxiāo le nàge xuésheng de kè.
en: The school suspended that student's class.

zh: 我爸爸老了，身体在老化。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba lǎo le, shēntǐ zài lǎohuà.
en: My father is old, his body is aging.

zh: 这两行字中间的间隔很大。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng háng zì zhōng jiān de jiàn gé hěn dà.
en: The gap between these two lines of text is very large.

zh: 同学们津津有味地看电影。
pinyin: tóngxuémen jīn jīn yǒu wèi de kàn diànyǐng.
en: The students are watching the movie with keen interest.

zh: 他一毛不拔，不给朋友钱。
pinyin: Tā yī máo bù bá, bù gěi péngyǒu qián.
en: He is extremely stingy and won't give his friends any money.

zh: 我好心帮你，你怎么不听？
pinyin: Wǒ hǎoxīn bāng nǐ, nǐ zěnme bù tīng?
en: I have good intentions to help you, why don't you listen?

zh: 这真是岂有此理，我不去。
pinyin: zhè zhēnshi qǐyǒucǐlǐ, wǒ bù qù.
en: This is truly absurd, I will not go.

zh: 妈妈理直气壮地叫我吃饭。
pinyin: Māma lǐ zhí qì zhuàng de jiào wǒ chīfàn.
en: Mother spoke with justification and forcefulness when calling me to eat.

zh: 我们坐下来喝茶说闲话吧。
pinyin: wǒmen zuò xiàlái hē chá shuō xiánhuà ba.
en: Let's sit down, drink tea, and chat.

zh: 病人在医院里折腾，很累。
pinyin: bìng rén zài yī yuàn lǐ zhē teng, hěn lèi.
en: The patient is tossing around in the hospital and is very tired.

zh: 总的来说，这是个好老师。
pinyin: zǒng de lái shuō, zhè shì gè hǎo lǎoshī.
en: To sum up, this is a good teacher.

zh: 学校里有很多新的建筑物。
pinyin: Xuéxiào lǐ yǒu hěnduō xīn de jiànzhùwù.
en: There are many new edifices in the school.

zh: 天太冷，我不由得想回家。
pinyin: Tiān tài lěng, bùyóude xiǎng huí jiā.
en: It is so cold, I cannot but want to go home.

zh: 他从来不去那家饭店吃饭。
pinyin: Tā cónglái bù qù nà jiā fàndiàn chīfàn.
en: He never goes to that restaurant to eat.

zh: 我和她是朋友，密不可分。
pinyin: Wǒ hé tā shì péngyǒu, mì bù kě fēn.
en: She and I are friends, we are inseparable.

zh: 他绘声绘色地介绍了北京。
pinyin: tā huìshēnghuìsè de jièshào le běijīng.
en: He introduced Beijing in a vivid and colorful way.

zh: 我们要等水里的东西沉淀。
pinyin: wǒmen yào děng shuǐ lǐ de dōngxi chén diàn.
en: We need to wait for the things in the water to settle.

zh: 晚间，我想去商店买东西。
pinyin: Wǎn jiān, wǒ xiǎng qù shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxī.
en: In the evening, I want to go to the shop to buy things.

zh: 这个杯子的售价比那个贵。
pinyin: Zhège bēizi de shòujià bǐ nàge guì.
en: The selling price of this cup is more expensive than that one.

zh: 今天我们去看了中国杂技。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒmen qù kànle Zhōngguó zájì.
en: Today we went to see Chinese acrobatics.

zh: 没钱买衣服，她有点发愁。
pinyin: Méi qián mǎi yīfu, tā yǒudiǎn fā chóu.
en: Having no money to buy clothes, she is a bit fretting.

zh: 你别愣着看我，快去帮忙。
pinyin: nǐ bié lèng zhe kàn wǒ ， kuài qù bāng máng 。
en: Don't stare at me blankly, go help quickly.

zh: 我想知道你的年薪是多少。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhīdào nǐ de niánxīn shì duōshǎo.
en: I want to know what your annual salary is.

zh: 医生给我的手包上了绷带。
pinyin: Yīshēng gěi wǒ de shǒu bāoshàngle bēngdài.
en: The doctor wrapped a bandage around my hand.

zh: 这个字是从那个字衍生的。
pinyin: Zhè ge zì shì cóng nà ge zì yǎn shēng de.
en: This character is derived from that one.

zh: 我去买东西，顺便去学校。
pinyin: Wǒ qù mǎi dōngxī, shùnbiàn qù xuéxiào.
en: I'm going to buy things, and I'll go to school on the way.

zh: 妈妈工作很忙，我不忧愁。
pinyin: Māma gōngzuò hěn máng, wǒ bù yōuchóu.
en: Mom is very busy with work; I am not worried.

zh: 请帮我查找一下你的书包。
pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ cházhǎo yīxià nǐ de shūbāo.
en: Please help me search for your schoolbag.

zh: 妈妈想方设法给我买衣服。
pinyin: māma xiǎngfāngshèfǎ gěi wǒ mǎi yīfu.
en: Mom thinks of every possible method to buy clothes for me.

zh: 这本书很好，我喜欢读之。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn hǎo, wǒ xǐhuān dú zhī.
en: This book is very good, I like reading it.

zh: 老师告知我们明天去学校。
pinyin: Lǎoshī gàozhī wǒmen míngtiān qù xuéxiào.
en: The teacher informed us to go to school tomorrow.

zh: 他是医生，这是他的特产。
pinyin: Tā shì yīshēng, zhè shì tā de tèchǎn.
en: He is a doctor, and this is his area of expertise.

zh: 我学习中文，要持之以恒。
pinyin: Wǒ xuéxí Zhōngwén, yào chízhīyǐhéng.
en: I want to study Chinese with perseverance.

zh: 这个杯子容纳不了太多水。
pinyin: Zhège bēizi róngnà bùliǎo tài duō shuǐ.
en: This cup cannot hold too much water.

zh: 你别熬夜，这对身体不好。
pinyin: Nǐ bié áoyè, zhè duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
en: Don't stay up late, it is not good for your health.

zh: 我思前想后，还是去上学。
pinyin: Wǒ sīqiánxiǎnghòu, háishì qù shàngxué.
en: I pondered over the causes and consequences, and decided to go to school.

zh: 她质问我们什么时候回来。
pinyin: Tā zhìwèn wǒmen shénme shíhou huílái.
en: She asked us when we would return.

zh: 他去学校的路和寻常一样。
pinyin: Tā qù xuéxiào de lù hé xúncháng yīyàng.
en: His route to school is the same as usual.

zh: 除此之外，家里没有别人。
pinyin: chú cǐ zhī wài, jiālǐ méiyǒu biérén.
en: Apart from this, there is no one else at home.

zh: 他关上门，随即去睡觉了。
pinyin: Tā guānshàng mén, suíjí qù shuìjiào le.
en: He closed the door, following which he went to sleep.

zh: 妈妈生病了，她要去就医。
pinyin: Māma shēngbìng le, tā yào qù jiù yī.
en: Mom is sick; she needs to seek medical treatment.

zh: 妈妈给我的爱是无条件的。
pinyin: Māma gěi wǒ de ài shì wútiáojiàn de.
en: The love my mother gives me is unconditional.

zh: 他脱口而出：“我爱你”。
pinyin: Tā tuō kǒu ér chū: “Wǒ ài nǐ.”
en: He blurted out, "I love you."

zh: 他不跟我说话，真没意思。
pinyin: Tā bù gēn wǒ shuōhuà, zhēn méi yìsi.
en: He doesn't talk to me, it's really of no interest.

zh: 我们要做朋友，天长地久。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào zuò péngyǒu, tiān cháng dì jiǔ.
en: We want to be friends, enduring while the world lasts.

zh: 同学们七嘴八舌地说着话。
pinyin: tóngxuémen qīzuǐbāshé de shuōzhe huà.
en: The classmates are chatting with everyone talking at once.

zh: 明天要考试，我有点犯愁。
pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎoshì, wǒ yǒudiǎn fànchóu.
en: There is an exam tomorrow, I am a bit worried.

zh: 读了这本书，我很有同感。
pinyin: Dúle zhè běn shū, wǒ hěn yǒu tónggǎn.
en: After reading this book, I have a similar impression.

zh: 孩子不爱读书，我很痛心。
pinyin: Háizi bù ài dúshū, wǒ hěn tòngxīn.
en: It is painful for me that the child does not like to study.

zh: 她一眼就喜欢上了那本书。
pinyin: Tā yīyǎn jiù xǐhuān shàngle nà běn shū.
en: She fell in love with that book at a quick look.

zh: 我们做了一个周密的准备。
pinyin: Wǒmen zuò le yīgè zhōumì de zhǔ de zhǔnbèi.
en: We made careful preparations.

zh: 乡亲们给了我们很多水果。
pinyin: Xiāngqīnmen gěile wǒmen hěnduō shuǐguǒ.
en: The local people gave us a lot of fruit.

zh: 我们碰巧买了一样的衣服。
pinyin: Wǒmen pèngqiǎo mǎi le yíyàng de yīfu.
en: We bought the same clothes by coincidence.

zh: 老师说，我们不能迫害同学。
pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, wǒmen bùnéng pòhài tóngxué.
en: The teacher said we cannot persecute our classmates.

zh: 据悉，同学们都很喜欢汉语。
pinyin: Jù xī, tóngxuémen dōu hěn xǐhuān Hànyǔ.
en: According to reports, all the students like Chinese very much.

zh: 这个商店的电影票供不应求。
pinyin: Zhège shāngdiàn de diànyǐngpiào gōngbùyìngqiú.
en: Movie tickets at this store are in short supply.

zh: 那个学生掉队了，没来学校。
pinyin: Nàge xuéshēng diào duì le, méi lái xuéxiào.
en: That student dropped out and didn't come to school.

zh: 准备考试是我们的当务之急。
pinyin: Zhǔnbèi kǎoshì shì wǒmen de dāngwùzhījí.
en: Preparing for the exam is our top priority.

zh: 明天五点有会，届时请你来。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǔ diǎn yǒu huì, jièshí qǐng nǐ lái.
en: There is a meeting tomorrow at five; please come when the time comes.

zh: 我们一起去看了那个纪念碑。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīqǐ qù kàn le nàge jìniànbēi.
en: We went to see that monument together.

zh: 老师催促学生们早点儿回家。
pinyin: Lǎoshī cuīcù xuéshengmen zǎodiǎnr huí jiā.
en: The teacher urges the students to go home early.

zh: 他们昨天晚上在夜总会见面。
pinyin: Tāmen zuótiān wǎnshàng zài yèzǒnghuì jiànmiàn.
en: They met at the nightclub last night.

zh: 我们在观望天气，准备去玩。
pinyin: wǒmen zài guānwàng tiānqì, zhǔnbèi qù wán.
en: We are waiting to see the weather, preparing to go play.

zh: 他的学历很高，有很多朋友。
pinyin: tā de xué lì hěn gāo ， yǒu hěn duō péng yǒu 。
en: He has a strong educational background and many friends.

zh: 桌子上放着各式各样的杯子。
pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe gè shì gè yàng de bēizi.
en: There are various cups placed on the table.

zh: 妈妈生病了，还要顾及工作。
pinyin: Māma shēngbìng le, hái yào gùjí gōngzuò.
en: Mom is sick but still has to attend to her work.

zh: 他住在一个不起眼的房间里。
pinyin: Tā zhù zài yīgè bù qǐyǎn de fángjiān lǐ.
en: He lives in an unremarkable room.

zh: 直至现在，他还在这里工作。
pinyin: Zhí zhì xiànzài, tā hái zài zhèlǐ gōngzuò.
en: Up until now, he is still working here.

zh: 我在网上买东西，订单很多。
pinyin: Wǒ zài wǎngshàng mǎi dōngxi, dìngdān hěnduō.
en: I buy things online, and there are many orders.

zh: 我们休息一下，喘息一会儿。
pinyin: wǒmen xiūxi yīxià, chuǎn xī yīhuìr.
en: Let's take a rest and catch our breath for a moment.

zh: 还没回家，我就精疲力竭了。
pinyin: hái méi huí jiā, wǒ jiù jīng pí lì jié le.
en: Before even getting home, I was washed out.

zh: 他生病了，这真是雪上加霜。
pinyin: Tā shēngbìng le, zhè zhēn shì xuěshàngjiāshuāng.
en: He is sick, and this is making matters worse.

zh: 她害羞地笑了笑，没有说话。
pinyin: Tā hàixiū de xiàole xiào, méiyǒu shuōhuà.
en: She gave a bashful smile without saying anything.

zh: 好在没下雨，我们去打球吧。
pinyin: hǎo zài méi xià yǔ, wǒ men qù dǎ qiú ba.
en: Luckily it didn't rain, let's go play ball.

zh: 奶奶身体不好，我来照料她。
pinyin: nǎinai shēntǐ bù hǎo, wǒ lái zhàoliào tā.
en: Grandma is not in good health, I will take care of her.

zh: 他和朋友朝夕相处，很高兴。
pinyin: Tā hé péngyǒu zhāo xī xiāng chǔ, hěn gāoxìng.
en: He is very happy to spend all his time with his friend.

zh: 这是我们的事，请你别插嘴。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen de shì, qǐng nǐ bié chāzuǐ.
en: This is our business, please don't butt in.

zh: 焦小姐想去那家商店买东西。
pinyin: Jiāo xiǎojiě xiǎng qù nà jiā shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi.
en: Miss Jiao wants to go to that shop to buy things.

zh: 他是一个土生土长的北京人。
pinyin: Tā shì yīgè tǔshēngtǔzhǎng de Běijīng rén.
en: He is a native Beijing person, born and raised.

zh: 我和亲朋好友在一起很高兴。
pinyin: Wǒ hé qīnpéng hǎoyǒu zài yīqǐ hěn gāoxìng.
en: I am very happy when with my kith and kin.

zh: 他毫不犹豫地买了这个手机。
pinyin: Tā háo bù yóu yù de mǎi le zhè ge shǒujī.
en: He bought this mobile phone without the slightest hesitation.

zh: 他走了，换言之，他不在了。
pinyin: Tā zǒu le, huànyánzhī, tā bù zài le.
en: He left; in other words, he is not here.

zh: 他没来，由此看来他不高兴。
pinyin: Tā méi lái, yóu cǐ kàn lái tā bù gāoxìng.
en: He didn't come; judging from this, he is not happy.

zh: 他病了，以至于不能去学校。
pinyin: Tā bìng le, yǐ zhìyú bùnéng qù xuéxiào.
en: He is sick, to the extent that he cannot go to school.

zh: 他平日里喜欢去图书馆读书。
pinyin: tā píngrì lǐ xǐhuān qù túshūguǎn dúshū.
en: He likes to go to the library to read every day.

zh: 他是一个喜欢沽名钓誉的人。
pinyin: Tā shì yīgè xǐhuān gūmíngdiàoyù de rén.
en: He is a person who likes to fish for compliments.

zh: 我们做好了万无一失的准备。
pinyin: Wǒmen zuò hǎo le wànwúyīshī de zhǔnbèi.
en: We have made surefire preparations.

zh: 这些水果太贵了，我买不起。
pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ tài guì le, wǒ mǎi bu qǐ.
en: These fruits are too expensive; I can't afford buying them.

zh: 这个电影院明天放映新电影。
pinyin: zhè ge diàn yǐng yuàn míng tiān fàng yìng xīn diàn yǐng.
en: This cinema will show a new movie tomorrow.

zh: 工作错综复杂，他不想做了。
pinyin: Gōng zuò cuò zōng fù zá, tā bù xiǎng zuò le.
en: The work is tangled and complicated, he does not want to do it anymore.

zh: 他没吃早饭，在路上晕倒了。
pinyin: Tā méi chī zǎofàn, zài lùshàng yūndǎo le.
en: He didn't eat breakfast and blacked out on the road.

zh: 我在论坛上认识了几个朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ zài lùntán shàng rènshíle jǐ gè péngyǒu.
en: I met a few friends on the forum.

zh: 他在路上碰上了那个坏天气。
pinyin: Tā zài lùshàng pèng shàng le nàge huài tiānqì.
en: He ran into that bad weather on the road.

zh: 我明天去图书馆归还这本书。
pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān qù túshūguǎn guīhuán zhè běn shū.
en: I will go to the library tomorrow to return this book.

zh: 鉴于他是我的朋友，我帮他。
pinyin: jiàn yú tā shì wǒ de péng yǒu, wǒ bāng tā.
en: Seeing that he is my friend, I will help him.

zh: 他想去看看这个国家的领土。
pinyin: Tā xiǎng qù kànkan zhège guójiā de lǐngtǔ.
en: He wants to go and see the territory of this country.

zh: 今天和明天的天气不相上下。
pinyin: Jīntiān hé míngtiān de tiānqì bù xiāng shàng xià.
en: Today's and tomorrow's weather are about the same.

zh: 他缓缓地坐下，喝了一杯茶。
pinyin: Tā huǎnhuǎn de zuòxià, hē le yì bēi chá.
en: He sat down unhurriedly and drank a cup of tea.

zh: 老师觉得这个学生很有出息。
pinyin: lǎo shī jué de zhè gè xué shēng hěn yǒu chū xi
en: The teacher thinks this student has great prospects.

zh: 妹妹是一个朝气蓬勃的女孩。
pinyin: Mèimei shì yīgè zhāoqìpéngbó de nǚhái.
en: My younger sister is a bright spark of a girl.

zh: 我们要准备一些水果去野餐。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhǔnbèi yīxiē shuǐguǒ qù yěcān.
en: We need to prepare some fruits for the picnic.

zh: 这本书引人入胜，我喜欢看。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǐn rén rù shèng, wǒ xǐhuān kàn.
en: This book is enchanting, I like reading it.

zh: 他有一个难以置信的好工作。
pinyin: Tā yǒu yīgè nányǐzhìxìn de hǎo gōngzuò.
en: He has an unbelievable job.

zh: 这些事不是侃大山，是真的。
pinyin: Zhèxiē shì bùshì kǎn dàshān, shì zhēn de.
en: These things are not gossip; they are true.

zh: 要不是下雨，我们就去学校。
pinyin: Yào bù shì xiàyǔ, wǒmen jiù qù xuéxiào.
en: But for the rain, we would go to school.

zh: 现在太晚了，我吃不上饭了。
pinyin: Xiànzài tài wǎn le, wǒ chī bu shàng fàn le.
en: It is too late now, I missed the meal.

zh: 弟弟非常淘气，妈妈很生气。
pinyin: Dìdi fēicháng táoqì, māma hěn shēngqì.
en: My younger brother is very naughty, and Mom is very angry.

zh: 这儿太热了，何况也没有水。
pinyin: Zhèr tài rè le, hékuàng yě méiyǒu shuǐ.
en: It is too hot here, to say nothing of the fact that there is no water.

zh: 我看见她，情不自禁地笑了。
pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn tā, qíng bù zì jīn de xiàole.
en: When I saw her, I could not help but smile.

zh: 我吃饭，与此同时我在看书。
pinyin: Wǒ chīfàn, yǔ cǐ tóng shí wǒ zài kànshū.
en: I am eating, and at the same time, I am reading a book.

zh: 请在这个地方填写你的电话。
pinyin: Qǐng zài zhège dìfāng tiánxiě nǐ de diànhuà.
en: Please write your phone number in this place.

zh: 他们的会面时间是下午三点。
pinyin: Tāmen de huìmiàn shíjiān shì xiàwǔ sān diǎn.
en: Their meeting time is at 3:00 PM.

zh: 很多外国人喜欢吃中国点心。
pinyin: hěn duō wài guó rén xǐ huān chī zhōng guó diǎn xīn.
en: Many foreigners like to eat Chinese dim sum.

zh: 银幕很大，我们去看电影吧。
pinyin: Yínmù hěn dà, wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba.
en: The movie screen is very big, let's go watch a movie.

zh: 这个足智多谋的学生帮了我。
pinyin: Zhège zúzhìduōmóu de xuéshēng bāngle wǒ.
en: This student, who is full of stratagems, helped me.

zh: 这些东西性价比很好，我想买。
pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi xìngjiàbǐ hěn hǎo, wǒ xiǎng mǎi.
en: These things have a very good cost-performance ratio, I want to buy them.

zh: 我忘记了他的名字，这真尴尬。
pinyin: Wǒ wàngjìle tā de míngzì, zhè zhēn gāngà.
en: I forgot his name, this is really awkward.

zh: 今天下雨，我们不妨在家看书。
pinyin: Jīntiān xiàyǔ, wǒmen bùfáng zài jiā kànshū.
en: Since it is raining today, there is no harm in us staying at home to read.

zh: 妈妈一如既往地给我买好吃的。
pinyin: Māma yī rú jì wǎng de gěi wǒ mǎi hǎochī de.
en: Mom buys me delicious food, just as in the past.

zh: 我不去，他恰恰相反，他要去。
pinyin: Wǒ bù qù, tā qià qià xiāng fǎn, tā yào qù.
en: I am not going; it is just the opposite, he is going.

zh: 我昨天在图书馆看见了饶同学。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài túshūguǎn kànjiànle Ráo tóngxué.
en: I saw student Rao at the library yesterday.

zh: 老师默默无闻地做了很多工作。
pinyin: Lǎoshī mòmòwúwén de zuò le hěn duō gōngzuò.
en: The teacher did a lot of work quietly and without fame.

zh: 我爱爸爸妈妈，我要孝敬他们。
pinyin: wǒ ài bàba māma, wǒ yào xiàojìng tāmen.
en: I love my mom and dad, I want to show them filial respect.

zh: 假设明天天气好，我们就去玩。
pinyin: jiǎshè míngtiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen jiù qù wán.
en: Suppose the weather is good tomorrow, we will go out to play.

zh: 考试前，他喝了一杯热茶壮胆。
pinyin: Kǎoshì qián, tā hēle yībēi rè chá zhuàngdǎn.
en: Before the exam, he drank a cup of hot tea to get his courage up.

zh: 时间很匆忙，我们快去学校吧。
pinyin: Shíjiān hěn cōngmáng, wǒmen kuài qù xuéxiào ba.
en: Time is pressing; let's go to school quickly.

zh: 他的房间里书和电脑一应俱全。
pinyin: Tā de fángjiān lǐ shū hé diànnǎo yīyīngjùquán.
en: Books and computers are all available in his room.

zh: 这次考试没考好，他有些泄气。
pinyin: zhè cì kǎoshì méi kǎohǎo, tā yǒuxiē xièqì.
en: He didn't do well on the exam, so he felt a bit discouraged.

zh: 房间太狭窄了，放不下大桌子。
pinyin: Fángjiān tài xiázhǎi le, fàng bú xià dà zhuōzi.
en: The room is too narrow; it cannot fit a large table.

zh: 火车延误了，我们要等一会儿。
pinyin: Huǒchē yánwù le, wǒmen yào děng yīhuìr.
en: The train is delayed, we need to wait for a while.

zh: 请在空白的地方写下你的名字。
pinyin: Qǐng zài kòngbái de dìfang xiě xià nǐ de míngzi.
en: Please write your name in the blank space.

zh: 他不爱说话，在那儿格格不入。
pinyin: Tā bù ài shuōhuà, zài nà'er gégébùrù.
en: He doesn't like to talk, and he feels out of place there.

zh: 他看到我，不假思索地说你好。
pinyin: Tā kàndào wǒ, bù jiǎ sī suǒ de shuō nǐ hǎo.
en: He saw me and said hello without thinking.

zh: 至此，这个学校有三百个学生。
pinyin: Zhì cǐ, zhège xuéxiào yǒu sānbǎi gè xuésheng.
en: Up until now, this school has three hundred students.

zh: 如果说他有时间，他会去学校。
pinyin: rú guǒ shuō tā yǒu shí jiān, tā huì qù xué xiào.
en: If he has time, he will go to school.

zh: 妈妈听了我的心里话，很高兴。
pinyin: Māma tīngle wǒ de xīnlǐhuà, hěn gāoxìng.
en: Mom was happy after hearing my true feelings.

zh: 他做事很认真，是我们的楷模。
pinyin: tā zuò shì hěn rèn zhēn, shì wǒ men de kǎi mó.
en: He works very seriously and is our example.

zh: 看到他来了，你不用大惊小怪。
pinyin: Kàndào tā láile, nǐ bùyòng dà jīng xiǎo guài.
en: You don't need to make a fuss about nothing just because he came.

zh: 今天我自由自在地休息了一天。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ zìyóuzìzài de xiūxi le yī tiān.
en: Today I had a leisurely rest for the whole day.

zh: 今天天气很好，我们去海滩吧。
pinyin: jīn tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo, wǒ men qù hǎi tān ba.
en: The weather is very good today, let's go to the beach.

zh: 我情愿在家看书，也不想出去。
pinyin: Wǒ qíngyuàn zài jiā kànshū, yě bùxiǎng chūqù.
en: I would rather stay at home reading books than go out.

zh: 这是你和我的事，不是一回事。
pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ hé wǒ de shì, bú shì yī huí shì.
en: This is your affair and my affair, not the same thing.

zh: 这次考试对学生来说至关重要。
pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì duì xuéshēng lái shuō zhìguānzhòngyào.
en: This exam is extremely important for the students.

zh: 第一次见面，我觉得有点别扭。
pinyin: Dì yī cì jiànmiàn, wǒ juéde yǒudiǎn bièniu.
en: Meeting for the first time, I felt a bit awkward.

zh: 他常常一边学习一边勤工俭学。
pinyin: Tā chángcháng yībiān xuéxí yībiān qín gōng jiǎn xué.
en: He often works part-time while studying.

zh: 他在书包里摸索半天没找到书。
pinyin: Tā zài shūbāo lǐ mōsuo bàntiān méi zhǎodào shū.
en: He fumbled in his schoolbag for a long time but didn't find the book.

zh: 他的工作很忙，常常身不由己。
pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò hěn máng, chángcháng shēn bù yóu jǐ.
en: His work is very busy; he is often unable to control his own actions.

zh: 新年快到了，我们在倒数时间。
pinyin: Xīnnián kuài dào le, wǒmen zài dàoshǔ shíjiān.
en: New Year is coming soon, we are counting down the time.

zh: 我家里有三个孩子，我是老大。
pinyin: wǒ jiā lǐ yǒu sān gè hái zi, wǒ shì lǎo dà.
en: There are three children in my family, and I am the eldest.

zh: 生病的时候，身体真的很难堪。
pinyin: Shēngbìng de shíhòu, shēntǐ zhēnde hěn nánkān.
en: When sick, the body is really hard to take.

zh: 这个精明的学生知道怎么学习。
pinyin: Zhè ge jīng míng de xué shēng zhī dào zěn me xué xí.
en: This astute student knows how to study.

zh: 老师告诉我，学习是他的座右铭。
pinyin: Lǎoshī gàosù wǒ, xuéxí shì tā de zuòyòumíng.
en: The teacher told me that learning is his motto.

zh: 她是我的老师，也是这里的专人。
pinyin: tā shì wǒ de lǎoshī, yě shì zhèlǐ de zhuān rén.
en: She is my teacher and also a specialist here.

zh: 我们两个素不相识，怎么去他家？
pinyin: wǒmen liǎng gè sù bù xiāng shí, zěnme qù tā jiā?
en: We are two total strangers, how can I go to his house?

zh: 无论如何，明天我们都要去学校。
pinyin: wú lùn rú hé, míng tiān wǒ men dōu yào qù xué xiào.
en: No matter what, we have to go to school tomorrow.

zh: 明天天气很好，我们去滑雪好吗？
pinyin: Míngtiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen qù huáxuě hǎo ma?
en: The weather is very good tomorrow, shall we go skiing?

zh: 考试的时候，我们不能弄虚作假。
pinyin: kǎo shì de shí hòu, wǒ men bù néng nòng xū zuò jiǎ.
en: When taking the exam, we must not practice fraud.

zh: 他不爱我，反过来，我也不爱他。
pinyin: Tā bù ài wǒ, fǎn guò lái, wǒ yě bù ài tā.
en: He doesn't love me; conversely, I don't love him either.

zh: 他工作很忙，甚至于没时间睡觉。

en: Many poplar trees are planted in the school.

pinyin: Tā mǎi le yī liàng zhōngxíng qìchē.
en: He bought a medium-sized car.

zh: 这款车是今年的新款。
pinyin: Zhè kuǎn chē shì jīnnián de xīn kuǎn.
en: This car is this year's new model.

zh: 老师谅解了我的意思。
pinyin: lǎo shī liàng jiě le wǒ de yì si.
en: The teacher understood my meaning.

zh: 我们要打破这个僵局。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào dǎpò zhège jiāngjú.
en: We must break this impasse.

zh: 汽车的悬挂系统坏了。
pinyin: qìchē de xuán guà xìtǒng huàile.
en: The car's suspension system is broken.

zh: 我只想听你实话实说。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng tīng nǐ shíhuàshíshuō.
en: I only want to hear you tell the truth.

zh: 他给我的礼物很丰厚。
pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ de lǐwù hěn fēnghòu.
en: The gift he gave me is very generous.

zh: 他们的做法自相矛盾。
pinyin: Tāmen de zuòfǎ zì xiāng máo dùn.

zh: 这是一个先天的特点。
pinyin: zhè shì yīgè xiāntiān de tèdiǎn.
en: This is an inborn characteristic.

pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi chōngxǐ yīxià shuǐguǒ.
en: You should rinse the fruit.

zh: 他是一个纯朴的农民。
pinyin: Tā shì yīgè chúnpǔ de nóngmín.
en: He is a simple and honest farmer.

zh: 他一时糊涂做了错事。
pinyin: tā yī shí hú tu zuò le cuò shì.
en: He was confused for a moment and did something wrong.

zh: 他不可以说走就出走。
pinyin: tā bù kěyǐ shuō zǒu jiù chūzǒu.
en: He cannot just run away as he pleases.

zh: 邻居们在一起很和气。
pinyin: Línjūmen zài yīqǐ hěn héqi.
en: The neighbors are friendly with each other.

zh: 同学们在教室里歌咏。
pinyin: Tóngxuémen zài jiàoshì lǐ gēyǒng.
en: The students are singing in the classroom.

zh: 他非常有灵敏的头脑。
pinyin: tā fēicháng yǒu língmǐn de tóunǎo.
en: He has a very smart mind.

zh: 老师很有优雅的气质。
pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn yǒu yōuyǎ de qìzhì.
en: The teacher has a graceful temperament.

zh: 他行使他的工作职责。
pinyin: Tā xíngshǐ tā de gōngzuò zhízé.
en: He exercises his work duties.

zh: 前面路坏了，请绕行。
pinyin: Qiánmiàn lù huàile, qǐng ràoxíng.
en: The road ahead is broken, please take a detour.

pinyin: Tā de kǎ tòuzhī le wǔbǎi yuán.
en: His card was overdrawn by five hundred yuan.

zh: 你不能推卸你的责任。
pinyin: Nǐ bùnéng tuīxiè nǐ de zérèn.
en: You cannot avoid your responsibility.

zh: 他非常喜欢吃莲子粥。
pinyin: Tā fēicháng xǐhuān chī lián zǐ zhōu.
en: He likes eating lotus seed porridge very much.

zh: 她喜欢在教室里空想。
pinyin: tā xǐ huān zài jiào shì lǐ kōng xiǎng.
en: She likes to fantasize in the classroom.

zh: 他有一个耀眼的未来。
pinyin: Tā yǒu yīgè yàoyǎn de wèilái.
en: He has a dazzling future.

zh: 运动员身体非常健壮。
pinyin: Yùndòngyuán shēntǐ fēicháng jiànzhuàng.
en: The athlete's body is very robust.

zh: 这是一个高昂的价格。
pinyin: Zhè shì yīgè gāo'áng de jiàgé.
en: This is a high price.

pinyin: yī shēng shuō tā chuán rǎn le gǎn mào.
en: The doctor said he caught a cold from someone.

zh: 你应该亲身去试一试。
pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi qīnshēn qù shì yī shì.
en: You should try it yourself.

zh: 这就是我们的缘分吧。
pinyin: Zhè jiùshì wǒmen de yuánfèn ba.
en: This must be our predestined connection.

zh: 她的衣服颜色很炫耀。
pinyin: Tā de yīfú yánsè hěn xuànyào.
en: The color of her clothes is very dazzling.

pinyin: Tā zài lùbiān kàn dào le fènbiàn.

pinyin: wǒmen yào bàmiǎn nàge huàirén.

pinyin: nàge gùshì zhēn jīngxīndòngpò.
en: That story is truly heart-stopping.

pinyin: Zhège dìfāng chōngmǎnle shēngjī.
en: This place is full of vigor.

pinyin: Tā xiànglái duì rén hěn yǒu lǐmào.
en: He has always been very polite to others.

pinyin: Háizi yào xuéhuì dúlì zìzhǔ.
en: Children must learn to be independent and autonomous.

pinyin: wǒ men kě yǐ yī qǐ zhēn chá ma ？

pinyin: Wǒmen yào duǒbì zhèxiē huàirén.

pinyin: Qǐng zài zhège yìchéng shàng qiānzì.
en: Please sign this agenda item.

pinyin: Lǎoshī xuānchēng zuòyè hěn zhòngyào.
en: The teacher asserts that homework is very important.

zh: 他装扮成了一个学生。
pinyin: Tā zhuāngbàn chéng le yī gè xuéshēng.
en: He disguised himself as a student.

zh: 这个冷冻食品很好吃。
pinyin: Zhège lěngdòng shípǐn hěn hǎochī.
en: This frozen food is delicious.

zh: 老师慰劳学生别难过。
pinyin: lǎo shī wèi láo xué shēng bié nán guò.
en: The teacher comforts the student not to be sad.

zh: 他是一个完全的路人。
pinyin: Tā shì yī gè wán quán de lù rén.
en: He is a complete stranger.

zh: 请把糖果分给同学们。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ tángguǒ fēn gěi tóngxuémen.
en: Please distribute the candy to the classmates.

pinyin: Cháng'é shì yuèliàng shàng de nǚrén.
en: Chang'e is the woman on the moon.

pinyin: tā chù fàn le xué xiào de xiào guī.
en: He violated school regulations.

zh: 他的木工手艺很有名。
pinyin: Tā de mùgōng shǒuyì hěn yǒumíng.
en: His carpentry craftsmanship is very famous.

pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā déle yìyùzhèng.
en: The doctor said he has clinical depression.

pinyin: Dàjiā déyì yú hǎo de tiānqì.

pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ xūjiǎ de shìqíng.
en: He told me false things.

pinyin: Wǒ chūcì chángshì zuò Zhōngguó cài.
en: I tried cooking Chinese food for the first time.

pinyin: hái zi qǐ qiú mā ma mǎi wán jù.
en: The child begs his mother to buy a toy.

zh: 别用粗糙的态度对他。
pinyin: bié yòng cū cāo de tài dù duì tā.
en: Don't treat him with a gruff attitude.

zh: 他正在抹窗户上的水。
pinyin: Tā zhèngzài mā chuānghù shàng de shuǐ.
en: He is wiping the water on the window.

zh: 大火烧毁了那间房子。

en: The big fire destroyed that house.

pinyin: Péngyǒu jiějiù le wǒ de máfan.

zh: 这些东西实在太贱了。
pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi shízài tài jiàn le.
en: These things are really too inexpensive.

pinyin: lǎoshī qiāngbì le wǒ de zuòwén.
en: The teacher discarded my essay.

pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhī dào zì jǐ de shēn jià.
en: She wants to know her own personal value (market price).

pinyin: Tā shì yīgè quánnéng de bāngshǒu.

pinyin: Tā xià yì shí de jiào le yī shēng.

zh: 他过度疲劳，请休息。
pinyin: Tā guòdù píláo, qǐng xiūxi.
en: He is over-tired, please rest.

zh: 他没留意到那个错误。
pinyin: Tā méi liúyì dào nàge cuòwù.
en: He didn't take note of that mistake.

zh: 我们要有高贵的品质。
pinyin: Wǒ men yào yǒu gāo guì de pǐn zhì.
en: We must have noble character.

zh: 快看，水已经沸腾了。
pinyin: kuài kàn, shuǐ yǐ jīng fèi téng le。
en: Look, the water is already boiling.

zh: 很多人问她是否后续。
pinyin: Hěnduō rén wèn tā shìfǒu hòuxù.

zh: 他有很高的艺术技艺。
pinyin: Tā yǒu hěn gāo de yì shù jì yì.
en: He possesses high artistic art.

zh: 他不想承担这个过错。
pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng chéngdān zhège guòcuò.
en: He does not want to bear this responsibility.

pinyin: yī shēng guān xīn bìng rén de shēng sǐ.
en: The doctor cares about the life and death of the patient.

zh: 请用力打开这个盒子。
pinyin: Qǐng yònglì dǎkāi zhège hézi.
en: Please use force to open this box.

zh: 这本书的故事很精妙。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū de gùshì hěn jīngmiào.
en: The story in this book is exquisite.

zh: 对这个问题，我不解。
pinyin: duì zhè gè wèn tí, wǒ bù jiě.
en: Regarding this question, I am puzzled.

zh: 这个瓶子里没有墨了。
pinyin: Zhège píngzi lǐ méiyǒu mòle.
en: There is no ink left in this bottle.

zh: 他有一个悲哀的过去。
pinyin: Tā yǒu yīgè bēi'āi de guòqù.
en: He has a sorrowful past.

zh: 山里的树林非常稠密。
pinyin: Shānlǐ de shùlín fēicháng chóumì.
en: The woods in the mountains are very dense.

zh: 医生正在帮助受害人。
pinyin: Yīshēng zhèngzài bāngzhù shòuhàirén.
en: The doctor is helping the victim.

zh: 医生无偿为我们看病。
pinyin: Yīshēng wúcháng wèi wǒmen kànbìng.
en: The doctor treated us for free.

zh: 老师叫板，大家唱歌。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jiàobǎn, dàjiā chànggē.
en: The teacher signals the musicians, and everyone sings.

zh: 他正在准备颁奖典礼。
pinyin: Tā zhèngzài zhǔnbèi bānjiǎng diǎnlǐ.
en: He is preparing for the award ceremony.

zh: 我们要小心那个悬崖。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào xiǎoxīn nàgè xuán yá.
en: We must be careful of that overhanging cliff.

zh: 打扫房间历时一小时。
pinyin: dǎ sǎo fáng jiān lì shí yī xiǎo shí.
en: Cleaning the room took one hour.

zh: 我们要支持执法工作。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhīchí zhífǎ gōngzuò.
en: We must support law enforcement work.

zh: 医生给这个机器减压。
pinyin: Yīshēng gěi zhège jīqì jiǎnyā.
en: The doctor reduces the pressure on this machine.

zh: 次日早晨，天气很好。
pinyin: Cìrì zǎochen, tiānqì hěn hǎo.
en: The morrow morning, the weather was very good.

pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā huáile shuāngbāotāi.
en: The doctor said she is pregnant with twins.

zh: 他不爱我，毫不关心。
pinyin: tā bù ài wǒ, háo bù guānxīn.
en: He does not love me, not in the least concerned.

zh: 这个月的房租下跌了。

zh: 大家在这里观摩中文。

zh: 这里没有生活的痕迹。

en: There is no vestige of life here.

zh: 他的坏习惯根深蒂固。
pinyin: Tā de huài xíguàn gēnshēndìgù.
en: His bad habits are deep-rooted.

zh: 大家一起唱起了凯歌。
pinyin: Dàjiā yīqǐ chàng qǐle kǎigē.

zh: 公园里的花都很芬芳。

zh: 很难找到匹配的对象。

zh: 你要填写这些表格吗？

zh: 他们两人的心很知己。

en: Their hearts are very intimate.

zh: 学习国际礼仪很重要。
pinyin: Xuéxí guójì lǐyí hěn zhòngyào.
en: Learning international etiquette is very important.

zh: 医生可以治愈这个病。
pinyin: yī shēng kě yǐ zhì yù zhè gè bìng.
en: The doctor can cure this illness.

zh: 你能不能给我出主意？
pinyin: Nǐ néng bù néng gěi wǒ chū zhǔ yi?

zh: 这是我们的双边协议。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen de shuāngbiān xiéyì.
en: This is our bilateral agreement.

zh: 这里的变化日新月异。
pinyin: zhèlǐ de biànhuà rìxīnyuèyì.
en: The changes here are renewing daily.

zh: 他掌握了学习的窍门。
pinyin: Tā zhǎngwòle xuéxí de qiàomén.
en: He has mastered the know-how of studying.

zh: 医生发现他还有知觉。
pinyin: yī shēng fā xiàn tā hái yǒu zhī jué.
en: The doctor discovered he still had consciousness.

zh: 他盲目地决定买房子。
pinyin: Tā mángmù de juédìng mǎi fángzi.
en: He blindly decided to buy a house.

zh: 他是这里的元老之一。
pinyin: tā shì zhè lǐ de yuán lǎo zhī yī.
en: He is one of the doyens here.

zh: 很多学生想了解异性。
pinyin: hěn duō xué shēng xiǎng liǎo jiě yì xìng.
en: Many students want to understand the opposite sex.

zh: 他收拾房间非常利索。
pinyin: Tā shōushi fángjiān fēicháng lìsuo.
en: He tidies up the room very nimbly.

zh: 周末我想回乡下看看。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xiǎng huí xiāngxia kànkan.

zh: 这个纲领已经写好了。
pinyin: Zhège gānglǐng yǐjīng xiě hǎo le.
en: This program has already been written.

zh: 这个事切身关系到你。
pinyin: Zhège shì qièshēn guānxì dào nǐ.
en: This matter directly concerns you.

zh: 老师叫我们排练节目。
pinyin: lǎo shī jiào wǒ men pái liàn jié mù.
en: The teacher told us to rehearse the program.

zh: 刚才的暴风骤雨很冷。
pinyin: gāng cái de bào fēng zhòu yǔ hěn lěng.
en: The tempest just now was very cold.

zh: 厨房里有一个新炉灶。
pinyin: chú fáng lǐ yǒu yí gè xīn lú zào.
en: There is a new stove in the kitchen.

zh: 他通过诈骗得到了钱。
pinyin: Tā tōng guò zhà piàn dé dào le qián.
en: He obtained money through swindling.

zh: 大厦左边有一个公园。
pinyin: Dàshà zuǒbian yǒu yī gè gōngyuán.
en: There is a park on the left side of the building.

zh: 联邦官员在北京开会。
pinyin: Liánbāng guānyuán zài Běijīng kāihuì.
en: Federal officials are having a meeting in Beijing.

zh: 我在学校见到了乡亲。
pinyin: Wǒ zài xuéxiào jiàndào le xiāngqīn.

zh: 我已经和他们挂钩了。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng hé tāmen guà gōu le.
en: I have already established contact with them.

zh: 别担心，那是亲生的。
pinyin: Bié dānxīn, nà shì qīnshēng de.
en: Don't worry, that is my own flesh and blood.

zh: 我把书放在抽屉里了。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài chōu ti lǐ le.

zh: 房间里有潜在的问题。
pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ yǒu qiánzài de wèntí.

zh: 我们没料到他会迟到。
pinyin: Wǒmen méi liào dào tā huì chídào.
en: We did not anticipate that he would be late.

zh: 多吃饭不见得一定好。
pinyin: Duō chīfàn bùjiàn de yīdìng hǎo.
en: Eating a lot is not necessarily good.

pinyin: jīng lǐ zhèng zài yàn shōu xīn diàn nǎo.
en: The manager is inspecting and accepting the new computers.

zh: 这个洗涤剂味道很好。
pinyin: Zhège xǐdí jì wèidào hěn hǎo.
en: This cleaning agent smells good.

zh: 他每天都在车间工作。
pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu zài chējiān gōngzuò.
en: He works in the workshop every day.

zh: 这个麻辣火锅很好吃。
pinyin: Zhège málà huǒguō hěn hǎochī.

zh: 学生们踊跃回答问题。

zh: 他们两个为什么吵嘴？

zh: 他总是挖苦我的工作。

pinyin: xué xiào de huài shì yù yǎn yù liè.

zh: 医生夸奖了病人的努力。
pinyin: Yīshēng kuājiǎng le bìngrén de nǔlì.
en: The doctor praised the patient's efforts.

zh: 电影里的海盗非常危险。
pinyin: diàn yǐng lǐ de hǎi dào fēi cháng wēi xiǎn.
en: The pirates in the movie are very dangerous.

zh: 他们自行选择了坐火车。
pinyin: tāmen zìxíng xuǎnzé le zuò huǒchē.
en: They voluntarily chose to take the train.

zh: 照片里有很多人的合影。
pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ yǒu hěnduō rén de hé yǐng.
en: There is a group photo of many people in the picture.

zh: 我们要看这个人的属性。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào kàn zhège rén de shǔxìng.
en: We want to look at this person's attribute.

zh: 这个古老的国家灭亡了。
pinyin: Zhège gǔlǎo de guójiā mièwáng le.
en: This ancient country was destroyed.

zh: 你的帮助对我至关重要。
pinyin: Nǐ de bāngzhù duì wǒ zhìguān zhòngyào.
en: Your assistance is crucial to me.

zh: 他非常有做生意的诀窍。
pinyin: Tā fēicháng yǒu zuò shēngyì de juéqiào.
en: He has a great knack for doing business.

zh: 那座小房子坐落在山下。
pinyin: Nà zuò xiǎo fángzi zuòluò zài shān xià.
en: That small house is situated at the foot of the mountain.

zh: 他每天开私家车去上班。
pinyin: Tā měitiān kāi sījiāchē qù shàngbān.
en: He drives his private car to work every day.

zh: 请帮我留一个好的位子。
pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ liú yīgè hǎo de wèizi.
en: Please help me save a good place.

zh: 我们要出发，不能耽搁。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào chūfā, bùnéng dāngē.
en: We must set off; we cannot tarry.

zh: 他没钱，只好写个欠条。
pinyin: Tā méi qián, zhǐhǎo xiě gè qiàntiáo.
en: He had no money, so he had to write an IOU.

zh: 请您检查一下您的订单。
pinyin: Qǐng nín jiǎnchá yīxià nín de dìngdān.
en: Please check your order.

zh: 他看着目标，有的放矢。
pinyin: Tā kànzhe mùbiāo, yǒu dì fàng shǐ.
en: He looks at the target and shoots with a clear aim.

zh: 他是一个本分的小伙子。
pinyin: Tā shì yī gè běnfèn de xiǎohuǒzi.
en: He is a young man who sticks to his role.

zh: 他们正在阴谋算计别人。
pinyin: Tāmen zhèngzài yīnmóu suànjì biérén.
en: They are conspiring to plot against others.

zh: 书包里装了沉甸甸的书。
pinyin: shū bāo lǐ zhuāng le chén diàn diàn de shū.
en: The schoolbag is filled with heavy books.

zh: 老师帮我润了一下句子。
pinyin: lǎo shī bāng wǒ rùn le yī xià jù zi.
en: The teacher helped me polish (embellish) the sentence.

zh: 老师执意要问这个问题。
pinyin: lǎo shī zhí yì yào wèn zhè gè wèn tí.
en: The teacher is determined to ask this question.

zh: 我们要报废这些旧电脑。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào bàofèi zhèxiē jiù diànnǎo.
en: We need to scrap these old computers.

zh: 他说的话听起来很滑稽。
pinyin: Tā shuō de huà tīng qǐlái hěn huájī.
en: What he said sounds huaji.

zh: 他一年到头都在外面工作。
pinyin: Tā yī nián dào tóu dōu zài wàimiàn gōngzuò.
en: He works outside all year round.

zh: 即使有挫折，他也要学习。
pinyin: jí shǐ yǒu cuò zhé, tā yě yào xué xí.
en: Even if there is a setback, he still wants to study.

zh: 读书能带给我们很多启示。
pinyin: Dúshū néng dài gěi wǒmen hěnduō qǐshì.
en: Reading can bring us much enlightenment.

zh: 他是一个品德优良的学生。
pinyin: tā shì yī gè pǐndé yōuliáng de xuésheng.
en: He is a student with good moral character.

zh: 巧克力在热牛奶里融化了。
pinyin: qiǎo kè lì zài rè niú nǎi lǐ róng huà le.
en: The chocolate dissolved in the hot milk.

zh: 这些书给家里增添了快乐。
pinyin: Zhèxiē shū gěi jiālǐ zēngtiān le kuàilè.
en: These books added happiness to the home.

zh: 我差点没认出你的新发型。
pinyin: Wǒ chàdiǎn méi rènchū nǐ de xīn fàxíng.
en: I almost didn't recognize your new hairstyle.

zh: 别担心，这点小事很好说。
pinyin: Bié dānxīn, zhè diǎn xiǎoshì hěn hǎoshuō.
en: Don't worry, this small matter is easy to resolve.

zh: 这家酒店的温泉非常有名。
pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn de wēnquán fēicháng yǒumíng.
en: The hot spring at this hotel is very famous.

zh: 冒昧打扰了，请问他在吗？
pinyin: Màomèi dǎrǎo le, qǐngwèn tā zài ma?
en: Sorry to take the liberty of bothering you, is he there?

zh: 他们住在一个偏僻的岛上。
pinyin: tā men zhù zài yī gè piān pì de dǎo shàng shàng.
en: They live on a remote island.

zh: 虽然很忙，他还是很从容。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, tā háishì hěn cóngróng.
en: Although very busy, he is still calm.

zh: 这种书在图书馆里很稀少。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng shū zài tú shū guǎn lǐ hěn xī shǎo.
en: This kind of book is rare in the library.

zh: 请把东西从走后门拿进来。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ dōngxi cóng zǒu hòumén ná jìnlái.
en: Please bring the things in through the back door.

zh: 我非常喜欢他主演的戏剧。
pinyin: Wǒ fēicháng xǐhuān tā zhǔyǎn de xìjù.
en: I really like the play in which he plays the leading role.

zh: 妈妈买了新手机和说明书。
pinyin: Māma mǎi le xīn shǒujī hé shuō míng shū.
en: Mom bought a new phone and a manual.

zh: 他不慎在地图上指错了路。
pinyin: tā bù shèn zài dì tú shàng zhǐ cuò le lù.
en: He was inattentive and pointed out the wrong road on the map.

zh: 他们首创了这个新的公司。
pinyin: Tāmen shǒuchuàngle zhège xīn de gōngsī.
en: They originated this new company.

zh: 很多和尚住在这个寺庙里。
pinyin: Hěnduō héshàng zhù zài zhège sì miào lǐ.
en: Many monks live in this monastery.

zh: 他说话的时候显得很慌张。
pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de shíhòu xiǎnde hěn huāngzhāng.
en: He seemed very agitated when he spoke.

zh: 我对他说的内容不以为然。
pinyin: wǒ duì tā shuō de nèiróng bù yǐ wéi rán.
en: I take exception to what he said.

zh: 他为了声誉做了很多工作。
pinyin: tā wèile shēngyù zuò le hěnduō gōngzuò.
en: He worked hard for his fame.

zh: 他永远不会背叛他的国家。
pinyin: Tā yǒngyuǎn bù huì bèipàn tā de guójiā.
en: He will never betray his country.

zh: 看到这件事，我无话可说。
pinyin: Kàn dào zhè jiàn shì, wǒ wú huà kě shuō.
en: Seeing this matter, I have nothing to say.

zh: 我们要克服学习中的难点。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào kèfú xuéxí zhōng de nándiǎn.
en: We must overcome the difficulties in our studies.

zh: 这个小凳子坐着很不舒服。
pinyin: Zhège xiǎo dèngzi zuòzhe hěn bù shūfu.
en: Sitting on this small seat is very uncomfortable.

zh: 他借用了一个很老的笑话。
pinyin: Tā jièyòngle yīgè hěn lǎo de xiàohuà.
en: He borrowed an old joke.

zh: 我们明天要参观几个古迹。
pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān yào cānguān jǐ gè gǔjì.
en: We are going to visit several historical sites tomorrow.

zh: 敌人想要侵略我们的国家。
pinyin: dírén xiǎng yào qīn lüè wǒmen de guójiā.
en: The enemy wants to invade our country.

zh: 他一阵头晕，坐在了地上。
pinyin: Tā yī zhèn tóuyūn, zuò zàile dìshàng.
en: He had a fit of dizziness and sat on the ground.

zh: 我是活动的第一个发起人。
pinyin: Wǒ shì huódòng de dì yī gè fāqǐrén.
en: I am the first initiator of the activity.

zh: 他非得买那个红色的手机。
pinyin: Tā fēiděi mǎi nàge hóngsè de shǒujī.
en: He insists on buying that red mobile phone.

zh: 我忘记了我的账号和密码。
pinyin: Wǒ wàngjì le wǒ de zhànghào hé mìmǎ.
en: I forgot my account and password.

zh: 你别去那个凶猛的狗旁边。
pinyin: nǐ bié qù nàge xiōngměng de gǒu pángbiān.
en: Don't go near that fierce dog.

zh: 我们这样做是约定俗成的。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhèyàng zuò shì yuēdìngsúchéng de.
en: It is our customary convention to do it this way.

zh: 今天天气很好，适合出游。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, shìhé chūyóu.
en: The weather is very good today, suitable for an outing.

zh: 大家异口同声地说：你好。
pinyin: Dàjiā yì kǒu tóng shēng de shuō: Nǐ hǎo.
en: Everyone said 'Hello' in unison.

zh: 老师正在呼唤学生的姓名。
pinyin: lǎoshī zhèngzài hūhuàn xuéshēng de xìngmíng.
en: The teacher is calling the students' names.

zh: 老师觉得你的想法很可行。
pinyin: Lǎoshī juéde nǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn kěxíng.
en: The teacher thinks your idea is very feasible.

zh: 他脑子里浮现出回家的路。
pinyin: Tā nǎozi lǐ fúxiàn chū huí jiā de lù.
en: The way home came to his mind.

zh: 外面噪声太大，我睡不着。
pinyin: Wài miàn zào shēng tài dà, wǒ shuì bù zháo bù zháo.
en: The noise outside is too loud, I cannot fall asleep.

zh: 老师正在孕育学生的梦想。
pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài yùnyù xuéshēng de mèngxiǎng.
en: The teacher is nurturing the students' dreams.

zh: 我觉得这个水果口味不错。
pinyin: Wǒ juédé zhège shuǐguǒ kǒuwèi bùcuò.
en: I think the flavor of this fruit is not bad.

zh: 图书馆门口贴了新的告示。
pinyin: Tú shū guǎn mén kǒu tiē le xīn de gào shì.
en: A new announcement has been posted at the entrance of the library.

zh: 这件衣服的售价是五十元。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de shòujià shì wǔshí yuán.
en: The selling price of this piece of clothing is fifty yuan.

zh: 喝水前先试试舌头烫不烫。
pinyin: Hē shuǐ qián xiān shìshi shétou tàng bù tàng.
en: Test if the water is too hot for your tongue before drinking.

zh: 我们要提高国家的软实力。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào tígāo guójiā de ruǎnshílì.
en: We want to improve the country's soft power.

zh: 这些水果看起来很不起眼。
pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ kàn qǐlái hěn bù qǐyǎn.
en: These fruits look nothing out of the ordinary.

zh: 请帮我捡起那个高尔夫球。
pinyin: qǐng bāng wǒ jiǎn qǐ nà gè gāo ěr fū qiú.
en: Please help me pick up that golf ball.

zh: 这些标签很难粘在书本上。
pinyin: zhè xiē biāo qiān hěn nán nián zài shū běn shàng
en: These labels are hard to adhere to the books.

zh: 别整天吃喝玩乐，要学习。
pinyin: Bié zhěngtiān chī hē wán lè, yào xuéxí.
en: Don't spend all day on pleasure; you need to study.

zh: 因为大雨，很多房子受害。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dàyǔ, hěnduō fángzi shòu hài.
en: Because of the heavy rain, many houses suffered damage.

zh: 医生用酒精给我的手消毒。
pinyin: Yīshēng yòng jiǔjīng gěi wǒ de shǒu xiāodú.
en: The doctor used ethanol to disinfect my hands.

zh: 我们现在补救还来得及吗？
pinyin: Wǒmen xiànzài bǔjiù hái láidéjí ma?
en: Is it still in time for us to remedy this now?

zh: 大家都认识大名鼎鼎的他。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu rènshi dà míng dǐng dǐng de tā.
en: Everyone knows the famous him.

zh: 因为有难处，他没去学校。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu nánchu, tā méi qù xuéxiào.
en: Because he had some trouble, he didn't go to school.

zh: 这个房子看起来非常庞大。
pinyin: Zhège fángzi kàn qǐlái fēicháng pángdà.
en: This house looks very huge.

zh: 朋友不辞而别，我很伤心。
pinyin: Péngyǒu bù cí ér bié, wǒ hěn shāngxīn.
en: My friend left without saying goodbye, I am very sad.

zh: 妈妈请了家政来打扫房间。
pinyin: Māma qǐngle jiāzhèng lái dǎsǎo fángjiān.
en: Mom hired a housekeeper to clean the room.

zh: 他获得了这个重要的奖项。
pinyin: Tā huòdéle zhège zhòngyào de jiǎngxiàng.
en: He won this important award.

zh: 我真是有幸买到了这张票。
pinyin: Wǒ zhēnshi yǒuxìng mǎi dào le zhè zhāng piào.
en: I am truly fortunate to have bought this ticket.

zh: 我们的生活没有太多交集。
pinyin: Wǒmen de shēnghuó méiyǒu tài duō jiāojí.
en: Our lives do not have much interaction.

zh: 她生育了一个健康的男孩。
pinyin: Tā shēngyùle yīgè jiànkāng de nánhái.
en: She gave birth to a healthy boy.

zh: 读书能让人领悟很多知识。
pinyin: dú shū néng ràng rén lǐng wù hěn duō zhī shi.
en: Reading can help people comprehend a lot of knowledge.

zh: 这件衣服穿起来恰如其分。
pinyin: zhè jiàn yīfu chuān qǐlái qià rú qí fèn.
en: This outfit fits just right.

zh: 那个饭店现在可以用餐吗？
pinyin: Nàge fàndiàn xiànzài kěyǐ yòngcān ma?
en: Can we eat at that restaurant now?

zh: 他们两个国家建立了同盟。
pinyin: Tāmen liǎng gè guójiā jiànlì le tóngméng.
en: Those two countries formed an alliance.

zh: 他正在检查桌子上的螺丝。
pinyin: Tā zhèngzài jiǎnchá zhuōzi shàng de luósī.
en: He is checking the screws on the table.

zh: 我们要一起渡过这个难关。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào yīqǐ dùguò zhège nán guān.
en: We must get through this crisis together.

zh: 他的汉语水准提高了很多。
pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ shuǐzhǔn tígāo le hěn duō.
en: His Chinese level has improved a lot.

zh: 这些房间的设计一目了然。
pinyin: Zhèxiē fángjiān de shèjì yīmùliǎorán.
en: The design of these rooms is obvious at a glance.

zh: 他们在那儿挖了一个地道。
pinyin: tā men zài nà ér wā le yī gè dì dào.
en: They dug a tunnel there.

zh: 他一直是一个正直的老师。
pinyin: Tā yīzhí shì yī gè zhèngzhí de lǎoshī.
en: He has always been an upright teacher.

zh: 不要居高临下地跟我说话。
pinyin: Bùyào jū gāo lín xià de gēn wǒ shuōhuà.
en: Do not speak to me in a haughty manner.

zh: 老师用手势告诉我们安静。
pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng shǒushì gàosù wǒmen ānjìng.
en: The teacher used a gesture to tell us to be quiet.

zh: 这些水果是通过海运来的。
pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ shì tōngguò hǎiyùn lái de.
en: These fruits were shipped here by sea.

zh: 电影里的故事都是虚幻的。
pinyin: diàn yǐng lǐ de gù shì dōu shì xū huàn de.
en: The stories in the movie are all illusory.

zh: 他们为了几块钱还在计较。
pinyin: tāmen wèile jǐ kuài qián hái zài jìjiào.
en: They are still haggling over a few yuan.

zh: 每天看书有助于学习汉语。
pinyin: Měitiān kànshū yǒu zhù yú xuéxí Hànyǔ.
en: Reading books every day contributes to learning Chinese.

zh: 这块胶带一点儿也不黏了。
pinyin: Zhè kuài jiāodài yīdiǎnr yě bù nián le.
en: This piece of tape is not sticky at all anymore.

zh: 这个地方名副其实，很美。
pinyin: Zhè ge dìfang míng fù qí shí, hěn měi.
en: This place is aptly named, it is very beautiful.

zh: 他跑得很快，我在追赶他。
pinyin: tā pǎo de hěn kuài, wǒ zài zhuīgǎn tā。
en: He is running fast; I am pursuing him.

zh: 他的性格一点儿也不张扬。
pinyin: Tā de xìnggé yīdiǎnr yě bù zhāngyáng.
en: His personality is not at all flashy.

zh: 车上有孕妇，请大家帮忙。
pinyin: chē shàng yǒu yùn fù, qǐng dà jiā bāng máng.
en: There is a pregnant woman on the bus, everyone please help.

zh: 大家喜欢什么，见仁见智。
pinyin: Dàjiā xǐhuān shénme, jiàn rén jiàn zhì.
en: What people like is a matter of opinion.

zh: 昔日的好朋友现在不见了。
pinyin: Xīrì de hǎo péngyǒu xiànzài bùjiàn le.
en: The good friend of former days is gone now.

zh: 这一天是我们相识的日子。
pinyin: zhè yī tiān shì wǒ men xiāng shí de rì zi.
en: This day is the day we met.

zh: 我们的工作做得一塌糊涂。
pinyin: wǒ men de gōng zuò zuò de yī tā hú tu.
en: Our work is in a complete mess.

zh: 他的想法不是一成不变的。
pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ bú shì yīchéngbùbiàn de.
en: His ideas are not immutable.

zh: 那棵大树的树干是空虚的。
pinyin: Nà kē dàshù de shùgàn shì kōngxū de.
en: The trunk of that big tree is hollow.

zh: 这两家饭馆的菜大同小异。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā fànguǎn de cài dàtóngxiǎoyì.
en: The dishes in these two restaurants differ only in small points.

zh: 他们住进了一家豪华旅馆。
pinyin: Tāmen zhùjìn le yījiā háohuá lǚguǎn.
en: They checked into a luxurious hotel.

zh: 他非常尊敬家里的半边天。
pinyin: Tā fēicháng zūnjìng jiālǐ de bànbiāntiān.
en: He respects the womenfolk in his family very much.

zh: 他一晃身就躲开了那个球。
pinyin: tā yī huǎng shēn jiù duǒkāi le nàgè qiú.
en: He dodged the ball in a flash.

zh: 天气太冷，我的脚麻木了。
pinyin: tiānqì tài lěng, wǒ de jiǎo mámù le.
en: It is too cold, my feet are numb.

zh: 房间的体积是二十立方米。
pinyin: fáng jiān de tǐ jī shì èr shí lì fāng mǐ.
en: The volume of the room is twenty cubic meters.

zh: 说到底，他喜欢这个颜色。
pinyin: shuō dào dǐ, tā xǐhuān zhège yánsè.
en: In the final analysis, he likes this color.

zh: 开车时，看到学校请减速。
pinyin: Kāichē shí, kàndào xuéxiào qǐng jiǎnsù.
en: When driving, please slow down when you see a school.

zh: 你觉得这个款式适合我吗？

zh: 他正在洗澡，没能接听电话。
pinyin: Tā zhèngzài xǐzǎo, méinéng jiētīng diànhuà.
en: He is taking a shower and could not answer the phone.

zh: 学校及其学生都在努力学习。
pinyin: xuéxiào jí qí xuéshēng dōu zài nǔlì xuéxí.
en: The school and its students are all studying hard.

zh: 老板在桌子上放了一些公事。
pinyin: Lǎobǎn zài zhuōzi shàng fàng le yīxiē gōng shì.
en: The boss left some documents on the table.

zh: 同学们对这个计划有异议吗？
pinyin: Tóngxuémen duì zhège jìhuà yǒu yìyì ma?
en: Do the students have any objections to this plan?

zh: 学校需要老师和学生的协作。
pinyin: Xuéxiào xūyào lǎoshī hé xuéshēng de xiézuò.
en: The school needs the cooperation of teachers and students.

zh: 他喜欢在阴暗的灯光下看书。
pinyin: tā xǐ huān zài yīn àn de dēng guāng xià kàn shū.
en: He likes reading under dim light.

zh: 书本是学习必不可少的工具。
pinyin: Shūběn shì xuéxí bìbùkěshǎo de gōngjù.
en: Books are indispensable tools for learning.

zh: 医生说病人的情况有了转机。
pinyin: Yīshēng shuō bìngrén de qíngkuàng yǒule zhuǎnjī.
en: The doctor said the patient's condition has taken a turn for the better.

zh: 由于没有地图，我们迷路了。
pinyin: yóu yú méi yǒu dì tú, wǒ men mí lù le.
en: Because we didn't have a map, we got lost.

zh: 今天天气很好，心情很舒畅。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, xīnqíng hěn shūchàng.
en: The weather is very good today, and I feel very happy.

zh: 我的成绩在班里是倒数第二。
pinyin: Wǒ de chéngjì zài bānlǐ shì dàoshǔ dì èr.
en: My grades are second to last in the class.

zh: 众所周知，他每天都去学校。
pinyin: Zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī, tā měitiān dōu qù xuéxiào.
en: As everyone knows, he goes to school every day.

zh: 我喜欢听这部电影的主题歌。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tīng zhè bù diànyǐng de zhǔtígē.
en: I like listening to this movie's theme song.

zh: 我们要开会，因为董事来了。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào kāihuì, yīnwèi dǒngshì lái le.
en: We need to have a meeting because a board member has arrived.

zh: 桌子上放着一些破旧的报纸。
pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe yīxiē pòjiù de bàozhǐ.
en: There are some shabby newspapers on the table.

zh: 他不喜欢我，总给我穿小鞋。
pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuān wǒ, zǒng gěi wǒ chuān xiǎo xié.
en: He doesn't like me and always makes things difficult for me.

zh: 我们搬进了一个宽敞的新家。
pinyin: Wǒmen bānjìn le yīgè kuānchang de xīnjiā.
en: We moved into a spacious new home.

zh: 同学们听着笑话，前仰后合。
pinyin: tóngxuémen tīngzhe xiàohuà, qián yǎng hòu hé.
en: The students were rocking back and forth listening to the joke.

zh: 他来自一个非常大的大家庭。
pinyin: Tā láizì yīgè fēicháng dà de dà jiā tíng.
en: He comes from a very big family.

zh: 他考试的时候总是提心吊胆。
pinyin: Tā kǎoshì de shíhou zǒngshì tí xīn diào dǎn.
en: He is always nervous when taking exams.

zh: 爷爷喜欢和邻居一起打麻将。
pinyin: yé ye xǐ huān hé lín jū yī qǐ dǎ má jiàng.
en: Grandpa likes to play mahjong with the neighbors.

zh: 老师对轻蔑的态度很不高兴。
pinyin: lǎoshī duì qīngmiè de tàidu hěn bù gāoxìng.
en: The teacher is very unhappy with the scornful attitude.

zh: 据悉，这家商店明年要搬走。
pinyin: Jù xī, zhè jiā shāngdiàn míngnián yào bān zǒu.
en: According to reports, this shop will move away next year.

zh: 你可以用这些钞票去买东西。
pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ yòng zhè xiē chāo piào qù mǎi dōng xī.
en: You can use this paper money to buy things.

zh: 老师说话的时候，不要插嘴。
pinyin: Lǎoshī shuōhuà de shíhòu, búyào chāzuǐ.
en: Do not interrupt when the teacher is speaking.

zh: 我灵机一动，想出了好办法。
pinyin: Wǒ líng jī yī dòng, xiǎng chū le hǎo bàn fǎ.
en: I had a sudden brainwave and came up with a good solution.

zh: 这次没考好，我感到很惭愧。
pinyin: zhè cì méi kǎo hǎo, wǒ gǎn dào hěn cán kuì.
en: I did not do well on the exam this time, and I feel very ashamed.

zh: 我正在这家会计事务所上班。
pinyin: Wǒ zhèngzài zhè jiā kuàijì shìwùsuǒ shàngbān.
en: I am working at this accounting firm.

zh: 远处此起彼伏的房子很好看。
pinyin: Yuǎnchù cǐqǐbǐfú de fángzi hěn hǎokàn.
en: The houses rising and falling in the distance look beautiful.

zh: 至此，我们一家人都在一起。
pinyin: Zhì cǐ, wǒmen yījiārén dōu zài yīqǐ.
en: Up until now, our whole family is together.

zh: 天气太可恶了，一直在下雨。
pinyin: Tiānqì tài kěwù le, yīzhí zài xiàyǔ.
en: The weather is repulsive; it has been raining all the time.

zh: 我看见苹果，不由自主想吃。
pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn píngguǒ, bùyóuzìzhǔ xiǎng chī.
en: I saw an apple and couldn't help wanting to eat it.

zh: 这家便利店二十四小时营业。
pinyin: Zhè jiā biànlìdiàn èrshísì xiǎoshí yíngyè.
en: This convenience store is open twenty-four hours a day.

zh: 那个朝气蓬勃的小伙子是谁？
pinyin: Nàge zhāoqìpéngbó de xiǎohuǒzi shì shéi?
en: Who is that bright spark of a young man?

zh: 我们要明白这个练习的用意。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào míngbai zhège liànxí de yòngyì.
en: We must understand the purpose of this exercise.

zh: 听到这个消息，我哭笑不得。
pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, wǒ kūxiàobùdé.
en: Hearing this news, I was caught between laughter and tears.

zh: 他睁开了眼睛，看见了朋友。
pinyin: Tā zhēngkāile yǎnjīng, kànjiànle péngyǒu.
en: He opened his eyes and saw his friend.

zh: 他固然好，但我还是想回家。
pinyin: Tā gùrán hǎo, dàn wǒ háishì xiǎng huí jiā.
en: He is admittedly good, but I still want to go home.

zh: 做菜的时候可以放一点淀粉。
pinyin: Zuò cài de shíhòu kěyǐ fàng yīdiǎn diànfěn.
en: You can add a little bit of starch when cooking.

zh: 请你讲解一下这个字的意思。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ jiǎngjiě yīxià zhège zì de yìsi.
en: Please explain the meaning of this character for me.

zh: 如果你太自私，就没有朋友。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ tài zìsī, jiù méiyǒu péngyǒu.
en: If you are too selfish, you won't have friends.

zh: 我因为粗心大意写错了名字。
pinyin: Wǒ yīnwèi cūxīn dàyì xiě cuò le míngzì.
en: I wrote the name wrong due to being inadvertent.

zh: 他在公园里看书，怡然自得。
pinyin: Tā zài gōngyuán lǐ kànshū, yíránzìdé.
en: He is reading a book in the park, happy and content.

zh: 他从国外回来，和父母团聚。
pinyin: Tā cóng guówài huílái, hé fùmǔ tuánjù.
en: He returned from abroad to reunite with his parents.

zh: 他一早起来跑步，身体很好。
pinyin: Tā yī zǎo qǐlái pǎobù, shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
en: He gets up early in the morning to run, so his health is good.

zh: 即使他生气了，我也要反驳。
pinyin: Jíshǐ tā shēngqì le, wǒ yě yào fǎnbó.
en: Even if he is angry, I still want to retort.

zh: 高速公路上汽车的时速很快。
pinyin: Gāosù gōnglù shàng qìchē de shísù hěn kuài.
en: The speed of cars on the highway is very fast.

zh: 我们的生活有很多风风雨雨。
pinyin: Wǒmen de shēnghuó yǒu hěnduō fēngfēngyǔyǔ.
en: Our life has many ups and downs.

zh: 老师对学生的关心无微不至。
pinyin: Lǎoshī duì xuésheng de guānxīn wúwēi-bùzhì.
en: The teacher cares for the students in every possible way.

zh: 他在这条路上来回跑了三次。
pinyin: Tā zài zhè tiáo lùshàng láihuí pǎole sān cì.
en: He ran back and forth on this road three times.

zh: 他工作的时候看起来很潇洒。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò de shíhòu kàn qǐlái hěn xiāosǎ.
en: He looks confident and at ease when he works.

zh: 请给我介绍一下当地的特产。
pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ jièshào yīxià dāngdì de tèchǎn.
en: Please introduce the local specialty products to me.

zh: 时间是世界上最可贵的东西。
pinyin: Shíjiān shì shìjiè shàng zuì kěguì de dōngxī.
en: Time is the most precious thing in the world.

zh: 我爱吃苹果，莫过于吃苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ ài chī píngguǒ, mòguòyú chī píngguǒ.
en: I love eating apples; nothing surpasses eating apples.

zh: 孩子过马路时喜欢左顾右盼。
pinyin: háizi guò mǎlù shí xǐhuān zuǒ gù yòu pàn.
en: Children like to look left and right when crossing the road.

zh: 除此之外，我不认识任何人。
pinyin: chú cǐ zhī wài, wǒ bù rènshì rènhé rén.
en: Apart from this, I don't know anyone else.

zh: 孩子们对新玩具很有好奇心。
pinyin: Háizi men duì xīn wánjù hěn yǒu hào qí xīn.
en: Children have an interest in new toys.

zh: 这本书给我的观感非常深刻。
pinyin: zhè běn shū gěi wǒ de guāngǎn fēicháng shēnkè.
en: This book left a very deep impression on me.

zh: 这是我的荣幸，请不用客气。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de róngxìng, qǐng bùyòng kèqì.
en: It is my honor, please don't mention it.

zh: 比起去年，现在的天气更热。
pinyin: Bǐ qǐ qùnián, xiànzài de tiānqì gèng rè.
en: Compared with last year, the weather is hotter now.

zh: 老师对我们的关心一如既往。
pinyin: Lǎoshī duì wǒmen de guānxīn yī rú jì wǎng.
en: The teacher's care for us is just as in the past.

zh: 迄今为止，这门课很有意思。
pinyin: qì jīn wéi zhǐ, zhè mén kè hěn yǒu yì si.
en: So far, this course is very interesting.

zh: 我们要准备一些礼品给客人。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhǔnbèi yīxiē lǐpǐn gěi kèrén.
en: We need to prepare some presents for the guests.

zh: 他说话出口成章，很有意思。
pinyin: Tā shuō huà chū kǒu chéng zhāng, hěn yǒu yì si.
en: He speaks in an articulate way, which is very interesting.

zh: 你别再胡闹了，大家都很累。
pinyin: nǐ bié zài hú nào le, dà jiā dōu hěn lèi.
en: Stop making trouble, everyone is tired.

zh: 这次比赛中，小明脱颖而出。
pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài zhōng, Xiǎomíng tuōyǐng'érchū.
en: In this competition, Xiao Ming revealed his talent.

zh: 我对不起，请接受我的歉意。
pinyin: wǒ duì bù qǐ, qǐng jiē shòu wǒ de qiàn yì.
en: I am sorry, please accept my apology.

zh: 晚上不要胡思乱想，快睡觉。
pinyin: Wǎnshang bùyào húsīluànxiǎng, kuài shuìjiào.
en: Don't indulge in flights of fancy at night, go to sleep.

zh: 我们有了前所未有的新发现。
pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu le qián suǒ wèi yǒu de xīn fāxiàn.
en: We have an unprecedented new discovery.

zh: 他在路上遇上了一个旧同学。
pinyin: Tā zài lùshàng yù shàng le yīgè jiù tóngxué.
en: He ran into an old classmate on the road.

zh: 他一进门就直奔冰箱找水喝。
pinyin: Tā yī jìnmén jiù zhí bèn bīngxiāng zhǎo shuǐ hē.
en: As soon as he entered the door, he made a beeline for the refrigerator to find water.

zh: 我们要去学正宗的中国书法。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào qù xué zhèngzōng de Zhōngguó shūfǎ.
en: We are going to learn traditional Chinese calligraphy.

zh: 老师请同学们一一回答问题。
pinyin: Lǎoshī qǐng tóngxuémen yī yī huídá wèntí.
en: The teacher asked the students to answer the questions one by one.

zh: 历经多日，他终于回到家了。
pinyin: Lì jīng duō rì, tā zhōngyú huí dào jiā le.
en: After many days, he finally returned home.

zh: 明天去学校的交通会很通顺。
pinyin: Míngtiān qù xuéxiào de jiāotōng huì hěn tōngshùn.
en: Traffic to school tomorrow will be smooth.

zh: 他的汉语进步到了这个地步。
pinyin: tā de hànyǔ jìnbù dào le zhège dìbù.
en: His Chinese has progressed to this stage.

zh: 他为了准备测验学习到很晚。
pinyin: tā wèi le zhǔn bèi cè yàn xué xí dào hěn wǎn.
en: He studied until late to prepare for the test.

zh: 老师教我们认识不同的立体。
pinyin: Lǎo shī jiāo wǒ men rèn shi bù tóng de lì tǐ.
en: The teacher taught us to recognize different solids.

zh: 老师在班里宣扬学习的方法。
pinyin: Lǎoshī zài bānlǐ xuānyáng xuéxí de fāngfǎ.
en: The teacher publicized study methods in the class.

zh: 我们要全心全意地帮助别人。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào quán xīn quán yì de bāngzhù biérén.
en: We must help others with all our heart and soul.

zh: 老师带我们去图书馆看名著。
pinyin: Lǎoshī dài wǒmen qù túshūguǎn kàn míngzhù.
en: The teacher took us to the library to read masterpieces.

zh: 我要去二楼的鞋子专柜看看。
pinyin: Wǒ yào qù èrlóu de xiézi zhuānguì kànkan.
en: I want to go to the shoe counter on the second floor to take a look.

zh: 他和他的朋友个子悬殊很大。
pinyin: Tā hé tā de péngyǒu gèzi xuánshū hěn dà.
en: There is a vast difference in height between him and his friend.

zh: 电影里的人有各种喜怒哀乐。
pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ de rén yǒu gè zhǒng xǐnùāilè.
en: The people in the movie have all kinds of joy, anger, sorrow, and happiness.

zh: 妈妈看着孩子，发出了感慨。
pinyin: mā mā kàn zhe hái zi, fā chū le gǎn kǎi.
en: Mother looked at the child and sighed with sorrow.

zh: 他从桌子的一头走到另一头。
pinyin: Tā cóng zhuōzi de yī tóu zǒu dào lìng yī tóu.
en: He walked from one end of the table to the other.

zh: 看到礼物，她美滋滋地笑了。
pinyin: Kàndào lǐwù, tā měizīzī de xiào le.
en: Seeing the gift, she smiled very happily.

zh: 这次考试没写完，我完蛋了。
pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì méi xiěwán, wǒ wándàn le.
en: I didn't finish the test this time, I am done for.

zh: 跑累了，他不得不止步休息。
pinyin: Pǎo lèi le, tā bùdébù zhǐbù xiūxi.
en: Tired from running, he had to stop to rest.

zh: 做菜时放一点儿香油很好吃。
pinyin: Zuòcài shí fàng yīdiǎnr xiāngyóu hěn hǎochī.
en: It is delicious to put a little sesame oil when cooking.

zh: 现在的公司不好，我想跳槽。
pinyin: Xiànzài de gōngsī bù hǎo, wǒ xiǎng tiào cáo.
en: The current company is not good, I want to switch jobs.

zh: 在这个佳节里，大家都休息。
pinyin: zài zhè ge jiā jié lǐ, dà jiā dōu xiū xi.
en: During this holiday, everyone is resting.

zh: 他工作了一天，浑身没劲儿。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò le yī tiān, húnshēn méi jìnr.
en: He worked all day and feels weak all over.

zh: 他工作非常努力，很有潜能。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò fēicháng nǔlì, hěn yǒu qiánnéng.
en: He works very hard and has a lot of potential.

zh: 这本书的篇幅占了很多地方。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū de piānfu zhànle hěn duō dìfang.
en: This book takes up a lot of space.

zh: 很多国家的人信仰伊斯兰教。
pinyin: Hěn duō guójiā de rén xìnyǎng Yīsīlánjiào.
en: People in many countries believe in Islam.

zh: 这个玩具真好玩，我爱不释手。
pinyin: Zhè ge wánjù zhēn hǎowán, wǒ àibùshìshǒu.
en: This toy is so fun, I can't put it down.

zh: 纵然天气不好，他也要去旅游。
pinyin: zòng rán tiān qì bù hǎo, tā yě yào qù lǚ yóu.
en: Even if the weather is not good, he still wants to go traveling.

zh: 他失踪了，没人知道他的着落。
pinyin: Tā shīzōngle, méi rén zhīdào tā de zhuóluò.
en: He went missing, no one knows his whereabouts.

zh: 工作太忙，我很少有空儿休息。
pinyin: Gōngzuò tài máng, wǒ hěn shǎo yǒu kòngr xiūxi.
en: Work is too busy; I rarely have free time to rest.

zh: 他在网上建立了一个无形的家。
pinyin: Tā zài wǎngshàng jiànlìle yīgè wúxíng de jiā.
en: He built a virtual home online.

zh: 房间里杂乱无章，请打扫一下。
pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ zá luàn wú zhāng, qǐng dǎsǎo yīxià.
en: The room is in a mess, please clean it up.

zh: 我和我的好朋友总是形影不离。
pinyin: Wǒ hé wǒ de hǎo péngyǒu zǒng shì xíng yǐng bù lí.
en: My good friend and I are always inseparable.

zh: 他指着书说道：“这是我的。”
pinyin: tā zhǐzhe shū shuō dào: “zhè shì wǒ de.”
en: He pointed at the book and stated, 'This is mine.'

zh: 医生正在忙，请您在外面稍候。
pinyin: Yīshēng zhèngzài máng, qǐng nín zài wàimiàn shāohòu.
en: The doctor is busy, please wait outside for a moment.

zh: 他恋恋不舍地看了看那个玩具。
pinyin: Tā liànliànbùshě de kànle kàn nàge wánjù.
en: He took a look at the toy with great reluctance.

zh: 老师耳闻目睹了同学们的帮助。
pinyin: Lǎoshī ěr wén mù dǔ le tóngxuémen de bāngzhù.
en: The teacher personally witnessed the students' help.

zh: 我一眼就看出他是我的好朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ yīyǎn jiù kàn chū tā shì wǒ de hǎo péngyǒu.
en: I could see at a glance that he is my good friend.

zh: 他没有告诉我们，私自离开了。
pinyin: Tā méi yǒu gào sù wǒ men, sī zì lí kāi le.
en: He did not tell us and left secretly.

zh: 这次的成功，真的是前无古人。
pinyin: Zhè cì de chénggōng, zhēnde shì qiánwúgǔrén.
en: This success is truly unprecedented.

zh: 小明躲在门后，跟我玩捉迷藏。
pinyin: Xiǎomíng duǒ zài ménhòu, gēn wǒ wán zhuōmícáng.
en: Xiao Ming hid behind the door to play hide-and-seek with me.

zh: 我从火车站带东西转交给朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ cóng huǒchēzhàn dài dōngxī zhuǎnjiāo gěi péngyǒu.
en: I brought things from the train station to hand over to my friend.

zh: 盛老师已经教我们三年中文了。
pinyin: Shèng lǎoshī yǐjīng jiāo wǒmen sān nián Zhōngwén le.
en: Teacher Sheng has been teaching us Chinese for three years.

zh: 爷爷住在一个古老的四合院里。
pinyin: Yéye zhù zài yīgè gǔlǎo de sìhéyuàn lǐ.
en: Grandpa lives in an old courtyard house.

zh: 我们要学习他见义勇为的精神。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào xuéxí tā jiàn yì yǒng wéi de jīngshén.
en: We should learn from his spirit of acting bravely for a just cause.

zh: 他是一个工作能力很出众的人。
pinyin: Tā shì yīgè gōngzuò nénglì hěn chūzhòng de rén.
en: He is a person with outstanding work ability.

zh: 医生正在和病人交涉手术的事。
pinyin: Yīshēng zhèngzài hé bìngrén jiāoshè shǒushù de shì.
en: The doctor is negotiating with the patient about the surgery.

zh: 从今以后，我会努力学习汉语。
pinyin: Cóng jīn yǐ hòu, wǒ huì nǔlì xuéxí Hànyǔ.
en: Henceforward, I will study Chinese diligently.

zh: 学校的图书馆有很多财经杂志。
pinyin: Xué xiào de tú shū guǎn yǒu hěn duō cái jīng zá zhì.
en: The school library has many finance and economics magazines.

zh: 他连滚带爬地从山上跑了下来。
pinyin: Tā lián gǔn dài pá de cóng shānshàng pǎo le xiàlái.
en: He came running down the mountain, stumbling and crawling.

zh: 我的朋友想有一个幸福的婚姻。
pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu xiǎng yǒu yīgè xìngfú de hūnyīn.
en: My friend wants to have a happy marriage.

zh: 你怎么就不能理解我的苦心呢？
pinyin: Nǐ zěnme jiù bùnéng lǐjiě wǒ de kǔxīn ne?
en: Why can't you understand my good intentions?

zh: 今天是我们校长七十岁的诞辰。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒmen xiàozhǎng qīshí suì de dànchén.
en: Today is our principal's 70th birthday.

zh: 为了买书，不喝水，得不偿失。
pinyin: Wèile mǎi shū, bù hē shuǐ, dé bù cháng shī.
en: Not drinking water in order to buy books is not worth the loss.

zh: 老师和学生齐心协力打扫房间。
pinyin: lǎo shī hé xué shēng qí xīn xié lì dǎ sǎo fáng jiān.
en: The teacher and students pull together to clean the room.

zh: 为了买那个房子，我全力以赴。
pinyin: wèile mǎi nàge fángzi, wǒ quánlìyǐfù.
en: In order to buy that house, I will do it at all costs.

zh: 今天他不舒服，没兴致出去玩。
pinyin: Jīntiān tā bù shūfu, méi xìngzhì chūqù wán.
en: He is not feeling well today and is not in the mood to go out and play.

zh: 总而言之，我们要去北京旅游。
pinyin: zǒng ér yán zhī, wǒmen yào qù Běijīng lǚyóu.
en: In a word, we are going to Beijing to travel.

zh: 你别大大咧咧的，要注意一点。
pinyin: Nǐ bié dà dà liē liē de, yào zhùyì yīdiǎn.
en: Don't be so careless/carefree, pay a little more attention.

zh: 伤势严重，请快点送他去医院。
pinyin: Shāngshì yánzhòng, qǐng kuài diǎn sòng tā qù yīyuàn.
en: The injury is serious; please send him to the hospital quickly.

zh: 老师的一言一行对学生有影响。
pinyin: lǎoshī de yī yán yī xíng duì xuéshēng yǒu yǐngxiǎng.
en: Every word and action of the teacher has an influence on the students.

zh: 相对而言，这个房间安静一些。
pinyin: xiāng duì ér yán, zhè gè fáng jiān ān jìng yī xiē.
en: Comparatively speaking, this room is quieter.

zh: 你不能一味地休息，要多运动。
pinyin: nǐ bù néng yī wèi de xiū xi, yào duō yùn dòng.
en: You cannot just keep resting; you need to exercise more.

zh: 他每天都在玩，最后一事无成。
pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu zài wán, zuìhòu yī shì wú chéng.
en: He plays every day and in the end, he achieves nothing.

zh: 他怎么没来，我感到很纳闷儿。
pinyin: Tā zěnme méi lái, wǒ gǎndào hěn nàmèn r.
en: I feel very puzzled as to why he didn't come.

zh: 以后工作上，还请您多多指教。
pinyin: Yǐhòu gōngzuò shàng, hái qǐng nín duōduō zhǐjiào.
en: In future work, please give me more advice.

zh: 这对他来说是一次意志的磨难。
pinyin: Zhè duì tā lái shuō shì yī cì yìzhì de mónàn.
en: This is a trial of will for him.

zh: 我们非常喜欢这里的文化氛围。
pinyin: Wǒmen fēicháng xǐhuān zhèlǐ de wénhuà fēnwéi.
en: We really like the cultural atmosphere here.

zh: 管家正在给那个家人分配工作。
pinyin: Guǎnjiā zhèngzài gěi nàge jiārén fēnpèi gōngzuò.
en: The housekeeper is assigning work to that servant.

zh: 他大模大样地坐在沙发上休息。
pinyin: tā dà mú dà yàng de zuò zài shā fā shàng xiū xi.
en: He sat poised on the sofa to rest.

zh: 在未来的学习中，你大有可为。
pinyin: Zài wèilái de xuéxí zhōng, nǐ dà yǒu kě wéi.
en: In your future studies, you have great prospects.

zh: 为了买这个手机，他节衣缩食。
pinyin: Wèile mǎi zhège shǒujī, tā jiéyīsuōshí.
en: In order to buy this mobile phone, he is saving on food and clothing.

zh: 工作太累了，我想去外面透气。
pinyin: gōngzuò tài lèi le, wǒ xiǎng qù wàimiàn tòuqì.
en: Work is too tiring, I want to go outside to breathe.

zh: 狂欢节的时候，大家都很高兴。
pinyin: Kuánghuānjié de shíhòu, dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.
en: During the carnival, everyone is very happy.

zh: 学校的这些安排非常合情合理。
pinyin: Xuéxiào de zhèxiē ānpái fēicháng héqínghélǐ.
en: These arrangements made by the school are very reasonable.

zh: 为了考试，我宁愿少玩一会儿。
pinyin: Wèile kǎoshì, wǒ nìngyuàn shǎo wán yīhuìr.
en: For the sake of the exam, I would rather play a little less.

zh: 同学们聚精会神地听老师讲课。
pinyin: Tóngxuémen jùjīnghuìshén de tīng lǎoshī jiǎngkè.
en: The students are listening to the teacher attentively.

zh: 早上我喜欢吃涂了果酱的面包。
pinyin: zǎo shang wǒ xǐ huān chī tú le guǒ jiàng de miàn bāo.
en: In the morning, I like to eat bread with jam spread on it.

zh: 他的喉咙发炎了，不能吃东西。
pinyin: Tā de hóulóng fāyán le, bùnéng chī dōngxi.
en: His throat is inflamed, he cannot eat.

zh: 小明觉得妈妈是守护他的天使。
pinyin: Xiǎomíng juéde māma shì shǒuhù tā de tiānshǐ.
en: Xiao Ming thinks his mother is an angel who protects him.

zh: 对他来说，这件工作轻而易举。
pinyin: Duì tā lái shuō, zhè jiàn gōngzuò qīng'éryìjǔ.
en: For him, this work is easy.

zh: 我的爸爸是木匠，他会做椅子。
pinyin: Wǒ de bàba shì mùjiàng, tā huì zuò yǐzi.
en: My dad is a carpenter, he can make chairs.

zh: 我看见桌上有一个奇怪的物体。
pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn zhuō shàng yǒu yī gè qíguài de wùtǐ.
en: I saw a strange object on the table.

zh: 你看，那儿有一个新奇的玩具。
pinyin: Nǐ kàn, nàr yǒu yī gè xīnqí de wánjù.
en: Look, there is a novel toy over there.

zh: 今天 我们 要 祭祀 祖先。
pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ men yào jì sì zǔ xiān.
en: Today we want to offer sacrifices to our ancestors.

zh: 请问，您看见过往的行人了吗？
pinyin: Qǐngwèn, nín kànjiànguò wǎng de xíngrén le ma?
en: Excuse me, have you seen the passers-by?

zh: 你是什么时候得知这个比赛的？
pinyin: Nǐ shì shénme shíhòu dézhī zhège bǐsài de?
en: When did you find out about this competition?

zh: 我不经意地听到了他们的谈话。
pinyin: Wǒ bùjīngyì de tīngdàole tāmen de tánhuà.
en: I overheard their conversation inadvertently.

zh: 请问电影院什么时候开始售票？
pinyin: Qǐngwèn diànyǐngyuàn shénme shíhòu kāishǐ shòupiào?
en: Excuse me, when does the cinema start selling tickets?

zh: 你走的时候，顺手帮我关下灯。
pinyin: Nǐ zǒu de shíhòu, shùnshǒu bāng wǒ guān xià dēng.
en: When you leave, please turn off the light on your way out.

zh: 我们有一个史无前例的好办法。
pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu yīgè shǐwúqiánlì de hǎo bànfǎ.
en: We have an unprecedented good method.

zh: 我要把这本小书换成那本大书。
pinyin: Wǒ yào bǎ zhè běn xiǎoshū huànchéng nà běn dàshū.
en: I want to exchange this small book for that big book.

zh: 我们争分夺秒，因为时间到了。
pinyin: wǒmen zhēngfēnduómiǎo, yīnwèi shíjiān dàole.
en: We are making every second count because the time is up.

zh: 虽说现在很冷，我们要去运动。
pinyin: suī shuō xiànzài hěn lěng, wǒmen yào qù yùndòng.
en: Though it is very cold now, we want to go exercise.

zh: 做作业的时候，请留心你的名字。
pinyin: Zuò zuòyè de shíhòu, qǐng liúxīn nǐ de míngzì.
en: When doing homework, please pay attention to your name.

zh: 那个坏人，我们还是敬而远之吧。
pinyin: nàge huàirén, wǒmen háishì jìng ér yuǎn zhī ba.
en: That bad person, we'd better keep a respectful distance from him.

zh: 老师和学生对这个问题有了共识。
pinyin: lǎoshī hé xuésheng duì zhège wèntí yǒu le gòngshí.
en: The teacher and students have a common understanding of this issue.

zh: 我们知道这个错误是不可避免的。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhīdào zhège cuòwù shì bù kě bì miǎn de.
en: We know that this mistake is inevitable.

zh: 前边的车太慢了，你可以超车吗？
pinyin: Qiánbian de chē tài màn le, nǐ kěyǐ chāochē ma?
en: The car in front is too slow, can you overtake?

zh: 不管有多难，我们都要勇往直前。
pinyin: Bùguǎn yǒu duō nán, wǒmen dōu yào yǒngwǎngzhíqián.
en: No matter how difficult it is, we must advance bravely.

zh: 老师正在教室里给学生讲解课文。
pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài jiàoshì lǐ gěi xuéshēng jiǎngjiě kèwén.
en: The teacher is explaining the text to the students in the classroom.

zh: 因为家境不好，他没买那个东西。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jiājìng bù hǎo, tā méi mǎi nàge dōngxi.
en: Because of his poor family financial situation, he did not buy that thing.

zh: 通过朋友的门路，他找到了工作。
pinyin: Tōngguò péngyǒu de ménlù, tā zhǎodào le gōngzuò.
en: Through a friend's connection, he found a job.

zh: 因为这次学习失利，他很不高兴。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè cì xuéxí shīlì, tā hěn bù gāoxìng.
en: Because of this academic setback, he is very unhappy.

zh: 洗衣机出毛病了，洗不干净衣服。
pinyin: Xǐyījī chū máobìng le, xǐ bù gānjìng yīfu.
en: The washing machine broke down and can't clean clothes well.

zh: 下雨的时候，我觉得有点儿烦闷。
pinyin: Xià yǔ de shíhòu, wǒ juédé yǒudiǎnr fánmèn.
en: When it rains, I feel a bit moody.

zh: 这几个星期他都在忙着筹备婚礼。
pinyin: Zhè jǐ gè xīngqī tā dōu zài mángzhe chóubèi hūnlǐ.
en: He has been busy preparing for his wedding these past few weeks.

zh: 元宵节的时候，我们一起吃元宵。
pinyin: Yuánxiāojié de shíhòu, wǒmen yīqǐ chī yuánxiāo.
en: During the Lantern Festival, we eat yuanxiao together.

zh: 听到这个消息，他猛然站了起来。
pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā měngrán zhànle qǐlái.
en: Hearing the news, he suddenly stood up.

zh: 老师叫我们测算这个房间的大小。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jiào wǒmen cè suàn zhège fángjiān de dàxiǎo.
en: The teacher asked us to measure and calculate the size of this room.

zh: 桌子上乱七八糟的，快整理一下。
pinyin: zhuōzi shàng luànqībāzāo de, kuài zhěnglǐ yīxià.
en: The table is a mess, please tidy it up quickly.

zh: 他看到大家看他，觉得很难为情。
pinyin: Tā kàndào dàjiā kàn tā, juéde hěn nánwéiqíng.
en: He felt embarrassed when he saw everyone looking at him.

zh: 今年春节，很多亲戚都来了我家。
pinyin: Jīnnián Chūnjié, hěnduō qīnqi dōu lái le wǒ jiā.
en: Many relatives came to my house this Spring Festival.

zh: 大家觉得他是一个无情无义的人。
pinyin: Dàjiā juéde tā shì yī gè wú qíng wú yì de rén.
en: Everyone thinks he is a cold and heartless person.

zh: 在大城市，下雨是司空见惯的事。
pinyin: Zài dà chéngshì, xià yǔ shì sīkōngjiànguàn de shì.
en: In big cities, rain is a common occurrence.

zh: 电影太感人了，很多人都流泪了。
pinyin: Diànyǐng tài gǎnrén le, hěnduō rén dōu liúlèi le.
en: The movie was so touching that many people shed tears.

zh: 他回到家，发现房间里空荡荡的。
pinyin: tā huí dào jiā, fā xiàn fáng jiān lǐ kōng dàng dàng de.
en: He returned home and found the room was empty.

zh: 我妈妈不假思索地买了这个礼物。
pinyin: Wǒ māma bù jiǎ sī suǒ de mǎi le zhège lǐwù.
en: My mother bought this gift without a second thought.

zh: 如果说外面在下雨，我们就回家。
pinyin: rú guǒ shuō wài miàn zài xià yǔ, wǒ men jiù huí jiā.
en: If it is raining outside, we will go home.

zh: 老师千方百计帮助我们学习中文。
pinyin: Lǎoshī qiān fāng bǎi jì bāngzhù wǒmen xuéxí Zhōngwén.
en: The teacher tries every way possible to help us learn Chinese.

zh: 他想去看看这个地方的地理环境。
pinyin: Tā xiǎng qù kànkan zhège dìfāng de dìlǐ huánjìng.
en: He wants to go and see the geographical environment of this place.

zh: 别说电影了，连电视都没时间看。
pinyin: Bié shuō diànyǐng le, lián diànshì dōu méi shíjiān kàn.
en: To say nothing of movies, I don't even have time to watch TV.

zh: 在这个国家，君子可以住大房子。
pinyin: Zài zhège guójiā, jūnzǐ kěyǐ zhù dà fángzi.
en: In this country, a nobleman can live in a big house.

zh: 我们要学会鉴别好朋友和坏朋友。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào xuéhuì jiànbié hǎo péngyǒu hé huài péngyǒu.
en: We must learn to differentiate between good friends and bad friends.

zh: 妈妈工作很努力，她常以身作则。
pinyin: Māma gōngzuò hěn nǔlì, tā cháng yǐshēnzuòzé.
en: Mom works very hard; she often sets an example.

zh: 老板很冷酷无情，不听我们说话。
pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn lěng kù wú qíng, bù tīng wǒmen shuōhuà.
en: The boss is very cold-hearted and does not listen to us.

zh: 老师希望我们做一个光明磊落的人。
pinyin: Lǎoshī xīwàng wǒmen zuò yīgè guāngmínglěiluò de rén.
en: The teacher hopes we will be open and candid people.

zh: 老师问了两个问题，我回答了后者。
pinyin: Lǎoshī wènle liǎng gè wèntí, wǒ huídále hòuzhě.
en: The teacher asked two questions, and I answered the latter.

zh: 请你帮帮我，我现在的处境很麻烦。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bāngbāng wǒ, wǒ xiànzài de chǔjìng hěn máfan.
en: Please help me, my current situation is very troublesome.

zh: 他在学校里学习外语，说得很流畅。
pinyin: tā zài xué xiào lǐ xué xue xí wài yǔ, shuō de hěn liú chàng.
en: He studies foreign languages at school and speaks them fluently.

zh: 为了考试，他夜以继日地学习汉语。
pinyin: wèi le kǎo shì, tā yè yǐ jì rì de xué xí hàn yǔ.
en: For the exam, he studied Chinese day and night.

zh: 今天下午，我在公园里看爷爷对弈。
pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ, wǒ zài gōngyuán lǐ kàn yéyé duìyì.
en: This afternoon, I watched my grandfather play Go in the park.

zh: 为了考试，同学们都在拼命地准备。
pinyin: Wèile kǎoshì, tóngxuémen dōu zài pīnmìng de zhǔnbèi.
en: For the sake of the exam, all the students are preparing as hard as they can.

zh: 在这个公司，多劳多得是很重要的。
pinyin: Zài zhège gōngsī, duōláoduōdé shì hěn zhòngyào de.
en: In this company, the principle of 'more work, more pay' is very important.

zh: 今天天气不错，美中不足是风太大。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì bùcuò, měizhōngbùzú shì fēng tài dà.
en: The weather is nice today, but the only flaw is that the wind is too strong.

zh: 老师不喜欢那个学生总是夸夸其谈。
pinyin: lǎoshī bù xǐhuān nàge xuéshēng zǒngshì kuā kuā qí tán.
en: The teacher does not like that the student always talks big.

zh: 考试结束了，我恨不得马上出去玩。
pinyin: Kǎoshì jiéshù le, wǒ hènbudé mǎshàng chūqù wán.
en: The exam is over; I wish I could go out and play right away.

zh: 每当天气好的时候，我们就去跑步。
pinyin: měi dāng tiānqì hǎo de shíhòu, wǒmen jiù qù pǎobù.
en: Whenever the weather is good, we go running.

zh: 在那朦胧的灯光下，我读了一本书。
pinyin: zài nà méng lóng de dēng guāng xià, wǒ dú le yī běn shū.
en: Under that dim light, I read a book.

zh: 如果你觉得累了，不妨休息一会儿。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ juédé lèile, bùfáng xiūxí yīhuǐ'er.
en: If you feel tired, there is no harm in resting for a while.

zh: 明天会发生什么，还是一个未知数。
pinyin: Míngtiān huì fāshēng shénme, háishì yīgè wèizhīshù.
en: What will happen tomorrow is still an unknown.

zh: 在这个项目中，他是我的重要手臂。
pinyin: zài zhè gè xiàng mù zhōng, tā shì wǒ de zhòng yào shǒu bì.
en: In this project, he is my important helper.

zh: 他匆匆忙忙地吃完饭，就去工作了。
pinyin: Tā cōngcōngmángmáng de chī wán fàn, jiù qù gōngzuò le.
en: He finished his meal hurriedly and then went to work.

zh: 那个穿着白衬衫的男人是我的老师。
pinyin: Nàge chuānzhuó bái chènshān de nánrén shì wǒ de lǎoshī.
en: That man wearing a white shirt is my teacher.
