pinyin: Tā yòng shǒu zài kǒudài lǐ mōsuo yàoshi.
en: He used his hand to feel about for the keys in his pocket.

zh: 村子里有一个年轻的寡妇。
pinyin: cūn zi lǐ yǒu yī gè nián qīng de guǎ fu.
en: There is a young widow in the village.

zh: 他的外表让我想起他爸爸。
pinyin: Tā de wàibiǎo ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ tā bàba.
en: His outward appearance reminds me of his father.

zh: 因为时间问题我们有顾虑。
pinyin: yīn wèi shí jiān wèn tí wǒ men yǒu gù lǜ
en: We have apprehensions because of time issues.

zh: 我们必须加快工作的进程。
pinyin: Wǒ men bì xū jiā kuài gōng zuò de jìn chéng.
en: We must speed up the course of the work.

zh: 他们直至看完电影才回家。
pinyin: Tāmen zhí zhì kàn wán diànyǐng cái huí jiā.
en: They stayed until they finished watching the movie before going home.

zh: 你竟然怀疑我，岂有此理？
pinyin: nǐ jìngrán huáiyí wǒ, qǐyǒucǐlǐ?
en: You actually doubt me, how can this be so?

zh: 你不能遇到小麻烦就退却。
pinyin: nǐ bùnéng yùdào xiǎo máfan jiù tuìquè.
en: You cannot shrink back just because you encounter small troubles.

zh: 这个贝壳的颜色非常特别。
pinyin: Zhè gè bèi ké de yán sè fēi cháng tè bié.
en: The color of this shell is very unique.

zh: 考试时他很沉着，不紧张。
pinyin: Kǎoshì shí tā hěn chénzhuó, bù jǐnzhāng.
en: He is not nervous during the exam; he is calm.

zh: 至此，我的作业还没写完。
pinyin: Zhì cǐ, wǒ de zuòyè hái méi xiěwán.
en: So far, I haven't finished my homework.

zh: 如果你不小心，就会受骗。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù xiǎoxīn, jiù huì shòupiàn.
en: If you are not careful, you will be hoodwinked.

zh: 我们要多打听灵通的消息。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào duō dǎtīng língtōng de xiāoxī.
en: We need to gather more information.

zh: 我的报名逾期了，很遗憾。
pinyin: wǒ de bào míng yú qī le, hěn yí hàn.
en: My registration failed to meet the deadline, it is a pity.

zh: 他编写了一个简单的程序。
pinyin: Tā biānxiě le yīgè jiǎndān de chéngxù.
en: He compiled a simple program.

zh: 为了孩子，她选择了容忍。
pinyin: Wèile háizi, tā xuǎnzé le róngrěn.
en: For the sake of the children, she chose to put up with it.

zh: 请你对这个问题进行答辩。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ duì zhège wèntí jìnxíng dábiàn.
en: Please provide a reply to this question.

zh: 实话实说，这道题太难了。
pinyin: Shíhuàshíshuō, zhè dào tí tài nán le.
en: To tell it as it is, this problem is too difficult.

zh: 她把孩子放在膝盖上把尿。
pinyin: Tā bǎ háizi fàng zài xīgài shàng bǎ niào.
en: She put the child on her knees to help it urinate.

zh: 我从他的神气看出了不满。
pinyin: Wǒ cóng tā de shénqì kàn chūle bùmǎn.
en: I saw his dissatisfaction from his expression.

zh: 为什么你总是絮叨这些事？
pinyin: wèi shén me nǐ zǒng shì xù dao zhè xiē shì?
en: Why do you always talk endlessly about these things?

zh: 我们要以最快的速度赶到。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào yǐ zuì kuài de sùdù gǎndào.
en: We must arrive at the fastest speed.

zh: 鸟儿在天上自由自在地飞。
pinyin: Niǎor zài tiānshàng zìyóuzìzài de fēi.
en: Birds fly freely in the sky.

zh: 如果零件坏了，请换新的。
pinyin: Rú guǒ líng jiàn huài le, qǐng huàn xīn de.
en: If the part is broken, please replace it with a new one.

zh: 这里的生活和往日不同了。
pinyin: zhè lǐ de shēng huó hé wǎng rì bù tóng le.
en: Life here is different from former days.

zh: 没有人可以推翻这个决定。
pinyin: Méiyǒu rén kěyǐ tuīfān zhège juédìng.
en: No one can overturn this decision.

zh: 我没想到会是这样的结局。
pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎngdào huì shì zhèyàng de jiéjú.
en: I didn't expect such an ending.

zh: 地铁站的客流越来越多了。
pinyin: Dìtiězhàn de kèliú yuè lái yuè duō le.
en: The passenger flow at the subway station is increasing.

zh: 他喜欢去城市的角落旅行。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuān qù chéngshì de jiǎoluò lǚxíng.
en: He likes to travel to remote corners of the city.

zh: 他是这个家族的唯一后代。
pinyin: Tā shì zhège jiāzú de wéiyī hòudài.
en: He is the only descendant of this family.

zh: 这本字典在学习时很管用。
pinyin: Zhè běn zìdiǎn zài xuéxí shí hěn guǎnyòng.
en: This dictionary is very useful when studying.

zh: 他拿出了所有的积蓄买车。
pinyin: Tā ná chū le suǒyǒu de jīxù mǎi chē.
en: He took out all his savings to buy a car.

zh: 这家工厂聘用当地的工人。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng pìnyòng dāngdì de gōngrén.
en: This factory employs local workers.

zh: 这次活动是他生活的契机。
pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng shì tā shēnghuó de qìjī.
en: This event was a turning point in his life.

zh: 长期坐着会导致身体麻痹。
pinyin: Chángqī zuòzhe huì dǎozhì shēntǐ mábì.
en: Sitting for a long time can lead to bodily paralysis.

zh: 从这儿到学校顶多十分钟。
pinyin: Cóng zhèr dào xuéxiào dǐngduō shí fēnzhōng.
en: It takes ten minutes at most to get to school from here.

zh: 那是一件模拟真皮的衣服。
pinyin: Nà shì yī jiàn mónǐ zhēnpí de yīfú.
en: That is a piece of clothing made of imitation leather.

zh: 餐厅一天有两百人次用餐。
pinyin: Cāntīng yītiān yǒu liǎngbǎi réncì yòngcān.
en: The restaurant has 200 visits for meals a day.

zh: 请把衣服挂在那个钩子上。
pinyin: qǐng bǎ yī fu guà zài nà gè gōu zi shàng.
en: Please hang the clothes on that hook.

zh: 他每天都在工作一线努力。
pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu zài gōngzuò yīxiàn nǔlì.
en: He works hard on the front line every day.

zh: 这个建议很得当，我同意。
pinyin: Zhège jiànyì hěn dédàng, wǒ tóngyì.
en: This suggestion is very suitable; I agree.

zh: 他在地图上插了一面小旗。
pinyin: Tā zài dìtú shàng chā le yī miàn xiǎo qí.
en: He stuck a small flag on the map.

zh: 他正在检查公司的数据库。
pinyin: Tā zhèngzài jiǎnchá gōngsī de shùjùkù.
en: He is checking the company's database.

zh: 这个说法引起了很大争端。
pinyin: Zhège shuōfǎ yǐnqǐle hěn dà zhēngduān.
en: This statement caused a lot of controversy.

zh: 大家都说他是修车的内行。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu shuō tā shì xiū chē de nèiháng.
en: Everyone says he is adept at repairing cars.

zh: 一瞬间，我感到非常快乐。
pinyin: Yī shùnjiān, wǒ gǎndào fēicháng kuàilè.
en: In a split second, I felt very happy.

zh: 他经常在高速公路上超速。
pinyin: tā jīng cháng zài gāo sù gōng lù shàng chāo sù.
en: He often speeds on the highway.

zh: 我每天走这条小路去学校。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǒu zhè tiáo xiǎo lù qù xuéxiào.
en: I walk along this small road to school every day.

zh: 他在这个部门只是个小卒。
pinyin: tā zài zhè gè bù mén zhǐ shì gè xiǎo zú.
en: He is just a minor figure in this department.

zh: 医生去医院视察卫生情况。
pinyin: yīshēng qù yīyuàn shìchá wèishēng qíngkuàng.
en: The doctor went to the hospital to conduct an investigation of sanitary conditions.

zh: 看到火灾，他感到很慌乱。
pinyin: Kàn dào huǒzāi, tā gǎndào hěn huāngluàn.
en: Seeing the fire, he felt very frenetic.

zh: 学校举办了盛大的运动会。
pinyin: Xuéxiào jǔbànle shèngdà de yùndònghuì.
en: The school held a grand sports meeting.

zh: 他有胜任这份工作的能力。
pinyin: Tā yǒu shèng rèn zhè fèn gōng zuò de néng lì.
en: He has the ability to be qualified for this job.

zh: 听说明天那两口子要搬家。
pinyin: Tīngshuō míngtiān nà liǎngkǒuzi yào bānjiā.
en: I heard that couple is moving tomorrow.

zh: 这是对大家的好意的滥用。
pinyin: Zhè shì duì dàjiā de hǎoyì de lànyòng.
en: This is an abuse of everyone's kindness.

zh: 他成为队长是当之无愧的。
pinyin: Tā chéngwéi duìzhǎng shì dāngzhīwúkuì de.
en: He is fully deserving of becoming the captain.

zh: 出门的时候要记得带口罩。
pinyin: Chūmén de shíhòu yào jìde dài kǒuzhào.
en: Remember to bring a mask when you go out.

zh: 你可以试用一下这些软件。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ shìyòng yīxià zhèxiē ruǎnjiàn.
en: You can try out these software programs.

zh: 学习需要志气，不能放弃。
pinyin: Xuéxí xūyào zhìqì, bùnéng fàngqì.
en: Learning requires resolve; you cannot give up.

zh: 我们一起去悼念那位英雄。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīqǐ qù dàoniàn nà wèi yīngxióng.
en: We went together to grieve for that hero.

zh: 这个消息是大家的定心丸。
pinyin: zhè gè xiāo xī shì dà jiā de dìng xīn wán.
en: This news set everyone's mind at ease.

zh: 他正在把木板钉在桌子上。
pinyin: tā zhèng zài bǎ mù bǎn dìng zài zhuō zi shàng
en: He is fixing the wooden board onto the table.

zh: 大家都在恭维这个新计划。
pinyin: dàjiā dōu zài gōngwéi zhège xīn jìhuà.
en: Everyone is speaking highly of this new plan.

zh: 朋友劝说他买那辆自行车。
pinyin: péngyǒu quànshuō tā mǎi nà liàng zìxíngchē.
en: A friend persuades him to buy that bicycle.

zh: 到了关键时刻，他出手了。
pinyin: Dào le guānjiàn shíkè, tā chūshǒu le.
en: At the critical moment, he took action.

zh: 他独自坐在凄凉的月光下。
pinyin: Tā dúzì zuò zài qīliáng de yuèguāng xià.
en: He sat alone under the mournful moonlight.

zh: 老师俯首检查学生的作业。
pinyin: lǎo shī fǔ shǒu jiǎn chá xué shēng de zuò yè.
en: The teacher bends their head to check the students' homework.

zh: 他假装很难过，是在演戏。
pinyin: Tā jiǎzhuāng hěn nánguò, shì zài yǎnxì.
en: He pretends to be sad; he is faking it.

zh: 她身上有一种淡淡的芬芳。
pinyin: Tā shēnshang yǒu yī zhǒng dàndàn de fēnfāng.
en: There is a faint perfume on her.

zh: 同事们都很眼红他的奖金。
pinyin: tóngshìmen dōu hěn yǎnhóng tā de jiǎngjīn.
en: The colleagues are all envious of his bonus.

zh: 他生气地把杯子砍了过来。
pinyin: Tā shēngqì de bǎ bēizi kǎnle guòlái.
en: He threw the cup at me angrily.

zh: 他提议我们在会议上讨论。
pinyin: Tā tíyì wǒmen zài huìyì shàng tǎolùn.
en: He proposed that we discuss it at the meeting.

zh: 桌上的蛋糕看起来很诱人。
pinyin: Zhuō shàng de dàngāo kàn qǐlái hěn yòurén.
en: The cake on the table looks very attractive.

zh: 工人们正在加紧完成任务。
pinyin: Gōngrénmen zhèngzài jiājǐn wánchéng rènwù.
en: The workers are stepping up to finish the task.

zh: 这块石头上雕着美丽的花。
pinyin: Zhè kuài shítou shàng diāozhe měilì de huā.
en: Beautiful flowers are carved on this stone.

zh: 那个柜子分成了三个间隔。
pinyin: Nà gè guì zi fēn chéng le sān gè jiàn gé.
en: That cabinet is divided into three compartments.

zh: 敢情你是为了这个才来的。
pinyin: gǎn qing nǐ shì wèi le zhè ge cái lái de.
en: As it turns out, you came here for this reason.

zh: 我们要对陌生人保持友善。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào duì mòshēngrén bǎochí yǒushàn.
en: We should be friendly toward strangers.

zh: 你怎么可以这样无情无义？
pinyin: Nǐ zěnme kěyǐ zhèyàng wú qíng wú yì?
en: How can you be so cold and heartless?

zh: 你可以给这个盒子加重吗？
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ gěi zhège hézi jiāzhòng ma?
en: Can you make this box heavier?

zh: 他总是不服气别人的批评。
pinyin: Tā zǒng shì bù fú qì biérén de pīpíng.
en: He is always indignant when receiving criticism from others.

zh: 他焦急地寻找丢失的钱包。
pinyin: Tā jiāojí de xúnzhǎo diūshī de qiánbāo.
en: He is anxiously looking for his lost wallet.

zh: 我们耗了三个月完成任务。
pinyin: Wǒmen hào le sāngè yuè wánchéng rènwù.
en: We spent three months completing the task.

zh: 我很傲，因为我有好成绩。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn ào, yīnwèi wǒ yǒu hǎo chéngjì.
en: I am very proud because I have good grades.

zh: 他累得趴在桌子上睡着了。
pinyin: Tā lèi de pā zài zhuōzi shàng shuìzháo le.
en: He was so tired that he lay on the table and fell asleep.

zh: 长期戒烟对他来说很困难。
pinyin: chángqī jièyān duì tā lái shuō hěn kùnnán.
en: Quitting smoking in the long term is very difficult for him.

zh: 他在面包上敷了一层果酱。
pinyin: Tā zài miànbāo shàng fū le yī céng guǒjiàng.
en: He spread a layer of jam on the bread.

zh: 他总是骗人，没人相信他。
pinyin: Tā zǒngshì piàn rén, méi rén xiāngxìn tā.
en: He always cheats people; no one believes him.

zh: 妹妹恳求爸爸带她去公园。
pinyin: Mèimei kěnqiú bàba dài tā qù gōngyuán.
en: My younger sister entreats Dad to take her to the park.

zh: 这家的饺子味道非常鲜美。
pinyin: Zhè jiā de jiǎozi wèidào fēicháng xiānměi.
en: The taste of the pot-stickers at this restaurant is very fresh and delicious.

zh: 大家否决了去那里的提议。
pinyin: Dàjiā fǒujué le qù nàlǐ de tíyì.
en: Everyone vetoed the proposal to go there.

zh: 这块银幕看起来非常清楚。
pinyin: Zhè kuài yínmù kàn qǐlái fēicháng qīngchu.
en: This movie screen looks very clear.

zh: 我们需要从底层开始做起。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào cóng dǐ céng kāishǐ zuò qǐ.
en: We need to start from the lowest level.

zh: 爷爷的心脏病突然发作了。
pinyin: yé ye de xīn zàng bìng tū rán fā zuò le.
en: Grandpa's heart disease suddenly flared up.

zh: 他送我花作为纪念日礼物。
pinyin: Tā sòng wǒ huā zuòwéi jìniànrì lǐwù.
en: He gave me flowers as an anniversary gift.

zh: 我们要去尚经理的办公室。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào qù Shàng jīnglǐ de bàngōngshì.
en: We are going to Manager Shang's office.

zh: 他常在同学面前标榜自己。
pinyin: tā cháng zài tóng xué miàn qián biāo bǎng zì jǐ.
en: He often parades himself in front of classmates.

zh: 为了工作，他积累了资历。
pinyin: wèi le gōng zuò, tā jī lěi le zī lì.
en: For work, he accumulated experience.

zh: 他们对失去工作感到悲哀。
pinyin: Tāmen duì shīqù gōngzuò gǎndào bēi'āi.
en: They felt grieved about losing their jobs.

zh: 老板因为工作的事很犯愁。
pinyin: Lǎobǎn yīnwèi gōngzuò de shì hěn fànchóu.
en: The boss is worried about work matters.

zh: 我们要小心他的奸诈计划。
pinyin: Wǒ men yào xiǎo xīn tā de jiān zhà jì huà.
en: We must be careful of his devious plan.

zh: 他制止了朋友的错误行为。
pinyin: Tā zhìzhǐ le péngyǒu de cuòwù xíngwéi.
en: He put a stop to his friend's wrong behavior.

zh: 我们必须尊重这里的规矩。
pinyin: wǒ men bì xū zūn zhòng zhè lǐ de guī jǔ.
en: We must honor the rules here.

zh: 他用力想松绑手上的绳子。
pinyin: Tā yònglì xiǎng sōngbǎng shǒushàng de shéngzi.
en: He tried hard to untie the rope on his hands.

zh: 黎明的时候，外面很安静。
pinyin: límíng de shíhou, wàimiàn hěn ānjìng.
en: At dawn, it is very quiet outside.

zh: 我永远也忘不了这次旅行。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒngyuǎn yě wàng bu liǎo zhè cì lǚxíng.
en: I will never be able to forget this trip.

zh: 他在比赛的关头做得很好。
pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài de guāntóu zuò de hěn hǎo.
en: He did well at the juncture of the competition.

zh: 看见这碗面，我就有瘾了。
pinyin: Kànjiàn zhè wǎn miàn, wǒ jiù yǒu yǐn le.
en: Seeing this bowl of noodles, I have a craving.

zh: 我们的中文水平逐年提高。
pinyin: wǒ men de zhōng wén shuǐ píng zhú nián tí gāo.
en: Our Chinese proficiency has improved over the years.

zh: 饭店开张以后，生意很好。
pinyin: Fàndiàn kāizhāng yǐhòu, shēngyì hěn hǎo.
en: After the restaurant opened, business was very good.

zh: 你不能总是这样无所事事。
pinyin: Nǐ bùnéng zǒng shì zhèyàng wúsuǒshìshì.
en: You cannot always idle your time away like this.

zh: 真的久违了，最近怎么样？
pinyin: Zhēnde jiǔwéi le, zuìjìn zěnmeyàng?
en: It really has been a long time since we met, how have you been?

zh: 听到声音，他立刻扭头看。
pinyin: Tīng dào shēngyīn, tā lìkè niǔtóu kàn.
en: Hearing a noise, he immediately turned his head to look.

zh: 他因为钱谋害了那位老人。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi qián móuhài le nà wèi lǎorén.
en: He plotted against the old man's life because of money.

zh: 小贩经常在学校门口卖书。
pinyin: Xiǎofàn jīngcháng zài xuéxiào ménkǒu mài shū.
en: The peddler often sells books at the school gate.

zh: 我看见了一艘巨大的潜艇。
pinyin: Wǒ kànjiànle yī sōu jùdà de qiántǐng.
en: I saw a huge submarine.

zh: 这个玩具的触觉非常特别。
pinyin: Zhège wánjù de chùjué fēicháng tèbié.
en: This toy has a very unique texture/feel.

zh: 小猫介于椅子和桌子中间。
pinyin: Xiǎo māo jiè yú yǐzi hé zhuōzi zhōngjiān.
en: The kitten is between the chair and the table.

zh: 大家都获悉了学校的安排。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu huòxī le xuéxiào de ānpái.

pinyin: dà jiā dōu zài tǎo lùn, bié láo dao le.
en: Everyone is discussing, stop chattering away.

zh: 观众们哄地一下笑出了声。
pinyin: Guānzhòngmen hōng de yíxià xiào chū le shēng.
en: The audience roared with laughter.

zh: 我们必须测验这个新机器。
pinyin: wǒ men bì xū cè yàn zhè gè xīn jī qì.
en: We must test this new machine.

zh: 他最终顺从了家人的压力。
pinyin: tā zuì zhōng shùn cóng le jiā rén de yā lì.
en: He eventually submitted to the pressure from his family.

zh: 照片里的孩子神态很开心。
pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ de háizi shéntài hěn kāixīn.
en: The child in the photo has a happy expression.

zh: 老师谈到关于考试的事情。
pinyin: Lǎoshī tán dào guānyú kǎoshì de shìqing.
en: The teacher spoke about things regarding the exam.

zh: 大家宣告明天去公园玩儿。
pinyin: dàjiā xuāngào míngtiān qù gōngyuán wán er.
en: Everyone declared that they will go to the park tomorrow.

zh: 别被他的话引诱去做错事。
pinyin: Bié bèi tā de huà yǐnyòu qù zuò cuò shì.
en: Do not be coerced by his words into doing wrong.

zh: 他在河里发现了一些金子。
pinyin: tā zài hé lǐ fā xiàn le yī xiē jīn zi
en: He found some gold in the river.

zh: 大家都喜欢热腾腾的市场。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xǐhuān rèténgténg de shìchǎng.
en: Everyone likes the bustling market.

zh: 这家店有很多珍贵的药材。
pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn yǒu hěnduō zhēnguì de yàocái.
en: This shop has many precious medicinal ingredients.

zh: 这件事情的突破口在这里。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì qíng de tū pò kǒu zài zhè lǐ.
en: The breakthrough point for this matter is here.

zh: 那是错误的，不要误导他。
pinyin: nà shì cuò wù de ， bú yào wù dǎo tā 。
en: That is wrong, do not misguide him.

zh: 奶奶特别宠爱她的小孙子。
pinyin: nǎinai tèbié chǒng'ài tā de xiǎo sūnzi.
en: Grandma dotes on her little grandson.

zh: 这种花和那种花属于同类。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huā hé nà zhǒng huā shǔyú tóng lèi.
en: This flower and that flower belong to the same category.

zh: 那位老人的微笑非常慈祥。
pinyin: nà wèi lǎo rén de wēi xiào fēi cháng cí xiáng.
en: That old man's smile is very benevolent.

zh: 这首歌是画龙点睛的部分。
pinyin: zhè shǒu gē shì huà lóng diǎn jīng de bùfèn.
en: This song is the part that brings everything to life.

zh: 他送给我一个特制的礼物。
pinyin: Tā sòng gěi wǒ yīgè tèzhì de lǐwù.
en: He gave me a specially made gift.

zh: 这次活动呈现出新的活力。
pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng chéngxiàn chū xīn de huólì.
en: This activity emerged with new vitality.

zh: 现在后悔已经无济于事了。
pinyin: xiànzài hòuhuǐ yǐjīng wú jì yú shì le.
en: Regretting it now is to no avail.

zh: 不要让时间拘束你的工作。
pinyin: Bùyào ràng shíjiān jūshù nǐ de gōngzuò.
en: Do not let time restrict your work.

zh: 他这样做是存心让我生气。
pinyin: tā zhèyàng zuò shì cúnxīn ràng wǒ shēngqì.
en: He did this deliberately to make me angry.

zh: 妈妈在摇篮旁边照顾宝宝。
pinyin: Māma zài yáolán pángbiān zhàogù bǎobao.
en: Mom is taking care of the baby by the cradle.

zh: 经理掌管所有的重要工作。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhǎngguǎn suǒyǒu de zhòngyào gōngzuò.
en: The manager controls all the important work.

zh: 他们在各自的领域很有成就。
pinyin: tā men zài gè zì de lǐng yù hěn yǒu chéng jiù.
en: They have great achievements in their respective fields.

zh: 我们要小心这种病的感染力。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào xiǎoxīn zhè zhǒng bìng de gǎnrǎnlì.
en: We must be careful about the infectiousness of this disease.

zh: 听到你的话，心里暖烘烘的。
pinyin: tīng dào nǐ de huà, xīn lǐ nuǎn hōng hōng de.
en: Hearing your words, my heart feels warmed.

zh: 这件事他翻来覆去想了很久。
pinyin: zhè jiàn shì tā fān lái fù qù xiǎng le hěn jiǔ.
en: He thought about this matter over and over for a long time.

zh: 他的点子改变了我们的计划。
pinyin: tā de diǎn zi gǎi biàn le wǒ men de jì huà.
en: His point changed our plan.

zh: 他原本以为这次考试很简单。
pinyin: Tā yuánběn yǐwéi zhè cì kǎoshì hěn jiǎndān.
en: He originally thought this exam would be very simple.

zh: 我们需要认真筹划这次旅行。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào rènzhēn chóuhuà zhè cì lǚxíng.
en: We need to plan this trip carefully.

zh: 我们已经到了很困难的境地。
pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng dào le hěn kùnnán de jìngdì.
en: We have already reached a very difficult situation.

zh: 老师帮助学生构建知识体系。
pinyin: Lǎoshī bāngzhù xuéshēng gòujiàn zhīshi tǐxì.
en: The teacher helps students construct a knowledge system.

zh: 老师正在帮助学生分辨争执。
pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài bāngzhù xuéshēng fēnbiàn zhēngzhí.
en: The teacher is helping the students resolve the dispute.

zh: 桌子上放着一颗晶莹的珍珠。
pinyin: zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe yī kē jīngyíng de zhēnzhū.
en: A sparkling pearl is placed on the table.

zh: 小明对学习的兴趣日趋浓厚。
pinyin: xiǎomíng duì xuéxí de xìngqù rìqū nónghòu.
en: Xiao Ming's interest in studying is gradually becoming stronger.

zh: 归根到底，他是一个好学生。
pinyin: guī gēn dào dǐ, tā shì yī gè hǎo xuésheng.
en: In the final analysis, he is a good student.

zh: 事故造成了一些身体后遗症。
pinyin: shìgù zàochéngle yīxiē shēntǐ hòuyízhèng.
en: The accident caused some physical residual effects.

zh: 我们想方设法解决这个问题。
pinyin: wǒmen xiǎngfāngshèfǎ jiějué zhège wèntí.
en: We think of every possible method to solve this problem.

zh: 这个城市的出租车比比皆是。
pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de chūzūchē bǐbǐjiēshì.
en: Taxis can be found everywhere in this city.

zh: 我们要种植十公顷的苹果树。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhòngzhí shí gōngqǐng de píngguǒ shù.
en: We want to plant ten hectares of apple trees.

zh: 他正在修理自行车的前车轮。
pinyin: Tā zhèngzài xiūlǐ zìxíngchē de qián chē lún.
en: He is repairing the front wheel of the bicycle.

zh: 他回答问题的声音非常响亮。
pinyin: Tā huídá wèntí de shēngyīn fēicháng xiǎngliàng.
en: The voice he used to answer the question was very loud and clear.

zh: 他对老师的决定表示了异议。
pinyin: Tā duì lǎoshī de juédìng biǎoshì le yìyì.
en: He expressed an objection to the teacher's decision.

zh: 长期的病痛折磨着他的身体。
pinyin: cháng qī de bìng tòng zhé mó zhe tā de shēn tǐ.
en: Long-term illness is tormenting his body.

zh: 他在表演中加入庸俗的动作。
pinyin: tā zài biǎo yǎn zhōng jiā rù yōng sú de dòng zuò.
en: He added tawdry movements to the performance.

zh: 我们要给子孙留下好的环境。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào gěi zǐsūn liú xià hǎo de huánjìng.
en: We must leave a good environment for posterity.

zh: 老师的话影响了他的自尊心。
pinyin: Lǎoshī de huà yǐngxiǎng le tā de zìzūnxīn.
en: The teacher's words affected his self-esteem.

zh: 做错了事，你应该感到羞愧。
pinyin: zuò cuò le shì, nǐ yīng gāi gǎn dào xiū kuì.
en: You should feel ashamed for doing something wrong.

zh: 冬天天气严峻，要注意身体。
pinyin: dōng tiān tiān qì yán jùn, yào zhù yì shēn tǐ.
en: The winter weather is severe, so take care of your health.

zh: 发生这种好歹，谁也不想的。
pinyin: fāshēng zhè zhǒng hǎodǎi, shuí yě bù xiǎng de.
en: Nobody wanted such a most unfortunate occurrence to happen.

zh: 这只是一个无关紧要的细节。
pinyin: Zhè zhǐshì yī gè wúguānjǐnyào de xìjié.
en: This is just an insignificant detail.

zh: 公司晚上要招待重要的客人。
pinyin: Gōngsī wǎnshàng yào zhāodài zhòngyào de kèrén.
en: The company is going to host important guests tonight.

zh: 看到你这么努力，我很欣慰。
pinyin: Kàndào nǐ zhème nǔlì, wǒ hěn xīnwèi.
en: Seeing you work so hard, I am very gratified.

zh: 他努力学习，终于脱颖而出。
pinyin: Tā nǔlì xuéxí, zhōngyú tuōyǐng'érchū.
en: He studied hard and finally revealed his talent.

zh: 太多的糖果会导致孩子肥胖。
pinyin: tài duō de táng guǒ huì dǎo zhì hái zi féi pàng.
en: Too much candy can lead to childhood obesity.

zh: 每天跑步，我们要持之以恒。
pinyin: Měitiān pǎobù, wǒmen yào chízhīyǐhéng.
en: We must persevere in running every day.

zh: 工作太忙，我勉强写完作业。
pinyin: gōngzuò tài máng, wǒ miǎnqiǎng xiě wán zuòyè.
en: I was so busy with work that I barely finished my homework.

zh: 她成为了这个品牌的代言人。
pinyin: Tā chéngwéi le zhège pǐnpái de dàiyánrén.
en: She became the spokesperson for this brand.

zh: 他是我们公司最忠实的员工。
pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen gōngsī zuì zhōngshí de yuángōng.
en: He is the most faithful employee in our company.

zh: 孩子长大了，进入了青春期。
pinyin: hái zi zhǎng dà le, jìn rù le qīng chūn qī.
en: The child has grown up and entered puberty.

zh: 我们要把这个名字简称小王。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎ zhège míngzi jiǎnchēng Xiǎo Wáng.
en: We want to abbreviate this name to Xiao Wang.

zh: 他没有遗忘那个难忘的夏天。
pinyin: Tā méiyǒu yíwàng nàge nánwàng de xiàtiān.
en: He did not forget that unforgettable summer.

zh: 即使是朋友也不能触犯法律。
pinyin: jí shǐ shì péng yǒu yě bù néng chù fàn fǎ lǜ.
en: Even friends cannot violate the law.

zh: 她认真地审视镜子里的自己。
pinyin: Tā rènzhēn de shěnshì jìngzi lǐ de zìjǐ.
en: She looks closely at herself in the mirror.

zh: 这两件衣服的质量不相上下。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu de zhìliàng bù xiāng shàng xià.
en: The quality of these two pieces of clothing is about the same.

zh: 这是纯粹的牛奶，没有加糖。
pinyin: Zhè shì chúncuì de niúnǎi, méiyǒu jiā táng.
en: This is pure (unadulterated) milk, with no added sugar.

zh: 她对自己的工作一直很忠贞。
pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ de gōngzuò yīzhí hěn zhōngzhēn.
en: She has always been loyal to her work.

zh: 他犹豫不决，不知道买什么。
pinyin: tā yóu yù bù jué, bù zhī dào mǎi shén me.
en: He is hesitant, not knowing what to buy.

zh: 说老实话，我不希望你离开。
pinyin: Shuō lǎo shí huà, wǒ bù xī wàng nǐ lí kāi.
en: To be frank, I don't want you to leave.

zh: 为了生活，她很早嫁了妹妹。
pinyin: Wèile shēnghuó, tā hěn zǎo jiàle mèimei.
en: For the sake of living, she married off her younger sister early.

zh: 天气无形中影响了我的心情。
pinyin: Tiānqì wúxíngzhōng yǐngxiǎngle wǒ de xīnqíng.
en: The weather imperceptibly affected my mood.

zh: 你需要填补这些重要的资料。
pinyin: nǐ xū yào tián bǔ zhè xiē zhòng yào de zī liào de zī liào.
en: You need to fill in these important details.

zh: 学校正在为图书馆筹集资金。
pinyin: Xuéxiào zhèngzài wèi túshūguǎn chóují zījīn.
en: The school is raising funds for the library.

zh: 孩子们在安静的环境里酣睡。
pinyin: háizimen zài ānjìng de huánjìng lǐ hānshuì.
en: The children are sleeping soundly in a quiet environment.

zh: 他是我们公司的董事会主席。
pinyin: tā shì wǒ men gōng sī de dǒng shì huì zhǔ xí.
en: He is the chairman of our company's board.

zh: 他在公司得到了晋升的机会。
pinyin: Tā zài gōng sī dé dào le jìn shēng de jī huì.
en: He got a promotion opportunity at the company.

zh: 我们打算去开发区参观一下。
pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn qù kāifāqū cānguān yīxià.
en: We plan to visit the development zone.

zh: 每个人喜欢吃的饭因人而异。
pinyin: Měi gè rén xǐhuān chī de fàn yīnrénéryì.
en: The food that everyone likes to eat varies from person to person.

zh: 收到信后，他当即回了电话。
pinyin: Shōudào xìn hòu, tā dāngjí huí le diànhuà.
en: After receiving the letter, he returned the call at once.

zh: 他不应该为了钱去迎合别人。
pinyin: tā bù yīng gāi wèi le qián qù yíng hé bié rén.
en: He should not pander to others for the sake of money.

zh: 很抱歉，你的要求我办不到。
pinyin: Hěn bàoqiàn, nǐ de yāoqiú wǒ bàn bu dào.
en: I'm sorry, I cannot fulfill your request.

zh: 为了学汉语，我报名了夜校。
pinyin: Wèile xué Hànyǔ, wǒ bàomíngle yè xiào.
en: In order to learn Chinese, I signed up for night school.

zh: 为了考试，他总是精益求精。
pinyin: Wèile kǎoshì, tā zǒngshì jīngyìqiújīng.
en: For the exam, he always strives for excellence.

zh: 朋友们汇聚在一起庆祝节日。
pinyin: péng yǒu men huì jù zài yī qǐ qìng zhù jié rì.
en: Friends come together to celebrate the holiday.

zh: 这件衣服的样子真讨人喜欢。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yàngzi zhēn tǎorénxǐhuan.
en: The style of this piece of clothing is delightful.

zh: 他是团队里必不可少的一员。
pinyin: Tā shì tuánduì lǐ bìbùkěshǎo de yī yuán.
en: He is an indispensable member of the team.

zh: 他是一位非常有才华的作家。
pinyin: Tā shì yī wèi fēicháng yǒu cáihuá de zuòjiā.
en: He is a very talented writer.

zh: 父母每个月给他一些零花钱。
pinyin: Fùmǔ měi gè yuè gěi tā yīxiē línghuāqián.
en: Parents give him some allowance every month.

zh: 他看这个苹果的观感是红的。
pinyin: tā kàn zhège píngguǒ de guāngǎn shì hóng de.
en: His observation of this apple is that it is red.

zh: 你别看他个儿小，力气很大。
pinyin: Nǐ bié kàn tā gè'r xiǎo, lìqi hěn dà.
en: Don't judge him by his small stature; he is very strong.

zh: 找了半天，钥匙偏偏不见了。
pinyin: Zhǎole bàntiān, yàoshi piānpiān bùjiànle.
en: Looked for a long time, but unfortunately the keys are missing.

zh: 如果你遇上困难，请告诉我。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yù shàng kùnnán, qǐng gàosù wǒ.
en: If you come across difficulties, please tell me.

zh: 那只猫连滚带爬地进了房间。
pinyin: Nà zhī māo lián gǔn dài pá de jìn le fángjiān.
en: That cat stumbled and crawled into the room.

zh: 公司职员正在办公室里开会。
pinyin: Gōngsī zhíyuán zhèngzài bàngōngshì lǐ kāihuì.
en: The company employees are holding a meeting in the office.

zh: 你应该多看看事情的负面吗？
pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi duō kàn kàn shì qing de fù miàn ma?
en: Should you look more at the negative side of things?

zh: 如果你跑得不快，就会掉队。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ pǎo de bù kuài, jiù huì diào duì.
en: If you don't run fast, you will fall behind.

zh: 老师帮助我们优化学习计划。
pinyin: Lǎoshī bāngzhù wǒmen yōuhuà xuéxí jìhuà.
en: The teacher helps us optimize our study plan.

zh: 我只是做了一个大概的估算。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ shì zuò le yī gè dà gài de gū suàn.
en: I just made a rough estimate.

zh: 腊月的时候，大家准备过年。
pinyin: Là yuè de shí hou, dà jiā zhǔn bèi guò nián.
en: During the twelfth lunar month, everyone prepares for the New Year.

zh: 请及时告知你朋友这个消息。
pinyin: Qǐng jíshí gàozhī nǐ péngyǒu zhège xiāoxi.
en: Please inform your friend of this news in a timely manner.

zh: 老师说，你的字迹需要练习。
pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, nǐ de zìjì xūyào liànxí.
en: The teacher said, your handwriting needs practice.

zh: 这是今年最畅销的商品之一。
pinyin: zhè shì jīnnián zuì chàngxiāo de shāngpǐn zhī yī.
en: This is one of the bestselling products this year.

zh: 他是一个值得大家敬佩的人。
pinyin: Tā shì yīgè zhídé dàjiā jìngpèi de rén.
en: He is a person worth everyone's esteem.

zh: 他在这条街上转悠了好几次。
pinyin: tā zài zhè tiáo jiē shàng zhuàn you le hǎo jǐ cì.
en: He has appeared repeatedly on this street several times.

zh: 他们正在餐厅里品尝葡萄酒。
pinyin: tā men zhèng zài cān tīng lǐ pǐn cháng pú táo jiǔ
en: They are tasting wine in the restaurant.

zh: 这是高速公路最危险的路段。
pinyin: Zhè shì gāosù gōnglù zuì wēixiǎn de lùduàn.
en: This is the most dangerous section of the highway.

zh: 我想传授你一些画画的方法。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chuánshòu nǐ yīxiē huàhuà de fāngfǎ.
en: I want to impart some painting methods to you.

zh: 他开创了一个新的研究领域。
pinyin: tā kāi chuàng le yī gè xīn de yán jiū lǐng yù.
en: He initiated a new field of research.

zh: 只要你情愿，我们就去旅游。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ qíngyuàn, wǒmen jiù qù lǚyóu.
en: As long as you are willing, we will go traveling.

zh: 我们应该帮助那些贫穷的人。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi bāngzhù nàxiē pínqióng de rén.
en: We should help those who are poor.

zh: 他上班睡觉，被公司开除了。
pinyin: Tā shàngbān shuìjiào, bèi gōngsī kāichú le.
en: He slept at work and was fired by the company.

zh: 为了开会，他把时间提早了。
pinyin: wèile kāihuì, tā bǎ shíjiān tízǎo le.
en: For the meeting, he brought the time forward.

zh: 我们准备了一顿团聚的晚餐。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhǔnbèi le yī dùn tuánjù de wǎncān.
en: We prepared a reunion dinner.

zh: 桌子上的书摆放得杂乱无章。

pinyin: zǒng ér yán zhī, zhège wèntí bù tài nán.

pinyin: Zhè cì hézuò xiǎnshìle wǒmen de mòqì.

pinyin: Wèile xiāochú píláo, tā qù shuìjiào le.

pinyin: Lǎoshī jiào wǒmen liànxí bùtóng de zìtǐ.

pinyin: Tā duì Zhōngguó Rújiā wénhuà hěn gǎn xìngqù.

pinyin: Tā zài zhè cì bǐsài zhōng dàoshǔ dì sān míng.

pinyin: zhè běn shū de nèi róng shì kè yì ān pái de.
en: The content of this book was painstakingly arranged.

pinyin: Tā zhèngzài xiǎng bànfǎ bǔjiù zhège cuòwù.

pinyin: Hěnjiǔ yǐqián, zhèlǐ shì yīgè wángguó.

zh: 我们要和身边的人融洽相处。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào hé shēnbiān de rén róngqià xiāngchǔ.

pinyin: nàge cān jūn gěile jiāngjūn hěnduō jiànyì.

pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ liànxí Hànyǔ yǐzhì xiàkè.

pinyin: lǎo shī shuō tā bù gāi zài kè táng shàng hú nào.

zh: 我要去那家运动专卖店买鞋。
pinyin: Wǒ yào qù nà jiā yùndòng zhuānmàidiàn mǎi xié.

pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jièyòng nǐ de zìxíngchē qù chāoshì.

pinyin: Cóng jīn yǐ hòu, wǒ bù chī zhè zhǒng yào le.

pinyin: Tā wèile kǎoshì, língchén hái zài liànxí.

pinyin: Tā zài měishù fāngmiàn yǒu hěn gāo de sùyǎng.

zh: 她对着镜子认真地梳理头发。
pinyin: Tā duìzhe jìngzi rènzhēn de shūlǐ tóufǎ.

pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīn qíng shì yī zhǒng hěn gāo de jìng jiè.

pinyin: Qǐng jiǎnchá yīxià wénzhāng lǐ de cuòbiézì.

pinyin: zhè cì huódòng jiāshēn le wǒmen de gǎnqíng.

pinyin: wǒmen kànle yī chǎng jīngxīndòngpò de bǐsài.

pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi shí shì qiú shì de gàosù tā jiéguǒ.

zh: 他是公司的一把手，每天很忙。
pinyin: Tā shì gōngsī de yī bǎ shǒu, měitiān hěn máng.

pinyin: Jìnniánlái, zhège chéngshì de biànhuà hěn dà.

zh: 这条裙子是用最好的丝绸做的。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo qúnzi shì yòng zuì hǎo de sīchóu zuò de.

zh: 你可以用这个词替换那个词吗？
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ yòng zhège cí tìhuàn nàge cí ma?

zh: 虽然很忙，她依然看护着家人。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, tā yīrán kānhùzhe jiārén.
en: Although she is busy, she still looks after her family.

zh: 那个木匠正在用工具修理桌子。
pinyin: Nàge mùjiàng zhèngzài yòng gōngjù xiūlǐ zhuōzi.

zh: 医生说他的腿伤很快就会愈合。

zh: 巷子非常狭窄，汽车开不过去。
pinyin: Xiàngzi fēicháng xiázhǎi, qìchē kāi bú guòqù.
en: The alley is very narrow, and cars cannot pass through.

zh: 他看书时常有一些虚幻的想法。
pinyin: tā kàn shū shí cháng yǒu yī xiē xū huàn de xiǎng fǎ.
en: He often has some imaginary ideas when reading.

zh: 因为生病了，他感到愁眉苦脸。
pinyin: yīn wèi shēng bìng le, tā gǎn dào chóu méi kǔ liǎn.
en: Because he is sick, he looks miserable.

zh: 她小心翼翼地把信放在桌子上。
pinyin: Tā xiǎo xīn yì yì de bǎ xìn fàng zài zhuō zi shàng.
en: She carefully placed the letter on the table.

zh: 在这个决定中，细节至关重要。
pinyin: Zài zhège juédìng zhōng, xìjié zhìguānzhòngyào.
en: In this decision, details are crucial.

zh: 他一直很在意这次考试的成绩。
pinyin: Tā yīzhí hěn zàiyì zhè cì kǎoshì de chéngjì.
en: He has always cared a lot about the results of this exam.

zh: 元宵节的时候，大家喜欢猜谜。
pinyin: Yuánxiāojié de shíhou, dàjiā xǐhuān cāimí.
en: During the Lantern Festival, everyone likes to guess riddles.

zh: 妹妹垂头丧气，因为没有苹果。
pinyin: Mèimei chuí tóu sàng qì, yīnwèi méiyǒu píngguǒ.
en: My younger sister is crestfallen because there are no apples.

zh: 他轻而易举地拿到了那个苹果。
pinyin: Tā qīng'éryìjǔ de nádào le nàge píngguǒ.
en: He got that apple with no difficulty.

zh: 时尚杂志里有很多漂亮的衣服。
pinyin: Shíshàng zázhì lǐ yǒu hěnduō piàoliang de yīfú.
en: There are many beautiful clothes in fashion magazines.

zh: 我真是一个笨蛋，忘了带钥匙。
pinyin: Wǒ zhēn shì yī gè bèndàn, wàngle dài yàoshi.
en: I'm such a silly person, I forgot to bring the keys.

zh: 老师说，这个盐水已经饱和了。
pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, zhège yánshuǐ yǐjīng bǎohé le.
en: The teacher said this salt water is already saturated.

zh: 他的成功空前，大家都很高兴。
pinyin: tā de chénggōng kōngqián, dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.
en: His success is unprecedented, and everyone is very happy.

zh: 你应该早点来，这样太不像话。
pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi zǎodiǎn lái, zhèyàng tài bùxiànghuà.
en: You should have come earlier; this is unreasonable.

zh: 他在这座大厦工作已经五年了。
pinyin: Tā zài zhè zuò dàshà gōngzuò yǐjīng wǔ nián le.

zh: 舞台上有一个引人注目的表演。
pinyin: Wǔtái shàng yǒu yīgè yǐn rén zhù mù de biǎoyǎn.

zh: 医生接到电话后立即赶往医院。
pinyin: Yīshēng jiē dào diànhuà hòu lìjí gǎn wǎng yīyuàn.
en: After receiving the call, the doctor immediately hurried to the hospital.

zh: 天气很冷，以至于河水结冰了。
pinyin: Tiānqì hěn lěng, yǐ zhìyú héshuǐ jiébīng le.
en: The weather is very cold, to the extent that the river has frozen.

zh: 公园里的花都绽放了，很漂亮。
pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ de huā dōu zhànfàng le, hěn piàoliang.
en: The flowers in the park are all blooming, they are very beautiful.

zh: 我想了解一下这个地名的由来。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng liǎojiě yīxià zhège dìmíng de yóulái.

zh: 我们应该谦虚，不应该太高傲。
pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi qiān xū, bù yīng gāi tài gāo ào.
en: We should be humble and not too proud.

zh: 他瞬间明白了这个问题的答案。
pinyin: Tā shùnjiān míngbáile zhège wèntí de dá'àn.
en: He understood the answer to this question in an instant.

zh: 他在照片里看到了奇怪的光环。

en: He saw a strange ring of light in the photo.

zh: 他发现牛奶的保质期已经到了。
pinyin: Tā fāxiàn niúnǎi de bǎozhìqī yǐjīng dào le.

zh: 坐船的时候，我总是觉得头晕。
pinyin: Zuò chuán de shíhòu, wǒ zǒng shì juéde tóuyūn.

zh: 我发现这些资料里有几个疑点。
pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn zhèxiē zīliào lǐ yǒu jǐ gè yídiǎn.
en: I discovered several doubtful points in these materials.

zh: 天气不错，我们去沙滩散步吧。
pinyin: Tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen qù shātān sànbù ba.
en: The weather is nice, let's go for a walk on the beach.

zh: 我们学校的吉祥物是一只小猫。
pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de jíxiángwù shì yī zhī xiǎomāo.
en: Our school's mascot is a kitten.

zh: 他宁可辛苦一点儿也不想放弃。
pinyin: tā nìng kě xīn kǔ yī diǎn er yě bù xiǎng fàng qì.
en: He would rather work hard than give up.

zh: 站在楼顶居高临下，看得很远。
pinyin: Zhàn zài lóudǐng jū gāo lín xià, kàn de hěn yuǎn.
en: Standing on the roof and looking down, one can see very far.

pinyin: Wèile kǎoshì, tā yīzhí zài wēnxí kèwén.

pinyin: Yéye zài gōngyuán lǐ guòzhe yōuxián de shēnghuó.

zh: 小孩子做错事，免不了被批评。

pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhǔnbèi hǎo yíngjiē kèrén de láifǎng.

zh: 老师希望我们坦率地回答问题。
pinyin: Lǎoshī xīwàng wǒmen tǎnshuài de huídá wèntí.
en: The teacher hopes we answer the questions frankly.

zh: 这篇课文里有一些难懂的字眼。
pinyin: Zhè piān kèwén lǐ yǒu yīxiē nándǒng de zìyǎn.
en: There are some difficult wordings in this text.

zh: 我们要离开这个狭小的办公室。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào líkāi zhège xiáxiǎo de bàngōngshì.
en: We want to leave this narrow office.

zh: 他在图书馆里安静地默读小说。
pinyin: Tā zài túshūguǎn lǐ ānjìng de mòdú xiǎoshuō.
en: He is reading a novel in silence in the library.

zh: 极少数的乘客觉得这趟车很慢。
pinyin: Jíshǎoshù de chéngkè juéde zhè tàng chē hěn màn.
en: A small minority of passengers think this train is slow.

pinyin: wài miàn yǒu rén zài gǎo guǐ, wǒ men kuài zǒu ba.

en: The supermarket is empty, there is not a single person.

pinyin: Kǎoshì méi tōngguò, tā gǎndào fēicháng shīluò.
en: He felt very dejected after failing the exam.

pinyin: Bàozhǐ shàng yǒu yī piān fēicháng zhòngyào de shèlùn.
en: There is a very important editorial in the newspaper.

pinyin: shuō dào dǐ, nǐ háishì yīnggāi nǔlì xuéxí.

en: Although the exam is difficult, he remains calm.

pinyin: Qǐngwèn zhè dòng xiězìlóu de rùkǒu zài nǎlǐ?

pinyin: dàjiā tīng dào hǎo xiāoxi, dōu méi kāi yǎn xiào.

pinyin: fēi jī qǐ fēi qián, qǐng zài jī cāng nèi zuò hǎo.

zh: 他觉得那次比赛失败太丢人了。
pinyin: Tā juéde nà cì bǐsài shībài tài diūrén le.

zh: 因为大家都在笑，他恼羞成怒。

zh: 天气之所以好，是因为有太阳。

zh: 春天到了，小河里的水碧绿的。
pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, xiǎohé lǐ de shuǐ bìlǜ de.
en: Spring has arrived, and the water in the small river is dark green.

zh: 这些药的有效期怎么看不清楚？
pinyin: Zhèxiē yào de yǒuxiàoqī zěnme kàn bù qīngchǔ?
en: Why is the sell-by date on these medicines hard to see?

zh: 生活中有很多不可避免的困难。
pinyin: Shēnghuó zhōng yǒu hěnduō bù kě bì miǎn de kùnnán.
en: There are many inevitable difficulties in life.

zh: 弟弟很贪玩儿，不喜欢写作业。
pinyin: dìdi hěn tān wánr, bù xǐhuan xiě zuòyè.
en: My younger brother is very playful and does not like to do homework.

zh: 他在异想天开地想要改变世界。
pinyin: Tā zài yì xiǎng tiān kāi de xiǎng yào gǎibiàn shìjiè.
en: He is indulging in the fantasy of changing the world.

zh: 看到照片，我禁不住想起了家。
pinyin: Kàndào zhàopiàn, wǒ jīnbuzhù xiǎngqǐ le jiā.
en: Seeing the photo, I couldn't help but think of home.

zh: 这家卫视播放的电影很有意思。
pinyin: zhè jiā wèishì bōfàng de diànyǐng hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: The movies played by this satellite TV station are very interesting.

zh: 他从事房地产工作已经五年了。
pinyin: Tā cóngshì fángdìchǎn gōngzuò yǐjīng wǔ nián le.
en: He has been working in real estate for five years.

zh: 他很有名，但我选择敬而远之。
pinyin: tā hěn yǒumíng, dàn wǒ xuǎnzé jìng ér yuǎn zhī.
en: He is famous, but I choose to keep a respectful distance.

zh: 他们两边都做好了比赛的架势。
pinyin: tā men liǎng biān dōu zuò hǎo le bǐ sài de jià shi.
en: Both sides have prepared the stance for the competition.

zh: 因为做错了事，他不该去说情。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zuòcuò le shì, tā bùgāi qù shuōqíng.
en: Because he did the wrong thing, he should not go to plead for him.

zh: 这只鹤立鸡群的小鸟在看朋友。
pinyin: Zhè zhī hèlìjīqún de xiǎoniǎo zài kàn péngyǒu.
en: This crane standing in a flock of chickens is looking at its friends.

zh: 学习中文时，你需要一个导师。
pinyin: Xuéxí Zhōngwén shí, nǐ xūyào yī gè dǎoshī.
en: When learning Chinese, you need a tutor.

zh: 比赛的时候，啦啦队非常热情。
pinyin: Bǐsài de shíhòu, lā lā duì fēicháng rèqíng.
en: During the competition, the cheerleading squad was very enthusiastic.

zh: 如果失败了，我们就从头再来。
pinyin: Rúguǒ shībài le, wǒmen jiù cóng tóu zàilái.
en: If we fail, we will start anew.

zh: 这份勤工俭学的工作很有意思。
pinyin: Zhè fèn qín gōng jiǎn xué de gōngzuò hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: This work-study program job is very interesting.

zh: 很多外籍游客喜欢在中国旅游。
pinyin: Hěn duō wài jí yóu kè xǐ huān zài zhōng guó lǚ yóu.
en: Many foreign tourists like to travel in China.

zh: 爷爷每个月都用这个存折存钱。
pinyin: yéye měi gè yuè dōu yòng zhège cúnzhé cún qián.
en: Grandpa uses this bankbook to save money every month.

zh: 老师用赤字标出了重要的题目。
pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng chìzì biāochū le zhòngyào de tímù.
en: The teacher marked the important questions with red letters.

zh: 他在毕业后很快就顺利上岗了。
pinyin: Tā zài bìyè hòu hěn kuài jiù shùnlì shànggǎng le.
en: He took up a job smoothly soon after graduation.

zh: 爷爷给我讲了一个有趣的谜语。
pinyin: Yéye gěi wǒ jiǎng le yīgè yǒuqù de míyǔ.
en: Grandpa told me an interesting riddle.

zh: 虽然很难，但他还是说了实话。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dàn tā háishì shuōle shíhuà.
en: Although it was difficult, he still told the truth.

zh: 天气冷了，白色的雪落下来了。
pinyin: Tiānqì lěng le, báisè de xuě luò xiàlái le.
en: The weather is cold, white snow is falling.

zh: 我们要抓紧时间，好赶上进度。
pinyin: Wǒ men yào zhuā jǐn shí jiān, hǎo gǎn shàng jìn dù.
en: We must hurry to keep up with the schedule.

zh: 这些网民对这个新闻很感兴趣。
pinyin: zhè xiē wǎng mín duì zhè gè xīn wén hěn gǎn xìng qù.
en: These netizens are very interested in this news.

zh: 那个穆斯林老人经常去清真寺。
pinyin: Nàge Mùsīlín lǎorén jīngcháng qù qīngzhēnsì.
en: That Muslim old man often goes to the mosque.

zh: 他在房间里跟小偷激烈地搏斗。
pinyin: Tā zài fángjiān lǐ gēn xiǎotōu jīliè de bódòu.
en: He wrestled fiercely with the thief in the room.

zh: 听到这个消息，他感到很气愤。
pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxī, tā gǎndào hěn qìfèn.
en: Hearing this news, he felt very indignant.

zh: 这些别有用心的人专门来捣乱。
pinyin: Zhèxiē biéyǒuyòngxīn de rén zhuānmén lái dǎoluàn.
en: These people with ulterior motives came specifically to stir up a row.

zh: 为了预防霍乱，要喝干净的水。
pinyin: wèile yùfáng huòluàn, yào hē gānjìng de shuǐ.
en: In order to prevent cholera, one must drink clean water.

zh: 要是耽误了工作，就不得了了。
pinyin: Yàoshi dānwù le gōngzuò, jiù bù dé liǎo le.
en: If the work is delayed, it will be a disaster.

zh: 不同的节气有不同的天气特点。
pinyin: Bùtóng de jiéqì yǒu bùtóng de tiānqì tèdiǎn.
en: Different solar terms have different weather characteristics.

zh: 听到这个计划，大家都哗然了。
pinyin: Tīngdào zhège jìhuà, dàjiā dōu huárán le.
en: Hearing this plan, everyone was in an uproar.

zh: 下雨的时候，路面很容易堵车。
pinyin: Xiàyǔ de shíhòu, lùmiàn hěn róngyì dǔchē.
en: When it rains, the roads easily get congested.

zh: 他喜欢运动，譬如跑步和打球。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuān yùndòng, pìrú pǎobù hé dǎqiú.
en: He likes sports, for example, running and playing ball games.

zh: 我们要竭尽全力去解决这些困难。
pinyin: Wǒ men yào jié jìn quán lì qù jiě jué zhè xiē kùn nán.
en: We must spare no effort to solve these difficulties.

zh: 董事长在会上发表了重要的讲话。
pinyin: Dǒng shì zhǎng zài huì shàng fā biǎo le zhòng yào de jiǎng huà.
en: The chairman delivered an important speech at the meeting.

zh: 没有人能取代你在我心中的地位。
pinyin: méi yǒu rén néng qǔ dài nǐ zài wǒ xīn zhōng de dì wèi.
en: No one can supplant your position in my heart.

zh: 他做事光明磊落，从不欺骗别人。
pinyin: Tā zuòshì guāngmínglěiluò, cóngbù qīpiàn biérén.
en: He is open and candid in his actions and never deceives others.

zh: 科学家们做出了惊天动地的发现。
pinyin: Kēxuéjiāmen zuòchūle jīng tiān dòng dì de fāxiàn.
en: The scientists made a world-shaking discovery.

zh: 众所周知，这件衣服的价格很高。
pinyin: Zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī, zhè jiàn yīfú de jiàgé hěn gāo.
en: As everyone knows, the price of this piece of clothing is very high.

zh: 考试的时候，他不知道怎么填空。
pinyin: Kǎoshì de shíhòu, tā bù zhīdào zěnme tiánkòng.
en: During the exam, he didn't know how to fill in the blanks.

zh: 朋友突然来看我，让我喜出望外。
pinyin: Péngyǒu tūrán lái kàn wǒ, ràng wǒ xǐchūwàngwài.
en: My friend suddenly came to visit me, which made me overjoyed at the turn of events.

zh: 这个比赛举世瞩目，大家都想看。
pinyin: Zhège bǐsài jǔshìzhǔmù, dàjiā dōu xiǎng kàn.
en: This competition is attracting worldwide attention, and everyone wants to watch it.

zh: 春天到了，燕子从南方飞回来了。
pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, yànzi cóng nánfāng fēi huílái le.
en: Spring has arrived, and the swallows have flown back from the south.

zh: 你有月票吗？坐公共汽车很方便。
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu yuèpiào ma? Zuò gōnggòng qìchē hěn fāngbiàn.
en: Do you have a monthly ticket? It is very convenient to take the bus.

zh: 如果你有时间，来我家吃顿便饭。
pinyin: rúguǒ nǐ yǒu shíjiān, lái wǒ jiā chī dùn biànfàn.
en: If you have time, come to my house for an ordinary meal.

zh: 外面下雨了，你非得现在出门吗？
pinyin: Wàimiàn xià yǔ le, nǐ fēiděi xiànzài chūmén ma?
en: It is raining outside, do you have to go out now?

zh: 这本书描写了普通人的喜怒哀乐。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū miáoxiě le pǔtōng rén de xǐnùāilè.
en: This book describes the joy, anger, sorrow, and happiness of ordinary people.

zh: 纵观整个房间，没有发现那本书。
pinyin: zòng guān zhěng gè fáng jiān, méi yǒu fā xiàn nà běn shū.
en: Surveying the whole room, I did not find that book.

zh: 他是一个家喻户晓的足球运动员。
pinyin: Tā shì yí gè jiā yù hù xiǎo de zú qiú yùn dòng yuán.
en: He is a household name football player.

zh: 她看见大家都有礼物，觉得红眼。
pinyin: Tā kànjiàn dàjiā dōu yǒu lǐwù, juéde hóngyǎn.
en: She felt envious seeing that everyone else had gifts.

zh: 假使明天下雪，我们就不出门了。
pinyin: jiǎshǐ míngtiān xiàxuě, wǒmen jiù bù chūmén le.
en: If it snows tomorrow, we won't go out.

zh: 生日那天，妈妈为我点亮了蜡烛。
pinyin: Shēngrì nèitiān, māma wèi wǒ diǎnliàng le làzhú.
en: On my birthday, Mom lit a candle for me.

zh: 天黑了，这样一来，看不见路了。
pinyin: Tiān hēi le, zhèyàng yī lái, kàn bù jiàn lù le.
en: It got dark; thus, the road could not be seen.

zh: 虽然很有钱，但他不能随心所欲。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn yǒuqián, dàn tā bùnéng suí xīn suǒ yù.
en: Although he is very rich, he cannot do whatever he wants.

zh: 因为生病，他缺席了今天的会议。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shēngbìng, tā quēxí le jīntiān de huìyì.
en: Because of illness, he was absent from today's meeting.

zh: 爷爷每天早上都去茶馆儿聊天儿。
pinyin: Yéye měitiān zǎoshang dōu qù cháguǎnr liáotiānr.
en: Grandpa goes to the teahouse to chat every morning.

zh: 除此之外，这个方法也非常简单。
pinyin: chú cǐ zhī wài, zhège fāngfǎ yě fēicháng jiǎndān.
en: In addition to this, this method is also very simple.

zh: 天气不好，我们据此改变了计划。
pinyin: Tiānqì bù hǎo, wǒmen jù cǐ gǎibiàn le jìhuà.
en: The weather is not good, we changed our plans accordingly.

zh: 他给孩子们发了一些精致的糖果。
pinyin: Tā gěi háizimen fāle yīxiē jīngzhì de tángguǒ.
en: He gave the children some exquisite candy.

zh: 他明天就走，何苦现在收拾行李？
pinyin: Tā míngtiān jiù zǒu, hékǔ xiànzài shōushi xíngli?
en: He leaves tomorrow, why bother packing luggage now?

zh: 他在昨晚的招待会上发表了演讲。
pinyin: Tā zài zuówǎn de zhāodàihuì shàng fābiǎo le yǎnjiǎng.
en: He delivered a speech at the reception last night.

zh: 弟弟已经懂事了，不会再乱跑了。
pinyin: Dìdi yǐjīng dǒng shì le, bú huì zài luàn pǎo le.
en: My younger brother has grown up; he won't run around recklessly anymore.

zh: 大家赞叹不已，这个学校很漂亮。
pinyin: Dàjiā zàntànbùyǐ, zhège xuéxiào hěn piàoliang.
en: Everyone is full of admiration; this school is very beautiful.

zh: 病人突然休克，请马上叫救护车。
pinyin: Bìngrén tūrán xiūkè, qǐng mǎshàng jiào jiùhùchē.
en: The patient suddenly went into shock; please call an ambulance immediately.

zh: 这首歌听起来犹如说话一样亲切。
pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē tīng qǐlái yóurú shuōhuà yīyàng qīnqiè.
en: This song sounds as intimate as spoken words.

zh: 他工作很忙，但依然很孝顺奶奶。
pinyin: Tā gōng zuò hěn máng, dàn yī rán hěn xiào shùn nǎi nai.
en: He is busy with work, but still devoted to his grandmother.

zh: 这件衣服的质量不亚于那件贵的。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de zhìliàng bù yà yú nà jiàn guì de.
en: The quality of this piece of clothing is not inferior to that expensive one.

zh: 夏天睡觉的时候，最好挂上蚊帐。
pinyin: Xiàtiān shuìjiào de shíhòu, zuì hǎo guà shàng wénzhàng.
en: It is best to hang up a mosquito net when sleeping in summer.

zh: 风一吹，树叶就从树上落下来了。
pinyin: Fēng yī chuī, shùyè jiù cóng shù shàng luò xiàlái le.
en: When the wind blows, the leaves fall down from the tree.

zh: 如果你工作刻苦，老板会喜欢你。
pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ gōng zuò kè kǔ, lǎo bǎn huì xǐ huān nǐ.
en: If you work hard, the boss will like you.

zh: 老师的话对他有潜移默化的影响。
pinyin: lǎoshī de huà duì tā yǒu qiányímòhuà de yǐngxiǎng.
en: The teacher's words had an imperceptible influence on him.

zh: 他从岩石的裂缝中看到了一朵花。
pinyin: tā cóng yánshí de lièfèng zhōng kàndàole yīduǒ huā.
en: He saw a flower in the crevice of the rocks.

zh: 历经努力，他考上了理想的大学。
pinyin: Lì jīng nǔlì, tā kǎo shàng le lǐxiǎng de dàxué.
en: Through hard work, he got into his ideal university.

zh: 这里冬天很冷，甚至于会下大雪。
pinyin: Zhè lǐ dōng tiān hěn lěng, shèn zhì yú huì xià dà xuě.
en: It is very cold here in winter, and it even snows heavily.

zh: 这条街上有一家很有名的老字号。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē shàng yǒu yī jiā hěn yǒumíng de lǎozìhào.
en: There is a very famous time-honored shop on this street.

zh: 他工作很努力，堪称一个好员工。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò hěn nǔlì, kānchēng yīgè hǎo yuángōng.
en: He works very hard; he can be said to be a good employee.

zh: 我们在学校后面开辟了一块园地。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài xuéxiào hòumiàn kāipìle yīkuài yuándì.
en: We opened up a garden area behind the school.

zh: 我们应邀参加了那个重要的会议。
pinyin: Wǒmen yìngyāo cānjiā le nàge zhòngyào de huìyì.
en: We attended that important meeting on invitation.

zh: 他准备在这个周末向女朋友求婚。
pinyin: Tā zhǔnbèi zài zhège zhōumò xiàng nǚpéngyǒu qiúhūn.
en: He is preparing to propose to his girlfriend this weekend.

zh: 如果你想学好汉语，一定要专注。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng xuéhǎo Hànyǔ, yīdìng yào zhuānzhù.
en: If you want to learn Chinese well, you must focus.

zh: 我们要保护好这些古老的建筑物。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎohù hǎo zhèxiē gǔlǎo de jiànzhùwù.
en: We must protect these ancient edifices well.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以我们去郊游。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen qù jiāoyóu.
en: Because the weather is very good, we are going on an excursion.

zh: 实验课上，同学们正在使用天平。
pinyin: Shíyàn kè shàng, tóngxuémen zhèngzài shǐyòng tiānpíng.
en: In the lab class, the students are using the balance scale.

zh: 在这个炎热的季节，请注意休息。
pinyin: Zài zhège yánrè de jìjié, qǐng zhùyì xiūxi.
en: During this blistering hot season, please pay attention to rest.

zh: 如果你错过这班车，那就倒霉了。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ cuòguò zhè bān chē, nà jiù dǎoméi le.
en: If you miss this bus, you are out of luck.

zh: 这件事很复杂，你别胡思乱想了。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn fùzá, nǐ bié húsīluànxiǎng le.
en: This matter is complex, don't let your imagination run wild.

zh: 面对批评，他坐在那里一声不吭。
pinyin: Miànduì pīpíng, tā zuò zài nàlǐ yī shēng bù kēng.
en: Facing the criticism, he sat there without saying a word.

zh: 手机出厂以后，我们要检查一下。
pinyin: Shǒujī chūchǎng yǐhòu, wǒmen yào jiǎnchá yīxià.
en: After the mobile phones leave the factory, we need to check them.

zh: 如果他不注意身体，必定会生病。
pinyin: Rúguǒ tā bù zhùyì shēntǐ, bìdìng huì shēngbìng.
en: If he does not take care of his body, he is bound to get sick.

zh: 他不习惯别人用这个称号称呼他。
pinyin: Tā bù xíguàn biérén yòng zhège chēnghào chēnghu tā.
en: He is not used to others using this term of address to call him.

zh: 从这个角度看，我有不同的见解。
pinyin: Cóng zhège jiǎodù kàn, wǒ yǒu bùtóng de jiànjiě.
en: From this perspective, I have a different view.

zh: 近年来，中国西部的发展非常快。
pinyin: Jìnniánlái, Zhōngguó xībù de fāzhǎn fēicháng kuài.
en: In recent years, the development of western China has been very fast.

zh: 孩子们都喜欢看精彩的马戏表演。
pinyin: Háizimen dōu xǐhuān kàn jīngcǎi de mǎxì biǎoyǎn.
en: The children all like watching wonderful circus performances.

zh: 别看这杯茶很便宜，味道非常好。
pinyin: Bié kàn zhè bēi chá hěn piányi, wèidào fēicháng hǎo.
en: Don't be fooled by the fact that this cup of tea is cheap; it tastes very good.

zh: 元宵节的时候，大家喜欢吃汤圆。
pinyin: yuán xiāo jié de shí hou, dà jiā xǐ huan chī tāng yuán.
en: During the Lantern Festival, everyone likes to eat tangyuan.

zh: 现在市场不景气，我们要多努力。
pinyin: Xiànzài shìchǎng bù jǐngqì, wǒmen yào duō nǔlì.
en: The market is slack now, we need to work harder.

zh: 因为喝了太多咖啡，他觉得心慌。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hēle tài duō kāfēi, tā juédé xīnhuāng.
en: Because he drank too much coffee, he felt heart palpitations.

zh: 看到她安全回来，我终于安心了。
pinyin: Kàndào tā ānquán huílái, wǒ zhōngyú ānxīn le.
en: Seeing her return safely, I finally feel relieved.

zh: 由于天气不好，飞机遭受了延误。
pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì bù hǎo, fēijī zāoshòu le yánwù.
en: Due to bad weather, the flight suffered a delay.

zh: 这条路上非常荒凉，几乎没有人。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù shàng fēi cháng huāng liáng, jī hū méi yǒu rén.
en: This road is very desolate, there is almost no one.

zh: 这次考试的最后一道题在出难题。
pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de zuìhòu yīdào tí zài chū nántí.
en: The last question of this exam is posing a challenge.

zh: 真的很抱歉，打搅了大家的工作。
pinyin: Zhēn de hěn bào qiàn, dǎ jiǎo le dà jiā de gōng zuò.
en: I am very sorry to have disturbed everyone's work.

zh: 请帮我辨认一下这些古董的真假。
pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ biànrèn yīxià zhèxiē gǔdǒng de zhēn jiǎ.
en: Please help me identify the authenticity of these antiques.

zh: 医生看到病人脸色惨白，很担心。
pinyin: yī shēng kàn dào bìng rén liǎn sè cǎn bái, hěn dān xīn.
en: The doctor saw the patient's face was deathly pale and was very worried.

zh: 这个农场里有很多可爱的小动物。
pinyin: Zhè gè nóng chǎng lǐ yǒu hěn duō kě ài de xiǎo dòng wù.
en: There are many cute little animals on this farm.

zh: 这种电脑对于学生来说太昂贵了。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng diànnǎo duìyú xuésheng lái shuō tài ángguì le.
en: This type of computer is too costly for students.

zh: 由于身体不舒服，他说话很费劲。
pinyin: Yóuyú shēntǐ bù shūfu, tā shuōhuà hěn fèijìn.
en: Due to feeling unwell, it is strenuous for him to speak.

zh: 为了学习汉语，我绝不半途而废。
pinyin: Wèile xuéxí Hànyǔ, wǒ juébù bàntú'érfèi.
en: In order to learn Chinese, I will never give up halfway.

zh: 那位作家出口成章，写了很多书。
pinyin: Nà wèi zuò jiā chū kǒu chéng zhāng, xiě le hěn duō shū.
en: That author is eloquent and has written many books.

zh: 学习中文虽然难，但我不会灰心。
pinyin: Xuéxí Zhōngwén suīrán nán, dàn wǒ bú huì huīxīn.
en: Although learning Chinese is hard, I will not lose heart.

zh: 为了寻觅工作，他去了很多城市。
pinyin: Wèile xúnmì gōngzuò, tā qùle hěnduō chéngshì.
en: In order to look for a job, he went to many cities.

zh: 请告诉我这个物品属于哪个类别。
pinyin: qǐng gào su wǒ zhè gè wù pǐn shǔ yú nǎ gè lèi bié.
en: Please tell me which category this item belongs to.

zh: 这两个计划的目的是截然不同的。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè jìhuà de mùdì shì jiéránbùtóng de.
en: The purposes of these two plans are different as black and white.

zh: 大家看到瑞雪，都感到非常高兴。
pinyin: Dàjiā kàndào ruìxuě, dōu gǎndào fēicháng gāoxìng.
en: Everyone felt very happy when they saw the timely snow.

zh: 他在马后炮的位置放了一个棋子。
pinyin: Tā zài mǎhòupào de wèizhì fàng le yī gè qízǐ.
en: He placed a chess piece in the position for a cannon-behind-horse move.

zh: 这本书里有很多关于催眠的故事。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū lǐ yǒu hěnduō guānyú cuīmián de gùshì.
en: This book has many stories about hypnosis.

zh: 多年来，他一直在这家公司工作。
pinyin: Duō nián lái, tā yīzhí zài zhè jiā gōngsī gōngzuò.
en: For many years, he has been working at this company.

zh: 我们提前在网上预定了这家餐厅。
pinyin: Wǒmen tíqián zài wǎngshàng yùdìng le zhè jiā cāntīng.
en: We booked this restaurant online in advance.

zh: 那个离奇的故事听起来不像真的。
pinyin: nà gè lí qí de gù shì tīng qǐ lái bú xiàng zhēn de.
en: That odd story does not sound real.

zh: 我们决定去那家五星级餐厅吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒmen juédìng qù nà jiā wǔ xīng jí cāntīng chīfàn.
en: We decided to go to that five-star restaurant to eat.

zh: 遇到这么好的老师是我们的福气。
pinyin: Yùdào zhème hǎo de lǎoshī shì wǒmen de fúqi.
en: Meeting such a good teacher is our blessing.

zh: 开学前，我们需要准备很多文具。
pinyin: Kāixué qián, wǒmen xūyào zhǔnbèi hěnduō wénjù.
en: Before school starts, we need to prepare a lot of stationery.

zh: 我们要从方方面面考虑这个问题。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào cóng fāngfāngmiànmiàn kǎolǜ zhège wèntí.
en: We need to consider this problem from all sides.

zh: 为了明天的课，我得早点儿备课。
pinyin: Wèile míngtiān de kè, wǒ děi zǎodiǎnr bèikè.
en: For tomorrow's class, I need to prepare lessons a little earlier.

zh: 这本书的内容侧重介绍中国文化。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng cèzhòng jièshào Zhōngguó wénhuà.
en: The content of this book focuses on introducing Chinese culture.

zh: 在学校里，我最擅长的科目是理科。
pinyin: Zài xuéxiào lǐ, wǒ zuì shàncháng de kēmù shì lǐkē.
en: At school, the subjects I am best at are the sciences.

zh: 他今天去面试，希望能有个好饭碗。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān qù miànshì, xīwàng néng yǒu gè hǎo fànwǎn.
en: He went for an interview today, hoping to have a good job.

zh: 他的分析很透彻，听起来顺理成章。
pinyin: tā de fēnxī hěn tòuchè, tīng qǐlái shùnlǐchéngzhāng.
en: His analysis is thorough and sounds logical.

zh: 这件衣服太贵，何况颜色也不好看。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu tài guì, hékuàng yánsè yě bù hǎokàn.
en: This piece of clothing is too expensive, to say nothing of the fact that the color is not nice.

zh: 每当看到照片，我就怀念我的朋友。
pinyin: Měi dāng kàn dào zhàozhàopiàn, wǒ jiù huáin iàn wǒ de péngyou.
en: Whenever I see the photo, I think of my friend.

zh: 这位老师在学生中享有很高的声望。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī zài xuésheng zhōng xiǎngyǒu hěn gāo de shēngwàng.
en: This teacher enjoys a high reputation among students.

zh: 不管我怎么打，他就是不接听电话。
pinyin: Bùguǎn wǒ zěnme dǎ, tā jiùshì bù jiētīng diànhuà.
en: No matter how I call, he just won't answer the phone.

zh: 我们要把下午的会议改为明天上午。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎ xiàwǔ de huìyì gǎi wéi míngtiān shàngwǔ.
en: We need to change the afternoon meeting to tomorrow morning.

zh: 这台电脑的价格太高了，我买不起。
pinyin: zhè tái diàn nǎo de jià gé tài gāo le, wǒ mǎi bu qǐ.
en: The price of this computer is too high, I cannot afford it.

zh: 听到这个消息，大家顿时高兴起来。
pinyin: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi, dàjiā dùnshí gāoxìng qǐlái.
en: Hearing this news, everyone immediately became happy.

zh: 我学习汉语、数学诸如此类的课程。
pinyin: Wǒ xuéxí Hànyǔ, shùxué zhūrúcǐlèi de kèchéng.
en: I study Chinese, math, and things like this.

zh: 虽然工作很忙碌，但我还是很高兴。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn mánglù, dàn wǒ háishì hěn gāoxìng.
en: Although work is very busy, I am still very happy.

zh: 公园门口的人川流不息，非常热闹。
pinyin: Gōngyuán ménkǒu de rén chuānliúbùxī, fēicháng rènào.
en: There is a constant stream of people at the park entrance; it is very lively.

zh: 大家都不喜欢那个盛气凌人的经理。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu bù xǐhuān nàge shèngqìlíngrén de jīnglǐ.
en: Everyone dislikes that arrogant bully of a manager.

zh: 假设飞机准时起飞，我们要快点走。
pinyin: jiǎshè fēijī zhǔnshí qǐfēi, wǒmen yào kuǎidiǎn zǒu.
en: Assume the plane takes off on time, we need to leave quickly.

zh: 在那次比赛里，他化险为夷，赢了。
pinyin: Zài nà cì bǐsài lǐ, tā huàxiǎnwéiyí, yíngle.
en: In that competition, he turned peril into safety and won.

zh: 春节的时候，晚上会有美丽的焰火。
pinyin: chūn jié de shí hou, wǎn shang huì yǒu měi lì de yàn huǒ.
en: During the Spring Festival, there will be beautiful fireworks at night.

zh: 他拒绝了这个机会，真是太愚蠢了。
pinyin: tā jù jué le zhè gè jī huì, zhēn shì tài yú chǔn le.
en: He refused the opportunity; it was truly stupid.

zh: 老板一毛不拔，从来不请我们吃饭。
pinyin: Lǎobǎn yī máo bù bá, cónglái bù qǐng wǒmen chīfàn.
en: The boss is extremely stingy and never treats us to a meal.

zh: 他听到这个消息后，感到非常惊讶。
pinyin: Tā tīng dào zhège xiāoxi hòu, gǎndào fēicháng jīngyà.
en: After hearing this news, he felt very surprised.

zh: 对于第一次见面，我至今记忆犹新。
pinyin: Duìyú dì yī cì jiànmiàn, wǒ zhìjīn jì yì yóu xīn.
en: I still remember our first meeting as if it were yesterday.

zh: 今天天气很好，快乐莫过于去公园。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, kuàilè mòguòyú qù gōngyuán.
en: The weather is very good today; nothing surpasses going to the park for happiness.

zh: 他总是想劫我去做他不喜欢的任务。
pinyin: tā zǒng shì xiǎng jié wǒ qù zuò tā bù xǐ huān de rèn wù
en: He always wants to coerce me to do tasks he does not like.

zh: 他如果不努力工作，就会一事无成。
pinyin: Tā rúguǒ bù nǔlì gōngzuò, jiù huì yī shì wú chéng.
en: If he does not work hard, he will achieve nothing.

zh: 他因为家里有钱，经常瞧不起别人。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi jiālǐ yǒu qián, jīngcháng qiáo bù qǐ biérén.
en: Because he is rich, he often looks down on others.

zh: 这几天，他接二连三地收到坏消息。
pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān, tā jiē èr lián sān de shōudào huài xiāoxi.
en: In the past few days, he has received bad news one after another.

zh: 那里的风景名副其实，真的很漂亮。
pinyin: Nàlǐ de fēngjǐng míng fù qí shí, zhēnde hěn piàoliang.
en: The scenery there is not just in name, it is really beautiful.

zh: 他的要求合情合理，我们应该帮忙。
pinyin: Tā de yāoqiú héqínghélǐ, wǒmen yīnggāi bāngmáng.
en: His request is reasonable, and we should help.

zh: 这儿的环境非常优雅，很适合读书。
pinyin: Zhèr de huánjìng fēicháng yōuyǎ, hěn shìhé dúshū.
en: The environment here is very elegant, very suitable for reading.

zh: 古今中外，人们都喜欢看好看的书。
pinyin: gǔ jīn zhōng wài, rén men dōu xǐ huān kàn hǎo kàn de shū.
en: At all times and in all places, people like to read good books.

zh: 老师看了我一眼，给我使了个眼色。
pinyin: Lǎoshī kàn le wǒ yīyǎn, gěi wǒ shǐ le gè yǎnsè.
en: The teacher looked at me and gave me a signal with his eyes.

zh: 对他没能参加考试，我感到很歉意。
pinyin: duì tā méi néng cān jiā kǎo shì, wǒ gǎn dào hěn qiàn yì.
en: I feel very much regret that he could not take the exam.

zh: 虽然有暴风骤雨，但是他去上班了。
pinyin: suī rán yǒu bào fēng zhòu yǔ, dàn shì tā qù shàng bān le.
en: Although there is a hurricane, he went to work.

zh: 他把桌子上的照片一一介绍给朋友。
pinyin: Tā bǎ zhuōzi shàng de zhàopiàn yī yī jièshào gěi péngyǒu.
en: He introduced the photos on the table to his friend one by one.

zh: 你为什么要多心呢？没有人怀疑你。
pinyin: Nǐ wèishéme yào duōxīn ne? Méiyǒu rén huáiyí nǐ.
en: Why are you being suspicious? No one is doubting you.

zh: 中秋节到了，家家户户准备吃月饼。
pinyin: Zhōngqiū jié dàole, jiā jiā hù hù zhǔnbèi chī yuèbǐng.
en: Mid-Autumn Festival has arrived, and every household prepares to eat mooncakes.

zh: 奶奶心灵手巧，经常帮我们修东西。
pinyin: nǎinai xīn líng shǒu qiǎo, jīngcháng bāng wǒmen xiū dōngxi.
en: Grandma is capable and often helps us repair things.

zh: 老师说要在这个字后面加一个括弧。
pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō yào zài zhège zì hòumiàn jiā yīgè kuòhú.
en: The teacher said to add a parenthesis after this character.

zh: 他每天早上习惯先过早，再去学校。
pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang xíguàn xiān guòzǎo, zài qù xuéxiào.
en: He is used to having breakfast first every morning before going to school.

zh: 端午节那天，我们全家一起吃粽子。
pinyin: Duānwǔjié nà tiān, wǒmen quánjiā yìqǐ chī zòngzi.
en: On the day of the Dragon Boat Festival, our whole family eats zongzi together.

zh: 她是一个坚强的女孩子，从不哭泣。
pinyin: Tā shì yīgè jiānqiáng de nǚháizi, cóngbù kūqì.
en: She is a staunch girl who never cries.

zh: 我们一起去旅游，看看外地的美景。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīqǐ qù lǚyóu, kànkan wàidì de měijǐng.
en: Let's travel together and see the beautiful scenery in other places.

zh: 由于天气不好，航班延误了两个小时。
pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì bù hǎo, hángbān yánwù le liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
en: Due to bad weather, the flight was delayed by two hours.

zh: 老师很有口才，大家都喜欢听他讲课。
pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn yǒu kǒucái, dàjiā dōu xǐhuān tīng tā jiǎngkè.
en: The teacher is very eloquent; everyone likes listening to his lessons.

zh: 孩子不能一味地玩游戏，应该多读书。
pinyin: hái zi bù néng yī wèi de wán yóu xì, yīng gāi duō dú shū.
en: Children shouldn't just keep playing games; they should read more.

zh: 去那家公司工作，必须要有大学学历。
pinyin: qù nà jiā gōng sī gōng zuò ， bì xū yào yǒu dà xué xué lì 。
en: To work at that company, you must have university academic qualifications.

zh: 休息和睡觉是两码事，但也是一回事。
pinyin: Xiūxi hé shuìjiào shì liǎng mǎ shì, dàn yě shì yī huí shì.
en: Resting and sleeping are different, but they are also one thing (in terms of recovery).

zh: 虽然这次考试没考好，但我不会气馁。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè cì kǎoshì méi kǎohǎo, dàn wǒ bù huì qìněi.
en: Although I didn't do well on this exam, I won't be discouraged.

zh: 南方天气很热，相比之下北方冷多了。
pinyin: Nánfāng tiānqì hěn rè, xiāngbǐzhīxià běifāng lěng duō le.
en: The weather in the south is very hot; by comparison, the north is much colder.

zh: 看在我们多年交情的份上，帮帮我吧。
pinyin: Kàn zài wǒmen duōnián jiāoqing de fènshang, bāngbāng wǒ ba.
en: For the sake of our many years of friendship, please help me.

zh: 他的回答耐人寻味，让我们想了很久。
pinyin: tā de huídá nàirénxúnwèi, ràng wǒmen xiǎng le hěnjiǔ.
en: His answer is thought-provoking, making us think for a long time.

zh: 听到这个坏消息，他的身体开始哆嗦。
pinyin: Tīng dào zhège huài xiāoxi, tā de shēntǐ kāishǐ duōsuo.
en: Hearing this bad news, his body began to tremble.

zh: 妈妈虽然说了你，但是她是有口无心。
pinyin: Māma suīrán shuōle nǐ, dànshì tā shì yǒu kǒu wú xīn.
en: Although Mom scolded you, she didn't mean it.

zh: 在这次选举中，他成为了最后的输家。
pinyin: Zài zhè cì xuǎnjǔ zhōng, tā chéngwéi le zuìhòu de shūjiā.
en: In this election, he became the final loser.

zh: 当我不开心的时候，我会找朋友倾诉。
pinyin: Dāng wǒ bù kāixīn de shíhòu, wǒ huì zhǎo péngyǒu qīngsù.
en: When I am unhappy, I find friends to pour my heart out to.

zh: 那个小偷在商场里得手之后马上跑了。
pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu zài shāngchǎng lǐ déshǒu zhīhòu mǎshàng pǎo le.
en: The thief ran away immediately after succeeding (in the theft).

zh: 按理说，今天天气很好，可以去公园。
pinyin: àn lǐ shuō, jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, kěyǐ qù gōngyuán.
en: It is reasonable to say that today's weather is good, we can go to the park.

zh: 面对那个问题，他是不假思索回答的。
pinyin: Miànduì nàge wèntí, tā shì bù jiǎ sī suǒ huídá de.
en: Facing that question, he answered without thinking.

zh: 现在大家可以随时随地在网上买东西。
pinyin: Xiànzài dàjiā kěyǐ suíshísuídì zài wǎngshàng mǎi dōngxī.
en: Nowadays, everyone can buy things online anytime and anywhere.

zh: 因为更衣室坏了，所以他去了一楼的。
pinyin: yīnwèi gēngyīshì huài le, suǒyǐ tā qù le yī lóu de.
en: Because the restroom was broken, he went to the one on the first floor.

zh: 无论如何，你都应该告诉老师这件事。
pinyin: wú lùn rú hé, nǐ dōu yīng gāi gào sù lǎo shī zhè jiàn shì.
en: In any case, you should tell the teacher about this.

zh: 这家医院有很多临床经验丰富的医生。
pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn yǒu hěnduō línchuáng jīngyàn fēngfù de yīshēng.
en: This hospital has many doctors with rich clinical experience.

zh: 如果有时间，请来游览我们的博物馆。
pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, qǐng lái yóulǎn wǒmen de bówùguǎn.
en: If you have time, please come to visit our museum.

zh: 由于工作太忙，他的学习进度没跟上。
pinyin: Yóuyú gōngzuò tài máng, tā de xuéxí jìndù méi gēn shàng.
en: Because work is too busy, his study pace hasn't kept up.

zh: 他从十岁开始集邮，家里有很多邮票。
pinyin: Tā cóng shí suì kāishǐ jíyóu, jiālǐ yǒu hěnduō yóupiào.
en: He started stamp collecting at the age of ten, and there are many stamps at home.

zh: 今天很热，也就是说我们可以去游泳。
pinyin: Jīntiān hěn rè, yě jiù shì shuō wǒmen kěyǐ qù yóuyǒng.
en: It is hot today, in other words, we can go swimming.

zh: 我没想到你会来，真是让我大吃一惊。
pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎngdào nǐ huì lái, zhēnshi ràng wǒ dà chī yī jīng.
en: I didn't expect you to come; it really astounded me.

zh: 教练在比赛中带路，告诉我们怎么做。
pinyin: Jiàoliàn zài bǐsài zhōng dàilù, gàosù wǒmen zěnme zuò.
en: The coach instructs us during the match, telling us what to do.

zh: 同学跟他打招呼，他总是爱理不理的。
pinyin: Tóngxué gēn tā dǎzhāohu, tā zǒngshì ài lǐ bù lǐ de.
en: When classmates greet him, he is always standoffish.

zh: 老人家身体不太舒服，我们去看看他吧。

pinyin: Tā xiān zhěnglǐ fángjiān, qíhòu dǎsǎo kètīng.
en: He tidies the room first, then cleans the living room.

zh: 那件衣服上被烧了一个大窟窿。
pinyin: Nà jiàn yīfú shàng bèi shāo le yī gè dà kūlong.
en: A big hole was burned in that piece of clothing.

zh: 这种官僚主义影响了工作效率。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng guānliáozhǔyì yǐngxiǎng le gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
en: This kind of bureaucracy affects work efficiency.

zh: 除非你告诉我，否则我不知道。
pinyin: Chú fēi nǐ gào su wǒ, fǒu zé wǒ bù zhī dào.
en: Only if you tell me, will I know.

zh: 你千万别小看这个简单的问题。
pinyin: Nǐ qiānwàn bié xiǎokàn zhège jiǎndān de wèntí.
en: You must not underestimate this simple question.

zh: 他因为迷路了，所以东张西望。
pinyin: tā yīnwèi mílù le, suǒyǐ dōng zhāng xī wàng.
en: Because he is lost, he is looking in all directions.

zh: 现在越来越多的人选择开电车。
pinyin: xiàn zài yuè lái yuè duō de rén xuǎn zé kāi diàn chē.
en: Nowadays more and more people choose to drive electric cars.

zh: 他们因为这种小事计较个不停。
pinyin: tāmen yīnwèi zhè zhǒng xiǎoshì jìjiào gè bù tíng.
en: They keep bickering over this kind of small matter.

zh: 我的英语水准还没有达到要求。
pinyin: Wǒ de Yīngyǔ shuǐzhǔn hái méiyǒu dádào yāo yāoqiú.
en: My English level has not reached the requirement yet.

zh: 在这会儿，大家都安静下来了。
pinyin: zài zhè huìr, dàjiā dōu ānjìng xiàlái le.
en: At this very moment, everyone quieted down.

zh: 他在公司里经常给同事穿小鞋。
pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī lǐ jīngcháng gěi tóngshì chuān xiǎo xié.
en: He often makes life difficult for his colleagues at the company.

zh: 多亏了好心人，我才没丢东西。
pinyin: Duōkuīle hǎoxīnrén, wǒ cái méi diū dōngxī.
en: Thanks to a good Samaritan, I didn't lose my things.

zh: 他在战场上表现出惊人的毅力。
pinyin: Tā zài zhànchǎng shàng biǎoxiàn chū jīngrén de yìlì.
en: He showed amazing perseverance on the battlefield.

zh: 我们必须面对现实，不能逃避。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū miàn duì xiànshí, bùnéng táobì.
en: We must face reality and cannot escape.

zh: 雨后，天空中出现了一道彩虹。
pinyin: yǔ hòu, tiān kōng zhōng chū xiàn le yī dào cǎi hóng.
en: After the rain, a rainbow appeared in the sky.

zh: 老师嘱咐我们要按时完成作业。
pinyin: lǎo shī zhǔ fu wǒ men yào àn shí wán chéng zuò yè.
en: The teacher urged us to finish our homework on time.

zh: 我们应该充分挖掘学生的潜力。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chōngfèn wājué xuéshēng de qiánlì.
en: We should fully tap into the students' potential.

zh: 作为初次尝试，这已经很好了。
pinyin: Zuòwéi chūcì chángshì, zhè yǐjīng hěn hǎo le.
en: As a first attempt, this is already very good.

zh: 他趁机向老师请教了几个问题。
pinyin: Tā chènjī xiàng lǎoshī qǐngjiào le jǐ gè wèntí.
en: He seized the opportunity to ask the teacher a few questions.

zh: 由于你的包容，他没受到惩罚。
pinyin: Yóuyú nǐ de bāoróng, tā méi shòudào chéngfá.
en: Because of your pardon, he was not punished.

zh: 经理邀请我去参加这次招待会。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ yāoqǐng wǒ qù cānjiā zhè cì zhāodàihuì.
en: The manager invited me to attend this reception.

zh: 清洁工负责维持教学楼的秩序。
pinyin: Qīngjiégōng fùzé wéichí jiàoxuélóu de zhìxù.
en: The janitor is responsible for maintaining order in the teaching building.

zh: 他挺起胸膛，看起来很有精神。
pinyin: tā tǐng qǐ xiōngtáng, kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu jīngshén.
en: He puffed out his chest, looking very energetic.

zh: 这种机器能净化房间里的空气。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jīqì néng jìnghuà fángjiān lǐ de kōngqì.
en: This kind of machine can purify the air in the room.

zh: 很多人在青春期会变得很害羞。
pinyin: hěn duō rén zài qīng chūn qī huì biàn de hěn hài xiū.
en: Many people become very shy during adolescence.

zh: 汉语学习变得愈来愈有意思了。
pinyin: Hànyǔ xuéxí biàn de yù lái yù yǒu yìsi le.
en: Learning Chinese is becoming more and more interesting.

zh: 老师为我们树立了良好的表率。
pinyin: Lǎoshī wèi wǒmen shùlìle liánghǎo de biǎoshuài.
en: The teacher set a good example for us.

zh: 他总是不务正业，只知道玩儿。
pinyin: Tā zǒng shì bùwùzhèngyè, zhǐ zhīdào wánr.
en: He never attends to his proper business and only knows how to hang out/waste time.

zh: 教孩子写作业需要很大的耐性。
pinyin: Jiào háizi xiě zuòyè xūyào hěn dà de nài xìng.
en: Teaching children to do homework requires a lot of patience.

zh: 我们不应该只看一个人的外貌。
pinyin: Wǒmen bù yīnggāi zhǐ kàn yīgè rén de wàimào.
en: We should not judge people solely by their appearance.

zh: 我们可以用这个机器过滤空气。
pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ yòng zhège jīqì guòlǜ kōngqì.
en: We can use this machine to filter the air.

zh: 别人谈话时插嘴是很不礼貌的。
pinyin: Biérén tánhuà shí chāzuǐ shì hěn bù lǐmào de.
en: It is very impolite to butt in when others are talking.

zh: 我们需要测算这些材料的重量。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào cè suàn zhèxiē cáiliào de zhòngliàng.
en: We need to measure and calculate the weight of these materials.

zh: 妹妹灵机一动，画了一只小猫。
pinyin: Mèi mei líng jī yī dòng, huà le yī zhī xiǎo māo.
en: My younger sister had a sudden bright idea and drew a kitten.

zh: 他不应该那么做，感到很悔恨。
pinyin: tā bù yīnggāi nàme zuò, gǎndào hěn huǐhèn.
en: He shouldn't have done that, he feels much remorse.

zh: 由于准备充分，比赛一帆风顺。
pinyin: Yóuyú zhǔnbèi chōngfèn, bǐsài yī fān fēng shùn.
en: Due to full preparation, the competition was plain sailing.

zh: 这部电影的剧本构思非常巧妙。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jùběn gòusī fēicháng qiǎomiào.
en: The script of this movie is conceived very ingeniously.

zh: 文章里借用了一些著名的观点。
pinyin: Wénzhāng lǐ jièyòngle yīxiē zhùmíng de guāndiǎn.
en: The article borrowed some famous viewpoints.

zh: 这道题太难了，他看着它犯愁。
pinyin: Zhè dào tí tài nán le, tā kànzhe tā fànchóu.
en: This question is too hard; he looks at it and feels anxious.

zh: 春节放鞭炮是约定俗成的传统。
pinyin: Chūnjié fàng biānpào shì yuēdìngsúchéng de chuántǒng.
en: Setting off firecrackers during Spring Festival is a customary convention.

zh: 大家对他这次的做法感到疑虑。
pinyin: dà jiā duì tā zhè cì de zuò fǎ gǎn dào yí lù.
en: Everyone feels misgivings about his actions this time.

zh: 他工作很久了，变得有些世故。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò hěnjiǔ le, biànde yǒuxiē shìgù.
en: He has been working for a long time and has become somewhat worldly-wise.

zh: 他讲的冷笑话真让人哭笑不得。
pinyin: Tā jiǎng de lěngxiàohuà zhēn ràng rén kūxiàobùdé.
en: The dad joke he told was both funny and embarrassing.

zh: 这是我们能力所能达到的极限。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen nénglì suǒ néng dádào de jíxiàn.
en: This is the extreme boundary our ability can reach.

zh: 那辆白色的车飞速地开了过去。
pinyin: Nà liàng báisè de chē fēisù de kāile guòqù.
en: That white car drove past swiftly.

zh: 儿子上大学后变得更加懂事了。
pinyin: Érzi shàng dàxué hòu biànde gèngjiā dǒng shì le.
en: My son has become more mature since going to university.

zh: 他总是对别人的成功感到红眼。
pinyin: Tā zǒngshì duì biérén de chénggōng gǎndào hóngyǎn.
en: He is always envious of others' success.

zh: 中庸是中国传统文化的一部分。
pinyin: Zhōngyōng shì Zhōngguó chuántǒng wénhuà de yībùfèn.
en: The Doctrine of the Mean is a part of Chinese traditional culture.

zh: 这件事关系到我们的一体利益。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì guānxì dào wǒmen de yītǐ lìyì.
en: This matter concerns the interests of all of us.

zh: 房间里的温度调节得恰如其分。
pinyin: fángjiān lǐ de wēndù tiáojié dé qià rú qí fèn.
en: The temperature in the room is set just right.

zh: 如果你去爬山，记得带上睡袋。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ qù páshān, jìdé dài shàng shuìdài.
en: If you go hiking, remember to bring a sleeping bag.

zh: 周末我经常去公园看老人下棋。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ jīngcháng qù gōngyuán kàn lǎorén xià qí.
en: I often go to the park on weekends to watch the elderly play chess.

zh: 为了安全，他不得不投奔外国。
pinyin: Wèile ānquán, tā bùdébù tóubèn wàiguó.
en: For safety, he had to seek asylum in a foreign country.

zh: 这部电影获得了多个国际奖项。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng huòdéle duō gè guójì jiǎngxiàng.
en: This movie won multiple international awards.

zh: 游客从四面八方来到这座城市。
pinyin: Yóukè cóng sì miàn bā fāng láidào zhè zuò chéngshì.
en: Tourists from all directions have come to this city.

zh: 老客户都来为这家新餐厅捧场。
pinyin: Lǎo kèhù dōu lái wèi zhè jiā xīn cāntīng pěng chǎng.
en: Regular customers all came to patronize this new restaurant.

zh: 大家认为这个会议是在走过场。
pinyin: Dàjiā rènwéi zhège huìyì shì zài zǒu guò chǎng.
en: Everyone thinks this meeting is just going through the motions.

zh: 政府正在查处非法经营的商店。
pinyin: zhèngfǔ zhèngzài cháchǔ fēifǎ jīngyíng de shāngdiàn.
en: The government is investigating and handling the illegally operating shops.

zh: 请在表格上填写您的联系号码。
pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé shàng tiánxiě nín de liánxì hàomǎ.
en: Please fill in your contact number on the form.

zh: 他从外套的袖珍里拿出了钥匙。
pinyin: Tā cóng wàitào de xiùzhēn lǐ ná chū le yàoshi.
en: He took the keys out of his jacket pocket.

zh: 为了上网，我们需要安装光缆。
pinyin: Wèile shàngwǎng, wǒmen xūyào ānzhuāng guānglǎn.
en: In order to access the internet, we need to install optical cables.

zh: 他拒绝在别人困难时乘人之危。
pinyin: tā jùjué zài biérén kùnnán shí chéng rén zhī wēi.
en: He refused to take advantage of others when they were in difficulty.

zh: 我喜欢苹果和梨，后者更好吃。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ hé lí, hòuzhě gèng hǎochī.
en: I like apples and pears; the latter is more delicious.

zh: 我们需要一个方案来应付万一。
pinyin: wǒ men xū yào yī gè fèn fàn àn lái yìng fù wàn yī.
en: We need a plan to handle any contingencies.

zh: 这个项目的可行性有一些争议。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de kěkěxìngxìng yǒu yīxiē zhēngyì.
en: The feasibility of this project is rather controversial.

zh: 为了目标，他忍心放弃了休息。
pinyin: Wèi le mù biāo, tā rěn xīn fàng qì le xiū xi.
en: For the goal, he steeled himself to give up resting.

zh: 这本书引发了广大读者的共鸣。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǐnfā le guǎngdà dúzhě de gòngmíng.
en: This book resonated with a vast number of readers.

zh: 他的鞋底是橡胶的，非常舒服。
pinyin: Tā de xiédǐ shì xiàngjiāo de, fēicháng shūfu.
en: The soles of his shoes are made of rubber and are very comfortable.

zh: 那个好心人收留了很多流浪狗。
pinyin: Nàge hǎoxīnrén shōuliúle hěnduō liúlànggǒu.
en: That kind person has taken in many stray dogs.

zh: 比赛中，他们成功反击了对方。
pinyin: Bǐsài zhōng, tāmen chénggōng fǎnjī le duìfāng.
en: In the game, they successfully struck back against the opponent.

zh: 他还在生我的气，一直不理我。
pinyin: Tā hái zài shēng wǒ de qì, yīzhí bù lǐ wǒ.
en: He is still angry with me and refuses to acknowledge me.

zh: 为了工作，我们需要坦诚合作。
pinyin: Wèile gōngzuò, wǒmen xūyào tǎnchéng hézuò.
en: For the work, we need to deal with each other plainly.

zh: 他总是不由自主地回忆起童年。
pinyin: Tā zǒng shì bùyóuzìzhǔ de huíyì qǐ tóngnián.
en: He always involuntarily recalls his childhood.

zh: 婚礼那天，新娘显得容光焕发。
pinyin: Hūnlǐ nèitiān, xīnniáng xiǎnde róngguānghuànfā.
en: On her wedding day, the bride appeared all smiles.

zh: 这次旅行我们一定要平安归来。
pinyin: zhè cì lǚ xíng wǒ men yī dìng yào píng ān guī lái
en: We must return safely from this trip.

zh: 外币涨价了，现在换钱不划算。
pinyin: wàibì zhǎngjià le, xiànzài huànqián bù huásuàn.
en: Foreign currency has appreciated, it is not cost-effective to exchange money now.

zh: 他把所有的钱都注在了比赛上。
pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu zhù zài le bǐsài shàng.
en: He staked all his money on the match.

zh: 由于工作出色，他获得了连任。
pinyin: Yóuyú gōngzuò chūsè, tā huòdé le liánrèn.
en: Due to excellent work, he obtained a second term.

zh: 人们讨厌那个国家的专制制度。
pinyin: Rénmen tǎoyàn nàge guójiā de zhuānzhì zhìdù.
en: People hate that country's autocratic system.

zh: 看来他在画画方面很有两下子。
pinyin: Kàn lái tā zài huà huà fāngmiàn hěn yǒu liǎng xià zi.
en: It seems he has real skill in painting.

zh: 长时间工作会引起颈部不舒服。
pinyin: cháng shíjiān gōngzuò huì yǐnqǐ jǐngbù bù shūfú.
en: Working for long hours can cause neck discomfort.

zh: 他吃了坏掉的鱼，就开始呕吐。
pinyin: Tā chī le huài diào de yú, jiù kāishǐ ǒutù.
en: He ate bad fish and started to vomit.

zh: 我们要向所有优秀的同志学习。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào xiàng suǒyǒu yōuxiù de tóngzhì xuéxí.
en: We must learn from all the outstanding comrades.

zh: 这条铁路是这个城市的生命线。
pinyin: zhè tiáo tiě lù shì zhè gè chéng shì de shēng mìng xiàn.
en: This railway is the lifeline of this city.

zh: 他把电脑里重复的资料都删了。
pinyin: Tā bǎ diànnǎo lǐ chóngfù de zīliào dōu shānle.
en: He deleted all the duplicate data in the computer.

zh: 这块石头在黑暗中依然会发光。
pinyin: zhè kuài shí tou zài hēi àn zhōng yī rán huì fā guāng.
en: This stone still emits light in the dark.

zh: 看到小猫受伤，我感到很痛心。
pinyin: Kàndào xiǎomāo shòushāng, wǒ gǎndào hěn tòngxīn.
en: I feel grieved to see the kitten injured.

zh: 医生正在研究胚胎的发育情况。
pinyin: Yīshēng zhèngzài yánjiū pēitāi de fāyù qíngkuàng.
en: The doctor is studying the development of the embryo.

zh: 这只是个特例，不能当作规则。
pinyin: Zhè zhǐ shì gè tè lì, bù néng dāng zuò guī zé.
en: This is just a special case and cannot be treated as a rule.

zh: 失败后再次尝试是天经地义的。
pinyin: Shībài hòu zàicì chángshì shì tiānjīngdìyì de.
en: Trying again after failure is a matter of course.

zh: 这些沼泽对生态平衡至关重要。
pinyin: Zhèxiē zhǎozé duì shēngtài pínghéng zhìguān zhòngyào.
en: These wetlands are crucial to the ecological balance.

zh: 你们这种解决问题的路子不对。
pinyin: Nǐmen zhè zhǒng jiějué wèntí de lùzi bú duì.
en: Your method for solving the problem is wrong.

zh: 爷爷把钓鱼的经验传授给了我。
pinyin: Yéye bǎ diàoyú de jīngyàn chuánshòu gěile wǒ.
en: Grandpa imparted his fishing experience to me.

zh: 我们公司非常看重员工的经验。
pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī fēicháng kànzhòng yuángōng de jīngyàn.
en: Our company attaches great importance to the experience of employees.

zh: 她那对弯弯的眉毛像月亮一样。
pinyin: tā nà duì wān wān de méi mao xiàng yuè liang yī yàng.
en: Her curved eyebrows look like the moon.

zh: 为了准备晚会，大家东奔西走。
pinyin: Wèile zhǔnbèi wǎnhuì, dàjiā dōngbēnxīzǒu.
en: Everyone is bustling about to prepare for the party.

zh: 我产生了一种似曾相识的错觉。
pinyin: wǒ chǎnshēngle yī zhǒng sìcéngxiāngshí de cuòjué.
en: I had an illusion of déjà vu.

zh: 他的报道十分客观，没有偏见。
pinyin: tā de bào dào shí fēn kè guān, méi yǒu piān jiàn.
en: His report is very impartial and free of bias.

zh: 他的演讲内容丰富，很有内涵。
pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng nèiróng fēngfù, hěn yǒu nèihán.
en: His speech is rich in content and meaningful.

zh: 大家都没想到他会爆冷门获胜。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu méi xiǎngdào tā huì bàolěngmén huòshèng.
en: No one expected him to pull off a coup and win.

zh: 考试时，我们要填充这些空格。
pinyin: Kǎoshì shí, wǒmen yào tiánchōng zhèxiē kònggé.
en: During the exam, we need to fill in these blanks.

zh: 灯光太耀眼，让我觉得不舒服。
pinyin: Dēngguāng tài yàoyǎn, ràng wǒ juéde bù shūfu.
en: The lights are too dazzling, making me feel uncomfortable.

zh: 秋天的风吹在身上感觉很凉爽。
pinyin: Qiūtiān de fēng chuī zài shēnshang gǎnjué hěn liángshuǎng.
en: The autumn breeze feels cool and refreshing on the body.

zh: 父母为女儿准备了丰厚的嫁妆。
pinyin: Fùmǔ wèi nǚ'ér zhǔnbèi le fēnghòu de jiàzhuang.
en: Parents prepared a generous dowry for their daughter.

zh: 这种石头非常坚硬，很难打碎。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shí tou fēicháng jiānyìng, hěn nán dǎsuì.
en: This kind of stone is very hard and difficult to break.

zh: 为了会议，他准备得非常周到。
pinyin: wèile huìyì, tā zhǔnbèi de fēicháng zhōudào.
en: He was very attentive in preparing for the meeting.

zh: 受伤后，他连腿都不能动弹了。
pinyin: Shòushāng hòu, tā lián tuǐ dōu bùnéng dòngtan le.
en: After the injury, he couldn't even budge his legs.

zh: 由于经常下雨，这里气候滋润。
pinyin: yóuyú jīngcháng xiàyǔ, zhèlǐ qìhòu zīrùn.
en: Due to frequent rain, the climate here is humid.

zh: 那个公园没有围墙，所以无边。
pinyin: Nàgè gōngyuán méiyǒu wéiqiáng, suǒyǐ wúbiān.
en: That park has no walls, so it is not bordered.

zh: 如果你赢了，就可以得到奖品。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yíng le, jiù kěyǐ dédào jiǎngpǐn.
en: If you win, you can get the prize.

zh: 年轻的僧人正在认真阅读经书。
pinyin: Niánqīng de sēngrén zhèngzài rènzhēn yuèdú jīngshū.
en: The young monk is reading scriptures carefully.

zh: 我还没来得及回复他的邀请函。
pinyin: Wǒ hái méi láidéjí huífù tā de yāoqǐng hán.
en: I haven't had the time to reply to his invitation letter yet.

zh: 发生了什么事，让你这么慌张？
pinyin: Fāshēng le shénme shì, ràng nǐ zhème huāngzhāng?
en: What happened to make you so agitated?

zh: 他作为发起人提出了这个想法。
pinyin: Tā zuòwéi fāqǐrén tíchūle zhège xiǎngfǎ.
en: As the proposer, he put forward this idea.

zh: 他用委婉的方式处理了这件事。
pinyin: Tā yòng wěiwǎn de fāngshì chǔlǐle zhè jiàn shì.
en: He handled this matter in a suave way.

zh: 由于搬家，我更改了我的住址。
pinyin: Yóuyú bānjiā, wǒ gēnggǎi le wǒ de zhùzhǐ.
en: Due to moving, I have changed my address.

zh: 这家公司的名誉在业内非常好。
pinyin: zhè jiā gōngsī de míngyù zài yè nèi fēicháng hǎo.
en: This company's reputation in the industry is very good.

zh: 不要担心，一切都会好起来的。
pinyin: Bù yào dānxīn, yīqiè dōu huì hǎo qǐlái de.
en: Don't worry, everything will be fine.

zh: 事后回想，那是个难忘的经历。
pinyin: shìhòu huíxiǎng, nà shì gè nánwàng de jīnglì.
en: In retrospect, that was an unforgettable experience.

zh: 我们要调节访问的频率和次数。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào tiáojié fǎngwèn de pínlǜ hé cì shù.
en: We need to adjust the frequency and occurrence of visits.

zh: 这次培训班招收了许多新学员。
pinyin: Zhè cì péixùnbān zhāoshōu le xǔduō xīn xuéyuán.
en: This training class recruited many new members of the institution.

zh: 他对于中国传统瓷器很有研究。
pinyin: Tā duìyú Zhōngguó chuántǒng cíqì hěn yǒu yánjiū.
en: He has done a lot of research on traditional Chinese porcelain.

zh: 工人正在用工具切割金属材料。
pinyin: gōngrén zhèngzài yòng gōngjù qiēgē jīnshǔ cáiliào.
en: The worker is using tools to cut metal materials.

zh: 邻居们齐心协力搬走了大石头。
pinyin: lín jū men qí xīn xié lì bān zǒu le dà shí tou.
en: The neighbors pulled together to move the large stone.

zh: 他掌管着这个城市的所有交通。
pinyin: Tā zhǎngguǎn zhe zhège chéngshì de suǒyǒu jiāotōng.
en: He controls all the traffic in this city.

zh: 他为了买房支付了高额的费用。
pinyin: Tā wèile mǎifáng zhīfù le gāo é de fèiyòng.
en: He paid a large amount of fees to buy a house.

zh: 这个药丸里药物的含量是多少？
pinyin: Zhège yàowán lǐ yàowù de hánliàng shì duōshǎo?
en: What is the quantity of medicine in this pill?

zh: 由于门铃坏了，我不得不敲门。
pinyin: Yóuyú ménlíng huài le, wǒ bùdébù qiāomén.
en: Because the doorbell was broken, I had to knock on the door.

zh: 这本书将相伴我度过这个夏天。
pinyin: zhè běn shū jiāng xiāng bàn wǒ dù guò zhè gè xià tiān.
en: This book will accompany me through this summer.

zh: 医生说那药里含有兴奋剂成分。
pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nà yào lǐ hányǒu xīngfènjì chéngfèn.
en: The doctor said the medicine contains stimulant ingredients.

zh: 这件事情或多或少对他有影响。
pinyin: zhè jiàn shì qing huò duō huò shǎo duì tā yǒu yǐng xiǎng.
en: This matter has more or less affected him.

zh: 他觉得接受这份礼物心安理得。
pinyin: Tā juéde jiēshòu zhè fèn lǐwù xīn'ānlǐdé.
