en: He feels no qualms about accepting this gift.

zh: 请务必在规定的时候提交报告。
pinyin: Qǐng wùbì zài guīdìng de shíhou tíjiāo bàogào.
en: Please ensure to submit the report at the specified time.

zh: 他发烧了，脸看起来红扑扑的。
pinyin: tā fāshāo le, liǎn kàn qǐlái hóngpūpū de.
en: He has a fever, and his face looks flushed.

zh: 这家饭馆的烤鸭特别原汁原味。
pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de kǎoyā tèbié yuán zhī yuán wèi.
en: The roast duck at this restaurant is especially authentic and original.

zh: 那位教授是这个领域里的泰斗。
pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu shì zhège lǐngyù lǐ de tàidǒu.
en: That professor is a leading authority in this field.

zh: 这次活动奠定了他成功的开始。
pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng diàndìng le tā chénggōng de kāishǐ.
en: This event established the beginning of his success.

zh: 这家出版社每年发行很多小说。
pinyin: Zhè jiā chū bǎn shè měi nián fā xíng hěn duō xiǎo shuō.
en: This publishing house publishes many novels every year.

zh: 我们必须无条件支持这个计划。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū wútiáojiàn zhīchí zhège jìhuà.
en: We must support this plan unconditionally.

zh: 那只小猫在他的手掌里睡着了。
pinyin: Nà zhī xiǎomāo zài tā de shǒuzhǎng lǐ shuìzháo le.
en: The kitten fell asleep in his palm.

zh: 这场比赛他自始至终都在努力。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài tā zì shǐ zhì zhōng dōu zài nǔlì.
en: He worked hard from start to finish in this match.

zh: 为了竞选成功，他准备了很久。
pinyin: wèile jìngxuǎn chénggōng, tā zhǔnbèi le hěnjiǔ.
en: He prepared for a long time to succeed in running for office.

zh: 这个简单的题目折腾了好几遍。
pinyin: zhè gè jiǎn dān de tí mù zhē teng le hǎo jǐ biàn.
en: This simple problem was reworked several times.

zh: 我们家习惯在腊月进行大扫除。
pinyin: Wǒ men jiā xí guàn zài là yuè jìn xíng dà sǎo chú.
en: Our family is accustomed to doing a big cleaning in the twelfth lunar month.

zh: 我说明白，但是说不上为什么。
pinyin: Wǒ shuō míngbai, dànshì shuō bu shàng wèishéme.
en: I can explain clearly, but I cannot say why.

zh: 听到这个消息，大家兴奋无比。
pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxī, dàjiā xīngfèn wúbǐ.
en: Hearing this news, everyone was incomparably excited.

zh: 他的肩膀很宽，看起来很有力。
pinyin: tā de jiānbǎng hěn kuān, kàn qǐlái hěn yǒulì.
en: His shoulders are broad, and he looks very strong.

zh: 医生点评了每个人的身体状况。
pinyin: Yī shēng diǎn píng le měi gè rén de shēn tǐ zhuàng kuàng.
en: The doctor provided a detailed assessment of everyone's physical condition.

zh: 这座城市里有很多天主教教堂。
pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì lǐ yǒu hěnduō tiān zhǔ jiào jiàotáng.
en: There are many Catholic churches in this city.

zh: 这段美丽的风景真是引人入胜。
pinyin: Zhè duàn měilì de fēngjǐng zhēnshi yǐn rén rù shèng.
en: This beautiful scenery is truly fascinating.

zh: 她精心挑选了一份礼物给老师。
pinyin: Tā jīngxīn tiāoxuǎn le yī fèn lǐwù gěi lǎoshī.
en: She carefully chose a gift for the teacher.

zh: 因为感冒，我的嗓子很不舒服。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gǎnmào, wǒ de sǎngzi hěn bù shūfu.
en: Because of a cold, my throat is very uncomfortable.

zh: 为了完成工作，我们需要提速。
pinyin: wèile wánchéng gōngzuò, wǒmen xūyào tí sù.
en: We need to speed up to finish the work.

zh: 这件事情我从未告诉过任何人。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqing wǒ cóngwèi gàosùguò rènhé rén.
en: I have never told anyone about this matter.

zh: 你不需要为了这些小事而自责。
pinyin: Nǐ bù xūyào wèile zhèxiē xiǎoshì ér zìzé.
en: You don't need to blame yourself for these small things.

zh: 因为做错事，他变得一无所有。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zuò cuòshì, tā biàn de yīwúsuǒyǒu.
en: Because he did the wrong thing, he became destitute.

zh: 大家在草地上尽情地唱歌跳舞。
pinyin: Dàjiā zài cǎodì shàng jìnqíng de chànggē tiàowǔ.
en: Everyone sang and danced to their hearts' content on the grass.

zh: 他发表了一篇关于电影的批判。
pinyin: tā fābiǎo le yī piān guānyú diànyǐng de pīpàn.
en: He published a critique about the movie.

zh: 这个谜题太怪了，没人能解开。
pinyin: Zhège mítí tài guài le, méi rén néng jiěkāi.
en: This puzzle is too bewildering; nobody can solve it.

zh: 我们要去外面宣扬环保的意义。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào qù wàimiàn xuānyáng huánbǎo de yìyì.
en: We want to go outside to publicize the significance of environmental protection.

zh: 我们无法判断那个消息的真假。
pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ pànduàn nàge xiāoxi de zhēn jiǎ.
en: We cannot judge whether that news is true or false.

zh: 长期工作导致了他患上职业病。
pinyin: Chángqī gōngzuò dǎozhì le tā huànshàngshàng zhíyèbìng.
en: Long-term work caused him to suffer from an occupational disease.

zh: 她事事操心，难免会感到疲惫。
pinyin: Tā shìshì cāoxīn, nánmiǎn huì gǎndào píbèi.
en: She worries about everything, so it is inevitable that she feels exhausted.

zh: 看到英雄回来，人们纷纷叫好。
pinyin: kàndào yīngxióng huílái, rénmen fēnfēn jiàohǎo.
en: Seeing the hero return, people cheered one after another.

zh: 数学课上我们讨论了逻辑命题。
pinyin: Shùxué kè shàng wǒmen tǎolùn le luójí mìngtí.
en: We discussed logical propositions in math class.

zh: 几年不见，家乡简直翻天覆地。
pinyin: Jǐ nián bùjiàn, jiāxiāng jiǎnzhí fāntiānfùdì.
en: After not seeing it for a few years, my hometown is turned upside down.

zh: 由于长途旅行，他很快酣睡了。
pinyin: yóuyú chángtú lǚxíng, tā hěn kuài hānshuì le.
en: Due to the long journey, he quickly fell into a deep sleep.

zh: 那个伯父在公园里练习太极拳。
pinyin: Nàge bófù zài gōngyuán lǐ liànxí tàijíquán.
en: That gentleman is practicing Tai Chi in the park.

zh: 话务员没能帮我接通那个部门。
pinyin: Huàwùyuán méinéng bāng wǒ jiētōng nàge bùmén.
en: The operator failed to put me through to that department.

zh: 经过一年，他变得截然不同了。
pinyin: Jīngguò yī nián, tā biàn de jiéránbùtóng le.
en: After a year, he has become entirely different.

zh: 他正在窗口察看外面是否有雨。
pinyin: Tā zhèngzài chuāngkǒu chákàn wàimiàn shìfǒu yǒu yǔ.
en: He is watching from the window to see if it is raining outside.

zh: 体育课的目标是增强学生体质。
pinyin: Tǐyù kè de mùbiāo shì zēngqiáng xuéshēng tǐzhì.
en: The goal of P.E. class is to strengthen students' physical fitness.

zh: 他喜欢用通俗的例子解释问题。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuān yòng tōngsú de lìzi jiěshì wèntí.
en: He likes to use everyday examples to explain problems.

zh: 旅游景点门前的游客络绎不绝。
pinyin: Lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn ménqián de yóukè luòyìbùjué.
en: There is a continuous flow of tourists in front of the tourist attraction entrance.

zh: 每个人都知道开天辟地的传说。
pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu zhīdào kāitiānpìdì de chuánshuō.
en: Everyone knows the legend of the creation of the world.

zh: 离开教室前，请记得关掉空调。
pinyin: Líkāi jiàoshì qián, qǐng jìde guāndiào kòngtiáo.
en: Please remember to turn off the air conditioner before leaving the classroom.

zh: 那个孩子受惊以后，一直在哭。
pinyin: Nàge háizi shòujīng yǐhòu, yīzhí zài kū.
en: That child has been crying ever since he was startled.

zh: 家属在医院领取了亲人的遗体。
pinyin: Jiāshǔ zài yīyuàn lǐngqǔ le qīnrén de yítǐ.
en: The family members claimed their relative's remains at the hospital.

zh: 操场上到处是同学们的嬉笑声。
pinyin: Cāochǎng shàng dàochù shì tóngxuémen de xīxiào shēng.
en: The playground is filled with the sound of students laughing and playing.

zh: 为了国家，烈士们付出了生命。
pinyin: Wèile guójiā, lièshìmen fùchūle shēngmìng.
en: For the country, the martyrs gave their lives.

zh: 我们应该正确地看待人工智能。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zhèngquè de kàndài réngōng zhìnéng.
en: We should view artificial intelligence correctly.

zh: 好在考试不难，大家都通过了。
pinyin: hǎo zài kǎo shì bù nán, dà jiā dōu tōng guò le.
en: Fortunately the exam wasn't hard, everyone passed.

zh: 由于工资很低，他买不起房子。
pinyin: Yóuyú gōngzī hěn dī, tā mǎi bu qǐ fángzi.
en: Because the salary is very low, he cannot afford a house.

zh: 我宁愿听实话，也不想被欺骗。
pinyin: Wǒ nìngyuàn tīng shíhuà, yě bùxiǎng bèi qīpiàn.
en: I would rather hear the truth than be deceived.

zh: 为了减少噪音，我们关了窗户。
pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo zàoyīn, wǒmen guānle chuānghu.
en: To reduce the noise, we closed the windows.

zh: 这个故事源于一个古老的传说。
pinyin: Zhège gùshì yuányú yīgè gǔlǎo de chuánshuō.
en: This story originates from an ancient legend.

zh: 我们要向他学习，以他为榜样。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào xiàng tā xuéxí, yǐ tā wèi bǎngyàng.
en: We should learn from him and take him as an example.

zh: 为了梦想，他去了遥远的城市。
pinyin: Wèile mèngxiǎng, tā qùle yáoyuǎn de chéngshì.
en: For his dream, he went to a distant city.

zh: 雨后的泥土散发出清新的气息。
pinyin: Yǔhòu de nítǔ sànfā chū qīngxīn de qìxī.
en: The soil after the rain gives off a fresh scent.

zh: 虽然下雨了，但他照常去跑步。
pinyin: Suīrán xiàyǔ le, dàn tā zhàocháng qù pǎobù.
en: Although it is raining, he goes running as usual.

zh: 他不应该在关键时刻犹豫不决。
pinyin: tā bù yīng gāi zài guān jiàn shí kè yóu yù bù jué.
en: He should not waver at critical moments.

zh: 妈妈已经把饭菜摆在餐桌上了。
pinyin: mā ma yǐ jīng bǎ fàn cài bǎi zài cān zhuō shàng le.
en: Mom has already set the food on the dining table.

zh: 他虽然侃大山，但是没有恶意。
pinyin: Tā suīrán kǎn dàshān, dànshì méiyǒu èyì.
en: Although he boasts, he has no ill intent.

zh: 这家商店经常出卖过期的食品。
pinyin: zhè jiā shāngdiàn jīngcháng chūmài guòqī de shípǐn.
en: This shop often offers expired food for sale.

zh: 护士正在给病人包扎受伤的腿。
pinyin: hù shì zhèng zài gěi bìng rén bāo zā shòu shāng de tuǐ.
en: The nurse is bandaging the patient's injured leg.

zh: 这幅画展现了一个热闹的画面。
pinyin: Zhè fú huà zhǎnxiànle yīgè rènào de huàmiàn.
en: This painting shows a lively tableau.

zh: 他为了买游戏机攒了很久的钱。
pinyin: Tā wèile mǎi yóuxìjī zǎnle hěnjiǔ de qián.
en: He saved money for a long time to buy a video game console.

zh: 我随手撕开了那个厚厚的信封。
pinyin: wǒ suí shǒu sī kāi le nà gè hòu hòu de xìn fēng.
en: I casually tore open that thick envelope.

zh: 他决定去旅行，过潇洒的生活。
pinyin: Tā juédìng qù lǚxíng, guò xiāosǎ de shēnghuó.
en: He decided to travel and live a free and easy life.

zh: 他的回答让大家感到出人意料。
pinyin: tā de huídá ràng dàjiā gǎndào chū rén yì liào.
en: His answer made everyone feel surprised.

zh: 老师向取得好成绩的学生庆贺。
pinyin: Lǎoshī xiàng qǔdé hǎo chéngjī de xuéshēng qìnghè.
en: The teacher congratulated the students who got good grades.

zh: 做鱼的时候，放点姜可以去腥。
pinyin: Zuò yú de shíhòu, fàng diǎn jiāng kěyǐ qù xīng.
en: When cooking fish, adding some ginger can remove the fishy smell.

zh: 只有实事求是，才能找到答案。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu shí shì qiú shì, cáinéng zhǎodào dá'àn.
en: Only by seeking truth from facts can we find the answer.

zh: 工人们夜以继日地修建这座桥。
pinyin: gōng rén men yè yǐ jì rì de xiū jiàn zhè zuò qiáo.
en: The workers are building this bridge day and night.

zh: 这种新产品得到了大家的好评。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīn chǎnpǐn dédàole dàjiā de hǎopíng.
en: This new product received favorable criticism from everyone.

zh: 这两份计划书的内容大同小异。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng fèn jìhuàshū de nèiróng dàtóngxiǎoyì.
en: The contents of these two proposals differ only in small points.

zh: 在那时，人们很看重门当户对。
pinyin: Zài nà shí, rénmen hěn kànzhòng méndānghùduì.
en: At that time, people valued families being well-matched in social status.

zh: 他们态度非常诚挚，欢迎大家。
pinyin: Tāmen tàidù fēicháng chéngzhì, huānyíng dàjiā.
en: Their attitude is very cordial; they welcome everyone.

zh: 我们要一鼓作气，把作业写完。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào yī gǔ zuò qì, bǎ zuòyè xiě wán.
en: We should finish our homework in one go with a spurt of energy.

zh: 如果觉得冷，就把空调关掉吧。
pinyin: rú guǒ jué de lěng, jiù bǎ kōng tiáo guān diào ba.
en: If you feel cold, just turn off the air conditioning.

zh: 夏天，公园里的叶子非常茂密。
pinyin: Xiàtiān, gōngyuán lǐ de yèzi fēicháng màomì.
en: In summer, the leaves in the park are very lush.

zh: 他很难鉴别这两张照片的真假。
pinyin: Tā hěn nán jiànbié zhè liǎng zhāng zhà zhāng zhàopiàn de zhēn jiǎ.
en: It is difficult for him to differentiate the authenticity of these two photos.

zh: 他大叫一声，发泄心中的不满。
pinyin: Tā dàjiào yīshēng, fāxiè xīnlǐ de bùmǎn.
en: He let out a loud shout to vent his dissatisfaction.

zh: 这张地图上的铁路线纵横交错。
pinyin: zhè zhāng dì tú shàng de tiě lù xiàn zòng héng jiāo cuò.
en: The railway lines on this map are criss-crossed.

zh: 他总喜欢穿一些新潮的运动鞋。
pinyin: Tā zǒng xǐhuān chuān yīxiē xīncháo de yùndòngxié.
en: He always likes to wear fashionable sneakers.

zh: 她好心送给我一件漂亮的衣服。
pinyin: Tā hǎoxīn sòng gěi wǒ yī jiàn piàoliang de yīfú.
en: She kindly gave me a beautiful piece of clothing.

zh: 由于非常难过，她不断地呜咽。
pinyin: yóuyú fēicháng nánguò, tā bùduàn de wūyè.
en: Due to being very sad, she sobbed continuously.

zh: 他去邮局，顺便帮我寄了包裹。
pinyin: Tā qù yóujú, shùnbiàn bāng wǒ jì le bāoguǒ.
en: He went to the post office and conveniently mailed a package for me.

zh: 虽然很困难，但他还是取胜了。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn kùnnán, dàn tā háishì qǔshèng le.
en: Although it was difficult, he still scored a victory.

zh: 他脑海里闪过一个疯狂的念头。
pinyin: Tā nǎohǎi lǐ shǎnguò yī gè fēngkuáng de niàntou.
en: A crazy thought flashed through his mind.

zh: 为了演出，我们每天都在排练。
pinyin: wèi le yǎn chū, wǒ men měi tiān dōu zài pái liàn.
en: For the performance, we are rehearsing every day.

zh: 这个消息让我们感到难以置信。
pinyin: Zhège xiāoxī ràng wǒmen gǎndào nányǐzhìxìn.
en: This news makes us feel it is hard to believe.

zh: 为了成功，我们需要与时俱进。
pinyin: wèile chénggōng, wǒmen xūyào yǔ shí jù jìn.
en: To succeed, we need to keep up with the times.

zh: 考试在周五，届时请带好铅笔。
pinyin: Kǎoshì zài zhōuwǔ, jièshí qǐng dài hǎo qiānbǐ.
en: The exam is on Friday; please bring your pencil when the time comes.

zh: 他的心里布满了对家乡的思念。
pinyin: tā de xīnlǐ bùmǎnle duì jiāxiāng de sīniàn.
en: His heart is filled with longing for his hometown.

zh: 因为要迟到了，他显得很慌乱。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yào chídàole, tā xiǎndé hěn huāngluàn.
en: Because he was going to be late, he appeared very hurried.

zh: 我们要学会独立自主处理事情。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào xuéhuì dúlì zìzhǔ chǔlǐ shìqíng.
en: We must learn to maintain control over our own affairs.

zh: 网线纠缠在一起，乱七八糟的。
pinyin: wǎng xiàn jiū chán zài yī qǐ, luàn qī bā zāo de.
en: The internet cables are in a tangle, all messy.

zh: 这些课程的学时安排非常紧凑。
pinyin: Zhèxiē kèchéng de xuéshí ānpái fēicháng jǐncòu.
en: The class hour arrangement for these courses is very tight.

zh: 她在方方面面表现得都很优秀。
pinyin: Tā zài fāngfāngmiànmiàn biǎoxiàn de dōu hěn yōuxiù.
en: She performs excellently in every aspect.

zh: 翻译时脱落了一个重要的细节。
pinyin: Fānyì shí tuōluò le yīgè zhòngyào de xìjié.
en: An important detail was omitted during the translation.

zh: 我国东边的沿海地区气候适宜。
pinyin: Wǒguó dōngbian de yánhǎi dìqū qìhòu shìyí.
en: The climate in the coastal areas of the eastern part of our country is suitable.

zh: 本期培训班招收了五十名学生。
pinyin: běn qī péi xùn bān zhāo shōu le wǔ shí míng xué shēng.
en: This term's training class enrolled fifty students.

zh: 这栋楼的高度高于周围的房子。
pinyin: Zhè dòng lóu de gāodù gāoyú zhōuwéi de fángzi.
en: The height of this building exceeds the surrounding houses.

zh: 经理体谅我的困难，给了假期。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ tǐliàng wǒ de kùnnán, gěile jiàqī.
en: The manager showed understanding of my difficulty and granted leave.

zh: 为了考试，他进行了严峻的练习。
pinyin: wèi le kǎo shì, tā jìn xíng le yán jùn de liàn xí.
en: He performed rigorous practice for the exam.

zh: 这种家禽产出的鸡蛋质量非常高。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiāqín chǎnchū de jī dàn zhìliàng fēicháng gāo.
en: The hen's eggs produced by this poultry are of very high quality.

zh: 大家讨论了天气、旅游诸如此类。
pinyin: Dàjiā tǎolùnle tiānqì, lǚyóu zhūrúcǐlèi.
en: Everyone discussed the weather, travel, and the rest.

zh: 他听说老校长逝世了，非常难过。
pinyin: tā tīng shuō lǎo xiào zhǎng shì shì le，fēi cháng nán guò。
en: He was very sad to hear that the old principal had passed away.

zh: 不能总是守株待兔，要自己努力。
pinyin: bù néng zǒng shì shǒu zhū dài tù ， yào zì jǐ nǔ lì 。
en: One cannot always trust to chance, one must work hard.

zh: 老师先讲课，进而让我们做练习。
pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān jiǎngkè, jìn'ér ràng wǒmen zuò liànxí.
en: The teacher gives a lecture first, and then lets us do exercises.

zh: 为了家人的健康，他每天都祈祷。
pinyin: Wèile jiārén de jiànkāng, tā měitiān dōu qídǎo.
en: For the health of his family, he prays every day.

zh: 他在比赛中表现出了极好的口才。
pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn chūle jí hǎo de kǒucái.
en: He showed excellent eloquence in the competition.

zh: 在陌生的城市，我感到有点孤独。
pinyin: zài mòshēng de chéngshì, wǒ gǎndào yǒudiǎn gūdú.
en: In a strange city, I feel a little lonely.

zh: 他一直很细心，难怪他很少犯错。
pinyin: tā yī zhí hěn xì xīn, nán guài tā hěn shǎo fàn cuò.
en: He is always careful, it is not surprising that he rarely makes mistakes.

zh: 这个好消息让众人感到非常高兴。
pinyin: Zhège hǎo xiāoxi ràng zhòngrén gǎndào fēicháng gāoxìng.
en: This good news made everyone feel very happy.

zh: 你已经迟到了，况且还没带课本。
pinyin: Nǐ yǐjīng chídàole, kuàngqiě hái méi dài kèběn.
en: You are already late, besides you didn't bring the textbook.

zh: 这台机器已经报废，不能再用了。
pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì yǐjīng bàofèi, bùnéng zài yòng le.
en: This machine has been scrapped and cannot be used anymore.

zh: 他的身体素质因为生病而减弱了。
pinyin: tā de shēntǐ sùzhì yīnwèi shēngbìng ér jiǎnruò le.
en: His physical fitness has weakened due to illness.

zh: 起初，我以为这是一件容易的事。
pinyin: Qǐchū, wǒ yǐwéi zhè shì yī jiàn róngyì de shì.
en: Originally, I thought this was an easy task.

zh: 改革开放促进了社会主义的发展。
pinyin: Gǎigé kāifàng cùjìnle shè huì zhǔ yì de fāzhǎn.
en: Reform and opening up promoted the development of socialism.

zh: 虽然有很多波折，但是他成功了。
pinyin: suī rán yǒu hěn duō bō zhé, dàn shì tā chéng gōng le.
en: Although there were many twists and turns, he succeeded.

zh: 为了赶上火车，他只能争分夺秒。
pinyin: wèile gǎnshàng huǒchē, tā zhǐnéng zhēngfēnduómiǎo.
en: To catch the train, he has to make every second count.

zh: 在这个城市，一个新生命诞生了。
pinyin: Zài zhège chéngshì, yī gè xīn shēngmìng dànshēng le.
en: A new life was born in this city.

zh: 你不能总是自私自利，只顾自己。
pinyin: nǐ bù néng zǒng shì zì sī zì lì, zhǐ gù zì jǐ.
en: You cannot always be focused only on your own selfish profit.

zh: 虽然异口同声，但他们想的不同。
pinyin: Suīrán yì kǒu tóng shēng, dàn tāmen xiǎng de bùtóng.
en: Although they have different mouths, they think differently.

zh: 这儿距离目的地差不多五十公里。
pinyin: Zhèr jùlí mùdìdì chàbùduō wǔshí gōnglǐ.
en: The destination is nearly fifty kilometers from here.

zh: 心里有事，我翻来覆去睡不着觉。
pinyin: xīnlǐ yǒu shì, wǒ fān lái fù qù shuì bù zháo jiào.
en: With something on my mind, I tossed and turned and couldn't fall asleep.

zh: 大家都很关心那个节目的收视率。
pinyin: dà jiā dōu hěn guān xīn nà gè jié mù de shōu shì lù.
en: Everyone is very concerned about that program's ratings.

zh: 这个问题没有更好的门路解决了。
pinyin: Zhè ge wèntí méiyǒu gèng hǎo de ménlù jiějué le.
en: There is no better way to solve this problem.

zh: 他用足智多谋的计策解决了问题。
pinyin: Tā yòng zúzhìduōmóu de jìcè jiějuéle wèntí.
en: He solved the problem using a stratagem full of wisdom.

zh: 这两个国家为了安全组成了同盟。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè guójiā wèile ānquán zǔchéng le tóngméng.
en: These two countries formed an alliance for security.

zh: 他因为表现好，就任了这个职位。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi biǎoxiàn hǎo, jiùrèn le zhège zhíwèi.
en: Because of his good performance, he assumed this post.

zh: 为了节日，他们做了隆重的安排。
pinyin: Wèile jiérì, tāmen zuòle lóngzhòng de ānpái.
en: For the festival, they made ceremonious arrangements.

zh: 这些习惯无形中改变了我的生活。
pinyin: Zhèxiē xíguàn wúxíngzhōng gǎibiànle wǒ de shēnghuó.
en: These habits imperceptibly changed my life.

zh: 如果你感到高兴，就吹个口哨吧。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ gǎndào gāoxìng, jiù chuī gè kǒushào ba.
en: If you feel happy, whistle a tune.

zh: 昨晚的雷声很大，让我提心吊胆。
pinyin: Zuówǎn de léishēng hěn dà, ràng wǒ tí xīn diào dǎn.
en: The thunder was very loud last night, making me nervous.

zh: 警察正在公园里搜寻失踪的孩子。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zhèngzài gōngyuán lǐ sōuxún shīzōng de háizi.
en: The police are searching for the missing child in the park.

zh: 大家都非常期待奥运会的开幕式。
pinyin: dà jiā dōu fēi cháng qī dài ào yùn huì de kāi mù shì.
en: Everyone is looking forward to the opening ceremony of the Olympic Games.

zh: 他非常喜欢研究不同的烹调方法。
pinyin: Tā fēicháng xǐhuān yánjiū bùtóng de pēngtiáo fāngfǎ.
en: He likes researching different cooking methods very much.

zh: 他每个月都会在这个专栏写文章。
pinyin: Tā měi gè yuè dōu huì zài zhè gè zhuān lán xiě wén zhāng.
en: He writes articles in this column every month.

zh: 老师教导我们树立正确的价值观。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jiàodǎo wǒmen shùlì zhèngquè de jiàzhíguān.
en: The teacher taught us to establish correct values.

zh: 因为伙食太差，他决定去外面吃。
pinyin: Yīnwèi huǒshí tài chà, tā juédìng qù wàimiàn chī.
en: Because the food was too bad, he decided to eat outside.

zh: 作为一个法官，他必须大公无私。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yīgè fǎguān, tā bìxū dàgōngwúsī.
en: As a judge, he must be impartial.

zh: 电影里的那个人表现得非常冷酷。
pinyin: diàn yǐng lǐ de nà gè rén biǎo xiàn dé fēi cháng lěng kù.
en: The person in the movie acts very unfeeling.

zh: 通过努力，他终于有了一技之长。
pinyin: Tōngguò nǔlì, tā zhōngyú yǒule yī jì zhī cháng.
en: Through hard work, he finally has proficiency in a particular field.

zh: 这家饭店的服务媲美五星级酒店。
pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn de fúwù pìměi wǔxīngjí jiǔdiàn.
en: The service at this restaurant is comparable to a five-star hotel.

zh: 这个浏览器下载文件的速度很快。
pinyin: Zhè ge liú lǎn qì xià zài wén jiàn de sù dù hěn kuài.
en: This browser downloads files very quickly.

zh: 他总是在大家面前标榜他的工作。
pinyin: tā zǒng shì zài dà jiā miàn qián biāo bǎng tā de gōng zuò.
en: He is always parading his work in front of everyone.

zh: 他们终于走到了这段旅程的终点。
pinyin: Tāmen zhōngyú zǒudào le zhè duàn lǚchéng de zhōngdiǎn.
en: They finally reached the end of this journey.

zh: 我在海边捡到了一个漂亮的贝壳。
pinyin: Wǒ zài hǎi biān jiǎn dào le yī gè piào liang de bèi ké.
en: I picked up a beautiful shell at the seaside.

zh: 那个国家曾深受帝国主义的侵略。
pinyin: nà gè guó jiā céng shēn shòu dì guó zhǔ yì de qīn lüè.
en: That country once suffered deeply from the aggression of imperialism.

zh: 他的创新思路得到了专家的认可。
pinyin: Tā de chuàngxīn sīlù dédàole zhuānjiā de rènkě.
en: His innovative line of thought received recognition from the experts.

zh: 他出色地完成了这次艰巨的任务。
pinyin: Tā chūsè de wánchéngle zhè cì jiānjù de rènwu.
en: He brilliantly completed this arduous mission.

zh: 他想借助这次机会提高汉语水平。
pinyin: Tā xiǎng jièzhù zhè cì jīhuì tígāo Hànyǔ shuǐpíng.
en: He wants to draw support from this opportunity to improve his Chinese level.

zh: 他不应该对别人的痛苦感到麻木。
pinyin: tā bù yīnggāi duì biérén de tòngkǔ gǎndào mámù.
en: He shouldn't be insensitive to others' pain.

zh: 如果有机会，欢迎你到我家做客。
pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu jīhuì, huānyíng nǐ dào wǒ jiā zuòkè.
en: If there is an opportunity, you are welcome to be a guest at my home.

zh: 他们准备举办一场世界级的比赛。
pinyin: Tāmen zhǔnbèi jǔbàn yī chǎng shìjièjí de bǐsài.
en: They are preparing to hold a world-class competition.

zh: 他书桌上的文件总是横七竖八的。
pinyin: Tā shūzhuō shàng de wénjiàn zǒngshì héngqīshùbā de.
en: The documents on his desk are always at sixes and sevens.

zh: 我感到非常荣幸能参加这次会议。
pinyin: Wǒ gǎn dào fēicháng róngxìng néng cānjiā zhè cì huìyì.
en: I feel very honored to attend this meeting.

zh: 我们非常赞赏这位艺术家的才华。
pinyin: Wǒmen fēicháng zànshǎng zhè wèi yìshùjiā de cáihuá.
en: We deeply admire this artist's talent.

zh: 这项工作非常艰巨，但我会努力。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò fēicháng jiānjù, dàn wǒ huì nǔlì.
en: This task is very arduous, but I will work hard.

zh: 学校派遣了几名老师去参加会议。
pinyin: Xuéxiào pàiqiǎn le jǐ míng lǎoshī qù cānjiā huìyì.
en: The school sent several teachers to attend the meeting.

zh: 年轻人不应该无所事事地过日子。
pinyin: Niánqīngrén bù yīnggāi wúsuǒshìshì de guò rìzi.
en: Young people should not idle their time away.

zh: 既然你已经归来，我们就出发吧。
pinyin: jìrán nǐ yǐjīng guīlái, wǒmen jiù chū chūfā ba.
en: Since you have come back, let us set off.

zh: 我们一起去爬山，然后到达山顶。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīqǐ qù páshān, ránhòu dàodá shāndǐng.
en: We went hiking together and then reached the hilltop.

zh: 无论有什么借口，你都应该道歉。
pinyin: Wúlùn yǒu shé me jièkǒu, nǐ dōu yīnggāi dàoqiàn.
en: No matter what excuse you have, you should apologize.

zh: 这种感觉好比回到家里一样舒服。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng gǎnjué hǎobǐ huíd huí dào jiālǐ yīyàng shūfu.
en: This feeling is just like being as comfortable as returning home.

zh: 大家看到比赛结果，都大吃一惊。
pinyin: Dàjiā kàndào bǐsài jiéguǒ, dōu dà chī yī jīng.
en: Everyone was astounded when they saw the competition results.

zh: 会议推迟了，也就是说时间改了。
pinyin: Huìyì tuīchí le, yě jiù shì shuō shíjiān gǎi le.
en: The meeting is postponed, that is to say the time has changed.

zh: 虽然他很有钱，但不必盛气凌人。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn yǒu qián, dàn búbì shèngqìlíngrén.
en: Although he is rich, he doesn't have to be overbearing.

zh: 他失去了工作，感到生活很空虚。
pinyin: Tā shīqù le gōngzuò, gǎndào shēnghuó hěn kōngxū.
en: He lost his job and feels emptiness in his life.

zh: 班级氛围对学生的成长至关重要。
pinyin: Bānjí fēnwéi duì xuésheng de chéngzhǎng zhǎng de chéngzhǎng zhìguān zhòngyào.
en: The class atmosphere is crucial for the students' growth.

zh: 坏天气迫使他们取消了旅游计划。
pinyin: Huài tiānqì pòshǐ tāmen qǔxiāo le lǚyóu jìhuà.
en: Bad weather forced them to cancel their travel plans.

zh: 他们决定建立一家新的合资企业。
pinyin: Tāmen juédìng jiànlì yījiā xīn de hézī qǐyè.
en: They decided to establish a new joint venture enterprise.

zh: 医生认为这只是一个简单的个案。
pinyin: Yīshēng rènwéi zhè zhǐshì yīgè jiǎndān de gè'àn.
en: The doctor thinks this is just a simple individual case.

zh: 我们应该齐心协力一起解决困难。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi qíxīnxiélì yīqǐ jiějué kùnnán.
en: We should work together as one to solve the difficulties.

zh: 大家都很敬业，一定要努力工作。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu hěn jìngyè, yídìng yào nǔlì gōngzuò.
en: Everyone is very dedicated to their work; we must work hard.

zh: 他不爱随大溜，总是自己做决定。
pinyin: Tā bú ài suí dà liù, zǒng shì zìjǐ zuò juédìng.
en: He doesn't like going with the tide; he always makes his own decisions.

zh: 这种事情在这里早已司空见惯了。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shìqing zài zhèlǐ zǎoyǐ sīkōngjiànguàn le.
en: Things like this are already common occurrences here.

zh: 他只会卖弄，其实没什么真本事。
pinyin: Tā zhǐ huì màinong, qíshí méishénme zhēn běnshì.
en: He only knows how to show off; in fact, he has no real skills.

zh: 这件事的情况，大家都不得而知。
pinyin: zhè jiàn shì de qíngkuàng, dàjiā dōu bù dé ér zhī.
en: The situation of this matter is unknown to everyone.

zh: 只要你坚持不懈，就一定能成功。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchíbùxiè, jiù yīdìng néng chénggōng.
en: As long as you persevere unremittingly, you will definitely succeed.

zh: 他们准备动身开始这次长途旅行。
pinyin: Tāmen zhǔnbèi dòngshēn kāishǐ zhè cì chángtú lǚxíng.
en: They are preparing to set off on this long journey.

zh: 在这个国家，服兵役不是自愿的。
pinyin: Zài zhège guójiā, fú bīngyì búshì zìyuàn de.
en: In this country, military service is not voluntary.

zh: 在朋友面前，我们应该坦白交流。
pinyin: Zài péngyǒu miànqián, wǒmen yīnggāi tǎnbái jiāoliú.
en: In front of friends, we should be forthcoming and communicate.

zh: 除了足球，他对棒球也很有兴趣。
pinyin: Chúle zúqiú, tā duì bàngqiú yě hěn yǒu xìngqù.
en: Besides soccer, he is also very interested in baseball.

zh: 每个国家都应该尊重别国的主权。
pinyin: Měi gè guójiā dōu yīnggāi zūnzhòng biéguó de zhǔquán.
en: Every country should respect the sovereignty of other countries.

zh: 这些研究人员走在科技的第一线。
pinyin: Zhèxiē yánjiū rényuán zǒu zài kējì de dì yī xiàn.
en: These researchers are at the forefront of science and technology.

zh: 我们要保护学校周围的生态环境。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎohù xuéxiào zhōuwéi de shēngtài huánjìng.
en: We must protect the ecological environment around the school.

zh: 在这个城市工作，大家都得吃苦。
pinyin: Zài zhège chéngshì gōngzuò, dàjiā dōu děi chīkǔ.
en: Working in this city, everyone has to endure hardships.

zh: 他因为孤陋寡闻，看问题很片面。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi gūlòuguǎwén, kàn wèntí hěn piànmiàn.
en: Because he is ill-informed and narrow-minded, he sees problems very one-sidedly.

zh: 为了买礼物，我攒了一些私房钱。
pinyin: Wèile mǎi lǐwù, wǒ zǎnle yīxiē sīfángqián.
en: To buy a gift, I saved up some secret purse money.

zh: 倘若你想成功，就必须努力工作。
pinyin: tǎng ruò nǐ xiǎng chéng gōng, jiù bì xū nǔ lì gōng zuò.
en: If you want to succeed, you must work hard.

zh: 看到那张照片，他终于恍然大悟。
pinyin: Kàndào nà zhāng zhàopiàn, tā zhōngyú huǎngrán-dàwù.
en: Seeing that photo, he finally suddenly realized.

zh: 他理直气壮地解释了自己的想法。
pinyin: Tā lǐ zhí qì zhuàng de jiěshìle zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
en: He explained his ideas with the courage of his convictions.

zh: 你为什么对这件事这么好奇心重？
pinyin: Nǐ wèishéme duì zhè jiàn shì zhème hào qí xīn zhòng?
en: Why are you so inquisitive about this matter?

zh: 面对这个问题，我感到无能为力。
pinyin: Miàn duì zhè gè wèn tí, wǒ gǎn dào wú néng wéi lì.
en: Faced with this problem, I feel powerless.

zh: 他极力想把这个好消息告诉大家。
pinyin: Tā jílì xiǎng bǎ zhège hǎo xiāoxi gàosù dàjiā.
en: He wants to tell everyone the good news at all costs.

zh: 他学习成绩不好，所以打算退学。
pinyin: Tā xuéxí chéngjì bù hǎo, suǒyǐ dǎsuàn tuìxué.
en: His academic performance is not good, so he plans to quit school.

zh: 这些奴隶被迫在农场里辛苦工作。
pinyin: Zhèxiē núlì bèi pò zài nóngchǎng lǐ xīnkǔ gōngzuò.
en: These slaves were forced to work hard on the farm.

zh: 他用非常有友情的态度对待客人。
pinyin: Tā yòng fēicháng yǒu yǒuqíng de tàidù duìdài kèrén.
en: He treats guests with very friendly feelings.

zh: 冬天有了瑞雪，明年会有好收成。
pinyin: Dōngtiān yǒu le ruìxuě, míngnián huì yǒu hǎo shōucheng.
en: With timely snow in winter, there will be a good harvest next year.

zh: 因为时间不够，他显得有些忙乱。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān bùgòu, tā xiǎnde yǒuxiē mángluàn.
en: Because there wasn't enough time, he appeared a bit rushed and muddled.

zh: 我们要修理围栏，这是亡羊补牢。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào xiūlǐ wéilán, zhè shì wángyángbǔláo.
en: We need to fix the fence, this is mending the pen after sheep are lost.

zh: 我们没准儿会在那个会议上碰面。
pinyin: wǒmen méizhǔnr huì zài nàge huìyì shàng pèngmiàn.
en: We might happen to meet at that meeting.

zh: 他作为老干部，对年轻人很照顾。
pinyin: Tā zuòwéi lǎo gànbù, duì niánqīng rén hěn zhàogù.
en: As a venerable veteran cadre, he takes good care of the young people.

zh: 医生说这种感冒的感染力比较大。
pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhè zhǒng gǎnmào de gǎnrǎnlì bǐjiào dà.
en: The doctor says this cold has high infectiousness.

zh: 这个商店的店员很少和客人交涉。
pinyin: Zhège shāngdiàn de diànyuán hěn shǎo hé kèrén jiāoshè.
en: The clerks in this store rarely have dealings with customers.

zh: 他走路时不经意地踩到了我的脚。
pinyin: Tā zǒulù shí bùjīngyì de cǎidàole wǒ de jiǎo.
en: He stepped on my foot by accident while walking.

zh: 因为严重的赤字，这家店关门了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yánzhòng de chìzì, zhè jiā diàn guānmén le.
en: Because of a serious deficit, this shop closed down.

zh: 比赛以后，他觉得自己是个输家。
pinyin: Bǐsài yǐhòu, tā juéde zìjǐ shì gè shūjiā.
en: After the competition, he felt like a loser.

zh: 我们要改善这个地区的电讯服务。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào gǎishàn zhège dìqū de diànxùn fúwù.
en: We want to improve the telecommunications service in this area.

zh: 大家众志成城，一定能做完工作。
pinyin: Dàjiā zhòngzhìchéngchéng, yīdìng néng zuòwán gōngzuò.
en: If everyone is united, we can definitely finish the work.

zh: 这个图表显示了去年公司的收入。
pinyin: Zhège túbiǎo xiǎnshìle qùnián gōngsī de shōurù.
en: This chart shows the company's income last year.

zh: 等了这么久，大家都觉得很烦躁。
pinyin: děng le zhè me jiǔ, dà jiā dōu jué de hěn fán zào.
en: Waiting for so long, everyone feels fidgety.

zh: 小时候我们总是无忧无虑地玩耍。
pinyin: Xiǎoshíhòu wǒmen zǒngshì wú yōu wú lǜ de wánshuǎ.
en: When we were young, we always played in a carefree way.

zh: 大家要同舟共济，才能完成工作。
pinyin: dàjiā yào tóng zhōu gòng jì, cáinéng wánchéng gōngzuò.
en: Everyone must collaborate to complete the work.

zh: 他为这家公司打下了坚实的根基。
pinyin: Tā wèi zhè jiā gōngsī dǎxià le jiānshí de gēnjī.
en: He laid a solid foundation for this company.

zh: 虽然题目很难，但我还是过关了。
pinyin: Suīrán tímù hěn nán, dàn wǒ háishì guò guān le.
en: Although the questions were difficult, I still passed.

zh: 他习惯了对公司的事情大包大揽。
pinyin: tā xí guàn le duì gōng sī de shì qíng dà bāo dà lǎn.
en: He is used to taking complete charge of company affairs.

zh: 你应该在忙碌的生活中注意休息。
pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi zài mánglù de shēnghuó zhōng zhùyì xiūxi.
en: You should pay attention to resting in your busy life.

zh: 大体上，我们可以接受这个计划。
pinyin: dà tǐ shàng, wǒ men kě yǐ jiē shòu zhè gè jì huà.
en: In general terms, we can accept this plan.

zh: 他对我使了个眼神，示意我离开。
pinyin: tā duì wǒ shǐ le gè yǎn shén, shì yì wǒ lí kāi。
en: He winked at me to signal for me to leave.

zh: 如果经常不吃早饭，很容易患病。
pinyin: Rúguǒ jīngcháng bù chī zǎofàn, hěn róngyì huànbìng.
en: If you don't eat breakfast often, it is easy to fall ill.

zh: 学校的新宿舍下个月就要竣工了。
pinyin: Xuéxiào de xīn sùshè xià gè yuè jiù yào jùngōng le.
en: The school's new dormitory will be completed next month.

zh: 寒假的时候，他打算回老家探亲。
pinyin: Hánjià de shíhòu, tā dǎsuàn huí lǎojiā tàn qīn.
en: During the winter break, he plans to return to his hometown to visit his family.

zh: 他咧嘴一笑，露出了洁白的牙齿。
pinyin: tā liě zuǐ yī xiào, lùchū le jiébái de yáchǐ.
en: He grinned, revealing his white teeth.

zh: 那家出版社负责出版他的新小说。
pinyin: Nà jiā chū bǎn shè fù zé chū bǎn tā de xīn xiǎo shuō.
en: That publishing house is responsible for publishing his new novel.

zh: 他的脚裸露在外面，看起来很冷。
pinyin: Tā de jiǎo luǒlù zài wàimiàn, kàn qǐlái hěn lěng.
en: His feet are exposed, and they look cold.

zh: 为了躲避飞来的球，他急忙后退。
pinyin: Wèile duǒbì fēi lái de qiú, tā jímáng hòutuì.
en: To avoid the flying ball, he recoiled in a hurry.

zh: 大家都在做自己力所能及的事情。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zài zuò zìjǐ lìsuǒnéngjí de shìqíng.
en: Everyone is doing things as far as their capabilities extend.

zh: 大家对这个新计划简直一无所知。
pinyin: Dàjiā duì zhège xīn jìhuà jiǎnzhí yī wú suǒ zhī.
en: Everyone knows absolutely nothing about this new plan.

zh: 为了花园好，我们必须斩草除根。
pinyin: Wèile huāyuán hǎo, wǒmen bìxū zhǎncǎochúgēn.
en: For the sake of the garden, we must pull out the weeds by the roots.

zh: 在高峰期，很难在路边拦到出租车。
pinyin: Zài gāofēngqī, hěn nán zài lùbiān lán dào chūzūchē.
en: During peak hours, it is hard to flag down a taxi on the side of the road.

zh: 这台打印机正在运行，请稍后再试。
pinyin: Zhè tái dǎyìnjī zhèngzài yùnxíng, qǐng shāohòu zài shì.
en: The printer is currently running, please try again later.

zh: 这个发现是科学研究的一个里程碑。
pinyin: Zhège fāxiàn shì kēxué yánjiū de yīgè lǐchéngbēi.
en: This discovery is a milestone in scientific research.

zh: 经理说道：“这个计划很有意思。”
pinyin: jīnglǐ shuō dào: “zhège jìhuà hěn yǒu yìsi.”
en: The manager stated, 'This plan is very interesting.'

zh: 他用一个精彩的笑话儿开启了演讲。
pinyin: tā yòng yī gè jīng cǎi de xiào huàr kāi qǐ le yǎn jiǎng
en: He started his speech with a brilliant joke.

zh: 他感到非常难过，好像走投无路了。
pinyin: Tā gǎndào fēicháng nánguò, hǎoxiàng zǒutóuwúlù le.
en: He felt very sad, as if he were at the end of his rope.

zh: 这句名言很有意思，我记得很清楚。
pinyin: Zhè jù míngyán hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒ jìdé hěn qīngchǔ.
en: This saying is very interesting, I remember it clearly.

zh: 遇到麻烦别上火，我们一起想办法。
pinyin: Yùdào máfan bié shànghuǒ, wǒmen yīqǐ xiǎng bànfǎ.
en: Don't get agitated when you encounter trouble; we'll think of a way together.

zh: 他非常努力，乃至每天学习到深夜。
pinyin: Tā fēicháng nǔlì, nǎizhì měitiān xuéxí dào shēnyè.
en: He is very hardworking, and goes so far as to study until late at night every day.

zh: 大家聚在一起唱歌跳舞，不亦乐乎？
pinyin: Dàjiā jù zài yīqǐ chànggē tiàowǔ, bù yì lè hū?
en: Isn't it a joy for everyone to gather and sing and dance?

zh: 总而言之，大家对这个计划很满意。
pinyin: zǒng ér yán zhī, dàjiā duì zhège jìhuà hěn mǎnyì.
en: In short, everyone is very satisfied with this plan.

zh: 这件事情很重要，你一定要多留心。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng hěn zhòngyào, nǐ yīdìng yào duō liúxīn.
en: This matter is very important; you must be extra careful.

zh: 归根到底，失败的原因是准备不足。
pinyin: guī gēn dào dǐ, shībài de yuányīn shì zhǔnbèi bùzú.
en: In the final analysis, the reason for the failure is insufficient preparation.

zh: 虽然这件旗袍很贵，但是我很喜欢。
pinyin: suīrán zhè jiàn qípáo hěn guì, dànshì wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
en: Although this cheongsam is very expensive, I like it very much.

zh: 这部纪录片是他在雨中摄像完成的。
pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn shì tā zài yǔ zhōng shèxiàng wánchéng de.
en: This documentary was completed by his videotaping in the rain.

zh: 为了练习冲浪，他买了一块新板子。
pinyin: Wèile liànxí chōnglàng, tā mǎi le yī kuài xīn bǎnzi.
en: In order to practice surfing, he bought a new board.

zh: 在互联网上，这样的消息比比皆是。
pinyin: Zài hùliánwǎng shàng, zhèyàng de xiāoxi bǐbǐjiēshì.
en: On the internet, such news can be found everywhere.

zh: 外边太黑了，晚间不要一个人出去。
pinyin: Wàibian tài hēi le, wǎn jiān bùyào yīgè rén chūqù.
en: It is too dark outside; do not go out alone at night.

zh: 她总是带着忧郁的表情，不想说话。
pinyin: Tā zǒng shì dàizhe yōuyù de biǎoqíng, bùxiǎng shuōhuà.
en: She always has a sullen expression and doesn't want to talk.

zh: 她总是在办公室说闲话，影响工作。
pinyin: tā zǒng shì zài bàngōngshì shuō xiánhuà, yǐngxiǎng gōngzuò.
en: She is always gossiping in the office, which affects work.

zh: 这件事很常见，你没必要大惊小怪。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn chángjiàn, nǐ méi bìyào dà jīng xiǎo guài.
en: This matter is very common; there is no need for you to make a fuss.

zh: 看见朋友时，他总是热情地打招呼。
pinyin: Kànjiàn péngyǒu shí, tā zǒng shì rèqíng de dǎ zhāohū.
en: When seeing friends, he always greets them warmly.

zh: 如果说他不开心，你可以送他礼物。
pinyin: rú guǒ shuō tā bù kāi xīn, nǐ kě yǐ sòng tā lǐ wù.
en: If he is not happy, you can give him a gift.

zh: 这首歌的节奏千变万化，很有意思。
pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē de jiézòu qiānbiànwànhuà, hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: The rhythm of this song is in a state of constant permutation and is very interesting.

zh: 虽然这辆车很昂贵，但我非常喜欢。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè liàng chē hěn ángguì, dàn wǒ fēicháng xǐhuān.
en: Although this car is very expensive, I like it a lot.

zh: 他那高大的形象留在了我的脑海里。
pinyin: Tā nà gāodà de xíngxiàng liú zài le wǒ de nǎohǎi lǐ.
en: His tall figure remained in my mind.

zh: 因为工作表现优异，他得到了奖励。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò biǎoxiàn yōuyì, tā dédàole jiǎnglì.
en: Because of his exceptional work performance, he received a reward.

zh: 花园里的花儿在明媚的阳光下开放。
pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ de huā er zài míngmèi de yángguāng xià kāifàng.
en: The flowers in the garden are blooming under the bright and beautiful sunshine.

zh: 连简单的问题他都不会，何况难的。
pinyin: Lián jiǎndān de wèntí tā dōu bù huì, hékuàng nán de.
en: He can't even answer simple questions, let alone the difficult ones.

zh: 妈妈每天潜移默化地教我爱护花草。
pinyin: māma měitiān qiányímòhuà de jiāo wǒ àihù huācǎo.
en: My mother secretly influences me every day to take care of plants.

zh: 他做的菜不仅好看，而且味道鲜美。
pinyin: Tā zuò de cài bùjǐn hǎokàn, érqiě wèidào xiānměi.
en: The dishes he makes are not only good-looking but also delicious.

zh: 冬天到了，很多年轻人喜欢去滑雪。
pinyin: Dōngtiān dào le, hěnduō niánqīng rén xǐhuān qù huáxuě.
en: Winter has arrived, and many young people like to go skiing.

zh: 作为老朋友，我对他的人品有信心。
pinyin: zuò wéi lǎo péng yǒu, wǒ duì tā de rén pǐn yǒu xìn xīn.
en: As an old friend, I have faith in his character.

zh: 那个坏蛋非常狡猾，警察没抓住他。
pinyin: Nàge huàidàn fēicháng jiǎohuá, jǐngchá méi zhuāzhù tā.
en: That bad guy is very crafty; the police didn't catch him.

zh: 别说买车了，他连自行车都买不起。
pinyin: Bié shuō mǎi chē le, tā lián zìxíngchē dōu mǎi bù qǐ.
en: To say nothing of buying a car, he cannot even afford a bicycle.

zh: 既然你错了，道歉就是理所当然的。
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ cuòle, dàoqiàn jiùshì lǐ suǒ dāng rán de.
en: Since you were wrong, an apology is inevitable and right.

zh: 周末我喜欢在家里度过悠闲的时光。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuān zài jiālǐ dùguò yōuxián de shíguāng.
en: I like to spend leisurely time at home on weekends.

zh: 时间和距离让他们的感情有了隔阂。
pinyin: Shíjiān hé jùlí ràng tāmen de gǎnqíng yǒule géhé.
en: Time and distance created an estrangement in their relationship.

zh: 他把洗好的衣服一件件晾在阳台上。
pinyin: Tā bǎ xǐ hǎo de yīfu yī jiàn jiàn liàng zài yángtái shàng.
en: He hung the washed clothes on the balcony one by one.

zh: 那个小偷儿趁我不注意拿走了钱包。
pinyin: nà gè xiǎo tōu r chèn wǒ bú zhù yì ná zǒu le qián bāo.
en: The thief took the wallet while I wasn't paying attention.

zh: 他以前无恶不作，大家都很讨厌他。
pinyin: Tā yǐqián wú è bù zuò, dàjiā dōu hěn tǎoyàn tā.
en: He used to stop at nothing to do evil, and everyone hated him.

zh: 妹妹看到小猫受伤，伤心地流泪了。
pinyin: Mèimei kàndào xiǎomāo shòushāng, shāngxīn de liúlèi le.
en: My younger sister saw the kitten was injured and shed tears in sadness.

zh: 为了健康去运动，这是无可厚非的。
pinyin: Wèile jiànkāng qù yùndòng, zhè shì wú kě hòu fēi de.
en: Exercising for the sake of health is perfectly understandable.

zh: 无论身处何处，我都不会忘记家乡。
pinyin: Wúlùn shēn chǔ héchù, wǒ dōu bù huì wàngjì jiāxiāng.
en: No matter where I am, I will not forget my hometown.

zh: 老师讲了一个故事，大家哄堂大笑。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎng le yī gè gùshì, dàjiā hōngtángdàxiào.
en: The teacher told a story, and the whole room roared with laughter.

zh: 只要他愿意改邪归正，我就原谅他。
pinyin: Zhǐyào tā yuànyì gǎi xié guī zhèng, wǒ jiù yuánliàng tā.
en: As long as he is willing to mend his ways, I will forgive him.

zh: 这件事太不可思议了，我不敢相信。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tài bù kě sī yì le, wǒ bù gǎn xiāngxìn.
en: This matter is so inconceivable, I cannot believe it.

zh: 这家超市商品一应俱全，非常方便。
pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì shāngpǐn yīyīngjùquán, fēicháng fāngbiàn.
en: This supermarket has everything you need; it is very convenient.

zh: 她今天穿着一件漂亮的裙子去学校。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān chuānzhuó yī jiàn piàoliang de qúnzi qù xuéxiào.
en: She is wearing a beautiful dress to school today.

zh: 他在经济方面的损失是微不足道的。
pinyin: Tā zài jīngjì fāngmiàn de sǔnshī shì wēi bù zú dào de.
en: His financial losses are negligible.

zh: 失去工作后，他只能和狗相依为命。
pinyin: Shīqù gōngzuò hòu, tā zhǐnéng hé gǒu xiāngyīwéimìng.
en: After losing his job, he could only rely on his dog for survival.

zh: 那个国家的人民遭受了长期的迫害。
pinyin: Nàge guójiā de rénmín zāoshòu le chángqī de pòhài.
en: The people of that country suffered long-term persecution.

zh: 不管我怎么解释，他始终一声不吭。
pinyin: Bùguǎn wǒ zěnme jiěshì, tā shǐzhōng yī shēng bù kēng.
en: No matter how I explained, he stayed silent.

zh: 我近来总是忘记把钥匙放在哪儿了。
pinyin: wǒ jìn lái zǒng shì wàng jì bǎ yào shi fàng zài nǎr le.
en: I have been constantly forgetting where I put my keys lately.

zh: 为了考试，我必须背诵这些语法点。
pinyin: Wèile kǎoshì, wǒ bìxū bèisòng zhèxiē yǔfǎ diǎn.
en: In order to take the exam, I must repeat these grammar points from memory.

zh: 周末的街道上熙熙攘攘，非常热闹。
pinyin: Zhōumò de jiēdào shàng xīxīrǎngrǎng, fēicháng rènao.
en: The streets are bustling with activity on the weekend; it is very lively.

zh: 希望爸爸妈妈平安，上帝保佑他们。
pinyin: Xīwàng bàba māma píng'ān, Shàngdì bǎoyòu tāmen.
en: I hope my mom and dad are safe; may God bless and protect them.

zh: 他的回答似是而非，让大家很困惑。
pinyin: Tā de huídá shì shì ér fēi, ràng dàjiā hěn kùnhuò.
en: His answer was apparently right but actually wrong, which confused everyone.

zh: 以前有很多文盲，现在情况好多了。
pinyin: Yǐqián yǒu hěnduō wénmáng, xiànzài qíngkuàng hǎo duō le.
en: There used to be many illiterate people, but the situation is much better now.

zh: 坚持阅读对我们的成长有很大益处。
pinyin: Jiānchí yuèdú duì wǒmen de chéngzhǎng yǒu hěn dà yìchu.
en: Persisting in reading is very beneficial to our growth.

zh: 别去惹那个人，他看起来非常凶狠。
pinyin: Bié qù rě nàge rén, tā kàn qǐlái fēicháng xiōnghěn.
en: Don't provoke that person; he looks very fierce.

zh: 他为了建这个私人池塘花了很多钱。
pinyin: Tā wèile jiàn zhège sīrén chítáng huāle hěnduō qián.
en: He spent a lot of money to build this private pool.

zh: 俗话说，在家靠父母，出门靠朋友。
pinyin: Sú huà shuō, zài jiā kào fùmǔ, chūmén kào péngyǒu.
en: As they say, at home you rely on your parents, abroad you rely on friends.

zh: 为了省钱，他过着风餐露宿的生活。
pinyin: wèile shěngqián, tā guòzhe fēngcānlùsù de shēnghuó.
en: In order to save money, he is living a rough life.

zh: 幸亏我提前准备了，不然就麻烦了。
pinyin: Xìngkuī wǒ tíqián zhǔnbèile, bùrán jiù máfan le.
en: Luckily I prepared in advance, otherwise it would have been troublesome.

zh: 为了得到这份工作，他编造了谎话。
pinyin: wèi le dé dào zhè fèn gōng zuò, tā biān zào le huǎng huà.
en: In order to get this job, he made up a lie.

zh: 春节的时候，城市里有热闹的庙会。
pinyin: chūn jié de shí hòu, chéng shì lǐ yǒu rè nao de miào huì.
en: During the Spring Festival, there are lively temple fairs in the city.

zh: 虽然他很倔强，但是大家都喜欢他。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn juéjiàng, dànshì dàjiā dōu xǐhuān tā.
en: Although he is very stubborn, everyone likes him.

zh: 这次事故中，他很幸运地幸免于难。
pinyin: Zhè cì shìgù zhōng, tā hěn xìngyùn de xìngmiǎn yú nàn.
en: In this accident, he was lucky enough to escape death.

zh: 小明和小红的考试成绩并列第一名。
pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Xiǎohóng de kǎoshì chéngjì bìngliè dì yī míng.
en: Xiaoming and Xiaohong's exam scores are tied for first place.

zh: 如果你不认识路，我可以为你带路。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù rènshi lù, wǒ kěyǐ wèi nǐ dàilù.
en: If you don't know the way, I can lead the way for you.

zh: 老汉虽然年纪大了，但是身体很好。
pinyin: Lǎohàn suīrán niánjì dàle, dànshì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
en: Although I am old, my health is very good.

zh: 他对员工很厚道，经常请大家吃饭。
pinyin: Tā duì yuángōng hěn hòudào, jīngcháng qǐng dàjiā chīfàn.
en: He is generous to his employees and often treats them to meals.

zh: 由于长时间工作，他感到有些头晕。
pinyin: Yóuyú cháng shíjiān gōngzuò, tā gǎndào yǒuxiē tóuyūn.
en: Due to working for a long time, he felt a bit dizzy.

zh: 我打算下个周末去养老院看望老人。
pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn xià gè zhōumò qù yǎng lǎoyuàn kànwàng lǎorén.
en: I plan to visit the elderly at the nursing home next weekend.

zh: 历史课上，我们讨论了冷战的问题。
pinyin: Lìshǐ kè shàng, wǒmen tǎolùn le lěngzhàn de wèntí.
en: In history class, we discussed the issues of the Cold War.

zh: 这件事很复杂，很难做到面面俱到。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn fùzá, hěn nán zuò dào miàn miàn jù dào.
en: This matter is very complex; it is hard to cover every detail.

zh: 这个博物馆里有很多朝代的艺术品。
pinyin: Zhège bówùguǎn lǐ yǒu hěnduō cháodài de yìshùpǐn.
en: There are artworks from many dynasties in this museum.

zh: 时隔多年，这里发生了很大的变化。
pinyin: shí gé duō nián, zhè lǐ fā shēng le hěn dà de biàn huà.
en: After many years, there have been great changes here.

zh: 能参加这次会议，我感到非常有幸。
pinyin: Néng cānjiā zhè cì huìyì, wǒ gǎndào fēicháng yǒuxìng.
en: I feel very fortunate to be able to attend this meeting.

zh: 考试中出现了几道非常偏僻的题目。
pinyin: Kǎoshì zhōng chūxiàn le jǐ dào fēicháng piānpì de tímù.
en: Several very obscure questions appeared in the exam.

zh: 虽然他说话很耿直，但是没有恶意。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shuōhuà hěn gěngzhí, dànshì méiyǒu èyì.
en: Although he speaks very frankly and honestly, he has no bad intentions.

zh: 他在拥挤的人群中寻找自己的朋友。
pinyin: tā zài yōng jǐ de rén qún zhōng xún zhǎo zì jǐ de péng yǒu.
en: He is looking for his friend in the crowded crowd.

zh: 事情到了这一步，我不由得他不信。
pinyin: Shìqing dàole zhè yī bù, bùyóude tā bù xìn.
en: Things have reached this point, he cannot but believe it.

zh: 父母为了孩子，吃过不少风风雨雨。
pinyin: Fùmǔ wèile háizi, chīguò bùshǎo fēngfēngyǔyǔ.
en: For the sake of their children, parents have endured many trials and tribulations.

zh: 他们结婚十年了，婚姻一直很美满。
pinyin: Tāmen jiéhūn shí nián le, hūnyīn yīzhí hěn měimǎn.
en: They have been married for ten years, and their marriage has always been perfect.

zh: 他因为睡不着觉，所以去买安眠药。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi shuì bùzháo jiào, suǒyǐ qù mǎi ānmiányào.
en: Because he couldn't sleep, he went to buy sleeping pills.

zh: 他站在十字路口，不知道往哪儿走。
pinyin: Tā zhàn zài shízìlùkǒu, bù zhīdào wǎng nǎ'er zǒu.
en: He stood at the crossroads, not knowing which way to go.

zh: 如果你是车主，请出示你的身份证。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ shì chēzhǔ, qǐng chūshì nǐ de shēnfènzhèng.
en: If you are the vehicle owner, please show your ID card.

zh: 听到这个消息，她难过得哭泣起来。
pinyin: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi, tā nánguò de kūqì qǐlái.
en: Hearing this news, she became so sad that she started to weep.

zh: 虽然他很有钱，但是他从不做生意。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn yǒu qián, dànshì tā cóngbù zuò shēngyì.
en: Although he is very rich, he never does business.

zh: 因为这次生意失败，他倾家荡产了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè cì shēngyì shībài, tā qīngjiādàngchǎn le.
en: Because of this business failure, he lost his entire family fortune.

zh: 考虑到路程，这个票价还是合理的。
pinyin: Kǎolǜ dào lùchéng, zhège piàojià háishì hélǐ de.
en: Considering the distance, this ticket price is still reasonable.

zh: 虽然很害怕，但他还是打开了棺材。
pinyin: Suī rán hěn hài pà, dàn tā hái shì dǎ kāi le guān cai.
en: Although he was scared, he still opened the coffin.

zh: 他工作很努力，为此大家都很佩服他。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò hěn nǔlì, wèicǐ dàjiā dōu hěn pèifú tā.
en: He works very hard; in this respect, everyone admires him.

zh: 听到这个好消息，大家都感到很欣慰。
pinyin: Tīng dào zhège hǎo xiāoxi, dàjiā dōu gǎndào hěn xīnwèi.
en: Hearing this good news, everyone felt very gratified.

zh: 虽然很忙，但他还是推辞了这次邀请。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, dàn tā háishì tuīcí le zhè cì yāoqǐng.
en: Although very busy, he still declined this invitation.

zh: 虽然很累，但是他依然很勤劳地工作。
pinyin: suī rán hěn lèi, dàn shì tā yī rán hěn qín láo de gōng zuò.
en: Although tired, he still works very hard.

zh: 老师讲得头头是道，学生们都听懂了。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎng dé tóutóushìdào, xuéshēngmen dōu tīngdǒngle.
en: The teacher explained it clearly and logically, and the students all understood.

zh: 老师说，这个动物的颜色发生了变异。
pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, zhège dòngwù de yánsè fāshēngle biànyì.
en: The teacher said the animal's color has undergone a variation.

zh: 这家医院的一把手决定更换新的设备。
pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de yī bǎ shǒu juédìng gēnghuàn xīn de shèbèi.
en: The head of this hospital decided to replace the equipment with new ones.

zh: 大家之所以高兴，是因为考试结束了。
pinyin: dà jiā zhī suǒ yǐ gāo xìng, shì yīn wèi kǎo shì jié shù le.
en: The reason why everyone is happy is that the exam is over.

zh: 这位文人对国家的发展有重要的贡献。
pinyin: Zhè wèi wénrén duì guójiā de fāzhǎn yǒu zhòngyào de gòngxiàn.
en: This cultivated individual has made important contributions to the country's development.

zh: 寒冷的天气影响了他的整体生理机能。
pinyin: hánlěng de tiānqì yǐngxiǎng le tā de zhěngtǐ shēnglǐ jīnéng.
en: The cold weather affected his entire body's physiological functions.

zh: 虽然出生在国外，但他的祖籍是中国。
pinyin: Suīrán chūshēng zài guówài, dàn tā de zǔjí shì Zhōngguó.
en: Although born abroad, his original domicile is China.

zh: 这本书讲述了一个很有趣的历史事件。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiǎngshù le yīgè hěn yǒuqù de lìshǐ shìjiàn.
en: This book talks about a very interesting historical event.

zh: 为了做实验，我买了一台新的发电机。
pinyin: Wèile zuò shíyàn, wǒ mǎi le yī tái xīn de fā diàn jī.
en: In order to do an experiment, I bought a new dynamo.

zh: 爷爷送给我的钢笔，我一直爱不释手。
pinyin: Yéye sòng gěi wǒ de gāngbǐ, wǒ yīzhí àibùshìshǒu.
en: I have always loved the fountain pen my grandfather gave me and could not put it down.

zh: 听到这个消息，大家都笑得前仰后合。
pinyin: tīngdào zhège xiāoxī, dàjiā dōu xiào de qián yǎng hòu hé.
en: Hearing this news, everyone laughed and swayed to and fro.

zh: 今天发生的事情完全在我的意料之外。
pinyin: Jīn tiān fā shēng de shì qíng wán quán zài wǒ de yì liào zhī wài.
en: What happened today was completely contrary to my expectation.

zh: 经过思前想后，我同意了他们的计划。
pinyin: Jīngguò sīqiánxiǎnghòu, wǒ tóngyì le tāmen de jìhuà.
en: After pondering over the past and future effects, I agreed to their plan.

zh: 为了购买那本书，我支付了二十英镑。
pinyin: wèi le gòu mǎi nà běn shū, wǒ zhī fù le èr shí yīng bàng.
en: In order to buy that book, I paid twenty pounds.

zh: 虽然她是我的继母，但我们关系很好。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shì wǒ de jìmǔ, dàn wǒmen guānxì hěn hǎo.
en: Although she is my stepmother, we have a good relationship.

zh: 元宵节晚上，公园里有很多漂亮的灯。
pinyin: Yuánxiāojié wǎnshàng, gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěnduō piàoliang de dēng.
en: On the night of the Lantern Festival, there are many beautiful lanterns in the park.

zh: 看到这么美的风景，我们都赞叹不已。
pinyin: Kàndào zhème měi de fēngjǐng, wǒmen dōu zàntànbùyǐ.
en: Seeing such beautiful scenery, we are all full of praise.

zh: 比起坐飞机，我更愿意坐火车去旅游。
pinyin: Bǐ qǐ zuò fēijī, wǒ gèng yuànyì zuò huǒchē qù lǚyóu.
en: Compared with flying, I prefer to travel by train.

zh: 如果身体不舒服，请就近去医院检查。
pinyin: Rúguǒ shēntǐ bú shūfu, qǐng jiùjìn qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
en: If you are not feeling well, please go to a nearby hospital for a check-up.

zh: 所有房间都打扫了，唯独厨房没打扫。
pinyin: Suǒyǒu fángjiān dōu dǎsǎo le, wéidú chúfáng méi dǎsǎo.
en: All rooms have been cleaned, all except the kitchen.

zh: 小丑在公园里表演，让孩子们很高兴。
pinyin: Xiǎochǒu zài gōngyuán lǐ biǎoyǎn, ràng háizimen hěn gāoxìng.
en: The clown performed in the park, making the children very happy.

zh: 我们在那个比赛中调整了射击的姿势。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài nàge bǐsài zhōng tiáozhěngle shèjī de zīshì.
en: We adjusted our shooting position during the competition.

zh: 春节的时候，大家都希望和家人团圆。
pinyin: Chūnjié de shíhòu, dàjiā dōu xīwàng hé jiārén tuányuán.
en: During the Spring Festival, everyone hopes to have a reunion with their family.

zh: 大家都紧张，只有他从容不迫地做事。
pinyin: dà jiā dōu jǐn zhāng, zhǐ yǒu tā cóng róng bù pò de zuò shì.
en: Everyone is nervous, only he acts in an unruffled way.

zh: 他讲的笑话一点也不好笑，太无聊了。
pinyin: tā jiǎng de xiào huà yī diǎn yě bù hǎo xiào, tài wú liáo le.
en: The joke he told wasn't funny at all; it was very boring.

zh: 房间里太久没有打扫，到处都是灰尘。
pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ tài jiǔ méiyǒu dǎsǎo, dàochù dōu shì huīchén.
en: The room hasn't been cleaned for a long time, and there is dust everywhere.

zh: 由于工作太忙，他不免感到有些疲劳。
pinyin: yóu yú gōng zuò tài máng, tā bù miǎn gǎn dào yǒu xiē pí láo.
en: Because work is too busy, he inevitably feels a bit tired.

zh: 整个周末，她都孤零零地待在房间里。
pinyin: Zhěnggè zhōumò, tā dōu gū líng líng de dāi zài fángjiān lǐ.
en: She stayed all alone in her room for the entire weekend.

zh: 为了考试，他制定了周密的学习计划。
pinyin: Wèile kǎoshì, tā zhìdìng le zhōumì de xuéxí jìhuà.
en: For the exam, he made a careful study plan.

zh: 这个雕塑非常精致，请不要用手触摸。
pinyin: Zhège diāosù fēicháng jīngzhì, qǐng bùyào yòng shǒu chùmō.
en: This sculpture is very delicate, please do not touch it with your hands.

zh: 这件衣服很便宜，甚至于只要五块钱。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fu hěn pián yi, shèn zhì yú zhǐ yào wǔ kuài qián.
en: This piece of clothing is very cheap, even costing only five yuan.

zh: 这个红色的衣服让他看起来与众不同。
pinyin: Zhège hóngsè de yīfú ràng tā kàn qǐlái yǔ zhòng bù tóng.
en: This red clothing makes him look like he stands out from the crowd.

zh: 这家工厂倒闭了，很多员工都下岗了。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng dǎobì le, hěnduō yuángōng dōu xiàgǎng le.
en: This factory went bankrupt, and many employees were laid off.

zh: 电影里的主角冷笑了一声，准备反击。
pinyin: diàn yǐng lǐ de zhǔ jiǎo lěng xiào le yī shēng, zhǔn bèi fǎn jī.
en: The main character in the movie laughed grimly, preparing to fight back.

zh: 他轻轻推开门，小心翼翼地走进里边。
pinyin: Tā qīngqīng tuī kāi mén, xiǎoxīnyìyì de zǒu jìn lǐ bian.
en: He gently pushed the door open and walked inside cautiously.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以我决定徒步回家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ juédìng túbù huí jiā.
en: Because the weather is nice, I decided to go home on foot.

zh: 听了那个奇怪的故事，大家半信半疑。
pinyin: Tīngle nàge qíguài de gùshì, dàjiā bàn xìn bàn yí.
en: After hearing that strange story, everyone was half-believing and half-doubting.

zh: 买东西以后，别忘了向售货员要收据。
pinyin: Mǎi dōngxi yǐhòu, bié wàngle xiàng shòuhuòyuán yào shōujù.
en: After buying things, don't forget to ask the salesperson for a receipt.

zh: 多亏了老师的好意，我才通过了考试。
pinyin: Duōkuī le lǎoshī de hǎoyì, wǒ cái tōngguò le kǎoshì.
en: Thanks to the teacher's kindness, I passed the exam.

zh: 鉴于这一决定很重要，我们需要讨论。
pinyin: jiàn yú zhè yī jué dìng hěn zhòng yào, wǒ men xū yào tǎo lùn.
en: Considering this decision is very important, we need to discuss it.

zh: 北京夏天的温度常常超过三十摄氏度。
pinyin: Běijīng xiàtiān de wēndù chángcháng chāoguò sānshí shèshìdù.
en: The temperature in Beijing in summer often exceeds thirty degrees Celsius.

zh: 虽然失恋很痛苦，但他还是去上班了。
pinyin: Suīrán shīliàn hěn tòngkǔ, dàn tā háishì qù shàngbān le.
en: Although the breakup was painful, he still went to work.

zh: 退休以后，爷爷过着怡然自得的生活。
pinyin: Tuìxiū yǐhòu, yéye guòzhe yíránzìdé de shēnghuó.
en: After retiring, grandfather lives a happy and content life.

zh: 假期结束了，我恋恋不舍地离开了家。
pinyin: Jiàqī jiéshù le, wǒ liànliànbùshě de líkāile jiā.
en: The vacation ended, and I left home with great reluctance.

zh: 只要你持之以恒，就一定能学会外语。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ chízhīyǐhéng, jiù yīdìng néng xuéhuì wàiyǔ.
en: As long as you persevere, you will definitely be able to learn a foreign language.

zh: 听到这个好消息，他激动得脱口而出。
pinyin: Tīngdào zhège hǎo xiāoxi, tā jīdòng de tuō kǒu ér chū.
en: Hearing this good news, he was so excited that he blurted it out.

zh: 如果你去问这个问题，一定会碰钉子。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ qù wèn zhège wèntí, yīdìng huì pèng dīngzi.
en: If you go to ask this question, you will definitely be rebuffed.

zh: 我们要保护好的牙齿，它们很有韧性。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎohù hǎo de yáchǐ, tāmen hěn yǒu rènxìng.
en: We must protect our teeth; they are quite tough.

zh: 突然停电了，屋子里的人都惊慌失措。
pinyin: Tūrán tíngdiàn le, wūzi lǐ de rén dōu jīnghuāngshīcuò.
en: The power suddenly went out, and everyone in the room panicked.

zh: 我不知道他在哪里，也不清楚他的所在。
pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào tā zài nǎlǐ, yě bù qīngchǔ tā de suǒzài.
en: I don't know where he is, and I am not clear about his location.

zh: 如果不听医生的建议，身体势必会变差。
pinyin: Rúguǒ bù tīng yīshēng de jiànyì, shēntǐ shìbì huì biàn chà.
en: If you don't listen to the doctor's advice, your health is bound to worsen.

zh: 没想到多年以后，我们还能在这里重逢。
pinyin: méi xiǎng dào duō nián yǐ hòu, wǒ men hái néng zài zhè lǐ chóng féng.
en: I didn't expect that after many years, we would meet again here.

zh: 看到电影的结局，他忍不住流出了眼泪。
pinyin: Kàndào diànyǐng de jiéjú, tā rěnbuzhù liúchū le yǎnlèi.
en: Seeing the end of the movie, he couldn't help but shed tears.

zh: 这台电脑性价比高，非常适合学生使用。
pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo xìngjiàbǐ gāo, fēicháng shìhé xuésheng shǐyòng.
en: This computer has a high cost-performance ratio and is very suitable for students to use.

zh: 听到这个好消息，大家心里都喜洋洋的。
pinyin: Tīng dào zhège hǎo xiāoxi, dàjiā xīnlǐ dōu xǐyángyáng de.
en: Hearing this good news, everyone feels radiant with joy.

zh: 他不仅迟到，还责怪别人，这有点过分。
pinyin: Tā bùjǐn chídào, hái zéguài biérén, zhè yǒudiǎn guòfèn.
en: He was not only late but also blamed others, which is unduly unreasonable.

zh: 由于你的粗心大意，公司损失了很多钱。
pinyin: Yóuyú nǐ de cūxīn dàyì, gōngsī sǔnshī le hěnduō qián.
en: Due to your negligence, the company lost a lot of money.

zh: 这次考试固然很难，但我相信你能通过。
pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì gùrán hěn nán, dàn wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ néng tōngguò.
en: Admittedly the exam was very difficult, but I believe you can pass.

zh: 为了考上好的大学，他一直在努力念书。
pinyin: Wèile kǎoshàng hǎo de dàxué, tā yīzhí zài nǔlì niàn shū.
en: In order to get into a good university, he has been studying hard.

zh: 为了得到这个机会，他不得不讨价还价。
pinyin: Wèile dédào zhège jīhuì, tā bùdébù tǎojiàhuánjià.
en: In order to get this opportunity, he had to bargain.

zh: 他无奈地看着老师，不知道该怎么回答。
pinyin: Tā wú nài de kàn zhe lǎo shī, bù zhī dào gāi zěn me huí dá.
en: He looked at the teacher with exasperation, not knowing how to answer.

zh: 因为这次意外，他身上留下了一个创伤。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè cì yìwài, tā shēnshang liúxià le yīgè chuāngshāng.
en: Because of this accident, a wound was left on his body.

zh: 为了这点小事麻烦你，我实在过意不去。
pinyin: Wèile zhè diǎn xiǎoshì máfan nǐ, wǒ shízài guòyìbùqù.
en: I feel very apologetic for troubling you with such a small matter.

zh: 因为昨晚没睡好，他上课时总是打盹儿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zuówǎn méi shuì hǎo, tā shàngkè shí zǒng shì dǎ dǔn r.
en: Because he didn't sleep well last night, he always dozes off in class.

zh: 想要通过这次考试，你必须下功夫复习。
pinyin: Xiǎngyào tōngguò zhè cì kǎoshì, nǐ bìxū xià gōngfu fùxí.
en: If you want to pass this exam, you must put effort into reviewing.

zh: 他们两个人的关系很好，一直形影不离。
pinyin: Tāmen liǎng gè rén de guānxì hěn hǎo, yīzhí xíng yǐng bù lí.
en: The two of them have a great relationship and are always inseparable.

zh: 事情已经这样了，我顾不得别人怎么想。
pinyin: Shìqing yǐjīng zhèyàng le, wǒ gù bu de biérén zěnme xiǎng.
en: Things are already like this, I cannot change how others think.

zh: 我和同学朝夕相处，建立了深厚的友谊。
pinyin: Wǒ hé tóngxué zhāo xī xiāng chǔ, jiànlì le shēnhòu de yǒuyì.
en: I spend all my time with my classmates, and we have built a deep friendship.

zh: 这家医院的内科在当地享有很高的声誉。
pinyin: zhè jiā yī yuàn de nèi kē zài dāng dì xiǎng yǒu hěn gāo de shēng yù.
en: The internal medicine department of this hospital enjoys a high reputation locally.

zh: 为了孩子，他们商量好了抚养费的问题。
pinyin: Wèile háizi, tāmen shāngliang hǎo le fǔyǎngfèi de wèntí.
en: For the sake of the child, they have settled the issue of child support.

zh: 如果不舒服，快去医院，这件事很要紧。
pinyin: rú guǒ bù shū fu, kuài qù yī yuàn, zhè jiàn shì hěn yào jǐn.
en: If you don't feel well, go to the hospital quickly; this is urgent.

zh: 他因为工作表现好，得到了丰厚的奖金。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò biǎoxiàn hǎo, dédào le fēnghòu de jiǎngjīn.
en: Because of his good work performance, he received a generous bonus.

zh: 他已经很难过了，你这么说真是雪上加霜。
pinyin: Tā yǐjīng hěn nánguò le, nǐ zhème shuō zhēn shì xuěshàngjiāshuāng.
en: He is already sad; your saying that is adding insult to injury.

zh: 这家专卖店的衣服虽然贵，但是质量很好。
pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānmàidiàn de yīfu suīrán guì, dànshì zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
en: Although the clothes in this specialty store are expensive, the quality is very good.

zh: 如果你没有入场券，就不能参加这次展览。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ méiyǒu rùchǎngquàn, jiù bùnéng cānjiā zhè cì zhǎnlǎn.
en: If you don't have an admission ticket, you cannot attend this exhibition.

zh: 他工作那么努力，考试成功是可想而知的。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò nàme nǔlì, kǎoshì chénggōng shì kě xiǎng ér zhī de.
en: He worked so hard, so his success in the exam goes without saying.

zh: 这件衣服很漂亮，不用说，大家都很喜欢。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn piàoliang, bù yòng shuō, dàjiā dōu hěn xǐhuān.
en: This piece of clothing is very beautiful; needless to say, everyone likes it very much.

zh: 在这么多人面前唱歌，他感到有些难为情。
pinyin: Zài zhème duō rén miànqián chànggē, tā gǎndào yǒuxiē nánwéiqíng.
en: He felt a bit embarrassed singing in front of so many people.

zh: 与其在家睡觉，不如跟我去俱乐部打台球。
pinyin: yǔqí zài jiā shuìjiào, bùrú gēn wǒ qù jùlèbù dǎ táiqiú.
en: Rather than sleeping at home, why not go to the club and play billiards with me?

zh: 这瓶牙膏快用完了，我们去超市买新的吧。
pinyin: Zhè píng yágāo kuài yòngwán le, wǒmen qù chāoshì mǎi xīn de ba.
en: This tube of toothpaste is almost finished; let's go to the supermarket to buy a new one.

zh: 新技术出现后，很快就取而代之了旧技术。
pinyin: Xīn jìshù chūxiàn hòu, hěn kuài jiù qǔ ér dài zhī le jiù jìshù.
en: After the new technology appeared, it quickly replaced the old one.

zh: 这个故事告诉我们要像愚公移山一样努力。
pinyin: Zhège gùshì gàosù wǒmen yào xiàng Yú gōng yí shān yīyàng nǔlì.
en: This story tells us to work hard like the old man moving mountains.

zh: 他需要一些时间来消化这突如其来的消息。
pinyin: Tā xūyào yīxiē shíjiān lái xiāohuà zhè tūrúqílái de xiāoxi.
en: He needs some time to absorb this sudden news.

zh: 在这个网站上，你可以匿名写下你的想法。
pinyin: Zài zhège wǎngzhàn shàng, nǐ kěyǐ nì míng xiě xià nǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
en: On this website, you can write down your thoughts anonymously.

zh: 为了这个重要的仪式，我准备了一套礼服。
pinyin: Wèile zhège zhòngyào de yíshì, wǒ zhǔnbèile yī tào lǐfú.
en: For this important ceremony, I prepared a suit of formal attire.

zh: 听着好听的音乐，我情不自禁地跳起舞来。
pinyin: Tīngzhe hǎotīng de yīnyuè, wǒ qíng bù zì jīn de tiào qǐ wǔ lái.
en: Listening to the beautiful music, I could not help but start dancing.

zh: 我对集邮很感兴趣，这是一种不错的爱好。
pinyin: Wǒ duì jíyóu hěn gǎn xìngqù, zhè shì yī zhǒng bùcuò de àihào.
en: I am very interested in philately; it is a good hobby.

zh: 虽然卤味的味道很重，但是很多人都喜欢吃。
pinyin: Suīrán lǔwèi de wèidào hěn zhòng, dànshì hěnduō rén dōu xǐhuān chī.
en: Although braised food has a strong flavor, many people like eating it.

zh: 他工作的时候，对客户的服务总是无微不至。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò de shíhòu, duì kèhù de fúwù zǒngshì wúwēi-bùzhì.
en: When he works, his service to customers is always in every possible way.

zh: 老师批评你是因为关心你，他是有口无心的。
pinyin: Lǎoshī pīpíng nǐ shì yīnwèi guānxīn nǐ, tā shì yǒu kǒu wú xīn de.
en: The teacher criticized you because they care about you; they spoke without any bad intent.

zh: 她试图用一块巧克力来安慰那个哭泣的孩子。
pinyin: Tā shìtú yòng yī kuài qiǎokèlì lái ānwèi nàge kūqì de háizi.
en: She attempted to comfort the crying child with a piece of chocolate.

zh: 您的中文说得这么好，我不敢当，您过奖了。
pinyin: Nín de Zhōngwén shuō de zhème hǎo, wǒ bù gǎndāng, nín guòjiǎng le.
en: Your Chinese is so good, I don't deserve such praise, you overpraise me.

zh: 尽管夜总会里非常吵闹，他还是想进去看看。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yèzǒnghuì lǐ fēicháng cháonào, tā háishì xiǎng jìnqù kànkan.
en: Although the nightclub was very noisy, he still wanted to go inside and take a look.

zh: 医生说他现在的身体状况是因为肥胖引起的。
pinyin: yī shēng shuō tā xiàn zài de shēn tǐ zhuàng kuàng shì yīn wèi féi pàng yǐn qǐ de.
en: The doctor says his current physical condition is caused by obesity.

zh: 他每天都锻炼，由此看来他的身体一定很好。
pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu duànliàn, yóu cǐ kàn lái tā de shēntǐ yīdìng hěn hǎo.
en: He exercises every day; judging from this, his health must be very good.

zh: 老师滔滔不绝地讲故事，同学们都听得很认真。
pinyin: Lǎoshī tāotāo bù jué de jiǎng gùshì, tóngxuémen dōu tīng de hěn rènzhēn.
en: The teacher told stories in a continuous stream, and the students listened very attentively.

zh: 因为他说话太难听，我忍不住给了他一个耳光。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā shuōhuà tài nántīng, wǒ rěnbuzhù gěi le tā yī gè ěrguāng.
en: Because he spoke so harshly, I couldn't help but slap him in the face.

zh: 尽管困难重重，他还是想出了一个妥善的办法。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn kùnnán chóngchóng, tā háishì xiǎng chū le yīgè tuǒshàn de bànfǎ.
en: Despite the many difficulties, he still came up with a proper solution.

zh: 他很想再跑一次，可惜年纪大了，感到力不从心。
pinyin: Tā hěn xiǎng zài pǎo yīcì, kěxī niánjì dàle, gǎndào lìbùcóngxīn.
en: He really wants to run once more, but unfortunately he is old and feels unable to do as he wishes.

zh: 虽然他说了错话，但他恼羞成怒，不让别人说话。
pinyin: suīrán tā shuō le cuòhuà, dàn tā nǎoxiūchéngnù, bú ràng biérén shuōhuà.
en: Although he said something wrong, he became enraged from humiliation and would not let others speak.

zh: 他非常喜欢旅游，每到一个地方都喜欢照相留念。
pinyin: Tā fēicháng xǐhuān lǚyóu, měi dào yí gè dìfāng dōu xǐhuān zhàoxiàng liúniàn.
en: He loves traveling very much, and he likes to take photos to commemorate every place he visits.

zh: 与其在家里看电视，不如去公园找些好玩儿的事儿做。
pinyin: Yǔqí zài jiālǐ kàn diànshì, bùrú qù gōngyuán zhǎo xiē hǎo wán r de shìr zuò.
en: Rather than watching TV at home, it's better to go to the park and find something fun to do.

zh: 听到这个消息，大家都非常吃惊，不约而同地站了起来。
pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxī, dàjiā dōu fēicháng chījīng, bùyuē'értóng de zhàn le qǐlái.
en: Hearing the news, everyone was very surprised and stood up at the same time without prior consultation.

zh: 他挥剑击退敌人。
pinyin: Tā huījiàn jītuì dírén.
en: He brandished his sword to repel the enemy.

zh: 炸弹把墙轰倒了。
pinyin: Zhàdàn bǎ qiáng hōng dǎo le.
en: The bomb exploded and knocked down the wall.

zh: 浆糊弄得太稠了。
pinyin: Jiànghú nòng de tài chóu le.
en: The paste was made too thick.

zh: 趁早识破了骗局。
pinyin: Chènzǎo shípòle piànjú.
en: He saw through the scam at the first opportunity.

zh: 藤蔓向墙壁蔓延。
pinyin: Téngwàn xiàng qiángbì mànyán.
en: The vines are extending toward the wall.

zh: 钢梁支撑着桥面。
pinyin: gāng liáng zhī chēng zhe qiáo miàn.
en: The steel beams strut the bridge deck.

zh: 失败乃成功之母。
pinyin: shī bài nǎi chéng gōng zhī mǔ。
en: Failure is the mother of success.

zh: 小猫把纸团抛开。
pinyin: Xiǎomāo bǎ zhǐtuán pāo kāi.
en: The kitten threw the paper ball away.

zh: 蓝领生活并不容易。
pinyin: lán lǐng shēng huó bìng bù róng yì.
en: Blue-collar life is not easy.

zh: 请把那根绳子剪断。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nà gēn shéngzi jiǎnduàn.
en: Please cut that rope.

zh: 这只猫画得真逼真。
pinyin: Zhè zhī māo huà de zhēn bī zhēn.
en: This cat is drawn very lifelike.

zh: 优胜劣汰是必然的。
pinyin: yōushèngliètài shì bìrán de.
en: Survival of the fittest is inevitable.

zh: 他把帽子抛向空中。
pinyin: tā bǎ mào zi pāo xiàng kōng zhōng.
en: He threw his hat into the air.

zh: 他初并不了解实情。
pinyin: Tā chū bìng bù liǎojiě shíqíng.
en: At first, he did not understand the truth.

zh: 士兵奋勇冲向敌人。
pinyin: Shìbīng fènyǒng chōng xiàng dírén.
en: The soldier dauntlessly charged at the enemy.

zh: 这纯粹是无稽之谈。
pinyin: Zhè chúncuì shì wújīzhītán.
en: This is purely nonsense.

zh: 洗澡时搓背很舒服。
pinyin: xǐ zǎo shí cuō bèi hěn shū fu.
en: It feels comfortable to scrub your back while bathing.

zh: 别看他长得那么娘。
pinyin: Bié kàn tā zhǎng de nàme niáng.
en: Don't judge him just because he looks effeminate.

zh: 他自称是无神论者。
pinyin: Tā zìchēng shì wúshénlùnzhě.
en: He professes to be an atheist.

zh: 骏马在旷野中驰腾。
pinyin: jùn mǎ zài kuàng yě zhōng chí téng.
en: The steed is galloping in the wilderness.

zh: 进口货物需要付税。
pinyin: Jìnkǒu huòwù xūyào fù shuì.
en: Imported goods need to pay import duties.

zh: 头痛伴随感冒而来。
pinyin: tóu tòng bàn suí gǎn mào ér lái。
en: A headache accompanies a cold.

zh: 请将调料涂抹均匀。
pinyin: Qǐng jiāng tiáoliào túmǒ jūnyún.
en: Please apply the seasoning so it is homogeneous.

zh: 许多物种已经毁灭。
pinyin: xǔduō wùzhǒng yǐjīng huǐmiè.
en: Many species have perished.

zh: 沉思让他变得安静。
pinyin: chén sī ràng tā biàn dé ān jìng.
en: Contemplation makes him become quiet.

zh: 该项目需提前预约。
pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù xū tíqián yùyuē.
en: This project requires an advance booking.

zh: 电梯可以直达顶层。
pinyin: Diàntī kěyǐ zhídá dǐngcéng.
en: The elevator can reach the top floor directly.

zh: 他因为贪心而堕落。
pinyin: tā yīn wèi tān xīn ér duò luò.
en: He became depraved because of greed.

zh: 这件作为并不容易。
pinyin: zhè jiàn zuò wéi bìng bù róng yì.
en: This deed is not easy.

zh: 他为生计四处奔波。
pinyin: Tā wèi shēngjì sìchù bēnbō.
en: He is constantly on the move everywhere to make a living.

zh: 士兵执行探敌任务。
pinyin: Shìbīng zhíxíng tàn dí rènwù.
en: The soldiers are carrying out a scout-the-enemy mission.

zh: 山泉泻成一道瀑布。
pinyin: shānquán xiè chéng yī dào pùbù.
en: The mountain spring forms a torrent like a waterfall.

zh: 请把图层重叠显示。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ túcéng chóngdié xiǎnshì.
en: Please superimpose the layers to display.

pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì tǎolùn le kuàguó hézuò de wèntí.
en: This meeting discussed issues of transnational cooperation.

zh: 因为时间太久，真相已不得而知。
pinyin: yīnwèi shíjiān tài jiǔ, zhēnxiàng yǐ bù dé ér zhī.
en: Because too much time has passed, I am unable to find out the truth.

zh: 虽然很累，但她的容颜依旧红润。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn tā de róngyán yījiù hóngrùn.
en: Although tired, her complexion remains rosy.

zh: 这些家具是多余的，把它搬走吧。
pinyin: Zhèxiē jiājù shì duōyú de, bǎ tā bān zǒu ba.
en: This furniture is superfluous, move it away.

zh: 为了避开高峰，我们只能走弯路。
pinyin: wèi le bì kāi gāo fēng, wǒ men zhǐ néng zǒu wān lù.

zh: 那个人的背影让我感到似曾相识。
pinyin: nàge rén de bèiyǐng ràng wǒ gǎndào sìcéngxiāngshí.
en: The back of that person looks seemingly familiar to me.

zh: 他不知道怎么办，感到一筹莫展。
pinyin: Tā bù zhīdào zěnme bàn, gǎndào yīchóumòzhǎn.
en: He doesn't know what to do and feels at wits' end.

zh: 这么大的错误，我哪儿担待得起？
pinyin: zhè me dà de cuò wù, wǒ nǎ r dān dài de qǐ?

zh: 我有幸目睹了这一历史性的时刻。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒuxìng mùdǔ le zhè yī lìshǐxìng de shíkè.

zh: 他试图构想一个全新的社会模式。
pinyin: Tā shìtú gòuxiǎng yīgè quánxīn de shèhuì móshìshì.
en: He attempted to conceive a brand new social model.

zh: 古今中外，这种故事都很受欢迎。
pinyin: gǔ jīn zhōng wài, zhè zhǒng gù shì dōu hěn shòu huān yíng.
en: At all times and in all places, this kind of story is very popular.

zh: 改革开放带来了巨大的经济成效。
pinyin: Gǎigé kāifàng dài lái le jùdà de jīngjì chéngxiào.
en: Reform and opening up brought huge economic results.

zh: 他因为那个错误受过严重的指责。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi nàge cuòwù shòuguò yánzhòng de zhǐzé.
en: He has received severe condemnation for that mistake (taken the blame).

zh: 夏天中午的太阳带着强烈的热气。
pinyin: xiàtiān zhōngwǔ de tàiyáng dàizhe qiángliè de rèqì.
en: The summer noon sun carries intense heat.

zh: 领土完整是国家主权的核心内容。
pinyin: Lǐngtǔ wánzhěng shì guójiā zhǔquán de héxīn nèiróng.

zh: 他在艺术领域是一位公认的行家。
pinyin: Tā zài yìshù lǐngyù shì yī wèi gōngrèn de hángjiā.
en: He is a recognized connoisseur in the field of art.

zh: 这个简单的例子包含深刻的寓意。
pinyin: Zhè ge jiǎndān de lìzi bāohán shēnkè de yùyì.
en: This simple example contains a deep lesson.

zh: 这次活动填补了大家经验的空白。
pinyin: zhè cì huó dòng tián bǔ le dà jiā jīng yàn de kòng bái.
en: This activity filled the gap in everyone's experience.

zh: 政府正在向灾区运送重要的物资。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài xiàng zāiqū yùnsòng zhòngyào de wùzī.

pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zài tǎolùn zhège jìhuà shìfǒu kěxíng.
en: Everyone is discussing whether this plan is feasible.

zh: 医生建议他遵循健康的饮食习惯。
pinyin: yī shēng jiàn yì tā zūn xún jiàn kāng de yǐn shí xí guàn.

zh: 这份晚报刊登了最新的国际消息。
pinyin: Zhè fèn wǎnbào kāndēng le zuìxīn de guójì xiāoxī.

zh: 面对这种困境，我们感到很难过。
pinyin: miàn duì zhè zhǒng kùn jìng, wǒ men gǎn dào hěn nán guò.
en: Facing this predicament, we find it very difficult (to handle).

zh: 我们要接受皮肤逐渐老化的事实。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào jiēshòu pífū zhújiàn lǎohuà de shìshí.

zh: 这位富人慷慨地捐赠了他的资产。
pinyin: Zhè wèi fùrén kāngkǎi de juānzèngle tā de zīchǎn.
en: This rich person generously donated his assets.

zh: 这些言论引起了舆论中心的关注。
pinyin: Zhèxiē yánlùn yǐnqǐ le yúlùn zhōngxīn de guānzhù.
en: These remarks have attracted the attention of the center of public opinion.

zh: 这两座山之间有一条明显的界限。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng zuò shān zhījiān yǒu yī tiáo míngxiǎn de jièxiàn.
en: There is a clear boundary between these two mountains.

zh: 如果你感觉不舒服，请尽快求医。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ gǎnjué bù shūfu, qǐng jǐnkuài qiú yī.
en: If you feel unwell, please seek medical treatment as soon as possible.

zh: 他在人工智能方面有深厚的造诣。
pinyin: Tā zài réngōng zhìnéng fāngmiàn yǒu shēnhòu de zàoyì.
en: He has profound attainments in the field of artificial intelligence.

zh: 关教授在学术界享有很高的声誉。
pinyin: Guān jiàoshòu zài xuéshùjiè xiǎngyǒu hěn gāo de shēngyù.
en: Professor Guan enjoys a high reputation in the academic circle.

zh: 他因为比赛赢了，一直得意扬扬。
pinyin: Tā yīn wèi bǐ sài yíng le, yī zhí dé yì yáng yáng.
en: Because he won the competition, he has been triumphant.

zh: 他分析了法律体系中的各个要素。
pinyin: Tā fēnxī le fǎlǜ tǐxì zhōng de gège yàosù.
en: He analyzed every key constituent in the legal system.

zh: 为了公平，一定要惩处那些坏人。
pinyin: wèi le gōng píng, yī dìng yào chéng chǔ nà xiē huài rén.
en: For the sake of fairness, we must administer justice to those bad people.

pinyin: Wèile kàngyì, gōngrénmen juédìng jítǐ dàigōng.
en: To protest, the workers decided to collectively go slow.

zh: 当我们回顾往事，总是很有感慨。
pinyin: Dāng wǒmen huígù wǎngshì, zǒng shì hěn yǒu gǎngǎi.
en: When we look back on the past, we always have many emotions.

zh: 海洋资源对人类的生存至关重要。
pinyin: Hǎiyáng zīyuán duì rénlèi de shēngcún zhìguān zhòngyào.
en: Ocean resources are vital to human survival.

zh: 飞行员成功让飞机在跑道上降落。
pinyin: fēixíngyuán chénggōng ràng fēijī zài pǎodào shàng jiàngluò.
en: The pilot successfully landed the plane on the runway.

zh: 为了来年的计划，我们必须努力。
pinyin: wèile láinián de jìhuà, wǒmen bìxū nǔlì.
en: We must work hard for the plans of the coming year.

pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè zhèngzài wèi xīn xiàngmù jìnxíng zhāobiāo.
en: This enterprise is conducting bidding for the new project.

zh: 他沉迷于吃喝玩乐，荒废了工作。
pinyin: Tā chénmí yú chī hē wán lè, huāngfèi le gōngzuò.
en: He is addicted to a life of pleasure and has neglected his work.

zh: 这件衣服虽然不起眼，但很舒服。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfú suīrán bù qǐyǎn, dàn hěn shūfú.
en: Although this piece of clothing is nothing out of the ordinary, it is very comfortable.

zh: 虽然他很有钱，但外表像个青蛙。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn yǒuqián, dàn wàibiǎo xiàng gè qīngwā.

zh: 这次演习的目标是测试防御能力。
pinyin: Zhè cì yǎnxí de mùbiāo shì cèshì fángyù nénglì.
en: The target of this exercise is to test defensive capabilities.

zh: 大家互相帮助，渡过了这个难关。
pinyin: Dàjiā hùxiāng bāngzhù, dùguòle zhège nánguān.
en: Everyone helped each other and got through this difficulty.

zh: 公园里到处张灯结彩，十分热闹。
pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ dàochù zhāngdēngjiécǎi, shífēn rènao.
en: The park is decorated everywhere with lanterns and colorful banners, looking very lively.

zh: 我们要不断提高自己的工作能力。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào bùduàn tígāo zìjǐ de gōngzuò néng lì.

pinyin: Yóuyú gōngzuò shīwù, tā bèi jīnglǐ kāichú le.
en: Due to a work error, he was fired by the manager.

zh: 这种丑陋的行为会让大家不高兴。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chǒulòu de xíngwéi huì ràng dàjiā bù gāoxìng.
en: This kind of ugly behavior will make everyone unhappy.

zh: 那位教授经常到不同的大学讲学。
pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu jīngcháng dào bùtóng de dàxué jiǎng xué.
en: That professor often goes to different universities to give lectures.

zh: 成功并不是虚幻的，而是要努力。
pinyin: chéng gōng bìng bú shì xū huàn de, ér shì yào nǔ lì.
en: Success is not illusory; it requires hard work.

zh: 我们必须力争在年底前达成目标。
pinyin: wǒmen bìxū lìzhēng zài niándǐ qián dáchéng mùbiāo.
en: We must strive to reach the goal before the end of the year.

zh: 为了这点琐事吵嘴，真是不值得。
pinyin: Wèile zhè diǎn suǒshì chǎozuǐ, zhēnshi bù zhídé.
en: It's really not worth quarreling over such trivial matters.

zh: 这个寓言讽刺了当时社会的黑暗。
pinyin: Zhège yùyán fěngcìle dāngshí shèhuì de hēi'àn.
en: This fable satirized the darkness of the society at that time.

pinyin: Wèile jiǎnqīng tòngkǔ, yīshēng juédìng mázuì tā.
en: To reduce the pain, the doctor decided to anesthetize him.

pinyin: Bó wù guǎn lǐ bǎi shè zhe zhēn guì de lì shǐ wén wù.
en: Precious historical artifacts are displayed in the museum.

pinyin: zhè ge xiāo xi xùn sù kuò sàn dào le quán guó gè dì.
en: The news spread rapidly to all parts of the country.

pinyin: Dàjiā yī gǔ zuò qì, zhōngyú pá dào le shāndǐng.
en: With a spurt of energy, everyone finally climbed to the top of the mountain.

pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chuántǒng láiyuányú jǐ bǎi nián qián de wénhuà.
en: This tradition originates from the culture of several hundred years ago.

pinyin: Nàgè gēshǒu gǎibiān le xǔduō chuántǒng de míngē.

pinyin: dú wán zhè běn xiǎo shuō, wǒ xīn zhōng gǎn kǎi liáng duō.

en: Summering in the mountains, the climate is very cool and pleasant.

zh: 我们应该学会感恩生活中的一切。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi xuéhuì gǎn'ēn shēnghuó zhōng de yīqiè.

zh: 遇到事情不要发热，要多想办法。

pinyin: Tā suīrán hé wǒ xiāngshí, dàn bù tài liǎojiě wǒ.
en: Although he is an acquaintance of mine, he doesn't know me very well.

zh: 这家小店每年年底都会认真算账。
pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎodiàn měinián niándǐ dūhuì rènzhēn suànzhàng.
en: This small shop carefully balances the books at the end of every year.

pinyin: Wǒ tōngguò kēhuàn xiǎngxiàng chuàngzào le yīgè shìjiè.

zh: 这里的花香让他感觉鼻子痒痒的。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ de huāxiāng ràng tā gǎnjué bízi yǎngyang de.
en: The fragrance of the flowers here makes his nose feel itchy.

pinyin: Wèile bácū zhè kē shù, dàjiā yīqǐ yònglì.
en: In order to pull out this tree, everyone exerted their strength together.

zh: 他为了这个剧本付出了很多心血。
pinyin: Tā wèile zhège jùběn fùchūle hěnduō xīnxuè.
en: He put a lot of hard work into this script.

zh: 当着大家的面，你别让他过不去。
pinyin: Dāngzhe dàjiā de miàn, nǐ bié ràng tā guòbuqù.

zh: 这个想法起源于他们发起的讨论。
pinyin: zhè gè xiǎng fǎ qǐ yuán yú tā men fā qǐ de tǎo lùn 。

zh: 少儿教育对儿童的成长至关重要。
pinyin: Shào'ér jiàoyù duì értóng de chéngzhǎng zhìguān zhòngyào.

zh: 每个人都有自己独一无二的特点。

zh: 虽然工作很累，但他从不发怨言。

zh: 由于视力问题，他的目光不太好。

zh: 如果你在场的话，一定会很惊讶。

zh: 在大家面前表演，他感到很害羞。

zh: 这部电影引起了广大观众的共鸣。
