pinyin: zài zī běn zhǔ yì shè huì zhōng, jìng zhēng shí fēn jī liè.
en: In capitalist society, competition is very fierce.

zh: 不管以后发生什么，我都会支持你。
pinyin: Bùguǎn yǐhòu fāshēng shénme, wǒ dūhuì zhīchí nǐ.
en: No matter what happens later, I will support you.

zh: 为了身体健康，你应该多注意血压。
pinyin: Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, nǐ yīnggāi duō zhùyì xuèyā.
en: For the sake of your health, you should pay more attention to your blood pressure.

zh: 这位演员每天都很忙，一直在拍戏。
pinyin: Zhè wèi yǎnyuán měitiān dōu hěn máng, yīzhí zài pāixì.
en: This actor is very busy every day, always filming.

zh: 她那讨人喜欢的微笑总是让人开心。
pinyin: Tā nà tǎorénxǐhuan de wēixiào zǒngshì ràng rén kāixīn.
en: Her charming smile always makes people happy.

zh: 这部电影讲述了古代皇宫里的故事。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎngshù le gǔdài huánggōng lǐ de gùshì.
en: This movie tells the story of the ancient imperial palace.

zh: 最近他总是旷课，成绩下降了很多。
pinyin: Zuìjìn tā zǒngshì kuàngkè, chéngjì xiàjiàng le hěnduō.
en: He has been cutting classes lately, and his grades have dropped a lot.

zh: 我们可以把这些植物移植到花园里。
pinyin: wǒ men kě yǐ bǎ zhè xiē zhí wù yí zhí dào huā yuán lǐ.
en: We can transplant these plants into the garden.

zh: 他即便在寒冷的冬天也坚持去游泳。
pinyin: tā jí biàn zài hán lěng de dōng tiān yě jiān chí qù yóu yǒng.
en: He insists on going to swim even in the cold winter.

zh: 他得知亲人去世的消息后非常悲伤。
pinyin: tā dé zhī qīn rén qù shì de xiāo xi hòu fēi cháng bēi shāng.
en: He was very sad after learning the news of his relative's passing.

zh: 为了实现诺言，他一直在努力工作。
pinyin: Wèile shíxiàn nuòyán, tā yīzhí zài nǔlì gōngzuò.
en: In order to fulfill his promise, he has been working hard.

zh: 雨后的天空出现了一道美丽的彩虹。
pinyin: yǔ hòu de tiān kōng chū xiàn le yī dào měi lì de cǎi hóng.
en: A beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky after the rain.

zh: 她大学毕业以后一直从事外贸工作。
pinyin: Tā dà xué bì yè yǐ hòu yī zhí cóng shì wài mào gōng zuò.
en: Since she graduated from university, she has been working in foreign trade.

zh: 他深感抱歉，希望能得到你的原谅。
pinyin: tā shēn gǎn bào qiàn, xī wàng néng dé dào nǐ de yuán liàng.
en: He feels deeply apologetic and hopes to receive your forgiveness.

zh: 为了安全，在山路上最好不要超车。
pinyin: Wèile ānquán, zài shānlù shàng zuìhǎo bùyào chāochē.
en: For safety, it is best not to overtake on mountain roads.

zh: 为了比赛，他每天锻炼，劲头很大。
pinyin: wèile bǐsài, tā měitiān duànliàn, jìntóu hěn dà.
en: He exercises every day for the competition with great vigor.

zh: 虽然条件很苛刻，但他还是接受了。
pinyin: suī rán tiáo jiàn hěn kē kè, dàn tā hái shì jiē shòu le.
en: Although the conditions were very harsh, he still accepted them.

zh: 由于性格果断，他很快完成了任务。
pinyin: Yóuyú xìnggé guǒduàn, tā hěn kuài wánchéngle rènwù.
en: Due to his firm character, he completed the task quickly.

zh: 中国在国际经济中发挥着重要作用。
pinyin: Zhōngguó zài guójì jīngjì zhōng fāhuīzhe zhòngyào zuòyòng.
en: China plays an important role in the international economy.

zh: 那位工人正踩着梯子进行维修工作。
pinyin: Nà wèi gōngrén zhèng cǎizhe tīzi jìnxíng wéixiū gōngzuò.
en: The worker is stepping on the ladder to perform maintenance work.

zh: 这栋建筑的右边装饰着精美的图案。
pinyin: Zhè dòng jiànzhù de yòubian zhuāngshìzhe jīngměi de tú'àn.
en: The right side of this building is decorated with exquisite patterns.

zh: 这位艺术家正在为我们演奏小提琴。
pinyin: zhè wèi yì shù jiā zhèng zài wèi wǒ men yǎn zòu xiǎo tí qín.
en: This artist is playing the violin for us.

zh: 老师走进教室，里面立刻鸦雀无声。
pinyin: Lǎoshī zǒujìn jiàoshì, lǐmiàn lìkè yā què wú shēng.
en: The teacher walked into the classroom, and it immediately fell into absolute silence.

zh: 他习惯在微信上处理日常工作事务。
pinyin: Tā xíguàn zài Wēixìn shàng chǔlǐ rìcháng gōngzuò shìwù.
en: He is used to handling daily work tasks on WeChat.

zh: 他们在月光下散步，感到无比浪漫。
pinyin: Tāmen zài yuèguāng xià sànbù, gǎndào wúbǐ làngmàn.
en: They walked under the moonlight and felt incredibly romantic.

zh: 我们正在征集有关环境保护的建议。
pinyin: wǒ men zhèng zài zhēng jí yǒu guān huán jìng bǎo hù de jiàn yì.
en: We are collecting suggestions regarding environmental protection.

zh: 为了确保准确，我们精确地倒计时。
pinyin: Wèile quèbǎo zhǔnquè, wǒmen jīngquè de dàojìshí.
en: To ensure accuracy, we count down precisely.

zh: 他不小心说错话，被对方甩了嘴巴。
pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn shuō cuò huà, bèi duìfāng shuǎi le zuǐba.
en: He misspoke accidentally and was slapped in the face by the other party.

zh: 这家公司的办公场地租金非常昂贵。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de bàngōng chǎngdì zūjīn fēicháng ángguì.
en: The rent for this company's office space is very expensive.

zh: 他每天都练习，难怪他踢球踢得好。
pinyin: tā měi tiān dōu liàn xí, nán guài tā tī qiú tī de hǎo.
en: He practices every day, it is not surprising that he plays football well.

zh: 她从小就对绘画表现出浓厚的兴趣。
pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù duì huìhuà biǎoxiàn chū nónghòu de xìngqù.
en: She has shown a keen interest in drawing since she was a child.

zh: 每年都有很多人参加义务献血活动。
pinyin: Měinián dōu yǒu hěnduō rén cānjiā yìwù xiàn xuè huódòng.
en: Every year many people participate in voluntary blood donation activities.

zh: 在这个冷门领域进行研究很有挑战。
pinyin: Zài zhège lěng mén lǐngyù jìnxíng yánjiū hěn yǒu tiǎozhàn.
en: Doing research in this neglected field is challenging.

zh: 他认真钻研这份功课的每一个细节。
pinyin: Tā rènzhēn zuānyán zhè fèn gōngkè de měi yīgè xìjié.
en: He carefully studied every detail of the assignment.

zh: 员工手册规定了所有人的工作职责。
pinyin: Yuángōng shǒucè guīdìng le suǒyǒu rén de gōngzuò zhízé.
en: The employee handbook specifies everyone's job responsibilities.

zh: 政府鼓励大学生创办高新技术企业。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ gǔlì dàxuéshēng chuàngbàn gāoxīn jìshù qǐyè.
en: The government encourages university students to start high-tech companies.

zh: 那尖锐的指甲深深地陷入了木头里。
pinyin: Nà jiānruì de zhǐjia shēnshēn de xiànrù le mùtou lǐ.
en: Those sharp fingernails sank deep into the wood.

zh: 在专业领域，他表现得像个小学生。
pinyin: zài zhuān yè lǐng yù, tā biǎo xiàn de xiàng gè xiǎo xué shēng.
en: In the professional field, he acts like a beginner.

zh: 他的表情千变万化，让人难以猜测。
pinyin: Tā de biǎoqíng qiānbiànwànhuà, ràng rén nányǐ cāicè.
en: His expressions are in a state of constant permutation, making it hard to guess his thoughts.

zh: 我们既要发展经济，也要兼顾环境。
pinyin: Wǒmen jì yào fāzhǎn jīngjì, yě yào jiāngù huánjìng.
en: We must develop the economy while also taking care of the environment.

zh: 你应该经常带你的宠物出来遛一遛。
pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi jīngcháng dài nǐ de chǒngwù chūlái liù yī liù.
en: You should often bring your pet out for a walk.

zh: 他不仅精通华语，还了解中国文化。
pinyin: Tā bùjǐn jīngtōng Huáyǔ, hái liǎojiě Zhōngguó wénhuà.
en: He is not only proficient in Chinese but also understands Chinese culture.

zh: 经理一直在催促我们完成这份工作。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ yīzhí zài cuīcù wǒmen wánchéng zhè fèn gōngzuò.
en: The manager has been urging us to finish this work.

zh: 小船在风浪中遇险，大家都很担心。
pinyin: xiǎochuán zài fēnglàng zhōng yùxiǎn, dàjiā dōu hěn dānxīn.
en: The small boat got into difficulties in the waves, and everyone was very worried.

zh: 请您核对一下刚才输入的证件号码。
pinyin: Qǐng nín héduì yīxià gāngcái shūrù de zhèngjiàn hàomǎ.
en: Please verify the ID number you just entered.

zh: 他们的关系从普通朋友演变为情人。
pinyin: tā men de guān xi cóng pǔ tōng péng yǒu yǎn biàn wéi qíng rén.
en: Their relationship evolved from ordinary friends to lovers.

zh: 他在舞台上表演，让观众前仰后合。
pinyin: tā zài wǔtái shàng biǎoyǎn, ràng guānzhòng qián yǎng hòu hé.
en: He performed on stage, making the audience rock back and forth.

zh: 因为缺席了考试，我需要参加补课。
pinyin: Yīnwèi quēxí le kǎoshì, wǒ xūyào cānjiā bǔkè.
en: Because I missed the exam, I need to attend a make-up lesson.

zh: 那次交通事故造成的损失非常惨重。
pinyin: Nà cì jiāotōng shìgù zàochéng de sǔnshī fēicháng cǎnzhòng.
en: The losses caused by that traffic accident were disastrous.

zh: 春天到了，花园里的花朵开始绽放。
pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, huāyuán lǐ de huāduǒ kāishǐ zhànfàng.
en: Spring has arrived, and the flowers in the garden have started to bloom.

zh: 我们要勇敢地面对眼前的这座高山。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào yǒnggǎn de miànduì yǎnqián de zhè zuò gāoshān.
en: We must bravely face the high mountain in front of us.

zh: 他耳闻目睹了这座城市的巨大变化。
pinyin: Tā ěr wén mù dǔ le zhè zuò chéngshì de jùdà biànhuà.
en: He personally witnessed the huge changes in this city.

zh: 听到消息后，人群哄的一声散开了。
pinyin: tīng dào xiāo xi hòu rén qún hòng de yī shēng sàn kāi le
en: Upon hearing the news, the crowd dispersed with a tumult.

zh: 他在深夜里发出了一些奇怪的声响。
pinyin: Tā zài shēnyè lǐ fāchūle yīxiē qíguài de shēngxiǎng.
en: He made some odd noises in the dead of night.

zh: 那个坏人到处呼风唤雨，制造麻烦。
pinyin: nàge huàirén dàochù hū fēng huàn yǔ, zhìzào máfan.
en: That bad person goes everywhere stirring up trouble.

zh: 这些观念在现代社会显得非常陈旧。
pinyin: Zhèxiē guānniàn zài xiàndài shèhuì xiǎnde fēicháng chénjiù.
en: These concepts appear very old-fashioned in modern society.

zh: 童话书里描述了一个长相可怕的巨人。
pinyin: Tónghuà shū lǐ miáoshùle yīgè zhǎngxiàng kěpà de jùrén.
en: The fairy tale book described a scary-looking giant.

zh: 每个人都看到了他脸上的那个耳光印。
pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu kàn dào le tā liǎn shàng de nà gè ěrguāng yìn.
en: Everyone saw the slap mark on his face.

zh: 他在领事馆工作，负责处理签证申请。
pinyin: Tā zài lǐngshìguǎn gōngzuò, fùzé chǔlǐ qiānzhèng shēnqǐng.
en: He works at the consulate and is responsible for handling visa applications.

zh: 这家餐馆的味道不亚于市中心的那家。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cānguǎn de wèidào bù yà yú shì zhōngxīn de nà jiā.
en: The taste of this restaurant is not inferior to the one in the city center.

zh: 这件事情重要与否，取决于你的想法。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng zhòngyào yǔ fǒu, qǔjué yú nǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
en: Whether this matter is important or not depends on your thoughts.

zh: 如果产品有问题，请及时给我们反馈。
pinyin: Rúguǒ chǎnpǐn yǒu wèntí, qǐng jíshí gěi wǒmen fǎnkuì.
en: If there is a problem with the product, please give us feedback in time.

zh: 为了未来的生活，他考虑了后顾之忧。
pinyin: Wèile wèilái de shēnghuó, tā kǎolǜle hòugùzhīyōu.
en: For his future life, he considered the future consequences.

zh: 虽然我们要各奔前程，但会一直联系。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen yào gè bèn qián chéng, dàn huì yīzhí liánxì.
en: Although we are going our separate ways, we will stay in touch.

zh: 老师讲故事的声音抑扬顿挫，很有趣。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎng gùshì de shēngyīn yìyángdùncuò, hěn yǒuqù.
en: The teacher's voice when telling the story had varied intonation, which was very interesting.

zh: 他一向性格温和，很少对同事发脾气。
pinyin: Tā yīxiàng xìnggé wēnhé, hěn shǎo duì tóngshì fā píqì.
en: He has always had a gentle personality and rarely loses his temper with colleagues.

zh: 我们可以通过运动来补偿身体的虚弱。
pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ tōngguò yùndòng lái bǔcháng shēntǐ de xūruò.
en: We can make up for physical weakness through exercise.

zh: 他小学时期就表现出卓越的艺术天赋。
pinyin: Tā xiǎoxué shíqī jiù biǎoxiàn chū zhuóyuè de yìshù tiānfù.
en: He showed excellent artistic talent during his elementary school years.

zh: 出国旅行前，我先去银行兑换了外币。
pinyin: Chūguó lǚxíng qián, wǒ xiān qù yínháng duìhuànle wàibì.
en: Before traveling abroad, I went to the bank to exchange foreign currency.

zh: 因为前面有车祸，所以我们要迟到了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi qiánmiàn yǒu chēhuò, suǒyǐ wǒmen yào chídào le.
en: Because there is a traffic accident ahead, we are going to be late.

zh: 我们要提倡理性消费，避免盲目跟风。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào tíchàng lǐxìng xiāofèi, bìmiǎn mángmù gēnfēng.
en: We should promote rational consumption and avoid following the trend blindly.

zh: 教授点评了学生论文中的每一个观点。
pinyin: Jiào shòu diǎn píng le xué shēng lùn wén zhōng de měi yī gè guān diǎn.
en: The professor provided a point-by-point critique of every argument in the student's thesis.

zh: 暴雨过后，树木横七竖八地倒在路上。
pinyin: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, shùmù héngqīshùbā de dào zài lùshàng.
en: After the rainstorm, trees fell in disorder on the road.

zh: 起重机的钩子悬挂在巨大的机器上方。
pinyin: qǐ zhòng jī de gōu zi xuán guà zài jù dà de jī qì shàng fāng.
en: The crane's hook is suspended above the massive machine.

zh: 如果你咳嗽得厉害，就应该去看医生。
pinyin: Rúguǒ késou de lìhai, jiù yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
en: If your cough is severe, you should go see a doctor.

zh: 他不喜欢在公共场合张扬自己的成就。
pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuān zài gōnggòng chǎnghé zhāngyáng zìjǐ de chéngjiù.
en: He does not like to show off his achievements in public.

zh: 我们要脚踏实地，不要总是异想天开。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào jiǎotàshídì, bùyào zǒng shì yì xiǎng tiān kāi.
en: We must be down-to-earth and not always have wild fantasies.

zh: 看到这些旧照片，他感叹过去的生活。
pinyin: kàn dào zhè xiē jiù zhào piàn, tā gǎn tàn guò qù de shēng huó.
en: Seeing these old photos, he lamented his past life.

zh: 医生说，严重的呕吐可能会导致脱水。
pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, yánzhòng de ǒutù kěnéng huì dǎozhì tuōshuǐ.
en: The doctor said that severe vomiting might lead to dehydration.

zh: 虽然工作完成了，但我还是感到烦闷。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò wánchéngle, dàn wǒ háishì gǎndào fánmèn.
en: Although the work is finished, I still feel moody.

zh: 这道简单的数学题对他来说轻而易举。
pinyin: Zhè dào jiǎndān de shùxué tí duì tā lái shuō qīng'éryìjǔ.
en: This simple math problem is easy for him.

zh: 我们不仅要看重形式，更要看重内容。
pinyin: Wǒmen bùjǐn yào kànzhòng xíngshì, gèng yào kànzhòng nèiróng.
en: We should not only value the form, but also the content.

zh: 如果你感到头晕，最好立刻躺下休息。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ gǎndào tóuyūn, zuì hǎo lìkè tǎng xià xiūxi.
en: If you feel dizzy, it is best to lie down and rest immediately.

zh: 看到那张照片，他当即认出了那个人。
pinyin: Kàndào nà zhāng zhàopiàn, tā dāngjí rènchū le nàge rén.
en: Seeing the photo, he recognized that person on the spot.

zh: 她正在阅读一本关于天文的专业书籍。
pinyin: Tā zhèngzài yuèdú yī běn guānyú tiānwén de zhuānyè shūjí.
en: She is reading a professional book about astronomy.

zh: 这不仅是任意的规则，而且很不公平。
pinyin: Zhè bùjǐn shì rènyì de guīzé, érqiě hěn bù gōngpíng.
en: This is not only an arbitrary rule but also very unfair.

zh: 公司经理正在考虑谁是合适的接班人。
pinyin: gōng sī jīng lǐ zhèng zài kǎo lǜ shéi shì hé shì de jiē bān rén.
en: The company manager is considering who is a suitable successor.

zh: 听了这个消息，大家禁不住鼓起掌来。
pinyin: Tīng le zhège xiāoxi, dàjiā jīnbuzhù gǔ qǐ zhǎng lái.
en: Hearing the news, everyone couldn't help but applaud.

zh: 包院士在科学领域做出了卓越的贡献。
pinyin: Bāo yuànshì zài kēxué lǐngyù zuòchū le zhuóyuè de gòngxiàn.
en: Academician Bao has made outstanding contributions in the field of science.

zh: 虽然我们分开了，但我一直挂念着你。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen fēnkāi le, dàn wǒ yīzhí guàniànzhe nǐ.
en: Although we are separated, I have been feeling anxious about you all along.

zh: 公园里种着许多奇花异草，非常漂亮。
pinyin: gōngyuán lǐ zhòngzhe xǔduō qíhuāyìcǎo, fēicháng piàoliang.
en: The park is planted with many rare and exotic flowers and herbs, which is very beautiful.

zh: 所有的观众都期待着奥运会的开幕式。
pinyin: Suǒyǒu de guānzhòng dōu qīdài zhe Àoyùnhuì de kāimùshì.
en: All the spectators are looking forward to the Olympic opening ceremony.

zh: 无论你怎么悔恨，错误都已经发生了。
pinyin: wúlùn nǐ zěnme huǐhèn, cuòwù dōu yǐjīng fāshēng le.
en: No matter how you repent, the mistake has already happened.

zh: 他习惯饭后嚼一块口香糖来清新口气。
pinyin: Tā xíguàn fànhòu jiáo yī kuài kǒuxiāngtáng lái qīngxīn kǒuqì.
en: He has a habit of chewing a piece of gum after a meal to freshen his breath.

zh: 考虑到大局，我们还是谨慎行事为妙。
pinyin: Kǎolǜ dào dàjú, wǒmen hái shì jǐnshèn xíngshì wéi miào.
en: Considering the big picture, we had better act with caution.

zh: 春节的时候，大街小巷都挂着红灯笼。
pinyin: chūn jié de shí hòu, dà jiē xiǎo xiàng dōu guà zhe hóng dēng lóng.
en: During the Spring Festival, red lanterns are hung in the big streets and small alleys.

zh: 这家公司打算雇佣更多有经验的工人。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī dǎsuàn gùyōng gèng duō yǒu jīngyàn de gōngrén.
en: This company plans to employ more experienced workers.

zh: 他在会上引用了一句关于成功的名言。
pinyin: Tā zài huìshàng yǐnyòngle yī jù guānyú chénggōng de míngyán.
en: He quoted a famous remark about success at the meeting.

zh: 面对大家，他心里火辣辣的，很着急。
pinyin: miàn duì dà jiā ， tā xīn lǐ huǒ là là de ， hěn zháo jí 。
en: Facing everyone, he feels agitated and anxious.

zh: 我实在没有多余的精力处理这些琐事。
pinyin: Wǒ shízài méiyǒu duōyú de jīnglì chǔlǐ zhèxiē suǒshì.
en: I really don't have spare energy to deal with these trivial matters.

zh: 他们在那座华丽的建筑里举行了婚礼。
pinyin: Tāmen zài nà zuò huáli de jiànzhù lǐ jǔxíngle hūnlǐ.
en: They held their wedding in that gorgeous building.

zh: 政府不仅提供了抚恤，还安排了工作。
pinyin: zhèng fǔ bù jǐn tí gōng le fǔ xù, hái ān pái le gōng zuò.
en: The government not only provided financial relief but also arranged jobs.

zh: 北京的胡同儿体现了深厚的文化底蕴。
pinyin: Běijīng de hú tòng r tǐxiànle shēnhòu de wénhuà dǐyùn.
en: Beijing's hutongs embody a profound cultural heritage.

zh: 会议推迟了，由此可见项目出了问题。
pinyin: Huìyì tuīchí le, yóu cǐ kě jiàn xiàngmù chū le wèntí.
en: The meeting was postponed; from this, it is evident that there is a problem with the project.

zh: 因为工作，我有机会结识许多聪明人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò, wǒ yǒu jīhuì jiéshí xǔduō cōngmíng rén.
en: Because of my work, I have the chance to get to know many smart people.

zh: 这部电影改编自一个有名的小说本事。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng gǎibiān zì yīgè yǒumíng de xiǎoshuō běnshì.
en: This movie is adapted from a famous original story.

zh: 他一个人承包了整个部门的清理工作。
pinyin: tā yīgè rén chéngbāo le zhěnggè bùmén de qīnglǐ gōngzuò.
en: He single-handedly undertook the cleaning work for the entire department.

zh: 虽然生活有很多苦难，但我们要努力。
pinyin: Suīrán shēnghuó yǒu hěnduō kǔnàn, dàn wǒmen yào nǔlì.
en: Although life has much suffering, we must work hard.

zh: 因为准备得很充分，他显得胸有成竹。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhǔnbèi de hěn chōngfèn, tā xiǎnde xiōngyǒuchéngzhú.
en: Because he is well prepared, he appears to have a plan in mind.

zh: 虽然他们的背景不同，但有很多共性。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen de bèijǐng bùtóng, dàn yǒu hěnduō gòngxìng.
en: Although their backgrounds are different, they have many commonalities.

zh: 这些数字标示了我们需要注意的重点。
pinyin: Zhèxiē shùzì biāoshìle wǒmen xūyào zhùyì de zhòngdiǎn.
en: These numbers indicate the main points we need to pay attention to.

zh: 法律面前人人平等，谁都不能得罪它。
pinyin: Fǎlǜ miànqián rénrén píngděng, shéi dōu bùnéng dézuì tā.
en: Everyone is equal before the law; no one can violate it.

zh: 这本书有两部分，后者比前者更简单。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒu liǎng bùfèn, hòuzhě bǐ qiánzhě gèng jiǎndān.
en: This book has two parts; the latter is simpler than the former.

zh: 他编造的这个借口显得非常荒谬好笑。
pinyin: Tā biānzào de zhège jièkǒu xiǎnde fēicháng huāngmiù hǎoxiào.
en: The excuse he fabricated seems very absurd and laughable.

zh: 公司致力于消除工作中的性别不平等。
pinyin: Gōngsī zhìlì yú xiāochú gōngzuò zhōng de xìngbié bù píngděng.
en: The company is committed to eliminating gender inequality at work.

zh: 这栋大楼的每一层都有独立的洗手间。
pinyin: zhè dòng dàlóu de měi yī céng dōu yǒu dúlì de xǐshǒujiān.
en: Every floor of this building has an independent toilet.

zh: 环境对人的性格有着潜移默化的改变。
pinyin: huánjìng duì rén de xìnggé yǒuzhe qiányímòhuà de gǎibiàn.
en: The environment has an imperceptible influence on a person's character.

zh: 不管年纪多大，都要保持一颗好奇心。
pinyin: bùguǎn niánjì duō dà, dōu yào bǎochí yì kē hàoqíxīn.
en: No matter how old you are, you should always maintain curiosity.

zh: 如果你不认识这个词，可以查找词典。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù rènshi zhège cí, kěyǐ cházhǎo cídiǎn.
en: If you don't know this word, you can look it up in the dictionary.

zh: 无论发生什么，我都会坚持我的原则。
pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme, wǒ dūhuì jiānchí wǒ de yuánzé.
en: No matter what happens, I will stick to my principles.

zh: 不要总是待在家里，不然会孤陋寡闻。
pinyin: Bùyào zǒngshì dāi zài jiālǐ, bùrán huì gūlòuguǎwén.
en: Don't always stay at home, otherwise you will be ignorant and inexperienced.

zh: 无论发生什么，我都会守护在你身边。
pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme, wǒ dūhuì shǒuhù zài nǐ shēnbiān.
en: No matter what happens, I will protect you by your side.

zh: 通过这次经历，我领悟了生活的意义。
pinyin: tōng guò zhè cì jīng lì, wǒ lǐng wù le shēng huó de yì yì.
en: Through this experience, I understood the meaning of life.

zh: 这件事做得对不对，每个人见仁见智。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zuò dé duì bù duì, měi gè rén jiàn rén jiàn zhì.
en: Whether doing this thing is right or wrong is a matter of opinion.

zh: 大家都很努力，我不由得加快了速度。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu hěn nǔlì, bùyóude jiākuàile sùdù.
en: Everyone is working hard, I cannot but speed up.

zh: 天色顿时暗了下来，看样子要下雨了。
pinyin: Tiānsè dùnshí ànle xiàlái, kànyàngzi yào xiàyǔ le.
en: The sky immediately darkened; it looks like it is going to rain.

zh: 通过多年的工作，他累积了不少财富。
pinyin: tōngguò duōnián de gōngzuò, tā lěijī le bù shǎo cáifù.
en: Through many years of work, he has accumulated quite a bit of wealth.

zh: 由于气候适宜，这里的橘子产量很高。
pinyin: yóu yú qì hòu shì yí, zhè lǐ de jú zi chǎn liàng hěn gāo.
en: Due to the suitable climate, the production of tangerines here is very high.

zh: 由于工作压力，他的生活节奏紊乱了。
pinyin: yóuyú gōngzuò yālì, tā de shēnghuó jiézòu wěnluàn le.
en: Due to work pressure, his life rhythm is in disorder.

zh: 他从德国带回了一些传统的特产香肠。
pinyin: Tā cóng Déguó dài huí le yīxiē chuántǒng de tèchǎn xiāngcháng.
en: He brought back some traditional specialty sausages from Germany.

zh: 我们要共同努力，抵制各种不正之风。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào gòngtóng nǔlì, dǐzhì gè zhǒng bù zhèng zhī fēng.
en: We must work together to resist all kinds of unhealthy tendencies.

zh: 你提出的条件太苛刻，我确实办不到。
pinyin: Nǐ tíchū de tiáojiàn tài kēkè, wǒ quèshí bàn bu dào.
en: The conditions you proposed are too harsh; I really cannot do it.

zh: 由于用力过猛，他的衣服袖子开花了。
pinyin: Yóuyú yònglì guòměng, tā de yīfu xiùzi kāihuā le.
en: Because he used too much force, the sleeve of his shirt ripped open.

zh: 别看他平时不太说话，其实他很幽默。
pinyin: Bié kàn tā píngshí bú tài shuōhuà, qíshí tā hěn yōumò.
en: Don't be fooled by the fact that he doesn't talk much; he is actually very humorous.

zh: 这家公司有足够的财力完成这个项目。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yǒu zúgòu de cái lì wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
en: This company has sufficient financial resources to complete this project.

zh: 他习惯在工作间隙吃点零食来缓解压力。
pinyin: Tā xíguàn zài gōngzuò jiànxì chī diǎn língshí lái huǎnjiě yālì.
en: He is in the habit of eating snacks during work breaks to relieve stress.

zh: 为了解决问题，学校采取了一些新举措。
pinyin: Wèile jiějué wèntí, xuéxiào cǎiqǔle yīxiē xīn jǔcuò.
en: In order to solve the problem, the school has taken some new moves.

zh: 看着窗外的美景，我不知不觉地入迷了。
pinyin: Kàn zhe chuāngwài de měijǐng, wǒ bù zhī bù jué de rùmí le.
en: Looking at the beautiful scenery outside the window, I was unconsciously fascinated.

zh: 那个问题的关系错综复杂，很难说清楚。
pinyin: Nà gè wèn tí de guān xì cuò zōng fù zá, hěn nán shuō qīng chǔ.
en: The relationships of that issue are tangled and complicated; it is hard to explain clearly.

zh: 这个国家的出口大于进口，所以有顺差。
pinyin: zhège guójiā de chūkǒu dàyú jìnkǒu, suǒyǐ yǒu shùn chā.
en: This country's exports are greater than its imports, so it has a surplus.

zh: 通过这次假期，我们加深了彼此的了解。
pinyin: Tōngguò zhè cì jiàqī, wǒmen jiāshēn le bǐcǐ de liǎojiě.
en: Through this vacation, we deepened our understanding of each other.

zh: 即便生活很艰难，他们也没考虑过离婚。
pinyin: jíbiàn shēnghuó hěn jiānnán, tāmen yě méi kǎolǜ guò líhūn.
en: Even though life was very difficult, they never considered divorce.

zh: 这种损人利己的行为，大家都非常讨厌。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng sǔn rén lì jǐ de xíngwéi, dàjiā dōu fēicháng tǎoyàn.
en: Everyone hates this kind of behavior that harms others for personal gain.

zh: 他花了一年时间整理并撰写了这部传记。
pinyin: Tā huā le yī nián shíjiān zhěnglǐ bìng zhuànxiě le zhè bù zhuànjì.
en: He spent a year organizing and writing this biography.

zh: 他匆忙洗澡后，便投入到紧张的工作中。
pinyin: Tā cōngmáng xǐzǎo hòu, biàn tóurù dào jǐnzhāng de gōngzuò zhōng.
en: After a hurried shower, he plunged into his intensive work.

zh: 为了不被发现，他一动不动地躲在树后。
pinyin: wèile bù bèi fāxiàn, tā yī dòng bù dòng de duǒ zài shù hòu.
en: In order not to be discovered, he hid behind the tree motionless.

zh: 为了增加房间的情调，她点了几根蜡烛。
pinyin: Wèile zēngjiā fángjiān de qíngdiào, tā diǎnle jǐ gēn làzhú.
en: To enhance the ambience of the room, she lit a few candles.

zh: 通过调查，我们了解了事情的来龙去脉。
pinyin: tōng guò diào chá, wǒ men liǎo jiě le shì qing de lái lóng qù mài.
en: Through the investigation, we understood the sequence of events.

zh: 孩子们在公园里踢足球，玩得不亦乐乎。
pinyin: Háizimen zài gōngyuán lǐ tī zúqiú, wán de bù yì lè hū.
en: The children are playing soccer in the park, having a great time.

zh: 为了实现梦想，他死心塌地地努力工作。
pinyin: Wèile shíxiàn mèngxiǎng, tā sǐ xīn tā dì de nǔlì gōngzuò.
en: To realize his dream, he is hell-bent on working hard.

zh: 大家都来到车站送别即将出国留学的他。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu láidào chēzhàn sòngbié jíjiāng chūguó liúxué de tā.
en: Everyone came to the station to see him off as he was about to study abroad.

zh: 为了方便大家，请不要在这个地方施工。
pinyin: Wèile fāngbiàn dàjiā, qǐng bùyào zài zhège dìfāng shī gōng.
en: For everyone's convenience, please do not carry out construction here.

zh: 汉字的演变反映了中国文化的悠久历史。
pinyin: Hànzì de yǎnbiàn fǎnyìng le Zhōngguó wénhuà de yōujiǔ lìshǐ.
en: The evolution of Chinese characters reflects the long history of Chinese culture.

zh: 我们怀着激动的心情迎接新一年的挑战。
pinyin: Wǒmen huáizhe jīdòng de xīnqíng yíngjiē xīn yī nián de tiǎozhàn.
en: We are looking forward to welcoming the challenges of the new year with excitement.

zh: 摄影师成功地捕捉到了这个精彩的瞬间。
pinyin: Shèyǐngshī chénggōng de bǔzhuō dào le zhège jīngcǎi de shùnjiān.
en: The photographer successfully captured this wonderful moment.

zh: 多亏没下雨，我们的活动进行得很顺利。
pinyin: Duōkuī méi xiàyǔ, wǒmen de huódòng jìnxíng de hěn shùnlì.
en: Luckily it didn't rain, so our activity went very smoothly.

zh: 透过现象看本质是认识事物的重要方法。
pinyin: Tòuguò xiànxiàng kàn běnzhì shì rènshí shìwù de zhòngyào fāngfǎ.
en: Looking past appearances to see the essence is an important method for understanding things.

zh: 既然他执意要走，我们也不便强加阻拦。
pinyin: jì rán tā zhí yì yào zǒu, wǒ men yě bú biàn qiáng jiā zǔ lán.
en: Since he is determined to leave, it is not appropriate for us to try and stop him.

zh: 通过这次交流，我们的关系必定会更好。
pinyin: Tōngguò zhè cì jiāoliú, wǒmen de guānxì bìdìng huì gèng hǎo.
en: Through this communication, our relationship is sure to get better.

zh: 在那个大人物眼中，我的意见无足轻重。
pinyin: Zài nàge dàrénwù yǎnzhōng, wǒ de yìjiàn wú zú qīng zhòng.
en: In the eyes of that important person, my opinion is insignificant.

zh: 为了准备这次旅行，他安排得面面俱到。
pinyin: Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì lǚxíng, tā ānpái dé miàn miàn jù dào.
en: In order to prepare for this trip, he arranged everything thoroughly.

zh: 面对困难，我们要以认真的态度去解决。
pinyin: Miànduì kùnnán, wǒmen yào yǐ rènzhēn de tàidù qù jiějué.
en: Facing difficulties, we must resolve them with an earnest attitude.

zh: 她试图用糖果来诱惑那个哭闹的小男孩。
pinyin: Tā shìtú yòng tángguǒ lái yòuhuò nàgè kūnnào de xiǎo nánhái.
en: She attempted to lure the crying little boy with candy.

zh: 对于这个奇怪的问题，大家都迷惑不解。
pinyin: Duìyú zhège qíguài de wèntí, dàjiā, dàjiā dōu míhuòbùjiě.
en: Regarding this strange question, everyone felt puzzled.

zh: 虽然情况很危险，但他还是化险为夷了。
pinyin: Suīrán qíngkuàng hěn wēixiǎn, dàn tā háishì huàxiǎnwéiyí le.
en: Although the situation was dangerous, he still turned peril into safety.

zh: 这次活动是我们公司发展史上的里程碑。
pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng shì wǒmen gōngsī fāzhǎn shǐ shàng de lǐchéngbēi.
en: This event is a milestone in our company's history.

zh: 我们在宇宙中的存在显得如此微不足道。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài yǔzhòu zhōng de cúnzài xiǎnde rúcǐ wēi bù zú dào.
en: Our existence in the universe appears so negligible.

zh: 我们应该多锻炼身体，譬如说每天跑步。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi duō duànliàn shēntǐ, pìrúshuō měitiān pǎobù.
en: We should exercise more, for example, by running every day.

zh: 如果你有任何难处，可以随时找我帮忙。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu rènhé nánchu, kěyǐ suíshí zhǎo wǒ bāngmáng.
en: If you have any trouble, you can come to me for help at any time.

zh: 老师看了看作业，随后告诉了大家结果。
pinyin: Lǎoshī kànle kàn zuòyè, suíhòu gàosùle dàjiā jiéguǒ.
en: The teacher looked at the homework, and soon after told everyone the results.

zh: 全公司的人，从经理以至于职员都到了。
pinyin: Quán gōngsī de rén, cóng jīnglǐ yǐ zhìyú zhíyuán dōu dào le.
en: Everyone in the company, from the manager up to the staff, arrived.

zh: 虽然他有很多缺点，但他的无知最严重。
pinyin: Suīrán tā yǒu hěnduō quēdiǎn, dàn tā de wúzhī zuì yánzhòng.
en: Although he has many shortcomings, his ignorance is the most serious.

zh: 回首学生时代，那真是一段美好的时光。
pinyin: Huíshǒu xuéshēng shídài, nà zhēn shì yīduàn měihǎo de shíguāng.
en: Looking back at my student days, that was truly a beautiful time.

zh: 他们诚心诚意地欢迎大家参加这个活动。
pinyin: Tāmen chéngxīn-chéngyì de huānyíng dàjiā cānjiā zhège huódòng.
en: They earnestly and sincerely welcome everyone to participate in this activity.

zh: 那个孩子看到陌生人时表现得有些畏缩。
pinyin: Nàge háizi kàndào mòshēngrén shí biǎoxiàn dé yǒuxiē wèisuō.
en: The child appeared a bit timid when seeing strangers.

zh: 如果你想创业，你需要准备足够的本钱。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng chuàngyè, nǐ xūyào zhǔnbèi zúgòu de běnqián.
en: If you want to start a business, you need to prepare enough capital.

zh: 在诱惑面前，他仿佛看见了魔鬼的影子。
pinyin: Zài yòuhuò miànqián, tā fǎngfú kànjiànle móguǐ de yǐngzi.
en: In the face of temptation, he seemed to see the shadow of a devil.

zh: 在那次事故中，他奇迹般地幸存了下来。
pinyin: zài nà cì shì gù zhōng, tā qí jì bān de xìng cún le xià lái.
en: In that accident, he survived miraculously.

zh: 我们不应该任人宰割，要学会保护自己。
pinyin: Wǒmen bù yīnggāi rèn rén zǎi gē, yào xuéhuì bǎohù zìjǐ.
en: We should not be taken advantage of; we must learn to protect ourselves.

zh: 在茫茫人海中，我们不过是彼此的路人。
pinyin: Zài máng máng rén hǎi zhōng, wǒ men bù guò shì bǐ cǐ de lù rén.
en: In the vast sea of people, we are merely strangers to each other.

zh: 得知这个消息，他欣喜若狂，非常高兴。
pinyin: Dézhī zhège xiāoxī, tā xīnxǐruòkuáng, fēicháng gāoxìng.
en: Upon hearing this news, he was ecstatic and very happy.

zh: 春节期间，亲友们都聚在一起吃年夜饭。
pinyin: Chūnjié qījiān, qīnyǒumen dōu jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn.
en: During the Spring Festival, friends and relatives all gather together for the New Year's Eve dinner.

zh: 在这项任务中，他确实是个得力的帮手。
pinyin: Zài zhè xiàng rènwù zhōng, tā quèshí shì gè délì de bāngshou.
en: In this task, he is indeed a capable helper.

zh: 委员会的成员们对这个提议进行了投票。
pinyin: Wěiyuánhuì de chéngyuánmen duì zhège tíyì jìnxíngle tóupiào.
en: The committee members voted on this proposal.

zh: 他没想到这竟然是一个精心设计的圈套。
pinyin: Tā méi xiǎngdào zhè jìngrán shì yīgè jīngxīn shèjì de quāntào.
en: He did not expect that this was actually a carefully designed trap.

zh: 听到救护车的声音，大家让开了一条路。
pinyin: Tīngdào jiùhùchē de shēngyīn, dàjiā ràngkāi le yītiáo lù.
en: Hearing the sound of the ambulance, everyone made way.

zh: 只要按这个键，电脑自然而然就会重启。
pinyin: Zhǐyào àn zhè ge jiàn, diànnǎo zìrán'érrán jiù huì chóngqǐ.
en: Just press this button, and the computer will restart automatically.

zh: 隔壁办公室传出的噪音干扰了我的工作。
pinyin: Gé bì bàn gōng shì chuán chū de zào yīn gān rǎo le wǒ de gōng zuò.
en: The noise from the office next door disrupted my work.

zh: 很抱歉，我不小心丢失了那份重要文件。
pinyin: Hěn bàoqiàn, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn diūshī le nà fèn zhòngyào wénjiàn.
en: I am very sorry, I accidentally lost that important document.

zh: 这个瑜伽垫子的质量很好，用起来很柔软。
pinyin: Zhège yújiā diànzi de zhìliàng hěn hǎo, yòng qǐlái hěn róuruǎn.
en: The quality of this yoga mat/cushion is very good, and it feels very soft to use.

zh: 在冬季享受一次桑拿，能缓解工作的疲劳。
pinyin: Zài dōngjì xiǎngshòu yīcì sāngná, néng huǎnjiě gōngzuò de píláo.
en: Enjoying a sauna in winter can relieve work fatigue.

zh: 不要因为萍水相逢就对他产生过高的期待。
pinyin: Bùyào yīnwèi píngshuǐxiāngféng jiù duì tā chǎnshēng guògāo de qīdài.
en: Do not have high expectations of him just because you met by chance.

zh: 我实在弄不明白这种电子玩意儿怎么操作。
pinyin: Wǒ shízài nòng bù míngbái zhè zhǒng diànzǐ wányìr zěnme cāozuò.
en: I really don't understand how to operate this kind of electronic gadget.

zh: 听说北京明天要下雪，气温会大幅度下降。
pinyin: Tīngshuō Běijīng míngtiān yào xià xuě, qìwēn huì dàfúdù xiàjiàng.
en: I heard that it will snow in Beijing tomorrow, and the temperature will drop significantly.

zh: 她那倔强的性格使她很难接受别人的建议。
pinyin: Tā nà juéjiàng de xìnggé shǐ tā hěn nán jiēshòu biérén de jiànyì.
en: Her stubborn personality makes it difficult for her to accept other people's advice.

zh: 虽然教室很简陋，但是同学们学习很努力。
pinyin: Suīrán jiàoshì hěn jiǎnlòu, dànshì tóngxuémen xuéxí hěn nǔlì.
en: Although the classroom is simple and crude, the students study very hard.

zh: 他正在聚精会神地写作业，没听到敲门声。
pinyin: Tā zhèngzài jùjīnghuìshén de xiě zuòyè, méi tīngdào qiāoménshēng.
en: He was concentrating on his homework and didn't hear the knock.

zh: 这次活动非常成功，多亏了大伙儿的努力。
pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng fēicháng chénggōng, duōkuīle dàhuǒr de nǔlì.
en: This event was very successful, thanks to everyone's hard work.

zh: 这些农民工虽然很辛苦，但是他们很努力。
pinyin: Zhè xiē nóng míng gōng suī rán hěn xīn kǔ, dàn shì tā men hěn nǔ lì.
en: Although these migrant workers work very hard, they are very diligent.

zh: 在艰苦奋斗的过程中，他克服了许多困难。
pinyin: Zài jiānkǔfèndòu de guòchéng zhōng, tā kèfúle xǔduō kùnnán.
en: In the process of struggling arduously, he overcame many difficulties.

zh: 现代传媒在我们的生活中起着重要的作用。
pinyin: Xiàndài chuánméi zài wǒmen de shēnghuó zhōng qǐzhe zhòngyào de zuòyòng.
en: Modern media plays an important role in our lives.

zh: 这家公司在过去几年里取得了长足的发展。
pinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī zài guò qù jǐ nián lǐ qǔ dé le cháng zú de fā zhǎn.
en: This company has achieved remarkable development in the past few years.

zh: 信用卡丢了以后，我立刻打了电话去挂失。
pinyin: Xìnyòngkǎ diū le yǐhòu, wǒ lìkè dǎ le diànhuà qù guàshī.
en: After I lost my credit card, I immediately called to report the loss.

zh: 他因为性格软弱，在工作中显得无所作为。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi xìnggé ruǎnruò, zài gōngzuò zhōng xiǎndé wúsuǒzuòwéi.
en: Because of his weak character, he seems feckless at work.

zh: 在那次庄严的仪式上，他正式接受了洗礼。
pinyin: Zài nà cì zhuāngyán de yíshì shàng, tā zhèngshì jiēshòule xǐlǐ.
en: At that solemn ceremony, he officially received baptism.

zh: 与其指责别人，不如先反思自己哪里不对。
pinyin: Yǔqí zhǐzé biérén, bùrú xiān fǎnsī zìjǐ nǎlǐ bù duì.
en: Rather than blaming others, it is better to reflect on where you are wrong.

zh: 为了保证万无一失，我们必须再检查一次。
pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng wànwúyīshī, wǒmen bìxū zài jiǎnchá yīcì.
en: To ensure it is surefire, we must check it again.

zh: 比赛开始后，运动员们争先恐后地向前跑。
pinyin: Bǐsài kāishǐ hòu, yùndòngyuánmen zhēngxiānkǒnghòu de xiàng qián pǎo.
en: After the race started, the athletes were striving to be first and fearing to be last to run forward.

zh: 生活中那些可乐的片段常能缓解我的压力。
pinyin: Shēnghuó zhōng nàxiē kě lè de piànduàn cháng néng huǎnjiě wǒ de yālì.
en: Those amusing moments in life can often relieve my stress.

zh: 虽然他很贪玩儿，但是他的成绩一直很好。
pinyin: suīrán tā hěn tān wánr, dànshì tā de chéngjì yīzhí hěn hǎo.
en: Although he is very playful, his grades have always been very good.

zh: 因为没有按时完成工作，他感到非常惭愧。
pinyin: yīn wèi méi yǒu àn shí wán chéng gōng zuò, tā gǎn dào fēi cháng cán kuì.
en: Because he did not finish the work on time, he felt very ashamed.

zh: 他看到精彩的表演，不由自主地鼓起掌来。
pinyin: Tā kàndào jīngcǎi de biǎoyǎn, bùyóuzìzhǔ de gǔ qǐ zhǎng lái.
en: Seeing the wonderful performance, he couldn't help but clap his hands.

zh: 因为最近是旅游旺季，所以机票非常难买。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn shì lǚyóu wàngjì, suǒyǐ jīpiào fēicháng nán mǎi.
en: Because it is peak tourist season recently, plane tickets are very hard to buy.

zh: 这辆车的车牌看起来有些模糊，很难辨认。
pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de chēpái kàn qǐlái yǒuxiē móhú, hěn nán biànrèn.
en: The license plate of this car looks a bit blurry and is hard to identify.

zh: 他在上司面前总是小心翼翼，生怕说错话。
pinyin: Tā zài shàng sī miàn qián zǒng shì xiǎo xīn yì yì, shēng pà shuō cuò huà.
en: He is always cautious in front of his boss, for fear of saying the wrong thing.

zh: 这个夏令营为学生提供了丰富的课外活动。
pinyin: Zhège xiàlìngyíng wèi xuéshēng tígōngle fēngfù de kèwài huódòng.
en: This summer camp provides students with rich extracurricular activities.

zh: 虽然他有口音，但是我说的话他都能听懂。
pinyin: Suīrán tā yǒu kǒuyīn, dànshì wǒ shuō de huà tā dōu néng tīngdǒng.
en: Although he has an accent, he can understand everything I say.

zh: 因为没有直达的公共汽车，我不得不倒车。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu zhídá de gōnggòng qìchē, wǒ bùdébù dǎochē.
en: Because there is no direct bus, I have to change buses.

zh: 因为很喜欢这首歌，观众的掌声经久不息。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn xǐhuān zhè shǒu gē, guānzhòng de zhǎngshēng jīngjiǔbùxī.
en: Because they liked this song very much, the audience's applause was prolonged.

zh: 为了治疗抑郁症，他开始去医院看心理医生。
pinyin: Wèile zhìliáo yìyùzhèng, tā kāishǐ qù yīyuàn kàn xīnlǐ yīshēng.
en: In order to treat his depression, he started going to the hospital to see a psychologist.

zh: 他在朋友们的见证下，满怀激动地向她求婚。
pinyin: Tā zài péngyǒumen de jiànzhèng xià, mǎnhuái jīdòng de xiàng tā qiúhūn.
en: Witnessed by friends, he proposed to her with great excitement.

zh: 作为一个男子汉，要有志气，不能随便低头。
pinyin: Zuòwéi nánzǐhàn, yào yǒu zhìqì, bùnéng suíbiàn dītóu.
en: As a man, one must have backbone and not bow one's head easily.

zh: 如果你去火车站，可以打车顺便带我一程吗？
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ qù huǒchēzhàn, kěyǐ dǎ chē shùnbiàn dài wǒ yī chéng ma?
en: If you are going to the train station, can you hitch me a lift?

zh: 虽然他工作很忙，但他每天都会坚持吃早饭。
pinyin: Suīrán tā gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn tā měitiān dūhuì jiānchí chī zǎofàn.
en: Although he is very busy with work, he insists on eating breakfast every day.

zh: 他们的行为非常离谱儿，引起了大家的不满。
pinyin: Tāmen de xíngwéi fēicháng lí pǔ r, yǐnqǐ le dàjiā de bùmǎn.
en: Their behavior was very outrageous and caused everyone's dissatisfaction.

zh: 无论别人怎么求他，他都保持着冷酷的态度。
pinyin: wú lùn bié rén zěn me qiú tā, tā dōu bǎo chí zhe lěng kù de tài dù.
en: No matter how others begged him, he maintained an unfeeling attitude.

zh: 由于天气不好，大家对飞机的安全感到悬念。
pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì bù hǎo, dàjiā duì fēijī de ānquán gǎndào xuánniàn.
en: Due to bad weather, everyone is worried about the safety of the plane.

zh: 随着时间的推移，我对这里的印象越来越深。
pinyin: suí zhe shí jiān de tuī yí, wǒ duì zhè lǐ de yìn xiàng yuè lái yuè shēn.
en: As time passes, my impression of this place is getting deeper and deeper.

zh: 比赛中途，运动员们得到了一点喘息的机会。
pinyin: bǐsài zhōngtú, yùndòngyuánmen dédàole yīdiǎn chuǎn xī de jīhuì.
en: Midway through the match, the athletes got a chance to catch their breath.

zh: 由于天气太热，大家都把窗户和门打开通风。
pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì tài rè, dàjiā dōu bǎ chuānghu hé mén dǎkāi tōngfēng.
en: Because the weather was too hot, everyone opened the windows and doors to ventilate.

zh: 这个皮球的弹性特别好，一下子就弹起来了。
pinyin: zhè gè pí qiú de tán xìng tè bié hǎo, yī xià zi jiù tán qǐ lái le.
en: This ball has great elasticity and bounced up immediately.

zh: 看到温度计上的数字不断上涨，他非常担心。
pinyin: kàn dào wēn dù jì shàng de shù zì bù duàn shàng zhǎng, tā fēi cháng dān xīn.
en: Seeing the numbers on the thermometer go up constantly, he was very worried.

zh: 在那个动荡的时代，很多人的遭遇十分可悲。
pinyin: Zài nàge dòngdàng de shídài, hěnduō rén de zāoyù shífēn kěbēi.
en: During that turbulent era, the experiences of many people were extremely lamentable.

zh: 如果你因为玩游戏而不休息，那是得不偿失的。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yīnwèi wán yóuxì ér bù xiūxi, nà shì débùchángshī de.
en: If you don't rest because you are playing games, the gains will not make up for the losses.

zh: 爷爷退休以后，在家里写写书法，过得很充实。
pinyin: Yéye tuìxiū yǐhòu, zài jiālǐ xiěxiě shūfǎ, guò de hěn chōngshí.
en: After retiring, grandfather practices calligraphy at home and lives a fulfilling life.

zh: 学生们聚集在广场上，公开抗议学校的新政策。
pinyin: Xuéshēngmen jùjí zài guǎngchǎng shàng, gōngkāi kàngyì xuéxiào de xīn zhèngcè.
en: The students gathered in the square to publicly protest the school's new policy.

zh: 很多外国人专门为了看国宝大熊猫来中国旅游。
pinyin: Hěnduō wàiguó rén zhuānmén wèile kàn guóbǎo dàxióngmāo lái Zhōngguó lǚyóu.
en: Many foreigners travel to China specifically to see the national treasure, the giant panda.

zh: 他辞去了高薪的工作，选择去山中做一名和尚。
pinyin: Tā cí qù le gāo xīn de gōng zuò, xuǎn zé qù shān zhōng zuò yī míng hé shang.
en: He resigned from his high-paying job and chose to become a Buddhist monk in the mountains.

zh: 请不要在会议上夸夸其谈，要说出具体的方法。
pinyin: qǐng bùyào zài huìyì shàng kuā kuā qí tán, yào shuō chū jùtǐ de fāngfǎ.
en: Please do not talk big at the meeting; give specific methods.

zh: 随着时间的推移，他逐渐熟悉了新的工作环境。
pinyin: Suízhe shíjiān de tuīyí, tā zhújiàn shúxīle xīn de gōngzuò huánjìng.
en: As time passed, he gradually became familiar with the new work environment.

zh: 医生已经尽力了，但他对这种病还是无能为力。
pinyin: Yī shēng yǐ jīng jìn lì le, dàn tā duì zhè zhǒng bìng hái shì wú néng wéi lì.
en: The doctor has tried his best, but he is still powerless against this illness.

zh: 老师看了看作业，纳闷儿地问我为什么没写完。
pinyin: Lǎoshī kànle kàn zuòyè, nàmèn r de wèn wǒ wèishéme méi xiěwán.
en: The teacher looked at the homework and asked me, puzzled, why I didn't finish it.

zh: 这个项目快要告一段落了，我们可以休息一下。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù kuài yào gào yī duànluò le, wǒmen kěyǐ xiūxi yīxià.
en: This project is about to come to a temporary end; we can take a break.

zh: 这个产品的市场份额比去年下降了两个百分点。
pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn de shìchǎng fèn'é bǐ qùnián xiàjiàng le liǎng gè bǎifēndiǎn.
en: The market share of this product has dropped by two percentage points compared to last year.

zh: 无论我怎么解释，他都爱理不理，这让我很难过。
pinyin: Wúlùn wǒ zěnme jiěshì, tā dōu ài lǐ bù lǐ, zhè ràng wǒ hěn nánguò.
en: No matter how I explain, he remains standoffish, which makes me very sad.

zh: 我朋友很爱面子，从不在别人面前说自己的困难。
pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu hěn ài miànzi, cóng bù zài biérén miànqián shuō zìjǐ de kùnnán.
en: My friend is very concerned with his image and never talks about his difficulties in front of others.

zh: 这次旅行的风景比我想象的更好，真是喜出望外。
pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng de fēngjǐng bǐ wǒ xiǎngxiàng de gèng hǎo, zhēnshi xǐchūwàngwài.
en: The scenery on this trip was even better than I imagined; I am pleasantly surprised.

zh: 老师对课文的分析十分透彻，大家听得都很认真。
pinyin: lǎo shī duì kè wén de fēn xī shí fēn tòu chè, dà jiā tīng de dōu hěn rèn zhēn.
en: The teacher's analysis of the text was very thorough, and everyone listened attentively.

zh: 在学校门口见到老师很正常，但见到校长就少见了。
pinyin: Zài xuéxiào ménkǒu jiàndào lǎoshī hěn zhèngcháng, dàn jiàndào xiàozhǎng jiù shǎojiàn le.
en: It's normal to see teachers at the school gate, but it's rare to see the principal.

zh: 在这个关键时刻，我们绝不能做出乘人之危的事情。
pinyin: zài zhège guānjiàn shíkè, wǒmen jué bùnéng zuòchū chéng rén zhī wēi de shìqíng.
en: At this critical moment, we must not do anything that takes advantage of others' precarious situations.

zh: 他为了供儿子上大学，在工厂里辛苦工作了很多年。
pinyin: Tā wèile gōng érzi shàng dàxué, zài gōngchǎng lǐ xīnkǔ gōngzuòle hěnduō nián.
en: In order to pay for his son's college education, he worked hard in the factory for many years.

zh: 考试的时候，他总是左顾右盼，老师提醒他不要作弊。
pinyin: kǎoshì de shíhou, tā zǒngshì zuǒ gù yòu pàn, lǎoshī tíxǐng tā bùyào zuòbì.
en: During the exam, he kept glancing around, and the teacher warned him not to cheat.

zh: 为了介绍他的新产品，他站在台上滔滔不绝地讲了一个小时。
pinyin: Wèile jièshào tā de xīn chǎnpǐn, tā zhàn zài táishàng tāotāo bù jué de jiǎngle yīgè xiǎoshí.
en: In order to introduce his new product, he stood on the stage and talked non-stop for an hour.

zh: A: 你设计的方案太棒了！ B: 好说，好说，还有很多不足。
pinyin: A: Nǐ shèjì de fāng'àn tài bàng le! B: Hǎoshuō, hǎoshuō, hái yǒu hěnduō bùzú.
en: A: Your design proposal is excellent! B: You flatter me, it still has many shortcomings.

zh: 墙头长满了青苔。
pinyin: qiángtóu zhǎng mǎnle qīngtái.
en: The top of the wall is covered with moss.

zh: 成员皆各尽其责。
pinyin: Chéngyuán jiē gè jìn qí zé.
en: Each and every member performs their duty.

zh: 这件案子牵攀甚广。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn ànzi qiānpān shèn guǎng.
en: This case implicates a wide range of people.

zh: 管道因冰冻而破裂。
pinyin: guǎndào yīn bīngdòng ér pòliè.
en: The pipe burst due to freezing.

zh: 铺设管道耗资巨大。
pinyin: pū shè guǎn dào hào zī jù dà.
en: Laying the pipeline costs a huge amount of money.

zh: 战乱连年，生灵不安。
pinyin: Zhànluàn liánnián, shēnglíng bù ān.
en: With years of war, the living are unpeaceful.

zh: 这张纸的边被削短了。
pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhǐ de biān bèi xiāo duǎn le.
en: The edge of this paper was pared shorter.

zh: 翻译应该忠实于原文。
pinyin: Fānyì yīnggāi zhōngshí yú yuánwén.
en: Translation should be faithful to the original text.

zh: 政府回收了废弃矿区。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ huíshōu le fèiqì kuàngqū.
en: The government reclaimed the abandoned mining area.

zh: 大门被漆成了朱红色。
pinyin: Dà mén bèi qī chéng le zhū hóng sè.
en: The gate was painted vermilion.

zh: 这种运动起源于欧洲。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yùndòng qǐyuán yú Ōuzhōu.

pinyin: Tā zhìlì yú yánjiū dāngdì dútè de mínsú wénhuà.
en: He is devoted to researching the unique folk customs and culture of the local area.

zh: 幸好带了雨伞，不然我就要淋雨了。
pinyin: Xìnghǎo dàile yǔsǎn, bùrán wǒ jiù yào línyǔ le.
en: Fortunately I brought an umbrella, otherwise I would have been caught in the rain.

zh: 这种先进技术名副其实，性能卓越。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiānjìn jìshù míng fù qí shí, xìngnéng zhuóyuè.
en: This advanced technology is not just in name, its performance is excellent.

zh: 他那标准的普通话令大家感到惊讶。
pinyin: Tā nà biāozhǔn de pǔtōnghuà lìng dàjiā gǎndào jīngyà.
en: His standard ordinary speech surprised everyone.

zh: 他先发表了演说，接着与听众交流。
pinyin: Tā xiān fābiǎole yǎnshuō, jiēzhe yǔ tīngzhòng jiāoliú.
en: He gave a speech first, and then went on to interact with the audience.

zh: 作为经理，他展现出了极强的亲和力。
pinyin: Zuòwéi jīnglǐ, tā zhǎnxiàn chūle jí qiáng de qīnhélì.

zh: 在激烈的竞争下，公司动不动就裁员。
pinyin: zài jīliè de jìngzhēng xià, gōngsī dòng bu dòng jiù cáiyuán.

zh: 如果不及时关闭阀门，后果会很严重。
pinyin: Rúguǒ bù jíshí guānbì fámén, hòuguǒ huì hěn yánzhòng.
en: If the valve is not closed in time, the consequences will be serious.

zh: 对于楼上发表的评论，我持保留态度。
pinyin: Duìyú lóu shàng fābiǎo de pínglùn, wǒ chí bǎoliú tàidu.
en: I have reservations about the comment posted by the previous poster.

zh: 这篇科普文章详细介绍了宇宙的起源。
pinyin: Zhè piān kē pǔ wénzhāng xiángxì jièshàole yǔzhòu de qǐyuán.
en: This popular science article provides a detailed introduction to the origin of the universe.

zh: 一旦你迷路了，请留在原地等待救援。
pinyin: yí dàn nǐ mí lù le, qǐng liú zài yuán dì děng dài jiù yuán.
en: Once you are lost, please stay in your place and wait for rescue.

zh: 他的故事引人入胜，大家都听得入迷。
pinyin: Tā de gùshì yǐn rén rù shèng, dàjiā dōu tīng dé rùmí.
en: His story is enchanting, everyone listened in a trance.

zh: 经过多年的练习，他掌握了这项技艺。
pinyin: Jīng guò duō nián de liàn xí, tā zhǎng wò le zhè xiàng jì yì.
en: After years of practice, he mastered this skill.

zh: 使者在关键时刻表现出了卓越的智慧。
pinyin: Shǐzhě zài guānjiàn shíkè biǎoxiàn chū le zhuóyuè de zhìhuì.
en: The envoy displayed outstanding wisdom at the critical moment.

zh: 为了参加婚礼，她专门换了一个发型。
pinyin: Wèile cānjiā hūnlǐ, tā zhuānmén huàn le yī gè fàxíng.
en: She specially changed her hairstyle to attend the wedding.

zh: 导游正在向游客介绍皇宫的建筑特点。
pinyin: Dǎoyóu zhèngzài xiàng yóukè jièshào huánggōng de jiànzhù tèdiǎn.

pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán zài zǎorì de shíyàn lǐ fāxiàn le wèntí.
en: The researchers discovered problems in the early days of the experiment.

pinyin: Zhè piàn huāng liáng de tǔ dì shàng céng jīng yǒu guò yī zuò chéng shì.
en: There was once a city on this desolate land.

pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài yánjiū zhè zhǒng bìngdú de zhìbìng jīzhì.

zh: 由于高原缺氧，我们都感到有些头晕。

zh: 他表现出的才华让所有人都感到震惊。

pinyin: Wèilái jǐ gè xīngqī gōngsī de yèwù jiāng shífēn fánmáng.

zh: 对于这种不公平的待遇，他愤怒不已。
pinyin: Duìyú zhè zhǒng bù gōngpíng de dàiyù, tā fènnù bù yǐ.
en: He was endlessly furious about this kind of unfair treatment.

zh: 为了防止旱灾，政府修建了新的水库。
pinyin: Wèile fángzhǐ hànzāi, zhèngfǔ xiūjiànle xīn de shuǐkù.
en: To prevent drought, the government built a new reservoir.

zh: 由于大雾，我失去了辨别方向的能力。
pinyin: Yóuyú dàwù, wǒ shīqùle biànbié fāngxiàng de nénglì.
en: Due to the heavy fog, I lost the ability to distinguish directions.

zh: 那场庄重的葬礼令所有人都非常感动。
pinyin: Nà chǎng zhuāngzhòng de zànglǐ lìng suǒyǒurén dōu fēicháng gǎndòng.
en: That solemn funeral moved everyone very much.

zh: 会议期间，请尽量不要接听私人电话。
pinyin: Huìyì qījiān, qǐng jǐnliàng bùyào jiētīng sīrén diànhuà.
en: During the meeting, please try not to answer personal calls.

zh: 他在奥运会上获得了一枚金色的奖牌。
pinyin: Tā zài àoyùnhuì shàng huòdéle yī méi jīnsè de jiǎngpái.
en: He won a golden medal at the Olympic Games.

zh: 他为了那件事一直蘑菇我，让我很烦。
pinyin: Tā wèile nà jiàn shì yīzhí mógu wǒ, ràng wǒ hěn fán.

zh: 这家公司及其产品在市场上很受欢迎。
pinyin: zhè jiā gōngsī jí qí chǎnpǐn zài shìchǎng shàng hěn shòu huānyíng.

zh: 他心里很难过，可是心里话难说出口。
pinyin: Tā xīnlǐ hěn nánguò, kěshì xīnlǐhuà nán shuōkǒur.

zh: 虽然生活很辛苦，但他一直艰苦奋斗。
pinyin: Suīrán shēnghuó hěn xīnkǔ, dàn tā yīzhí jiānkǔfèndòu.
en: Although life is hard, he keeps struggling arduously.

zh: 护士们轮流值班，以确保病人的安全。
pinyin: Hùshìmen lúnliú zhíbān, yǐ quèbǎo bìngrén de ānquán.
en: The nurses are on duty in rotations to ensure the patients' safety.

zh: 为了学好功夫，他每天去找师父练功。
pinyin: Wèile xué hǎo gōngfu, tā měitiān qù zhǎo shīfu liàngōng.
en: In order to learn kung fu well, he goes to see his master to practice every day.

zh: 他那种坦率的性格赢得了大家的信任。
pinyin: Tā nà zhǒng tǎnshuài de xìnggé yíngdéle dàjiā de xìnrèn.
en: His frank personality won everyone's trust.

zh: 他穿着一件白T恤和一条蓝色牛仔裤。
pinyin: tā chuān zhe yī jiàn bái T-xù hé yī tiáo lán sè niú zǎi kù.
en: He is wearing a white T-shirt and a pair of blue jeans.

zh: 我们要为实现中华民族的富强而奋斗。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào wèi shíxiàn Zhōnghuá mínzú de fùqiáng ér fèndòu.

zh: 为了高效工作，他总是严格遵守日程。

pinyin: Tā bǎ xiāo hǎo de píngguǒ qiē chéng xiǎo kuài fēngěile dàjiā.

en: This art exhibition showcased the unique charm of contemporary art.

pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng ràng wǒ jiéshíle yī wèi yǒuqù de dǎoyóu.
en: This trip allowed me to meet an interesting tour guide for the first time.

zh: 由于某种不同寻常的原因，他迟到了。
pinyin: Yóuyú mǒu zhǒng bùtóngxúncháng de yuányīn, tā chídào le.

pinyin: tā chuān guò mì jí de rén qún, zǒu xiàng le wǔ tái zhōng xīn.

pinyin: Suīrán tā jùjué le tā, dàn tā yīrán chīxīn bù gǎi.

pinyin: shēn wéi tóng rén, wǒ men yīng dāng bǎo chí zhuān yè de tài dù.

pinyin: jiàn yú mù qián de qíng kuàng, wǒ men bì xū gǎi biàn jì huà.

zh: 他为了照顾老人，就近租了一套公寓。
pinyin: Tā wèile zhàogù lǎorén, jiùjìn zū le yī tào gōngyù.

pinyin: Chāidàn zhuānjiā xiǎoxīnyìyì de chāichúle nàgè zhàdàn.

pinyin: Guówáng juédìng qīnzì qù kǎochá biānjìng de fángyù gōngshì.

zh: 作为新人，你要积极借鉴前辈的经验。
pinyin: Zuòwéi xīnrén, nǐ yào jījí jièjiàn qiánbèi de jīngyàn.

pinyin: kē xué jiā zhèng zài yán jiū rè dài jí bìng de chuán bō fāng shì.

zh: 那场大火让这座古老的房子面目全非。
pinyin: Nà chǎng dàhuǒ ràng zhè zuò gǔlǎo de fángzi miànmùquánfēi.

en: That tsunami destroyed all the coastal buildings in an instant.

pinyin: Tāmen sīxià dáchéng le yī xiàng hùbùqīnfàn de xiéyì.

pinyin: Wèile fāngbiàn jiāoliú, wǒmen tǒngyī shǐyòng jiǎntǐzì.

zh: 这种简单的方法对解决问题无济于事。

en: To improve the texture, he decided to add milk to the coffee.

zh: 大夫们正在商讨关于国家经济的宏观政策。
pinyin: dà fū men zhèng zài shāng tǎo guān yú guó jiā jīng jì de hóng guān zhèng cè.
en: The senior officials are discussing macroeconomic policies concerning the country.

zh: 你费尽心思布置这个场景，究竟是干什么？
pinyin: nǐ fèi jìn xīn sī bù zhì sī bù zhì bù zhì zhè gè chǎng jǐng, jiū jìng shì gàn shén me?
en: You put so much effort into setting up this scene, what exactly are you doing?

zh: 这些辛勤的员工为公司做出了巨大的贡献。
pinyin: Zhèxiē xīnqín de yuángōng wèi gōngsī zuò chū le jùdà de gòngxiàn.
en: These hardworking employees have made huge contributions to the company.

zh: 尽管尝试了各种方法，他还是没能彻底戒烟。
pinyin: jǐnguǎn chángshì le gè zhǒng fāngfǎ, tā háishì méi néng chèdǐ jièyān.
en: Despite trying various methods, he still failed to quit smoking completely.

zh: 如果身体出现炎症，一定要及时去医院检查。
pinyin: Rúguǒ shēntǐ chūxiàn yánzhèng, yīdìng yào jíshí qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
en: If inflammation appears in the body, you must go to the hospital for an examination in time.

zh: 孩子顽皮的天性有时会给家长带来不少困扰。
pinyin: Háizi wánpí de tiānxìng yǒushí huì gěi jiāzhǎng dàilái bùshǎo kùnrǎo.
en: A child's naughty nature can sometimes bring a lot of trouble to parents.

zh: 每个人都有自己的想法，他的做法无可厚非。
pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, tā de zuòfǎ wú kě hòu fēi.
en: Everyone has their own ideas; his actions are understandable.

zh: 正值风和日丽的季节，非常适合去郊外旅行。
pinyin: zhèngzhí fēnghé-rìlì de jìjié, fēicháng shìhé qù jiāowài lǚxíng.
en: It is the season of fine weather and sunshine, which is very suitable for traveling to the countryside.

zh: 因为突然刮风下雨，我们的计划只好推迟了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tūrán guāfēng xiàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà zhǐhǎo tuīchí le.
en: Because it suddenly became windy and rainy, we had to postpone our plans.

zh: 经过几个小时的商量，双方终于达成了共识。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ gè xiǎoshí de shāngliáng, shuāngfāng zhōngyú dáchéng le gòngshí.
en: After several hours of discussion, both sides finally reached a consensus.

zh: 这个年轻人因为见义勇为受到了大家的表扬。
pinyin: Zhège niánqīng rén yīnwèi jiàn yì yǒng wéi shòudào le dàjiā de biǎoyáng.
en: This young man was praised by everyone for his courageous action.

zh: 她凭借优异的成绩获得了学校颁发的奖学金。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè yōuyì de chéngjì huòdé le xuéxiào bānfā de jiǎngxuéjīn.
en: She received a scholarship awarded by the school due to her excellent grades.

zh: 请保管好你的钥匙，以免造成不必要的麻烦。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎoguǎn hǎo nǐ de yàoshi, yǐmiǎn zàochéng bú bìyào de máfan.
en: Please take good care of your key to avoid unnecessary trouble.

zh: 老实说，他这种犹豫不决的态度让我很失望。
pinyin: lǎo shí shuō, tā zhè zhǒng yóu yù bù jué de tài dù ràng wǒ hěn shī wàng.
en: Honestly speaking, his indecisive attitude makes me very disappointed.

zh: 在竞争激烈的社会中，他自认为是社会废物。
pinyin: Zài jìngzhēng jīliè de shèhuì zhōng, tā zìrènwéi shì shèhuì fèiwù.
en: In a highly competitive society, he considers himself a useless person.

zh: 如果你一直保持这个方向，就能到达目的地。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yīzhí bǎochí zhège fāngxiàng, jiù néng dàodá mùdìdì.
en: If you continue straight in this direction, you will reach the destination.

zh: 鉴于目前的情况，他大约不会轻易做出让步。
pinyin: Jiànyú mùqián de qíngkuàng, tā dàyuē bù huì qīngyì zuòchū ràngbù.
en: Given the current situation, he will probably not easily make concessions.

zh: 这种行为已经成为了他的一种下意识的习惯。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xíngwéi yǐjīng chéngwéile tā de yī zhǒng xià yì shí de xíguàn.
en: This behavior has already become a kind of subconscious habit for him.

zh: 关于这个古墓里的棺材，有很多神秘的传说。
pinyin: Guān yú zhè gè gǔ mù lǐ de guān cai, yǒu hěn duō shén mì de chuán shuō.
en: Regarding the coffin in this ancient tomb, there are many mysterious legends.

zh: 无论做什么，只要全心全意，总会获得成功。
pinyin: Wúlùn zuò shénme, zhǐyào quán xīn quán yì, zǒng huì huòdé chénggōng.
en: No matter what you do, as long as you do it with all your heart and soul, you will always succeed.

zh: 他通过划分音节来学习这个陌生的外语单词。
pinyin: Tā tōng guò huà fēn yīn jié lái xué xí zhè gè mò shēng de wài yǔ dān cí.
en: He learns this unfamiliar foreign word by dividing it into syllables.

zh: 无论从哪个角度看，他都是无可挑剔的人选。
pinyin: Wúlùn cóng nǎge jiǎodù kàn, tā dōu shì wúkě tiāotì de rén xuǎn.
en: No matter which perspective you look from, he is an impeccable choice of person.

zh: 如果你想解开这个方程，必须先找到未知数。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng jiěkāi zhège fāngchéng, bìxū xiān zhǎodào wèizhīshù.
en: If you want to solve this equation, you must find the unknown number first.

zh: 听到这个消息，大家都不知道该怎么安慰她。
pinyin: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi, dàjiā dōu bù zhīdào gāi zěnme ānwèi tā.
en: Hearing this news, nobody knew how to comfort her.

zh: 这篇日记字里行间流露出他内心深处的忧郁。
pinyin: Zhè piān rìjì zìlǐhángjiān liúlù chū tā nèixīn shēnchù de yōuyù.
en: Between the lines of this diary, his deep-seated melancholy is revealed.

zh: 如果你感到身体不舒服，可能是感染了流感。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ gǎndào shēntǐ bù shūfu, kěnéng shì gǎnrǎn le liúgǎn.
en: If you feel unwell, you might have caught the flu.

zh: 在行业不景气的情况下，很多员工被辞退了。
pinyin: Zài hángyè bù jǐngqì de qíngkuàng xià, hěnduō yuángōng bèi cítuì le.
en: In a situation where the industry is in a slump, many employees were fired.

zh: 面对突如其来的变故，他站在原地目瞪口呆。
pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de biàngù, tā zhàn zài yuándì mù dèng kǒu dāi.
en: Faced with the sudden change of events, he stood there dumbstruck.

zh: 为了一个虚伪的朋友感到伤心，实在是不值。
pinyin: Wèile yīgè xūwěi de péngyǒu gǎndào shāngxīn, shízài shì bù zhí.
en: It is truly not worth feeling sad over a hypocritical friend.

zh: 科学家们正在积极寻找克服这一困境的途径。
pinyin: Kēxuéjiāmen zhèngzài jījí xúnzhǎo kèfú zhè yī kùnjìng de tújìng.
en: Scientists are actively seeking ways to overcome this dilemma.

zh: 双方为了利益争执不休，非要理论出个对错。
pinyin: Shuāng fāng wèi le lì yì zhēng zhí bù xiū, fēi yào lǐ lùn chū gè duì cuò.
en: Both sides kept arguing over interests, insisting on debating who was right and who was wrong.

zh: 在这场残酷的竞争中，几乎没有真正的赢家。
pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng cánkù de jìngzhēng zhōng, jīhū méiy méiyǒu zhēnzhèng de yíngjiā.
en: In this cruel competition, there are almost no real winners.

zh: 我们进行了深入的座谈，交流了彼此的看法。
pinyin: Wǒmen jìnxíngle shēnrù de zuòtán, jiāoliúle bǐcǐ de kànfǎ.
en: We had an in-depth informal discussion and exchanged our opinions.

zh: 看着那张旧照片，我有一种说不上来的感觉。
pinyin: Kànzhe nà zhāng jiù zhàopiàn, wǒ yǒu yī zhǒng shuō bu shànglái de gǎnjué.
en: Looking at that old photo, I have a feeling I can't quite describe.

zh: 这孩子总是喜欢研究各种稀奇古怪的玩意儿。
pinyin: Zhè háizi zǒngshì xǐhuān yánjiū gèzhǒng xīqí gǔguài de wányìr.
en: This child always likes to study all kinds of strange things.

zh: 对于这个不公平的结果，他表现得很不服气。
pinyin: Duìyú zhège bù gōngpíng de jié jiéguǒ, tā biǎoxiàn de hěn bù fú qì.
en: Regarding this unfair result, he acted very defiantly.

zh: 他虽然年纪小，但说起道理来总是头头是道。
pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dàn shuō qǐ dàolǐ lái zǒng shì tóutóushìdào.
en: Although he is young, he always speaks very logically when talking about principles.

zh: 他认为这个领域的研究前景广阔，大有可为。
pinyin: Tā rènwéi zhège lǐngyù de yánjiū qiánjǐng guǎngkuò, dà yǒu kě wéi.
en: He believes that research in this field has broad prospects and is very promising.

zh: 我们要明确此次调查问卷的样本数量有多少。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào míngquè cǐcì diàochá wènjuǎn de yàngběn shùliàng yǒu duōshǎo.
en: We must clarify how many samples this survey questionnaire has.

zh: 在这个实验中，我们主要观察物体的运动规律。
pinyin: Zài zhège shíyàn zhōng, wǒmen zhǔyào guānchá wùtǐ de yùndòng guīlǜ.
en: In this experiment, we mainly observe the movement laws of objects.

zh: 在那段艰苦的日子里，他始终是我的忠实同伴。
pinyin: Zài nà duàn jiānkǔ de rìzi lǐ, tā shǐzhōng shì wǒ de zhōngshí tóngbàn.
en: During those difficult days, he was always my loyal companion.

zh: 他不仅精通日语，还对日本文化有深入的研究。
pinyin: Tā bùjǐn jīngtōng Rìyǔ, hái duì Rìběn wénhuà yǒu shēnrù de yánjiū.
en: He is not only proficient in Japanese, but also has in-depth research on Japanese culture.

zh: 在大自然的怀抱中，所有的烦恼仿佛都消失了。
pinyin: Zài dà zì rán de huáibào zhōng, suǒyǒu de fánnǎo fǎngfú dōu xiāoshī le.
en: In the embrace of nature, all worries seem to vanish.

zh: 为了保护环境，我们不能在这个湖泊里丢垃圾。
pinyin: Wèile bǎohù huánjìng, wǒmen bùnéng zài zhège húbō lǐ diū lājī.
en: In order to protect the environment, we cannot throw trash into this lake.

zh: 他们一边享用晚餐，一边商讨项目的具体细节。
pinyin: Tāmen yībiān xiǎngyòng wǎncān, yībiān shāngtǎo xiàngmù de jùtǐ xìjié.
en: While enjoying dinner, they discussed the specific details of the project.

zh: 尽管身体极度疲惫，他还是在天亮之前醒来了。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shēntǐ jídù píbèi, tā háishì zài tiānliàng zhīqián xǐng lái le.
en: Despite being extremely exhausted, he still woke up before dawn.

zh: 由于他一贯的所作所为，大家对他失去了信任。
pinyin: Yóuyú tā yīguàn de suǒ zuò suǒ wéi, dàjiā duì tā shīqù le xìnrèn.
en: Because of his consistent conduct and deeds, everyone has lost trust in him.

zh: 如果不努力练习，这样一来，比赛就很难赢了。
pinyin: Rúguǒ bù nǔlì liànxí, zhèyàng yī lái, bǐsài jiù hěn nán yíng le.
en: If one doesn't practice hard, if this happens, winning the competition will be difficult.

zh: 我们必须找到更多的筹码，才能在竞争中获胜。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū zhǎodào gèng duō de chóumǎ, cáinéng zài jìngzhēng zhōng huòshèng.
en: We must find more bargaining chips to win in the competition.

zh: 为了身体健康，你应该少吃脂肪含量高的食物。
pinyin: Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, nǐ yīnggāi shǎo chī zhīfáng hánliàng gāo de shíwù.
en: For your health, you should eat less food with high fat content.

zh: 无论遇到什么问题，我们都要有志气坚持下去。
pinyin: Wúlùn yù dào shénme wèntí, wǒmen dōu yào yǒu zhìqì jiānchí xiàqù.
en: No matter what problems we encounter, we must have the resolve to persist.

zh: 为了掩盖一个谎言，他不得不编造更多的谎言。
pinyin: Wèile yǎngài yīgè huǎngyán, tā bùdébù biānzào gèng duō de huǎngyán.
en: To cover up one lie, he had to make up more lies.

zh: 为了准备这次活动，我们需要更好的后勤保障。
pinyin: wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì huódòng, wǒmen xūyào gèng hǎo de hòuqín bǎozhàng.
en: To prepare for this event, we need better logistics support.

zh: 对于这些复杂的法律条款，他非常认识且了解。
pinyin: Duìyú zhèxiē fùzá de fǎlǜ tiáokuǎn, tā fēicháng rènshi qiě liǎojiě.
en: He is very familiar with and understands these complex legal clauses.

zh: 在学术研究中弄虚作假是绝对不能容忍的行为。
pinyin: zài xué shù yán jiū zhōng nòng xū zuò jiǎ shì jué duì bù néng róng rěn de xíng wéi.
en: Practicing fraud in academic research is an absolutely intolerable act.

zh: 不管是大人物还是普通人，都要学会不耻下问。
pinyin: Bùguǎn shì dà rénwù háishì pǔtōng rén, dōu yào xuéhuì bù chǐ xià wèn.
en: Whether one is an important person or an ordinary person, one must learn not to be ashamed to ask subordinates for advice.

zh: 他在窗外看到了一张熟悉的脸，感到非常惊讶。
pinyin: Tā zài chuāngwài kàn dào le yī zhāng shúxī de liǎn, gǎndào fēicháng jīngyà.
en: He saw a familiar face outside the window and felt very surprised.

zh: 许多外国游客对中国戏曲表现出了浓厚的兴趣。
pinyin: Xǔduō wàiguó yóukè duì Zhōngguó xìqǔ biǎoxiàn chūle nónghòu de xìngqù.
en: Many foreign tourists have shown a keen interest in Chinese opera.

zh: 大家以为他会失败，事实恰恰相反，他成功了。
pinyin: Dà jiā yǐ wéi tā huì shī bài, shì shí qià qià xiāng fǎn, tā chéng gōng le.
en: Everyone thought he would fail, but the fact is just the opposite; he succeeded.

zh: 为了完成科研项目，科学家们废寝忘食地工作。
pinyin: Wèile wánchéng kēyán xiàngmù, kēxuéjiāmen fèiqǐnwàngshí de gōngzuò.
en: In order to complete the research project, the scientists work while forgetting to eat and sleep.

zh: 经历了长途跋涉，他终于可以坐下喝杯热茶了。
pinyin: Jīnglì le chángtú báshè, tā zhōngyú kěyǐ zuò xià hē bēi rè chá le.
en: After a long journey, he could finally sit down and drink a cup of hot tea.

zh: 他小心翼翼地打开包裹，查看里面的精致礼品。
pinyin: Tā xiǎoxīnyìyì de dǎkāi bāoguǒ, chákàn lǐmiàn de jīngzhì lǐpǐn.
en: He carefully opened the package to inspect the exquisite gift inside.

zh: 对于经常出差的他来说，住酒店早已司空见惯。
pinyin: Duìyú jīngcháng chūchāi de tā lái shuō, zhù jiǔdiàn zǎoyǐ sīkōngjiànguàn.
en: For him, who is often on business trips, staying in hotels is a common occurrence.

zh: 尽管隔着一道门，我依然隐约听见他们在争论。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gézhe yī dào mén, wǒ yīrán yǐnyuē tīngjiàn tāmen zài zhēnglùn.
en: Even though there was a door in between, I could still vaguely hear them arguing.

zh: 这件事很复杂，他思前想后，想通了其中的道理。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn fùzá, tā sīqiánxiǎnghòu, xiǎng tōng le qízhōng de dàolǐ.
en: This matter is complicated; he pondered over the connections and figured out the logic.

zh: 学习外语不仅需要刻苦，还需要多与当地人交流。
pinyin: Xuéxí wàiyǔ bùjǐn xūyào kèkǔ, hái xūyào duō yǔ dāngdì rén jiāoliú.
en: Learning a foreign language requires not only hard work but also frequent interaction with locals.

zh: 他不拘小节，为人大大咧咧，深受朋友们的喜爱。
pinyin: Tā bùjūxiǎojié, wéirén dà dà liē liē, shēn shòu péngyǒumen de xǐ'ài.
en: He doesn't fuss over minor details and has a carefree nature, which is why he is deeply loved by his friends.

zh: 对于今天这一代人来说，环保意识已经深入人心。
pinyin: Duì yú jīn tiān zhè yī dài rén lái shuō, huán bǎo yì shí yǐ jīng shēn rù rén xīn.
en: For the present generation, environmental awareness has become deeply rooted in people's hearts.

zh: 他从那场严重的车祸中幸存下来，真是一个奇迹。
pinyin: Tā cóng nà chǎng yánzhòng de chēhuò zhōng xìngcún xiàlái, zhēn shì yí gè qíjì.
en: It is a miracle that he survived that serious car accident.

zh: 这位医生不仅医术高超，而且对病人非常有耐心。
pinyin: zhè wèi yī shēng bù jǐn yī shù gāo chāo, ér qiě duì bìng rén fēi cháng yǒu nài xīn.
en: This doctor is not only highly skilled in medicine but also very patient with patients.

zh: 既然你已经决定辞职了，现在干吗还要犹豫不决？
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ yǐjīng juédìng cízhí le, xiànzài gàn má hái yào yóuyù bù jué?
en: Since you have already decided to resign, why are you still hesitating now?

zh: 他盯着我的眼睛，似乎想从我的表情中寻找答案。
pinyin: Tā dīngzhe wǒ de yǎnjing, sìhū xiǎng cóng wǒ de biǎoqíng zhōng xúnzhǎo dá'àn.
en: He stared into my eyes, as if looking for an answer in my expression.

zh: 无论走到哪里，她都对自己的祖国感到无比自豪。
pinyin: Wúlùn zǒu dào nǎlǐ, tā dōu duì zìjǐ de zǔguó gǎndào wúbǐ zìháo.
en: No matter where she goes, she feels incredibly proud of her motherland.

zh: 许多国际品牌都在这次车展上展示了最新的车型。
pinyin: Xǔduō guójì pǐnpái dōu zài zhè cì chēzhǎn shàng zhǎnshìle zuìxīn de chēxíng.
en: Many international brands showcased their latest vehicle models at this auto show.

zh: 他太小气，像一毛不拔一样，连一根毛都不愿意动。
pinyin: Tā tài xiǎoqì, xiàng yī máo bù bá yīyàng, lián yī gēn máo dōu bù yuànyì dòng.
en: He is too stingy, like someone who won't spare a hair, unwilling to move even a single strand.

zh: 尽管困难重重，项目中还有一些环节值得我们深思。
pinyin: jǐnguǎn kùnnán chóngchóng, xiàngmù zhōng hái yǒu yīxiē huánjié zhídé wǒmen shēnsī.
en: Despite the many difficulties, there are still some aspects of the project worth our deep reflection.

zh: 少林寺不仅是武术的发源地，也是重要的文化遗产。
pinyin: Shàolínsì bùjǐn shì wǔshù de fāyuándì, yěshì zhòngyào de wénhuà yíchǎn.
en: Shaolin Temple is not only the birthplace of martial arts but also an important cultural heritage.

zh: 听到这个意外的消息，他顿时脸色难看，一言不发。
