pinyin: Zhè wèi císhànjiā yīshēng dōu zài zhìlì yú gǎishàn qióngrén de shēnghuó.
en: This philanthropist has devoted his whole life to improving the lives of poor people.

zh: 由于长期缺乏水分，她的嘴唇显得有些干裂。
pinyin: yóu yú cháng qī quē fá shuǐ fèn, tā de zuǐ chún xiǎn dé yǒu xiē gān liè.
en: Due to a lack of water for a long time, her lips appeared a bit chapped.

zh: 望着那空荡荡的广场，我不禁感到一丝忧郁。
pinyin: wàng zhe nà kōng dàng dàng de guǎng chǎng, wǒ bù jīn gǎn dào yī sī yōu yù.
en: Looking at the empty square, I couldn't help but feel a hint of melancholy.

zh: 长期吸烟对人的喉咙和肺部都有严重的危害。
pinyin: cháng qī xī yān duì rén de hóu lóng hé fèi bù dōu yǒu yán zhòng de wèi hài.
en: Long-term smoking causes serious harm to a person's throat and lungs.

zh: 天下没有不散的筵席，大家终究要各奔前程。
pinyin: Tiānxià méiyǒu bù sàn de yánxí, dàjiā zhōngjiū yào gè bèn qián chéng.
en: There is no feast that does not end; eventually, everyone must go their own way.

zh: 为了实现理想，即使面临挑战也要勇往直前。
pinyin: Wèile shíxiàn lǐxiǎng, jíshǐ miànlín tiǎozhàn yě yào yǒngwǎngzhíqián.
en: In order to realize one's ideals, one must advance bravely even when facing challenges.

zh: 无论距离多么遥远，都不能把我们的心隔开。
pinyin: Wúlùn jùlí duōme yáoyuǎn, dōu bùnéng bǎ wǒmen de xīn gé kāi.
en: No matter how far the distance, nothing can separate our hearts.

zh: 在这个浮躁的时代，人们应该坚守道德底线。
pinyin: Zài zhège fúzào de shídài, rénmen yīnggāi jiānshǒu dàodé dǐxiàn.
en: In this restless era, people should stick to moral bottom lines.

zh: 实现中华民族的伟大复兴是时代的必然选择。
pinyin: Shíxiàn Zhōnghuá mínzú de wěidà fùxīng shì shídài de bìrán xuǎnzé.
en: Realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation is the inevitable choice of the era.

zh: 在这困难时期，他始终保持着昂扬的正能量。
pinyin: Zài zhè kùnnán shíqī, tā shǐzhōng bǎochízhe ángyáng de zhèngnéngliàng.
en: During this difficult time, he always maintained high spirits and positivity.

zh: 他在报告中列举了几种常用的统计分析方法。
pinyin: Tā zài bàogào zhōng lièjǔle jǐ zhǒng chángyòng de tǒngjì fēnxī fāngfǎ.
en: He listed several commonly used statistical analysis methods in the report.

zh: 无论出身如何，每个人在人格上都是平等的。
pinyin: Wúlùn chūshēn rúhé, měi gèrén zài réngé shàng dōu shì píngděng de.
en: Regardless of background, everyone is equal in dignity.

zh: 尽管公务繁忙，他还是抽空陪家人享用晚饭。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gōngwù fánmáng, tā háishì chōukòng péi jiārén xiǎngyòng wǎnfàn.
en: Despite his busy official duties, he still makes time to enjoy dinner with his family.

zh: 面对困难，他总是保持说干就干的积极态度。
pinyin: Miànduì kùnnán, tā zǒng shì bǎochí shuō gàn jiù gàn de jījí tàidù.
en: Facing difficulties, he always maintains an active attitude of acting immediately.

zh: 面对突发状况，他依然保持冷静，出口成章。
pinyin: Miàn duì tū fā zhuàng kuàng, tā yī rán bǎo chí lěng jìng, chū kǒu chéng zhāng.
en: Facing an emergency, he remained calm and articulate.

zh: 这一带的地质结构复杂，常发生轻微的地震。
pinyin: Zhè yī dài de dìzhì jiégòu fùzá, cháng fāshēng qīngwēi de dìzhèn.
en: The geological structure of this region is complex, and minor earthquakes occur frequently.

zh: 他没有直接说明，而是以反问的方式拒绝了。
pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhíjiē shuōmíng, ér shì yǐ fǎn wèn de fāngshì jùjué le.
en: He did not explain directly, but refused by answering with a question.

zh: 获奖者们在热烈的掌声中走上舞台接受颁奖。
pinyin: Huòjiǎngzhěmen zài rèliè de zhǎngshēng zhōng zǒu shàng wǔtái jiēshòu bānjiǎng.
en: The winners walked onto the stage to receive their awards amidst warm applause.

zh: 为了完成任务，大家接二连三地赶往办公室。
pinyin: Wèile wánchéng rènwu, dàjiā jiē èr lián sān de gǎnwǎng bàngōngshì.
en: In order to complete the task, everyone rushed to the office one after another.

zh: 在突如其来的变故面前，他依然能从容面对。
pinyin: Zài tūrúqílái de biàngù miàngù miànqián, tā yīrán néng cóngróng miàn duì.
en: In the face of sudden unexpected events, he can still face them calmly.

zh: 在极其压抑的环境中，人容易产生焦虑情绪。
pinyin: Zài jíqí yāyì de huánjìng zhōng, rén róngyì chǎnshēng jiāolǜ qíngxù.
en: In an extremely oppressive environment, people are likely to develop anxiety.

zh: 这场战争对国家的经济造成了毁灭性的打击。
pinyin: zhè chǎng zhàn zhēng duì guó jiā de jīng jì zào chéng le huǐ miè xìng de dǎ jī.
en: This war dealt a devastating blow to the nation's economy.

zh: 这些毕业生凭借出色的表现获得了录用机会。
pinyin: Zhèxiē bìyèshēng píngjiè chūsè de biǎoxiàn huòdéle lùyòng jīhuì.
en: These graduates obtained job offers thanks to their outstanding performance.

zh: 这次的调查结果建议我们尽早采取有效措施。
pinyin: Zhè cì de diàochá jiéguǒ jiànyì wǒmen jǐnzǎo cǎiqǔ yǒuxiào cuòshī.
en: The results of this investigation suggest that we should take effective measures as early as possible.

zh: 随着年龄的增长，他越来越理解父母的苦心。
pinyin: Suízhe niánlíng de zēngzhǎng, tā yuè lái yuè lǐjiě fùmǔ de kǔxīn.
en: As he grows older, he increasingly understands his parents' good intentions.

zh: 为了坐得更舒服，我在沙发上加了一个垫子。
pinyin: Wèile zuò de gèng shūfu, wǒ zài shāfā shàng jiā le yī gè diànzi.
en: In order to sit more comfortably, I added a cushion to the sofa.

zh: 尽管困难重重，但他从来不抱怨命运的不公。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn kùnnán chóngchóng, dàn tā cónglái bù bàoyuàn mìngyùn de bùgōng.
en: Despite the numerous difficulties, he never complains about the unfairness of fate.

zh: 经理虽然在国外，但依然遥控着公司的业务。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ suīrán zài guówài, dàn yīrán yáokòngzhe gōngsī de yèwù.
en: Although the manager is abroad, he still remotely directs the company's business.

zh: 他无缘无故地发火，真不知道他到底在干吗。
pinyin: Tā wúyuánwúgù de fāhuǒ, zhēn bù zhīdào tā dàodǐ zài gàn má.
en: He got angry for no reason, I really don't know what on earth he is doing.

zh: 这家书店装修得十分别致，充满了文化情调。
pinyin: Zhè jiā shūdiàn zhuāngxiū dé shífēn biézhì, chōngmǎnle wénhuà qíngdiào.
en: This bookstore is uniquely decorated and full of cultural ambience.

zh: 我们从素未谋面的网友变成了现实中的挚友。
pinyin: Wǒmen cóng sùwèimóumiàn de wǎngyǒu biànchéng le xiànshí zhōng de zhìyǒu.
en: We turned from strangers online into best friends in reality.

zh: 现代社会，网络已经渗透到生活的方方面面。
pinyin: Xiàndài shèhuì, wǎngluò yǐjīng shèntòu dào shēnghuó de fāngfāngmiànmiàn.
en: In modern society, the Internet has penetrated every aspect of life.

zh: 奥运会期间，鸟巢吸引了来自全世界的游客。
pinyin: Àoyùnhuì qījiān, Niǎocháo xīyǐn le láizì quán shìjiè de yóukè.
en: During the Olympic Games, the Bird's Nest attracted tourists from all over the world.

zh: 推开卧室的窗户，一股清新的空气扑面而来。
pinyin: Tuīkāi wòshì de chuānghu, yī gǔ qīngxīn de kōngqì pūmiàn ér lái.
en: Pushing open the bedroom window, a breath of fresh air came toward me.

zh: 即使他在看管贵重物品，也难免会感到疲倦。
pinyin: Jíshǐ tā zài kānguǎn guìzhòng wùpǐn, yě nánmiǎn huì gǎndào píjuàn.
en: Even though he is looking after valuable items, it is inevitable that he will feel tired.

zh: 面对陌生的环境，那位小朋友显得有些拘谨。
pinyin: Miànduì mòshēngde huánjìng, nàwèi xiǎopéngyǒu xiǎnde yǒuxiē jūjǐn.
en: Facing the unfamiliar environment, the child appeared a bit reserved.

zh: 由于父母离异，他从小就和继父生活在一起。
pinyin: Yóuyú fùmǔ líyì, tā cóngxiǎo jiù hé jìfù shēnghuó zài yīqǐ.
en: Due to his parents' divorce, he has lived with his stepfather since he was a child.

zh: 即使是细微的变化，我们也应当理睬并深思。
pinyin: jí shǐ shì xì wēi de biàn huà, wǒ men yě yīng dāng lǐ cǎi bìng shēn sī.
en: Even for subtle changes, we should heed them and think deeply.

zh: 他无法忍受这种日复一日、单调枯燥的生活。
pinyin: Tā wúfǎ rěnshòu zhè zhǒng rì fù yī rì, dāndiào kūzào de shēnghuó.
en: He could not bear this monotonous and dull day-to-day life.

zh: 为了研究方言，他坚持听写这些古老的音频。
pinyin: Wèile yánjiū fāngyán, tā jiānchí tīngxiě zhèxiē gǔlǎo de yīnpín.
en: In order to study dialects, he persists in transcribing these ancient audio recordings.

zh: 为了保护环境，我们应该减少对煤炭的依赖。
pinyin: Wèile bǎohù huánjìng, wǒmen yīnggāi jiǎnshǎo duì méitàn de yīlài.
en: In order to protect the environment, we should reduce our reliance on coal.

zh: 虽然很累，但是汗水让我们的工作更有意义。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì hànshuǐ ràng wǒmen de gōngzuò gèng yǒu yìyì.
en: Although it is tiring, sweat makes our work more meaningful.

zh: 每逢新年，海外的游子们总是格外思念故乡。
pinyin: měi féng xīn nián, hǎi wài de yóu zǐ men zǒng shì gé wài sī niàn gù xiāng.
en: Every New Year, those living abroad always miss their hometowns dearly.

zh: 为了庆祝节日，学校举办了一场隆重的庆典。
pinyin: Wèile qìngzhù jiérì, xuéxiào jǔbànle yī chǎng lóngzhòng de qìngdiǎn.
en: In order to celebrate the festival, the school held a grand celebration.

zh: 经过精心的照料，院子里的果树开始结果了。
pinyin: Jīngguò jīngxīn de zhàoliào, yuànzi lǐ de guǒshù kāishǐ jiēguǒ le.
en: After careful tending, the fruit trees in the yard have started to bear fruit.

zh: 面对突如其来的变故，他陷入了深深的思索。
pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de biàngù, tā xiànrùle shēnshēn de sīsuǒ.
en: Facing the sudden change, he fell into deep thought.

zh: 我们必须对现行的管理系统进行彻底的改革。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū duì xiànxíng de guǎnlǐ xìtǒng jìnxíng chèdǐ de gǎigé.
en: We must carry out a thorough reform of the existing management system.

zh: 这种新药虽然效果好，但是副作用还不清楚。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīn yào suīrán xiàoguǒ hǎo, dànshì fù zuò yòng hái bù qīngchǔ.
en: Although this new medicine is effective, its side effects are not yet clear.

zh: 他敏锐地观察到现场气氛发生了微妙的变化。
pinyin: Tā mǐnruì de guānchá dào xiànchǎng qìfēn fāshēng le wēimiào de biànhuà.
en: He keenly observed that the atmosphere at the scene had undergone a subtle change.

zh: 为了争夺遗产，亲戚们开始了长期的打官司。
pinyin: wèile zhēngduó yíchǎn, qīnqīmen kāishǐ le chángqī de dǎ guān si.
en: In order to fight for the inheritance, the relatives started a long-term dispute.

zh: 虽然生活平淡，但他觉得这才是寻常的幸福。
pinyin: Suīrán shēnghuó píngdàn, dàn tā juédé zhè cáishì xúncháng de xìngfú.
en: Although life is plain, he feels this is ordinary happiness.

zh: 他在本次评选中表现卓越，被选为先进分子。
pinyin: Tā zài běn cì píngxuǎn zhōng biǎoxiàn zhuóyuè, bèi xuǎn wéi xiānjìn fènzǐ.
en: He performed excellently in this selection and was chosen as a meritorious member.

zh: 往事犹如电影画面般猛然浮现在我的脑海中。
pinyin: Wǎngshì yóurú diànyǐng huàmiàn bān měngrán fúxiàn zài wǒ de nǎohǎi zhōng.
en: Past events suddenly emerged in my mind like scenes from a movie.

zh: 为了提高教学质量，学校引进了优秀的师资。
pinyin: Wèile tígāo jiàoxué zhìliàng, xuéxiào yǐnjìn le yōuxiù de shīzī.
en: In order to improve teaching quality, the school has introduced excellent teaching staff.

zh: 在这个竞争激烈的行业，傲慢只会阻碍进步。
pinyin: Zài zhège jìngzhēng jīliè de hángyè, àomàn zhǐ huì zǔ'ài jìnbù.
en: In this highly competitive industry, arrogance only hinders progress.

zh: 面对困难，他一个劲儿地鼓励自己坚持下去。
pinyin: Miànduì kùnnán, tā yī gè jìn r de gǔlì zìjǐ jiānchí xiàqù.
en: Facing difficulties, he kept encouraging himself to persist.

zh: 面对众人的讥笑，他依然保持着自信的态度。
pinyin: miàn duì zhòng rén de jī xiào, tā yī rán bǎo chí zhe zì xìn de tài dù.
en: Faced with the sneers of the crowd, he still maintained a confident attitude.

zh: 父亲坐在写字台旁，翻阅着那些陈旧的文件。
pinyin: Fùqīn zuò zài xiězìtái páng, fānyuèzhe nàxiē chénjiù de wénjiàn.
en: Father sat by the writing desk, leafing through those old documents.

zh: 为了方便工作，他在公司附近租赁了一套公寓。
pinyin: Wèile fāngbiàn gōngzuò, tā zài gōngsī fùjìn zūlìnle yī tào gōngyù.
en: For the sake of work convenience, he rented an apartment near the company.

zh: 或许我们应当深入探讨一下这个方案的可行性。
pinyin: huò xǔ wǒ men yīng dāng shēn rù tàn tǎo yī xià zhè gè fāng àn de kě xíng xìng.
en: Perhaps we should further discuss the feasibility of this proposal.

zh: 长期的高压工作环境可能会损害人的心脏健康。
pinyin: Chángqī de gāoyā gōngzuò huánjìng kěnéng huì sǔnhài rén de xīnzàng jiànkāng.
en: A long-term high-pressure work environment may damage a person's heart health.

zh: 记者们对那起突发新闻进行了深入的追踪报道。
pinyin: Jìzhěmen duì nà qǐ tūfā xīnwén jìnxíng le shēnrù de zhuīzōng bàodào.
en: The journalists conducted in-depth follow-up reporting on the breaking news.

zh: 上个月的业绩大幅增长，超出了董事会的预期。
pinyin: shàng gè yuè de yèjì dàfú zēngzhǎng, chāochū le dǒngshìhuì de yùqī.
en: Performance grew significantly last month, exceeding the board's expectations.

zh: 大家迫不及待地想验证这一科学假设的准确性。
pinyin: Dàjiā pòbùjídài de xiǎng yànzhèng zhè yī kēxué jiǎshè de zhǔnquèxìng.
en: Everyone couldn't wait to verify the accuracy of this scientific hypothesis.

zh: 他熟练地拿起筷子，开始品尝桌上的美味佳肴。
pinyin: tā shú liàn de ná qǐ kuài zi, kāi shǐ pǐn cháng zhuō shàng de měi wèi jiā yáo.
en: He skillfully picked up his chopsticks and began to taste the delicacies on the table.

zh: 尽管伯母年事已高，依然十分关心我们的学业。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn bómǔ niánshìyǐgāo, yīrán shēn shí fēn guānxīn wǒmen de xuéyè.
en: Although my uncle's wife is advanced in years, she is still very concerned about our studies.

zh: 听说那儿发生了交通事故，交通堵塞得很厉害。
pinyin: Tīngshuō nàr fāshēngle jiāotōng shìgù, jiāotōng dǔsè de hěn lìhài.
en: I heard that a traffic accident happened there, and the traffic jam is very severe.

zh: 我们在异国他乡漂泊了多久，终于回到了故乡。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài yìguótāxiāng piāobóle duōjiǔ, zhōngyú huí dàole gùxiāng.
en: We had been drifting in a foreign land for such a long time, and finally returned to our hometown.

zh: 由于他在比赛中表现抢眼，很快被教练选中了。
pinyin: yóuyú tā zài bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn qiǎngyǎn, hěn kuài bèi jiàoliàn xuǎnzhòng le.
en: Because of his eye-catching performance in the competition, he was quickly selected by the coach.

zh: 作为一个领导者，你不能推卸监管方面的职责。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yīgè lǐngdǎozhě, nǐ bùnéng tuīxiè jiāngxiè jiāng jiānguǎn fāngmiàn de zhízé.
en: As a leader, you cannot avoid your regulatory responsibilities.

zh: 在这个行业，她向来善于处理复杂的人际关系。
pinyin: Zài zhège hángyè, tā xiànglái shànyú chǔlǐ fùzá de rénjì guānxì.
en: In this industry, she has always been good at handling complex interpersonal relationships.

zh: 年轻人只要坚持奋斗，在各个领域都大有可为。
pinyin: Niánqīng rén zhǐyào jiānchí fèndòu, zài gège lǐngyù dōu dà yǒu kě wéi.
en: As long as young people persist in their efforts, they have great prospects in every field.

zh: 作为业内的权威，他认得很多重要的合作伙伴。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yènèi de quánwēi, tā rènde hěn duō zhòngyào de hézuò huǒbàn.
en: As an authority in the industry, he knows many important business partners.

zh: 这个国家的首都不仅经济发达，而且历史悠久。
pinyin: Zhège guójiā de shǒudū bùjǐn jīngjì fādá, érqiě lìshǐ yōujiǔ.
en: The capital of this country is not only economically developed but also has a long history.

zh: 旅行的意义不在于目的地，而在于沿途的风景。
pinyin: Lǚxíng de yìyì bù zàiyú mùdìdì, ér zàiyú yántú de fēngjǐng.
en: The meaning of travel lies not in the destination, but in the scenery along the way.

zh: 作为公众人物，他的一言一行都受到社会关注。
pinyin: zuòwéi gōngzhòng rénwù, tā de yī yán yī xíng dōu shòudào shèhuì guānzhù.
en: As a public figure, his every word and action receives social attention.

zh: 这家餐厅邀请顾客免费品尝他们新推出的甜点。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng yāoqǐng gùkè miǎnfèi pǐncháng tāmen xīn tuīchū de tiándiǎn.
en: The restaurant invited customers to taste their newly launched dessert for free.

zh: 为了参加这个聚会，他老远地从外地赶了过来。
pinyin: Wèile cānjiā zhège jùhuì, tā lǎoyuǎn de cóng wàidì gǎn le guòlái.
en: In order to attend this party, he rushed over from a long way away.

zh: 这座历史悠久的公园见证了城市几十年的变迁。
pinyin: Zhè zuò lìshǐ yōujiǔ de gōngyuán jiànzhèng le chéngshì jǐ shí nián de biànqiān.
en: This historic park has witnessed the changes of the city over several decades.

zh: 为了保护公司的名声，我们必须解决这个问题。
pinyin: wèi le bǎo hù gōng sī de míng shēng, wǒ men bì xū jiě jué zhè gè wèn tí.
en: In order to protect the company's reputation, we must solve this problem.

zh: 人生最大的成就，莫过于实现自己的崇高理想。
pinyin: Rénshēng zuìdà de chéngjiù, mòguòyú shíxiàn zìjǐ de chónggāo lǐxiǎng.
en: The greatest achievement in life is nothing more than realizing one's lofty ideals.

zh: 他对待岳父就像对待自己的亲生父亲一样尊敬。
pinyin: Tā duìdài yuèfù jiù xiàng duìdài zìjǐ de qīnshēng fùqīn yīyàng zūnjìng.
en: He treats his father-in-law with the same respect as his own biological father.

zh: 互联网的普及对人类社会产生了划时代的影响。
pinyin: Hùliánwǎng de pǔjí duì rénlèi shèhuì chǎnshēng le huàshídài de yǐngxiǎng.
en: The popularity of the internet has had an epoch-marking impact on human society.

zh: 在这个复杂的社会里，他依然保持敦厚的品格。
pinyin: Zài zhège fùzá de shèhuì lǐ, tā yīrán bǎochí dūnhòu de pǐngé.
en: In this complex society, he still maintains an honest and sincere character.

zh: 这种核桃的营养价值很高，深受消费者的喜爱。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng hétáo de yíngyǎng jiàzhí hěn gāo, shēn shòu xiāofèizhě de xǐ'ài.
en: This type of walnut has high nutritional value and is deeply loved by consumers.

zh: 由于找不到合适的锤子，他只好换了一种工具。
pinyin: Yóuyú zhǎobùdào héshì de chuízi, tā zhǐhǎo huànle yī zhǒng gōngjù.
en: Because he couldn't find a suitable hammer, he had to change to another tool.

zh: 经过多方面的调研，我们认为该项目是可行的。
pinyin: Jīngguò duō fāngmiàn de diàoyán, wǒmen rènwéi gāi xiàngmù shì kěxíng de.
en: After multifaceted research, we believe that the project is feasible.

zh: 他那种坚持不懈的精神受到了人们的一致称赞。
pinyin: tā nà zhǒng jiānchí bùxiè de jīngshén shòudàole rénmen de yīzhì chēngzàn.
en: His spirit of perseverance received unanimous praise from the people.

zh: 那位歌手唱出了动听的歌曲，感动了所有观众。
pinyin: Nà wèi gēshǒu chàng chū le dòngtīng de gēqǔ, gǎndòng le suǒyǒu guānzhòng.
en: That singer sang a pleasant song and moved all the audience.

zh: 白总裁在新闻发布会上回应了关于合并的质疑。
pinyin: Bái zǒngcái zài xīnwén fābùhuì shàng huíyìng le guānyú hébìng de zhìyí.
en: President Bai responded to questions regarding the merger at the press conference.

zh: 这些研究沿着这一思路展开，取得了巨大成功。
pinyin: Zhèxiē yánjiū yánzhe zhè yī sīlù zhǎnkāi, qǔdé le jùdà chénggōng.
en: These studies were conducted following this train of thought and achieved great success.

zh: 尽管户外下雪，孩子们依然在操场上尽情玩耍。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn hùwài xià xuě, háizimen yīrán zài cāochǎng shàng jìnqíng wánshuǎ.
en: Even though it is snowing outdoors, the children are still playing to their heart's content on the playground.

zh: 经过一个漫长的冬季，春季终于悄悄地降临了。
pinyin: Jīngguò yīgè màncháng de dōngjì, chūnjì zhōngyú qiāoqiāo de jiànglín le.
en: After a long winter, spring has finally arrived quietly.

zh: 无论遇到什么困难，他都始终陪伴在妻子身边。
pinyin: Wúlùn yùdào shénme kùnnán, tā dōu shǐzhōng péibàn zài qīzi shēnbiān.
en: No matter what difficulties he encounters, he always stays by his wife's side.

zh: 经过反复推敲，他修改了这个句子的表达方式。
pinyin: Jīngguò fǎnfù tuīqiāo, tā xiūgǎi xiūgǎi le zhè ge jù zi de biǎodá fāngshì.
en: After repeated deliberation, he revised the way this sentence was expressed.

zh: 父母总是感叹时光飞逝，孩子们转眼就长大了。
pinyin: Fùmǔ zǒngshì gǎntàn shíguāng fēishì, háizimen zhuǎnyǎn jiù zhǎng dà le.
en: Parents always lament that time flies, and in the blink of an eye, their children have grown up.

zh: 虽然他不太相信占卜，但他偶尔也会尝试一下。
pinyin: Suīrán tā bú tài xiāngxìn zhānbǔ, dàn tā ǒu'ěr yě huì chángshì yīxià.
en: Although he doesn't really believe in divination, he occasionally tries it.

zh: 我们要发扬尊老爱幼的传统，经常去探望姥爷。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào fāyáng zūnlǎoàiyòu de chuántǒng, jīngcháng qù tànwàng lǎo ye.
en: We should carry on the tradition of respecting the elderly and caring for the young by visiting my maternal grandfather often.

zh: 由于身体状况不佳，外婆已经很少出门散步了。
pinyin: Yóuyú shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng bù jiā, wàipó yǐjīng hěn shǎo chūmén sànbù le.
en: Due to poor health, my maternal grandmother rarely goes out for a walk anymore.

zh: 即使生活充满艰辛，她也从不轻易在人前流泪。
pinyin: Jíshǐ shēnghuó chōngmǎn jiānxīn, tā yě cóngbù qīngyì zài rénqián liúlèi.
en: Even though life is full of hardships, she never sheds tears in front of others easily.

zh: 春天是播种的好季节，农民们正在田里忙碌着。
pinyin: Chūntiān shì bōzhǒng de hǎo jìjié, nóngmínmen zhèngzài tián lǐ mánglùzhe.
en: Spring is a good season for sowing, and the farmers are busy in the fields.

zh: 不管面临多少挫折，我们都应该继续追求理想。
pinyin: Bùguǎn miànlín duōshǎo cuòzhé, wǒmen dōu yīnggāi jìxù zhuīqiú lǐxiǎng.
en: No matter how many setbacks we face, we should continue to pursue our ideals.

zh: 与其在此争论，不如采取行动，你觉得怎么样？
pinyin: Yǔqí zài cǐ zhēnglùnglùn, bùrú cǎiqǔ xíngdòng, nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?
en: Instead of arguing here, how about we take action?

zh: 随着经济的发展，人们的生活渐渐富裕起来了。
pinyin: suí zhe jīng jì de fā zhǎn, rén men de shēng huó jiàn jiàn fù yù qǐ lái le.
en: With the development of the economy, people's lives have gradually become prosperous.

zh: 她凭借精明的判断力在激烈的竞争中脱颖而出。
pinyin: Tā píng jiè jīng míng de pàn duàn lì zài jī liè de jìng zhēng zhōng tuō yǐng ér chū.
en: She stood out in the fierce competition by virtue of her astute judgment.

zh: 这种理论对资本主义的矛盾进行了深刻的批判。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng lǐ lùn duì zī běn zhǔ yì de máo dùn jìn xíng le shēn kè de pī pàn.
en: This theory provides a profound critique of the contradictions of capitalism.

zh: 在这场忙乱的撤离行动中，许多人丢失了行李。
pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng mángluàn de chèlí xíngdòng zhōng, xǔduō rén diūshīle xínglǐ.
en: During this rushed and muddled evacuation, many people lost their luggage.

zh: 为了参加奥运会，运动员们每天都在努力训练。
pinyin: Wèile cānjiā àoyùnhuì, yùndòngyuánmen měitiān dōu zài nǔlì xùnliàn.
en: In order to participate in the Olympics, the athletes are training hard every day.

zh: 无论你是赞同还是反对，这项提议都已经通过了。
pinyin: wú lùn nǐ shì zàn tóng hái shì fǎn duì, zhè xiàng tí yì dōu yǐ jīng tōng guò le.
en: Regardless of whether you agree or oppose it, this proposal has already been passed.

zh: 医院专门为那些长期卧床的病人提供了康复训练。
pinyin: Yīyuàn zhuānmén wèi nàxiē chángqī wòchuáng de bìngrén tígōngle kāngfù xùnliàn.
en: The hospital specifically provided rehabilitation training for those bedridden invalids.

zh: 既然决定要去远方，就得保证身上有充足的物资。
pinyin: Jìrán juédìng yào qù yuǎnfāng, jiù dé bǎozhèng shēnshang yǒu chōngzú de wùzī.
en: Since you have decided to go far away, you must ensure you have enough supplies with you.

zh: 由于经营不善，那家老牌旅行社最终还是倒闭了。
pinyin: Yóuyú jīngyíng bùshàn, nà jiā lǎopái lǚxíngshè zuìzhōng háishì dǎobìle.
en: Due to poor management, that long-established travel agency eventually went bankrupt.

zh: 这件毛衣的款式非常时尚，很适合在正式场合穿。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn máoyī de kuǎnshì fēicháng shíshàng, hěn shìhé zài zhèngshì chǎnghé chuān.
en: The style of this sweater is very fashionable and suitable for formal occasions.

zh: 为了筹备即将到来的假期，我们提前预订了机票。
pinyin: Wèile chóubèi jíjiāng dàolái de jiàqī, wǒmen tíqián yùdìng le jīpiào.
en: In order to prepare for the upcoming vacation, we booked flight tickets in advance.

zh: 经过几个小时的艰难跋涉，我们终于登上了山顶。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ gè xiǎoshí de jiānnán báshè, wǒmen zhōngyú dēngshàng le shāndǐng.
en: After several hours of difficult trekking, we finally reached the hilltop.

zh: 面对这个复杂的局面，常专家提出了独特的见解。
pinyin: Miànduì zhège fùzá de júmiàn, Cháng zhuānjiā tíchū le dútè de jiànjiě.
en: Facing this complicated situation, Expert Chang put forward unique insights.

zh: 我们必须在上午截止日期之前提交这份机密文件。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū zài shàngwǔ jiézhǐ rìqī zhīqián tíjiāo zhè fèn jīmì wénjiàn.
en: We must submit this confidential document before the morning deadline.

zh: 那些激进分子企图通过媒体散布分裂国家的言论。
pinyin: Nàxiē jījìn fènzǐ qǐtú tōngguò méitǐ sànbù fēnliè guójiā de yánlùn.
en: Those radicals are attempting to spread separatist rhetoric through the media.

zh: 他在院子里栽了一棵柿子树，期待着来年的丰收。
pinyin: Tā zài yuànzi lǐ zāi le yī kē shìzi shù, qīdàizhe láinián de fēngshōu.
en: He planted a persimmon tree in the courtyard, looking forward to a bumper harvest next year.

zh: 通过整合多媒体资源，学习效率得到了显著提高。
pinyin: Tōngguò zhěnghé duō méi tǐ zīyuán, xuéxí xiàolǜ dédàole xiǎnzhù tígāo.
en: By integrating multimedia resources, learning efficiency has been significantly improved.

zh: 在传统的戏曲表演中，扇子常被用作重要的道具。
pinyin: Zài chuántǒng de xìqǔ biǎoyǎn zhōng, shànzi cháng bèi yòng zuò zhòngyào de dàojù.
en: In traditional theatrical performances, the fan is often used as an important prop.

zh: 为了支持丈夫的事业，她辞去了那份稳定的工作。
pinyin: Wèile zhīchí zhàngfu de shìyè, tā cíqù le nà fèn wěndìng de gōngzuò.
en: In order to support her husband's career, she resigned from that stable job.

zh: 尽管家庭条件不错，他依然过着非常节俭的生活。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn jiātíng tiáojiàn bùcuò, tā yīrán guòzhe fēicháng jiéjiǎn de shēnghuó.
en: Even though his family is well-off, he still leads a very frugal life.

zh: 考虑到自行车的零件老化，他不得不去店里修车。
pinyin: Kǎolǜ dào zìxíngchē de língjiàn lǎohuà, tā bùdébù qù diànlǐ xiū chē.
en: Considering the bike's parts are aging, he has to go to the shop to get it repaired.

zh: 他在大学期间通过选修课获得了不少额外的学分。
pinyin: Tā zài dàxué qījiān tōngguò xuǎnxiūkè huòdé le bùshǎo éwài de xuéfēn.
en: He earned quite a few extra course credits through elective courses during his university years.

zh: 马戏表演中那惊险的动作赢得了观众热烈的掌声。
pinyin: Mǎxì biǎoyǎn zhōng nà jīngxiǎn de dòngzuò yíngdéle guānzhòng rèliè de zhǎngshēng.
en: The thrilling stunts in the circus performance won warm applause from the audience.

zh: 真是的，由于你的粗心大意，整个计划都泡汤了。
pinyin: Zhēn shì de, yóuyú nǐ de cūxīndàyì, zhěnggè jìhuà dōu pàotāng le.
en: Really! Because of your carelessness, the whole plan was ruined.

zh: 这幅油画的色彩非常丰富，具有很高的艺术价值。
pinyin: Zhè fú yóuhuà de sècǎi fēicháng fēngfù, jùyǒu hěn gāo de yìshù jiàzhí.
en: The colors of this oil painting are very rich, and it has high artistic value.

zh: 幸好他的意见及时得到了反馈，项目才没有失败。
pinyin: Xìnghǎo tā de yìjiàn jíshí dédàole fǎnkuì, xiàngmù cái méiyǒu shībài.
en: Fortunately, his opinion was received in time, so the project did not fail.

zh: 他们凭借卓越的才华，终于在艺术领域脱颖而出。
pinyin: Tāmen píngjiè zhuóyuè de cáihuá, zhōngyú zài yìshù lǐngyù tuōyǐng ér chū.
en: Relying on their outstanding talent, they finally stood out in the field of art.

zh: 她那充满忧郁的眼神中，隐约闪烁着晶莹的眼泪。
pinyin: Tā nà chōngmǎn yōuyù de yǎnshén zhōng, yǐnyuē shǎnshuò zhe jīngyíng de yǎnlèi.
en: In her melancholy eyes, sparkling tears glimmered faintly.

zh: 发展航天事业对国家的经济和科技进步至关重要。
pinyin: fā zhǎn háng tiān shì yè duì guó jiā de jīng jì hé kē jì jìn bù zhì guān zhòng zhòng guān zhòng yào.
en: Developing the space flight industry is crucial to the nation's economic and technological progress.

zh: 鉴于恶劣的天气条件，搜救工作面临巨大的挑战。
pinyin: Jiànyú èliè de tiānqì tiáojiàn, sōujiù gōngzuò miànlín jùdà de tiǎozhàn.
en: Given the severe weather conditions, the search and rescue work is facing immense challenges.

zh: 这种现象在社会上或多或少地存在着，不容忽视。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng xiàn xiàng zài shè huì shàng huò duō huò shǎo de cún zài zhe, bù róng hū shì.
en: This phenomenon exists more or less in society and cannot be ignored.

zh: 大家没想到这位穿着朴素的老人竟然是一位大款。
pinyin: Dàjiā méi xiǎngdào zhè wèi chuānzhe púsù de lǎorén jìngrán shì yī wèi dà kuǎn.
en: Everyone did not expect that this simply dressed old man was actually a very wealthy person.

zh: 我们必须坚持到底，绝不能在关键时刻半途而废。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū jiānchí dàodǐ, juébùnéng zài guānjiàn shíkèkè bàntú'érfèi.
en: We must persist to the end and absolutely cannot give up halfway at a critical moment.

zh: 他在巴黎生活了十年，法语说得和母语一样流利。
pinyin: Tā zài Bālí shēnghuó le shí nián, fǎyǔ shuō de hé mǔyǔ yīyàng liúlì.
en: He lived in Paris for ten years, and his French is as fluent as his native language.

zh: 要在漫长的人生中遇见知己是一件极为幸运的事。
pinyin: Yào zài màncháng de rénshēng zhōng yùjiàn zhījǐ shì yī jiàn jíwéi xìngyùn de shì.
en: It is an extremely fortunate thing to meet a soulmate in one's long life.

zh: 如果想获得成功，就应该表现出不耻下问的态度。
pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng huòdé chénggōng, jiù yīnggāi biǎoxiàn chū bù chǐ xià wèn de tàidù.
en: If you want to achieve success, you should show an attitude of not being ashamed to ask those below you.

zh: 在缺乏监护的情况下，未成年人很容易受到伤害。
pinyin: Zài quēfá jiānhù de qíngkuàng xià, wèi chéngniánrén hěn róngyì shòudào shānghài.
en: In the absence of guardianship, minors are easily harmed.

zh: 面对突发状况，大部分人表现出了看热闹的心态。
pinyin: Miànduì túfā zhuàngkuàng, dàbùfèn rén biǎoxiàn chūle kàn rènao de xīntài.
en: Facing the emergency, most people showed a mentality of just watching the bustling scene.

zh: 为了家庭，他感到身不由己，必须继续辛苦工作。
pinyin: Wèile jiātíng, tā gǎndào shēn bù yóu jǐ, bìxū jìxù xīnkǔ gōngzuò.
en: For the sake of his family, he feels he has no control and must continue working hard.

zh: 由于发生了一起严重车祸，高速公路暂时封闭了。
pinyin: Yóuyú fāshēngle yīqǐ yánzhòng chēhuò, gāosù gōnglù zhànshí fēngbì le.
en: Due to a serious traffic accident, the expressway is temporarily closed.

zh: 他的这种行为令人极其失望，以至于我无话可说。
pinyin: Tā de zhè zhǒng xíngwéi lìng rén jíqí shīwàng, yǐ zhìyú wǒ wú huà kě shuō.
en: This behavior of his is extremely disappointing, to the point where I have nothing to say.

zh: 面对巨大的工作压力，学会适度放松是至关重要的。
pinyin: Miànduì jùdà de gōngzuò yālì, xuéhuì shìdù fàngsōng shì zhìguān zhòngyào de.
en: Facing immense work pressure, learning to relax appropriately is crucial.

zh: 在那次激烈的争论中，他选择一声不吭，以示抗议。
pinyin: Zài nà cì jīliè de zhēnglùn zhōng, tā xuǎnzé yī shēng bù kēng, yǐ shì kàngyì.
en: During that heated argument, he chose to remain silent as a form of protest.

zh: 即使在大雪天气，公共汽车依然准时接送乘客上车。
pinyin: Jíshǐ zài dàxuě tiānqì, gōnggòng qìchē yīrán zhǔnshí jiēsòng chéngkè shàng chē.
en: Even in heavy snow, the bus still picks up passengers on time.

zh: 长期以来，这片土地的生态环境得到了有效的保护。
pinyin: Cháng qī yǐ lái, zhè piàn tǔdì de shēngtài huánjìng dédào le yǒuxiào de bǎohù.
en: For a long time, the ecological environment of this land has been effectively protected.

zh: 人的一生很难事事都遂心，应当学会坦然面对遗憾。
pinyin: Rén de yīshēng hěn nán shìshì dōu suìxīn, yīngdāng xuéhuì tǎnrán miànduì yíhàn.
en: It is difficult for everything in one's life to be to one's liking; one should learn to face regrets with composure.

zh: 对于那里的经济发展，专家们持有截然不同的观点。
pinyin: Duìyú nà li de jīngjì fāzhǎn, zhuānjiāmen chíyǒu jiérán bùtóng de guāndiǎn.
en: Regarding the economic development there, the experts hold completely different viewpoints.

zh: 随着工业的发展，职业病的防治工作显得尤为重要。
pinyin: Suízhe gōngyè de fāzhǎn, zhíyèbìng de fángzhì gōngzuò xiǎnde yóuwéi zhòngyào.
en: With the development of industry, the prevention and control of occupational diseases have become particularly important.

zh: 他那种冷静的态度，就像暴风雨来临前的宁静一样。
pinyin: Tā nà zhǒng lěngjìng de tàidù, jiù xiàng bàofēngyǔ láilín qián de níngjìng yīyàng.
en: His calm attitude is like the stillness before a storm.

zh: 在双方父母的见证下，他们举行了隆重的订婚仪式。
pinyin: Zài shuāngfāng fùmǔ de jiànzhèng xià, tāmen jǔxíng le lóngzhòng de dìnghūn yíshì.
en: Under the witness of both parents, they held a grand engagement ceremony.

zh: 为了孩子能受到更好的教育，他们决定在城市定居。
pinyin: Wèile háizi néng shòudào gèng hǎo de jiàoyù, tāmen juédìng zài chéngshì dìngjū.
en: In order for their children to receive a better education, they decided to settle in the city.

zh: 尽管月饼的种类繁多，但我还是最喜欢传统的口味。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yuèbǐng de zhǒnglèi fánduō, dàn wǒ háishì zuì xǐhuān chuántǒng de kǒuwèi.
en: Although there are many varieties of mooncakes, I still prefer the traditional flavors.

zh: 经过调查，我们发现他竟然是整个事件的罪魁祸首。
pinyin: Jīngguò diàochá, wǒmen fāxiàn tā jìngrán shì zhěnggè shìjiàn de zuìkuíhuòshǒu.
en: After investigation, we discovered that he was actually the ringleader of the entire incident.

zh: 他们俩看起来关系非常融洽，不像是有矛盾的样子。
pinyin: Tāmen liǎ kàn qǐ lai guānxì fēicháng róngqià, bù xiàng shì yǒu máodùn de yàngzi.
en: The two of them seem to have a very harmonious relationship; they don't look like they have any conflict.

zh: 听到这个意外的消息，他心中不免产生了一丝不安。
pinyin: tīng dào zhè ge yì wài de xiāo xi, tā xīn zhōng bù miǎn chǎn shēng le yī sī bù ān.
en: Hearing this unexpected news, he inevitably felt a trace of unease in his heart.

zh: 与其在这个闷热的房间里待着，不如去公园散散步。
pinyin: Yǔqí zài zhège mēnrè de fángjiān lǐ dāizhe, bùrú qù gōngyuán sànsànbù.
en: Rather than staying in this stuffy room, it's better to go for a walk in the park.

zh: 各国的运动员在亚运会上表现出了极高的竞技水平。
pinyin: gè guó de yùn dòng yuán zài yà yùn huì shàng biǎo xiàn chū le jí gāo de jìng jì shuǐ píng.
en: The athletes from various countries demonstrated an extremely high level of competition at the Asian Games.

zh: 虽然我们没有血缘关系，但他像我大哥一样照顾我。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen méiyǒu xuèyuán guānxì, dàn tā xiàng wǒ dàgē yīyàng zhàogù wǒ.
en: Although we are not related by blood, he takes care of me like a big brother.

zh: 外公那深沉的爱，是我人生道路上源源不断的动力。
pinyin: Wàigōng nà shēnchén de ài, shì wǒ rénshēng dàolù shàng yuányuán bùduàn de dònglì.
en: My maternal grandfather's deep love is a constant source of motivation on my life's journey.

zh: 为了完成这项庞大的工作，我们需要更多人的帮助。
pinyin: Wèile wánchéng zhè xiàng pángdà de gōngzuò, wǒmen xūyào gèng duō rén de bāngzhù.
en: To complete this huge task, we need more people's help.

zh: 为了庆祝生日，我们去餐厅享用了一顿丰盛的晚餐。
pinyin: Wèile qìngzhù shēngrì, wǒmen qù cāntīng xiǎngyòng le yī dùn fēngshèng de wǎncān.
en: To celebrate the birthday, we went to a restaurant to enjoy a sumptuous dinner.

zh: 在这个充满竞争的时代，很多人都害怕被社会淘汰。
pinyin: Zài zhège chōngmǎn jìngzhēng de shídài, hěnduō rén dōu hàipà bèi shèhuì táotài.
en: In this competitive era, many people are afraid of being eliminated by society.

zh: 尽管两人发生过争执，但他对女朋友的感情始终如一。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn liǎng rén fāshēngguò zhēngzhí, dàn tā duì nǚpéngyǒu de gǎnqíng shǐzhōng rúyī.
en: Although they have had arguments, his feelings for his girlfriend remain constant.

zh: 虽然现场非常嘈杂，但我还是清晰地听到了他的发言。
pinyin: Suīrán xiànchǎng fēicháng cáozá, dàn wǒ háishì qīngxī de tīng dào le tā de fāyán.
en: Although the scene was very noisy, I still clearly heard his speech.

zh: 在极其枯燥的研究工作中，他依然保持着高度的耐性。
pinyin: Zài jíqí kūzào de yánjiū gōngzuò zhōng, tā yīrán bǎochízhe gāodù de nài xìng.
en: During the extremely boring research work, he still maintained a high level of patience.

zh: 我们开车经过那个弯道时，请一定要慢一点转方向盘。
pinyin: Wǒmen kāichē jīngguò nàge wāndào shí, qǐng yīdìng yào màn yīdiǎn zhuǎi fāngxiàngpán.
en: When we drive past that curve, please be sure to turn the steering wheel slowly.

zh: 儿子终于不负众望，在这次考试中取得了优异的成绩。
pinyin: Érzi zhōngyú bùfùzhòngwàng, zài zhè cì kǎoshì zhōng qǔdéle yōuyì de chéngjì.
en: The son finally lived up to expectations and achieved excellent results in this exam.

zh: 在传统的中国家庭观念中，亲戚之间的关系非常密切。
pinyin: Zài chuántǒng de Zhōngguó jiātíng guānniàn zhōng, qīnqi zhī jiān de guānxì fēicháng mìqiè.
en: In traditional Chinese family values, the relationships between relatives are very close.

zh: 他气喘吁吁地跑上楼去，想赶快告诉大家这个好消息。
pinyin: Tā qìchuǎnxūxū de pǎoshàng lóu qù, xiǎng gǎnkuài gàosù dàjiā zhège hǎo xiāoxi.
en: He ran upstairs panting, wanting to tell everyone the good news quickly.

zh: 即使在这样恶劣的天气下，我依然能看见远处的灯塔。
pinyin: Jíshǐ zài zhèyàng èliè de tiānqì xià, wǒ yīrán néng kànjiàn yuǎnchù de dēngtǎ.
en: Even in such severe weather, I can still see the lighthouse in the distance.

zh: 李老师在学术领域享有很高的声誉，深受学生的尊敬。
pinyin: Lǐ lǎoshī zài xuéshù lǐngyù xiǎngyǒu hěn gāo de shēngyù, shēn shòu xuéshēng de zūnjìng.
en: Teacher Li enjoys a high reputation in the academic field and is deeply respected by students.

zh: 通过下棋，我不仅学会了思考，还结识了不少新朋友。
pinyin: Tōngguò xià qí, wǒ bùjǐn xuéhuì le sīkǎo, hái jiéshí le bùshǎo xīn péngyǒu.
en: Through playing chess, I not only learned how to think but also made many new friends.

zh: 小明在舞台上表演时出了个丑，台下的观众哄堂大笑。
pinyin: Xiǎomíng zài wǔtái shàng biǎoyǎn shí chū le gè chǒu, táixià de guānzhòng hōngtángdàxiào.
en: Xiao Ming made a fool of himself while performing on stage, and the audience roared with laughter.

zh: 我们要欣赏他那耿直的品质，不必计较他表达的方式。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào xīnshǎng tā nà gěngzhí de pǐnzhì, bùbì jìjiào tā biǎodá de fāngshì.
en: We should appreciate his honest quality and not worry too much about his way of expressing himself.

zh: 经过了一周的阴雨连绵，今天终于迎来了晴朗的天气。
pinyin: jīngguò le yīzhōu de yīnyǔ liánmián, jīntiān zhōngyú yínglái le qínglǎng de tiānqì.
en: After a week of continuous rain, we finally welcomed sunny weather today.

zh: 他在外语学院进修，旨在进一步巩固自己的听力优势。
pinyin: tā zài wài yǔ xué yuàn jìn xiū, zhǐ zài jìn yī bù gǒng gù zì jǐ de tīng lì yōu shì.
en: He is pursuing advanced studies at the Foreign Language Institute, aiming to further consolidate his advantage in listening ability.

zh: 由于长期服用这种药片，他的身体产生了一些副作用。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī fúyòng zhè zhǒng yàopiàn, tā de shēntǐ chǎnshēngle yīxiē fùzuòyòng.
en: Due to long-term use of this pill, his body developed some side effects.

zh: 这两家公司的管理方式截然不同，实在无法一概而论。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī de guǎnlǐ fāngshì jiérán bùtóng, shízài wúfǎ yīgài'érlùn.
en: The management styles of these two companies are completely different and cannot be lumped together.

zh: 通过跳舞，她不仅锻炼了身体，还培养了优雅的气质。
pinyin: Tōngguò tiàowǔ, tā bùjǐn duànliàn le shē shēntǐ, hái péiyǎng le yōuyǎ de qìzhì.
en: By dancing, she not only exercised her body but also cultivated an elegant temperament.

zh: 为了消暑，他一口气买了好几个西瓜放在冰箱里冷藏。
pinyin: Wèile xiāoshǔ, tā yīkǒuqì mǎi le hǎo jǐ gè xīguā fàng zài bīngxiāng lǐ lěngcáng.
en: To beat the heat, he bought several watermelons in one go and put them in the refrigerator to chill.

zh: 由于他在高速公路上严重违章，警察吊销了他的驾照。
pinyin: Yóuyú tā zài gāosù gōnglù shàng yánzhòng wéizhāng, jǐngchá diàoxiāo le tā de jiàzhào.
en: Because he committed a serious traffic violation on the highway, the police revoked his driver's license.

zh: 我不认为一个人的价值取决于他身上是否穿戴着名牌儿。
pinyin: Wǒ bù rènwéi yígè rén de jiàzhí qǔjué yú tā shēnshang shìfǒu chuāndàizhe míngpáir.
en: I don't think a person's value depends on whether they are wearing designer brands.

zh: 她那条做工考究的裙子，完美地衬托出了她优雅的气质。
pinyin: Tā nà tiáo zuògōng kǎojiù de qúnzi, wánměi de chèntuō chūle tā yōuyǎ de qìzhì.
en: Her exquisitely crafted skirt perfectly complemented her elegant temperament.

zh: 在那个特殊的时代，许多知识分子受到了不公平的待遇。
pinyin: Zài nàge tèshū de shídài, xǔduō zhīshi fènzǐ shòudào le bù gōngpíng de dàiyù.
en: In that special era, many intellectuals were treated unfairly.

zh: 经过多年的努力，他终于如愿以偿地进入了理想的大学。
pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, tā zhōngyú rúyuànyǐcháng de jìnrù le lǐxiǎng de dàxué.
en: After years of effort, he finally fulfilled his wish of entering his ideal university.

zh: 没有任何真理是绝对的，我们需要不断地去探索和修正。
pinyin: Méiyǒu rènhé zhēnlǐ shì juéduì de, wǒmen xūyào bùduàn de qù tànsuǒ hé xiūzhèng.
en: No truth is absolute; we need to constantly explore and revise it.

zh: 因为他总是很幽默，所以大家给他起了一个风趣的外号。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā zǒngshì hěn yōumò, suǒyǐ dàjiā gěi tā qǐle yīgè fēngqù de wàihào.
en: Because he is always humorous, everyone gave him a funny nickname.

zh: 他站在月台上，向那个曾经寄托了他梦想的地方郑重告别。
pinyin: Tā zhàn zài yuètái shàng, xiàng nàgè céngjīng jìtuō le tā mèngxiǎng de dìfāng zhèngzhòng gàobié.
en: He stood on the platform, solemnly bidding farewell to the place that once held his dreams.

zh: 虽然这家图书馆的设备有些陈旧，但学习氛围依然很浓厚。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā túshūguǎn de shèbèi yǒuxiē chénjiù, dàn xuéxí fēnwéi yīrán hěn nónghòu.
en: Although the facilities of this library are a bit outdated, the study atmosphere is still very strong.

zh: 看着那群玩耍的小孩儿，他不禁陷入了对童年的回忆之中。
pinyin: Kànzhe nà qún wánshuǎ de xiǎo hái r, tā bùjīn xiànrùle duì tóngnián de huíyì zhī zhōng.
en: Watching that group of playing children, he could not help but fall into memories of his childhood.

zh: 学校不仅要传授知识，还要引导中学生树立正确的人生观。
pinyin: xué xiào bù jǐn yào chuán shòu zhī shi, hái yào yǐn dǎo zhōng xué shēng shù lì zhèng què de rén shēng guān.
en: Schools should not only impart knowledge but also guide high school students to establish a correct outlook on life.

zh: 在庄严的礼堂里，任何交头接耳的行为都是对他人的不尊重。
pinyin: Zài zhuāngyán de lǐtáng lǐ, rènhé jiāotóujiēěr de xíngwéi dōu shì duì tārén de bù zūnzhòng.
en: In the solemn auditorium, any behavior of whispering to each other is a sign of disrespect to others.

zh: 尽管现在的饮食习惯发生了改变，米饭依然是很多人的主食。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiànzài de yǐnshí xíguàn fāshēngle gǎibiàn, mǐfàn yīrán shì hěnduō rén de zhǔshí.
en: Although dietary habits have changed nowadays, rice remains a staple food for many people.

zh: 尽管他竭尽全力去争取，最终还是没接到这个重要的工程项目。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā jiéjìn quánlì qù zhēngqǔ, zuìzhōng háishì méi jiē dào zhège zhòngyào de gōngchéng xiàngmù.
en: Although he tried his best to compete for it, he ultimately did not receive this important engineering project.

zh: 护士把针扎入静脉血管。
pinyin: Hùshi bǎ zhēn zhārù jìngmài xuèguǎn.
en: The nurse inserted the needle into the vein.

zh: 世间万物皆为虚无梦幻。
pinyin: Shì jiān wàn wù jiē wéi xū wú mèng huàn.
en: All things in the world are empty illusions.

zh: 保加利亚在欧洲的东南部。
pinyin: Bǎojiālìyà zài Ōuzhōu de dōngnánbù.
en: Bulgaria is in the southeast of Europe.

zh: 这座雕塑刻画得栩栩如生。
pinyin: Zhè zuò diāosù kèhuà dé xǔxǔrúshēng.
en: This statue is carved vividly.

zh: 必须精练原棉以去除杂质。
pinyin: Bìxū jīngliàn yuánmián yǐ qùchú zázhì.
en: It is necessary to scour raw cotton to remove impurities.

zh: 画框贴歪了，请把它调平。
pinyin: huàkuāng tiē wāi le, qǐng bǎ tā tiáo píng.
en: The frame is stuck at a crooked angle, please adjust it to be flat.

zh: 流亡者历尽艰辛终于登陆。
pinyin: Liúwángzhě lìjìn jiānxīn zhōngyú dēnglù.
en: The exiles endured great hardships and finally came ashore.

zh: 该餐厅主营各式高端海鲜。
pinyin: Gāi cāntīng zhǔyíng gèshì gāoduān hǎixiān.
en: The restaurant specializes in various types of high-end seafood.

zh: 城市版图随人口扩张而膨胀。
pinyin: chéng shì bǎn tú suí rén kǒu kuò zhāng ér péng zhàng.
en: The city map expands as the population grows.

zh: 此后，法律将严惩此类行为。
pinyin: Cǐ hòu, fǎlǜ jiāng yánchéng cǐ lèi xíngwéi.
en: Hereafter, the law will strictly punish such actions.

zh: 诗人常借季节更替抒发情感。
pinyin: Shī rén cháng jiè jì jié gēng tì shū fā qíng gǎn.
en: Poets often use the change of seasons to express their emotions.

zh: 这种解释无须深究其合理性。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiěshì wúxū shēnjiū qí hélǐxìng.
en: One does not necessarily need to delve into the rationality of this explanation.

zh: 其论据空洞且显得非常疑惑。
pinyin: Qí lùnjù kōngdòng qiě xiǎnde fēicháng yíhuò.
en: Its argument is empty and appears very unconvincing.

zh: 安装过程务必做到精准无误。
pinyin: Ānzhuāng guòchéng wùbì zuòdào jīngzhǔn wúwù.
en: The fixing process must be precise and error-free.

zh: 医学界已经攻克了该类病症。
pinyin: yī xué jiè yǐ jīng gōng kè le gāi lèi bìng zhèng.
en: The medical field has conquered this type of disease.

zh: 必须进一步探究其深层原因。
pinyin: Bìxū jìnyībù tànjiū qí shēncéng yuányīn.
en: We must go a step further to explore its underlying causes.

zh: 人们前往故居瞻仰伟人遗容。
pinyin: Rénmen qiánwǎng gùjū zhānyǎng wěirén yíróng.
en: People went to the former residence to pay respects to the great man.

zh: 他义无反顾地奔赴战乱之地。
pinyin: tā yìwúfǎngù de bēnfù zhànluàn zhī dì.
en: He rushed to the war-torn region without hesitation.

zh: 被告请求法官重新审理此案。
pinyin: Bèigào qǐngqiú fǎguān chóngxīn shěnlǐ cǐ àn.
en: The defendant requested the judge to retry the case.

zh: 他因伪造支票而被警方逮捕。
pinyin: Tā yīn wěizào zhīpiào ér bèi jǐngfá dàibǔ.
en: He was arrested by the police for forging a cheque.

zh: 重型负荷可能会导致桥梁坍塌。
pinyin: Zhòngxíng fùhé kěnéng huì dǎozhì qiáoliáng tāntā.
en: A heavy load might cause the bridge to collapse.

zh: 政府鼓励村民搬迁以改善生活。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ gǔlì cūnmín bānqiān yǐ gǎishàn shēnghuóu shēnghuó.
en: The government encourages villagers to relocate to improve their lives.

zh: 部落的巫婆通过仪式祈求雨水。
pinyin: bù luò de wū pó tōng guò yí shì qí qiú yǔ shuǐ.
en: The tribe's female shaman prays for rain through rituals.

zh: 敌军大批反正，战局得以扭转。
pinyin: dí jūn dà pī fǎn zhèng, zhàn jú dé yǐ niǔ zhuǎn.
en: The enemy forces defected in large numbers, and the war situation was reversed.

zh: 经过太阳照射，桃子变得红润。
pinyin: jīng guò tài yáng zhào shè, táo zi biàn dé hóng rùn.
en: After being exposed to the sun, the peaches became florid.

zh: 不要为了虚荣心而刻意出风头。
pinyin: Bùyào wèile xūróngxīn ér kèyì chū fēngtou.
en: Do not deliberately push yourself forward out of vanity.

zh: 前线官兵誓死防护每一寸领土。
pinyin: Qiánxiàn guānbīng shìsǐ fánghù měi yī cùn lǐngtǔ.
en: The officers and soldiers on the front line vow to defend every inch of territory to the death.

zh: 该行业受政府严格的牌照管制。
pinyin: Gāi hángyè shòu zhèngfǔ yángé de páizhào guǎnzhì.
en: This industry is subject to strict government license regulation.

zh: 靠投机取巧发财往往难以长久。
pinyin: Kào tóujīqǔqiǎo fā cái wǎngwǎng nányǐ chángjiǔ.
en: Getting rich by opportunistic schemes is often difficult to sustain.

zh: 因路面湿滑，刹车距离变长了。
pinyin: yīn lù miàn miàn shī huá, shā chē jù lí biàn cháng le.
en: Due to the wet road, the braking distance increased.

zh: 新郎西装革履，显得神采奕奕。
pinyin: Xīnláng xīzhuānggélǚ, xiǎnde shéncǎi yìyì.
en: The bridegroom was dressed in a suit, looking full of vigor.

zh: 这种商品被归为高端消费类别。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng shāng pǐn bèi guī wéi gāo duān xiāo fèi lèi bié.

zh: 政府致力于通过合理的政策来调节贫富分配。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhìlì yú tōngguò hélǐ de zhèngcè lái tiáojié pínfù fēnpèi.
en: The government is committed to regulating the distribution of wealth through reasonable policies.

zh: 他陶醉于这壮丽的景色之中，久久不愿离去。
pinyin: Tā táozuì yú zhè zhuànglì de jǐngsè zhī zhōng, jiǔjiǔ bù yuàn líqù.
en: He was so enchanted by the magnificent scenery that he was reluctant to leave for a long time.

zh: 经过深思熟虑，他最终决定走路去外地发展。
pinyin: jīngguò shēnsīshúlǜ, tā zuìzhōng juédìng zǒulù qù wàidì fāzhǎn.
en: After careful consideration, he finally decided to leave to develop elsewhere.

zh: 为了减少污染，许多国家开始大力发展核能。
pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo wūrǎn, xǔduō guójiā kāishǐ dàlì fāzhǎn hénéng.
en: In order to reduce pollution, many countries have begun to vigorously develop nuclear energy.

zh: 该建筑物上的醒目标志引导着游客前往入口。
pinyin: gāi jiàn zhù wù shàng de xǐng mù biāo zhì yǐn dǎo zhe yóu kè qián wǎng rù kǒu.
en: The prominent sign on the building guides tourists to the entrance.

zh: 政府通过了一系列关于绿色发展的指导方针。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tōngguòle yī xìliè guānyú lǜsè fāzhǎn de zhǐdǎo fāngzhēn.
en: The government has passed a series of guidelines regarding green development.

zh: 研究显示，女性在管理层的百分比有所上升。
pinyin: Yán jiū xiǎn shì, nǚ xìng zài guǎn lǐ céng de bǎi fēn bǐ yǒu suǒ shàng shēng.
en: Research shows that the percentage of women in management has risen.

zh: 通过精打细算，他一直在储蓄以备不时之需。
pinyin: Tōngguò jīngdǎxìsuàn, tā yīzhí zài chǔxù yǐ bèi bùshízhīxū.
en: By careful calculation, he has been saving money for a rainy day.

zh: 辩论赛中，他着重强调了制度改革的紧迫性。
pinyin: Biànlùnsài zhōng, tā zhuózhòng qiángdiào le zhìdù gǎigé de jǐnpòxìng.
en: In the debate, he stressed the urgency of institutional reform.

zh: 受经济影响，几家大型百货零售商纷纷倒闭。
pinyin: Shòu jīngjì yǐngxiǎng, jǐ jiā dàxíng bǎihuò língshòushāng fēnfēn dǎobì.
en: Affected by the economy, several large department store retailers have gone bankrupt.

zh: 我们需要测验该材料在极端环境下的稳定性。
pinyin: wǒ men xū yào cè yàn gāi cái liào zài jí duān huán jìng xià de wěn dìng xìng.
en: We need to test the stability of the material in extreme environments.

zh: 只有客观地分析形势，才能制定正确的对策。
pinyin: Zhǐ yǒu kèguān de fēnxī xíngshì, cáinéng zhìdìng zhèngquè de duìcè.
en: Only if one analyzes the situation objectively can one formulate correct countermeasures.

zh: 采取措施来及早预防这种疾病是非常关键的。

en: Taking measures to prevent this disease as early as possible is very critical.

zh: 大地震后，那些精美的雕塑都变得残缺破碎。
pinyin: dà dì zhèn hòu, nà xiē jīng měi de diāo sù dōu biàn dé cán quē pò suì.
en: After the great earthquake, those exquisite sculptures were left shattered.

zh: 为了防止洪水，当地居民修建了坚固的堤坝。
pinyin: Wèile fángzhǐ hóngshuǐ, dāngdì jūmín xiūjiàn le jiāngù de dībà.
en: In order to prevent floods, local residents built strong embankments.

zh: 只有通过勤劳的双手，才能创造美好的未来。

en: Only through hardworking hands can one create a beautiful future.

zh: 这场罕见的洪灾使成千上万的居民无家可归。

zh: 面对那些酒肉相识，他总是表现得非常疏离。

en: Faced with those superficial acquaintances, he always appears very distant.

zh: 由于水管破裂，小区暂时停止了自来水供应。
pinyin: Yóuyú shuǐguǎn pòliè, xiǎoqū zhànshí tíngzhǐle zìláishuǐ gōngyìng.
en: Due to a burst water pipe, the residential area has temporarily stopped running water supply.

zh: 为了响应号召，大批知识分子纷纷下乡支教。
pinyin: Wèile xiǎngyìng hàozhào, dàpī zhīshífènzǐ fēnfēn xiàxiāng zhījiào.
en: In response to the call, a large number of intellectuals went to the countryside to support education.

zh: 该吉祥物的设计体现了当地独特的文化特色。
pinyin: Gāi jíxiángwù de shèjì tǐxiànle dāngdì dútè de wénhuà tèsè.
en: The design of the mascot embodies the local unique cultural characteristics.

zh: 任何试图危害国家利益的行为都将受到惩罚。

zh: 我们不应该因为别人的缺点而肆意取笑他人。
pinyin: Wǒmen bù yīnggāi yīnwèi biérén de quēdiǎn ér sìyì qǔxiào tārén.

zh: 为了防止传染病，政府加强了对牲畜的检疫。

zh: 无论走到哪里，亲人的嘱托总会回荡在耳畔。

en: After a long legal process, he finally won this lawsuit.

en: As long as the links are tightly connected, no fatal accidents will occur.

pinyin: kēxué jìshù de jìnbù xiǎnzhù jiāsù le shèhuì zhuǎnxíng de jìnchéng.
en: The advancement of science and technology has significantly accelerated the process of social transformation.

zh: 为了确认信息的准确性，我核实了那条消息。

zh: 由于长期缺乏锻炼，他的胃口变得越来越差。

zh: 在这种复杂局势下，必须通过替身保护自己。

zh: 由于前途未卜，他的内心充满了深深的忧愁。

zh: 她凭借其出色的领导能力获得了大家的尊敬。

zh: 他挥动着手中的棍子，试图驱赶靠近的野兽。

zh: 他辛苦了一辈子，终于可以安享养老生活了。
pinyin: Tā xīnkǔle yībèizi, zhōngyú kěyǐ ānxiǎng yǎng lǎo shēnghuó le.
en: He worked hard all his life and can finally enjoy a peaceful retirement life.

zh: 为了重振经济，他们重新装修了市郊的舞厅。

zh: 这场宏大的交响乐演奏会在学校礼堂圆满落幕。

zh: 通过第一手资料，我们可以更清楚地了解情况。

zh: 虽然汽水很解渴，但是含糖量太高，不宜多喝。

en: Traditional Chinese culture continues to thrive in today's society.

zh: 虽然我经验不足，但还是希望前辈能不吝指教。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ jīngyàn bùzú, dàn háishì xīwàng qiánbèi néng bùlìn zhǐjiào.
en: Although I lack experience, I still hope my seniors will not hesitate to give me guidance.

zh: 为了方便发送，我把这个视频压缩成了小文件。
pinyin: Wèile fāngbiàn fāsòng, wǒ bǎ zhège shìpín yāsuō chéng le xiǎo wénjiàn.
en: For ease of sending, I compressed this video into a small file.

zh: 这个湖泊的水位因为长期的干旱而大幅度下降。
pinyin: Zhège húbō de shuǐwèi yīnwèi chángqī de gānhàn ér dàfúdù xiàjiàng.
en: The water level of this lake has dropped significantly due to the long-term drought.

zh: 由于长期疲劳的累积，他的健康状况日益恶化。
pinyin: yóuyú chángqī píláo de lěijī, tā de jiànkāng zhuàngkuàng rìyì èhuà.
en: Due to the long-term accumulation of fatigue, his health condition is deteriorating day by day.

zh: 真正的友谊往往建立在无条件信任的基础之上。
pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de yǒuyì wǎngwǎng jiànlì zài wútiáojiàn xìnrèn de jīchǔ zhī shàng.
en: True friendship is often built on the foundation of unconditional trust.

zh: 由于地理位置优越，这家饭店在当地享有盛誉。
pinyin: Yóuyú dìlǐ wèizhì yōuyuè, zhè jiā fàndiàn zài dāngdì xiǎngyǒu shèngyù.
en: Due to its prime location, this restaurant enjoys a great reputation locally.

zh: 我们要具备批判性思维，深入探讨哲学的本质。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào jùbèi pīpànxìng sīwéi, shēnrù tàntǎo zhéxué de běnzhì.
en: We must possess critical thinking and delve deeply into the essence of philosophy.

zh: 趁机利用这个良好的形势，公司决定扩大规模。
pinyin: Chènjī lìyòng zhège liánghǎo de xíngshì, gōngsī juédìng kuòdà guīmó.
en: Seizing the opportunity provided by this favorable situation, the company decided to expand its scale.

zh: 人类的活动已经对鲨鱼的生存环境构成了威胁。
pinyin: Rénlèi de huódòng yǐjīng duì shāyú de shēngcún huánjìng gòuchéngle wēixié.
en: Human activities have posed a threat to the living environment of sharks.

zh: 学校通过官方渠道通报了著名学者的来访事宜。
pinyin: Xuéxiào tōngguò guānfāng qúdào tōngbào le zhùmíng xuézhě de láifǎng shìyí.
en: The school announced the matters concerning the famous scholar's visit through official channels.

zh: 面对突发状况，他表现得从容不迫，让人放心。
pinyin: miàn duì tduì tū fā zhuàng kuàng, tā biǎo xiàn dé cóng róng bù pò, ràng rén fàng xīn.
en: Facing the sudden situation, he acted calmly, making people feel relieved.

zh: 由于客观条件的局限，这个计划暂时无法实施。
pinyin: Yóuyú kèguān tiáojiàn de júxiàn, zhège jìhuà zànshí wúfǎ shíshī.
en: Due to the limitations of objective conditions, this plan cannot be implemented for the time being.

zh: 代表团在访问期间受到了当地政府隆重的接待。
pinyin: Dàibiǎotuán zài fǎngfǎng qījiān shòudào le dāngdì zhèngfǔ lóngzhòng de jiēdài.
en: The delegation received a grand reception from the local government during their visit.

zh: 这个地区的土壤非常适合种植这种名贵的草药。
pinyin: Zhège dìqū de tǔrǎng fēicháng shìhé zhòngzhí zhè zhǒng míngguì de cǎoyào.
en: The soil in this area is very suitable for planting this kind of precious medicinal herb.

zh: 他在林间小路上漫步，嘴里还轻快地吹着口哨。
pinyin: Tā zài línjiān xiǎolù shàng mànbù, zuǐ lǐ hái qīngkuài de chuīzhe kǒushào.
en: He strolled along the forest path, whistling a tune lightheartedly.

zh: 他总是习惯把责任推卸给别人，而不反思自己。
pinyin: Tā zǒng shì xíguàn bǎ zérèn tuīxiè gěi biérén, ér bù fǎnsī zìjǐ.
en: He is always in the habit of shifting responsibility to others rather than reflecting on himself.

zh: 会议定于中午十二点结束，以便大家享用午餐。
pinyin: Huìyì dìngyú zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn jiéshù, yǐbiàn dàjiā xiǎngyòng wǔcān.
en: The meeting is scheduled to end at noon so everyone can enjoy lunch.

zh: 尽管经历了许多挫折，他依然对未来充满乐观。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn jīnglì le xǔduō cuòzhé, tā yīrán duì wèilái chōngmǎn lèguān.
en: Despite having experienced many setbacks, he remains full of optimism about the future.

zh: 由于系统升级失败，他的笔记本处于瘫痪状态。
pinyin: Yóuyú xìtǒng shēngjí shībài, tā de bǐjìběn chǔyú tānhuàn zhuàngtài.
en: Due to a failed system upgrade, his laptop is in a paralyzed state.

zh: 尽管面对严峻的考验，他依然强忍住没有哭泣。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn miànduì yánjùn de kǎoyàn, tā yīrán qiǎng rěnzhù méiyǒu kūqì.
en: Despite facing severe trials, he still held back his tears and did not weep.

zh: 由于护照丢失，他不得不前往领事馆寻求帮助。
pinyin: Yóuyú hùzhào diūshī, tā bùdébù qiánwǎng lǐngshìguǎn xúnqiú bāngzhù.
en: Due to his passport being lost, he had to go to the consulate to seek help.

zh: 住房保障体系是社会福利制度的重要组成部分。
pinyin: Zhùfáng bǎozhàng tǐxì shì shèhuì fúlì zhìdù de zhòngyào zǔchéng bùfèn.
en: The housing security system is an important component of the social welfare system.

zh: 会议上，代表们针对该方案进行了深入的谈论。
pinyin: Huìyì shàng, dàibiǎomen zhēnduì gāi fāng'àn jìnxíngle shēnrù de tánlùn.
en: At the meeting, the representatives conducted an in-depth discussion regarding the proposal.

zh: 尽管晚年生活凄凉，他依然保持着乐观的态度。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wǎnnián shēnghuó qīliáng, tā yīrán bǎochízhe lèguān de tàidù.
en: Although his later life was mournful, he still maintained an optimistic attitude.

zh: 这位艺术家擅长用动人的旋律歌咏生命的真谛。
pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā shàncháng yòng dòngrén de xuánlǜ gēyǒng shēngmìng de zhēndì.
en: This artist is adept at using moving melodies to sing of the true meaning of life.

zh: 核武器的存在构成了对全人类安全的巨大威胁。
pinyin: Hé wǔ qì de cúnzài gòuchéngle duì quán rénlèi quán rénlèi ānquán de jùdà wēixié.
en: The existence of nuclear weapons constitutes a huge threat to the security of all mankind.

zh: 这套课本系统地阐述了现代物理学的基础理论。
pinyin: Zhè tào kèběn xìtǒng de chǎnshùle xiàndài wùlǐxué de jīchǔ lǐlùn.
en: This textbook series systematically explains the basic theories of modern physics.

zh: 他敏锐地察觉到空气中弥漫着一股烧焦的气味。
pinyin: Tā mǐnruì de chájué dào kōngqì zhōng mímànzhe yī gǔ shāojiāo de qìwèi.
en: He keenly sensed a burnt odor permeating the air.

zh: 为了跟上时代，我们必须摒弃那些陈旧的思想。
pinyin: Wèile gēnshàng shídài, wǒmen bìxū bǐngqì nàxiē chénjiù de sīxiǎng.
en: In order to keep up with the times, we must abandon those old-fashioned ideas.

zh: 你们若能在紧要关头保持冷静，局势便会好转。
pinyin: Nǐmen ruò néng zài jǐnyào guāntóu bǎochí lěngjìng, júshì biàn huì hǎozhuǎn.
en: If you can keep calm at the critical moment, the situation will improve.

zh: 他那尖锐且刺耳的嘲笑声在空旷的房间里回荡。
pinyin: Tā nà jiānruì qiě cì'ěr de cháoxiào shēng zài kōngkuàng de fángjiān lǐ huídàng.
en: His sharp and ear-piercing laughter echoed in the empty room.

zh: 由于环境恶劣，动物进化出了特殊的防卫机制。
pinyin: Yóuyú huánjìng èliè, dòngwù jìnhuà chū le tèshū de fángwèi jīzhì.
en: Due to the harsh environment, animals have evolved special defense mechanisms.

zh: 设计师通过抽象的图片来表达内心复杂的情感。
pinyin: Shèjìshī tōngguò chōuxiàng de túpiàn lái biǎodá nèixīn fùzá de qínggǎn.
en: The designer expresses complex inner emotions through abstract pictures.

zh: 在劳动仲裁中，雇主必须出示相关的法律依据。
pinyin: Zài láodòng zhòngcái zhōng, gùzhǔ bìxū chūshì xiāngguān de fǎlǜ yìjù.
en: In labor arbitration, the employer must produce relevant legal basis.

zh: 由于天气恶劣，队长不得不下令停止搜索任务。
pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì èliè, duìzhǎng bùdébù xiàlìng tíngzhǐ sōusuǒ rènwù.
en: Due to the severe weather, the captain had to give the order to stop the search mission.

zh: 为了提供更优质的服务，我们调整了业务流程。
pinyin: Wèile tígōng gèng yōuzhì de fúwù, wǒmen tiáozhěng le yèwù liúchéng.
en: In order to provide higher quality service, we have adjusted our business processes.

zh: 他不仅擅长绘画，还专门从事卡通人物设计工作。
pinyin: Tā bùjǐn shàncháng huìhuà, hái zhuānmén cóngshì kǎtōng rénwù shèjì gōngzuò.
en: He is not only good at drawing but also specializes in cartoon character design.

zh: 他庆幸自己及时发现了错误，避免了巨大的损失。
pinyin: tā qìng xìng zì jǐ jí shí fā xiàn le cuò wù, bì miǎn le jù dà de sǔn shī.
en: He felt fortunate that he discovered the error in time, avoiding a huge loss.

zh: 为了实现共同富裕，国家制定了一系列相关政策。
pinyin: Wèile shíxiàn gòngtóng fùyù, guójiā zhìdìngle yī xìliè xiāngguān zhèngcè.
en: In order to achieve common prosperity, the country has formulated a series of relevant policies.

zh: 我们必须具备远见，从根本上解决深层次的矛盾。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū jùbèi yuǎnjiàn, cóng gēnběn shàng jiějué shēncéngcì de máodùn.
en: We must possess foresight to solve deep-seated contradictions from the root.

zh: 哥哥性格稳重，总是能妥善处理各种棘手的问题。
pinyin: Gēge xìnggé wěnzhòng, zǒng shì néng tuǒshàn chǔlǐ gè zhǒng jíshǒu de wèntí.
en: My older brother has a steady personality and can always properly handle all kinds of tricky problems.

zh: 工程师正在设法消除设备运行中产生的背景噪声。
pinyin: Gōng chéng shī zhèng zài shè fǎ xiāo chú shè bèi yùn xíng zhōng chǎn shēng de bèi jǐng zào shēng.
en: The engineer is trying to eliminate the background noise generated during equipment operation.

zh: 考虑到目前严峻的情况，我们必须采取应急措施。
pinyin: Kǎolǜ dào mùqián yánjùn de qíngkuàng, wǒmen bìxū cǎiqǔ yìngjí cuòshī.
en: Considering the current grim situation, we must take emergency measures.

zh: 由于物流配送的局限性，新鲜牛奶很难长途运输。
pinyin: Yóuyú wùliú pèisòng de júxiànxìng, xīnxiān niúnǎi hěn nán chángtú yùnshū.
en: Due to the limitations of logistics and distribution, fresh milk is difficult to transport over long distances.

zh: 由于路面极其湿滑，汽车的方向盘稍微有些失灵。
