en: Due to the extremely slippery road surface, the car's steering wheel was slightly malfunctioning.

zh: 尽管困难重重，他依然深信自己的目标能够实现。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn kùnnán chóngchóng, tā yīrán shēnxìn zìjǐ de mùbiāo nénggòu shíxiàn.
en: Despite many difficulties, he still firmly believes that his goals can be achieved.

zh: 为了尽快康复，他决定听从医生的建议住院治疗。
pinyin: Wèile jǐnkuài kāngfù, tā juédìng tīngcóng yīshēng de jiànyì zhùyuàn zhìliáo.
en: To recover as soon as possible, he decided to follow the doctor's advice to stay in the hospital for treatment.

zh: 他试图通过摇晃瓶子来分辨里面装的是什么液体。
pinyin: Tā shìtú tōngguò yáohuàng píngzi lái fēnbiàn lǐmiàn zhuāng de shì shénme yètǐ.
en: He tried to determine what liquid was inside by shaking the bottle.

zh: 她向来不喜欢铺张浪费，所以生日过得十分简单。
pinyin: Tā xiànglái bù xǐhuān pūzhāng làngfèi, suǒyǐ shēngrì guò dé shífēn jiǎndān.
en: She has never liked extravagance and waste, so her birthday was spent very simply.

zh: 探险队员在荒岛上忍饥挨饿，表现出顽强的毅力。
pinyin: Tànxiǎn duìyuán zài huāngdǎo shàng rěnjī-ái'è, biǎoxiàn chū wánqiáng de yìlì.
en: The explorers were famished on the deserted island, showing tenacious perseverance.

zh: 那名运动员在终点前拼命冲刺，最终赢得了冠军。
pinyin: Nà míng yùndòngyuán zài zhōngdiǎn qián pīnmìng chōngcì, zuìzhōng yíngdéle guànjūn.
en: That athlete sprinted with all his might before the finish line and eventually won the championship.

zh: 我们要合理利用充沛的水资源，实现可持续发展。
pinyin: wǒmen yào hélǐ lìyòng chōngpèi de shuǐzīyuán, shíxiàn kěchíxù fāzhǎn.
en: We must rationally use our abundant water resources to achieve sustainable development.

zh: 虽然他经历了不少挫折，但好运最终还是降临了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā jīnglì le bùshǎo cuòzhé, dàn hǎoyùn zuìzhōng háishì jiànglín le.
en: Although he experienced many setbacks, good luck eventually arrived.

zh: 这些传统的歌舞艺术反映了当地独特的民族风情。
pinyin: Zhèxiē chuántǒng de gēwǔ yìshù fǎnyìngle dāngdì dútè de mínzú fēngqíng.
en: These traditional song and dance arts reflect the unique local ethnic customs.

zh: 只要不放弃希望，我们或许能够见证奇迹的发生。
pinyin: Zhǐyào bú fàngqì xīwàng, wǒmen huòxǔ nénggòu jiànzhèng qíjì de fāshēng.
en: As long as we do not give up hope, we might be able to witness the occurrence of a miracle.

zh: 专家们正在评估该核电站对周边生态环境的影响。
pinyin: Zhuānjiāmen zhèngzài pínggū gāi hédiànzhàn duì zhōubiān shēngtài huánjìng de yǐngxiǎng.
en: Experts are evaluating the impact of the nuclear power plant on the surrounding ecological environment.

zh: 这件衣服的设计融合了传统的元素与现代的审美。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de shèjì rónghé le chuántǒng de yuánsù yǔ xiàndài de shěnměi.
en: The design of this garment blends traditional elements with modern aesthetics.

zh: 通过分析现场的物证，他们最终破获了这起案件。
pinyin: Tōngguò fēnxī xiànchǎng de wùzhèng, tāmen zuìzhōng pòhuò le zhè qǐ ànjiàn.
en: By analyzing the material evidence at the scene, they finally solved this case.

zh: 尽管经历了战乱，他依然是那个文明幸存的后裔。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn jīnglìle zhànluàn, tā yīrán shì nàge wénmíng xìngcún de hòuyì.
en: Despite having experienced the war, he remains a surviving descendant of that civilization.

zh: 面对危险，他依然挺起胸膛，表现出极大的勇气。
pinyin: miànduì wēixiǎn, tā yīrán tǐng qǐ xiōngtáng, biǎoxiàn chū jídà de yǒngqì.
en: Faced with danger, he still puffed out his chest, showing great courage.

zh: 作为一名专业歌手，他非常注重保护自己的嗓子。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng zhuānyè gēshǒu, tā fēicháng zhùzhòng bǎohù zìjǐ de sǎngzi.
en: As a professional singer, he pays great attention to protecting his voice.

zh: 为了节省空间，我在书橱的上方安装了一些隔板。
pinyin: Wèile jiéshěng kōngjiān, wǒ zài shūchú de shàngfāng ānzhuāngle yīxiē gébǎn.
en: In order to save space, I installed some shelves above the bookcase.

zh: 由于污染严重，这个水域的生态系统受到了破坏。
pinyin: Yóuyú wūrǎn yánzhòng, zhège shuǐyù de shēngtài xìtǒng shòudào le pòhuài.
en: Due to severe pollution, the ecosystem of this body of water has been destroyed.

zh: 由于恶劣的天气，直升机无法执行紧急救援任务。
pinyin: Yóuyú èliè de tiānqì, zhíshēngjī wúfǎ zhíxíng jǐnjí jiùjiùyuán rènwù.
en: Due to the severe weather, the helicopter could not carry out the emergency rescue mission.

zh: 他在面对巨大的压力时，依然能保持平和的内心。
pinyin: Tā zài miànduì jùdà de yālì shí, yīrán néng bǎochí pínghé de nèixīn.
en: Even when facing immense pressure, he is still able to maintain a peaceful heart.

zh: 这条运河连接了南北两个城市，促进了文化交流。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo yùnhé liánjiē le nánběi liǎng gè chéngshì, cùjìn le wénhuà jiāoliú.
en: This canal connects the cities in the north and south, promoting cultural exchange.

zh: 我不小心路过那条巷子，无意间目睹了那场冲突。
pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎoxīn lùguò nà tiáo xiàngzi, wúyìjiān mùdǔle nà chǎng chōngtú.
en: I accidentally passed through that alley and inadvertently witnessed the conflict.

zh: 尽管导师百般劝阻，他最终还是毅然选择了退学。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn dǎoshī bǎibān quànzǔ, tā zuìzhōng háishì yìrán xuǎnzé le tuìxué.
en: Although his mentor tried every possible way to dissuade him, he ultimately chose to quit school resolutely.

zh: 透过他坚定的眼神，足以看出他迎接挑战的决心。
pinyin: Tòuguò tā jiāndìng de yǎnshén, zúyǐ kàn chū tā yíngjiē tiǎozhàn de juéxīn.
en: Through his determined eyes, one can sufficiently see his resolve to face the challenge.

zh: 即使面临困境，他依然能客观地分析自己的处境。
pinyin: Jíshǐ miànlín kùnjìng, tā yīrán néng kèguān de fēnxī zìjǐ de chǔjìng.
en: Even when facing adversity, he can still objectively analyze his own situation.

zh: 通过观察植物的根源，我们能了解它的生长状况。
pinyin: Tōngguò guānchá zhíwù de gēnyuán, wǒmen néng liǎojiě tā de shēngzhǎng zhuàngkuàng.
en: By observing the roots of the plant, we can understand its growth condition.

zh: 这台相机的性能非常出色，特别适合在野外照相。
pinyin: Zhè tái xiàngjī de xìngnéng fēicháng chūsè, tèbié shìhé zài yěwài zhàoxiàng.
en: This camera has excellent performance, making it especially suitable for taking photos in the wild.

zh: 这部文学作品深刻感人，评论家们对其赞不绝口。
pinyin: Zhè bù wénxué zuòpǐn shēnkè gǎnrén, pínglùnjiāmen duì qí zànbùjuékǒu.
en: This literary work is profound and moving; critics have praised it endlessly.

zh: 由于缺乏远见，这个企业最终陷入了可悲的境地。
pinyin: Yóuyú quēfá yuǎnjiàn, zhège qǐyè zuìzhōng xiànrù le kěbēi de jìngdì.
en: Due to a lack of foresight, the company eventually fell into a lamentable situation.

zh: 那种忧郁的气氛笼罩着整个房间，让人感到压抑。
pinyin: Nà zhǒng yōuyù de qìfēn lǒngzhàozhe zhěnggè fángjiān, ràng rén gǎndào yāyì.
en: That sullen atmosphere enveloped the whole room, making people feel depressed.

zh: 通过这次采访，他向大家展示了自己真实的一面。
pinyin: Tōngguò zhè cì cǎifǎng, tā xiàng dàjiā zhǎnshìle zìjǐ zhēnshí de yīmiàn.
en: Through this interview, he revealed his true side to everyone.

zh: 为了能在比赛中获得银牌，他每天坚持刻苦训练。
pinyin: Wèile néng zài bǐsài zhōng huòdé yínpái, tā měitiān jiānchí kèkǔ xùnliàn.
en: In order to win a silver medal in the competition, he insists on training hard every day.

zh: 在极其简陋的条件下，他依然坚持进行科学实验。
pinyin: Zài jíqí jiǎnlòu de tiáojiàn xià, tā yīrán jiānchí jìnxíng kēxué shíyàn.
en: Under extremely simple and crude conditions, he still persisted in conducting scientific experiments.

zh: 通过不懈的努力，他最终取得了优异的科研成果。
pinyin: Tōngguò bùxiè de nǔlì, tā zuìzhōng qǔdéle yōuyì de kēyán chéngguǒ.
en: Through unremitting efforts, he finally achieved exceptional scientific research results.

zh: 由于冷链技术的进步，海鲜的新鲜度得到了保障。
pinyin: Yóu yú lěng liàn jì shù de jìn bù, hǎi xiān de xīn xiān dù dé dào le bǎo zhàng.
en: Due to the progress of cold chain technology, the freshness of seafood is guaranteed.

zh: 即使住在农村，用蚊帐也能有效地避免感染疟疾。
pinyin: Jíshǐ zhù zài nóngcūn, yòng wénzhàng yě néng yǒuxiào de bìmiǎn gǎnrǎn nüèjí.
en: Even living in rural areas, using a mosquito net can effectively avoid malaria infection.

zh: 这项技术能够自动修复漏洞，我们不用手动干预。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù nénggòu zìdòng xiūfù lòudòng, wǒmen bù yòng shǒudòng gānyù.
en: This technology can automatically fix vulnerabilities; we don't need to intervene manually.

zh: 如果你想保护牙齿，就得养成按时刷牙的好习惯。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng bǎohù yáchǐ, jiù děi yǎngchéng ànshí shuāyá de hǎo xíguàn.
en: If you want to protect your teeth, you must develop the good habit of brushing them on time.

zh: 为了克服内心的恐惧，他学会了直视自己的弱点。
pinyin: Wèile kèfú nèixīn de kǒngjù, tā xuéhuìle zhíshì zìjǐ de ruòdiǎn.
en: In order to overcome his inner fear, he learned to look his own weaknesses straight in the face.

zh: 由于长期的战乱，这片山区成了土匪出没的地方。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī de zhànluàn, zhè piàn shānqū chéngle tǔfěi chūmò de dìfāng.
en: Due to long-term warfare, this mountainous area became a place where bandits haunted.

zh: 在进行化学实验之前，必须对试管进行均匀加热。
pinyin: Zài jìnxíng huàxué shíyàn zhīqián, bìxū duì shìguǎn jìnxíng jūnyún jiārè.
en: Before conducting the chemistry experiment, the test tube must be heated evenly.

zh: 在那场激烈的辩论中，会场的空气显得格外凝重。
pinyin: zài nà chǎng jī liè de biàn lùn zhōng, huì chǎng de kōng qì xiǎn dé gé wài níng zhòng.
en: During that heated debate, the atmosphere of the venue seemed exceptionally heavy.

zh: 透过那扇模糊的窗户，我隐约看得见山峰的轮廓。
pinyin: tòuguò nà shàn móhú de chuānghù, wǒ yǐnyuē kàn de jiàn shānfēng de lúnkuò.
en: Through that blurry window, I can vaguely see the outline of the mountain peaks.

zh: 通过精密的设备，我们捕捉到了极其微弱的音响。
pinyin: Tōngguò jīngmì de shèbèi, wǒmen bǔzhuō dào le jíqí wēiruò de yīnxiǎng.
en: Through precise equipment, we captured extremely faint sounds.

zh: 在艰苦的岁月里，大家互相接济，共同渡过难关。
pinyin: Zài jiānkǔ de suìyuè lǐ, dàjiā hùxiāng jiējì, gòngtóng dùguò nánguān.
en: During the hard times, everyone helped each other with material supplies to overcome the difficulties together.

zh: 经过漫长的等待，他终于见到了久仰的学术权威。
pinyin: Jīngguò màncháng de děngdài, tā zhōngyú jiàn dào le jiǔyǎng de xuéshù quánwēi.
en: After a long wait, he finally met the academic authority he had long admired.

zh: 在顶级美食的背后，往往隐藏着复杂的制作工艺。
pinyin: Zài dǐngjí měishí de bèihòu, wǎngwǎng yǐncángzhe fùzá de zhìzuò gōngyì.
en: Behind gourmet food, there often lies complex craftsmanship.

zh: 啦啦队的精彩表演极大地鼓舞了运动员们的士气。
pinyin: Lā lā duì de jīngcǎi biǎoyǎn jídà de gǔwǔ le yùndòngyuánmen de shìqì.
en: The wonderful performance of the cheerleading squad greatly boosted the morale of the athletes.

zh: 这部文学作品深刻地揭示了那个时代人们的心声。
pinyin: Zhè bù wénxué zuòpǐn shēnkè de jiēshì le nàge shídài rénmen de xīnshēng.
en: This literary work profoundly reveals the heartfelt wishes of the people of that era.

zh: 他小心翼翼地把气球系在栏杆上，以免被风吹走。
pinyin: Tā xiǎoxīnyìyì de bǎ qìqiú xì zài lángǎn shàng, yǐmiǎn bèi fēng chuī zǒu.
en: He carefully tied the balloon to the railing to prevent it from being blown away by the wind.

zh: 为了庆祝节日，奶奶亲手煮了一锅热腾腾的汤圆。
pinyin: wèi le qìng zhù jié rì, nǎi nai qīn shǒu zhǔ le yī guō rè téng téng de tāng yuán.
en: To celebrate the holiday, grandma cooked a pot of hot tangyuan by herself.

zh: 他凭借卓越的科研成果荣获了该领域的最高奖项。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè zhuóyuè de kēyán chéngguǒ rónghuòle gāi lǐngyù de zuìgāo jiǎngxiàng.
en: By virtue of his outstanding scientific research achievements, he won the highest award in the field.

zh: 为了拍摄这部纪录片，他们走访了许多偏远地区。
pinyin: wèile pāishè zhè bù jìlùpiàn, tāmen zǒufǎngle xǔduō piānyuǎn dìqū.
en: In order to film this documentary, they visited many remote areas.

zh: 这支球队在国际赛场上展现出了顽强的拼搏精神。
pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì zài guójì sàichǎng shàng zhǎnxiàn chūle wánqiáng de pīnbó jīngshén.
en: This team demonstrated a tenacious fighting spirit in the international arena.

zh: 这里的文化底蕴深厚，吸引了众多学者前来考察。
pinyin: Zhè lǐ de wénhuà dǐyùn shēnhòu, xīyǐnle zhòngduō xuézhě qiánlái kǎochá.
en: The cultural heritage here is profound, attracting many scholars to come and conduct research.

zh: 由于长期饥饿，他的骨头几乎脱离了肌肉的包裹。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī jī'è, tā de gǔtou jīhū tuōlí le jīròu de bāoguǒ.
en: Due to long-term starvation, his bones had almost separated from the surrounding flesh.

zh: 随着一阵刺耳的电铃声，大家迅速撤离了教学楼。
pinyin: Suízhe yīzhèn cì'ěr de diànlíng shēng, dàjiā xùnsù chèlí le jiàoxuélóu.
en: Following a harsh electric bell sound, everyone quickly evacuated the teaching building.

zh: 对于许多漂泊在外的人来说，家乡是心灵的港湾。
pinyin: duì yú xǔ duō piāo bó zài wài de rén lái shuō, jiā xiāng shì xīn líng de gǎng wān.
en: For many people drifting abroad, their hometown is a harbor for the soul.

zh: 无论遇到什么挑战，队长都会带领我们积极应对。
pinyin: Wúlùn yùdào shénme tiǎozhàn, duìzhǎng dūhuì dàilǐng wǒmen jījí yìngduì.
en: No matter what challenges arise, the team leader leads us to respond positively.

zh: 无论如何，这项改革都将对社会产生深远的影响。
pinyin: wú lùn rú hé, zhè xiàng gǎi gé dōu jiāng duì shè huì chǎn shēng shēn yuǎn de yǐng xiǎng.
en: In any case, this reform will have a profound impact on society.

zh: 她那乌黑亮丽的头发在阳光下显得格外引人注目。
pinyin: Tā nà wū hēi liàng lì de tóu fa zài yáng guāng xià xiǎn dé gé wài yǐn rén zhù mù.
en: Her jet-black, shiny hair looks exceptionally eye-catching under the sunlight.

zh: 为了降低职业病的发病率，公司改善了工作环境。
pinyin: Wèile jiàngdī zhíyèbìng de fābìnglǜ, gōngsī gǎishàn le gōngzuò huánjìng.
en: In order to reduce the incidence of occupational diseases, the company improved the working environment.

zh: 他那宽阔的肩膀仿佛能承受住所有的压力与挫折。
pinyin: Tā nà kuānkuò de jiānbǎng fǎngfú néng chéngshòu zhù suǒyǒu de yālì yǔ cuòzhé.
en: His broad shoulders seemed capable of withstanding all the pressure and setbacks.

zh: 他一直在耐心观察，试图捕捉到市场的最佳时机。
pinyin: Tā yìzhí zài nàixīn guānchá, shìtú bǔzhuō dào shìchǎng de zuìjiā shíjī.
en: He has been observing patiently, trying to capture the best market opportunity.

zh: 代表团成员就共同关心的议题进行了深入的磋商。
pinyin: Dàibiǎotuán chéngyuán jiù gòngtóng guānxīn de yìtí jìnxíng le shēnrù de cuōshāng.
en: The delegation members held in-depth consultations on issues of common concern.

zh: 家长若是盲目纵容，往往会造成孩子的性格缺陷。
pinyin: Jiāzhǎng ruòshì mángmù zòngróng, wǎngwǎng huì zàochéochéng háizi de xìnggé quēxiàn.
en: If parents blindly indulge their children, it often leads to character flaws.

zh: 他在异国他乡奋斗，心中始终挂念着祖国的亲人。
pinyin: Tā zài yìguótāxiāng fèndòu, xīnzhōng shǐzhōng guàniànzhe zǔguó de qīnrén.
en: He struggles in a foreign land, while always feeling anxious about his relatives back in the motherland.

zh: 由于经营不善，那家著名的夜总会最终被迫停业。
pinyin: Yóuyú jīngyíng bùshàn, nà jiā zhùmíng de yèzǒnghuì zuìzhōng bèipò tíngyè.
en: Due to poor management, that famous nightclub was eventually forced to shut down.

zh: 这种合作机制进一步加深了两国之间的经济联系。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng hézuò jīzhì jìnyì jìnyībù jiāshēn le liǎng guó zhījiān de jīngjì liánxì.
en: This cooperation mechanism further deepened the economic ties between the two countries.

zh: 夕阳西下，站台上上演着一幕幕凄凉的送别场面。
pinyin: Xīyáng xīxià, zhàntái shàng shàngyǎnzhe yímù-mù qīliáng de sòngbié chǎngmiàn.
en: As the sun set, scene after scene of desolate farewells were played out on the platform.

zh: 作为一名顶尖选手，他展现出了极高的竞技水平。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng dǐngjiān xuǎnshǒu, tā zhǎnxiàn chūle jí gāo de jìngjì shuǐpíng.
en: As a top athlete, he demonstrated a very high level of competitiveness.

zh: 为了制作这种特殊的面包，必须选用优质的面粉。
pinyin: wèi le zhì zuò zhè zhǒng tè shū de miàn bāo, bì xū xuǎn yòng yōu zhì de miàn fěn.
en: In order to make this kind of special bread, one must select high-quality flour.

zh: 尽管外头环境恶劣，他们依然坚持完成了勘探工作。
pinyin: Jǐn guǎn wài tou huán jìng è liè, tā men yī rán jiān chí wán chéng le kān tàn gōng zuò.
en: Although the environment outside was harsh, they persisted and completed the exploration work.

zh: 为了在这竞争激烈的行业生存，他不得不讨好客户。
pinyin: Wèile zài zhè jìngzhēng jīliè de hángyè shēngcún, tā bùdébù tǎohǎo kèhù.
en: To survive in this highly competitive industry, he has to curry favor with clients.

zh: 在漫长的等待后，我们终于迎来了期盼已久的胜利。
pinyin: Zài màncháng de děngdài hòu, wǒmen zhōngyú yíngláile qīpàn yǐ jiǔ de shènglì.
en: After a long wait, we finally ushered in the long-awaited victory.

zh: 我们需要采取有效的措施来控制不断攀升的失业率。
pinyin: wǒ men xū yào cǎi qǔ yǒu xiào de cuò shī lái kòng zhì bú duàn pān shēng de shī yè lǜ.
en: We need to take effective measures to control the continuously rising unemployment rate.

zh: 这两部电影在同年上映，并引起了广泛的社会关注。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng bù diànyǐng zài tóngnián shàngyìng, bìng yǐnqǐ le guǎngfàn de shèhuì guānzhù.
en: These two films were released in the same year and attracted widespread social attention.

zh: 我们的仓库目前剩余的库存空间大概有五十立方米。
pinyin: wǒ men de cāng kù mù qián shèng yú de kù cún kōng jiān dà gài yǒu wǔ shí lì fāng mǐ.
en: Our warehouse currently has approximately fifty cubic meters of remaining storage space.

zh: 面对记者的反复追问，他终于表现出明显的不耐烦。
pinyin: miàn duì jì zhě de fǎn fù zhuī wèn tā zhōng yú biǎo xiàn chū míng xiǎn de bù nài fán
en: Faced with the reporter's repeated questions, he finally showed obvious impatience.

zh: 要是他能意识到问题的严重性，或许还能挽回局面。
pinyin: Yào shi tā néng yìshí dào wèntí de yánzhòngxìng, huòxǔ hái néng wǎnhuí júmiàn.
en: If he could realize the seriousness of the problem, perhaps he could still save the situation.

zh: 通过深入的访谈，我们挖掘出了许多被掩盖的真相。
pinyin: Tōngguò shēnrù de fǎngtán, wǒmen wājué chū le xǔduō bèi yǎngài de zhēn zhēnxiàng.
en: Through in-depth interviews, we unearthed many covered-up truths.

zh: 根据他目前的所作所为，这种评价是客观且公正的。
pinyin: Gēnjù tā mùqián de suǒ zuò suǒ wéi, zhè zhǒng píngjià shì kèguān qiě gōngzhèng de.
en: Based on his current conduct and deeds, this assessment is objective and fair.

zh: 除了客观条件，主观努力在很大程度上决定了结果。
pinyin: Chú le kèguān tiáojiàn, zhǔguān nǔlì zài hěn dà chéngdù shàng juédìng le jiéguǒ.
en: Apart from objective conditions, subjective effort determines the result to a large extent.

zh: 为了减轻经济负担，不少大学生利用课余时间打工。
pinyin: Wèile jiǎnqīng jīngjì fùdān, bùshǎo dàxuéshēng lìyòng kèyú shíjiān dǎgōng.
en: In order to reduce their financial burden, many university students take part-time jobs during their spare time.

zh: 为了考察高原的生态系统，专家们克服了重重困难。
pinyin: Wèile kǎochá gāoyuán de shēngtài xìtǒng, zhuānjiāmen kèfúle chóngchóng kùnnán.
en: In order to investigate the plateau's ecosystem, the experts overcame many difficulties.

zh: 那个偏远小镇的古老传统极其神秘，简直不可思议。
pinyin: Nàge piānyuǎn xiǎozhèn de gǔlǎo chuántǒng jíqí shénmì, jiǎnzhí bù kě sī yì.
en: The ancient traditions of that remote small town are extremely mysterious, simply inconceivable.

zh: 今年遭遇了前所未有的干旱，庄稼收成远不如往年。
pinyin: jīn nián zāo yù le qián suǒ wèi yǒu de gān hàn, zhuāng jia shōu chéng yuǎn bù rú wǎng nián.
en: This year we experienced an unprecedented drought, and the crop harvest is far worse than in former years.

zh: 这条街道上车辆川流不息，影响了周围居民的生活。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào shàng chēliàng chuānliúbùxī, yǐngxiǎng le zhōuwéi jūmín de shēnghuó.
en: Vehicles stream endlessly on this street, affecting the lives of the local residents.

zh: 由于他在专注地构思论文，任何人不得随意打搅他。
pinyin: Yóu yú tā zài zhuān zhù de gòu sī lùn wén, rèn hé rén bù dé suí yì dǎ jiǎo tā.
en: Because he is focusing on drafting his thesis, no one is allowed to disturb him at will.

zh: 为了节省开支，他选择了一家设施简陋的旅馆暂住。
pinyin: Wèile jiéshěng kāizhī, tā xuǎnzé le yī jiā shèshī jiǎnlòu de lǚguǎn zànzhù.
en: In order to save expenses, he chose to stay temporarily at a hotel with simple facilities.

zh: 一般来说，即使环境恶劣，这种植物也能顽强生存。
pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, jíshǐ huánjìng èliè, zhè zhǒng zhíwù yě néng wánqiáng shēngcún.
en: Generally speaking, even if the environment is harsh, this kind of plant can survive tenaciously.

zh: 在制冷设备普及之前，冰块是存放在木制冰箱里的。
pinyin: Zài zhìlěng shèbèi pǔjí zhīqián, bīngkuài shì cúnfàng zài mùzhì bīngxiāng lǐ de.
en: Before the popularization of refrigeration equipment, ice was stored in wooden iceboxes.

zh: 他在法庭上提供了虚假的陈述，企图掩盖事实真相。
pinyin: Tā zài fǎtíng shàng tígōngle xūjiǎ de chénshù chénshù, qǐtú yǎngài shìshí zhēnxiàng.
en: He provided false statements in court, attempting to cover up the truth.

zh: 他站在舞台中央，用深情的歌唱打动了每一位观众。
pinyin: Tā zhàn zài wǔtái zhōngyāng, yòng shēnqíng de gēchàng dǎdòngle měi yī wèi guānzhòng.
en: Standing in the center of the stage, he moved every member of the audience with his soulful singing.

zh: 古代 君主 经常 举行 隆重 的 祭祀 仪式。
pinyin: gǔ dài jūn zhǔ jīng cháng jǔ xíng lóng zhòng de jì sì yí shì.
en: Ancient monarchs often held grand sacrificial ceremonies.

zh: 由于人手不足，他不得不兼任两个部门的领导职务。
pinyin: Yóuyú rénshǒu bùzú, tā bùdébù jiānrèn liǎng gè bùmén de lǐngdǎo zhíwù.
en: Due to a shortage of manpower, he has to hold concurrent leadership positions in two departments.

zh: 面对这场突如其来的经济危机，很少有企业能幸免。
pinyin: Miànduì zhè chǎng tūrúqílái de jīngjì wēijī, hěn shǎo yǒu qǐyè néng xìngmiǎn.
en: Facing this sudden economic crisis, very few enterprises could avoid being affected.

zh: 为了等待救援，他们整整在这片荒原上坚持了十天。
pinyin: Wèile děngdài jiùyuán, tāmen zhěngzhěng zài zhè piàn piàn zhè piàn huāngyuán shàng jiānchíle shí tiān.
en: In order to wait for rescue, they persisted for a whole ten days in this wilderness.

zh: 在申请过程中，你必须提供真实的姓名及身份证明。
pinyin: Zài shēnqǐng guòchéng zhōng, nǐ bìxū tígōng zhēnshí de xìngmíng jí shēnfèn zhèngmíng.
en: During the application process, you must provide your real full name and proof of identity.

zh: 在粮食危机期间，任何剩余的物资都显得至关重要。
pinyin: Zài liángshí wēijī qījiān, rènhé shèngyú de wùzī dōu xiǎnde zhì dé zhìguān zhòngyào.
en: During the food crisis, any surplus supplies appeared vital.

zh: 他博览群书，对各种领域的知识都抱有浓厚的兴趣。
pinyin: Tā bólǎnqúnshū, duì gè zhǒng lǐngyù de zhīshi dōu bàoyǒu nónghòu de xìngqù.
en: He is widely read and takes a keen interest in knowledge from various fields.

zh: 无论是谁，在法律面前都必须遵守同样的契约精神。
pinyin: Wúlùn shì shéi, zài fǎlǜ miànqián dōu bìxū zūnshǒu tóngyàng de qìyuē jīngshén.
en: No matter who it is, everyone must comply with the same spirit of contract before the law.

zh: 尽管情况紧急，他还是果断地剪断了炸药的导火索。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn qíngkuàng jǐnjí, tā háishì guǒduàn de jiǎnduànle zhày zhàyào de dǎohuǒsuǒ.
en: Although the situation was critical, he decisively cut the fuse of the explosive.

zh: 在那段艰难的岁月里，他始终叮嘱亲友要珍重保重。
pinyin: Zài nà duàn jiānnán de suìyuè lǐ, tā shǐzhōng dīngzhǔ qīnyǒu yào zhēnzhòng bǎozhòng.
en: During those difficult years, he constantly urged his family and friends to cherish themselves and take care.

zh: 他在战场上的英勇表现使他获得了一枚珍贵的勋章。
pinyin: tā zài zhàn chǎng shàng de yīng yǒng biǎo xiàn shǐ tā huò dé le yī méi zhēn guì de xūn zhāng.
en: His heroic performance on the battlefield earned him a precious medal.

zh: 在漫长的人生旅途中，我们会遇到各种各样的挑战。
pinyin: zài màncháng de rénshēng lǚtú zhōng, wǒmen huì yùdào gèzhǒng gèyàng de tiǎozhàn.
en: In the long journey of life, we will encounter all kinds of challenges.

zh: 这位卓越的企业家一直在致力于培养年轻的接班人。
pinyin: zhè wèi zhuó yuè de qǐ yè jiā yī zhí yī zhí zài zhì lì yú péi yǎng nián qīng de jiē bān rén.
en: This outstanding entrepreneur has been committed to cultivating young successors.

zh: 在繁华的都市中，人们往往承受着巨大的心理压力。
pinyin: Zài fánhuá de dūshì zhōng, rénmen wǎngwǎng chéngshòuzhe jùdà de xīnlǐ yālì.
en: In a bustling city, people often bear tremendous psychological pressure.

zh: 随着电梯的上升，城市景观逐渐从他的视线中淡出。
pinyin: Suízhe diàntī de shàng de shàng de shàngshēng, chéngshì jǐngguān zhújiàn cóng tā de shìxiàn zhōng dànchū.
en: As the elevator ascended, the cityscape gradually faded from his line of sight.

zh: 考古学家在一座古墓中挖掘出一具保存完好的尸体。
pinyin: Kǎogǔ xuéjiā zài yī zuò gǔmù zhōng wājué chū yī jù bǎocún wánhǎo de shītǐ.
en: Archaeologists excavated a well-preserved corpse from an ancient tomb.

zh: 在经历了漫长的昏迷之后，他终于奇迹般地醒来了。
pinyin: Zài jīnglì le màncháng de hūnmí zhīhòu, tā zhōngyú qíjìbān de xǐng lái le.
en: After experiencing a long coma, he finally woke up miraculously.

zh: 许多传统节日都有独特的习俗，比如春节要吃饺子。
pinyin: Xǔduō chuántǒng jiérì dōu yǒu dútè de xísú, bǐrú chūnjié yào chī jiǎozi.
en: Many traditional festivals have unique customs, for example, eating dumplings during the Spring Festival.

zh: 面对如此悲惨的境遇，他依然展现出了惊人的毅力。
pinyin: Miànduì rúcǐ bēicǎn de jìngyù, tā yīrán zhǎnxiàn chū le jīngrén de yìlì.
en: Faced with such miserable circumstances, he still showed astonishing perseverance.

zh: 经济的发展与社会的稳定息息相关，两者密不可分。
pinyin: Jīngjì de fāzhǎn yǔ shèhuì de wěndìng xīxīxiāngguān, liǎngzhě mì bù kě fēn.
en: Economic development is closely bound up with social stability; the two are inseparable.

zh: 在这座古老的寺庙里，僧侣们静静地看着太阳下山。
pinyin: Zài zhè zuò gǔlǎo de sìmiào lǐ, sēnglǚmen jìngjìng de kànzhe tàiyáng xiàshān.
en: In this ancient temple, the monks watched the sun set quietly.

zh: 虽然他没去过俄罗斯，但是他的俄语说得非常流利。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méi qùguò Éluósī, dànshì tā de éyǔ shuō de fēicháng liúlì.
en: Although he has not been to Russia, his Russian is very fluent.

zh: 他凭着卓越的科研成果，拿到了这一届的科学奖项。
pinyin: Tā píngzhe zhuóyuè de kēyán chéngguǒ, nádào le zhè yī jiè de kēxué jiǎngxiàng.
en: Relying on his outstanding scientific research achievements, he obtained this year's science award.

zh: 为了缓解交通压力，政府限制了私家车的出行时间。
pinyin: Wèile huǎnjiě jiāotōng yālì, zhèngfǔ xiànzhìle sījiāchē de chūxíng shíjiān.
en: To ease traffic congestion, the government has restricted the driving times for private cars.

zh: 由于缺乏经验，他的第一次外交尝试显得十分拙劣。
pinyin: yóu yú quē fá jīng yàn, tā de dì yī cì wài jiāo cháng shì xiǎn de shí fēn zhuō liè.
en: Due to a lack of experience, his first diplomatic attempt appeared quite clumsy.

zh: 由于恶劣的天气条件，调度中心决定取消下班航次。
pinyin: Yóuyú èliè de tiānqì tiáojiàn, diàodù zhōngxīn juédìng qǔxiāo xià bānhángcì.
en: Due to adverse weather conditions, the dispatch center decided to cancel the next voyage/service.

zh: 他深入偏远山区，亲自体验了那里艰苦的生活环境。
pinyin: Tā shēnrù piānyuǎn shānqū, qīnzì tǐyàn le nàlǐ jiānkǔ de shēnghuó huánjìng.
en: He went deep into the remote mountainous area to personally experience the harsh living environment there.

zh: 由于他在关键时刻的失误，遭到了大家的严厉责怪。
pinyin: yóu yú tā zài guān jiàn shí kè de shī wù, zāo dào le dà jiā de yán lì zé guài.
en: Because of his mistake at the critical moment, he was severely rebuked by everyone.

zh: 这场不可思议的奇迹让所有在场的嘉宾都目瞪口呆。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng bùkěsīyì de qíjì ràng suǒyǒu zài chǎng de jiābīn dōu mù dèng kǒu dāi.
en: This incredible miracle left all the guests present dumbstruck.

zh: 由于地理位置偏僻，这家加油站的营业时间比较固定。
pinyin: Yóuyú dìlǐ wèizhì piānpì, zhè jiā jiāyóuzhàn de yíngyè shíjiān bǐjiào gùdìng.
en: Due to the remote location, the operating hours of this gas station are relatively fixed.

zh: 他对于权力有着极端的渴望，这最终导致了他的毁灭。
pinyin: tā duì yú quán lì yǒu zhe jí duān de kě wàng, zhè zuì zhōng dǎo zhì le tā de huǐ miè.
en: He had an extreme desire for power, which eventually led to his destruction.

zh: 月亮周围浮现出一层朦胧的光环，预示着天气的变化。
pinyin: Yuèliàng zhōuwéi fúxiàn chū yī céng ménglóng de guānghuán, yùshìzhe tiānqì de biànhuà.
en: A hazy ring of light appeared around the moon, foreshadowing a change in the weather.

zh: 无论是在古代还是现代，人们对长寿的追求从未停止。
pinyin: Wúlùn shì zài gǔdài háishì xiàndài, rénmen duì chángshòu de zhuīqiú cóngwèi tíngzhǐ.
en: Whether in ancient or modern times, people's pursuit of longevity has never ceased.

zh: 作为一名演员，他不仅要会演戏，还要学会管理情绪。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yì míng yǎnyuán, tā bùjǐn yào huì yǎnxì, hái yào xuéhuì guǎnlǐ qíngxù.
en: As an actor, he must not only know how to act, but also learn to manage his emotions.

zh: 记者在新闻发布会上就这一敏感问题进行了深入询问。
pinyin: Jìzhě zài xīnwén fābùhuì shàng jiù zhè yī mǐngǎn wèntí jìnxíng le shēnrù xúnwèn.
en: The reporter conducted an in-depth inquiry regarding this sensitive issue at the press conference.

zh: 对于这个争议性话题，不同的人有着完全不同的表述。
pinyin: Duìyú zhège zhēngyìxìng huàtí, bùtóng de rén yǒuzhe wánquán bùtóng de biǎoshù.
en: Regarding this controversial topic, different people have completely different expressions.

zh: 在这个竞争激烈的时代，每个人都渴望获得一技之长。
pinyin: Zài zhège jìngzhēng jīliè de shídài, měi gèrén dōu kěwàng huòdé yī jì zhī cháng.
en: In this era of fierce competition, everyone aspires to acquire proficiency in a particular field.

zh: 为了参加这次跳远比赛，他每天都在操场上刻苦训练。
pinyin: Wèile cānjiā zhè cì tiào yuǎn bǐsài, tā měitiān dōu zài cāochǎng shàng kèkǔ xùnliàn.
en: In order to participate in this long jump competition, he trains hard on the playground every day.

zh: 他在经历了多年的奔波后，终于渴望一种安稳的归宿。
pinyin: Tā zài jīnglì le duōnián de bēnbō hòu, zhōngyú kěwàng yī zhǒng ānwěn de guīsù.
en: After years of rushing about, he finally longed for a steady place to settle down.

zh: 面对突如其来的危机，他不得不独自承担所有的责任。
pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de wēijī, tā bùdébù dúzì chéngdān suǒyǒu de zérèn.
en: Faced with a sudden crisis, he had no choice but to bear all the responsibility alone.

zh: 面对复杂的问题，他显得有些茫然，只是静静地发愣。
pinyin: Miànduì fùzá de wèntí, tā xiǎnde yǒuxiē mángrán, zhǐshì jìngjìng de fālèng.
en: Facing the complex problem, he appeared somewhat bewildered, just quietly staring blankly.

zh: 为了筹办这次峰会，委员会投入了大量的人力和财力。
pinyin: Wèile chóubàn zhè cì fēnghuì, wěiyuánhuì tóurùle dàliàng de rénlì hé cáilì.
en: In order to arrange this summit, the committee invested a great deal of human and financial resources.

zh: 在这个竞争激烈的行业，唯有创新才能让你与众不同。
pinyin: Zài zhège jìngzhēng jīliè de hángyè, wéiyǒu chuàngxīn cáinéng ràng nǐ yǔ zhòng bù tóng.
en: In this highly competitive industry, only innovation can make you stand out from the crowd.

zh: 无论遇到什么挫折，我都庆幸有老公始终如一的支持。
pinyin: Wúlùn yùdào shénme cuòzhé, wǒ dōu qìngxìng yǒu lǎogōng shǐzhōng rúyī de zhīchí.
en: No matter what setbacks I encounter, I feel fortunate to have my husband's consistent support.

zh: 由于地理位置优越，这栋办公楼很快就被出租出去了。
pinyin: Yóuyú dìlǐ wèizhì yōuyuè, zhè dòng bàngōnglóu hěn kuài jiù bèi chūzū chūqù le.
en: Due to its prime location, this office building was rented out very quickly.

zh: 通过科学的分析，专家们纠正了大众长期以来的误区。
pinyin: Tōngguò kēxué de fēnxī, zhuānjiāmen jiūzhèngle dàzhòng chángqī yǐlái de wùqū.
en: Through scientific analysis, experts corrected the long-standing mistaken ideas of the public.

zh: 在浩瀚的宇宙中，人类试图找到外星文明存在的迹象。
pinyin: Zài hàohàn de yǔzhòu zhōng, rénlèi shìtú zhǎodào wàixīng wénmíng cúnzài de jìxiàng.
en: In the vast universe, humanity attempts to find signs of the existence of extraterrestrial civilization.

zh: 他总是表现得那么客气，反而让我们觉得有些见外了。
pinyin: Tā zǒng shì biǎoxiàn dé nàme kèqì, fǎn'ér ràng wǒmen juédé yǒuxiē jiàn wài le.
en: He is always so polite that it actually makes us feel a bit distant.

zh: 通过研究这些考古遗物，我们能了解当时的社会状况。
pinyin: Tōngguò yánjiū zhèxiē kǎogǔ yíwù, wǒmen néng liǎojiě dāngshí de shèhuì zhuàngkuàng.
en: By studying these archaeological remnants, we can understand the social conditions of that time.

zh: 面对如此诱人的条件，他毅然放弃了这次宝贵的机会。
pinyin: Miànduì rúcǐ yòurén de tiáojiàn, tā yìrán fàngqìle zhè cì bǎoguì de jīhuì.
en: Faced with such attractive terms, he resolutely gave up this precious opportunity.

zh: 这个学术课题的界定显得有些宽泛，需要进一步明确。
pinyin: Zhège xuéshù kètí de jièdìng xiǎnde yǒuxiē kuānfàn, xūyào jìnyībù míngquè.
en: The definition of this academic project seems a bit wide-ranging and needs further clarification.

zh: 假使他能诚恳地承认错误的话，我们或许可以原谅他。
pinyin: Jiǎshǐ tā néng chéngkěn de chéngrèn cuòwù dehuà, wǒmen huòxǔ kěyǐ yuánliàng tā.
en: If he can sincerely admit his mistake, perhaps we can forgive him.

zh: 经过几代人的改进，这个秘方终于达到了完美的境界。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ dài rén de gǎijìn, zhège mì fāng zhōngyú dádào le wánměi de jìngjiè.
en: After generations of improvements, this secret recipe has finally reached a state of perfection.

zh: 我们需要挑选一个合适的人选来承担这项艰巨的任务。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào tiāoxuǎn yī gè héshì de rénxuǎn lái chéngdān zhè xiàng jiānjù de rènwù.
en: We need to select a suitable candidate to take on this arduous task.

zh: 在那个动荡的年代，他目睹了不少人无辜挨打的惨状。
pinyin: Zài nàge dòngdàng de niándài, tā mùdǔle bùshǎo rén wúgū ái dǎ de cǎnzhuàng.
en: In that turbulent era, he witnessed the tragic state of many innocent people taking beatings.

zh: 他在极度焦虑的情况下，不得不依赖安眠药才能入睡。
pinyin: Tā zài jídù jiāolǜ de qíngkuàng xià, bùdébù yīlài ānmiányào cáinéng rùshuì.
en: Under extreme anxiety, he had to rely on sleeping pills to fall asleep.

zh: 若非吸取了这次的教训，下次我们恐怕还会重蹈覆辙。
pinyin: Ruòfēi xīqǔle zhè cì de jiàoxùn, xià cì wǒmen kǒngpà hái huì chóngdǎofùzhé.
en: If we don't learn from this lesson, I'm afraid we will repeat the same mistake next time.

zh: 这次长途跋涉，我们共同的目标就是实现这一路平安。
pinyin: Zhè cì chángtú báshè, wǒmen gòngtóng de mùbiāo jiùshì shíxiàn zhè yī lù píng ān.
en: For this long trek, our common goal is to ensure the journey is safe.

zh: 既然你对此一窍不通，那我就为你科普一下其中的逻辑。
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ duì cǐ yīqiàobùtōng, nà wǒ jiù wèi nǐ kē pǔ yīxià qízhōng de luójí.
en: Since you know nothing about this, let me explain the logic behind it in simple terms for you.

zh: 在那个偏僻的村庄，能够熟练掌握外语的村民寥寥无几。
pinyin: Zài nàge piānpì de cūnzhuāng, nénggòu shúliàn zhǎngwò wàiyǔ de cūnmín liáoliáowújǐ.
en: In that remote village, there are very few villagers who can master a foreign language proficiently.

zh: 为了实现这个宏伟的理想，他竭尽全力克服了各种障碍。
pinyin: Wèi le shí xiàn zhè gè hóng wěi de lǐ xiǎng, tā jié jìn quán lì kè fú le gè zhǒng zhàng ài.
en: To realize this grand ideal, he spared no effort in overcoming various obstacles.

zh: 为了捕捉完美的瞬间，摄影师在寒风中等待了几个小时。
pinyin: Wèile bǔzhuō wánměi de shùnjiān, shèyǐngshī zài hánfēng zhōng děngdài le jǐ gè xiǎoshí.
en: In order to capture the perfect moment, the photographer waited in the cold wind for several hours.

zh: 面对敌人的重重圈套，我们要保持冷静，避免上当受骗。
pinyin: Miànduì dírén de chóngchóng quāntào, wǒmen yào bǎochí lěngjìng, bìmiǎn shàngdàng shòupiàn.
en: Facing the enemy's layers of traps, we must remain calm and avoid being deceived.

zh: 面对这种棘手的局面，我们实在想不出更好的应对办法。
pinyin: Miànduì zhè zhǒng jíshǒu de júmiàn, wǒmen shízài xiǎng bù chū gèng hǎo de yìngduì bànfǎ.
en: Facing such a thorny situation, we really cannot think of a better way to deal with it.

zh: 他展现出了巨大的运动潜力，有望在未来的比赛中夺冠。
pinyin: Tā zhǎnxiàn chūle jùdà de yùndòng qiánlì, yǒuwàng zài wèilái de bǐsài zhōng duóguàn.
en: He demonstrated tremendous athletic potential and is expected to win the championship in future competitions.

zh: 经过多年的努力，他终于在这一领域取得了响亮的成就。
pinyin: Jīngguò duōnián de nǔlì, tā zhōngyú zài zhè yī lǐngyù qǔdé le xiǎngliàng de chéngjiù.
en: After many years of hard work, he finally achieved outstanding results in this field.

zh: 每当看到这张照片，我总会想起小时候无忧无虑的时光。
pinyin: Měidāng kàndào zhè zhāng zhàopiàn, wǒ zǒng huì xiǎngqǐ xiǎo shí hou wúyōuwúlǜ de shíguāng.
en: Whenever I see this photo, I always recall the carefree times of my childhood.

zh: 就算面对再严峻的挑战，他依然保持着从容不迫的态度。
pinyin: jiù suàn miàn duì zài yán jùn de tiǎo zhàn, tā yī rán bǎo chí zhe cóng róng bù pò de tài dù.
en: Even if faced with the most severe challenges, he still maintains a calm and unhurried attitude.

zh: 在这个快节奏的社会里，一份体贴的关怀显得尤为珍贵。
pinyin: Zài zhège kuài jiézòu de shèhuì lǐ, yī fèn tǐtiē de guānhuái xiǎnde yóuwéi zhēnguì.
en: In this fast-paced society, a piece of considerate care seems especially precious.

zh: 为了培养孩子的独立能力，父母鼓励他参加这次夏令营。
pinyin: Wèile péiyǎng háizi de dúlì nénglì, fùmǔ gǔlì tā cānjiā zhè cì xiàlìngyíng.
en: In order to cultivate the child's independence, his parents encouraged him to participate in this summer camp.

zh: 想到家乡的美食，他情不自禁地产生了一种怀念的感觉。
pinyin: Xiǎngdào jiāxiāng de měishí, tā qíng bù zì jīn de chǎnshēngle yī zhǒng huáiniàn de gǎnjué.
en: Thinking of the delicious food from his hometown, he could not help but feel a sense of nostalgia.

zh: 奥运会闭幕式在体育场隆重举行，吸引了全世界的目光。
pinyin: Àoyùnhuì bìmùshì zài tǐyùchǎng lóngzhòng jǔxíng, xīyǐn le quán shìjiè de mùguāng.
en: The Olympic closing ceremony was held grandly in the stadium, attracting the world's attention.

zh: 站在山顶，他凝视着缓缓升起的旭日，心中充满了希望。
pinyin: zhàn zài shān dǐng, tā níng shì zhe huǎn huǎn shēng qǐ de xù rì, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le xī wàng.
en: Standing at the top of the mountain, he gazed at the slowly rising sun, his heart filled with hope.

zh: 他的成功不仅依靠努力，还取决于他具备了特大的勇气。
pinyin: Tā de chénggōng bùjǐn yīkào nǔlì, hái qǔjué yú tā jùbèi le tè dà de yǒngqì.
en: His success relies not only on hard work but also on the fact that he possesses exceptionally big courage.

zh: 无数平凡的英雄在岗位上默默奉献，铸就了国家的繁荣。
pinyin: Wúshù píngfán de yīngxióng zài gǎngwèi shàng mòmò fèngxiàn, zhùjiùle guójiā de fánróng.
en: Countless ordinary heroes contribute silently at their posts, forging the nation's prosperity.

zh: 他不由自主地陷入了沉思，仿佛周围的一切都与他无关。
pinyin: Tā bùyóuzìzhǔ de xiànrù le chénsī, fǎngfú zhōuwéi de yīqiè dōu yǔ tā wúguān.
en: He couldn't help but sink into deep thought, as if everything around him had nothing to do with him.

zh: 他在大学主修阿拉伯语，并对中东文化产生了浓厚的兴趣。
pinyin: Tā zài dàxué zhǔxiū Ālābóyǔ, bìng duì Zhōngdōng wénhuà chǎnshēngle nónghòu de xìngqù.
en: He majored in Arabic at university and developed a strong interest in Middle Eastern culture.

zh: 尽管经历了那场严重的车祸，他还是勇敢地重新驾驶汽车。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn jīnglì le nà chǎng yánzhòng de chēhuò, tā háishì yǒnggǎn de chóngxīn jiàshǐ qìchē.
en: Despite experiencing that serious traffic accident, he bravely started driving again.

zh: 为了筹备这次盛大的开幕式，工作人员付出了巨大的努力。
pinyin: Wèile chóubèi zhè cì shèngdà de kāimùshì, gōngzuò rényuán fùchū le jùdà de nǔlì.
en: In order to prepare for this grand opening ceremony, the staff put in tremendous effort.

zh: 在严峻的挑战面前，我们要始终保持众志成城的团结精神。
pinyin: Zài yánjùn de tiǎozhàn miànqián, wǒmen yào shǐzhōng bǎochí zhòngzhìchéngchéng de tuánjié jīngshén.
en: In the face of severe challenges, we must always maintain the spirit of unity and shared resolve.

zh: 面对突如其来的困难，大伙儿齐心协力，终于渡过了难关。
pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de kùnnán, dàhuǒr qíxīnxiélì, zhōngyú dùguòle nánguān.
en: Facing the sudden difficulties, everyone worked together and finally overcame the crisis.

zh: 在极其恶劣的环境下，他最终选择了离开这个偏远的山村。
pinyin: Zài jíqí èliè de huánjìng xià, tā zuìzhōng xuǎnzé le líkāi zhège piānyuǎn de shāncūn.
en: Under extremely harsh conditions, he finally chose to leave this remote mountain village.

zh: 我们处理问题不能刻舟求剑，必须根据实际情况做出调整。
pinyin: Wǒmen chǔlǐ wèntí bùnéng kè zhōu qiú jiàn, bìxū gēnjù shíjì qíngkuàng zuòchū tiáozhěng.
en: We cannot be rigid when dealing with problems; we must make adjustments according to the actual situation.

zh: 在如此恶劣的环境下生存下来，确实是一件难以置信的事。
pinyin: Zài rúcǐ èliè de huánjìng xià shēngcún xiàlái, quèshí shì yī jiàn nányǐzhìxìn de shì.
en: Surviving in such harsh conditions is truly an incredible thing.

zh: 他在图书馆里废寝忘食地钻研学术，以此来不断充实自己。
pinyin: Tā zài túshūguǎn lǐ fèiqǐnwàngshí de zuānyán xuéshù, yǐ cǐ lái bùduàn chōngshí zìjǐ.
en: He studies academics in the library while forgetting to eat and sleep, in order to constantly enrich himself.

zh: 在那段充满挑战的岁月里，他们始终互相扶持，形影不离。
pinyin: Zài nà duàn chōngmǎn tiǎozhàn de suìyuè lǐ, tāmen shǐzhōng hùxiāng fúchí, xíng yǐng bù lí.
en: During those challenging years, they always supported each other and remained inseparable.

zh: 尽管面临重重困难，他还是出色地完成了那项艰巨的使命。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn miànlín chóngchóng kùnnán, tā háishì chūsè de wánchéngle nà xiàng jiānjù de shǐmìng.
en: Despite facing many difficulties, he still excellently completed that arduous mission.

zh: 无论工作多忙，他总能从琐碎的日常中发掘出独特的乐趣。
pinyin: Wú lùn gōng zuò duō máng, tā zǒng néng cóng suǒ suì de rì cháng zhōng fā jué chū dú tè de lè qù.
en: No matter how busy work is, he can always discover unique delight in trivial daily life.

zh: 这种似是而非的道理不仅不能解决问题，反而会误导别人。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shì shì ér fēi de dàolǐ bùjǐn bùnéng jiějué wèntí, fǎn'ér huì wùdǎo biérén.
en: This kind of specious reasoning not only fails to solve problems but also misleads others.

zh: 尽管他们偶尔会发生争执，但她男朋友依然对她呵护备至。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tāmen ǒu'ěr huì fāshēng zhēngzhí, dàn tā nán péngyou yīrán duì tā hēhù bèizhì.
en: Although they occasionally have disputes, her boyfriend still takes great care of her.

zh: 为了避免误解，我们应当设身处地地站在别人的角度思考。
pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn wùjiě, wǒmen yīngdāng shèshēnchǔdì de zhàn zài biérén de jiǎodù sīkǎo.
en: To avoid misunderstandings, we should put ourselves in others' shoes and think.

zh: 面对复杂多变的国际局势，我们不能采取一成不变的政策。
pinyin: Miànduì fùzá duōbiàn de guójì júshì, wǒmen bùnéng cǎiqǔ yīchéngbùbiàn de zhèngcè.
en: Facing the complex and changing international situation, we cannot adopt immutable policies.

zh: 许多 游客 被 这个 半岛 的 自然 风光 所 吸引。
pinyin: Xǔduō yóukè bèi zhège bàndǎo de zìrán fēngguāng suǒ xīyǐn.
en: Many tourists are attracted by the natural scenery of this peninsula.

zh: 尽管已经临近星期天晚上，他依然沉浸在学术研究的海洋中。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǐjīng línjìn xīngqītiān wǎnshàng, tā yīrán chénjìn zài xuéshù yánjiū de hǎiyáng zhōng.
en: Although it is already late on Sunday night, he remains immersed in the ocean of academic research.

zh: 我们本是素不相识的旅人，却在异国他乡结下了深厚的友谊。
pinyin: wǒmen běn shì sù bù xiāng shí de lǚrén, què zài yìguó tāxiāng jié xià le shēnhòu de yǒuyì.
en: We were originally total strangers, yet we forged a deep friendship in a foreign land.

zh: 为了筹备这场大型演唱会，工作人员已经连续工作了几个月。
pinyin: Wèile chóubèi zhè chǎng dàxíng yǎnchànghuì, gōngzuò rényuán yǐjīng liánxù gōngzuòle jǐ gè yuè.
en: In order to prepare for this large-scale concert, the staff have been working continuously for months.

zh: 他在极度虚弱的状态下，嘴唇微微颤抖着，似乎想说些什么。
pinyin: tā zài jí dù xū ruò de zhuàng tài xià, zuǐ chún wēi wēi chàn dǒu zhe, sì hū xiǎng shuō xiē shén me.
en: In a state of extreme weakness, his lips trembled slightly, as if he wanted to say something.

zh: 昨天那场突如其来的暴风雨给城市的交通带来了巨大的挑战。
pinyin: Zuótiān nà chǎng tūrúqílái de bàofēngyǔ gěi chéngshì de jiāotōng dàilái le jùdà de tiǎozhàn.
en: The sudden rainstorm yesterday brought huge challenges to the city's traffic.

zh: 这次合作是一次难得的机遇，有助于提升我们的核心竞争力。
pinyin: zhè cì hé zuò shì yī cì nán dé de jī yù, yǒu zhù yú tí shēng wǒ men de hé xīn jìng zhēng lì.
en: This cooperation is a rare opportunity, which helps to enhance our core competitiveness.

zh: 为了追求自己的梦想，他毅然放弃了很多人喜欢的高薪职位。
pinyin: Wèile zhuīqiú zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng, tā yìrán fàngqìle hěnduō rén xǐhuan de gāoxīn zhíwèi.
en: In order to pursue his dream, he resolutely gave up a high-paying position that many people like.

zh: 他用那支钢笔蘸了蘸墨水，在信纸上郑重地写下了自己的名字。
pinyin: tā yòng nà zhī gāng bǐ zhàn le zhàn mò shuǐ, zài xìn zhǐ shàng zhèng zhòng de xiě xià le zì jǐ de míng zìng zi.
en: He dipped his fountain pen in ink and solemnly wrote his name on the letter paper.

zh: 即使机票价格昂贵，他依然毫不犹豫地预订了飞往国外的航班。
pinyin: Jíshǐ jīpiào jiàgé ángguì, tā yīrán háobù yóuyù de yùdìng le fēi wǎng guówài de hángbān.
en: Even though the plane ticket price was expensive, he still booked the flight abroad without any hesitation.

zh: 作为一个团队领导，不仅要有能力，还要让下属觉得你很好处。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yīgè tuánduì lǐngdǎo, bùjǐn yào yǒu nénglì, hái yào ràng xiàshǔ juéde nǐ hěn hǎochǔ.
en: As a team leader, not only do you need to be capable, but you must also make your subordinates feel that you are easy to get along with.

zh: 学校安排了丰富多彩的活动，让同学们度过一个有意义的寒假。
pinyin: Xuéxiào ānpáile fēngfù duōcǎi de huódòng, ràng tóngxuémen dùguò yīgè yǒu yìyì de hánjià.
en: The school arranged various activities to let the students spend a meaningful winter vacation.

zh: 原以为他只是随口说说，哪知道他竟然真的去践行了他的诺言。
pinyin: yuán yǐ wéi tā zhǐ shì suí kǒu shuō shuō, nǎ zhī dào tā jìng rán zhēn de qù jiàn xíng le tā de nuò de nuò yán.
en: I thought he was just speaking casually, but who would have thought he would actually fulfill his promise.

zh: 这种半真半假的传言在互联网上迅速传播，造成了很大的影响。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bàn zhēn bàn jiǎ de chuányán zài hùliánwǎng shàng xùnsù chuánbō, zàochéngle hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
en: This kind of half-true, half-false rumor spread rapidly on the internet, causing a major impact.

zh: 想要进入这个高端论坛，一张昂贵的入场券是必不可少的门槛。
pinyin: Xiǎngyào jìnrù zhège gāoduān lùntán, yī zhāng ángguì de rùchǎngquàn shì bì bùkě shǎo de ménkǎn.
en: To enter this high-end forum, an expensive admission ticket is an essential threshold.

zh: 无论是在短跑还是跳远项目中，他都展现出了卓越的田径天赋。
pinyin: wúlùn shì zài duǎnpǎo háishì tiàoyuǎn xiàngmù zhōng, tā dōu zhǎnxiàn chūle zhuóyuè de tiánjìng tiānfù.
en: Whether in sprinting or long jump events, he has displayed exceptional talent for track and field.

zh: 在那个充满挑战的环境中，大家朝夕相处，共同克服了重重困难。
pinyin: Zài nàge chōngmǎn tiǎozhàn de huánjìng zhōng, dàjiā zhāo xī xiāng chǔ, gòngtóng kèfú le chóngchóng kùnnán.
en: In that challenging environment, everyone spent all their time together and overcame many difficulties.

zh: 在那次激烈的辩论中，他由于一不小心，泄露了公司的商业机密。
pinyin: Zài nà cì jīliè de biànlùn zhōng, tā yóuyú yī bù xiǎo xīn, xièlù le gōngsī de shāngyè jīmì.
en: During that intense debate, he was a little bit careless and leaked the company's trade secrets.

zh: 这次篮球联赛不仅促进了学校间的交流，也丰富了学生的课余生活。
pinyin: Zhè cì lánqiú liánsài bùjǐn cùjìn le xuéxiào jiān de jiāoliú, yě fēngfù le xuéshēng de kèyú shēnghuó.
en: This basketball league not only promoted exchanges between schools but also enriched students' extracurricular lives.

zh: 文武百官皆跪拜于当今面前。
pinyin: wén wǔ bǎi guān jiē guì bài yú dāng jīn miàn qián.
en: All civil and military officials knelt before His Majesty.

zh: 嘈杂的街市声让人无法静心。
pinyin: Cáozá de jiēshì shēng ràng rén wúfǎ jìngxīn.
en: The noisy sounds of the market make it impossible to calm down.

zh: 深海生物因其环境而显得稀罕。
pinyin: Shēnhǎi shēngwù yīn qí huánjìng ér xiǎnde xīhan.
en: Deep-sea creatures appear rare due to their environment.

zh: 那种风趣让整场气氛变得轻松。
pinyin: Nà zhǒng fēngqù ràng zhěng chǎng qìfēn biàn dé qīngsōng.
en: That charm made the whole atmosphere relaxed.

zh: 这份感谢之情将永远铭刻在心。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gǎnxiè zhī qíng jiāng yǒngyuǎn míngkè zài xīn.
en: This feeling of gratitude will be engraved in my heart forever.

zh: 实验中烧瓶因高温受压而破碎。
pinyin: Shíyàn zhōng shāopíng yīn gāowēn shòuyā ér pòsuì.
en: During the experiment, the flask smashed into pieces due to high temperature and pressure.

zh: 该公司因侵害知识产权而被起诉。
pinyin: Gāi gōngsī yīn qīnhài zhīshi chǎnquán ér bèi qǐsù.
en: The company was sued for infringing on intellectual property rights.

zh: 当地居民依靠捕捞海藻维持生计。
pinyin: Dāngdì jūmín yīkào bǔlāo hǎi zǎo wéichí shēngjì.
en: Local residents rely on harvesting kelp to make a living.

zh: 他那种哗众取宠的表现令人生厌。
pinyin: Tā nà zhǒng huázhòngqǔchǒng de biǎoxiàn lìng rén shēngyàn.
en: His showy behavior to gain popularity is disgusting.

zh: 真理面前，一切谬论皆不容辩驳。
pinyin: Zhēnlǐ miànqián, yīqiè miùlùn jiē bù róng biànbó.
en: In the face of truth, all fallacies cannot be debated.

zh: 辩论时应注意措辞与话语的逻辑。
pinyin: Biànlùn shí yīng zhùyì cuòcí yǔ huàyǔ de luójí.
en: One should pay attention to phrasing and logic of words during a debate.

zh: 该项目因涉及不正当回扣而流产。
pinyin: gāi xiàng mù yīn shè jí bù zhèng dāng huí kòu ér liú chǎn.
en: The project was aborted due to improper brokerage involvement.

zh: 该投资者持有大量未公开的债券。
pinyin: Gāi tóuzīzhě chíyǒu dàliàng wèi gōngkāi de zhàiquàn.
en: The investor holds a large amount of undisclosed bonds.

zh: 警方正通过指纹核对嫌疑人身份。
pinyin: Jǐngfāng zhèng tōngguò zhǐwén héduì xiányírén shēnfèn.
en: The police are verifying the suspect's identity through fingerprints.

zh: 该项目需按照既定程序严格执行。
pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù xū ànzhào jìdìng chéngxù yángé zhíxíng.
en: The project must be strictly executed according to the established procedure.

zh: 该项目因环保要求被列入审查流程。
pinyin: gāi xiàng mù yīn huán bǎo yāo qiú bèi liè rù shěn chá liú chéng.
en: The project was included in the review process due to environmental protection requirements.

zh: 该品牌因其卓越的品质而驰名中外。
pinyin: gāi pǐnpái yīn qí zhuóyuè de pǐnzhì ér chímíng zhōngwài.
en: The brand is famous both at home and abroad for its excellent quality.

zh: 那片荷塘中，盛开的莲花宛如仙境。
pinyin: Nà piàn hétáng zhōng, shèngkāi de liánhuā wǎnrú xiānjìng.
en: In that lotus pond, the lotuses in full bloom are like a fairyland.

zh: 那位远道而来的客人受到盛情款待。
pinyin: Nà wèi yuǎn dào ér lái de kè rén shòu dào shèng qíng kuǎn dài.
en: The visitor who came from afar was treated with great hospitality.

zh: 该方案的创新之处表现得相当不错。
pinyin: Gāi fāng'àn de chuàngxīn zhī chù biǎoxiàn de xiāngdāng bú cuò.
en: The innovative aspect of the plan performs quite well (is not bad).

zh: 你这样胡闹只会让问题变得更复杂。
pinyin: nǐ zhè yàng hú nào zhǐ huì ràng wèn tí biàn de gèng fù zá.
en: Acting willfully like this will only make the problem more complex.

zh: 检察官指控他是该团伙的协作同谋。
pinyin: Jiǎncháguān zhǐkòng tā shì gāi tuánhuǒ de xiézuò tóngmóu.
en: The prosecutor accused him of being an accomplice of the gang.

zh: 长焦距镜头可以让远处的景物变大。
pinyin: Cháng jiāojù jìngtóu kěyǐ ràng yuǎnchù de jǐngwù biàn dà.
en: A long focal length lens can make distant scenery appear larger.

zh: 渔夫撑着竹竿，缓缓地划向湖中心。
pinyin: Yúfū chēngzhe zhúgān, huǎnhuǎn de huá xiàng hú zhōngxīn.
en: The fisherman pushed with a bamboo pole and rowed slowly toward the center of the lake.

zh: 整座城市在节日的灯火中通宵闪耀。
pinyin: Zhěng zuò chéngshì zài jiérì de dēnghuǒ zhōng tōngxiāo shǎnyào.
en: The whole city shone throughout the night amidst the festive lights.

zh: 该项目要求所有专家提供履历证书。
pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù yāoqiú suǒyǒu zhuānjiā tígōng lǚlì zhèngshū.
en: The project requires all experts to provide career credentials.

zh: 寒冬腊月，唯有梅花独自吐露芬芳。
pinyin: Hándōnglàyuè, wéiyǒu méihuā dúzì tǔlù fēnfāng.
en: In the depth of winter, only the wintersweet exhales its fragrance alone.

zh: 每逢佳节，海外游子总是倍感思乡。
pinyin: měi féng jiā jié, hǎi wài yóu zǐ zǒng shì bèi gǎn sī xiāng.
en: Every holiday, people living abroad feel an extra sense of homesickness.

zh: 这种新型材料的硬度仅次于金刚石。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīnxíng cáiliào de yìngdù jǐn cì yú jīngāngshí.
en: The hardness of this new material is second only to diamond.

zh: 每当季节更替，大雁都会准时迁徙。
pinyin: měidāng jìjié gēngtì, dàyàn dūhuì zhǔnshí qiānxǐ.
en: Whenever the seasons change, the wild geese migrate on time.

zh: 体育馆内座无虚席，气氛十分热烈。
pinyin: tǐ yù guǎn nèi zuò wú xū xí, qìfēn shífēn rèliè.
en: The stadium was filled to capacity, and the atmosphere was very enthusiastic.

zh: 底线张力调节不当会导致布料起皱。
pinyin: Dǐxiàn zhānglì tiáojié bùdàng huì dǎozhì bùliào qǐzhòu.
en: Improper adjustment of the under thread tension will cause the fabric to wrinkle.

zh: 他拥有深邃的洞察力与独特的远见。
