pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào dìngqī qīnglǐ cípán yǐ tígāo jìsuànjī de yùnxíng xiàolǜ.
en: We need to clean up the disk regularly to improve the computer's operating efficiency.

zh: 那条河流横跨城市的东西走向，将城区一分为二。
pinyin: nà tiáo hé liú héng kuà chéng shì de dōng xī zǒu xiàng, jiāng chéng qū yī fēn wéi èr.
en: That river crosses the city from east to west, dividing the urban area into two.

zh: 如果车辆的时速过快，极易引发严重的交通事故。
pinyin: Rúguǒ chēliàng de shísù guò kuài, jíyì yǐnfā yánzhòng de jiāotōng shìgù.
en: If the vehicle's speed is too fast, it is very easy to cause a serious traffic accident.

zh: 面对舆论的恶意诋毁，他采取了理性的反击措施。
pinyin: Miànduì yúlùn de èyì dǐhuǐ, tā cǎiqǔ le lǐxìng de fǎnjī cuòshī.
en: Facing malicious slander from public opinion, he took rational counterattacking measures.

zh: 这些古董的摆放位置经过了专家深思熟虑的考量。
pinyin: zhè xiē gǔ dǒng de bǎi fàng wèi zhì jīng guò le zhuān jiā shēn sī shú lǜ de kǎo liáng.
en: The placement of these antiques has been carefully considered by experts.

zh: 对于这种毫无根据的指责，我懒得作出任何回应。
pinyin: Duìyú zhè zhǒng háowú gēnjù de zhǐzé, wǒ lǎn de zuòchū rènhé huíyìng.
en: Regarding such groundless accusations, I don't feel like making any response.

zh: 工厂引进了先进的技术，以更高效地烘干原材料。
pinyin: gōngchǎng yǐnjìn le xiānjìn de jìshù, yǐ gèng gāoxiào de hōnggān yuáncáiliào.
en: The factory introduced advanced technology to dry raw materials more efficiently.

zh: 律师要求原告准确地陈述事实，不得有任何虚构。
pinyin: Lǜshī yāoqiú yuángào zhǔnquè de chénshù shìshí, bùdé yǒu rènhé xūgòu.
en: The lawyer asked the plaintiff to state the facts accurately, without any fabrication.

zh: 这位军官凭借卓越的军事才能赢得了部下的尊敬。
pinyin: Zhè wèi jūnguān píngjiè zhuóyuè de jūnshì cáinéng yíngdé le bùxià de zūnjìng.
en: This officer won the respect of his subordinates by virtue of his outstanding military talent.

zh: 随着人工智能的发展，一系列伦理挑战随之产生。
pinyin: Suízhe réngōng zhìnéng de fāzhǎn, yī xìliè lúnlǐ tiǎozhàn suízhī chǎnshēng.
en: With the development of artificial intelligence, a series of ethical challenges have emerged.

zh: 那记干脆利落的火锅彻底摧毁了对方的进攻节奏。
pinyin: Nà jì gāncuì lìluò de huǒguō chèdǐ cuīhuǐ le duìfāng de jìngōng jiézòu.
en: That crisp and clean blocked shot completely destroyed the opponent's offensive rhythm.

zh: 城乡人口的流动对社会经济结构产生了深远影响。
pinyin: Chéngxiāng rénkǒu de liúdòng duì shèhuì jīngjì jiégòu chǎnshēngle shēnyuǎn yǐngxiǎng.
en: The flow of population between the city and the countryside has had a profound impact on the socio-economic structure.

zh: 这件刺绣衬衫做工精湛，体现了极高的工艺水平。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn cìxiù chènshān zuògōng jīngzhàn, tǐxiàn le jí gāo de gōngyì shuǐpíng.
en: This embroidered blouse has exquisite workmanship, reflecting a very high level of craftsmanship.

zh: 由于国际局势的影响，美元汇率出现了剧烈波动。
pinyin: Yóuyú guójì júshì de yǐngxiǎng, měiyuán huìlǜ chūxiàn le jùliè bōdòng.
en: Due to the impact of the international situation, the US dollar exchange rate has shown drastic fluctuations.

zh: 多云的天气往往会遮蔽阳光，让人感觉比较凉爽。
pinyin: Duōyún de tiānqì wǎngwǎng huì zhēbì yángguāng, ràng rén gǎnjué bǐjiào liángshuǎng.
en: Cloudy weather often blocks the sunlight, making people feel relatively cool.

zh: 随着经济的发展，人们的生活变得越来越富裕了。
pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì de fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó biàn de yuè lái yuè fùyù le.
en: With the development of the economy, people's lives are becoming increasingly affluent.

zh: 教条主义会导致思想僵化，阻碍创新思维的发展。
pinyin: Jiàotiáo zhǔyì huì dǎozhì sīxiǎng jiānghuà, zǔ'ài chuàngxīn sīwéi de fāzhǎn.
en: Dogmatism leads to rigid thinking and hinders the development of innovative ideas.

zh: 尽管大象体型庞大，但它们行动起来却非常敏捷。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn dàxiàng tǐxíng pángdà, dàn tāmen xíngdòng qǐlái què fēicháng mǐnjié.
en: Although elephants are huge, they are very agile when they move.

zh: 由于这里交通便利，许多商业机构纷纷在此聚集。
pinyin: Yóuyú zhèlǐ jiāotōng biànlì, xǔduō shāngyè jīgòu fēnfēn zài cǐ jùjí.
en: Due to the convenient transportation, many commercial organizations have gathered here one after another.

zh: 他虔诚地跪在菩萨面前，祈求家人的平安与健康。
pinyin: tā qián chéng de guì zài pú sà miàn qián, qí qiú jiā rén de píng ān yǔ jiàn kāng.
en: He knelt devoutly before the bodhisattva, praying for the peace and health of his family.

zh: 既然合同已经签署，你不必再为了细节反复推敲。
pinyin: Jìrán hétóng yǐjīng qiānshǔ, nǐ bù bì zài wèile xìjié fǎnfù tuīqiāo.
en: Since the contract has been signed, you need not deliberate repeatedly over the details.

zh: 法律不仅保护个人的权利，还强制执行各种契约。
pinyin: Fǎlǜ bùjǐn bǎohù gèrén de quánlì, hái qiángzhì zhíxíng gèzhǒng qìyuē.
en: Law not only protects personal rights but also enforces various contracts.

zh: 由于原材料价格上涨，水泥的生产成本有所增加。
pinyin: Yóuyú yuáncáiliào jiàgé shàngzhǎng, shuǐní de shēngchǎn chéngběn yǒu suǒ zēngjiā.
en: Due to the rise in raw material prices, the production cost of cement has increased.

zh: 我叔叔不仅在学术领域颇有建树，而且为人谦逊。
pinyin: Wǒ shūshu bùjǐn zài xuéshù lǐngyù pō yǒu jiànshù, érqiě wéirén qiānxùn.
en: My uncle has not only achieved success in the academic field but is also modest.

zh: 这些迁徙的天鹅在严寒的冬季会飞往温暖的南方。
pinyin: Zhèxiē qiānxǐ de tiān é zài yánhán de dōngjì huì fēiwǎng wēnnuǎn de nánfāng.
en: These migratory swans fly to the warm south during the bitter winter.

zh: 庆祝活动圆满成功，会场内洋溢着喜洋洋的气氛。
pinyin: Qìngzhù huódòng yuánmǎn chénggōng, huìchǎng nèi yángyìzhe xǐyángyáng de qìfēn.
en: The celebration was a complete success, and the venue was permeated with a radiant, joyful atmosphere.

zh: 这种结构设计导致了内部零件的裸露，容易损坏。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiégòu shèjì dǎozhìle nèibù língjiàn de luǒlù, róngyì sǔnhuài.
en: This structural design leaves the internal components exposed, making them prone to damage.

zh: 能人的出现标志着人类制造工具能力的巨大飞跃。
pinyin: néng rén de chūxiàn biāozhìzhe rénlèi zhìzào gōngjù nénglì de jùdà fēiyuè.
en: The emergence of Homo habilis marks a huge leap in human tool-making ability.

zh: 夏天在野外露营，最让人苦恼的就是蚊子的骚扰。
pinyin: Xiàtiān zài yěwài lùyíng, zuì ràng rén kǔnǎo de jiùshì wénzi de sāorǎo.
en: When camping in the wild in summer, what bothers people most is the harassment of mosquitoes.

zh: 他因公务繁忙而缺席了这场至关重要的行业峰会。
pinyin: Tā yīn gōngwù fánmáng ér quēxí le zhè chǎng zhìguānzhòngyào de hángyè fēnghuì.
en: He was absent from this crucial industry summit due to his busy official duties.

zh: 在公共场合，每个人都应当维护良好的社会秩序。
pinyin: zài gōng gòng chǎng hé, měi gè rén dōu yīng dāng wéi hù liáng hǎo de shè huì shù xù.
en: In public places, everyone should maintain good social order.

zh: 为了提高效率，公司引进了新型轻型工业机器人。
pinyin: Wèile tígāo xiàolǜ, gōngsī yǐnjìn le xīnxíng qīngxíng gōngyè jīqìrén.
en: In order to improve efficiency, the company introduced new light industrial robots.

zh: 繁华的夜市里人声鼎沸，充满了浓郁的生活气息。
pinyin: Fánhuá de yèshì lǐ rénshēngdǐngfèi, chōngmǎnle nóngyù de shēnghuó qìxí.
en: The bustling night market is noisy with crowds, full of a rich atmosphere of daily life.

zh: 这些珍贵的历史遗迹真实地反映了当时的社会民俗。
pinyin: Zhèxiē zhēnguì de lìshǐ yíjì zhēnshí de fǎnyìngle dāngshí de shèhuì mínsú.
en: These precious historical sites truly reflect the social customs of that time.

zh: 这片区域地质结构不稳定，动不动就引发山体滑坡。
pinyin: zhè piàn qūyù dìzhì jiégòu bù wěndìng, dòng bu dòng jiù yǐnfā shāntǐ huápō.
en: The geological structure of this area is unstable and is apt to cause landslides.

zh: 为了营造良好的课堂气氛，老师鼓励大家积极发言。
pinyin: wèi le yíng zào liáng hǎo de kè táng qì fēn, lǎo shī gǔ lì dà jiā jī jí fā yán.
en: In order to create a good classroom atmosphere, the teacher encourages everyone to speak actively.

zh: 经过严密的逻辑推理，警官终于揭开了案件的真相。
pinyin: Jīngguò yánmì de luójí tuīlǐ, jǐngguān zhōngyú jiēkāi le ànjiàn de zhēnxiàng.
en: Through rigorous logical deduction, the police officer finally uncovered the truth of the case.

zh: 他将遗产的一半捐赠给了慈善机构，以此回馈社会。
pinyin: Tā jiāng yíchǎn de yībàn juānzèng gěi le císhàn jīgòu, yǐ cǐ huíkuì shèhuì.
en: He donated half of his inheritance to charity to give back to society.

zh: 尽管天气状况恶劣，救援队依然坚持进行搜救工作。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tiānqì zhuàngkuàng èliè, jiùyuánduì yīrán jiānchí jìnxíng sōujiù gōngzuò.
en: Despite the adverse weather conditions, the rescue team persisted in carrying out search and rescue work.

zh: 这家公司致力于通过官方网站提供透明的咨询服务。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhìlì yú tōngguò guānfāng wǎngzhàn tígōng tòumíng de zīxún fúwúfù.
en: This company is committed to providing transparent consulting services through its official website.

zh: 他将这位医生比作天使，感谢她治愈了自己的顽疾。
pinyin: Tā jiāng zhè wèi yīshēng bǐzuò tiānshǐ, gǎnxiè tā zhìyùle zìjǐ de wánjí.
en: He likened the doctor to an angel, thanking her for curing his stubborn illness.

zh: 由于长期缺乏锻炼，他的身体素质快要每况愈下了。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī quēfá duànliàn, tā de shēntǐ sùzhì kuài yào měikuàngyùxià le.
en: Due to a long-term lack of exercise, his physical health is about to go from bad to worse.

zh: 无论处境多么艰巨，我们都不应表现出畏缩或退却。
pinyin: Wúlùn chǔjìng duōme jiānjù, wǒmen dōu bùyīng biǎoxiàn chū wèisuō huò tuìquè.
en: No matter how arduous the situation is, we should not show cowering or retreat.

zh: 院子里那把充满年代感的藤椅勾起了他童年的回忆。
pinyin: Yuànzi lǐ nà bǎ chōngmǎn niándài gǎn de téngyǐ gōu qǐle tā tóngnián de huíyì.
en: The vintage-looking rattan chair in the courtyard stirred up memories of his childhood.

zh: 姥姥不仅是一位勤劳的女性，更是一位智慧的长者。
pinyin: Lǎo lao bùjǐn shì yī wèi qínláo de nǚxìng, gèng shì yī wèi zhìhuì de zhǎngzhě.
en: My maternal grandmother is not only a hardworking woman, but also a wise elder.

zh: 由于项目进度滞后，我们必须在月底之前完成任务。
pinyin: Yóuyú xiàngmù jìndù zhìhòu, wǒmen bìxū zài yuèdǐ zhīqián wánchéng rènwù.
en: Due to the project delay, we must complete the task before the end of the month.

zh: 随着工业的发展，地球的生态平衡遭到了严重破坏。
pinyin: Suízhe gōngyè de fāzhǎn, dìqiú de shēngtài pínghéng zāodào le yánzhòng pòhuài.
en: With the development of industry, the Earth's ecological balance has been seriously damaged.

zh: 在充满变数的时代，我们只能静静等待局势的发展。
pinyin: Zài chōngmǎn biànshù de shídài, wǒmen zhǐnéng jìngjìng děngdài júshì de fāzhǎn.
en: In this era full of variables, we can only quietly wait for the situation to develop.

zh: 历史上的许多战争都是为了侵占更多的资源与土地。
pinyin: Lìshǐ shàng de xǔduō zhànzhēng dōu shì wèile qīnzhàn gèng duō de zīyuán yǔ tǔdì.
en: Many wars in history were for the purpose of invading and occupying more resources and land.

zh: 为了赶上会议，我不得不乘坐特快航班前往目的地。
pinyin: Wèile gǎnshàng huìyì, wǒ bùdébù chéngzuò tè kuài hángbān qiánwǎng mùdìdì.
en: In order to catch the meeting, I had to take an express flight to the destination.

zh: 老师在批改作业时给了每一位学生合理的标记分数。
pinyin: Lǎoshī zài pīgǎi zuòyè shí gěile měi yī wèi xuéshēng hélǐ de biāojì fēnshù.
en: The teacher gave each student a reasonable mark while grading assignments.

zh: 为了庆祝节日，小镇组织了一场别开生面的嘉年华。
pinyin: Wèile qìngzhù jiérì, xiǎozhèn zǔzhī le yī chǎng bié kāi shēng miàn de jiā nián huá.
en: In order to celebrate the festival, the small town organized a unique carnival.

zh: 由于外观造型时尚，这款新家电在市场上大受欢迎。
pinyin: Yóuyú wàiguān zàoxíng shíshàng, zhè kuǎn xīn jiādiàn zài shìchǎng shàng dà shòu huānyíng.
en: Due to its stylish outward appearance, this new home appliance is very popular in the market.

zh: 为了维持公司的运营，全体员工必须分担这一风险。
pinyin: Wèile wéichí gōngsī de yùnyíng, quántǐ yuángōng bìxū fēndān zhè yī fēngxiǎn.
en: In order to maintain the company's operations, all employees must share this risk.

zh: 为了避免发生危险，请务必定期检修家里的热水器。
pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng wēixiǎn, qǐng wùbì dìngqī jiǎnxiū jiālǐ de rèshuǐqì.
en: To avoid danger, please be sure to have the water heater in your home inspected regularly.

zh: 那场音乐会的门票极为抢手，刚一开售便销售一空。
pinyin: nà chǎng yīn yuè huì de mén piào jí wéi qiǎng shǒu, gāng yī kāi shòu biàn xiāo shòu yī kōng.
en: Tickets for that concert were extremely popular and sold out as soon as they went on sale.

zh: 我们在网上预订酒店时，必须填写详细的邮寄地址。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài wǎngshàng yùdìng jiǔdiàn shí, bìxū tiánxiě xiángxì de yóujì dìzhǐ.
en: When we book a hotel online, we must fill in a detailed mailing address.

zh: 为了追求科学真理，他放弃了优越的物质生活条件。
pinyin: Wèile zhuīqiú kēxué zhēnlǐ, tā fàngqìle yōuyuè de wùzhì shēnghuó tiáojiàn.
en: In order to pursue scientific truth, he gave up superior material living conditions.

zh: 金字塔不仅是世界文化遗产，更是人类文明的象征。
pinyin: Jīnzìtǎ bùjǐn shì shìjiè wénhuà yíchǎn, gèng shì rénlèi wénmíng de xiàngzhēng.
en: The pyramid is not only a world cultural heritage site, but also a symbol of human civilization.

zh: 在暴风雨中，舵手必须保持冷静以控制船只的方向。
pinyin: Zài bàofēngyǔ zhōng, duòshǒu bìxū bǎochí lěngjìng yǐ kòngzhì chuánzhī de fāngxiàng.
en: In the storm, the helmsman must stay calm to control the direction of the ship.

zh: 他在挫折中不断汲取经验，从而获得了显著的进步。
pinyin: Tā zài cuòzhé zhōng bùduàn jíqǔ jīngyàn, cóng'ér huòdé le xiǎnzhù de jìnbù.
en: He constantly drew experience from setbacks, thereby achieving significant improvement.

zh: 竞争对手的策略调整让公司陷入了措手不及的境地。
pinyin: Jìngzhēng duìshǒu de cèlüè tiáozhěng ràng gōngsī xiànrù le cuò shǒu bù jí de jìngdì.
en: The competitor's strategic adjustment put the company in a state of being caught off guard.

zh: 他那种痴心执着的态度，让周围的人感到无比敬佩。
pinyin: Tā nà zhǒng chīxīn zhízhuó de tàidù, ràng zhōuwéi de rén gǎndào wúbǐ jìngpèi.
en: His attitude of infatuated persistence makes those around him feel immense admiration.

zh: 姐姐总是以一种豁达的态度面对生活中的各种挑战。
pinyin: Jiějie zǒngshì yǐ yī zhǒng huòdá de tàidù miànduì shēnghuó zhōng de gèzhǒng tiǎozhàn.
en: My older sister always faces the various challenges in life with an open-minded attitude.

zh: 为了避免以后的纠纷，我们必须严格遵守合约条款。
pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn yǐhòu de jiūfēn, wǒmen bìxū yángé zūnshǒu héyuē tiáokuǎn.
en: In order to avoid future disputes, we must strictly abide by the contract terms.

zh: 无论遇到什么困难，都不能指望通过捷径获取成功。
pinyin: Wúlùn yùdào shéme kùnnán, dōu bùnéng zhǐwàng tōngguò jiéjìng huòqǔ chénggōng.
en: No matter what difficulties you face, you cannot count on taking shortcuts to achieve success.

zh: 为了保持身材，他尽量避免摄入过多的高热量芝士。
pinyin: Wèile bǎochí shēncái, tā jǐnliàng bìmiǎn shèrù guòduō de gāo rèliàng zhīshì.
en: In order to keep in shape, he tries his best to avoid consuming too much high-calorie cheese.

zh: 随着市场竞争的加剧，工商企业面临着严峻的挑战。
pinyin: Suízhe shìchǎng jìngzhēng de jiājù, gōngshāng qǐyè miànlínzhe yánjùn de tiǎozhàn.
en: With the intensification of market competition, industrial and commercial enterprises are facing severe challenges.

zh: 这种决策虽然能带来收益，但也伴随着巨大的风险。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jué cè suī rán néng dài lái shōu yì, dàn yě bàn suí zhe jù dà de fēng xiǎn.
en: Although this decision can bring returns, it is also accompanied by huge risks.

zh: 通过研究该现象及其内在规律，我们获得了新发现。
pinyin: tōngguò yánjiū gāi xiànxiàng jí qí nèizài guīlǜ, wǒmen huòdé le xīn fāxiàn.
en: By studying this phenomenon and its underlying principles, we have made new discoveries.

zh: 幸亏他在关键时刻保持了冷静，否则后果不堪设想。
pinyin: Xìngkuī tā zài guānjiàn shíkè bǎochíle lěngjìng, fǒuzé hòuguǒ bùkān shèxiǎng.
en: Luckily he remained calm at the critical moment, otherwise the consequences would have been unimaginable.

zh: 在这个季节，选择一款清爽的发型能让人感到舒适。
pinyin: Zài zhège jìjié, xuǎnzé yī kuǎn qīngshuǎng de fàxíng néng ràng rén gǎndào shūshì.
en: In this season, choosing a fresh and clean hairstyle can make one feel comfortable.

zh: 想要在学术领域有所建树，扎实的基本功不可或缺。
pinyin: xiǎngyào zài xuéshù lǐngyù yǒu suǒ jiànshù, zhāshi de jīběngōng bùkěhuòquē.
en: To make achievements in the academic field, solid fundamentals are indispensable.

zh: 在激烈的市场竞争中，维持现状往往等于慢性自杀。
pinyin: Zài jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng, wéichí xiànzhuàng wǎngwǎng děngyú mànxìng zìshā.
en: In fierce market competition, maintaining the status quo is often tantamount to slow suicide.

zh: 将军运用了高明的计策，最终扭转了战场上的颓势。
pinyin: jiāngjūn yùnyòng le gāomíng de jìcè, zuìzhōng niǔzhuǎn le zhànchǎng shàng de tuíshì.
en: The general employed a brilliant stratagem and eventually reversed the unfavorable situation on the battlefield.

zh: 外交谈判的焦点在于如何达成双方都能接受的共识。
pinyin: Wàijiāo tánpàn de jiāodiǎn zàiyú rúhé dáchéng shuāngfāng dōu néng jiēshòu de gòngshí.
en: The focal point of the diplomatic negotiations lies in how to reach a consensus that both sides can accept.

zh: 在海外漂泊多年，他恨不得立刻插上翅膀飞回祖国。
pinyin: Zài hǎiwài piāobó duōnián, tā hènbudé lìkè chā shàng chìbǎng fēi huí zǔguó.
en: Having drifted overseas for many years, he wished he could grow wings and fly back to his motherland at once.

zh: 在科学研究领域，只有不断精益求精才能取得突破。
pinyin: Zài kēxué yánjiū lǐngyù, zhǐyǒu bùduàn jīngyìqiújīng cáinéng qǔdé tūpò.
en: In the field of scientific research, only by constantly striving for improvement can one make breakthroughs.

zh: 许多学者致力于研究帝国主义对殖民地的深远影响。
pinyin: xǔ duō xué zhě zhì lì yú yán jiū dì guó zhǔ yì duì zhí mín dì de shēn yuǎn yǐng xiǎng.
en: Many scholars are committed to studying the profound influence of imperialism on colonies.

zh: 他创作了一系列充满想象力的童话作品，深受欢迎。
pinyin: Tā chuàngzuòle yī xìliè chōngmǎn xiǎngxiànglì de tónghuà zuòpǐn, shēn shòu huānyíng.
en: He created a series of imaginative fairy tale works, which are very popular.

zh: 为了避开障碍物，驾驶员不得不进行了一次急转弯。
pinyin: Wèile bìkāi zhàng'àiwù, jiàshǐyuán bùdébù jìnxíngle yīcì jí zhuǎn wān.
en: In order to avoid the obstacle, the driver had no choice but to make a sudden turn.

zh: 首相正在召集内阁会议，讨论当前严峻的经济形势。
pinyin: shǒu xiàng zhèng zài zhào jí nèi gé huì yì, tǎo lùn dāng qián yán jùn de jīng jì xíng shì.
en: The Prime Minister is convening a cabinet meeting to discuss the current severe economic situation.

zh: 随着国际局势的动荡，燃油价格出现了剧烈的波动。
pinyin: Suízhe guójì júshì de dòngdàng, rányóu jiàgé chūxiànle jùliè de bōdòng.
en: Due to the turbulence of the international situation, fuel oil prices have experienced drastic fluctuations.

zh: 由于采取了有效的宏观调控措施，物价保持了平稳。
pinyin: yóuyú cǎiqǔ le yǒuxiào de hóngguān tiáokòng cuòshī, wùjià bǎochí le píngwěn.
en: Due to the implementation of effective macro-control measures, prices have remained stable.

zh: 许多中年人面临着照顾父母和抚养子女的双重压力。
pinyin: Xǔduō zhōngniánrén miànlínzhe zhàogù fùmǔ hé fǔyǎng zǐnǚ de shuāngchóng yālì.
en: Many middle-aged people face the dual pressure of caring for parents and raising children.

zh: 为了营造温馨的气氛，他在客厅摆放了许多艺术品。
pinyin: Wèile yíngzào wēnxīn de qìfēn, tā zài kètīng bǎifàngle xǔduō yìshùpǐn.
en: In order to create a warm atmosphere, he placed many works of art in the living room.

zh: 政府提供了奖学金以鼓励优秀的留学生来本国深造。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tígōngle jiǎngxuéjīn yǐ gǔlì yōuxiù de liú xué shēng lái běnguó shēnzào.
en: The government provided scholarships to encourage excellent international students to pursue further studies in the country.

zh: 面对恶劣的自然环境，他们依然坚持徒步穿越沙漠。
pinyin: Miànduì èliè de zìrán huánjìng, tāmen yīrán jiānchí túbù chuānyuè shāmòumò.
en: Facing the harsh natural environment, they still persisted in trekking across the desert.

zh: 离别时刻，大家怀着依依不舍的心情相互拥抱告别。
pinyin: Líbié shíkè, dàjiā huáizhe yī yī bù shě de xīnqíng xiānghù yōngbào gàobié.
en: At the moment of parting, everyone hugged and said goodbye with a feeling of reluctance.

zh: 面对激烈的市场竞争，企业必须树立坚定的自信心。
pinyin: Miànduì jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng, qǐyè bìxū shùlì jiāndìng de zìxìnxīn.
en: Facing intense market competition, enterprises must establish firm self-confidence.

zh: 为了防止细菌传播，实验室采取了严密的消毒措施。
pinyin: Wèile fángzhǐ xìjūn chuán chuánbō, shíyànshì cǎiqǔle yánmì de xiāodú cuòshī.
en: In order to prevent the spread of bacteria, the laboratory has adopted strict disinfection measures.

zh: 这座历史悠久的建筑中，更衣室被改造成了休息区。
pinyin: zhè zuò lìshǐ yōujiǔ de jiànzhù zhōng, gēngyīshì bèi gǎizào chéng le xiūxi qū.
en: In this historic building, the restroom has been converted into a lounge area.

zh: 为了能够阅读原始文献，他不得不自学好几种外文。
pinyin: Wèile nénggòu yuèdú yuánshǐ wénxiàn, tā bùdébù zìxué hǎo jǐ zhǒng wàiwén.
en: In order to read original documents, he had no choice but to teach himself several foreign languages.

zh: 为了保护嗓子，他尽量避免咽喉受到冷空气的刺激。
pinyin: Wèile bǎohù sǎngzi, tā jǐnliàng bìmiǎn yānhóu shòudào lěngqì de cìjī.
en: In order to protect his voice, he tries his best to avoid irritating his throat with cold air.

zh: 由于数字媒体的普及，光盘的使用率正在逐渐下降。
pinyin: Yóuyú shù shùzì méitǐ de pǔjí, guāngpán de shǐyòng lǜ zhèngzài zhújiàn xiàjiàng.
en: Due to the popularity of digital media, the usage rate of CDs is gradually declining.

zh: 由于法律效力的要求，这份欠条必须注明还款日期。
pinyin: Yóuyú fǎlǜ xiàolì de yāoqiú, zhè fèn qiàntiáo bìxū zhù zhù míng huánkuǎn rìqī.
en: Due to legal validity requirements, this certificate of indebtedness must specify the repayment date.

zh: 由于项目进度紧迫，大家不得不承受巨大的工作量。
pinyin: Yóuyú xiàngmù jìndù jǐnpò, dàjiā bùdébù chéngshòu jùdà de gōngzuòliàng.
en: Due to the tight project schedule, everyone has to endure a huge workload.

zh: 由于长期不清理，梳子上的灰尘已经堆积得很多了。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī bù qīnglǐ, shūzi shàng de huīchén yǐjīng duījī de hěnduō le.
en: Due to not being cleaned for a long time, the dust on the comb has accumulated quite a bit.

zh: 长跑不仅需要良好的耐力，还需要坚韧不拔的意志。
pinyin: Chángpǎo bùjǐn xūyào liánghǎo de nàilì, hái xūyào jiānrènbùbá de yìzhì.
en: Long-distance running requires not only good endurance but also a persistent will.

zh: 他凭借精湛的手艺，常年为社区的老人们义务理发。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè jīngzhàn de shǒuyì, chángnián wèi shèqū de lǎorénmen yìwù lǐfà.
en: With his superb skills, he has been cutting hair for the elderly in the community voluntarily for years.

zh: 他作为一名出色的调查员，对线索有着敏锐的嗅觉。
pinyin: Tā zuòwéi yī míng chūsè de diàochá yuán, duì xiànsuǒ yǒuzhe mǐnruì de xiùjué.
en: As an outstanding investigator, he has a keen sense for clues.

zh: 这种现象极具争议，换言之，人们的观点截然不同。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiànxiàng jí jù zhēngyì, huànyánzhī, rénmen de guāndiǎn jiérán bùtóng.
en: This phenomenon is highly controversial; in other words, people's opinions are diametrically opposed.

zh: 这本杂志致力于为文学爱好者提供交流创作的园地。
pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì zhìlì yú wèi wénxué àihàozhě tígōng jiāoliú chuàngzuò de yuándì.
en: This magazine is dedicated to providing a space for literature enthusiasts to exchange and create.

zh: 在那段困苦的岁月中，她视这份关怀为神圣的恩惠。
pinyin: zài nà duàn kùnkǔ de suìyuè zhōng, tā shì zhè fèn guānhuái wéi shénshèng de ēnhuì.
en: During those difficult years, she regarded this care as a divine grace.

zh: 这座山脚下的别墅不仅设计独特，装修也极其豪华。
pinyin: Zhè zuò shānjiǎo xià de biéshù bùjǐn shèjì dútè, zhuāngxiū yě jíqí háohuá.
en: The villa at the foot of the mountain is not only uniquely designed but also extremely luxurious in decoration.

zh: 人生总会遇到各种挫折，关键在于我们如何去克服。
pinyin: Rénshēng zǒng huì yù dào gèzhǒng cuòzhé, guānjiàn zàiyú wǒmen rúhé qù kèfú.
en: Life will always encounter various setbacks; the key lies in how we overcome them.

zh: 他习惯在周末利用空余时间阅读一些经典文学作品。
pinyin: Tā xíguàn zài zhōumò lìyòng kòngyú shíjiān yuèdú yīxiē jīngdiǎn wénxué zuòpǐn.
en: He is accustomed to using his spare time on the weekend to read some classic literary works.

zh: 这次改革的影响范围广泛，其效果已全部显现出来。
pinyin: Zhècì gǎigé de yǐngxiǎng fànwéi guǎngfàn, qí xiàoguǒ yǐ quánbù xiǎnxiàn chūlái.
en: The scope of this reform is extensive, and its effects have all become apparent.

zh: 为了避免造成更大的损失，他连忙采取了补救措施。
pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn zàochéng gèng dà de sǔnshī, tā liánmáng cǎiqǔ le bǔjiù cuòshī.
en: In order to avoid causing greater losses, he promptly took remedial measures.

zh: 在这广阔的天空之下，我感到头顶的星空无比深邃。
pinyin: Zài zhè guǎngkuò de tiānkōng zhī xià, wǒ gǎndào tóudǐng de xīngkōng wúbǐ shēnsuì.
en: Under this vast sky, I feel the starry expanse above my head is incomparably deep.

zh: 他的观点稍微显得有些偏激，但并非完全没有道理。
pinyin: Tā de guāndiǎn shāowēi xiǎnde yǒuxiē piānjī, dàn bìngfēi wánquán méiyǒu dàolǐ.
en: His point of view seems a little bit extreme, but it is not entirely unreasonable.

zh: 在现代社会，人们逐渐淡化了门当户对的择偶标准。
pinyin: Zài xiàndài shèhuì, rénmen zhújiàn dànhuà le méndānghùduì de zé'ǒu biāozhǔn.
en: In modern society, people have gradually downplayed the standard of an appropriate match in choosing a spouse.

zh: 在这战乱的年代，能拥有一段安宁的时光多么难得。
pinyin: Zài zhè zhànluàn de niándài, néng yōngyǒu yīduàn ānníng de shíguāng duōme nándé.
en: In this era of war, how rare it is to have a moment of peace.

zh: 这位学者一生致力于学术研究，获得了极高的声誉。
pinyin: Zhè wèi xuézhě yīshēng zhìlì yú xuéshù yánjiū, huòdéle jí gāo de shēngyù.
en: This scholar devoted his whole life to academic research and earned a very high reputation.

zh: 当面对重大的职业抉择时，他表现出了少有的犹豫。
pinyin: Dāng miànduì zhòngdà de zhíyè juézé shí, tā biǎoxiàn chū le shǎoyǒu de yóuyù.
en: When facing a major career choice, he showed rare hesitation.

zh: 除夕夜，此起彼伏的爆竹声增添了浓厚的节日气氛。
pinyin: chú xī yè, cǐ qǐ bǐ fú de bào zhú shēng zēng tiān le nóng hòu de jié rì qì fēn.
en: On New Year's Eve, the continuous sound of firecrackers added to the strong festive atmosphere.

zh: 虽然他遭受了众人的耻笑，却依然坚持自己的理想。
pinyin: suī rán tā zāo shòu le zhòng rén de chǐ xiào, què yī rán jiān chí zì jǐ de lǐ xiǎng.
en: Although he suffered sneers from everyone, he still stuck to his ideals.

zh: 在处理交通事故时，确认车主的合法身份至关重要。
pinyin: Zài chǔlǐ jiāotōng shìgù shí, quèrèn chēzhǔ de héfǎ shēnfèn zhìguān zhòngyào.
en: When dealing with traffic accidents, confirming the legal identity of the vehicle owner is of vital importance.

zh: 月饼不仅象征着团圆，还承载了深厚的传统文化底蕴。
pinyin: Yuèbǐng bùjǐn xiàngzhēngzhe tuányuán, hái chéngzàile shēnhòu de chuántǒng wénhuà dǐyùn.
en: Mooncakes not only symbolize reunion but also carry a profound cultural heritage.

zh: 通过社交媒体，他与远方的亲朋好友保持着紧密联系。
pinyin: Tōngguò shèjiāo méitǐ, tā yǔ yuǎnfāng de qīnpéng hǎoyǒu bǎochí zhe jǐnmì liánxì.
en: Through social media, he maintains close contact with distant friends and family.

zh: 他们公司正在酝酿一项旨在拓展海外市场的战略计划。
pinyin: Tāmen gōngsī zhèngzài yùnniàng yī xiàng zhǐzài tuòzhǎn hǎiwài shìchǎng de zhànlüè jìhuà.
en: Their company is brewing a strategic plan aimed at expanding into overseas markets.

zh: 面对突如其来的灾难，我们必须保持冷静并团结一致。
pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de zāinàn, wǒmen bìxū bǎochí lěngjìng bìng tuánjié yīzhì.
en: Facing sudden disasters, we must remain calm and stay united.

zh: 他在艺术领域钻研多年，在圈内看来确实很有两下子。
pinyin: Tā zài yìshù lǐngyù zuānyán duō nián, zài quānnèi kàn lái quèshí hěn yǒu liǎng xià zi.
en: He has studied in the field of art for many years, and it is clear he knows his stuff within the circle.

zh: 虽然已经过去了很多年，但我依然忘不了家乡的味道。
pinyin: Suīrán yǐjīng guòqùle hěnduō nián, dàn wǒ yīrán wàng bu liǎo jiāxiāng de wèidào.
en: Although many years have passed, I still cannot forget the taste of my hometown.

zh: 这家果园采用科学的栽培技术，产出的水果口感极佳。
pinyin: Zhè jiā guǒyuán cǎiyòng kēxué de zāipéi jìshù, chǎnchū de shuǐguǒ kǒugǎn jíjiā.
en: This orchard adopts scientific cultivation techniques, and the fruit it produces has an excellent taste.

zh: 面对媒体的追问，当事人选择保持沉默，称无可奉告。
pinyin: Miàn duì méitǐ de zhuīwèn, dāngshìrén xuǎnzé bǎochí chénmò, chēng wú kě fèng gào.
en: Facing the media's persistent questioning, the person involved chose to remain silent, stating they had no comment.

zh: 在人潮汹涌的车站，乘客务必提防混入其中的小偷儿。
pinyin: zài rén cháo xiōng yǒng de chē zhàn, chéng kè wù bì tí fáng hùn rù qí zhōng de xiǎo tōu r.
en: At the crowded station, passengers must be on guard against thieves who mix in with the crowd.

zh: 由于原材料价格上涨，我们不得不重新调整生产预算。
pinyin: Yóuyú yuáncáiliào jiàgé shàngzhǎng, wǒmen bùdébù chóngxīn tiáozhěng shēngchǎn yùsuàn.
en: Due to the rise in raw material prices, we have to readjust the production budget.

zh: 作为儒家经典，《大学》强调了由内而外的道德修养。
pinyin: Zuòwéi Rújiā jīngdiǎn, "Dà Xué" qiángdiàole yóunèi'érwài de dàodé xiūyǎng.
en: As a Confucian classic, the "Great Learning" emphasizes moral cultivation from within to without.

zh: 通过这份报告，我们可以大致推断出市场的发展趋势。
pinyin: Tōngguò zhè fèn bàogào, wǒmen kěyǐ dàzhì tuīduàn chū shìchǎngshìchǎng de fāzhǎn qūshì.
en: Through this report, we can more or less infer the development trend of the market.

zh: 在缺乏法律依据的情况下，他不便直接介入这场纠纷。
pinyin: Zài quēfá fǎlǜ yījù de qíngkuàng xià, tā búbiàn zhíjiē jièrù zhè chǎng jiūfēn.
en: In the absence of legal basis, it is inconvenient for him to intervene directly in this dispute.

zh: 尽管归代表的建议非常独特，但尚未得到最终的批准。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn Guī dàibiǎo de jiànyì fēicháng dútè, dàn shàngwèi dédào zuìzhōng de pīzhǔn.
en: Although Representative Gui's proposal is very unique, it has not yet received final approval.

zh: 在极其恶劣的天气下，船长依然坚持航行以履行职责。
pinyin: Zài jíqí èliè de tiānqì xià, chuánzhǎng yīrán jiānchí hángxíng yǐ lǚxíng zhízé.
en: In extremely harsh weather, the skipper persisted in sailing to fulfill his duties.

zh: 街道两旁挂满了各式各样的灯笼，充满了节日的气氛。
pinyin: Jiēdào liǎngpáng guàmǎnle gèshìgèyàng de dēnglóng, chōngmǎnle jiérì de qìfēn.
en: Both sides of the street were covered with various lanterns, full of festive atmosphere.

zh: 面对突发状况，他迅速总结了自己的感想并做出决策。
pinyin: Miànduì túfā zhuàngkuàng, tā xùnsù zǒngjié le zìjǐ de gǎnxiǎng bìng zuò chū juécè.
en: Facing the emergency, he quickly summarized his thoughts and made a decision.

zh: 即使面对众人的质疑，他依然顽固地坚持自己的立场。
pinyin: Jíshǐ miànduì zhòngrén de zhìyí, tā yīrán wángù de jiānchí zìjǐ de lìchǎng.
en: Even when faced with public skepticism, he stubbornly stuck to his position.

zh: 尽管市场行情时好时坏，他依然坚持自己的投资策略。
pinyin: jǐnguǎn shìchǎng hángqíng shí hǎo shí huài, tā yīrán jiānchí zìjǐ de tóuzī cèlüè.
en: Although the market situation fluctuates, he still sticks to his investment strategy.

zh: 他那种乐观向上的精神深深地感染了周围的每一个人。
pinyin: Tā nà zhǒng lèguān xiàngshàng de jīngshén shēnshēn de gǎnrǎn le zhōuwéi de měi yī gè rén.
en: His optimistic and upward-looking spirit deeply infected everyone around him.

zh: 由于情报准确，敌后特工在这次任务中再次轻易得手。
pinyin: Yóuyú qíngbào zhǔnquè, díhòu tègōng zài zhè cì rènwù zhōng zàicì qīngyì déshǒu.
en: Due to accurate intelligence, the agent behind enemy lines succeeded easily in this mission again.

zh: 尽管工作繁忙，他依然坚持每天享用营养丰富的早餐。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gōngzuò fánmáng, tā yīrán jiānchí měitiān xiǎngyòng yíngyǎng fēngfù de zǎocān.
en: Despite being busy with work, he still insists on enjoying a nutritious breakfast every day.

zh: 法官认为被告的辩护理由合情合理，因此减轻了处罚。
pinyin: Fǎguān rènwéi bèigào de biànhù lǐyóu héqínghélǐ, yīncǐ jiǎnqīng le chǔfá.
en: The judge considered the defendant's defense reasonable, and therefore reduced the punishment.

zh: 通过技术创新，公司有效地控制了生产过程中的能耗。
pinyin: Tōngguò jìshù chuàngxīn, gōngsī yǒuxiào de kòngzhì le shēngchǎn guòchéng zhōng de nénghào.
en: Through technological innovation, the company has effectively controlled energy consumption during the production process.

zh: 由于原材料成本上涨，该方案的定价不得不做出调整。
pinyin: Yóuyú yuáncáiliào chéngběn shàngzhǎng, gāi fāng'àn de dìngjià bùdébù zuòchū tiáozhěng.
en: Due to the rising cost of raw materials, the pricing for this plan had to be adjusted.

zh: 如果想要从事这项职业，你需要考取相应的专业执照。
pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng yào cóngshì zhè xiàng zhíyè, nǐ xūyào kǎoqǔ xiāngyìng de zhuānyè zhízhào.
en: If you want to engage in this profession, you need to obtain the corresponding professional license.

zh: 经过多年的筹备，他终于创办了一份属于自己的报纸。
pinyin: Jīngguò duōnián de chóubèi, tā zhōngyú chuàngbànle yī fèn shǔyú zìjǐ de bàozhǐ.
en: After years of preparation, he finally established a newspaper of his own.

zh: 既然你无法在两边之间做出选择，不如暂时搁置争议。
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ wúfǎ zài liǎng biān zhī jiān zuò chū xuǎnzé, bùrú zànshí gēzhì zhēngyì.
en: Since you cannot make a choice between the two sides, it is better to temporarily shelve the dispute.

zh: 由于严重的经济危机，这家公司再也无法维持运营了。
pinyin: Yóuyú yánzhòng de jīngjì wēijī, zhè jiā gōngsī zài yě wúfǎ wéichí yùnyíng le.
en: Due to a severe economic crisis, this company can no longer maintain operations ever again.

zh: 随着经济的发展，这种新式建筑在城市中越来越常见。
pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì de fāzhǎn, zhè zhǒng xīnshì jiànzhù zài chéngshì zhōng yuè lái yuè chángjiàn.
en: With economic development, this kind of new-style architecture is becoming increasingly common in the city.

zh: 太极作为一种运动，不仅能强身健体，还能调节心态。
pinyin: Tàijí zuòwéi yī zhǒng yùndòng, bùjǐn néng qiángshēn jiàntǐ, hái néng tiáojié xīntài.
en: As a type of exercise, Taiji can not only strengthen the body but also regulate one's mindset.

zh: 在激烈的市场竞争中，被淘汰的企业往往被视为输家。
pinyin: Zài jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng, bèi táotài de qǐyè wǎngwǎng bèi shìwéi shūjiā.
en: In fierce market competition, enterprises that are eliminated are often regarded as losers.

zh: 这个方案看似完美，但在执行过程中难免会遇到挑战。
pinyin: Zhè ge fāng'àn kàn sì wánměi, dàn zài zhíxíng guòchéng zhōng nánmiǎn huì yùdào tiǎozhàn.
en: This proposal looks as if it is perfect, but it is hard to avoid challenges during the implementation process.

zh: 经过多位专家的全力抢救，病人的伤势终于趋于稳定。
pinyin: Jīngguò duō wèi zhuānjiā de quánlì qiǎngjiù, bìngrén de shāngshì zhōngyú qūyú wěndìng.
en: After the all-out rescue efforts of several experts, the patient's injury condition has finally stabilized.

zh: 为了保证环境卫生，进入手术室必须换上专门的衣服。
pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng huánjìng wèishēng, jìnrù shǒushùshì bìxū huànshàng zhuānmén de yīfu.
en: In order to ensure environmental hygiene, one must change into special clothes before entering the operating room.

zh: 这次经济改革的力度空前，旨在全面提升国家竞争力。
pinyin: zhè cì jīngjì gǎigé de lìdù kōngqián, zhǐzài quánmiàn tíshēng guójiā jìngzhēnglì.
en: The intensity of this economic reform is unprecedented, aiming to comprehensively enhance national competitiveness.

zh: 每逢重大节日，国家机关都会在醒目的位置悬挂国徽。
pinyin: Měiféng zhòngdà jiérì, guójiā jīguān dūhuì zài xǐngmù de wèizhì xuánguà guóhuī.
en: On every major holiday, state organs hang the national emblem in a prominent position.

zh: 面对困难保持冷静，应该成为我们生活中的一种常态。
pinyin: Miànduì kùnnán bǎochí lěngjìng, yīnggāi chéngwéi wǒmen shēnghuó zhōng de yī zhǒng chángtài.
en: Staying calm in the face of difficulties should become a normal state in our lives.

zh: 对于这次失误，他表现得十分坦率，承认了全部责任。
pinyin: Duìyú zhè cì shīwù, tā biǎoxiàn dé shífēn tǎnshuài, chéngrènle quánbù zérèn.
en: Regarding this mistake, he acted very frankly and admitted full responsibility.

zh: 由于经营不善，这家曾经辉煌的企业最终陷入了困境。
pinyin: Yóuyú jīngyíng bùshàn, zhè jiā céngjīng huīhuáng de qǐyè zuìzhōng xiànrùle kùnjìng.
en: Due to poor management, this once glorious enterprise eventually fell into a predicament.

zh: 这片土地拥有丰富多彩的自然景观和独特的民族风情。
pinyin: Zhè piàn tǔdì yōngyǒu fēngfùduōcǎi de zìrán jǐngguān hé dútè de mínzú fēngqíng.
en: This land possesses rich and colorful natural landscapes and unique ethnic customs.

zh: 随着经济的发展，人民的生活基本上达到了小康水平。
pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì de fāzhǎn, rénmín de shēnghuó jīběnshàng dádào le xiǎokāng shuǐpíng.
en: With the development of the economy, the people's lives are on the whole at a moderately prosperous level.

zh: 这对夫妇在经历了一系列矛盾后，不得不以离婚告终。
pinyin: zhè duì fūfù zài jīnglì le yīxìliè máodùn hòu, bùdébù yǐ líhūn gàozhōng.
en: After experiencing a series of conflicts, the couple had no choice but to end up in divorce.

zh: 地理位置不仅影响当地的气候，还制约着农业的发展。
pinyin: Dìlǐ wèizhì bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng dāngdì de qìhòu, hái zhìyuēzhe nóngyè de fāzhǎn.
en: Geographical location not only influences the local climate but also restricts the development of agriculture.

zh: 那个年轻人不顾父母的反对，毅然决定出去闯荡一番。
pinyin: Nàge niánqīngrén bùgù fùmǔ de fǎnduì, yìrán juédìng chūqù chuǎngdàng yīfān.
en: Ignoring his parents' objections, the young man resolutely decided to go out and make his own way in the world.

zh: 这家农场采用先进的农业技术，显著提高了生产效率。
pinyin: Zhè jiā nóng chǎng cǎi yòng xiān jìn de nóng yè jì shù, xiǎn zhù tí gāo le shēng chǎn xiào lǜ.
en: This farm adopts advanced agricultural technology, significantly improving production efficiency.

zh: 他在合同里加上了补充条款，免得日后发生法律纠纷。
pinyin: Tā zài hétóng lǐ jiāshàngle bǔchōng tiáokuǎn, miǎnde rìhòu fāshēng fǎlǜ jiūfēn.
en: He added supplementary clauses to the contract so as not to cause legal disputes in the future.

zh: 老实说，这一系列复杂的变故彻底改变了我的人生观。
pinyin: lǎo shí shuō, zhè yī xì liè fù zá de biàn gù chè dǐ gǎi biàn le wǒ de rén shēng guān.
en: Honestly speaking, this series of complicated changes completely changed my outlook on life.

zh: 茶道不仅是一种艺术，更是一种追求内心平静的方式。
pinyin: Chádào bùjǐn shì yī zhǒng yìshù, gèng shì yī zhǒng zhuīqiú nèixīn píngjìng de fāngshì.
en: Sado is not just an art, but a way to pursue inner peace.

zh: 经理考虑到他近期频繁出差，决定给予他一些额外补贴。
pinyin: jīnglǐ kǎolǜ dào tā jìnqī pínfán chūchāi, juédìng jǐyǔ tā yīxiē éwài bǔtiē.
en: Considering his frequent business trips recently, the manager decided to provide him with some extra allowances.

zh: 这些瓷器不仅具有实用价值，还体现了卓越的艺术审美。
pinyin: Zhèxiē cíqì bùjǐn jùyǒu shíyòng jiàzhí, hái tǐxiàn le zhuóyuè de yìshù shěnměi.
en: These porcelain items not only have practical value but also embody excellent artistic aesthetics.

zh: 他仔细研究了那份古老的药方，希望能找到治病的良策。
pinyin: Tā zǐ xì yán jiū le nà fèn gǔ lǎo de yào fāng, xī wàng néng zhǎo néng zhǎo néng zhǎo néng zhǎo néng zhǎo néng zhǎo dào zhì bìng de liáng cè.
en: He carefully studied the ancient prescription, hoping to find an effective way to treat the disease.

zh: 为了改善睡眠质量，她特意挑选了一个高度适中的枕头。
pinyin: Wèile gǎishàn shuìmián zhìliàng, tā tèyì tiāoxuǎnle yīgè gāodù shìzhōng de zhěntou.
en: To improve her sleep quality, she specifically chose a pillow with a moderate height.

zh: 任何辉煌的成就，背后都凝聚着无数人默默付出的汗水。
pinyin: Rènhé huīhuáng de chéngjiù, bèihòu dōu níngjùzhe wúshù rén mòmò fùchū de hànshuǐ.
en: Behind every glorious achievement lies the sweat silently paid by countless people.

zh: 面对困难，他凭借着倔强的意志，最终克服了所有挑战。
pinyin: Miànduì kùnnán, tā píngjiè zhe juéjiàng de yìzhì, zuìzhōng kèfú le suǒyǒu tiǎozhàn.
en: Facing difficulties, he relied on his stubborn will to finally overcome all challenges.

zh: 他原本想推辞这项艰巨的任务，但最终还是接受了挑战。
pinyin: Tā yuánběn xiǎng tuīcí zhè xiàng jiānjù de rènwù, dàn zuìzhōng háishì jiēshòu le tiǎozhàn.
en: He originally wanted to decline this arduous task, but ultimately accepted the challenge.

zh: 纵然时代变迁，那些珍贵的传统文化依然值得我们传承。
pinyin: zòng rán shí dài biàn qiān, nà xiē zhēn guì de chuán tǒng wén huà yī rán zhí dé wǒ men chuán chéng.
en: Even if times change, those precious traditional cultures are still worth passing down.

zh: 在这个充满竞争的时代，我们更应注重个人品德的修养。
pinyin: Zài zhège chōngmǎn jìngzhēng de shídài, wǒmen gèng yīng zhùng zhù zhùzhòng gèrén pǐndé de xiūyǎng.
en: In this competitive era, we should pay more attention to the cultivation of personal moral character.

zh: 尽管大家都称赞这个提议，但实际上并没有人愿意执行。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn dà jiā dōu chēng zàn zhè gè tí yì, dàn shí jì shàng bìng méi yǒu rén yuàn yì zhí xíng.
en: Although everyone praises the proposal, in fact, no one is willing to execute it.

zh: 这部纪录片讲述了几个土生土长的村民守护家乡的故事。
pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn jiǎngshùle jǐ gè tǔshēngtǔzhǎng de cūnmín shǒuhù jiāxiāng de gùshì.
en: This documentary tells the story of several villagers, born and raised in the area, who protect their hometown.

zh: 他编写的这部专业字典，在学术界具有很高的参考价值。
pinyin: Tā biānxiě de zhè bù zhuānyè zìdiǎn, zài xuéshùjiè jùyǒu hěn gāo de cānkǎo jiàzhí.
en: The professional dictionary he compiled has high reference value in the academic circle.

zh: 他不仅是一位优秀的作家，还是极具天赋的艺术评论家。
pinyin: Tā bùjǐn shì yī wèi yōuxiù de zuòjiā, hái shì jí jù tiānfù de yìshù pínglùnjiā.
en: He is not only an excellent writer, but also a very talented art critic.

zh: 无论处境如何艰苦，他总是坚持不懈地追求自己的理想。
pinyin: Wúlùn chǔjìng rúhé jiānkǔ, tā zǒngshì jiānchíbùxiè de zhuīqiú zìjǐ de lǐxiǎng.
en: No matter how difficult the circumstances are, he always pursues his ideals unremittingly.

zh: 这位导演要求演员在镜头前精确地控制自己的一举一动。
pinyin: Zhè wèi dǎoyǎn yāoqiú yǎnyuán zài jìngtóu qián jīngquè de kòngzhì zìjǐ de yī jǔ yī dòng.
en: This director requires actors to precisely control their every movement in front of the camera.

zh: 在恶劣的自然环境下，水源成了当地居民唯一的生命线。
pinyin: zài è liè de zì rán huán jìng xià, shuǐ yuán chéng le dāng dì jū mín wéi yī de shēng mìng xiàn.
en: In the harsh natural environment, the water source became the only lifeline for local residents.

zh: 宇航员坐在狭小的返回舱胶囊中，准备重返地球大气层。
pinyin: Yǔhángyuán zuò zài xiáxiǎo de fǎnhuícāng jiāonáng zhōng, zhǔnbèi chóngfǎn dìqiú dàqìcéng.
en: The astronaut sat in the cramped return capsule, preparing to re-enter the Earth's atmosphere.

zh: 那段艰苦奋斗的岁月，至今仍铭刻在心，我永远都记得。
pinyin: Nà duàn jiānkǔ fèndòu de suìyuè, zhìjīn réng míngkè zài xīn, wǒ yǒngyuǎn dōu jìde.
en: That period of struggling hard is still engraved in my heart, and I will remember it forever.

zh: 由于经营不善，这家拥有百年历史的报社最终宣布倒闭。
pinyin: yóu yú jīng yíng bù shàn, zhè jiā yōng yǒu bǎi nián lì shǐ de bào shè zuì zhōng xuān bù dǎo bì.
en: Due to poor management, this century-old newspaper office finally announced its closure.

zh: 经过深思熟虑，他认为这份工作非常适合他的性格特点。
pinyin: Jīngguò shēnsī-shúlǜ, tā rènwéi zhè fèn gōngzuò fēicháng shìhé tā de xìnggé tèdiǎn.
en: After careful consideration, he believes this job is very suitable for his personality traits.

zh: 由于电视机的普及，人们获取信息的渠道更加多元化了。
pinyin: Yóuyú diànshìjī de pǔjí, rénmen huòqǔ xìnxī de qúdào gèngjiā duōyuánhuà le.
en: Due to the popularization of television sets, people's channels for obtaining information have become more diversified.

zh: 直到揭开谜底的那一刻，他才对这件离奇案件恍然大悟。
pinyin: Zhídào jiēkāi mídǐ de nà yīkè, tā cái duì zhè jiàn líqí ànjiàn huǎngrán-dàwù.
en: Not until the moment the secret was revealed did he suddenly realize the truth about this bizarre case.

zh: 无论社会如何变迁，我们都不应该丧失诚实的优良品德。
pinyin: Wúlùn shèhuì rúhé biànqiān, wǒmen dōu bù yīnggāi sàngshī chéngshí de yōuliáng pǐndé.
en: No matter how society changes, we should not lose the fine moral quality of honesty.

zh: 随着大数据技术的发展，各行各业都发生了巨大的变化。
pinyin: Suízhe dàshùjù jìshù de fāzhǎn, gè háng gè yè dōu fāshēngle jùdà de biànhuà.
en: With the development of big data technology, all walks of life have undergone tremendous changes.

zh: 由于准备不足，他在讲台上显得十分尴尬，当众出丑了。
pinyin: Yóuyú zhǔnbèi bùzú, tā zài jiǎngtái shàng xiǎnde shífēn gāngà, dāngzhòng chūchǒu le.
en: Due to insufficient preparation, he appeared very awkward on the podium and made a fool of himself in public.

zh: 他在公益事业方面表现得非常热心，赢得了大家的尊重。
pinyin: Tā zài gōngyì shìyè fāngmiàn biǎoxiàn dé fēicháng rèxīn, yíngdéle dàjiā de zūnzhòng.
en: He is very enthusiastic about public welfare and has won everyone's respect.

zh: 医生正在详细分析肿瘤的性质，以决定后续的治疗方案。
pinyin: Yīshēng zhèngzài xiángxì fēnxī zhǒngliú de xìngzhì, yǐ juédìng hòuxù de zhìliáo fāng'àn.
en: The doctor is carefully analyzing the nature of the tumor to determine the follow-up treatment plan.

zh: 社会学家们在深入探讨阶级分化对经济公平的长期影响。
pinyin: Shèhuìxuéjiāmen zài shēnrù tàntǎo jiējí fēnhuà duì jīngjì gōngpíng de chángqī yǐngxiǎng.
en: Sociologists are deeply exploring the long-term effects of class polarization on economic equity.

zh: 载人航天工程的成功体现了我国航天技术的跨越式发展。
pinyin: zài rén háng tiān gōng chéng de chéng gōng tǐ xiàn le wǒ guó háng tiān jì shù de kuà yuè shì fā zhǎn.
en: The success of the manned space flight project embodies the leapfrog development of our country's space technology.

zh: 在这寒冷的月份，他毅然决然地投入了这项艰巨的任务。
pinyin: Zài zhè hánlěng de yuèfèn, tā yìránjuérán de tóurù le zhè xiàng jiānjù de rènwù.
en: In this cold month, he resolutely threw himself into this arduous task.

zh: 这个乐队凭借那张新专辑在国际舞台上获得了巨大成功。
pinyin: Zhège yuèduì píngjiè nà zhāng xīn zhuānjí zài guójì wǔtái shàng huòdé le jùdà chénggōng.
en: This pop group achieved great success on the international stage thanks to that new album.

zh: 虽然这种面条儿的制作工艺比较复杂，但味道非常地道。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè zhǒng miàntiáoer de zhìzuò gōngyì bǐjiào fùzá, dàn wèidào fēicháng dìdào.
en: Although the production process for this type of noodle is quite complex, the taste is very authentic.

zh: 我们不应恐惧失败，而应勇于尝试，从挫折中吸取经验。
pinyin: Wǒmen bùyīng kǒngjù shībài, ér yīng yǒngyú chángshì, cóng cuòzhé zhōng xīqǔ jīngyàn.
en: We should not fear failure, but should be brave enough to try and learn from setbacks.

zh: 他在拍卖会上偶然发现了一枚做工极其精湛的古董戒指。
pinyin: Tā zài pāimàihuì shàng ǒurán fāxiàn le yī méi zuògōng jíqí jīngzhàn de gǔdǒng jièzhi.
en: He accidentally discovered an exquisitely crafted antique ring at the auction.

zh: 每当提到传统的风味小吃，我总会想到各式各样的卤味。
pinyin: Měidāng tídào chuántǒng de fēngwèi xiǎochī, wǒ zǒng huì xiǎngdào gèshìgèyàng de lǔwèi.
en: Whenever traditional snacks are mentioned, I always think of all kinds of braised food.

zh: 他通过鉴别这些古籍的字迹，推断出了作者的真实身份。
pinyin: Tā tōngguò jiànbié zhèxiē gǔjí de zìjì, tuīduàn chū le zuòzhě de zhēnshí shēnfèn.
en: By identifying the handwriting in these ancient books, he deduced the true identity of the author.

zh: 通过整合现有的数据库，我们能更高效地分析市场趋势。
pinyin: Tōngguò zhěnghé xiànyǒu de shùjùkù, wǒmen néng gèng gāoxiào de fēnxī shìchǎng qūshì.
en: By integrating existing databases, we can analyze market trends more efficiently.

zh: 在该庄严的典礼上，大家一致表达了对英雄的崇高敬意。
pinyin: Zài gāi zhuāngyán de diǎnlǐ shàng, dàjiā yīzhì biǎodá le duì yīngxióng de chónggāo jìngyì.
en: At the solemn ceremony, everyone unanimously expressed their high respect for the heroes.

zh: 作为一种珍贵的文化遗产，民歌值得我们去挖掘和传承。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī zhǒng zhēnguì de wénhuà yíchǎn, míngē zhídé wǒmen qù wājué hé chuánchéng.
en: As a precious cultural heritage, folk songs deserve to be excavated and passed on.

zh: 董事会召开了一次会议，旨在研讨公司未来的发展战略。
pinyin: Dǒngshìhuì zhàokāile yīcì huìyì, zhǐ zài yántǎo gōngsī wèilái de fāzhǎn zhànlüè.
en: The board of directors held a meeting to discuss the company's future development strategy.

zh: 这部小说的人物关系错综复杂，反映了当时社会的矛盾。
pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎo shuō de rén wù guān xì cuò zōng fù zá, fǎn yìng le dāng shí shè huì de máo dùn.
en: The relationships between the characters in this novel are tangled and complicated, reflecting the social contradictions of that time.

zh: 在充满不确定性的经济环境下，投资者们整日提心吊胆。
pinyin: Zài chōngmǎn bù quèdìngxìng de jīngjì huánjìng xià, tóuzīzhěmen zhěngrì tí xīn diào dǎn.
en: In an economic environment full of uncertainty, investors are nervous all day long.

zh: 面对复杂的人性，作者在作品中留下了耐人寻味的伏笔。
pinyin: miànduì fùzá de rénxìng, zuòzhě zài zuòpǐn zhōng liúxià le nàirénxúnwèi de fúbǐ.
en: Facing complex human nature, the author left thought-provoking foreshadowing in the work.

zh: 尽管由于各种阻碍难以频繁见面，我们的友谊依然稳固。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yóuyú gèzhǒng zǔ'ài nányǐ pínfán jiànmiàn, wǒmen de yǒuyì yīrán wěngù.
en: Although it is difficult to meet frequently due to various obstacles, our friendship remains solid.

zh: 这本菜单设计得非常精美，详细介绍了各种食材的产地。
pinyin: Zhè běn càidān shèjì dé fēicháng jīngměi, xiángxì jièshào le gè zhǒng shícái de chǎndì.
en: This menu is exquisitely designed and provides detailed information about the origins of various ingredients.

zh: 为了庆祝新项目顺利完成，我们去了一家知名酒楼聚餐。
pinyin: Wèile qìngzhù xīn xiàngmù shùnlì wánchéng, wǒmen qùle yī jiā zhīmíng jiǔlóu jùcān.
en: To celebrate the successful completion of the new project, we went to a famous restaurant for a gathering.

zh: 由于他在科研领域的卓越贡献，获得这份荣誉当之无愧。
pinyin: Yóuyú tā zài kēyán lǐngyù de zhuóyuè gòngxiàn, huòdé zhè fèn róngyù dāngzhīwúkuì.
en: Due to his outstanding contributions in the field of scientific research, he is fully deserving of this honor.

zh: 为了保持海鲜的口感，物流过程中的保鲜措施至关重要。
pinyin: Wèile bǎochí hǎixiān de kǒugǎn, wùliú cāngchǔ wùliú guòchéng zhōng de bǎoxiān cuòshī zhìguān zhònguān zhòngyào.
en: To maintain the texture of seafood, fresh-keeping measures during the logistics process are crucial.

zh: 既然我们面临着如此严峻的挑战，就必须尽量团结一致。
pinyin: Jìrán wǒmen miànlínzhe rúcǐ yánjùn de tiǎozhàn, jiù bìxū jǐnliàng tuánjié yīzhì.
en: Since we are facing such severe challenges, we must stay as united as possible.

zh: 无论前方的道路多么艰险，我们都必须保持坚定的信念。
pinyin: wú lùn qián fāng de dào lù duō me jiān xiǎn, wǒ men dōu bì xū bǎo chí jiān dìng de xìn niàn.
en: No matter how many hardships and perils lie ahead on the path, we must maintain firm conviction.

zh: 这位老板凭借丰富的经验，成功地经营着一家大型企业。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎobǎn píngjiè fēngfù de jīngyàn, chénggōng de jīngyíng zhe yī jiā dàxíng qǐyè.
en: Relying on his rich experience, this boss successfully manages a large enterprise.

zh: 为了确保万无一失，我们必须对实验过程进行彻底复查。
pinyin: Wèile quèbǎo wànwúyīshī, wǒmen bìxū duì shíyàn guòchéng jìnxíng chèdǐ fùchá.
en: In order to ensure everything is foolproof, we must conduct a thorough re-examination of the experimental process.

zh: 这项艰巨的任务最终还是交给了经验丰富的团队来执行。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng jiānjù de rènwù zuìzhōng háishì jiāogěi le jīngyàn fēngfù de tuánduì lái zhíxíng.
en: This arduous task was eventually handed over to the experienced team for execution.

zh: 这项运动不仅能缓解颈部压力，还能增强身体的柔韧性。
pinyin: zhè xiàng yùndòng bùjǐn néng huǎnjiě jǐngbù yālì, hái néng zēngqiáng shēntǐ de róurènxìng.
en: This exercise not only relieves neck pressure but also enhances the body's flexibility.

zh: 他以独特的嗓音在舞台上深情地唱歌，打动了所有的观众。
pinyin: Tā yǐ dútè de sǎngyīn zài wǔtái shàng shēnqíng de chànggē, dǎdòngle suǒyǒu de guānzhòng.
en: He sang passionately on stage with a unique voice, moving all the audience.

zh: 无论遭遇多么严峻的挑战，只要心态积极，一切都没关系。
pinyin: Wúlùn zāoyù duōme yánjùn de tiǎozhàn, zhǐyào xīntài jījí, yīqiè dōu méi guānxi.
en: No matter how severe the challenges encountered, as long as one has a positive mindset, it doesn't matter.

zh: 虽然预报显示降水概率不高，但我们还是取消了户外活动。
pinyin: Suīrán yùbào xiǎnshì jiàngshuǐ gàilǜ bù gāo, dàn wǒmen háishì qǔxiāole hùwài huódòng.
en: Although the forecast showed a low probability of precipitation, we still canceled our outdoor activities.

zh: 潮湿的泥土散发出一种独特的气味，勾起了他童年的回忆。
pinyin: Cháoshī de nítǔ sànfā chū yī zhǒng dútè de qìwèi, gōuqǐle tā tóngnián de huíyì.
en: The damp soil emitted a unique odor, evoking memories of his childhood.

zh: 即便走过无数次这个地段，我依然会被这里的繁华所吸引。
pinyin: Jíbiàn zǒuguò wúshù cì zhège dìduàn, wǒ yīrán huì bèi zhèlǐ de fánhuá suǒ xīyǐn.
en: Even though I have passed by this area countless times, I am still attracted by its prosperity.

zh: 作为儒家经典，中庸对中国人的道德观念有着深远的影响。
pinyin: Zuòwéi Rújiā jīngdiǎn, zhōngyōng duì Zhōngguó rén de dàodé dàodé guānniàn yǒu zhe shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
en: As a Confucian classic, the Doctrine of the Mean has a profound influence on the moral concepts of the Chinese people.

zh: 通过观看那场棒球比赛，我对这项运动有了进一步的了解。
pinyin: Tōngguò guānkàn nà chǎng bàngqiú bǐsài, wǒ duì zhè xiàng yùndòng yǒule jìnyībù de liǎojiě.
en: By watching that baseball game, I gained a further understanding of this sport.

zh: 尽管执行任务的难度极大，他还是严格遵循了上级的吩咐。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhíxíng rènwù de nándù jídà, tā háishì yángé zūnxúnle shàngjí de fēnfù.
en: Although the difficulty of executing the mission was immense, he strictly followed the superior's instructions.

zh: 既然已经察觉到了潜在的风险，我们就必须时刻保持留心。
pinyin: Jìrán yǐjīng chájué dào le qiánzài de fēngxiǎn, wǒmen jiù bìxū shíkè bǎochí liúxīn.
en: Since we have already detected potential risks, we must remain vigilant at all times.

zh: 面对突发状况，他虽然表现得有些忙乱，但还是处理好了。
pinyin: Miànduì tūfā zhuàngkuàng, tā suīrán biǎoxiàn de yǒuxiē mángluàn, dàn háishì chǔlǐ hǎole.
en: Faced with an unexpected situation, although he appeared a bit rushed and muddled, he still handled it well.

zh: 这对夫妇决定推迟蜜月，以便能专心处理紧急的工作事务。
pinyin: zhè duì fūfù juédìng tuīchí mìyuè, yǐbiàn néng zhuānxīn chǔlǐ jǐnjí de gōngzuò shìwù.
en: The couple decided to postpone their honeymoon so they could focus on urgent work matters.

zh: 尽管这个外号听起来有些调侃的意味，但他本人并不介意。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhège wàihào tīng qǐlái yǒuxiē tiáokǎn de yìwèi, dàn tā běnrén bìng bù jièyì.
en: Although this nickname sounds a bit teasing, he himself does not mind.

zh: 他在奥运会上的辉煌成就让他获得了那枚至高无上的金牌。
pinyin: tā zài ào yùn huì shàng de huī huáng chéng jiù ràng tā huò dé le nà méi zhì gāo wú shàng de jīn pái.
en: His glorious achievements at the Olympic Games earned him that supreme gold medal.

zh: 鉴于市场需求的变化，我们不得不对现有的产品进行改版。
pinyin: Jiànyú shìchǎng xūqiú de biànhuà, wǒmen bùdébù duì xiànyǒu de chǎnpǐn jìnxíng gǎibǎn.
en: Given the changes in market demand, we have to revise the current products.

zh: 在这个复杂的人际环境中，他依然保持着那份耿直与纯粹。
pinyin: Zài zhège fùzá de rénjì huánjìng zhōng, tā yīrán bǎochízhe nà fèn gěngzhí yǔ chúncuì.
en: In this complicated interpersonal environment, he still maintains his honesty and purity.

zh: 在那次拍卖会上，那幅古老的油画最终以惊人的价格成交。
pinyin: Zài nà cì pāimàihuì shàng, nà fú gǔlǎo de yóuhuà zuìzhōng yǐ jīngrén de jiàgé chéngjiāo.
en: At that auction, the ancient oil painting was finally sold at an astonishing price.

zh: 那家公司推出的新产品外观独特，在市场上显得格外抢眼。
pinyin: nà jiā gōngsī tuīchū de xīn chǎnpǐn wàiguān dútè, zài shìchǎng shàng xiǎnde géwài qiǎngyǎn.
en: The new product launched by that company has a unique appearance, making it exceptionally eye-catching in the market.

zh: 尽管前路充满艰辛，我依然祝愿你能实现心中宏伟的抱负。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn qiánlù chōngmǎn jiānxīn, wǒ yīrán zhùyuàn nǐ néng shíxiàn xīnzhōng hóngwěi de bàofù.
en: Although the road ahead is full of hardships, I still wish that you can realize your grand ambitions.

zh: 这一系列的雕塑作品，深刻地展现了历史变迁的真实写照。
pinyin: Zhè yī xìliè de diāosù zuòpǐn, shēnkè de zhǎnxiànle lìshǐ biànqiān de zhēnshí xiězhào.
en: This series of sculptures profoundly presents a true portrayal of historical changes.

zh: 成功往往取决于能否在激烈的竞争中脱颖而出，赢得机会。
pinyin: Chénggōng wǎngwǎng qǔjué yú néngfǒu zài jīliè de jìngzhēng zhōng tuōyǐng'érchū, yíngdé jīhuì.
en: Success often depends on whether one can stand out in intense competition and win a chance.

zh: 两家公司为了应对市场挑战，不约而同地选择了转型之路。
pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī wèile yìngduì shìchǎng tiǎozhàn, bùyuē'értóng de xuǎnzé le zhuǎnxíng zhī lù.
en: To deal with market challenges, both companies chose the path of transformation without prior consultation.

zh: 那位幸运儿在这次公益彩票中奖后，决定捐出一部分奖金。
pinyin: Nà wèi xìngyùn'ér zài zhè cì gōngyì cǎipiào zhòngjiǎng hòu, juédìng juānchū yībùfèn jiǎngjīn.
en: After winning a prize in the charity lottery, that lucky person decided to donate a portion of the prize money.

zh: 为了避免在众目睽睽之下出洋相，他提前做了充分的准备。
pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn zài zhòngmùkuíkuí zhī xià chū yáng xiàng, tā tíqián zuòle chōngfèn de zhǔ de zhǔ de zhǔnbèi.
en: In order to avoid making a fool of himself in public, he made sufficient preparations in advance.

zh: 他在学术界的权威地位未必能保证他的结论是绝对客观的。
pinyin: Tā zài xuéshùjiè de quánwēi dìwèi wèibì néng bǎozhèng tā de jiélùn shì juéduì kèguān de.
en: His authoritative status in academia might not guarantee that his conclusions are absolutely objective.

zh: 由于项目进度滞后，团队正在全力以赴地弥补之前的损失。
pinyin: Yóuyú xiàngmù jìndù zhìhòu, tuánduì zhèngzài quánlìyǐfù de míbǔbǔ zhīqián de sǔnshī.
en: Due to the project schedule lagging behind, the team is doing everything possible to make up for previous losses.

zh: 这对夫妇在漫长的岁月中彼此扶持，共同度过了许多难关。
pinyin: Zhè duì fūfù zài màncháng de suìyuè zhōng bǐcǐ fúchí, gòngtóng dùguòle xǔduō nánguān.
en: The couple supported each other through the long years and overcame many difficulties together.

zh: 在极其焦急的情况下，他终于拨通了救援中心的紧急热线。
pinyin: Zài jíqí jiāojí de qíngkuàng xià, tā zhōngyú bō tōng le jiùyuán zhōngxīn de jǐnjí rèxiàn.
en: In an extremely anxious situation, he finally got through to the emergency hotline of the rescue center.

zh: 随着高等教育的普及，大学生毕业后的就业竞争日益激烈。
pinyin: Suízhe gāoděng jiàoyù de pǔjí, dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu de jiùyè jìngzhēng rìyì jīliè.
en: With the popularization of higher education, the employment competition for university graduates is becoming increasingly fierce.

zh: 他的魔术手法极其巧妙，令在场的所有人都感到不可思议。
pinyin: Tā de móshù shǒufǎ jíqí qiǎomiào, lìng zàichǎng de suǒyǒu rén dōu gǎndào bùkěsīyì.
en: His magic technique was extremely ingenious, making everyone present feel it was incredible.

zh: 当他在海边看到壮丽的日出时，他内心的压力瞬间消散了。
pinyin: Dāng tā zài hǎibiān kàn dào zhuànglì de rìchū shí, tā nèixīn de yālì shùnjiān xiāosàn le.
en: When he saw the magnificent sunrise at the beach, his inner pressure instantly dissipated.

zh: 面对这种不公平的现象，我们绝不能袖手旁观，任其发展。
pinyin: Miànduì zhè zhǒng bù gōngpíng de xiànxiàng, wǒmen jué bùnéng xiù shǒu páng guān, rèn qí fāzhǎn fāzhǎn.
en: Faced with this kind of unfair phenomenon, we must absolutely not stand idly by and let it develop.

zh: 由于长期缺乏社交，他已经很难感受到那种简单的快活了。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī quēfá shèjiāo, tā yǐjīng hěn nán gǎnshòu dào nà zhǒng jiǎndān de kuàihuo le.
en: Due to a long-term lack of social interaction, it is already hard for him to feel that simple kind of happiness.

zh: 这栋住宅楼没有电梯，住户们每天不得不辛苦地步行上楼。
pinyin: Zhè dòng zhùzháilóu méiyǒu diàntī, zhùhùmen měitiān bùdébù xīnkǔ de bùxíng shànglóu.
en: This residential building has no elevator, and the residents have to walk upstairs laboriously every day.

zh: 上次访问不仅促进了双方的互信，还深化了经济领域的合作。
pinyin: Shàng cì fǎngwèn bùjǐn cùjìnle shuāngfāng de hùxìn, hái shēnhuàle jīngjì lǐngyù de hézuò.
en: The last visit not only promoted mutual trust between the two sides but also deepened cooperation in the economic field.

zh: 因为我的疏忽给公司造成了损失，我内心感到十分过意不去。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ de shūhu gěi gōngsī zàochéng le sǔnshī, wǒ nèixīn gǎndào shífēn guòyìbùqù.
en: Because my negligence caused losses to the company, I feel deeply apologetic in my heart.

zh: 由于极度的恐惧，他的牙齿在不断地打架，全身不停地哆嗦。
pinyin: Yóuyú jídù de kǒngjù, tā de yáchǐ zài bùduàn de dǎjià, quánshēn bùtíng de duōsuo.
en: Due to extreme fear, his teeth were chattering, and he was trembling all over.

zh: 他工作非常繁忙，但还是抽空去看望了那位受人尊敬的教授。
pinyin: tā gōng zuò fēi cháng fán máng, dàn hái shì chōu kòng qù kàn wàng le nà wèi shòu rén zūn jìng de jiào shòu.
en: He is very busy with work, but he still made time to visit that respected professor.

zh: 国画不仅是中国文化的象征，也是一种独特的艺术表现形式。
pinyin: Guóhuà bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó wénhuà de xiàngzhēng, yěshì yī zhǒng dútè de yìshù biǎoxiàn xíngshì.
en: Traditional Chinese painting is not only a symbol of Chinese culture, but also a unique form of artistic expression.

zh: 作为一名礼貌的访客，去朋友家作客时带点礼物是很合适的。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng lǐmào de fǎngkè, qù péngyǒu jiā zuòkè shí dài diǎn lǐwù shì hěn héshì de.
en: As a polite visitor, it is very appropriate to bring a gift when visiting a friend's house.

zh: 在这寒冷的季节里，这场瑞雪无疑给干旱的土地带来了希望。
pinyin: Zài zhè hánlěng de jìjié lǐ, zhè chǎng ruìxuě wúyí gěi gānhàn de tǔdì dàilái le xīwàng.
en: In this cold season, this timely snow undoubtedly brought hope to the drought-stricken land.

zh: 他敏锐地察觉到了妻子的疲惫，表现出了难得的体贴与包容。
pinyin: Tā mǐnruì de chájué dào le qīzi de píbèi, biǎoxiàn chū le nándé de tǐtiē yǔ bāoróng.
en: He keenly sensed his wife's exhaustion and showed a rare level of consideration and tolerance.

zh: 为了选拔优秀的公务员，国家采取了一系列严格的考核措施。
pinyin: Wèile xuǎnbá yōuxiù de gōngwùyuán, guójiā cǎiqǔle yī xìliè yángé de kǎohé cuòshī.
en: In order to select outstanding civil servants, the state has adopted a series of strict assessment measures.

zh: 随着城市化的进程，大街小巷的面貌发生了翻天覆地的变化。
pinyin: suí zhe chéng shì huà de jìn chéng, dà jiē xiǎo xiàng de miàn mào fā shēng le fān tiān fù dì de biàn huà.
en: With the process of urbanization, the appearance of the big streets and small alleys has undergone earth-shaking changes.

zh: 这栋建筑极其复杂，即使有向导带领，我也很难独自走上去。
pinyin: Zhè dòng jiànzhù jíqí fùzá, jíshǐ yǒu xiàngdǎo dàilǐng, wǒ yě hěn nán dúzì zǒu shàng qù.

zh: 该政策旨在促进西部欠发达地区的经济转型。

en: Facing such a dangerous environment, you absolutely must not let your guard down.

pinyin: Gōng pú yīngdāng liánjié fènggōng, quánxīnquányì wèi qúnzhòng jiějué kùnnán.
en: Public servants should be honest and official-minded, and wholeheartedly solve difficulties for the masses.

zh: 为了确保外交礼仪，大使由专人陪同出席晚宴。
pinyin: Wèile quèbǎo wàijiāo lǐyí, dàshǐ yóu zhuānrén péitóng chūxí wǎnyàn.
en: To ensure diplomatic protocol, the ambassador was accompanied by a designated person to attend the banquet.

zh: 竹子在东方文化中常被视为气节与谦逊的象征。
pinyin: Zhúzi zài dōngfāng wénhuà zhōng cháng bèi shìwéi qìjié yǔ qiānxùn de xiàngzhēng.
en: Bamboo is often regarded as a symbol of integrity and humility in Eastern culture.

zh: 长期的人才短缺已成为制约该行业发展的瓶颈。
pinyin: Chángqī de réncái duǎnquē yǐ chéngwéi zhìyuē gāi hángyè fāzhǎn de píngjǐng.
en: The long-term shortage of talent has become a bottleneck restricting the development of this industry.

zh: 尽管表演的技巧华丽，但这并不足以打动观众。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn biǎoyǎn de jìqiǎo huáli, dàn zhè bìng bùzú yǐ dǎdòng guānzhòng.
en: Although the performance technique is gorgeous, it is not enough to move the audience.

zh: 随着无线通信的发展，人们联系变得更方便了。
pinyin: Suízhe wúxiàn tōngxìn de fāzhǎn, rénmen liánxì biàn dé gèng fāngbiànle.
en: With the development of wireless communication, it has become more convenient for people to keep in touch.

zh: 据统计，龙氏家族在该地区的影响力依然很大。
pinyin: Jù tǒngjì, Lóng shì jiāzú zài gāi dìqū de yǐngxiǎnglì yīrán hěn dà.
en: According to statistics, the Long family's influence in this region remains significant.

zh: 船员们必须严格遵守航海纪律，确保航程顺利。
pinyin: Chuányuánmen bìxū yángé zūnshǒu hánghǎi jìlǜ, quèbǎo hángchéng shùnlì.
en: The crew members must strictly observe maritime discipline to ensure a smooth voyage.

zh: 机构臃肿与官僚主义会导致行政成本大幅攀升。
pinyin: Jīgòu yōngzhǒng yǔ guānliáozhǔyì huì dǎozhì xíngzhèng chéngběn dàfú pānshēng.
en: Bloated institutions and bureaucracy can lead to a significant rise in administrative costs.

zh: 由于局势迅速恶化，部队被迫开枪以控制现场。
pinyin: yóuyú júshì xùnsù èhuà, bùduì bèi pò kāi qiāng yǐ kòngzhì xiànchǎng.
en: Due to the rapidly deteriorating situation, the troops were forced to open fire to control the scene.

zh: 我们要定期检查设备，以防因过度磨损而损坏。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào dìngqī jiǎnchá shèbèi, yǐ fáng yīn guòdù mósǔn ér sǔnhuài.
en: We must check the equipment regularly to prevent damage due to excessive wear.

zh: 政府通过优化公共设施建设来加强城市竞争力。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tōngguò yōuhuà gōnggòng shèshī jiànshè lái jiāqiáng chéngshì jìngzhēnglì.
en: The government is reinforcing urban competitiveness by optimizing the construction of public facilities.

zh: 该企业致力于为全球客户提供优质的教育资源。
pinyin: Gāi qǐyè zhìlì yú wèi quánqiú kèhù tígōng yōuzhì de jiàoyù zīyuán.
en: The enterprise is committed to providing high-quality educational resources to global clients.

zh: 寒冷的冬夜，烟囱里飘出的炊烟显得格外温馨。
pinyin: Hánlěng de dōngyè, yāncōng lǐ piāochū de chuīyān xiǎnde géwài wēnxīn.
en: On a cold winter night, the smoke drifting from the chimney felt exceptionally warm and cozy.

zh: 作为一名外交官，他被派往海外担任领事一职。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng wàijiāoguān, tā bèi pài wǎng hǎiwài dānrèn lǐngshì yī zhí.
en: As a diplomat, he was sent overseas to serve as a consul.

zh: 这对双胞胎虽然性格迥异，但感情却十分亲密。
pinyin: Zhè duì shuāngbāotāi suīrán xìnggé jiǒngyì, dàn gǎnqíng què shífēn qīnmì.
en: Although this pair of twins has very different personalities, they are very close.

zh: 这个春天阳光明媚，大地变得温暖而充满生机。
pinyin: Zhège chūntiān yángguāng míngmèi, dàdì biàn de wēnnuǎn ér chōngmǎn shēngjī.
en: The sun is bright this spring, and the earth has become warm and full of vitality.

zh: 扁董事长决定暂时搁置这项争议性的投资计划。
pinyin: Piān dǒngshìzhǎng juédìng zànshí gēzhì zhè xiàng zhēngyìxìng de tóuzī jìhuà.
en: Chairman Pian decided to temporarily shelve this controversial investment plan.

zh: 这种通过乞讨来获取不义之财的行为令人鄙视。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng tōngguò qǐtǎo lái huòqǔ búyì zhī cái de xíngwéi lìng rén bǐshì.
en: This behavior of begging to obtain ill-gotten gains is contemptible.

zh: 他不仅精通厨艺，还能制作出口感极佳的寿司。
pinyin: Tā bùjǐn jīngtōng chúyì, hái néng zhìzuò chū kǒugǎn jíjiā de shòusī.
en: He is not only proficient in culinary arts, but can also make sushi with an excellent texture.

zh: 在港澳台地区，人们通常使用繁体字进行交流。
pinyin: Zài Gǎng-Ào-Tái dìqū, rénmen tōngcháng shǐyòng fántǐzì jìnxíng jiāoliú.
en: In Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan, people usually use traditional Chinese characters to communicate.

zh: 这种先进的技术为用户带来了全新的感官体验。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiānjìn de jìshù wèi yònghù dài lái le quánxīn de gǎnguān tǐyàn.
en: This advanced technology brought a brand-new sensory experience to users.

zh: 我们必须建立完善的预警系统以防御重大灾害。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū jiànlì wánshàn de yùjǐng xìtǒng yǐ fángyù zhòngdà zāihài.
en: We must establish a comprehensive early warning system to defend against major disasters.

zh: 该补充条款对原先签署的协议具有法律约束力。
pinyin: Gāi bǔchōng tiáokuǎn duì yuánxiān qiān qiānshǔ de xiéyì jùyǒu fǎlǜ yuēshùlì.
en: This supplementary clause is legally binding on the original agreement signed.

zh: 遥望浩瀚的天上，无数星辰闪烁着微弱的光芒。
pinyin: Yáowàng hàohàn de tiānshàng, wúshù xīngchén shǎnshuòzhe wēiruò de guāngmáng.
en: Looking up at the vast sky, countless stars flicker with a faint light.

zh: 尽管时间流逝，他们之间的同窗感情依然如故。
pinyin: Jǐn guǎn shí jiān liú shì, tā men zhī jiān de tóng chuāng gǎn qíng yī rán rú gù.
en: Despite the passage of time, the affection between them as classmates remains unchanged.

zh: 该学堂致力于推动高等教育的学术交流与创新。
pinyin: Gāi xuétáng zhìlì yú tuīdòng gāoděng jiàoyù de xuéshù jiāoliú yǔ chuàngxīn.
en: The college is committed to promoting academic exchange and innovation in higher education.

zh: 辩论赛现场的紧张氛围让每个人都屏住了呼吸。
pinyin: Biànlùnsài xiànchǎng de jǐnzhāng fēnwéi ràng měi gè rén dōu bǐngzhùle hūxī.
en: The tense atmosphere at the debate competition made everyone hold their breath.

zh: 由于工厂订单激增，工人不得不轮流值守夜班。
pinyin: Yóuyú gōngchǎng dìngdān jīzēng, gōngrén bùdébù lúnliú zhíshǒu yèbān.
en: Due to a surge in factory orders, the workers have to take turns covering the night shift.

zh: 该政策旨在吸引更多优秀的外籍人才来此发展。
pinyin: Gāi zhèng cè zhǐ zài xī yǐn gèng duō yōu xiù de wài jí rén cái lái cǐ fā zhǎn.
en: The policy aims to attract more outstanding foreign talent to develop here.

zh: 尽管近来项目进展顺利，我们仍不能掉以轻心。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn jìn lái xiàng mù jìn zhǎn shùn lì, wǒ men réng bù néng diào yǐ qīng xīn.
en: Although the project has been progressing smoothly lately, we still cannot lower our guard.

zh: 为了应对突发状况，政府设立了专项应急基金。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì tūfā zhuàngkuàng, zhèngfǔ shèlì le zhuānxiàng yìngjí jījīn.
en: In order to cope with emergencies, the government set up a special emergency fund.

zh: 双方本着平等互利的原则达成了长期合作协议。
pinyin: Shuāngfāng běnzhe píngděng hùlì de yuánzé dáchéng le chángqī hézuò xiéyì.
en: Both sides reached a long-term cooperation agreement based on the principles of equality and mutual benefit.

zh: 面对突发疫情，医护工作者毅然奔赴抗疫一线。
pinyin: Miànduì tūfā yìqíng, yīhù gōngzuòzhě yìrán bēnfù kàngyì yīxiàn.
en: Facing the sudden epidemic, medical workers resolutely rushed to the front line of the fight against the epidemic.

zh: 作家以生动的笔触勾勒出那个时代的社会风貌。
pinyin: zuò jiā yǐ shēng dòng de bǐ chù gōu lè chū nà gè shí dài de shè huì fēng mào.
en: The author outlined the social landscape of that era with vivid strokes.

zh: 由于战乱，许多家庭被迫分离，难以实现团圆。
pinyin: Yóuyú zhànluàn, xǔduō jiātíng bèi pò fēnlí, nányǐ shíxiàn tuányuán.
en: Due to the war, many families were forced to separate, making it difficult to achieve reunion.

zh: 为了保持热度，制作方将连续剧改为分段播出。
pinyin: wèile bǎochí rèdù, zhìzuòfāng jiāng liánxùjù gǎi wèi fēnduàn bōchū.
en: To maintain popularity, the producers changed the show into a program in parts.

zh: 虽然他厨艺精湛，但唯独对制作包子一窍不通。
pinyin: Suīrán tā chúyì jīngzhàn, dàn wéidú duì zhìzuò bāozi yīqiàobùtōng.
en: Although he is a skillful chef, he is completely ignorant when it comes to making steamed buns.

zh: 无论遭遇何种挫折，他从未减退过创作的热情。
pinyin: Wú lùn zāo yù hé zhǒng cuò zhé, tā cóng wèi jiǎn tuì guò chuàng zuò de rè qíng.
en: No matter what setbacks he encountered, his passion for creation never diminished.

zh: 缺乏力量训练使得他的核心肌肉变得软弱无力。
pinyin: quē fá lì liàng xùn liàn shǐ dé tā de hé xīn jī ròu biàn dé ruǎn ruò wú lì.
en: The lack of strength training has made his core muscles flabby.

zh: 他将核心资产抵押，以此筹集企业转型的资金。
pinyin: tā jiāng héxīn zīchǎn dǐyā, yǐ cǐ chóují qǐyè zhuǎnxíng de zījīn.
en: He put up his core assets as collateral to raise capital for the enterprise's transformation.

zh: 他作为一名传奇选手，在荣誉满载时宣布退役。
pinyin: tā zuò wéi yī míng chuán qí xuǎn shǒu, zài róng yù mǎn zài shí xuān bù tuì yì.
en: As a legendary player, he announced his retirement while full of honors.

zh: 粉嫩的花瓣在微风中摇曳，散发出淡淡的清香。
pinyin: fěn nèn de huā bàn zài wēi fēng zhōng yáo yè, sàn fā chū dàn dàn de qīng xiāng.
en: The delicate pink petals swayed in the breeze, emitting a faint fragrance.

zh: 在崎岖的山路上攀登，每一步都走得极其费劲。
pinyin: Zài qíqū de shānlù shàng pāndēng, měi yī bù dōu zǒu de jíqí fèijìn.
en: Climbing on the rugged mountain road, every step taken is extremely strenuous.

zh: 爸爸在金融领域深耕多年，具备敏锐的洞察力。
pinyin: Bàba zài jīnróng lǐngyù shēngēng duōnián, jùbèi mǐnruì de dòngchálì.
en: My father has been deeply engaged in the financial field for many years and possesses keen insight.

zh: 伟大的文学作品往往能够唤醒人们沉睡的灵魂。
pinyin: Wěidà de wénxué zuòpǐn wǎngwǎng nénggòu huànxǐng rénmen chénshuì de línghún.
en: Great literary works can often awaken people's dormant souls.

zh: 经营一段长久的婚姻需要双方共同努力与包容。
pinyin: Jīngyíng yīduàn chángjiǔ de hūnyīn xūyào shuāngfāng gòngtóng nǔlì yǔ bāoróng.
en: Maintaining a long-lasting marriage requires mutual effort and tolerance from both sides.

zh: 某些神话人物被赋予了呼风唤雨的超自然力量。
pinyin: mǒuxiē shénhuà rénwù bèi fùyǔle hū fēng huàn yǔ de chāozìrán lìlián rénlì.
en: Certain mythical figures are endowed with supernatural powers to call the wind and summon the rain.

zh: 该车型凭借出色的性能赢得了广大消费者的青睐。
pinyin: Gāi chēxíng píngjiè chūsè de xìngnéng yíngdéle guǎngdà xiāofèizhě de qīnglài.
en: This vehicle model has won the favor of the vast majority of consumers due to its excellent performance.

zh: 由于长期沉迷于职业扑克比赛，他感到身心疲惫。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī chénmí yú zhíyè pūkè bǐsài, tā gǎndào shēnxīn píbèi.
en: Due to long-term obsession with professional poker tournaments, he feels exhausted both physically and mentally.

zh: 科学家试图利用基因技术使这种灭绝的动物重现。
pinyin: Kēxuéjiā shìtú lìyòng jīyīn jìshù shǐ zhè zhǒng mièjué de dòngwù chóngxiàn.
en: Scientists are attempting to use genetic technology to bring this extinct animal to reappear.

zh: 为了避免手机欠费，我设置了话费自动扣款业务。
pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn shǒujī qiànfèi, wǒ shèzhìle huàfèi zìdòng kòukuǎn yèwù.
en: In order to avoid my phone bill being in arrears, I set up automatic payment for phone charges.

zh: 由于情报机构的机密属性，其运作细节不便透露。
pinyin: Yóuyú qíngbào jīgòu de jīmì shǔxìng, qí yùnzuò xìjié bùbiàn tòulù.
en: Due to the classified nature of the intelligence agency, the details of its operations cannot be revealed.

zh: 由于工程进度严重滞后，项目组不得不加班赶工。
pinyin: Yóuyú gōngchéng jìndù yánzhòng zhìhòu, xiàngmùzǔ bù dé bù jiābān gǎngōng.
en: Due to the severe delay in the project schedule, the project team has to work overtime to catch up.

zh: 经纪公司正在全力打造这位潜力巨大的新晋明星。
pinyin: Jīngjì gōngsī zhèngzài quánlì dǎzào zhè wèi qiánlì jùdà de xīnjìn míngxīng.
en: The agency is sparing no effort to build up this rising star with huge potential.

zh: 由于长期接触劣质肥皂，她的双手变得异常粗糙。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī jiēchù lièzhì féizào, tā de shuāngshǒu biàn dé yìcháng cūcāo.
en: Due to long-term exposure to low-quality soap, her hands have become unusually rough.

zh: 这种果汁不含任何人工添加剂，深受消费者喜爱。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng guǒzhī bù hán rènhé réngōng tiānjiājì, shēn shòu xiāofèizhě xǐ'ài.
en: This type of fruit juice contains no artificial additives and is deeply loved by consumers.

zh: 他俯首沉思，仿佛在追溯那段被岁月尘封的往事。
pinyin: tā fǔ shǒu chén sī, fǎng fó zài zhuī sù nà duàn bèi suì yuè chén fēng de wǎng shì.
en: He bows his head in contemplation, as if tracing back the past events sealed by time.

zh: 专家警告称生育压力会对心理健康产生负面影响。
pinyin: Zhuānjiā jǐnggào chēng shēngyù yālì huì duì xīnlǐ jiànkāng chǎnshēng fùmiàn yǐngxiǎng.
en: Experts warn that fertility-related pressure can have a negative impact on mental health.

zh: 虽然表面上证据充足，但这其中仍存在不少疑点。
pinyin: Suīrán biǎomiàn shàng zhèngjù chōngzú, dàn zhè qízhōng réng cúnzài bùshǎo yídiǎn.
en: Although there is sufficient evidence on the surface, there are still many doubtful points within it.

zh: 他耗时多年，终于在核心期刊上发表了研究论著。
pinyin: Tā hàoshí duō nián, zhōngyú zài héxīn qīkān shàng fābiǎo le yánjiū lùnzhù.
en: After many years of hard work, he finally published his research work in a core journal.

zh: 由于拉锁生锈了，无论怎么用力也无法将其拉开。
pinyin: yóu yú lā suǒ shēng xiù le, wú lùn zěn me yòng lì yě wú fǎ jiāng qí lā kāi.
en: Because the zipper is rusted, no matter how hard I try, I cannot open it.

zh: 尽管文化背景迥异，但人类的基本情感是相似的。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn wén huà bèi jǐng jiǒng yì, dàn rén lèi de jī běn qíng gǎn shì xiāng sì de.
en: Although cultural backgrounds are vastly different, basic human emotions are similar.

zh: 艺术创作需要创新，绝不能因循守旧、一成不变。
pinyin: Yìshù chuàngzuò xūyào chuàngxīn, jué bùnéng yīnxúnshǒujiù, yīchéngbùbiàn.
en: Artistic creation requires innovation; it must never be stagnant or immutable.

zh: 即便在极端寒冷的气候下，深海也并未完全冻结。
pinyin: jíbiàn zài jíduān hánlěng de qìhòu xià, shēnhǎi yě bìngwèi wánquán dòngjié.
en: Even in extremely cold climates, the deep sea has not completely frozen.

zh: 这种复杂的方程，不用计算机几乎无法精确求解。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fùzá de fāngchéng, bùyòng jìsuànjī jīhū wúfǎ jīngquè qiújiě.
en: It is almost impossible to solve this kind of complex equation accurately without a calculator.

zh: 由于长途跋涉，他的靴子已经磨损得不成样子了。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángtú báshè, tā de xuēzi yǐjīng mósǔn de bùchéng yàngzi le.
en: Due to the long trek, his boots were worn out beyond recognition.

zh: 由于经营状况恶化，董事会提议更换首席执行官。
pinyin: yóu yú jīng yíng zhuàng kuàng è huà, dǒng shì huì tí yì gēng huàn shǒu xí zhí xíng guān.
en: Due to the worsening business conditions, the board of directors proposed replacing the CEO.

zh: 他凭借卓越的才华将此挑战作为事业发展的阶梯。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè zhuóyuè de cáihuá jiāng cǐ tiǎozhàn zuòwéi shìyè fāzhǎn de jiētī.
en: Relying on his outstanding talent, he used this challenge as a stepping stone for his career development.

zh: 骆驼能够在严酷的沙漠环境中生存，这令人惊叹。
pinyin: Luòtuó nénggòu zài yánkù de shāmò huánjìng zhōng shēngcún, zhè lìng rén jīngtàn.
en: It is amazing that camels can survive in the harsh desert environment.

zh: 这项科研成果将进一步加快相关领域的技术革新。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng kēyán chéngguǒ jiāng jìnyībù jiākuài xiāngguān lǐngyù de jìshù géxīn.
en: This scientific research achievement will further accelerate technological innovation in related fields.

zh: 在专业比赛中犯这种低级错误，确实显得离谱儿。
