pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè yīnwèi guòdù yīlài dānyī shìchǎng ér xiànrùle cáiwù kùnjìng.
en: This enterprise fell into financial distress because it relied too heavily on a single market.

zh: 为了了解市场动态，他订阅了许多专业的财经评论。
pinyin: Wèi le liǎo jiě shì chǎng dòng tài, tā dìng yuè le xǔ duō zhuān yè de cái jīng píng lùn.
en: In order to understand market trends, he subscribed to many professional financial and economic commentaries.

zh: 这项科学研究旨在探讨性别差异对认知能力的影响。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng kēxué yánjiū zhǐ zài tàntǎo xìngbié chāyì duì rènzhī nénglì de yǐngxiǎng.
en: This scientific research aims to explore the influence of sex differences on cognitive abilities.

zh: 通过优化生产线，工厂大幅缩短了产品的交付周期。
pinyin: Tōngguò yōuhuà shēngchǎnxiàn, gōngchǎng dàfú suōduǎn le chǎnpǐn de jiāofù zhōuqī.
en: By optimizing the production line, the factory significantly shortened the product delivery cycle.

zh: 社会舆论对这项公益事业表示了热烈的欢呼与支持。
pinyin: Shèhuì yúlùn duì zhè xiàng gōngyì shìyè biǎoshì le rèliè de huānhū yǔ zhīchí.
en: Public opinion expressed enthusiastic acclaim and support for this public welfare undertaking.

zh: 果园里的果树经过精心培育，结出的果实硕大甘甜。
pinyin: Guǒyuán lǐ de guǒshù jīngguò jīngxīn péiyù, jiéchū de guǒshí shuòdà gāntián.
en: The fruit trees in the orchard have been carefully cultivated, and the fruits they produce are large and sweet.

zh: 面对这场突如其来的变故，他双手颤抖，不知所措。
pinyin: Miàn duì zhè chǎng tūrúqílái de biàngù, tā shuāngshǒu chàndǒu, bùzhīsuǒcuò.
en: Facing this sudden change, his hands trembled and he was at a loss.

zh: 他独自攀登那座荒凉的山岭，试图寻找失踪的同伴。
pinyin: Tā dúzì pāndēng nà zuò huāngliáng de shānlǐng, shìtú xúnzhǎo shīzōng de tóngbàn.
en: He climbed the desolate mountain ridge alone, attempting to find his missing companion.

zh: 尽管世事变迁，那种天长地久的信念始终未曾改变。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shìshì biànqiān, nà zhǒng tiān cháng dì jiǔ de xìnniàn shǐzhōng wèi céng gǎibiàn.
en: Despite the changing of the world, that eternal belief has never changed.

zh: 由于长期磨损，车辆的车轴出现了金属疲劳的征兆。
pinyin: yóuyú chángqī mósǔn, chēliàng de chē zhóu chūxiàn le jīnshǔ píláo de zhēngzhào.
en: Due to long-term wear, the vehicle's axle showed signs of metal fatigue.

zh: 由于生态环境恶化，该地区的水产品产量显著下降。
pinyin: Yóuyú shēngtài huánjìng èhuà, gāi dìqū de shuǐchǎnpǐn chǎnliàng xiǎnzhù xiàjiàng.
en: Due to the deterioration of the ecological environment, the output of aquatic products in this region has dropped significantly.

zh: 他时刻警惕着，绝不给心怀叵测之人任何可乘之机。
pinyin: Tā shíkè jǐngtìzhe, juébù gěi xīnhuái pǒcè zhī rén rènhé kě chéng zhī jī.
en: He is always vigilant and will never give those with ulterior motives any opportunity to exploit.

zh: 通过推广先进的灌溉技术，该地区实现了高效节水。
pinyin: Tōngguò tuīguǎng xiānjìn de guàngài jìshù, gāi dìqū shíxiànle gāoxiào jiéshuǐ.
en: By promoting advanced irrigation technology, the region has achieved efficient water conservation.

zh: 只有通过这种特殊的酶，才能激活体内的免疫反应。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu tōngguò zhè zhǒng tèshū de méi, cáinéng jīhuó tǐnèi de miǎnyì fǎnyìng.
en: Only by using this special enzyme can the immune response in the body be activated.

zh: 当晚的演出极其精彩，观众们纷纷报以热烈的掌声。
pinyin: Dāngwǎn de yǎnchū jíqí jīngcǎi, guānzhòngmen fēnfēn bàoyǐ rèliè de zhǎngshēng.
en: The performance on that evening was extremely brilliant, and the audience gave warm applause one after another.

zh: 通过对比分析，我们确定了各项指标所占的百分比。
pinyin: Tōng guò duì bǐ fēn xī, wǒ men què dìng le gè xiàng zhǐ biāo suǒ zhàn de bǎi fēn bǐ.
en: Through comparative analysis, we determined the percentage accounted for by each indicator.

zh: 这场突如其来的瘟疫使整个社会的经济陷入了停滞。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng tūrúqílái de wēnyì shǐ zhěnggè shèhuì de jīngjì xiànrù le tíngzhì.
en: This sudden plague caused the entire society's economy to come to a standstill.

zh: 虽然薯片很美味，但我还是尽量避免摄入过多油脂。
pinyin: Suīrán shǔpiàn hěn měiwèi, dàn wǒ háishì jǐnliàng bìmiǎn shèrù guòduō yóuzhī.
en: Although potato chips are delicious, I still try to avoid consuming too much fat.

zh: 经过缜密的观察，专家终于认出了这件文物的真伪。
pinyin: Jīngguò zhěnmì de guānchá, zhuānjiā zhōngyú rènchū le zhè jiàn wénwù de zhēnwěi.
en: After careful observation, the expert finally recognized the authenticity of this artifact.

zh: 在全球化浪潮之下，国际贸易的融合显得势不可当。
pinyin: zài quán qiú huà làng cháo zhī xià, guó jì mào yì de róng hé xiǎn de shì bù kě dāng.
en: Under the wave of globalization, the integration of international trade appears impossible to resist.

zh: 随着生活水平的提高，饲养宠物的人数呈上升趋势。
pinyin: Suízhe shēnghuó shuǐpíng de tígāo, sìyǎng chǒngwù de rénshù chéng shàngshēng qūshì.
en: With the improvement of living standards, the number of people keeping pets is on an upward trend.

zh: 战争给许多平民造成了难以磨灭的身体与精神创伤。
pinyin: Zhànzhēng gěi xǔduō píngmín zàochéng le nányǐ mómiè de shēntǐ yǔ jīngshén chuāngshāng.
en: The war caused indelible physical and mental trauma to many civilians.

zh: 全球变暖带来了很多负面影响，比如说海平面上升。
pinyin: Quánqiú biànnuǎn dài lái le hěn duō fùmiàn yǐngxiǎng, bǐrúshuō hǎipíngmiàn shàngshēng.
en: Global warming has brought many negative impacts, for example, sea-level rise.

zh: 这种新型减肥药物旨在有效抑制人体对脂肪的吸收。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīnxíng jiǎnféi yàowù zhǐ zài yǒuxiào yìzhì réntǐ duì zhīfáng de xīshōu.
en: This new type of weight-loss drug is designed to effectively inhibit the human body's absorption of fat.

zh: 他在讲台上侃侃而谈，进行了一场深刻的学术演讲。
pinyin: Tā zài jiǎngtái shàng kǎnkǎn'értán, jìnxíngle yī chǎng shēnkè de xuéshù yǎnjiǎng.
en: He spoke eloquently on the platform, delivering a profound academic lecture.

zh: 企业在全球化进程中必须灵活运用差异化竞争战略。
pinyin: Qǐyè zài quánqiúhuà jìnchéng zhōng bìxū línghuó yùnyòng chāyìhuà jìngzhēng zhànlüè.
en: Enterprises must flexibly apply differentiated competitive strategies in the process of globalization.

zh: 为了应对金融危机，该国开始大量储备人民币资产。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì jīnróng wēijī, gāi guó kāishǐ dàliàng chǔbèi rénmínbì zī zīchǎn.
en: In order to cope with the financial crisis, the country began to store a large amount of Chinese Yuan assets.

zh: 长期压力过大会导致血压升高，甚至引发心脏疾病。
pinyin: Chángqī yālì guòdà huì dǎozhì xuèyā shēnggāo, shènzhì yǐnfā xīnzàng jíbìng.
en: Long-term excessive stress can lead to increased blood pressure and even trigger heart disease.

zh: 金融市场的不稳定性往往会导致投资者的恐慌心理。
pinyin: Jīnróng shìchǎng de bù wěndìngxìng wǎngwǎng huì dǎozhì tóuzīzhě de kǒnghuāng xīnlǐ.
en: The instability of the financial market often leads to panic among investors.

zh: 这种文学批评的方法论已经超出了传统的审美范畴。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wénxué pīpíng de fāngfǎlùn yǐjīng chāochūle chuántǒng de shěnměi fànchóu.
en: This methodology of literary criticism has already transcended the traditional aesthetic category.

zh: 为了应对紧急情况，工厂进行了大规模的防灾演练。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì jǐnjí qíngkuàng, gōngchǎng jìnxíngle dàguīmó de fángzāi yǎnliàn.
en: In order to respond to emergencies, the factory conducted a large-scale disaster prevention drill.

zh: 两国在互利共赢的基础上达成协议，正式宣布建交。
pinyin: Liǎng guó zài hùlì gòngyíng de jīchǔ shàng dáchéng xiéyì, zhèngshì xuānbù jiàn jiāo.
en: The two countries reached an agreement on the basis of mutual benefit and win-win results, and officially announced the establishment of diplomatic relations.

zh: 只有把握全局，才能在激烈的竞争中立于不败之地。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu bǎwò quánjú, cáinéng zài jīliè de jìngzhēng zhōng lìyú bùbài zhī dì.
en: Only by grasping the overall situation can one remain invincible in fierce competition.

zh: 为了达成共识，双方管理层进行了多轮艰苦的洽谈。
pinyin: Wèile dáchéng gòngshì, shuāngfāng guǎnlǐcéng jìnxíngle duō lún jiānkǔ de qiàtán.
en: In order to reach a consensus, the management of both sides conducted several rounds of arduous negotiations.

zh: 相关机构通过模型测算了全球气候变化的影响趋势。
pinyin: Xiāngguān jīgòu tōngguò móxíng cè suànle quánqiú qìhòu biànhuà de yǐngxiǎng qūshì.
en: Relevant institutions have measured and calculated the impact trends of global climate change through models.

zh: 由于长期的传统，他已习惯了这些繁文缛节的规矩。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī de chuántǒng, tā yǐ xíguànle zhèxiē fánwénrùjié de guīju.
en: Due to long-standing traditions, he has grown accustomed to these cumbersome rules.

zh: 为了优化城市空间，规划局批准了新建高层居民楼。
pinyin: Wèi le yōu huà chéng shì kōng jiān, guī huà jú pī zhǔn le xīn jiàn gāo céng jū mín lóu.
en: In order to optimize urban space, the planning bureau approved the construction of new high-rise residential towers.

zh: 经过多方考证，确认这块碑文是由区家先祖题写的。
pinyin: jīng guò duō fāng kǎo zhèng, què rèn zhè kuài bēi wén shì yóu ōu jiā xiān zǔ tí xiě de.
en: After multiple verifications, it was confirmed that this inscription was written by an ancestor of the Ou family.

zh: 随着经济的发展，许多人投身于现代化的家禽养殖。
pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì de fāzhǎn, xǔduō rén tóushēn yú xiàndàihuà de jiāqín yǎngzhí.
en: With the development of the economy, many people have invested themselves in modernized poultry farming.

zh: 随着人口高龄化，政府不得不调整相关的养老政策。
pinyin: Suízhe rénkǒu gāolínghuà, zhèngfǔ bùdébù tiáozhěng xiāngguān de yǎnglǎo zhèngcè.
en: With the aging of the population, the government has to adjust relevant pension policies.

zh: 为了追求食物的天然口感，餐厅决定停止添加味精。
pinyin: Wèile zhuīqiú shíwù de tiānrán kǒngǎn, cāntīng juédìng tíngzhǐ tiānjiā wèijīng.
en: In order to pursue the natural texture of food, the restaurant decided to stop adding MSG.

zh: 通过不断创新，这家企业已跻身于世界级顶尖行列。
pinyin: Tōngguò bùduàn chuàngxīn, zhè jiā qǐyè yǐ jīshēn yú shìjièjí dǐngjiān hángliè.
en: Through continuous innovation, this enterprise has ranked among the world-class elite.

zh: 这项尖端医疗技术成功实现了人体器官移植的突破。
pinyin: zhè xiàng jiān duān yī liáo jì shù chéng gōng shí xiàn le rén tǐ qì guān yí zhí de tū pò.
en: This cutting-edge medical technology has successfully achieved a breakthrough in human organ transplantation.

zh: 尽管票价昂贵，但这届艺术节的门票依然销售一空。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn piàojià ángguì, dàn zhè jiè yìshùjié de ménpiào yīrán xiāoshòu yīkōng.
en: Although the ticket price is expensive, tickets for this art festival are still sold out.

zh: 尽管票价昂贵，但歌迷们对演唱会的热情丝毫未减。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn piàojià ángguì, dàn gēmínmen duì yǎnchànghuì de rèqíng sīháo wèijiǎn.
en: Despite the expensive ticket prices, the fans' enthusiasm for the concert has not diminished in the slightest.

zh: 由于种种客观因素，该项目的实施进程不得不延期。
pinyin: Yóuyú zhǒng zhǒng kèguān yīnsù, gāi xiàngmù de shíshī jìnchéng bùdébù yánqī.
en: Due to all kinds of objective factors, the implementation schedule of the project had to be postponed.

zh: 虽然政府采取了措施，但贫富差距并没有明显缩小。
pinyin: Suīrán zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ le cuòshī, dàn pínfù chājù bìng méiyǒu míngxiǎn suōxiǎo.
en: Although the government took measures, the gap between the rich and the poor did not significantly narrow.

zh: 尽管他是当红主演，但平时依然保持着谦逊的作风。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā shì dānghóng zhǔyǎn, dàn píngshí yīrán bǎochí zhe qiānxùn de zuòfēng.
en: Although he is a popular lead actor, he still maintains a modest style in his daily life.

zh: 文具市场的竞争日益激烈，各大品牌纷纷推陈出新。
pinyin: Wénjù shìchǎng de jìngzhēng rìyì jīliè, gè dà pǐnpái fēnfēn tuīchénchūxīn.
en: The stationery market competition is increasingly fierce, and major brands are constantly innovating.

zh: 下个月召开的学术研讨会将探讨全球化的深远影响。
pinyin: Xià gè yuè zhàokāi de xuéshù yántǎohuì jiāng tàntǎo quánqiúhuà de shēnyuǎn yǐngxiǎng.
en: The academic seminar to be held next month will explore the profound impact of globalization.

zh: 那座宏伟的纪念碑矗立在广场中央，显得格外庄严。
pinyin: Nà zuò hóngwěi de jìniànbēi chùlì zài guǎngchǎng zhōngyāng, xiǎnde géwài zhuāngyán.
en: The magnificent monument stands in the center of the square, looking exceptionally solemn.

zh: 他宁愿在逆境中坚守原则，也不愿为了利益而妥协。
pinyin: Tā nìngyuàn zài nìjìng zhōng jiānshǒu yuánzé, yě bùyuàn wèile lìyì ér tuǒ tuǒxié.
en: He would rather hold fast to his principles in adversity than compromise for the sake of profit.

zh: 导演巧妙地运用艺术手法提升了这部电视剧的格调。
pinyin: Dǎoyǎn qiǎomiào de yùnyòng yìshù shǒufǎ tíshēng le zhè bù diànshìjù de gédiào.
en: The director cleverly used artistic techniques to elevate the style of this TV drama.

zh: 科学家们正在致力于提高激光束的精确度与稳定性。
pinyin: Kēxuéjiā men zhèngzài zhìlì yú tígāo jīguāngshù de jīngquèdù yǔ wěndìngxìng.
en: Scientists are working on improving the precision and stability of laser beams.

zh: 该委员会经过慎重考虑，最终否决了这项改革方案。
pinyin: Gāi wěiyuánhuì jīngguò shènzhòng kǎolǜ, zuìzhōng fǒujuéle zhè xiàng gǎigé fāng'àn.
en: After careful consideration, the committee ultimately rejected this reform proposal.

zh: 科技发展迅速，然而人类面临的环境问题依然严峻。
pinyin: Kējì fāzhǎn xùnsù, rán'ér rénlèi miànlín de huánjìng wèntí yīrán yánjùn.
en: Technology is developing rapidly, however, the environmental problems facing humanity remain severe.

zh: 尽管工作非常繁忙，主编还是坚持审阅每一篇稿件。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gōngzuò fēicháng fánmáng, zhǔbiān háishì jiānchí shěnyuè měi yī piān gǎojiàn.
en: Despite the busy work, the editor-in-chief still insists on reviewing every manuscript.

zh: 为了缓解交通压力，政府决定扩大客运车辆的规模。
pinyin: Wèile huǎnjiě jiāotōng yālì, zhèngfǔ juédìng kuòdà kèyùn chēliàng de guīmó.
en: In order to relieve traffic pressure, the government decided to expand the scale of intercity bus vehicles.

zh: 这款电饭锅凭借其卓越的性能赢得了消费者的青睐。
pinyin: Zhè kuǎn diànfànguō píngjiè qí zhuóyuè de xìngnéng yíngdé le xiāofèizhě de qīnglài.
en: This electric rice cooker has won the favor of consumers due to its excellent performance.

zh: 他的言谈举止显得十分客气，让人感到有些距离感。
pinyin: Tā de yántán jǔzhǐ xiǎnde shífēn kèqi, ràng rén gǎndào yǒuxiē jùlǐ gǎn.
en: His demeanor appeared very formal, making people feel a sense of distance.

zh: 这一项战略蓝图将对行业的长远改革产生深远影响。
pinyin: Zhè yī xiàng zhànlüè lántú jiāng duì hángyè de chángyuǎn gǎigé chǎnshēng shēnyuǎn yǐngxiǎng.
en: This strategic blueprint will have a profound impact on the long-term reform of the industry.

zh: 他在措辞上十分讲究，每一个字眼都经过反复斟酌。
pinyin: Tā zài cuòcí shàng shífēn jiǎngjiu, měi yīgè zìyǎn dōu jīngguò fǎnfù zhēnzhóu.
en: He is very particular about his phrasing, and every wording has been carefully considered.

zh: 合同已经正式签署，就是说双方必须严格履行承诺。
pinyin: Hétóng yǐjīng zhèngshì qiānshǔ, jiù shì shuō shuāngfāng bìxū yángé lǚxíng chéngnuò.
en: The contract has been officially signed, in other words, both parties must strictly fulfill their promises.

zh: 面对严峻的挑战，企业必须正视市场竞争的残酷性。
pinyin: miàn duì yán jùn de tiǎo zhàn, qǐ yè bì xū zhèng shì shì chǎng jìng zhēng de cán kù xìng.
en: Facing severe challenges, enterprises must squarely confront the cruelty of market competition.

zh: 我们必须等待时机，以便随时给予竞争对手致命一击。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū děngdài shíjī, yǐbiàn suíshí jǐyǔ jìngzhēng duìshǒu zhìmìng yī jī.
en: We must wait for the opportunity to strike the competitor at the right time.

zh: 如果你只是一味地等待，只会让自己处于被动的局面。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ zhǐshì yīwèi de děngdài, zhǐ huì ràng zìjǐ chǔyú bèidòng de júmiàn.
en: If you just wait blindly, you will only put yourself in a passive situation.

zh: 在极其恶劣的环境下，人类始终在为维持性命而拼搏。
pinyin: Zài jíqí èliè de huánjìng xià, rénlèi shǐzhōng zài wèi wéichí xìngmìng ér pīnbó.
en: In extremely harsh environments, humans are always struggling to maintain their lives.

zh: 由于化纤工业的迅速发展，人们的选择更加多样化了。

pinyin: bùtóng lǐngyù de zhuānjiā wǎngwǎng duì tóngyī xiànxiàng yǒuzhe xiāngtóng de yánjiū xìngqù.
en: Experts from different fields often have the same research interests regarding the same phenomenon.

zh: 在全球化背景下，不同宗教之间的对话显得尤为迫切。
pinyin: Zài quánqiúhuà bèijǐng xià, bùtóng zōngjiào zhī jiān de duìhuà xiǎndé yóuwú pòqiè.
en: In the context of globalization, dialogue between different religions appears particularly urgent.

zh: 对于这种复杂的社会现象，公众普遍持什么样的态度？
pinyin: Duìyú zhè zhǒng fùzá de shèhuì xiànxiàng, gōngzhòng pǔbiàn chí shénme yàng de tàidù?
en: Regarding this kind of complex social phenomenon, what kind of attitude does the public generally hold?

zh: 这些出土文物为研究古代文明提供了宝贵的实物证据。
pinyin: Zhèxiē chūtǔ wénwù wèi yánjiū gǔdài wénmíng tígōngle bǎoguì de shíwù zhèngjù.
en: These unearthed cultural relics provide valuable physical evidence for studying ancient civilization.

zh: 由于交通不便，他不得不通过网络遥控项目的开发进程。
pinyin: Yóuyú jiāotōng bùbiàn, tā bùdébù tōngguò wǎngluò yáokòng xiàngmù de kāifā jìnchéng.
en: Due to inconvenient transportation, he has to remotely direct the project's development progress via the internet.

zh: 尽管由于观念差异产生过摩擦，但我始终尊重我的岳母。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yóuyú guānniàn chāyì chǎnshēngguò mócā, dàn wǒ shǐzhōng zūnzhòng wǒ de yuèmǔ.
en: Although there have been frictions due to differences in perspective, I have always respected my mother-in-law.

zh: 这种自发的行为体现了社会成员之间的友爱与互助精神。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zìfā de x de xíngwéi tǐxiàn le shèhuì chéngyuán zhījiān de yǒu'ài yǔ hùzhù jīngshén.
en: This kind of spontaneous behavior embodies the spirit of friendship and mutual aid among society members.

zh: 健身教练建议我们补充高质量的蛋白质以促进肌肉生长。
pinyin: jiànshēn jiàoliàn jiànyì wǒmen bǔchōng gāo zhìliàng de dànbáizhì yǐ cùjìn jīròu shēngzhǎng.
en: The fitness coach suggests we supplement with high-quality protein to promote muscle growth.

zh: 他作为一名学者，其严谨的治学态度赢得了社会的钦佩。
pinyin: Tā zuòwéi yī míng xuézhě, qí yánjǐn de zhìxué tàidù yíngdéle shèhuì de qīnpèi.
en: As a scholar, his rigorous academic attitude has won the great respect of society.

zh: 他对于学术研究的投入程度已经达到了令人钦佩的地步。
pinyin: tā duì yú xué shù yán jiū de tóu rù chéng dù yǐ jīng dá dào le lìng rén qīn pèi de dì bù.
en: His level of dedication to academic research has reached an admirable point.

zh: 该事件在网络上迅速发酵，引发了广大网民的热烈讨论。
pinyin: gāi shì jiàn zài wǎng luò shàng xùn sù fā jiào, yǐn fā le guǎng dà wǎng mín de rè liè tǎo lǎo lùn.
en: The incident fermented rapidly online, triggering heated discussions among the vast number of netizens.

zh: 无论面对多少艰难险阻，他始终保持着奋勇奔跑的姿态。
pinyin: Wúlùn miànduì duōshǎo jiānnán xiǎnzǔ, tā shǐzhōng bǎochízhe fènyǒng bēnpǎo de zītài.
en: No matter how many difficulties and obstacles he faces, he always maintains a posture of running forward courageously.

zh: 经过严格的质量检测，车间的产品终于可以投入市场了。
pinyin: Jīngguò yángé de zhìliàng jiǎncè, chējiān de chǎnpǐn zhōngyú kěyǐ tóurù shìchǎng le.
en: After strict quality inspection, the workshop's products can finally be put on the market.

zh: 他对于调料的比例掌握得恰到好处，做饭水平令人惊叹。
pinyin: Tā duìyú tiáoliào de bǐlì zhǎngǐ zhǎngwò dé qià dào hǎochù, zuòfàn shuǐpíng lìng rén jīngtàn.
en: He has mastered the ratio of seasonings perfectly; his cooking level is amazing.

zh: 从那封信的字迹中，我感受到了一种难得的从容与淡定。
pinyin: Cóng nà fēng xìn de zìjì zhōng, wǒ gǎnshòu dào le yī zhǒng nándé de cóngróng yǔ dàndìng.
en: From the handwriting in that letter, I felt a rare sense of composure and calm.

zh: 他这一番话明显是存心挑拨离间，试图破坏团队的团结。
pinyin: tā zhè yī fān huà míngxiǎn shì cúnxīn tiǎobólíjiàn, shìtú pòhuài tuánduì de tuánjié.
en: His words were clearly intended to sow discord and attempt to undermine the team's unity.

zh: 在缺乏燃料的年代，稻草成了当地村民重要的能源来源。
pinyin: Zài quēfá ránliào de niándài, dào cǎo chéng le dāngdì cūnmín zhòngyào de néngyuán láiyuán.
en: In an era of fuel shortages, rice straw became an important source of energy for the local villagers.

zh: 作为一名杰出的建筑设计师，他主张可持续发展的理念。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng jiéchū de jiànzhù shèjìshī, tā zhǔzhāng kě chíxù fāzhǎn de lǐniàn.
en: As an outstanding architect, he advocates the concept of sustainable development.

zh: 我们必须明确公司未来的发展方向，无论结果成功与否。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū míngquè gōngsī wèilái de fāzhǎn fāngxiàng, wúlùn jiéguǒ chénggōng yǔ fǒu.
en: We must clarify the company's future development direction, regardless of whether the result is successful or not.

zh: 这位学者的研究课题是关于中国各地区姓氏的分布情况。
pinyin: Zhè wèi xuézhě de yánjiū kètí shì guānyú Zhōngguó gè dìqū xìngshì de fēnbù qíngkuàng.
en: This scholar's research project is about the distribution of family names in different regions of China.

zh: 随着普通话的推广，年轻一代使用方言的频率逐渐降低。
pinyin: suí zhe pǔ tōng huà de tuī guǎng, nián qīng yī dài shǐ yòng fāng yán de pín lǜ zhú jiàn jiàng dī.
en: With the promotion of Mandarin, the frequency of the younger generation using dialects is gradually decreasing.

zh: 公司高层正在会议室用餐，并讨论下一季度的战略规划。
pinyin: Gōngsī gāocéng zhèngzài huìyìshì yòngcān, bìng tǎolùn xià yī jìdù de zhànlüè guīhuà.
en: The company's senior management is having a meal in the conference room while discussing strategic planning for the next quarter.

zh: 不好意思，此次任务未能如期完成，给团队带来了损失。
pinyin: Bù hǎo yì si, cǐcì rènwù wèinéng rúqī wánchéng, gěi tuánduì dàilái le sǔnshī.
en: Sorry, this mission was not completed on schedule, causing losses to the team.

zh: 我们必须采取有效措施，帮助灾区人民摆脱当前的困境。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū cǎiqǔ yǒuxiào cuòshī, bāngzhù zāiqū rénmín bǎituō dāngqián de kùnjìng.
en: We must take effective measures to help the people in the disaster area get out of their current predicament.

zh: 作为企业的核心领导，总经理必须具备卓越的决策能力。
pinyin: Zuòwéi qǐyè de héxīn lǐngdǎo, zǒng jīnglǐ bìxū jùbèi zhuóyuè de juécè nénglì.
en: As the core leader of the enterprise, the CEO must possess excellent decision-making capabilities.

zh: 面对竞争激烈的社会，许多年轻人感到无形的生存压力。
pinyin: miàn duì jìng zhēng jī liè de shè huì, xǔ duō nián qīng rén gǎn dào wú xíng de shēng cún yā lì.
en: Facing a highly competitive society, many young people feel intangible pressure of survival.

zh: 习惯于默读的读者往往能更快地捕捉到文章的核心逻辑。
pinyin: Xíguàn yú mòdú de dúzhě wǎngwǎng néng gèng kuài de bǔzhuō dào wénzhāng de héxīn luójí.
en: Readers accustomed to reading in silence are often able to grasp the core logic of an article more quickly.

zh: 这款显示器的分辨率极高，能够呈现出清晰细腻的图像。
pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xiǎnshìqì de fēnlǜ jī gāo, nénggòu chéngxiàn chū qīngxī xìnì de túxiàng.
en: This monitor has an extremely high resolution and can display clear and detailed images.

zh: 心理咨询热线在缓解民众焦虑情绪方面发挥了重要作用。
pinyin: Xīnlǐ zīxún rèxiàn zài huǎnjiě mínzhòng jiāolǜ qíngxù fāngmiàn fāhuīle zhòngyào zuòyòng.
en: The psychological counseling hotline has played an important role in alleviating public anxiety.

zh: 许多中国大妈在广场舞中展现了充沛的活力与社交热情。
pinyin: Xǔduō Zhōngguó dàmā zài guǎngchǎngwǔ zhōng zhǎnxiànle chōngpèi de huólì yǔ shǔ shèjiāo rèqíng.
en: Many middle-aged Chinese ladies demonstrate abundant vitality and social enthusiasm through square dancing.

zh: 在面临复杂局面时，采取稳妥的方针往往是明智的选择。
pinyin: Zài miànlín fùzá júmiàn shí, cǎiqǔ wěntuǒ de fāngzhēn wǎngwǎng shì míngzhì de xuǎnzé.
en: When facing complex situations, adopting a dependable policy is often a wise choice.

zh: 为了保护野生生物，动物园采取了许多科学的管理措施。
pinyin: Wèile bǎohù yěshēng shēngwù, dòngwùyuán cǎiqǔle xǔduō kēxué de guǎnlǐ cuòshī.
en: In order to protect wildlife, the zoo has adopted many scientific management measures.

zh: 在你启程远赴异国他乡之际，我衷心地祝愿你一路顺风。
pinyin: Zài nǐ qǐchéng yuǎnfù yìguótāxiāng zhī jì, wǒ zhōngxīn de zhùyuàn nǐ yīlùshùnfēng.
en: As you set off to a foreign land, I sincerely wish you a pleasant journey.

zh: 尽管这项工程看起来困难重重，但他依然决定迎难而上。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè xiàng gōngchéng kàn qǐ lai kùnnán chóngchóng, dàn tā yīrán juédìng yíngnán'érshàng.
en: Although this project seems fraught with difficulties, he still decided to face the challenge head-on.

zh: 他作为一名忠实的追随者，从未质疑过导师的任何决策。
pinyin: Tā zuòwéi yī míng zhōngshí de zhuīsuízhě, cóngwèi zhíyí guò dǎoshī de rènhé juécè.
en: As a faithful follower, he has never questioned any of the mentor's decisions.

zh: 由于遭遇严重的经济危机，这家公司不得不向政府求救。
pinyin: Yóuyú zāoyù yánzhòng de jīngjì wēijī, zhè jiā gōngsī bùdébù xiàng zhèngfǔ qiújiù.
en: Due to a severe economic crisis, the company had to seek help from the government.

zh: 科学家们正在致力于研究如何缓解地球气候变暖的趋势。
pinyin: Kēxuéjiā men zhèngzài zhìlì yú yánjiū rúhé huǎnjiě dìqiú qìhòu biànnuǎn de qūshì.
en: Scientists are working on researching how to mitigate the trend of global warming.

zh: 为了防止个人财产受损，请务必妥善保管好您的银行卡。
pinyin: Wèile fángzhǐ gèrén cáichǎn shòusǔn, qǐng wùbì tuǒshàn bǎoguǎn hǎo nín de yínhángkǎ.
en: In order to prevent personal property loss, please make sure to keep your bank card safe.

zh: 每逢节假日，这个景点总是挤满了来自全国各地的游客。
pinyin: Měiféng jiéjiàrì, zhège jǐngdiǎn zǒngshì jǐmǎnle láile zì quán guó gè dì de yóukè.
en: Every holiday, this tourist attraction is always crowded with tourists from all over the country.

zh: 对于孩子的成长而言，培养其独立思考的能力至关重要。
pinyin: Duìyú háizi de chéngzhǎng ér yán, péiyǎng qí dúlì sīkǎo de nénglì zhìguān zhòngyào.
en: For a child's growth, cultivating their ability to think independently is crucial.

zh: 面对复杂多变的国际局势，政府表现出难以掩饰的忧愁。
pinyin: Miànduì fùzá duōbiàn de guójì júshì, zhèngfǔ biǎoxiàn chū nányǐ yǎnshì de yōuchóu.
en: Faced with the complex and volatile international situation, the government shows unconcealable worry.

zh: 尽管采取了严格的预防措施，森林还是因干旱而着火了。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn cǎiqǔ le yángé de yùfáng cuòshī, sēnlín háishì yīn gānhàn ér zháohuǒ le.
en: Despite strict preventive measures, the forest caught fire due to the drought.

zh: 保护野生大熊猫的栖息地对于维护生物多样性至关重要。
pinyin: Bǎohù yěshēng dà xíongmāo de qīxīdì duìyú wéihù shēngwù duōyàngxìng zhìguān zhòngyào.
en: Protecting the habitat of wild giant pandas is crucial for maintaining biodiversity.

zh: 尽管店里顾客盈门，售货员依然能有条不紊地处理订单。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn diàn lǐ gùkè yíngmén, shòuhuòyuán yīrán néng yǒutiáobùwěn de chǔlǐ dìngdān.
en: Even though the store was crowded with customers, the sales clerk was still able to process orders in an orderly manner.

zh: 为了节约用水，这台洗衣机采用了先进的智能感应系统。
pinyin: Wèile jiéyuē yòngshuǐ, zhè tái xǐyījī cǎiyòng le xiānjìn de zhìnéng gǎnyìng xìtǒng.
en: In order to save water, this washing machine adopts an advanced intelligent sensor system.

zh: 这家邮局历史悠久，见证了当地邮政事业的发展与变迁。
pinyin: Zhè jiā yóujú lìshǐ yōujiǔ, jiànzhèng le dāngdì yóuzhèng shìyè de fāzhǎn yǔ biànqiān.
en: This post office has a long history, witnessing the development and changes of the local postal service.

zh: 依法纳税不仅是公民的义务，更是社会文明进步的体现。
pinyin: Yīfǎ nàshuì bùjǐn shì gōngmín de yìwù, gèng shì shèhuì wénmíng jìnbù de tǐxiàn.
en: Paying taxes according to the law is not only a citizen's duty but also a reflection of social progress.

zh: 这部文学作品凭借其独特的风格成为了独一无二的经典。
pinyin: Zhè bù wénxué zuòpǐn píngjiè qí dútè de fēnggé chéngwéi le dú yī wú èr de jīngdiǎn.
en: This literary work became a unique classic due to its distinctive style.

zh: 对于国家制定的长远规划，各级政府都不敢有丝毫怠慢。
pinyin: Duìyú guójiā zhìdìng de chángyuǎn guīhuà, gèjí zhèngfǔ dōu bù gǎn yǒu sīháo dàimàn.
en: Regarding the long-term plans established by the state, governments at all levels dare not be the slightest bit negligent.

zh: 他长期在外奔波，难以兼顾家庭，对妻子感到十分愧疚。
pinyin: Tā chángqī zài wài bēnbō, nányǐ jiāngù jiātíng, duì qīzǐ gǎndào shífēn kuìjiù.
en: He has been traveling for work for a long time, struggling to balance his family life, and feels very guilty toward his wife.

zh: 作为一种传统文化象征，茶馆儿承载了深厚的历史记忆。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī zhǒng chuántǒng wénhuà xiàngzhēng, cháguǎnr chéngzài le shēnhòu de lìshǐ jìyì.
en: As a symbol of traditional culture, the teahouse carries profound historical memories.

zh: 为了制定长远规划，我们需要深入研究行业的发展动向。
pinyin: Wèile zhìdìng chángyuǎn guīhuà, wǒmen xūyào shēnrù yánjiū hángyè de fāzhǎn dòngxiàng.
en: In order to formulate long-term plans, we need to deeply study the development trends of the industry.

zh: 这种人体工程学鼠标旨在减轻长时间使用后的手部疲劳。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng réntǐ gōngchéngxué shǔbiāo zhǐ zài jiǎnqīng cháng shíjiān shǐyòng hòu de shǒubù píláo.
en: This ergonomic mouse is designed to reduce hand fatigue after long periods of use.

zh: 无论面对多么复杂的环境，他总能保持稳定的射击姿势。
pinyin: Wúlùn miànduì duōme fùzá de huánjìng, tā zǒng néng bǎochí wěndìng de shèjī zīshì.
en: No matter how complex the environment is, he can always maintain a stable shooting posture.

zh: 很多外国人在申请中国永久居留权时必须放弃原有国籍。
pinyin: Hěnduō wàiguórén zài shēnqǐng Zhōngguó yǒngjiǔ jūliúquán shí bìxū fàngqì yuányǒu guójí.
en: Many foreigners must renounce their original nationality when applying for permanent residency in China.

zh: 为了建立可信的品牌形象，公司采取了严格的质量标准。
pinyin: Wèile jiànlì kěxìn de pǐnpái xíngxiàng, gōngsī cǎiqǔle yángé de zhìliàng biāozhǔn.
en: In order to build a trustworthy brand image, the company adopted strict quality standards.

zh: 如今他已成为一名著名的教授，依然保持着谦虚的态度。
pinyin: Rújīn tā yǐ chéngwéi yī míng zhùmíng de jiàoshòu, yīrán bǎochí zhe qiānxū de tàidù.
en: Nowadays, he has become a famous professor, yet he still maintains a humble attitude.

zh: 一句话，这种策略虽然激进，却是扭转局势的唯一途径。
pinyin: Yī jù huà, zhè zhǒng cèlüè suīrán jījìn, què shì niǔzhuǎn júshì de wéiyī tújìng.
en: In a word, although this strategy is radical, it is the only way to reverse the situation.

zh: 经过慎重考虑，我们决定通过公函的形式正式予以回复。
pinyin: Jīngguò shènzhòng kǎolǜ, wǒmen juédìng tōngguò gōnghán de xíngshì zhèngshì yǔyǐ huífù.
en: After careful consideration, we decided to give a formal response in the form of an official letter.

zh: 经过反复斟酌，双方最终就签署协议的日期达成了共识。
pinyin: Jīngguò fǎnfù zhēnzhuó, shuāngfāng zuìzhōng jiù qiānshǔ xiéyì de rìqī dáchéng le gòngshí.
en: After careful consideration, both parties finally reached a consensus on the date for signing the agreement.

zh: 尽管那儿的地理位置比较偏僻，但依然吸引了许多游客。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn nàr de dìlǐ wèizhì bǐjiào piānpì, dàn yīrán xīyǐnle xǔduō yóukè.
en: Although the geographical location there is relatively remote, it still attracts many tourists.

zh: 为了解决这个问题，公司专门聘请了几位领域内的专家。
pinyin: Wèile jiějué zhège wèntí, gōngsī zhuānmén pìnqǐngle jǐ wèi lǐngyù nèi de zhuānjiā.
en: In order to solve this problem, the company specifically hired several experts in the field.

zh: 这项提议在大会上获得了通过，随后正式进入实施阶段。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng tíyì zài dàhuì shàng huòdéle tōngguò, suíhòu zhèngshì jìnrù shíshī jiēduàn.
en: This proposal was passed at the conference, and soon after it officially entered the implementation phase.

zh: 虽然他每天重复同样的操作，却从不表现出厌烦的情绪。
pinyin: Suīrán tā měitiān chóngfù tóngyàng de cāozuò, què cóngbù biǎoxiàn chū yànfán de qíngxù.
en: Although he repeats the same operations every day, he never shows any sign of boredom.

zh: 他的言论让他成为了众矢之的，简直就像一个活动的靶子。
pinyin: tā de yán lùn ràng tā chéng wéi zhòng shǐ zhī dì, jiǎn zhí jiù xiàng yī gè huó dòng de bǎ zi.
en: His remarks made him a target of public criticism, just like a moving target.

zh: 通过更新博客，他逐渐建立起了自己在该领域的专业声誉。
pinyin: Tōngguò gēngxīn bókè, tā zhújiàn jiànlì qǐle zìjǐ zài gāi lǐngyù de zhuānyè shēngyù.
en: By updating his blog, he gradually established his professional reputation in the field.

zh: 该学院致力于为每一位就读的学生提供高质量的教育资源。
pinyin: gāi xuéyuàn zhìlì yú wèi měi yī wèi jiùdú de xuéshēng tígōng gāo zhìliàng de jiàoyù zīyuán.
en: The college is committed to providing high-quality educational resources to every student enrolled.

zh: 他不仅拒不认错，还对受害者表现出极度傲慢，拒绝道歉。
pinyin: Tā bùjǐn jù bù rèncuò, hái duì shòuhàizhě biǎoxiàn chū jídù àomàn, jùjué dàoqiàn.
en: Not only did he refuse to admit his mistake, but he also showed extreme arrogance toward the victim and refused to apologize.

zh: 我们要深刻反思为何传统的道德观念在现代社会逐渐淡化。
pinyin: wǒ men yào shēn kè fǎn sī wèi hé chuán tǒng de dào dé guān niàn zài xiàn dài shè huì zhú jiàn dàn huà.
en: We must reflect deeply on why traditional moral values are gradually fading in modern society.

zh: 当最后一枚焰火在夜空中绽放时，全场观众都欢呼了起来。
pinyin: dāng zuì hòu yī méi yàn huǒ zài yè kōng zhōng zhàn fàng shí, quán chǎng quán chǎng guān zhòng dōu huān hū le qǐ lái.
en: When the last firework bloomed in the night sky, the whole audience cheered.

zh: 由于季节更替，该地区在十月下旬常有大范围的降温现象。
pinyin: Yóuyú jìjié gēngtì, gāi dìqū zài shí yuè xiàxún cháng yǒu dà fànwéi de jiàngwēn xiànxiàng.
en: Due to the change of seasons, the region often experiences widespread temperature drops in the last third of October.

zh: 在做出重大决策之前，必须对各种潜在风险进行深入推敲。
pinyin: Zài zuòchū zhòngdà juécè zhīqián, bìxū duì gèzhǒng qiánzài fēngxiǎn jìnxíng shēnrù tuīqiāo.
en: Before making a major decision, one must carefully weigh the various potential risks.

zh: 这种文学创作上的怀旧情结，反映了他对传统文化的眷恋。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wénxué chuàngzuò shàng de huáijiù qíngjié, fǎnyìngle tā duì chuántǒng wénhuà de juànliàn.
en: This kind of nostalgia in literary creation reflects his attachment to traditional culture.

zh: 他在艺术领域不断尝试新奇的表达手法，追求卓越的创新。
pinyin: Tā zài yìshù lǐngyù bùduàn chángshì xīnqí de biǎodá shǒufǎ, zhuīqiú zhuóyuè de chuàngxīn.
en: He constantly experiments with novel expressive techniques in the field of art, pursuing excellence in innovation.

zh: 在这个充满竞争的时代，人们普遍渴望内心的宁静与安稳。
pinyin: Zài zhège chōngmǎn jìngzhēng de shídài, rénmen pǔbiàn kěwàng nèixīn de níngjìng yǔ ānwěn.
en: In this competitive era, people generally long for inner peace and stability.

zh: 这所学校致力于培养具备卓越创新思维和综合素质的人才。
pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào zhìlì yú péiyǎng jùbèi zhuóyuè chuàngxīn sīwéi hé zōnghé sùzhì de réncái.
en: This school is dedicated to cultivating talents with excellent innovative thinking and comprehensive quality.

zh: 由于长期致力于科研，教授在学术领域积累了丰硕的著作。
pinyin: yóuyú chángqī zhìlì yú kēyán, jiàoshòu zài xuéshù lǐngyù jīlěi le fēngshuò de zhùzuò.
en: Due to his long-term dedication to scientific research, the professor has accumulated a bountiful collection of academic works.

zh: 为了达到令观众满意的演出效果，剧组排练了整整三个月。
pinyin: Wèile dádào lìng guānzhòng mǎnyì de yǎnchū xiàoguǒ, jùzǔ páiliàn le zhěngzhěng sān gè yuè.
en: In order to achieve a performance effect to the audience's satisfaction, the crew rehearsed for three whole months.

zh: 为了保证产品质量，公司对所有原材料进行了严格的筛选。
pinyin: Wèile bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn zhìliàng, gōngsī duì suǒyǒu yuáncáiliào jìnxíng le yángé de shāixuǎn.
en: In order to ensure product quality, the company conducted strict screening of all raw materials.

zh: 这座历史悠久的古城，白天与夜晚展现出截然不同的风采。
pinyin: zhè zuò lì shǐ yōu jiǔ de gǔ chéng, bái tiān yǔ yè wǎn zhǎn xiàn chū jié rán bù tóng de fēng cǎi.
en: This historic ancient city displays completely different styles during the day and at night.

zh: 虽然遭遇了巨大的挫折，但他在崩溃边缘依然保持着理智。
pinyin: Suīrán zāoyù le jùdà de cuòzhé, dàn tā zài bēngkuì biānyuán yīrán bǎochí zhe lǐzhì.
en: Although he encountered huge setbacks, he still maintained his sanity on the verge of collapse.

zh: 随着投影技术的革新，银幕的色彩表现力得到了显著提升。
pinyin: Suízhe tóuyǐng jìshù de géxīn, yínmù de sècǎi biǎoxiànlì dédào le xiǎnzhù tíshēng.
en: With the innovation of projection technology, the color performance of the movie screen has been significantly improved.

zh: 在这场难得的艺术展览中，观众可以尽情领略大师的风采。
pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng nándé de yìshù zhǎnlǎn zhōng, guānzhòng kěyǐ jìnqíng lǐnglüè dàshī de fēngcǎi.
en: In this rare art exhibition, visitors can enjoy the master's style to their hearts' content.

zh: 通过统计学方法，我们可以计算出该事件发生的理论概率。
pinyin: tōng guò tǒng jì xué fāng fǎ, wǒ men kě yǐ jì suàn chū gāi shì jiàn fā shēng de lǐ lùn gài lǜ.
en: By using statistical methods, we can calculate the theoretical probability of the event occurring.

zh: 由于疏忽大意，他不慎将办公室的钥匙遗落在出租车里了。
pinyin: Yóuyú shūhū dàyì, tā búshèn jiāng bàngōngshì de yàoshi yíluò zài chūzūchē lǐ le.
en: Due to his carelessness, he accidentally left his office key in the taxi.

zh: 在处理这类紧急危机时，他非得亲自过问每一个细节不可。
pinyin: Zài chǔlǐ zhèi lèi jǐnjí wēijī shí, tā fēiděi qīnzì guòwèn měi yī gè xìjié bùkě.
en: When dealing with such emergencies, he insists on checking every detail personally.

zh: 在那个遥远的时代，人们普遍认为人类的命运由上帝主宰。
pinyin: Zài nàge yáoyuǎn de shídài, rénmen pǔbiàn rènwéi rénlèi de mìngyùn yóu Shàngdì zhǔzài.
en: In that distant era, people generally believed that human destiny was governed by God.

zh: 为了保障系统的稳定性，我们需要对服务器进行全面升级。
pinyin: Wèile bǎozhàng xìtǒng de wěndìngxìng, wǒmen xūyào duì fúwùqì jìnxíng quánmiàn shēngjí shěān shēngjíǎn shēngjí.
en: To ensure system stability, we need to perform a comprehensive upgrade of the server.

zh: 这种挫折并没有让他变得垂头丧气，反而激发了他的斗志。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cuòzhé bìng méiyǒu ràng tā biàn dé chuí tóu sàng qì, fǎn'ér jīfā le tā de dòuzhì.
en: This setback did not make him crestfallen, but instead sparked his fighting spirit.

zh: 经过几年的实践，他已成长为一名经验丰富的资深工程师。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ nián de shíjiàn, tā yǐ chéngzhǎng wéi yī míng jīngyàn fēngfù de zīshēn gōngchéngshī.
en: After years of practice, he has grown into an experienced senior engineer.

zh: 这项体检旨在评估员工在极端工作环境下的生理承受能力。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng tǐjiǎn zhǐ zài pínggū yuángōng zài jíduān gōngzuò huánjìng xià de shēnglǐ chéngshòu nénglì.
en: This medical check-up aims to evaluate the physiological endurance of employees under extreme working environments.

zh: 这种材料的密度很大，因此其单位体积的重量也相应增加。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào de mìdù hěn dà, yīncǐ qí dānwèi tǐjī de zhòngliàng yě xiāngyìng zēngjiā.
en: The density of this material is very high, so its weight per unit volume increases accordingly.

zh: 随着电讯基础设施的完善，偏远地区也能享受到高速网络。
pinyin: Suízhe diànxùn jīchǔ shèshī de wánshàn, piānyuǎn dìqū yě néng xiǎngshòu dào gāosù wǎngluò.
en: With the improvement of telecommunications infrastructure, remote areas can also enjoy high-speed networks.

zh: 经过几年的精心修缮，这座清真寺终于恢复了往日的辉煌。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ nián de jīngxīn xiūshàn, zhè zuò qīngzhēnsì zhōngyú huīfù le wǎngrì de huīhuáng.
en: After several years of careful renovation, the mosque finally regained its former glory.

zh: 随着电池技术的突破，电动车的续航里程得到了显著提升。
pinyin: Suízhe diànchí jìshù de tūpò, diàn dòng chē de xùháng lǐchéng dédàole xiǎnzhù tíshēng.
en: With breakthroughs in battery technology, the driving range of electric vehicles has significantly improved.

zh: 经过漫长的后期筹备，该纪录片在艰苦的环境下圆满关机。
pinyin: Jīngguò màncháng de hòuqī chóubèi, gāi jìlùpiàn zài jiānkǔ de huánjìng xià yuánmǎn guān jī.
en: After long post-production preparations, the documentary successfully finished shooting under harsh conditions.

zh: 为了减轻副作用，他特意请教了专家关于服用中药的禁忌。
pinyin: Wèile jiǎnqīng fùzuòyòng, tā tèyì qǐngjiào le zhuānjiā guānyú fúyòng zhōngyào de jìnjì.
en: In order to reduce side effects, he specifically consulted an expert about the contraindications of taking traditional Chinese medicine.

zh: 会议将首先总结过去一年的业绩，其次布置下季度的任务。
pinyin: Huìyì jiāng shǒuxiān zǒngjié guòqù yī nián de yèjì, qícì bùzhì xià jìdù de rènwù.
en: The meeting will summarize last year's performance first, and arrange next quarter's tasks next.

zh: 为了保障您的财产安全，请勿向任何人泄露您的银行账号。
pinyin: Wèile bǎozhàng nín de cáichǎn ānquán, qǐng wù xiàng rènhé rén xièlòu nín de yínháng zhànghào.
en: In order to ensure the security of your assets, please do not disclose your bank account number to anyone.

zh: 尽管医疗设备不断更新，医生依然认为临床经验至关重要。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn yī liáo shè bèi bù duàn gēng xīn, yī shēng yī rán rèn wéi lín chuáng jīng yàn zhì guān zhòng yào.
en: Although medical equipment is constantly being updated, doctors still believe that clinical experience is crucial.

zh: 他不仅具有卓越的才干，而且始终坚守着当初许下的诺言。
pinyin: Tā bùjǐn jùyǒu zhuóyuè de cáigàn, érqiě shǐzhōng jiānshǒuzhe dāngchū xǔxià de nuòyán.
en: He not only possesses exceptional talent but has also remained steadfast in keeping the promise he made originally.

zh: 哈哈，与其在这里唉声叹气，不如振作起来寻找解决方案。
pinyin: hā hā, yǔ qí zài zhè lǐ āi shēng tàn qì, bù rú zhèn zuò qǐ lái xún zhǎo jiě jué fāng àn.
en: Haha, rather than sighing here, it is better to pull yourself together and look for a solution.

zh: 在某些文化中，红色不仅是喜庆的颜色，更是吉祥的符号。
pinyin: zài mǒuxiē wénhuà zhōng, hóngsè bùjǐn shì xǐqìng de yánsè, gèng shì jíxiáng de fúhào.
en: In some cultures, red is not only a festive color but also a symbol of good fortune.

zh: 这家连锁超市通过精细化的管理，大幅度降低了运营成本。
pinyin: Zhè jiā liánsuǒ chāoshì tōngguò jīngxìhuà de guǎnlǐ, dàfúdù jiàngdīle yùnyíng chéngběn.
en: This supermarket chain has significantly reduced operating costs through refined management.

zh: 随着基础设施的完善，公共汽车网络已覆盖了偏远的郊区。
pinyin: Suízhe jīchǔ shèshī de wánshàn, gōnggòng qìchē wǎngluò yǐ fùgàile piānyuǎn de jiāoqū.
en: With the improvement of infrastructure, the bus network has covered the remote suburbs.

zh: 在辩论赛中，对手不断地向他出难题，试图让他陷入困境。
pinyin: Zài biànlùnsài zhōng, duìshǒu bùduàn de xiàng tā chū nántí, shìtú ràng tā xiànrù kùnjìng.
en: In the debate competition, the opponent constantly posed tough questions to him, attempting to put him in a difficult position.

zh: 对待挫折的态度，往往决定了一个人如何看待自身的价值。
pinyin: Duìdài cuòzhé de tàidù, wǎngwǎng juédìngle yīgè rén rúhé kàndài zìshēn de jiàzhí.
en: One's attitude toward setbacks often determines how one looks upon one's own value.

zh: 方言往往保留了古老的语音特点，形成了独特的地域口音。
pinyin: Fāngyán wǎngwǎng bǎoliú le gǔlǎo de yǔyīn tèdiǎn, xíngchéng le dútè de dìyù kǒuyīn.
en: Dialects often preserve ancient phonetic features, forming unique regional accents.

zh: 他精心布置了晚宴现场，力求营造出一种浪漫的艺术情调。
pinyin: Tā jīngxīn bùzhìle wǎnyàn xiànchǎng, lìqiú yíngzào chū yī zhǒng làngmàn de yìshù qíngdiào.
en: He meticulously arranged the dinner venue, striving to create a romantic artistic ambience.

zh: 为了应对突发的传染病，卫生部门制定了严格的防疫措施。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì tūfā de chuánrǎnbìng, wèishēng bùmén zhìdìngle yángé de fángyì cuòshī.
en: In order to respond to the sudden outbreak of an infectious disease, the health department formulated strict epidemic prevention measures.

zh: 为了应对日益增长的需求，我们需要增加生产设备的投入。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì rìyì zēngzhǎng de xūqiú, wǒmen xūyào zēngjiā shēngchǎn shèbèi de tóurù.
en: To cope with the growing demand, we need to increase investment in production equipment.

zh: 为了应对气候危机，各国正致力于减少二氧化碳的排放量。
pinyin: wèi le yìng duì qì hòu wēi jī, gè guó zhèng zhì lì yú jiǎn shǎo èr yǎng huà tàn de pái fàng liàng.
en: In order to address the climate crisis, countries are committed to reducing carbon dioxide emissions.

zh: 由于长期的脑部损伤，他逐渐丧失记忆，最终患上了痴呆。
pinyin: yóuyú chángqī de nǎobù sǔnshāng, tā zhújiàn sàngshī jìyì, zuìzhōng huànshàngle chīdāi.
en: Due to long-term brain injury, he gradually lost his memory and eventually suffered from dementia.

zh: 经过好久的反复推敲，他终于完成了这份详尽的调研报告。
pinyin: Jīngguò hǎojiǔ de fǎnfù tuīqiāo, tā zhōngyú wánchéng le zhè fèn xiángjìn de diàoyán bàogào.
en: After a long period of repeated deliberation, he finally completed this detailed research report.

zh: 鉴于项目正处于关键阶段，主管婉言谢绝了他请假的请求。
pinyin: Jiànyú xiàngmù zhèng chǔyú guānjiàn jiēduàn, zhǔguǎn wǎnyán xièjué le tā qǐngjià de qǐngqiú.
en: Given that the project is at a critical stage, the supervisor politely declined his request for leave.

zh: 这些历史遗迹不仅是珍贵的文化遗产，也是民族精神的象征。
pinyin: Zhè xiē lìshǐ yíjì bùjǐn shì zhēnguì de wénhuà yíchǎn, yě shì mínzú jīngshén de xiàngzhēng.
en: These historical sites are not only precious cultural heritage, but also symbols of the national spirit.

zh: 成功往往不仅依赖于个人的天分，更取决于后天的艰苦奋斗。
pinyin: Chénggōng wǎngwǎng bùjǐn yīlài yú gèrén de tiān fèn, gèng qǔjué yú hòutiān de jiānkǔ fèndòu.
en: Success often depends not only on individual natural gift, but even more on hard work afterwards.

zh: 学校不仅致力于学术研究，还十分重视校园文化氛围的营造。
pinyin: Xuéxiào bùjǐn zhìlì yú xuéshù yánjiū, hái shífēn zhòngshì xiàoyuán wénhuà fēnwéi de yíngzào.
en: The school is not only committed to academic research but also attaches great importance to cultivating a campus cultural atmosphere.

zh: 面对突如其来的变故，他从亲友那里获得了巨大的精神慰藉。
pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de biàngù, tā cóng qīnyǒu nàlǐ huòdéle jùdà de jīngshén wèijiè.
en: Facing the sudden turn of events, he received great spiritual comfort from his friends and relatives.

zh: 只有发扬愚公移山的精神，才能克服前进道路上的艰巨挑战。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu fāyáng Yú gōng yí shān de jīngshén, cáinéng kèfú qiánjìn dàolù shàng de jiānjù tiǎozhàn.
en: Only by carrying forward the spirit of the old man moving mountains can we overcome the arduous challenges on the path of progress.

zh: 为了迎接盛大的节日，当地居民提前准备了丰富的庆典活动。
pinyin: Wèile yíngjiē shèngdà de jiérì, dāngdì jūmín tíqián zhǔnbèi le fēngfù de qìngdiǎn huódòng.
en: In order to welcome the grand festival, local residents prepared rich celebratory activities in advance.

zh: 无论离家多远，大家都会尽量赶在过年之前回家与家人团聚。
pinyin: Wúlùn lí jiā duō yuǎn, dàjiā dūhuì jǐnliàng gǎn zài guònián zhīqián huí jiā yǔ jiārén tuánjù.
en: No matter how far away from home, everyone will try their best to return home to reunite with their families before Chinese New Year.

zh: 身为领导者，若是能做到不耻下问，必然能赢得下属的尊重。
pinyin: Shēnwéi lǐngdǎozhě, ruò shì néng zuò dào bù chǐ xià wèn, bìrán néng yíngdé xiàshǔ de zūnzhòng.
en: As a leader, if one can be not ashamed to ask subordinates, one will certainly win their respect.

zh: 这项技术固然具有优势，但维护成本也是我们要考虑的因素。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù gùrán jùyǒu yōushì, dàn wéihù chéngběn yěshì wǒmen yào kǎolǜ de yīnsù.
en: This technology is admittedly advantageous, but maintenance cost is also a factor we must consider.

zh: 尽管岁月流逝，那场惊心动魄的比赛过程，他依然记忆犹新。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn suìyuè liúshì, nà chǎng jīngxīndòngpò de bǐsài guòchéng, tā yīrán jì yì yóu xīn.
en: Despite the passage of time, he still remembers the thrilling process of that match vividly.

zh: 只有透彻了解市场需求，企业才能在激烈的竞争中脱颖而出。
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu tòu chè liǎo jiě shì chǎng xū qiú, qǐ yè cái néng zài jī liè de jìng zhēng zhōng tuō yǐng ér chū.
en: Only by having a penetrating understanding of market demands can an enterprise stand out in fierce competition.

zh: 在那段艰难的岁月里，许多人为了生存不得不跋山涉水求医。
pinyin: Zài nà duàn jiānnán de suìyuè lǐ, xǔduō rén wèile shēngcún bùdébù báshānshèshuǐ qiú yī.
en: During those difficult times, many people had to travel long distances to seek medical treatment to survive.

zh: 面对突如其来的变故，他吓得瘫坐在地，半晌没能动弹分毫。
pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de biàngù, tā xià de tānzuò zài dì, bànshǎng méi néng dòngtan fénháo.
en: Faced with the sudden turn of events, he slumped to the ground in fear and could not budge an inch for a long while.

zh: 新闻发布会现场气氛热烈，记者们七嘴八舌地向发言人提问。
pinyin: xīnwén fābùhuì xiànchǎng qìfēn rèliè, jìzhěmen qīzuǐbāshé de xiàng fāyánrén tíwèn.
en: The atmosphere at the press conference was lively, with reporters asking the spokesperson questions all at once.

zh: 在面临巨大的压力时，他从不惊慌失措，总是能够保持冷静。
pinyin: Zài miànlín jùdà de yālì shí, tā cóngbù jīnghuāng shīcuò, zǒng shì nénggòu bǎochí lěngjìng.
en: When facing immense pressure, he never panics and is always able to remain calm.

zh: 随着经济的发展，东南地区的产业结构正在发生剧烈的转型。
pinyin: suí zhe jīng jì de fā zhǎn, dōng nán dì qū de chǎn yè jié gòu zhèng zài fā shēng jù liè de zhuǎn xíng.
en: With the development of the economy, the industrial structure in the southeast region is undergoing a drastic transformation.

zh: 品尝一口软糯的汤圆，浓郁的芝麻香气瞬间在口中弥漫开来。
pinyin: pǐn cháng yī kǒu ruǎn nuò de tāng yuán, nóng yù de zhī ma xiāng qì shùn jiān zài kǒu zhōng mí màn kāi lái.
en: Tasting a soft and sticky tangyuan, the rich aroma of sesame instantly fills the mouth.

zh: 在正式的社交场合，得体的穿着反映了一个人的教养与礼貌。
pinyin: Zài zhèngshì de shèjiāo chǎnghé, détǐ de chuānzhuó fǎnyìng le yī gè rén de jiàoyǎng yǔ lǐmào.
en: In formal social situations, appropriate attire reflects a person's upbringing and manners.

zh: 作为纳税人，他积极履行义务，同时也捍卫自己的合法权益。
pinyin: Zuòwéi nàshuìrén, tā jījí lǚxíng yìwù, tóngshí yě hànwèi zìjǐ de héfǎ quányì.
en: As a taxpayer, he actively fulfills his obligations while also defending his legitimate rights and interests.

zh: 随着城市化进程的加快，北京的交通状况发生了显著的变化。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshìhuà jìnchéng de jiākuài, Běijīng de jiāotōng zhuàngkuàng fāshēng le xiǎnzhù de biànhuà.
en: With the acceleration of urbanization, the traffic conditions in Beijing have undergone significant changes.

zh: 为了维持剧团的日常运作，他们不得不寻求外部资金的支持。
pinyin: Wèile wéichí jùtuán de rìcháng yùnzuò, tāmen bùdébù xúnqiú wàibù zījīn de zhīchí.
en: In order to maintain the daily operations of the theatrical troupe, they had to seek external financial support.

zh: 雨水不仅滋润了干涸的土地，也为农作物提供了充足的水分。
pinyin: Yǔshuǐ bùjǐn zīrùn le gānhé de tǔdì, yě wèi nóngzuòwù tígōng le chōngzú de shuǐfèn.
en: Rainwater not only moistens the parched land but also provides sufficient moisture for crops.

zh: 尽管上期的项目进展缓慢，但我们最终还是按时完成了任务。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn shàng qī de xiàng mù jìn zhǎn huǎn màn, dàn wǒ men zuì zhōng hái shì àn shí wán chéng le rèn wu.
en: Although the project's progress was slow in the previous period, we eventually completed the task on time.

zh: 在缺乏充分调研的情况下采取行动，无疑是一种鲁莽的行为。
pinyin: Zài quēfá chōngfèn diàoyán de qíngkuàng xià cǎiqǔ xíngdòng, wúyí shì yī zhǒng lǔmǎng de xíngwéi.
en: Taking action in the absence of sufficient research is undoubtedly a hot-headed behavior.

zh: 这位老僧人不仅精通佛法，还对中国传统文化有深刻的研究。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo sēngrén bùjǐn jīngtōng fófǎ, hái duì Zhōngguó chuántǒng wénhuà yǒu shēnkè de yánjiū.
en: This old monk is not only proficient in Buddhism but also has profound research into traditional Chinese culture.

zh: 作为一名负责任的教师，他习惯于在放学后为学生无偿补课。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng fùzérèn de jiàoshī, tā xíguàn yú zài fàngxué hòu wèi xuésheng wúcháng bǔkè.
en: As a responsible teacher, he is accustomed to providing free tutoring for students after school ends.

zh: 他虽对这突如其来的好运感到半信半疑，但内心仍充满喜悦。
pinyin: Tā suī duì zhè tūrúqílái de hǎoyùn gǎndào bàn xìn bàn yí, dàn nèixīn réng chōngmǎn xǐyuè.
en: Although he felt half-believing about this sudden stroke of luck, his heart was still filled with joy.

zh: 为了在截止日期前完成项目，团队成员不得不连续熬夜赶工。
pinyin: Wèile zài jiézhǐ rìqī qián wánchéng xiàngmù, tuánduì chéngyuán bùdébù liánxù áoyè gǎngōng.
en: In order to complete the project before the deadline, team members had to stay up late continuously to rush the work.

zh: 通过这种方式，他不仅掌握了主动权，还增加了谈判的筹码。
pinyin: Tōngguò zhè zhǒng fāngshì, tā bùjǐn zhǎngwòle zhǔdòngquán, hái zēngjiāle tánpàn de chóumǎ.
en: Through this method, he not only gained the initiative but also increased his bargaining chips.

zh: 为了呈现原汁原味的古典文学艺术，剧团进行了深入的考证。
pinyin: Wèile chéngxiàn yuán zhī yuán wèi de gǔdiǎn wénxué yìshù, jùtuán jìnxíngle shēnrù de kǎozhèng.
en: In order to present the original flavor of classical literature and art, the theater troupe conducted in-depth research.

zh: 那座古老的寺庙坐落在山顶，即便老远也能感受到它的庄严。
pinyin: Nà zuò gǔlǎo de sìmiào zuòluò zài shāndǐng, jíbiàn lǎoyuǎn yě néng gǎnshòu dào tā de zhuāngyán.
en: That ancient temple is situated on the mountaintop, and one can feel its solemnity even from a great distance.

zh: 在全球化背景下，美德两国在科技创新领域的竞争日益激烈。
pinyin: Zài quánqiúhuà bèijǐng xià, Měi Dé liǎng guó zài kējì chuàngxīn lǐngyù de jìngzhēng rìyì jīliè.
en: Under the background of globalization, competition between the USA and Germany in the field of technological innovation is becoming increasingly fierce.

zh: 这位哲学家创立了独特的思想体系，对后世产生了深远影响。
pinyin: Zhè wèi zhéxuéjiā chuànglì le dútè de sīxiǎng tǐxì, duì hòushì chǎnshēng le shēnyuǎn yǐngxiǎng.
en: This philosopher established a unique ideological system, which had a profound impact on later generations.

zh: 他们签署了一份关于技术转让的协议，旨在加强双方的合作。
pinyin: Tāmen qiānshǔ le yī fèn guānyú jìshù zhuǎnràng de xiéyì, zhǐ zài jiāqiáng shuāngfāng de hézuò.
en: They signed an agreement on technology transfer, aiming to strengthen cooperation between the two sides.

zh: 通过大规模的战术演习，部队的协同作战能力得到了显著提升。
pinyin: Tōngguò dàguīmó de zhànshù yǎnxí, bùduì de xiétóng zuòzhàn nénglì dédàole xiǎnzhù tíshēng.
en: Through large-scale tactical drills, the unit's cooperative combat capability has been significantly improved.

zh: 由于事态的发展过于曲折，我完全没想到最后的结果竟是如此。
pinyin: yóu yú shì tài de fā zhǎn guò yú qū zhé, wǒ wán quán méi xiǎng dào zuì hòu de jié guǒ jìng shì rú cǐ.
en: Due to the twists and turns in the development of the situation, I never expected the final outcome to be like this.

zh: 番茄富含维生素，经常食用对维持人体机能有显著的辅助作用。
pinyin: Fānqié fùhán wéishēngsù, jīngcháng shíyòng duì wéichí réntǐ jīnéng yǒu xiǎnzhù de fǔzhù zuòyòng.
en: Tomatoes are rich in vitamins, and regular consumption has a significant auxiliary effect on maintaining bodily functions.

zh: 在这个竞争激烈的时代，许多机构都极其看重个人的综合素质。
pinyin: Zài zhège jìngzhēng jīliè de shídài, xǔduō jīgòu dōu jíqí kànzhòng gèrén de zōnghé sùzhì.
en: In this era of fierce competition, many institutions place extreme importance on an individual's comprehensive quality.

zh: 尽管做了充分的调研，项目的进展依然出现了意料之外的变数。
pinyin: Jǐn guǎn zuò le chōng fèn de diào yán, xiàng mù de jìn zhǎn yī rán chū xiàn le yì liào zhī wài de biàn shù.
en: Despite thorough research, the project's progress still encountered unforeseen variables contrary to expectation.

zh: 嫂子不仅在工作中表现出色，在处理家庭关系方面也十分成熟。
pinyin: Sǎozi bùjǐn zài gōngzuò zhōng biǎoxiàn chūsè, zài chǔlǐ jiātíng guānxì fāngmiàn yě shífēn chéngshú.
en: My sister-in-law is not only excellent at work but also very mature in handling family relationships.

zh: 科学研究在这一领域仍存在明显的空白，需要我们进一步探索。
pinyin: Kēxué yánjiū zài zhè yī lǐngyù réng cúnzài míngxiǎn de kòngbái, xūyào wǒmen jìnyībù tànsuǒ.
en: There are still obvious blank spaces (gaps) in scientific research in this field that require our further exploration.

zh: 为了实现这个宏伟的目标，我们需要凝聚共识，一道不懈奋斗。
pinyin: Wèile shíxiàn zhège hóngwěi de mùbiāo, wǒmen xūyào níngjù gòngshí, yīdào bùxiè fèndòu.
en: In order to realize this grand goal, we need to build consensus and strive together unremittingly.

zh: 作为一名合格的领导，不仅要有远见，还要善于倾听员工意见。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng hégé de lǐngdǎo, bùjǐn yào yǒu yuǎnjiàn, hái yào shànyú qīngtīng yuángōng yìjiàn.
en: As a qualified leader, one must not only have vision but also be good at listening to employees' opinions.

zh: 他凭借顽强的意志，终于把那块巨石搬开了，没费太大的力气。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè wánqiáng de yìzhì, zhōngyú bǎ nà kuài jùshí bānkāi le, méi fèi tài dà de lìqì.
en: Relying on his tenacious will, he finally moved the boulder away without exerting too much effort.

zh: 无论发生什么，我们都应保持理性，切勿大惊小怪，草率行事。
pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme, wǒmen dōu yīng bǎochí lǐxìng, qièwù dà jīng xiǎo guài, cǎoshuài xíngshì.
en: No matter what happens, we should remain rational and avoid making a fuss or acting rashly.

zh: 他通过多年的努力，终于在跨国做生意方面取得了显著的成就。
pinyin: Tā tōngguò duōnián de nǔlì, zhōngyú zài kuàguó zuò shēngyì fāngmiàn qǔdéle xiǎnzhù de chéngjiù.
en: Through years of effort, he finally achieved significant success in doing international business.

zh: 姑姑虽然工作繁忙，但始终保持着严谨的工作态度，令人敬佩。
pinyin: Gūgu suīrán gōngzuò fánmáng, dàn shǐzhōng bǎochízhe yánjǐn de gōngzuò tàidù, lìng rén jìngpèi.
en: Although my aunt is busy with work, she always maintains a rigorous work attitude, which is admirable.

zh: 尽管这间办公室十分狭窄，但我依然欢迎你随时进来探讨问题。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè jiān bàngōngshì shífēn xiázhǎi, dàn wǒ yīrán huānyíng nǐ suíshí jìn lái tǎolù wèntí.
en: Although this office is very cramped, I still welcome you to come in and discuss issues at any time.

zh: 我们必须敏锐地捕捉到行业变革的趋势，从而制定长远的规划。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū mǐnruì de bǔzhuō dào hángyè biàngé de qūshì, cóng'ér zhìdìng chángyuǎn de guīhuà.
en: We must keenly capture the trends of industry transformation in order to formulate long-term plans.

zh: 在经历了那场突如其来的地震后，村民们依然处于受惊的状态。
pinyin: Zài jīnglì le nà chǎng tūrúqílái de dìzhèn hòu, cūnmínmen yīrán chǔyú shòujīng de zhuàngtài.
en: After experiencing that sudden earthquake, the villagers were still in a startled state.

zh: 通过精心的备课，他得以在课堂上深入浅出地讲解复杂的概念。
pinyin: Tōngguò jīngxīn de bèikè, tā déyǐ zài kètáng shàng shēnrùqiǎnchū de jiǎngjiě fùzá de gàiniàn.
en: Through meticulous lesson preparation, he is able to explain complex concepts in a simple way in class.

zh: 随着物联网技术的普及，越来越多的家用电器具备了联网功能。
pinyin: Suízhe wùliánwǎng jìshù de pǔjí, yuè lái yuè duō de jiāyòng diànqì jùbèile liánwǎng gōngnéng.
en: With the popularization of Internet of Things technology, more and more household appliances have network connection capabilities.

zh: 既然我们志同道合，不如一块儿携手共进，去实现我们的理想。
pinyin: Jìrán wǒmen zhìtóngdàohé, bùrú yīkuài'er xiéshǒu gòngjìn, qù shíxiàn wǒmen de lǐxiǎng.
en: Since we share common goals, why don't we join hands and move forward together to realize our ideals?

zh: 为了拍摄这种难得一见的野生动物，摄影师在森林里待了很久。
pinyin: Wèile pāishè zhè zhǒng nán dé yī jiàn de yěshēng dòngwù, shèyǐngshī zài sēnlín lǐ dàile hěnjiǔ.
en: To photograph this rare animal, the photographer stayed in the forest for a long time.

zh: 开幕式展现了该国深厚的文化底蕴，给世界留下了深刻的印象。
pinyin: Kāimùshì zhǎnxiàn le gāi guó shēnhòu de wénhuà dǐyùn, gěi shìjiè liúxià le shēnkè de yìnxiàng.
en: The opening ceremony showcased the country's profound cultural heritage and left a deep impression on the world.

zh: 经理正在召开紧急会议，但他听见敲门声，随即示意助手请进。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhèngzài zhàokāi jǐnjí huìyì, dàn tā tīngjiàn qiāomén shēng, suíjí shìyì zhùshǒu qǐng jìn.
en: The manager was holding an urgent meeting, but hearing the knock, he signaled his assistant to invite them in.

zh: 他那富有感染力的演讲展示了他卓越的口才与深厚的文学底蕴。
pinyin: Tā nà fùyǒu gǎnrǎnlì de yǎnjiǎng zhǎnshìle tā zhuóyuè de kǒucái yǔ shēnhòu de wénxué dǐyùn.
en: His contagious speech demonstrated his superb eloquence and profound literary background.

zh: 他在研究中详细阐述了天主教教义对社会道德规范的塑造作用。
pinyin: Tā zài yánjiū zhōng xiángxì chǎnshù le tiān zhǔ jiào jiàoyì duì shèhuì dàodé guīfàn de sùzào zuòyòng.
en: In his research, he elaborated on the role of Catholic doctrine in shaping social moral norms.

zh: 他凭借卓越的远见和创新精神，在竞争激烈的市场中迅速致富。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè zhuóyuè de yuǎnjiàn hé chuàngxīn jīngshén, zài jìngzhēng jīliè de shìchǎng zhōng xùnsù zhìfù.
en: Relying on his outstanding foresight and spirit of innovation, he quickly became rich in a highly competitive market.

zh: 在数字化支付普及的今天，依然有部分老人偏爱使用传统的存折。
pinyin: zài shùzìhuà zhīfù pǔjí de jīntiān, yīrán yǒu bùfèn lǎorén piān'ài shǐyòng chuántǒng de cúnzhé.
en: In today's era of widespread digital payments, some elderly people still prefer using traditional passbooks.

zh: 这项政策虽然出发点是好的，但在执行过程中暴露出了许多弊端。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè suīrán chūfādiǎn shì hǎo de, dàn zài zhíxíng guòchéng zhōng bàolù chūle xǔduō bìduān.
en: Although the starting point of this policy was good, it exposed many systemic problems during the implementation process.

zh: 在这座繁华的都市，早上忙碌的街头呈现出一派生机勃勃的景象。
pinyin: Zài zhè zuò fán huá de dū shì, zǎo shang máng lù de jiē tóu chéng xiàn chū yī pài shēng jī bó bó de jǐng xiàng.
en: In this bustling metropolis, the busy streets in the early morning present a vibrant scene.

zh: 服用这种药物后，他总算摆脱了失眠的困扰，能够安稳地睡着了。
pinyin: Fúyòng zhè zhǒng yàowù hòu, tā zǒngsuàn bǎituō le shīmián de kùnrǎo, nénggòu ānwěn de shuìzháo le.
en: After taking this medication, he finally got rid of his insomnia and was able to fall asleep peacefully.

zh: 为了进一步了解东北地区的工业发展，他去那里进行了实地考察。
pinyin: Wèile jìnyíbù liǎojiě dōngběi dìqū de gōngyè fāzhǎn, tā qù nàlǐ jìnxíngle shídì kǎochá.
en: To further understand the industrial development of the Northeast region, he went there for a field investigation.

zh: 由于经营状况不佳，这家公司的酒水业务遭遇了前所未有的挑战。
pinyin: Yóuyú jīngyíng zhuàngkuàng bù jiā, zhè jiā gōngsī de jiǔshuǐ yèwù zāoyù le qián suǒ wèi yǒu de tiǎozhàn.
en: Due to poor business conditions, the company's beverage business has encountered unprecedented challenges.

zh: 在极其严峻的形势下，他依然保持冷静，时刻提防着敌人的袭击。
pinyin: Zài jíqí yánjùn de xíngshì xià, tā yīrán bǎochí lěngjìng, shíkè dǐfángzhe dírén de xíjī.
en: Under extremely severe circumstances, he remained calm, constantly guarding against enemy attacks.

zh: 尽管成员们对这个方案持有不同的见解，但最终还是达成了一致。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chéngyuánmen duì zhège fāng'àn chíyǒu bùtóng de jiànjiě, dàn zuìzhōng háishì dáchéngle yīzhì.
en: Although the members held different opinions on this plan, they finally reached a consensus.

zh: 在当今动荡的国际局势下，和平共处是促进全球繁荣的根本前提。
pinyin: Zài dāngjīn dòngdàng de guójì júshì xià, hépíng gòngchǔ shì cùjìn quánqiú fánróng de gēnběn qiántí.
en: In today's turbulent international situation, peaceful coexistence is the fundamental prerequisite for promoting global prosperity.

zh: 他凭借着流利的西班牙语，成功在那家跨国企业谋得了一份职位。
pinyin: tā píngjièzhe liúlì de xībānyáyǔ, chénggōng zài nà jiā kuànguó qǐyè móudé le yī fèn zhíwèi.
en: Relying on his fluent Spanish, he successfully obtained a position at that multinational enterprise.

zh: 面对艰难的挑战，他依然死心塌地地追求自己的理想，绝不妥协。
pinyin: Miànduì jiānnán de tiǎozhàn, tā yīrán sǐ xīn tā dì de zhuīqiú zìjǐ de lǐxiǎng, juébù tuǒxié.
en: Facing difficult challenges, he remains hell-bent on pursuing his ideals, never compromising.

zh: 即使处于极度焦虑的状态，他也尽量克制自己，不向家人发脾气。
pinyin: Jíshǐ chǔyú jídù jiāolǜ de zhuàngtài, tā yě jǐnliàng kèzhì zìjǐ, bù xiàng jiārén fā píqì.
en: Even when in a state of extreme anxiety, he tries his best to restrain himself and not lose his temper with his family.

zh: 这位指挥家对这首乐曲的艺术处理非常独特，引起了观众的共鸣。
pinyin: Zhè wèi zhǐhuījiā duì zhè shǒu yuèqǔ de yìshù chǔlǐ fēicháng dútè, yǐnqǐle guānzhòng de gòngmíng.
en: The conductor's artistic interpretation of this musical composition is very unique and resonated with the audience.

zh: 由于这家酒楼具备得天独厚的地理优势，每天光顾的食客络绎不绝。
pinyin: Yóuyú zhè jiā jiǔlóu jùbèi détian-dúhòu de dìlǐ yōushì, měitiān guānggù de shíkè luòyì-bùjué.
en: Due to the restaurant's unique geographical advantage, the stream of customers visiting every day is endless.

zh: 尽管周围的环境十分嘈杂，他依然神情专注，一动不动地坐在桌前。
pinyin: jǐnguǎn zhōuwéi de huánjìng shífēn cáozá, tā yīrán shénqíng zhuānzhùzhuàn, yī dòng bù dòng de zuò zài zhuō qián.
en: Although the surrounding environment was very noisy, he remained focused and sat motionless at the table.

zh: 趁着这次难得的假期，他决定回国探亲，顺便拜访多年未见的老友。
pinyin: Chènzhe zhè cì nándé de jiàqī, tā juédìng huí guó tàn qīn, shùnbiàn bàifǎng duōnián wèi jiàn de lǎoyǒu.
en: Taking advantage of this rare vacation, he decided to return to his country to visit his family and incidentally pay a visit to old friends he hadn't seen for years.

zh: 航天员面临着巨大的身体挑战，但这无法阻挡他们探索宇宙的决心。
pinyin: Hángtiānyuán miànlínzhe jùdà de shēntǐ tiǎozhàn, dàn zhè wúfǎ zǔdǎng tāmen tànsuǒ yǔzhòu yǔzhòu de juéxīn.
en: Astronauts face tremendous physical challenges, but this cannot stop their determination to explore the universe.

zh: 那年轻人沉浸在成功的喜悦中，心里美滋滋的，对未来充满了憧憬。
pinyin: Nà niánqīngrén chénjìn zài chénggōng de xǐyuè zhōng, xīnlǐ měizīzī de, duì wèilái chōngmǎn le chōngjǐng.
en: The young man is immersed in the joy of success, feeling very happy and full of longing for the future.

zh: 这位艺术家的创作风格具有开天辟地的意义，彻底改变了现代艺术。
pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā de chuàngzuò fēnggé jùyǒu kāitiānpìdì de yìyì, chèdǐ gǎibiàn le xiàndài yìshù.
en: The artist's creative style has a pioneering significance, completely changing modern art.

zh: 在繁重的工作压力下，适度的休假有助于维持心理健康与工作效率。
pinyin: Zài fánzhòng de gōngzuò yālì xià, shìdù de xiūjià yǒu zhù yú wéichí xīnlǐ jiànkāng yǔ gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
en: Under heavy work pressure, an appropriate vacation helps maintain mental health and work efficiency.

zh: 这部科幻电影描述了一个离奇的时空幻觉，挑战了观众的逻辑思维。
pinyin: zhè bù kē huàn diàn yǐng miáo shù le yī gè lí qí de shí kōng huàn jué, tiǎo zhàn le guān zhòng de luó jí sī wéi sī wéi.
en: This sci-fi movie describes an odd space-time hallucination, challenging the audience's logical thinking.

zh: 随着自动化程度的提高，机器在很大程度上取代了繁重的人工劳动。
pinyin: Suízhe zìdònghuà chéngdù de tígāo, jīqì zài hěn dà chéngdù shàng qǔdàile fánzhòng de réngōng láodòng.
en: With the increase in automation, machines have to a large extent replaced heavy manual labor.

zh: 他在岗位上勤勤恳恳，以极其敬业的工作作风赢得了同事们的尊重。
pinyin: Tā zài gǎngwèi shàng qínqínkěnkěn, yǐ jíqí jìngyè de gōngzuò zuòfēng yíngdé le tóngshìmen de zūnzhòng.
en: He works conscientiously at his post and has won the respect of his colleagues with his extremely dedicated work style.

zh: 为了在职业资格考试中取得优异成绩，他废寝忘食地钻研相关知识。
pinyin: Wèile zài zhíyè zīgé kǎoshì zhōng qǔdé yōuyì chéngjì, tā fèiqǐnwàngshí de zuānyán xiāngguān zhīshì.
en: In order to achieve excellent results in the professional qualification exam, he studied the relevant knowledge diligently.

zh: 这家企业千方百计改善管理，最终在激烈的市场竞争中生存了下来。
pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè qiān fāng bǎi jì gǎishàn guǎnlǐ, zuìzhōng zài jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng shēngcún le xiàlái.
en: The enterprise tried every possible way to improve management and finally survived the fierce market competition.

zh: 每当夜幕降临，楼下那家咖啡馆总是熙熙攘攘，充满了都市的气息。
pinyin: Měidāng yèmù jiànglín, lóu xià nà jiā kāfēiguǎn zǒngshì xīxīràngràng, chōngmǎnle dūshì de qìxī.
en: Whenever night falls, that coffee shop downstairs is always bustling with noise and excitement, full of urban atmosphere.

zh: 在这个新兴行业中，由于市场供不应求，许多公司获得了惊人的暴利。
pinyin: zài zhè ge xīn xīng háng yè zhōng, yóu yú shì chǎng gōng bù yìng qiú, xǔ duō gōng sī huò dé le jīng rén de bào lì.
en: In this emerging industry, due to supply failing to meet demand, many companies have achieved astonishing huge profits.

zh: 在这场激烈的竞争中，他始终保持光明磊落的态度，赢得了对手的尊重。
pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng jīliè de jìngzhēng zhōng, tā shǐzhōng bǎochí guāngmínglěiluò de tàidù, yíngdéle duìshǒu de zūnzhòng.
en: In this fierce competition, he always maintained an open and candid attitude, earning the respect of his opponents.

zh: 尽管已经临近截止日期，他依然在星期日选择休息，以保持充沛的精力。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn yǐ jīng lín jìn jié zhǐ rì qī, tā yī rán zài xīng qī rì xuǎn zé xiū xi, yǐ bǎo chí chōng pèi de jīng lì.
en: Despite the approaching deadline, he still chose to rest on Sunday to maintain his energy.

zh: 尽管遭受了三番五次的挫折，他依然坚持不懈，最终取得了卓越的成就。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zāoshòu le sān fān wǔ cì de cuòzhé, tā yīrán jiānchí bùxiè, zuìzhōng qǔdé le zhuóyuè de chéngjiù.
en: Despite suffering setbacks over and over again, he remained persistent and ultimately achieved outstanding success.

zh: 由于长期不规律的饮食习惯，他患上了严重的胃病，甚至连早饭都吃不下。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī bù guīlǜ de yǐnshí xíguàn, tā huàn shàngle yánzhòng de wèibìng, shènzhì lián zǎofàn dōu chī bù xià.
en: Due to long-term irregular eating habits, he developed a severe stomach condition and couldn't even eat breakfast.

zh: 尽管日程安排得非常紧凑，他还是挤出时间来，一有空儿就研究古典文学。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn rìchéng ānpái de fēicháng jǐncòu, tā háishì jǐchū shíjiān lái, yī yǒu kòng r jiù yánjiū gǔdiǎn wénxué.
en: Although his schedule is very tight, he manages to squeeze out time to study classical literature whenever he has a moment of leisure.

zh: 无论是在严峻的考验中还是在日常生活中，他总能敏锐地把握住时代的脉搏。
pinyin: Wúlùn shì zài yánjùn de kǎoyàn zhōng háishì zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, tā zǒng néng mǐnruì de bǎwò zhù shídài de màibó.
en: Whether in severe tests or in daily life, he can always keenly grasp the pulse of the era.

zh: 城市在纪念日当天鸣响警报以示哀悼。
pinyin: Chéngshì zài jìniànrì dàngtiān míngxiǎng jǐngbào yǐ shì āidào.
en: The city sounded the alarm on the memorial day to express mourning.

zh: 他在墓碑旁伫立良久，以此凭吊故友。
pinyin: Tā zài mùbēi páng zhùlì liángjiǔ, yǐ cǐ píngdiào gùyǒu.
en: He stood by the tombstone for a long time to mourn his old friend.

zh: 满山遍野的桃花如云似霞，蔚为壮观。
pinyin: Mǎnshānbiànyě de táohuā rú yún sì xiá, wèiwéizhuàngguān.
en: The peach blossoms covering the mountains look like clouds and rosy clouds, which is a spectacular sight.

zh: 该官员因长期恪守廉洁准则而受到表彰。
pinyin: Gāi guānyuán yīn chángqī kèshǒu liánjié zhǔnzé ér shòudào biǎozhāng.
en: The official was commended for long-term adherence to incorruptibility standards.

zh: 宴席间众人推杯换盏，嬉笑声不绝于耳。
pinyin: Yànxí jiān zhòngrén tuībēihuànzhǎn, xīxiào shēng bùjuéyú'ěr.
en: During the banquet, people were clinking glasses, and the sound of laughter and play was constant.

zh: 该车辆因车牌污损被交警拦下进行检查。
pinyin: Gāi chēliàng yīn chēpái wūsǔn bèi jiāojǐng lán xià jìnxíng jiǎnchá.
en: The vehicle was stopped by traffic police for inspection due to a defaced license plate.

zh: 她在国际影坛上因饰演该主角而声名鹊起。
pinyin: tā zài guó jì yǐng tán shàng yīn shì yǎn gāi zhǔ jué ér shēng míng què qǐ.
en: She rose to fame in the international film scene for playing that leading role.

zh: 该病毒具有极强的传染性，必须严加防范。
pinyin: Gāi bìngdú jùyǒu yǒu jí qiáng de chuánrǎnxìng, bìxū yánjiā fángfàn.
en: The virus is highly contagious and must be strictly guarded against.

zh: 该研究精准地描述了物理运动的函数曲线。
pinyin: Gāi yánjiū jīngzhǔn de miáoshùle wùlǐ yùndòng de hánshù qūxiàn.
en: The study accurately described the function curve of physical motion.

zh: 审计人员必须严格监察企业的财务合规性。
pinyin: shěnjì rényuán bìxū yángé jiānchá qǐyè de cáiwù héguīxìng.
en: Auditors must strictly supervise the financial compliance of the enterprise.

zh: 每届世界杯都会吸引全球数以亿计的观众。
pinyin: Měi jiè shìjièbēi dōu huì xīyǐn quánqiú shù yǐ yì jì de guānzhòng.
en: Every World Cup attracts hundreds of millions of viewers globally.

zh: 鹅卵石在溪水的长期冲刷下变得格外光滑。
pinyin: Éluánshí zài xīshuǐ de chángqī chōngshuā xià biàn de géwài guānghuá.
en: The pebbles became exceptionally smooth after being washed by the stream for a long time.

zh: 这封信由于信封破损严重，未能按时投递。
pinyin: zhè fēng xìn yóu yú xìn fēng pò sǔn yán zhòng, wèi néng àn shí tóu dì.
en: Due to the severe damage to the envelope, this letter was not delivered on time.

zh: 这种带有攻击性的言语将对方贬低为恐龙。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng dàiyǒu gōngjī xìng de yányǔ jiāng duìfāng biǎndī wèi kǒng lóng.
en: This type of aggressive speech degrades the other person as an ugly person.

zh: 厨师用慢火炖煮，使食材呈现出极致的鲜美。
pinyin: Chúshī yòng mànhuǒ dùnzhǔ, shǐ shícái chéngxiàn chū jízhì de xiānměi.
en: The chef cooked over a slow fire, bringing out the ultimate deliciousness of the ingredients.

zh: 老板决定在大街上广而告之以广告吸引客户。
pinyin: Lǎobǎn juédìng zài dàjiē shàng guǎng ér gào zhī yǐ guǎnggào xīyǐn kèhù.
en: The boss decided to announce it on the street to advertise and attract clients.

zh: 森林里的空气既清新又凉爽，令人心旷神怡。
pinyin: Sēnlín lǐ de kōngqì jì qīngxīn yòu liángshuǎng, lìng rén xīnkuàngshényí.
en: The air in the forest is both fresh and cool, making one feel relaxed and happy.

zh: 塞翁失马，焉知非福，坏事也许能变成好事。
pinyin: Sàiwēngshīmǎ, yānzhīfēifú, huàishì yěxǔ néng biàn chéng hǎoshì.
en: A blessing in disguise; a bad thing might turn into a good thing.

zh: 该夜校致力于为职场人士提供多元化的培训。
pinyin: Gāi yè xiào zhìlì yú wèi zhíchǎng rénshì tígōng duōyuánhuà de péixùn.
en: The evening school is dedicated to providing diverse training for professionals.

zh: 许多社会名流都现身于这场极尽奢华的葬礼。
pinyin: Xǔduō shèhuì míngliú dōu xiànshēn yú zhè chǎng jíjìn shēhuá de zànglǐ.
en: Many socialites appeared at this extravagant funeral.

zh: 这种古老的仪式至今仍限于该部落内部举行。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng gǔlǎo de yíshì zhìjīn réng xiànyú gāi bùluò nèibù jǔxíng.
en: This ancient ritual is still confined to being held within that tribe.

zh: 这座书橱不仅工艺精湛，而且极具收藏价值。
pinyin: Zhè zuò shūchú bùjǐn gōngyì jīngzhàn, érqiě jí jù shōucáng jiàzhí.
en: This bookcase is not only exquisite in craftsmanship, but also has great collection value.

zh: 该项目的经费总计已超过预算，需重新核算。
pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù de jīngfèi zǒngjì yǐ chāoguò yùsuàn, xū chóngxīn hésuàn.
en: The total funding for the project has exceeded the budget and requires recalculation.

zh: 该实验室严禁闲杂人等入内，以防发生意外。
pinyin: Gāi shí yàn shì yán jìn xián zá rén děng rù nèi, yǐ fáng fā shēng yì wài.
en: Unauthorized personnel are strictly prohibited from entering the laboratory to prevent accidents.

zh: 尽管丁总在行业内举足轻重，但他从不张扬。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn Dīng zǒng zài hángyènèi jǔzúqīngzhòng, dàn tā cóngbù zhāngyáng.
en: Although President Ding is influential in the industry, he is never ostentatious.

zh: 随着夕阳西下，金色的余晖铺满了整个水面。
pinyin: suí zhe xī yáng xī xià, jīn sè de yú huī pū mǎn le zhěng gè shuǐ miàn.
en: As the sun set, the golden afterglow covered the entire water surface.

zh: 攀登这座终年积雪的雪山需要极高的意志力。
pinyin: Pāndēng zhè zuò zhōngnián jīxuě de xuěshān xūyào jí gāo de yìzhìlì.
en: Climbing this snow-capped mountain, which is covered in snow all year round, requires extreme willpower.

zh: 该市的公立医疗机构已全面实现了数字化管理。
pinyin: Gāi shì de gōnglì yīliáo jīgòu yǐ quánmiàn shíxiàn le shùzìhuà guǎnlǐ.
en: The city's public medical institutions have fully implemented digital management.

zh: 战争的硝烟散去，留下的只有满目疮痍的废墟。
pinyin: Zhànzhēng de xiāoyān sàn qù, liú xià de zhǐyǒu mǎnmùchuāngyí de fèixū.
en: As the smoke of war cleared, all that remained were the devastated ruins.

zh: 公司决定将闲置的厂房出租，以增加额外收入。
pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng jiāng xiánzhì de chǎngfáng chūzū, yǐ zēngjiā éwài shōurù.
en: The company decided to rent out the idle factory building to increase additional revenue.

zh: 为了扩大市场份额，该财团决定收购竞争对手。
pinyin: Wèile kuòdà shìchǎng fèn'é, gāi cáituán juédìng shōugòu jìngzhēng duìshǒu.
en: In order to expand market share, the consortium decided to acquire its competitor.

zh: 该设备广泛应用于集成电路磁卡的读取与识别。
pinyin: Gāi shèbèi guǎngfàn yìngyòng yú jíchéng diànlù cí kǎ de dúqǔ yǔ shíbié.
en: The device is widely used for reading and identifying integrated circuit IC cards.

zh: 某些专家认为催眠是一种极具争议的辅助疗法。
pinyin: Mǒuxiē zhuānjiā rènwéi cuīmián shì yī zhǒng jí jù zhēngyì de fǔzhù liáofǎ.
en: Some experts believe that hypnosis is a highly controversial complementary therapy.

zh: 这次非法集会的所有参与者已被警方依法拘留。
pinyin: Zhè cì fēifǎ jíhuì de suǒyǒu cānyùzhě yǐ bèi jǐngfāng yīfǎ jūliú.
en: All participants in this illegal assembly have been detained by the police in accordance with the law.

zh: 这盏灯的柔和光线恰好衬托出画作细腻的笔触。
pinyin: Zhè zhǎn dēng de róuhé guāngxiàn qiàhǎo chèntuō chū huàzuò xìnì de bǐchù.
en: The soft light of this lamp perfectly highlights the delicate brushstrokes of the painting.

zh: 各方应避免采取任何加剧紧张局势的单边措施。
pinyin: Gèfāng yīng bìmiǎn cǎiqǔ rènhé jiājù jǐnzhāng júshì de dān biān cuòshī.
en: All parties should avoid taking any unilateral measures that aggravate the tension.

zh: 那件艺术品展现出一种洗尽铅华后的古朴之美。
pinyin: Nà jiàn yìshùpǐn zhǎnxiàn chū yī zhǒng xǐjìnqiānhuá hòu de gǔpǔ zhī měi.
en: That artwork displays a kind of simple and unadorned beauty after stripping away all artificiality.

zh: 古代文明通常诞生于大河沿岸肥沃的冲积平原。
pinyin: Gǔdài wénmíng tōngcháng dànshēng yú dàhé yán'àn féiwò de chōngjī píngyuán.
en: Ancient civilizations usually originated on the fertile alluvial plains along large rivers.

zh: 尽管夏天酷暑难耐，大家依然热衷于户外活动。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiàtiān kùshǔ nánnài, dàjiā yīrán rèzhōng yú hùwài huódòng.
en: Although the summer heat is unbearable, everyone is still keen on outdoor activities.

zh: 该刊物在学术界享有盛誉，每年定期出版两期。
pinyin: Gāi kānwù zài xuéshùjiè xiǎngyǒu shèngyù, měinián dìngqī chūbǎn liǎng qī.
en: The journal enjoys a high reputation in academia and is published twice a year.

zh: 该网页采用了先进的交互技术以提升用户体验。
pinyin: Gāi wǎngyè cáiyòng le xiānjìn de jiāohù jìshù yǐ tíshēng yònghù tǐyàn.
en: The web page adopts advanced interactive technology to improve user experience.

zh: 这栋建筑的装饰风格极其精致，令人叹为观止。
pinyin: Zhè dòng jiànzhù de zhuāngshì fēnggé jíqí jīngzhì, lìng rén tànwéiguānzhǐ.
