en: In order to stay healthy, he gave up sweet drinks and switched to pure natural orange juice.

zh: 科研人员彻夜奋战，终于在黎明前攻克了技术难关。
pinyin: Kēyán rényuán chèyè fènzhàn, zhōngyú zài límíng qián gōngkèle jìshù nánguān.
en: The researchers fought through the night and finally overcame the technical difficulties before dawn.

zh: 随着网络技术的发展，在线教育产业变得异常火暴。
pinyin: Suízhe wǎngluò jìshù de fāzhǎn, zàixiàn jiàoyù chǎnyè biàn de yìcháng huǒbào.
en: With the development of internet technology, the online education industry has become exceptionally booming.

zh: 政府应该让行政过程更加透明，以获得民众的信任。
pinyin: Zhèng fǔ yīng gāi ràng xíng zhèng guò chéng gèng jiā tòu míng, yǐ huò dé mín zhòng mín zhòng de xìn rèn.
en: The government should make the administrative process more transparent to gain the public's trust.

zh: 政府正在针对当前经济形势进行深刻的剖析与梳理。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài zhēnduì dāngqián jīngjì xíngshì jìnxíng shēnkè de pōuxī yǔ shūlǐ.
en: The government is conducting a profound analysis and sorting out of the current economic situation.

zh: 经过多方考证，这个家族确实以铁为姓，历史悠久。
pinyin: Jīngguò duōfāng kǎozhèng, zhège jiāzú quèshí yǐ Tiě wéi xìng, lìshǐ yōujiǔ.
en: After much verification, this family indeed uses Tie as their surname and has a long history.

zh: 在瞬息万变的时代，我们应当审时度势，寻求创新。
pinyin: Zài shùnxīwànbiàn de shídài, wǒmen yīngdāng shěnshídùshì, xúnqiú chuàngxīn.
en: In an era of rapid change, we should assess the situation and seek innovation.

zh: 这片海岸由于遭受严重的侵蚀，生态状况日益恶化。
pinyin: Zhè piàn hǎi àn yóu yú zāo shòu yán zhòng de qīn shí, shēng tài zhuàng kuàng rì yì è huà.
en: Due to severe erosion, the ecological condition of this seacoast is deteriorating day by day.

zh: 当地政府致力于开发温泉旅游资源以促进经济增长。
pinyin: Dāngdì zhèngfǔ zhìlì yú kāifā wēnquán lǚyóu zīyuán yǐ cùjìn jīngjì zēngzhǎng.
en: The local government is committed to developing hot spring tourism resources to promote economic growth.

zh: 该通讯工程项目旨在改善偏远地区光缆的覆盖范围。
pinyin: Gāi tōngxùn gōngchéng xiàngmù zhǐzài gǎishàn piānyuǎn dìqū guānglǎn de fùgài fànwéi.
en: The telecommunications project aims to improve the coverage of optical cables in remote areas.

zh: 演讲者频繁的手势增强了其演说的感染力与说服力。
pinyin: Yǎnjiǎngzhě pínfán de shǒushì zēngqiáng le qí yǎnshuō de gǎnrǎnlì yǔ shuōfúlì.
en: The speaker's frequent gestures enhanced the appeal and persuasiveness of his speech.

zh: 这位大师毫无保留地向徒弟传授了自己的毕生绝学。
pinyin: Zhè wèi dàshī háowúbǎoliú de xiàng túdì chuánshòu le zìjǐ de bìshēng juéxué.
en: The master imparted his lifelong unique skills to his apprentice without reservation.

zh: 科学家正在尝试通过修改基因来治疗某些遗传性疾病。
pinyin: Kē xué jiā zhèng zài cháng shì tōng guò xiū gǎi jī yīn lái zhì liáo mǒu xiē yí chuán xìng jí bìng.
en: Scientists are trying to treat certain hereditary diseases by modifying genes.

zh: 这件古代乐器虽然年代久远，但依然保存得非常完整。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn gǔdài yuèqì suīrán niándài jiǔyuǎn, dàn yīrán bǎocún dé fēicháng wánzhěng.
en: Although this ancient musical instrument is very old, it is still preserved very well.

zh: 经过深思熟虑，他决定彻底改变目前的这种生活状态。
pinyin: Jīngguò shēnsīshúlǜ, tā juédìng chèdǐ gǎibiàn mùqián de zhè zhǒng shēnghuó zhuàngtài.
en: After deep deliberation, he decided to completely change his current state of life.

zh: 无论涉及何种公事，我们都应保持客观且专业的态度。
pinyin: Wúlùn shèjí hé zhǒng gōng shì, wǒmen dōu yīng bǎochí kèguān qiě zhuānyè de tàidù.
en: Regardless of what work matters are involved, we should maintain an objective and professional attitude.

zh: 磨难使他变得独立而成熟，不再仅仅是生理上的成长。
pinyin: Mónàn shǐ tā biàn dé dúlì ér chéngshú, bù zài jǐnjǐn shì shēnglǐ shàng de chéngzhǎng.
en: Hardships made him independent and mature, not just physical growth.

zh: 当挚友遭遇不幸时，任何言语的安慰都显得苍白无力。
pinyin: Dāng zhìyǒu zāoyù bùxìng shí, rènhé yányǔ de ānwèi dōu xiǎnde cāngbái wúlì.
en: When a close friend encounters misfortune, any verbal comfort seems pale and powerless.

zh: 怀着一颗感恩的心去感悟生命，才能获得内心的平静。
pinyin: Huáizhe yī kē gǎn'ēn de xīn qù gǎnwù shēngmìng, cáinéng huòdé nèixīn de píngjìng.
en: Only by perceiving life with a grateful heart can one attain inner peace.

zh: 实验室严禁在未佩戴橡胶手套的情况下接触化学试剂。
pinyin: Shíyànshì yánjìn zài wèi pèidài xiàngjiāo shǒutào de qíngkuàng xià jiēchù huàxué shìjì.
en: It is strictly forbidden to touch chemical reagents in the laboratory without wearing rubber gloves.

zh: 只有打破陈旧的思维定势，才能拥有更加宏大的眼界。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu dǎpò chénjiù de sīwéi dìngshì, cáinéng yōngyǒu gèngjiā hóngdà de yǎnjiè.
en: Only by breaking old mental sets can one possess a more magnificent field of vision.

zh: 考察队的车辆在横穿沙漠的途中遭遇了罕见的沙尘暴。
pinyin: kǎo chá duì de chē liàng zài héng chuān shā mò de tú zhōng zāo yù le hǎn jiàn de shā chén bào.
en: The expedition's vehicles encountered a rare sandstorm while crossing the desert.

zh: 为了缓解交通拥堵，政府限制了市中心的停车位数量。
pinyin: Wèi le huǎn jiě jiāo tōng yōng dǔ, zhèng fǔ xiàn zhì le shì zhōng xīn de tíng chē wèi shù liàng.
en: In order to alleviate traffic congestion, the government has limited the number of parking spaces in the city center.

zh: 由于情况危急，医疗团队必须立即采取行动进行抢救。
pinyin: yóu yú qíng kuàng wēi jí, yī liáo tuán duì bì xū lì jí cǎi qǔ xíng dòng jìn xíng qiǎng jiù.
en: Due to the critical situation, the medical team must take immediate action to perform a rescue.

zh: 随着工业化的推进，部分古迹遭到了不可逆转的破坏。
pinyin: Suízhe gōngyèhuà de tuījìn, bùfèn gǔjì zāodàole bùkě nìzhuǎn de pòhuài.
en: With the advancement of industrialization, some historical sites have suffered irreversible damage.

zh: 在这个动荡的时代，人们倾向于把金子当作避险资产。
pinyin: zài zhè gè dòng dàng de shí dài, rén men qīng xiàng yú bǎ jīn zǐ dāng zuò bì xiǎn zī chǎn.
en: In this turbulent era, people tend to treat gold as a safe-haven asset.

zh: 出于安全考虑，离开实验室时必须关掉所有电源设备。
pinyin: Chūyú ānquán kǎolǜ, líkāi shíyànshì shí bìxū guāndiào suǒyǒu diànyuán shèbèi.
en: For safety reasons, you must turn off all power equipment when leaving the laboratory.

zh: 未经相关部门批准，任何个人不得擅自改变建筑结构。
pinyin: Wèijīng xiāngguān bùmén pīzhǔn, rènhé gèrén bùdé shànzì gǎibiàn jiànzhù jiégòu.
en: Without the approval of the relevant department, no individual may alter the building structure without authorization.

zh: 该项目在促进地区经济发展方面具有深远的战略意义。
pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù zài cùjìn dìqū jīngjì fāzhǎnzhǎn fāngmiàn jùyǒu shēnyuǎn de zhànlüè yìyì.
en: The project has profound strategic significance in promoting regional economic development.

zh: 贫富差距的持续加剧已成为社会治理面临的严峻挑战。
pinyin: pín fù chā jù de chí xù jiā jù yǐ chéng wéi shè huì zhì lǐ miàn lín de yán jùn tiǎo zhàn.
en: The continuous intensification of the wealth gap has become a severe challenge facing social governance.

zh: 每逢端午节，人们都会通过各种民俗活动来纪念屈原。
pinyin: Měiféng Duānwǔjié, rénmen dōu huì tōngguò gèzhǒng mínsú huódòng lái jìniàn Qū Yuán.
en: Every Dragon Boat Festival, people commemorate Qu Yuan through various folk activities.

zh: 站在山顶，周围的美景尽收眼底，让人感到心情舒畅。
pinyin: Zhàn zài shāndǐng, zhōuwéi de měijǐng jìn shōu yǎndǐ, ràng rén gǎndào xīnqíng shūchàng.
en: Standing on the mountaintop, the surrounding beautiful scenery is in full view, making one feel relaxed.

zh: 由于地理环境不同，南北方的饮食习惯存在明显差异。
pinyin: Yóuyú dìlǐ huánjìng bùtóng, nánběifāng de yǐnshí xíguàn cúnzài míngxiǎn chāyì.
en: Due to different geographical environments, there are obvious differences in dietary habits between the north and the south.

zh: 人生好比一场马拉松，关键不在于速度，而在于毅力。
pinyin: Rénshēng hǎobǐ yī chǎng mǎlāsōng, guānjiàn bù zàiyú sùdù, ér zàiyú yìlì.
en: Life is just like a marathon; the key is not in speed, but in perseverance.

zh: 该政策在实施初期便迅速见效，极大缓解了市场压力。
pinyin: Gāi zhèngcè zài shíshī chūqī biàn xùnsù jiàn xiào, jídà huǎnjiě le shìchǎng yālì.
en: The policy produced immediate effects in the early stages of implementation, greatly relieving market pressure.

zh: 那项投资看似前景广阔，实则隐藏着巨大的市场风险。
pinyin: Nà xiàng tóuzī kàn sì qiánjǐng guǎngkuò, shízé yǐncángzhe jùdà de shìchǎng fēngxiǎn.
en: That investment looks as if it has broad prospects, but it actually hides enormous market risks.

zh: 这场喜事举办得隆重而庄严，给宾客留下了深刻印象。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng xǐshì jǔbàn dé lóngzhòng ér zhuāngyán, gěi bīnkè liúxià le shēnkè yìnxiàng.
en: The wedding was held in a grand and solemn manner, leaving a deep impression on the guests.

zh: 环境保护与经济发展应当相辅相成，实现可持续增长。
pinyin: huánjìng bǎohù yǔ jīngjì fāzhǎn yīngdāng xiāng fǔ xiāng chéng, shíxiàn kě chíxù zēngzhǎng.
en: Environmental protection and economic development should complement each other to achieve sustainable growth.

zh: 企业应当严格遵守规则，而不应试图钻空子获取利益。
pinyin: Qǐyè yīngdāng yángé zūnshǒu guīzé, ér bù yīng shìtú zuān kòng zi huòqǔ lìyì.
en: Enterprises should strictly follow the rules, rather than attempting to take advantage of loopholes for profit.

zh: 由于地形复杂，我们决定租一辆越野性能良好的吉普。
pinyin: Yóuyú dìxíng fùzá, wǒmen juédìng zū yī liàng yuèyě xìngnéng liánghǎo de jípǔ.
en: Due to the complex terrain, we decided to rent a Jeep with good off-road performance.

zh: 该研究旨在探讨这一疗法的临床应用前景及其局限性。
pinyin: Gāi yánjiū zhǐ zài tàntǎo zhè yī liáofǎ de línchuáng yìngyòng qiánjǐng jí qí júxiànxìng.
en: This study aims to explore the clinical application prospects and limitations of this therapy.

zh: 只有经过常年累月的苦练，才能达到炉火纯青的境界。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jīngguò chángniánlěiyuè de kǔ liàn, cáinéng dádào lúhuǒchúnqīng de jìngjiè.
en: Only through years of diligent practice can one reach a state of perfection.

zh: 由于该地区的治安状况堪忧，他决定搬离现在的住处。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi dìqū de zhì'ān zhuàngkuàng kānyōu, tā juédìng bānlí xiànzài de zhùchù.
en: Due to the worrying public security situation in the area, he decided to move out of his current residence.

zh: 全球化进程深刻地改变了人们的价值观念与生活方式。
pinyin: quánqiúhuà jìnchéng shēnkè de gǎibiàn le rénmen de jiàzhí guānniàn yǔ shēnghuó fāngshì.
en: The process of globalization has profoundly changed people's values and lifestyles.

zh: 在实验操作中，严禁将易燃物品放置在高温设备附近。
pinyin: Zài shíyàn cāozuò zhōng, yánjìn jiāng yìrán wùpǐn fàngzhì zài gāowēn shèbèi fùjìn.
en: During experiments, it is strictly forbidden to place flammable items near high-temperature equipment.

zh: 由于运输成本上涨，每公斤产品的利润空间被压缩了。
pinyin: Yóuyú yùnshū chéngběn shàngzhǎng, měi gōngjīn chǎnpǐn de lìrùn kōngjiān bèi yāsuō le.
en: Due to rising transportation costs, the profit margin per kilogram of product has been compressed.

zh: 他们漫步在静谧的湖畔，尽情享受着这份难得的悠闲。
pinyin: Tāmen mànbù zài jìngmì de húpàn, jìnqíng xiǎngshòuzhe zhè fèn nándé de yōuxián.
en: They strolled along the quiet lakeshore, fully enjoying this rare moment of leisure.

zh: 由于做工过于逼真，这件艺术品的真假令人捉摸不透。
pinyin: Yóuyú zuògōng guòyú bīzhēn, zhè jiàn yìshùpǐn de zhēn jiǎ lìngrén zhuōmō bù tòu.
en: Due to the craftsmanship being so lifelike, the authenticity of this artwork is hard to fathom.

zh: 维修人员仔细核对规格，确保每一颗螺丝都安装到位。
pinyin: Wéixiū rényuán zǐxì héduì guīgé, quèbǎo měi yī kē luósī dōu ānzhuāng dàowèi.
en: The maintenance staff carefully checked the specifications to ensure every screw was installed in place.

zh: 探险家穿越了茫茫沙漠，只为寻觅那座传说中的古城。
pinyin: Tànxiǎnjiā chuānyuè le mángmáng shāmò, zhǐ wèi xúnmì nà zuò chuánshuō zhōng de gǔchéng.
en: The explorer crossed the vast desert, just to look for that legendary ancient city.

zh: 登山者们不畏艰险，终于登上了那座终年积雪的山峰。
pinyin: Dēngshānzhěmen bù wèi jiānxiǎn, zhōngyú dēngshàng le nà zuò zhōngnián jīxuě de shān fēng.
en: The climbers were not afraid of difficulties and dangers, and finally reached the snow-capped peak.

zh: 尽管只是一名基层职员，他依然对职业前景充满憧憬。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhǐ shì yī míng jīcéng zhíyuán, tā yīrán duì zhíyè qiánjǐng chōngmǎn chōngjǐng.
en: Although only a grassroots office worker, he is still full of longing for his career prospects.

zh: 面对严峻的挑战，企业只得调整经营策略以维持生存。
pinyin: Miànduì yánjùn de tiǎozhàn, qǐyè zhǐdé tiáozhěng jīngyíng cèlüè yǐ wéichí shēngcún.
en: Facing severe challenges, the company had no alternative but to adjust its business strategy to maintain survival.

zh: 由于他在该行业的卓越贡献，他被公认为业内的泰斗。
pinyin: Yóuyú tā zài gāi hángyè de zhuóyuè gòngxiàn, tā bèi gōngrèn wéi yènèi de tàidǒu.
en: Due to his outstanding contributions to the industry, he is recognized as a leading authority in the field.

zh: 由于地址变更，这封重要信件被退回了原寄件人手中。
pinyin: Yóuyú dìzhǐ biàngēng, zhè fēng zhòngyào xìnjiàn bèi tuíhuí le yuán jìjiànrén shǒuzhōng.
en: Due to a change of address, this important letter was returned to the original sender.

zh: 那名高级官员最终因长期受贿受到了法律的严厉制裁。
pinyin: nà míng gāo jí guān yuán zuì zhōng yīn cháng qī shòu huì shòu dào le fǎ lǜ de yán lì zhì cái.
en: That high-ranking official was finally severely punished by the law for long-term bribery.

zh: 面对长辈的质询，他唯有默默点头，不敢有丝毫辩驳。
pinyin: miànduì zhǎngbèi de zhìxún, tā wéiyǒu mòmò diǎn tóu, bù gǎn yǒu sīháo bià biànbó.
en: Facing the elder's questioning, he could only nod silently, not daring to offer the slightest refutation.

zh: 学术交流的目的是互相切磋，还望各位专家多加指教。
pinyin: Xuéshù jiāoliú de mùdì shì hùxiāng qiēcuō, hái wàng gèwèi zhuānjiā duōjiā zhǐjiào.
en: The purpose of academic exchange is to learn from each other; I hope all experts will provide much guidance.

zh: 这项尖端医学研究旨在探索抑制肿瘤生长的新型疗法。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng jiānduān yīxué yánjiū zhǐ zài tànsuǒ yìzhì zhǒngliú shēngzhǎng de xīnxíng liáofǎ.
en: This cutting-edge medical research aims to explore new therapies to inhibit tumor growth.

zh: 如果不严格遵循医嘱，手术后的伤口容易产生并发症。
pinyin: rúguǒ bù yángé zūnxún yīzhǔ, shǒushù hòu de shāngkǒu róngyì chǎnshēng bìngfāzhèng.
en: If you do not strictly follow medical advice, the surgical cut is prone to complications.

zh: 古诗云清明时节雨纷纷，描写了节日期间的气候特征。
pinyin: Gǔshī yún Qīngmíng shíjié yǔ fēnfēn, miáoxiě le jiérì qījiān de qìhòu tèzhēng.
en: The ancient poem says 'it drizzles during the Qingming season,' describing the climate characteristics during the festival.

zh: 那位老球员虽然早已退役，但仍致力于推广这项运动。
pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo qiúyuán suīrán zǎoyǐ tuìyì, dàn réng zhìlì yú tuīguǎng zhè xiàng yùndòng.
en: Although that veteran player retired long ago, he is still committed to promoting this sport.

zh: 由于未能出示有效收据，我们无法为您办理退货手续。
pinyin: Yóuyú wèi néng chūshì yǒuxiào shōujù, wǒmen wúfǎ wèi nín bànlǐ tuìhuò shǒuxù.
en: Due to the failure to present a valid receipt, we are unable to process the return for you.

zh: 该慈善机构正在筹集财力以改善贫困地区的教育设施。
pinyin: Gāi císhàn jīgòu zhèngzài chóují cái lì yǐ gǎishàn pínkùn dìqū de jiàoyù shèshī.
en: The charity is raising financial resources to improve educational facilities in impoverished areas.

zh: 随着基础设施的完善，乡下已经不再是落后的代名词。
pinyin: Suízhe jīchǔ shèshī de wánshàn, xiāngxia yǐjīng bù zài shì luòhòu de dàimíngcí.
en: With the improvement of infrastructure, rural areas are no longer synonymous with backwardness.

zh: 他在菜园里种植了各种各样的辣椒，以满足烹饪需求。
pinyin: Tā zài càiyuán lǐ zhòngzhíle gèzhǒng gèyàng de làjiāo, yǐ mǎnzú pēngrènrgèng xūqiú.
en: He planted various kinds of hot peppers in the vegetable garden to satisfy cooking needs.

zh: 倘若我们能够秉持初心，必然可以克服眼前的重重障碍。

zh: 这名老工匠决定将毕生所学毫无保留地传授给他的徒弟。

en: Faced with a deep crisis, he attempted to save the collapsing economy through reform.

zh: 老王两口子相濡以沫几十年，始终保持着谦逊淳朴的家风。
pinyin: Lǎo Wáng liǎngkǒuzi xiāngrúyǐmò jǐshí nián, shǐzhōng bǎochízhe qiānxùn chúnpǔ de jiāfēng.
en: The couple, Lao Wang and his wife, have supported each other through thick and thin for decades, always maintaining a modest and simple family tradition.

zh: 尽管外表看起来很普通，但其里边蕴含着深厚的文化底蕴。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wàibiǎo kàn qǐlái hěn pǔtōng, dàn qí lǐ bian yùnhánzhe shēnhòu de wénhuà dǐyùn.
en: Although it looks ordinary on the outside, it contains deep cultural heritage inside.

zh: 他的审美风格独特，总喜欢穿着剪裁考究的复古风格裤子。
pinyin: Tā de shěnměi fēnggé dútè, zǒng xǐhuān chuānzhe jiǎncái kǎojiù de fùgǔ fēnggé kùzi.
en: His aesthetic style is unique; he always enjoys wearing vintage-style trousers with exquisite tailoring.

zh: 设计师通过别致的构思，赋予了这件艺术品独特的生命力。
pinyin: Shèjìshī tōngguò biézhì de gòusī, fùyǔle zhè jiàn yìshùpǐn dútè de shēngmìnglì.
en: Through an unusual concept, the designer has given this artwork a unique vitality.

zh: 由于战乱，许多妇女成了寡妇，不得不承担起家庭的重担。
pinyin: yóu yú zhàn luàn, xǔ duō fù nǚ chéng le guǎ fu, bù dé bù chéng dān qǐ jiā tíng de zhòng dàn.
en: Due to the war, many women became widows and had to shoulder the burden of the family.

zh: 这种廉价的劳动力资源曾一度推动了当地经济的迅速崛起。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng liánjià de láodònglì zīyuán céng yīdù tuīdòngle dāngdì jīngjì de xùnsù juéqǐ.
en: This kind of cheap labor resource once promoted the rapid rise of the local economy.

zh: 这部传记详尽地记录了这位科学家的卓越贡献与生平经历。
pinyin: Zhè bù zhuànjì xiángjìn de jìlù le zhè wèi kēxuéjiā de zhuóyuè gòngxiàn yǔ shēngpíng jīnglì.
en: This biography exhaustively records the outstanding contributions and life experiences of this scientist.

zh: 该城市通过举办国际博览会，成功招揽了大批海外投资商。
pinyin: gāi chéngshì tōngguò jǔbàn guójì bólǎnhuì, chénggōng zhāolǎnle dàpī hǎiwài tóuzīshāng.
en: The city successfully attracted a large number of overseas investors by hosting international expositions.

zh: 随着数字技术的飞速发展，传统传媒正面临着巨大的挑战。
pinyin: Suízhe shùzì jìshù de fēisù fāzhǎn, chuántǒng chuánméi zhèng miànlínzhe jùdà de tiǎozhàn.
en: With the rapid development of digital technology, traditional media is facing enormous challenges.

zh: 该国经济数据持续回暖，由此可见宏观调控措施初见成效。
pinyin: Gāi guó jīngjì shùjù chíxù huínuǎn, yóu cǐ kě jiàn hóngguān tiáokòng cuòshī chū jiàn chéngxiào.
en: The country's economic data continues to recover; from this, it can be seen that the macroeconomic control measures are beginning to show results.

zh: 在当今竞争激烈的职场中，人才跳槽已是屡见不鲜的现象。
pinyin: Zài dāngjīn jìngzhēng jīliè de zhíchǎng zhōng, réncái tiào cáo yǐ shì lǚjiànbùxiān de xiànxiàng.
en: In today's highly competitive job market, professionals changing jobs is a common phenomenon.

zh: 历经沧桑的游子，心中始终盼望着能重回故土，了却夙愿。
pinyin: Lìjīng cāngsāng de yóuzǐ, xīnzhōng shǐzhōng pànwàngzhe néng chónghuí gùtǔ, liǎoquè sùyuàn.
en: The wanderer, having experienced the vicissitudes of life, always hopes in his heart to return to his homeland to fulfill his long-cherished wish.

zh: 父亲临终前的嘱咐，我至今仍铭记在心，不敢有丝毫怠慢。
pinyin: fù qīn lín zhōng qián de zhǔ fu, wǒ zhì jīn réng míng jì zài xīn, bù gǎn yǒu sī háo dài màn.
en: I still keep my father's final instructions in mind and dare not be the slightest bit negligent.

zh: 由于生态环境的恶化，这些野生动物处于濒临灭绝的状态。
pinyin: Yóuyú shēngtài huánjìng de èhuà, zhèxiē yěshēng dòngwù chǔyú bīnlín mièjué de zhuàngtài.
en: Due to the deterioration of the ecological environment, these wild animals are on the verge of extinction.

zh: 会长在演讲中强调了协会应该致力于促进文化交流与合作。
pinyin: Huìzhǎng zài yǎnjiǎng zhōng qiángdiào le xiéhuì yīnggāi zhìlì yú cùjìn wénhuà jiāoliú yǔ hézuò.
en: In his speech, the president emphasized that the association should be committed to promoting cultural exchange and cooperation.

zh: 只有深刻理解本土文化，企业的经营策略才能在当地扎根。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu shēnkè lǐjiě běntǔ wénhuà, qǐyè de jīngyíng cèlüè cáinéng zài dāngdì zhāgēn.
en: Only by deeply understanding local culture can a company's business strategy take root locally.

zh: 自治区首府的建设步伐正在不断加快，城市面貌日新月异。
pinyin: Zìzhìqū shǒufǔ de jiànshè bùfá zhèngzài bùduàn jiākuài, chéngshì miànmào rìxīnyuèyì.
en: The construction pace of the autonomous region's capital is accelerating constantly, and the city's appearance is changing with each passing day.

zh: 对于那项改革，他其实早有预见，只是未便公开发表意见。
pinyin: Duìyú nà xiàng gǎigé, tā qíshí zǎo yǒu yùjiàn, zhǐshì wèibiàn gōngkāi fābiǎo yìjiàn.
en: Regarding that reform, he actually foresaw it long ago, but it was not convenient to express his opinion publicly.

zh: 由于松院士在科研领域的卓越贡献，他获得了终身成就奖。
pinyin: Yóuyú Sōng yuànshì zài kēyán lǐngyù de zhuóyuè gòngxiàn, tā huòdé le zhōngshēn chéngjiù jiǎng.
en: Due to Academician Song's outstanding contributions in the field of scientific research, he received the lifetime achievement award.

zh: 在通货膨胀的影响下，通过理财来保值增值显得尤为重要。
pinyin: Zài tōnghuò péngzhàng de yǐngxiǎng xià, tōngguò lǐcái lái bǎozhí zēngzhí xiǎnde yóuwéi zhòngyào.
en: Under the influence of inflation, managing wealth to preserve and increase value appears especially important.

zh: 考古学家通过分析陪葬器物，推断出了墓主人的社会地位。
pinyin: Kǎogǔ xuéjiā tōngguò fēnxī péizàng qìwù, tuīduàn chūle mù zhǔrén de shèhuì dìwèi.
en: Archaeologists inferred the social status of the tomb owner by analyzing the burial artifacts.

zh: 尽管头顶乌云密布，但他依然坚持完成了这次艰巨的任务。
pinyin: jǐnguǎn tóudǐng wū yún mìbù, dàn tā yīrán jiānchí wánchéng le zhè cì jiānjù de rènwù.
en: Despite the gathering black clouds overhead, he persisted and completed this arduous task.

zh: 尽管那家企业的年薪极其优厚，但他依然决定辞职去创业。
pinyin: jǐnguǎn nà jiā qǐyè de niánxīn jíqí yōuhòu, dàn tā yīrán juédìng cízhí qù chuàngyè.
en: Although that enterprise's annual salary was extremely generous, he still decided to resign to start his own business.

zh: 相关部门正在制定长效管理方案，以巩固目前的改革成果。
pinyin: xiāng guān bù mén zhèng zài zhì dìng cháng xiào guǎn lǐ fāng àn, yǐ gǒng gù mù qián de gǎi gé chéng guǒ.
en: Relevant departments are formulating a long-term management plan to consolidate current reform achievements.

zh: 这座大桥连接了海峡两岸，极大地促进了当地经济的发展。
pinyin: Zhè zuò dàqiáo liánjiē le hǎixiá liǎng'àn, jídà de cùjìn le dāngdì jīngjì de fāzhǎn.
en: This bridge connects the two sides of the strait, greatly promoting the development of the local economy.

zh: 随着冷链物流技术的革新，更多新鲜农产品得以远销海外。
pinyin: Suízhe lěngliàn wùliú jìshù de géxīn, gèng duō xīnxiān nóngchǎnpǐn déyǐ yuǎnxiāo hǎiwài.
en: With the innovation of cold chain logistics technology, more fresh agricultural produce can be sold overseas.

zh: 经过严格的质量检验，该样品已经达到了预期的性能指标。
pinyin: Jīngguò yángé de zhìliàng jiǎnyàn, gāi yàngpǐn yǐjīng dádàole yùqī de xìngnéng zhǐbiāo.
en: After strict quality inspection, the sample has met the expected performance indicators.

zh: 作为中国文化的象征，长城不仅历史悠久，而且气势磅礴。
pinyin: Zuòwéi Zhōngguó wénhuà de xiàngzhēng, Chángchéng bùjǐn lìshǐ yōujiǔ, érqiě qìshì pángbó.
en: As a symbol of Chinese culture, the Great Wall not only has a long history but is also magnificent.

zh: 为了防止水管破裂，我们必须在冬季采取必要的防冻措施。
pinyin: wèi le fáng zhǐ shuǐ guǎn pò liè, wǒ men bì xū zài dōng jì cǎi qǔ bì yào de fáng dòng cuǐ dǒng cuǐ d cuǐ dng cuò shī.
en: In order to prevent the water pipes from bursting, we must take necessary anti-freezing measures during winter.

zh: 在与对手达成谅解之前，双方代表决定坐下进行深度磋商。
pinyin: Zài yǔ duìshǒu dáchéng liàngjiě zhīqián, shuāngfāng dàibiǎo juédìng zuò xià jìnxíng shēndù chāngshāng.
en: Before reaching an understanding with the opponent, the representatives of both sides decided to sit down for in-depth consultations.

zh: 通过现代修复技术，我们可以提取陈旧胶带中的原始影像。
pinyin: Tōngguò xiàndài xiūfù jìshù, wǒmen kěyǐ tíqǔ chénjiù jiāodài zhōng de yuánshǐ yǐngxiàng.
en: Through modern restoration technology, we can extract the original footage from old magnetic tapes.

zh: 随着工业化进程的加快，全球气温呈现出显著的上升趋势。
pinyin: Suízhe gōngyèhuà jìnchéng de jiākuài, quánqiú qìwēn chéngxiàn chū xiǎnzhù de shàngshēng qūshì.
en: With the acceleration of industrialization, the global air temperature shows a significant upward trend.

zh: 双方在谈判中互不相让，使得原本紧张的关系进一步激化。
pinyin: shuāngfāng zài tánpàn zhōng hù bù xiāngràng, shǐdé yuánběn jǐnzhāng de guānxì jìnyíbù jīhuà.
en: Neither side would give way during the negotiations, causing the already tense relationship to further intensify.

zh: 在这场正式的商务宴请中，他举杯向每一位合作伙伴敬酒。
pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng zhèngshì de shāngwù yànqǐng zhōng, tā jǔbēi xiàng měi yī wèi hézuò huǒbàn jìng jiǔ.
en: At this formal business banquet, he raised his glass to offer a toast to every partner.

zh: 受灾地区的物资供应情况非常严重，急需社会各界的支援。
pinyin: Shòuzāi dìqū de wùzī gōngyìng qíngkuàng fēicháng yánzhòng, jíxū shèhuì gèjiè de zhīyuán.
en: The supply of goods in the disaster-stricken area is in a critical state, and support from all sectors of society is urgently needed.

zh: 这位土生土长的学者致力于研究当地独具特色的民间文化。
pinyin: Zhè wèi tǔshēngtǔzhǎng de xuézhě zhìlì yú yánjiū dāngdì dújùtèsè de mínjiān wénhuà.
en: This native-born scholar is dedicated to researching the unique local folk culture.

zh: 这台老旧的机器时不时会出现故障，必须进行彻底的检修。
pinyin: Zhè tái lǎojiù de jīqì shíbùshí huì chūxiàn gùzhàng, bìxū jìnxíng chèdǐ de jiǎnxiū.
en: This old machine malfunctions from time to time and requires a thorough inspection.

zh: 每逢传统佳节，整座城市张灯结彩，呈现出一派繁荣景象。
pinyin: Měiféng chuántǒng jiājié, zhěngzuò chéngshì zhāngdēngjiécǎi, chéngxiàn chū yīpài fánróng jǐngxiàng.
en: Whenever a traditional festival arrives, the whole city is decorated with lanterns and colorful banners, presenting a scene of prosperity.

zh: 企业实行多劳多得的分配制度，极大地调动了员工的积极性。
pinyin: Qǐyè shíxíng duōláoduōdé de fēnpèi zhìdù, jídà de diàodòngle yuángōng de jījíxìng.
en: The enterprise implements a distribution system of 'more work, more pay,' which has greatly mobilized the enthusiasm of the employees.

zh: 怀旧并非仅仅是对过去的迷恋，而是一种对生活的深沉反思。
pinyin: Huáijiù bìngfēi jǐnjǐn shì duì guòqù de míliàn, ér shì yī zhǒng duì shēnghuó de shēnchén fǎnsī.
en: Nostalgia is not merely an obsession with the past, but a profound reflection on life.

zh: 为了适应激烈的国际竞争，许多企业开始积极拓展外国市场。
pinyin: Wèi le shì yìng jī liè de guó jì jìng zhēng, xǔ duō qǐ yè kāi shǐ jī jí tuò zhǎn wài guó shì chǎng.
en: In order to adapt to fierce international competition, many companies have started to actively expand into foreign markets.

zh: 在这片原始森林中，偶有游人穿梭其间，探寻大自然的奥秘。
pinyin: Zài zhè piàn yuánshǐ sēnlín zhōng, ǒu yǒu yóurén chuānsuō qíjiān, tànxún dàzìrán de àomì.
en: In this primeval forest, tourists occasionally shuttle through, exploring the mysteries of nature.

zh: 魔术师娴熟地操纵着手中的棍子，观众们对此感到无比惊叹。
pinyin: Móshùshī xiánshú de cāozòngzhe shǒuzhōng de gùnzi, guānzhòngmen duì cǐ gǎndào wúbǐ jīngtàn.
en: The magician manipulated the stick in his hand skillfully, and the audience was incredibly amazed by it.

zh: 为了能够熟练掌握俄语，他每天都坚持阅读相关的文学作品。
pinyin: Wèile nénggòu shúliàn zhǎngwò éyǔ, tā měitiān dōu jiānchí yuèdú xiāngguān de wénxué zuòpǐn.
en: In order to master Russian proficiently, he persists in reading relevant literary works every day.

zh: 这部作品经过长时间的推敲与打磨，终于呈现出完美的效果。
pinyin: Zhè bù zuòpǐn jīngguò jīng chángshíjiān de tuīqiāo yǔ dǎmó, zhōngyú chéngxiàn chū wánměi de xiàoguǒ.
en: After a long period of refinement and polishing, this work finally presents a perfect effect.

zh: 该方案在经过多次反复论证后，终于获得了相关部门的批准。
pinyin: Gāi fāng'àn zài jīngguò duōcì fǎnfù lùnzhèng hòu, zhōngyú huòdé le xiāngguān bùmén de pīzhǔn.
en: After undergoing multiple rounds of rigorous verification, the proposal was finally approved by the relevant departments.

zh: 这场大选不仅反映了民众的诉求，更体现了复杂的政治格局。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng dàxuǎn bùjǐn fǎnyìngle mínzhòng de sùqiú, gèng tǐxiànle fùzá de zhèngzhì géjú.
en: This general election not only reflects the public's demands but also embodies the complex political landscape.

zh: 在缺乏现代取暖设备的年代，火柴是维持日常生活的必需品。
pinyin: Zài quēfá xiàndài qǔnuǎn shèbèi de niándài, huǒchái shì wéichí rìcháng shēnghuó de bìxūpǐn.
en: In the era when modern heating equipment was lacking, matches were a necessity for daily life.

zh: 即便身处繁华都市，他依然与家乡的老乡保持着密切的联系。
pinyin: Jíbiàn shēnchǔ fánhuá dūshì, tā yīrán yǔ jiāxiāng de lǎoxiāng bǎochí zhe mìqiè de liánxì.
en: Even while living in a bustling city, he still maintains close contact with fellow townsmen from his hometown.

zh: 尽管这是一种常见的社交习俗，但送礼的动机往往十分复杂。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè shì yī zhǒng chángjiàn de shèjiāo xísú, dàn sòng lǐ de dòngjī wǎngwǎng shífēn fùzá.
en: Although this is a common social custom, the motives behind gift-giving are often very complex.

zh: 该设备采用先进的无线传输协议，确保了数据传输的稳定性。
pinyin: Gāi shèbèi cǎiyòng xiānjìn de wúxiàn chuánshū xiéyì, quèbǎole shùjù chuánshū de wěndìngxìng.
en: The device adopts advanced wireless transmission protocols to ensure the stability of data transmission.

zh: 在那遥远的宇宙深处，无数恒星犹如璀璨的星星点缀着黑暗。
pinyin: Zài nà yáoyuǎn de yǔzhòu shēnchù, wúshù héngxīng yóurú cuǐcàn de xīngxing diǎnzhuìzhe hēi'àn.
en: In the depths of the distant universe, countless stars adorn the darkness like glittering gems.

zh: 改革应当遵循循序渐进的方针，以避免社会出现剧烈的动荡。
pinyin: gǎi gé yīng dāng zūn xún xún xù jiàn jìn de fāng zhēn, yǐ bì miǎn shè huì chū xiàn jù liè de dòng dàng.
en: Reform should follow a step-by-step policy to avoid drastic social unrest.

zh: 那个磨损严重的网球由于失去弹性，已经不适合继续比赛了。
pinyin: nàge mósǔn yánzhòng de wǎngqiú yóuyú shīqù tánxìng, yǐjīng bù shìhé jìxù bǐsài le.
en: That worn-out tennis ball is no longer suitable for the match because it has lost its elasticity.

zh: 比起大型超市，很多老年人更习惯去附近的菜市场采购食材。
pinyin: Bǐqǐ dàxíng chāoshì, hěnduō lǎoniánrén gèng xíguàn qù fùjìn de cài shì chǎng cǎigòu shícái.
en: Compared to large supermarkets, many elderly people are more accustomed to going to the nearby food market to purchase ingredients.

zh: 无论时代如何变迁，这些古典名著依然具备永恒的艺术魅力。
pinyin: Wúlùn shídài rúhé biànqiān, zhèxiē gǔdiǎn míngzhù yīrán jùbèi yǒnghéng de yìshù mèilì.
en: No matter how times change, these classical masterpieces still possess eternal artistic charm.

zh: 虽然结果不尽如人意，但他还是以平和的心态接受了这一切。
pinyin: Suīrán jiéguǒ bù jìn rú rén yì, dàn tā háishì yǐ pínghé de xīntài jiēshòu le zhè yīqiè.
en: Although the result was not satisfactory, he accepted everything with a calm mindset.

zh: 尽管他才华横溢，但平日里行事低调，从不张扬自己的才干。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā cáihuá héngyì, dàn píngrì lǐ xíngshì dīdiào, cóng bù zhāngyáng zìjǐ de cáigàn.
en: Although he is immensely talented, he keeps a low profile in his daily life and never flaunts his abilities.

zh: 相关外交人员已抵达大使馆，准备就双边贸易协定展开磋商。
pinyin: Xiāngguān wàijiāo rényuán yǐ dǐdá dàshǐguǎn, zhǔnbèi jiù shuāngbiān màoyì xiédìng zhǎnkāi cuōshāng.
en: The relevant diplomatic personnel have arrived at the embassy, preparing to engage in consultations regarding the bilateral trade agreement.

zh: 尽管树林的发展速度很快，但它依然保持着独特的城市风貌。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn Shùlín de fāzhǎn sùdù hěn kuài, dàn tā yīrán bǎochí zhe dútè de chéngshì fēngmào.
en: Although Shulin's development speed is very fast, it still maintains its unique urban appearance.

zh: 鉴赏诗词不仅需要深厚的文学底蕴，还需要敏锐的审美直觉。
pinyin: jiàn shǎng shī cí bù jǐn xū yào shēn hòu de wén xué dǐ yùn, hái xū yào mǐn ruì de shěn měi zhí jué.
en: Appreciating poetry requires not only deep literary knowledge but also keen aesthetic intuition.

zh: 这项医学研究旨在探讨遗传因素在心脏病发病机制中的作用。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng yīxué yánjiū zhǐ zài tàntǎo yíchuán yīnsù zài xīnzàngbìng fābìng jīzhì zhōng de zuòyòng.
en: This medical study aims to explore the role of genetic factors in the pathogenesis of heart disease.

zh: 随着市场需求的不断演变，标致公司正致力于开发电动车型。
pinyin: Suízhe shìchǎng xūqiú de bùduàn yǎnbiàn, Biāozhì gōngsī zhèng zhìlì yú kāifā diàndòng chēxíng.
en: With the continuous evolution of market demand, Peugeot is committed to developing electric vehicle models.

zh: 为了维护自己的权益，他不得不正式控告该企业的违规行为。
pinyin: wèile wéihù zìjǐ de quányì, tā bùdébù zhèngshì kònggào gāi qǐyè de wéiguī xíngwéi.
en: In order to safeguard his rights and interests, he had to formally accuse the enterprise of its violations.

zh: 直到这项科研成果正式发布，他才在那场发布会上公开露面。
pinyin: Zhídào zhè xiàng kēyán chéngguǒ zhèngshì fābù, tā cái zài nà chǎng fābùhuì shàng gōngkāi lòumiàn.
en: It was not until this scientific research result was officially released that he made a public appearance at the press conference.

zh: 无论面对怎样的困境，他都始终保持着对舞台的热爱与敬畏。
pinyin: Wúlùn miànduì zěnyàng de kùnjìng, tā dōu shǐzhōng bǎochízhe duì wǔtái de rè'ài yǔ jìngwèi.
en: No matter what kind of plight he faces, he has always maintained his love and reverence for the stage.

zh: 虽然他建议我们摄入适量的脂肪，但我依然保持谨慎的态度。
pinyin: suī rán tā jiàn yì wǒ men shè rù shì liàng de zhī fáng, dàn wǒ yī rán bǎo chí jǐn shèn de tài dù.
en: Although he suggested we consume an appropriate amount of fat, I still maintain a cautious attitude.

zh: 这家餐厅供应的传统豆浆口感细腻，且富含丰富的植物蛋白。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng gōngyìng de chuántǒng dòujiāng kǒugǎn xìnì, qiě fùhán fēngfù de zhíwù dànbái.
en: The traditional soy milk served at this restaurant has a smooth texture and is rich in plant protein.

zh: 即使面临诸多摩擦，他们依然在努力协调以求和谐地过日子。
pinyin: jíshǐ miànlín zhūduō mócā, tāmen yīrán zài nǔlì xiétiáo yǐ qiú héxié de guò rì zi.
en: Even facing many frictions, they are still trying to coordinate to get along harmoniously.

zh: 该地区凭借其得天独厚的矿藏优势，促进了工业的迅速发展。
pinyin: Gāi dì qū píng jiè qí dé tiān dú hòu de kuàng cáng yōu shì, cù jìn le gōng yè de xùn sù fā zhǎn.
en: Relying on its unique mineral resource advantages, this region has promoted the rapid development of industry.

zh: 作为一名优秀的辩护律师，他致力于维护法律的公正与尊严。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng yōuxiù de biànhù lǜshī, tā zhìlì yú wéihù fǎlǜ de gōngzhèng yǔ zūnyán.
en: As an excellent defense lawyer, he is committed to upholding the justice and dignity of the law.

zh: 经过激烈的角逐，他凭借精湛的技术最终赢得了决赛的冠军。
pinyin: Jīngguò jīliè de juézhú, tā píngjiè jīngzhàn de jìshù zuìzhōng yíngdé le juésài de guànjūn.
en: After a fierce competition, he eventually won the championship of the finals with his superb skills.

zh: 尽管外部环境恶劣，他仍暗地里筹划着这项宏大的商业蓝图。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wàibù huánjìng èliè, tā réng àndìlǐ chóuhuàzhe zhè xiàng hóngdà de shāngyè lántú.
en: Despite the harsh external environment, he is still secretly planning this ambitious business blueprint.

zh: 面对突发的自然灾害，当地民众展现出了极大的勇气与韧性。
pinyin: miàn duì tū fā de zì rán zāi hài, dāng dì mín zhòng zhǎn xiàn chū le jí dà de yǒng qì yǔ rèn xìng.
en: Facing the sudden natural disaster, the local populace demonstrated great courage and resilience.

zh: 为了构思这部长篇小说，作者在偏远的乡村潜心创作了三年。
pinyin: Wèile gòusī zhè bù chángpiān xiǎoshuō, zuòzhě zài piānyuǎn de xiāngcūn qiánxīn chuàngzuò le sān nián.
en: In order to conceive this novel, the author devoted himself to writing in a remote village for three years.

zh: 面对错综复杂的局面，他一时感到头绪混乱，不知从何下手。
pinyin: Miànduì cuòzōngfùzá de júmiàn, tā yīshí gǎndào tóuxù hùnluàn, bùzhī cóng hé xiàshǒu.
en: Faced with the complicated situation, he felt confused for a moment and did not know where to start.

zh: 各方在峰会上达成了重要的共识，旨在促进全球可持续发展。
pinyin: gè fāng zài fēng huì shàng dá chéng le zhòng yào de gòng shí, zhǐ zài cù jìn quán qiú kě chí xù fā zhǎn.
en: The parties reached an important consensus at the summit, aimed at promoting global sustainable development.

zh: 经过严密的统计，此次科研项目总共采集了三千个有效样本。
pinyin: Jīngguò yánmì de tǒngjì, cǐ cì kēyán xiàngmù zǒnggòng cǎijí le sānqiān gè yǒuxiào yàngběn.
en: After rigorous statistics, this scientific research project collected a total of three thousand valid samples.

zh: 该项目圆满完成，标志着团队取得了具有里程碑意义的成就。
pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù yuánmǎn wánchéng, biāozhìzhe tuánduì qǔdéle jùyǒu lǐchéngbēi yìyì de chéngjiù.
en: The project was completed successfully, marking a milestone achievement for the team.

zh: 数据分析显示，该平台的广告点击率呈现出明显的增长趋势。
pinyin: shù jù fēn xī xiǎn shì, gāi píng tái de guǎng gào diǎn jī lǜ chéng xiàn chū míng xiǎn de zǎn de zēng zhǎng qū shì.
en: Data analysis shows that the platform's advertising click-through rate exhibits an obvious growth trend.

zh: 尽管外界舆论众说纷纭，他依然一如既往地坚持自己的原则。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wàijiè yúlùn zhòngshuōfēnyún, tā yīrán yī rú jì wǎng de jiānchí zìjǐ de yuánzé.
en: Despite the mixed public opinions, he persists in his principles just as in the past.

zh: 他原本以为炒股能迅速致富，却没想到最终导致了严重的亏损。
pinyin: Tā yuánběn yǐwéi chǎogǔ néng xùnsù zhìfù, què méi xiǎngdào zuìzhōng dǎozhì le yánzhòng de kuīsǔn.
en: He originally thought that speculating in stocks could lead to quick riches, but he didn't expect it to eventually lead to severe losses.

zh: 人类的活动往往会破坏动物的栖息地，导致生态平衡受到威胁。
pinyin: Rénlèi de huódòng wǎngwǎng huì pòhuài dòngwù de qīxīdì, dǎozhì shēngtài shēngtài pínghéng shòudào wēixié.
en: Human activities often destroy animal habitats, causing the ecological balance to be threatened.

zh: 由于该事件的影响深远，它理所当然地成为了各大报刊的头条。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi shìjiàn de yǐngxiǎng shēnyuǎn, tā lǐsuǒdāngrán de chéngwéile gè dà bàokān de tóutiáo.
en: Due to the profound impact of the event, it naturally became the headline for all major newspapers and periodicals.

zh: 能在学术交流会上聆听大师的见解，并获得赐教，我深感荣幸。
pinyin: Néng zài xuéshù jiāoliú huì shàng língtīng dàshī de jiànjiě, bìng huòdé cìjiào, wǒ shēngǎn róngxìng.
en: I feel deeply honored to listen to the master's insights and receive their guidance at the academic conference.

zh: 他凭借丰富的想象力，在小说中构建了一个宏大而诡秘的场景。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè fēngfù de xiǎngxiànglì, zài xiǎoshuō zhōng gòujiànle yīgè hóngdà ér guǐmì de chǎngjǐng.
en: Relying on his rich imagination, he constructed a grand and mysterious scene in the novel.

zh: 尽管缺乏专业的指导，他的素描作品依然展现出独特的艺术感。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn quēfá zhuānyè de zhǐdǎo, tā de sùmiáo zuòpǐn yīrán zhǎnxiàn chū dútè de yìshù gǎn.
en: Despite the lack of professional guidance, his sketch work still displays a unique artistic sense.

zh: 互联网企业往往能够通过挖掘大数据来预见消费者的潜在需求。
pinyin: Hùliánwǎng qǐyè wǎngwǎng nénggòu tōngguò wājué dàshùjù lái yùjiàn xiāofèizhě de qiánzài xūqiú.
en: Internet companies are often able to foresee the potential needs of consumers by mining big data.

zh: 环境保护的意识应该深入千家万户，成为每个公民的自觉行动。
pinyin: Huánjìng bǎohù de yìshí yīnggāi shēnrù qiānjiāwànhù, chéngwéi měi gè gōngmín de zìjué xíngdòng.
en: The awareness of environmental protection should reach every family and become the conscious action of every citizen.

zh: 近年来，尽管面临诸多挑战，国家依然致力于推动可持续发展。
pinyin: Jìnniánlái, jǐnguǎn miànlín zhūduō tiǎozhàn, guójiā yīrán zhìlì yú tuīdòng kě chíxù fāzhǎn.
en: For the past few years, despite facing many challenges, the country remains committed to promoting sustainable development.

zh: 尽管存在争议，核能依然是缓解全球能源危机的重要手段之一。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn cúnzài zhēngyì, hénéng yīrán shì huǎnjiě quánqiú néngyuán wēijī de zhòngyào shǒuduàn zhī yī.
en: Despite the controversy, nuclear energy remains one of the important means to alleviate the global energy crisis.

zh: 为了获得晋升，他不得不将全部精力投入到当前的科研项目中。
pinyin: Wèi le huò dé jìn shēng, tā bù dé bù jiāng quán bù jīng lì tóu rù dào dāng qián de kē yán xiàng mù zhōng.
en: In order to get promoted, he had to devote all his energy to the current research project.

zh: 书中人物复杂的心理状态与平淡的叙述手法构成了鲜明的反差。
pinyin: Shū zhōng rénwù fùzá de xīnlǐ zhuàngtài yǔ píngdàn de xùshù shǒufǎ gòuchéngle xiānmíng de fǎnchā.
en: The complex psychological state of the characters in the book and the dull narrative style form a sharp contrast.

zh: 作为一名职业球员，他致力于教练新一代选手以提升国家水平。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng zhíyè qiúyuán, tā zhìlì yú jiàoliàn xīn yīdài xuǎnshǒu yǐ tíshēng guójiā shuǐpíng.
en: As a professional athlete, he is dedicated to coaching the new generation of players to improve the national standard.

zh: 由于未能达到规定的学分要求，他被取消了申请奖学金的资格。
pinyin: Yóuyú wèinéng dádào guīdìng de xuéfēn yāoqiú, tā bèi qǔxiāo le shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn de zīgé.
en: Due to failing to meet the required course credits, he was disqualified from applying for the scholarship.

zh: 建筑师通过精确的几何计算，赋予了这座大楼独特的建筑形状。
pinyin: Jiànzhùshī tōngguò jīngquè de jǐhé jìsuàn, fùyǔle zhè zuò dàlóu dútè de jiànzhù xíngzhuàng.
en: The architect gave this building a unique architectural shape through precise geometric calculations.

zh: 尽管市场环境严峻，他依然坚持投资，最终导致了严重的亏本。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shìchǎng huánjìng yánjùn, tā yīrán jiānchí tóuzī, zuìzhōng dǎozhì le yánzhòng de kuīběn.
en: Despite the harsh market environment, he persisted in investing, which eventually led to a serious loss.

zh: 庙会不仅展示了传统的民俗文化，还促进了当地的旅游业发展。
pinyin: miào huì bù jǐn zhǎn shì le chuán tǒng de mín sú wén huà, hái cù jìn le dāng dì de lǚ yóu yè fā zhǎn.
en: The temple fair not only showcases traditional folk culture but also promotes the development of local tourism.

zh: 在那场旷日持久的战争中，国王始终坚守着自己的领土与尊严。
pinyin: Zài nà chǎng kuàngrìchíjiǔ de zhànzhēng zhōng, guówáng shǐzhōng jiānshǒu zhe zìjǐ de lǐngtǔ yǔ zūnyán.
en: Throughout that protracted war, the king steadfastly defended his territory and dignity.

zh: 尽管他竭力掩饰内心的不安，但依然急忙地回避了对方的目光。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā jiélì yǎnshì nèixīn de bù'ān, dàn yīrán jímáng de huíbì le duìfāng de mùguāng.
en: Although he tried his best to hide his inner anxiety, he still hurriedly avoided the other person's gaze.

zh: 随着全球化的发展，华语在国际交流中扮演着愈发重要的角色。
pinyin: Suízhe quánqiúhuà de fāzhǎn, Huáyǔ zài guójì jiāoliú zhōng bànyǎn zhe yùfā zhòngyào de juésè.
en: With the development of globalization, the Chinese language plays an increasingly important role in international communication.

zh: 通过多年的耳闻目睹，他深刻地洞察了社会各阶层的生存现状。
pinyin: Tōngguò duōnián de ěr wén mù dǔ, tā shēnkè de dòngchá le shèhuì gè jiēcéng de shēngcún xiànzhuàng.
en: Through years of personal observation, he has deeply insighted into the living conditions of various social strata.

zh: 面对瞬息万变的市场需求，这家企业的生产效率明显跟不上了。
pinyin: Miànduì shùnxīwànbiàn de shìchǎng xūqiú, zhè jiā qǐyè de shēngchǎn xiàolǜ míngxiǎn gēn bu shàng le.
en: Faced with ever-changing market demands, this company's production efficiency clearly cannot keep up.

zh: 虽然生活条件艰苦，但他还是尽心尽力地伺候着退休的老校长。
pinyin: Suīrán shēnghuó tiáojiàn jiānkǔ, dàn tā háishì jènxīnjènlì de cìhouzhe tuìxiū de lǎo xiàozhǎng.
en: Although living conditions are difficult, he still does his best to attend to the retired principal.

zh: 他对于长年累月的辛勤付出毫无怨言，这种敬业精神令人钦佩。
pinyin: Tā duìyú chángniánlěiyuè de xīnqín fùchū háowú yuànyán, zhè zhǒng jìngyè jīngshén lìngrén qīnpèi.
en: He has no complaints about his years of hard work, and this professionalism is admirable.

zh: 面对突如其来的变故，老人家展现出了令人钦佩的沉着与智慧。
pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de biàngù, lǎo rén jiā zhǎnxiàn chū le lìngrén qīnpèi de chénzhuó yǔ zhìhuì.
en: Facing the sudden changes, the old person displayed admirable composure and wisdom.

zh: 全球化进程不仅拓宽了贸易渠道，也促进了文化间的相互包容。
pinyin: Quánqiúhuà jìnchéng bùjǐn tuòkuānle màoyì qúdào, yě cùjìnle wénhuà jiān de xiānghù bāoróng.
en: The process of globalization has not only broadened trade channels but also promoted mutual tolerance between cultures.

zh: 他仿佛着了魔一般，一天到晚沉迷于这种复杂的逻辑推理游戏。
pinyin: Tā fǎngfú zháole mó yībān, yī tiān dào wǎn chénmí yú zhè zhǒng fùzá de luójí tuīlǐ yóuxì.
en: He seems obsessed, indulging in this kind of complex logic puzzle game all day long.

zh: 在面临行业竞争的压力下，企业必须尽快实现关键技术的攻关。
pinyin: Zài miànlín hángyè jìngzhēng de yālì xià, qǐyè bìxū jǐnkuài shíxiàn guānjiàn jìshù de gōngguān.
en: Under the pressure of industry competition, enterprises must achieve breakthroughs in key technologies as soon as possible.

zh: 无数仁人志士为了民族的独立，前赴后继，牺牲了宝贵的生命。
pinyin: wúshù rénrénzhìshì wèile mínzú de dúlì, qiánfùhòujì, xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng.
en: Countless patriots advanced dauntlessly in wave upon wave for the independence of the nation, sacrificing their precious lives.

zh: 为了确保交通安全，高速公路对各类车辆的车速都有严格限制。
pinyin: wèi le què bǎo jiāo tōng ān quán, gāo sù gōng lù duì gè lèi chē liàng de chē sù dōu yǒu yán gé xiàn zhì.
en: In order to ensure traffic safety, expressways have strict speed limits for all types of vehicles.

zh: 作为一名学生，他必须保证学业优异，同时积极参与社会实践。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng xuéshēng, tā bìxū bǎozhèng xuéyè yōuyì, tóngshí jījí cānyù shèhuì shíjiàn.
en: As a student, he must ensure excellent academic performance while actively participating in social practice.

zh: 电视台投入了大量资金改造演播室，旨在提升节目的视觉效果。
pinyin: Diànshìtái tóurùle dàliàngliàng zījīn gǎizào yǎnbōshì, zhǐ zài tíshēng jiémù de shìjué xiàoguǒ.
en: The television station invested a large amount of funds to renovate the broadcasting studio, aiming to enhance the program's visual effects.

zh: 在那次庄重的餐桌礼仪演示中，每一件餐具的摆放都十分讲究。
pinyin: zài nà cì zhuāng zhòng de cān zhuō lǐ yí yǎn shì zhōng, měi yī jiàn cān jù de bǎi fàng dōu shí fēn jiǎng jiu.
en: In that formal dining table etiquette demonstration, the placement of every piece of tableware was very particular.

zh: 即便面对强劲的对手，他也始终保持冷静，在棋盘上从容对弈。
pinyin: Jíbiàn miàn duì qiángjìng de duìshǒu, tā yě shǐzhōng bǎochí lěngjìng, zài qípán shàng cóngróng duìyì.
en: Even when facing a strong opponent, he remained calm and played Go composedly on the board.

zh: 优秀的领导者通常善于倾听他人的意见，从而做出理性的决策。
pinyin: Yōuxiù de lǐngdǎozhě tōngcháng shànyú qīngtīng tārén de yìjiàn, cóng'ér zuòchū lǐxìng de juécè.
en: Excellent leaders are usually good at listening to others' opinions, so as to make rational decisions.

zh: 在该国经济转型的过程中，其股票市场表现出明显的涨价趋势。
pinyin: zài gāi guó jīngjì zhuǎnxíng de guòchéng zhōng, qí gǔpiào shìchǎng biǎoxiàn chū míngxiǎn de zhǎngjià qūshì.
en: During the country's economic transformation process, its stock market showed a clear trend of appreciation.

zh: 在那段黑暗的时期，许多知识分子选择通过文学作品进行反抗。
pinyin: Zài nà duàn hēi àn de shí qī, xǔ duō zhī shí fèn zǐ xuǎn zé tōng guò wén xué zuò pǐn jìn xíng fǎn kàng.
en: During that dark period, many intellectuals chose to rebel through literary works.

zh: 面对突如其来的变故，他表现得异常冷静，一切工作照常进行。
pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de biàngù, tā biǎoxiàn dé yìcháng lěngjìng, yīqiè gōngzuò zhàocháng jìnxíng.
en: Facing the sudden turn of events, he appeared unusually calm, and everything proceeded as usual.

zh: 多年来，他不仅致力于学术研究，还积极投身于社会公益事业。
pinyin: Duō nián lái, tā bùjǐn zhìlì yú xuéshù yánjiū, hái jījí tóushēn yú shèhuì gōngyì shìyè.
en: For many years, he has not only been devoted to academic research but also actively involved in social welfare undertakings.

zh: 那位歌手与歌迷之间的互动非常融洽，表现出极高的职业素养。
pinyin: Nà wèi gēshǒu yǔ gēmí zhī jiān de hùdòng fēicháng róngqià, biǎoxiàn chū jí gāo de zhíyè sùyǎng.
en: The interaction between that singer and the fans is very harmonious, demonstrating high professionalism.

zh: 留学生在异国他乡面临着诸多挑战，但也获得了宝贵的人生阅历。
pinyin: Liú xué shēng zài yìguótāxiāng miànlínzhe zhūduō tiǎozhàn, dàn yě huòdéle bǎoguì de rénshēng yuèlì.
en: International students face many challenges in a foreign land, but they also gain valuable life experience.

zh: 皇宫里收藏了许多珍贵的文物，充分体现了古代工匠的卓越技艺。
pinyin: Huánggōng lǐ shōucángle xǔduō zhēnguì de wénwù, chōngfèn tǐxiànle gǔdài gōngjiàng de zhuóyuè jìyì.
en: The imperial palace houses many precious cultural relics, fully reflecting the excellent skills of ancient craftsmen.

zh: 面对艰难的选择，他始终坚守原则，赢得了所有竞争对手的尊敬。
pinyin: Miànduì jiānnán de xuǎnzé, tā shǐzhōng jiānshǒu yuánzé, yíngdéle suǒyǒu jìngzhēng duìshǒu de zūnjìng.
en: Facing difficult choices, he always stood by his principles and earned the respect of all his competitors.

zh: 随着基础设施的完善，偏远地区的电信覆盖范围得到了显著提升。
pinyin: Suízhe jīchǔ shèshī de wánshàn, piānyuǎn dìqū de diànxìn fùgài fànwéi dédào le xiǎnzhù tíshēng.
en: With the improvement of infrastructure, telecommunications coverage in remote areas has been significantly enhanced.

zh: 她们不仅在学术领域取得了卓越的成就，还积极投身于公益事业。
pinyin: Tāmen bùjǐn zài xuéshù lǐngyù qǔdéle zhuóyuè de chéngjiù, hái jījí tóushēn yú gōngyì shìyè.
en: They have not only achieved excellent accomplishments in the academic field, but also actively devoted themselves to public welfare.

zh: 他在俱乐部发表了关于环境保护的演讲，呼吁大家采取具体措施。
pinyin: Tā zài jùlèbù fābiǎole guānyú huánjìng bǎohù de yǎnjiǎng, hūyù dàjiā cǎiqǔ jùtǐ cuòshī.
en: He gave a speech about environmental protection at the club, calling on everyone to take concrete measures.

zh: 尽管他竭力保持镇定，但那则出乎意料的报道还是让他大吃一惊。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā jiélì bǎochí zhèndìng, dàn nà zé chūhūyìliào de bàodào háishì ràng tā dà chī yī jīng.
en: Although he tried hard to stay calm, that unexpected report still left him astounded.

zh: 鉴于环境保护的需要，政府对工业用水的立方米单价进行了调整。
pinyin: jiàn yú huán jìng bǎo hù de xū yào, zhèng fǔ duì gōng yè yòng shuǐ de lì fāng mǐ dān jià jìn xíng le tiáo zhěng.
en: In view of environmental protection needs, the government adjusted the unit price per cubic meter for industrial water usage.

zh: 联想凭借其卓越的科技创新能力，在国际市场上占据了重要地位。
pinyin: Liánxiǎng píngjiè qí zhuóyuè de kējì chuàngxīn nénglì, zài guójì shìchǎng shàng zhànjù le zhòngyào dìwèi.
en: Relying on its outstanding technological innovation capabilities, Lenovo occupies an important position in the international market.

zh: 这一突发事件给当地基础设施的重建工作造成了难以逾越的障碍。
pinyin: zhè yī tūfā shìjiàn gěi dāngdì jīchǔ shèshī de chóngjiàn gōngzuò zàochéngle nányǐ yùyuè de zhàng'ài.
en: This sudden incident created insurmountable obstacles for the reconstruction of local infrastructure.

zh: 无论在科研领域还是日常生活中，探索未知的过程总会碰到挫折。
pinyin: Wúlùn zài kēyán lǐngyù háishì rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, tànsuǒ wèizhī de guòchéng zǒng huì pèngdào cuòzhé.
en: Whether in scientific research or daily life, one will always come across setbacks when exploring the unknown.

zh: 机器在运转过程中发出的刺耳响声，引起了技术人员的高度重视。
pinyin: jīqì zài yùnzhuǎn guòchéng zhōng fāchū de cì'ěr xiǎngshēng, yǐnqǐ le jìshù rényuán de gāodù zhòngshì.
en: The harsh noise emitted during the machine's operation drew the high attention of the technicians.

zh: 面对突如其来的挑战，众人表现得十分从容，展现了极高的素养。
pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de tiǎozhàn, zhòngrén biǎoxiàn dé shífēn cóngróng, zhǎnxiàn le jí gāo de sùyǎng.
en: Faced with the sudden challenge, everyone acted very calmly, demonstrating high quality.

zh: 随着冷链物流的普及，内陆地区的居民也能享用到高品质的海鲜。
pinyin: Suízhe lěngliàn wùliú de pǔjí, nèilù dìqū de jūmín yě néng xiǎngyòng dào gāo pǐnzhì de hǎixiān.
en: With the popularization of cold chain logistics, residents in inland areas can also enjoy high-quality seafood.

zh: 他凭借扎实的表演功底，终于从跑龙套的演员晋升为剧中的主角。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè zhāshi de biǎoyǎn gōngdǐ, zhōngyú cóng pǎo lóng tào de yǎnyuán jìnshēng wèi jù zhōng de zhǔjiǎo.
en: Relying on his solid acting skills, he finally promoted from being an extra to the lead actor in the drama.

zh: 随着航空工业的飞速发展，现代飞机的安全系数得到了显著提高。
pinyin: Suízhe hángkōng gōngyè de fēisù fāzhǎn, xiàndài fēijī de ānquán xìshù dédào le xiǎnzhù tígāo.
en: With the rapid development of the aviation industry, the safety factor of modern airplanes has been significantly improved.

zh: 在漫长的历史进程中，许多家族通过血缘传承延续了祖先的使命。
pinyin: Zài màncháng de lìshǐ jìnchéng zhōng, xǔduō jiāzú tōngguò xuèyuán chuánchéng yánxù le zǔxiān de shǐmìng.
en: In the long course of history, many families have continued their ancestors' mission through bloodline inheritance.

zh: 那场音乐会上，歌手深情地弹奏着吉他，引起了全场观众的共鸣。
pinyin: nà chǎng yīnyuèhuì shàng, gēshǒu shēnqíng de tánzòu zhe jítā, yǐnqǐ le quánchǎng guānzhòng de gòngmíng.
en: At that concert, the singer played the guitar emotionally, resonating with the entire audience.

zh: 随着社交媒体的发展，这些观点迅速成为了公众讨论的热门话题。
pinyin: Suízhe shèjiāo méitǐ de fāzhǎn, zhèxiē guāndiǎn xùnsù chéngwéi le gōngzhòng tǎolùn de rèmén huàtí.
en: With the development of social media, these viewpoints have quickly become popular topics of public discussion.

zh: 语言学家致力于研究方言的演变及其在社会文化中所扮演的角色。
pinyin: yǔ yán xué jiā zhì lì yú yán jiū fāng yán de yǎn biàn jí qí zé qí zài shè huì wén huà zhōng suǒ bàn yǎn de jué sè.
en: Linguists are committed to studying the evolution of dialects and the roles they play in social culture.

zh: 虽然这栋房子的地理位置优越，但其价钱远超出了我的预算范围。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè dòng fángzi de dìlǐ wèizhì yōuyuè, dàn qí jiàqian yuǎn chāochū le wǒ de yùsuàn fànwéi.
en: Although the location of this house is excellent, its price is far beyond my budget range.

zh: 随着航空技术的突飞猛进，新型客机的燃油效率得到了显著提高。
pinyin: Suízhe hángkōng jìshù de tūfēiměngjìn, xīnxíng kèjī de rányóu xiàolǜ dédàole xiǎnzhù tígāo.
en: With the rapid advancement of aviation technology, the fuel efficiency of new passenger planes has improved significantly.

zh: 这项科学实验要求精确测量出样品的重量，单位必须精确到千克。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng kēxué shíyàn yāoqiú jīngquè cèliáng chū yàngpǐn de zhòngliàng, dānwèi bìxū jīngquè dào qiānkè.
en: This scientific experiment requires precise measurement of the sample's weight, with units strictly specified in kilograms.

zh: 面对诸多诱惑，他依然坚定地选择应聘那家科研机构的核心岗位。
pinyin: Miànduì zhūduō yòuhuò, tā yīrán jiāndìng de xuǎnzé yìngpìn nà jiā kēyán jīgòu de héxīn gǎngwèi.
en: Faced with many temptations, he still firmly chose to accept the job offer for the core position at that research institution.

zh: 许多人不仅钦佩他的商业头脑，更敬佩他作为创始人的坚定信念。
pinyin: Xǔduō rén bùjǐn qīnpèi tā de shāngyè tóunǎo, gèng jìngpèi tā zuòwéi chuàngshǐrén de jiāndìng xìnniàn.
en: Many people not only admire his business acumen, but also respect his firm belief as a founder.

zh: 他凭借惊人的爆发力，在跳远决赛中一举打破了保持多年的纪录。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè jīngrén de bàofālì, zài tiào yuǎn juésài zhōng yī jǔ dǎpòle bǎochí duō nián de jìlù.
en: With his astonishing explosive power, he broke the long-standing record in the long jump final.

zh: 在那场激烈的争辩后，双方陷入了尴尬的沉默，彼此皆无话可说。
pinyin: Zài nà chǎng jīliè de zhēngbiàn hòu, shuāngfāng xiànrù le gāngà de chénmò, bǐcǐ jiē wú huà kě shuō.
en: After that heated debate, both sides fell into an awkward silence, and neither had anything left to say.

zh: 通过多次反复的战术演练，士兵们的协同作战能力得到了显著提升。
pinyin: Tōngguò duōcì fǎnfù de zhànshù yǎnliàn, shìbīngmen de xiétóng zuòzhàn nénglì dédàole xiǎnzhù tíshēng.
en: Through repeated tactical drills, the soldiers' cooperative combat ability has been significantly improved.

zh: 礼仪作为一种约定俗成的约束机制，在社会交往中发挥着重要作用。
pinyin: Lǐyí zuòwéi yī zhǒng yuēdìngsúchéng de yuēshù jīzhì, zài shèhuì jiāowǎng zhōng fāhuīzhe zhòngyào zuòyòng.
en: Etiquette, as a customary convention of constraint, plays an important role in social interaction.

zh: 伊斯兰教的建筑风格融合了多种文化元素，展现出独特的艺术魅力。
pinyin: Yīsīlánjiào de jiànzhù fēnggé rónghé le duō zhǒng wénhuà yuánsù, zhǎnxiàn chū dútè de yìshù mèilì.
en: The architectural style of Islam integrates various cultural elements, demonstrating a unique artistic charm.

zh: 在那场激烈的辩论赛中，评委们聚精会神地倾听每一位选手的陈述。
pinyin: Zài nà chǎng jīliè de biànlùnsài zhōng, píngwěimen jùjīnghuìshén de qīngtīng měi yī wèi xuǎnshǒu de chénshù.
en: During that intense debate competition, the judges listened attentively to every contestant's statement.

zh: 无论多么繁琐的家务，她总是处理得井井有条，真是一个勤快的人。
pinyin: Wúlùn duōme fánsuǒ de jiāwù, tā zǒng shì chǔlǐ dé jǐngjǐngyǒutiáo, zhēn shì yīgè qínkuai de rén.
en: No matter how tedious the housework is, she always handles it in an organized way; she is truly a diligent person.

zh: 政府正在加强对乳制品市场的严格监管，以确保消费者的食品安全。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài jiāqiáng duì rǔ zhì pǐn shìchǎng de yángé jiānguǎn, yǐ quèbǎo xiāofèizhě de shípǐn ānquán.
en: The government is strengthening strict supervision of the dairy market to ensure food safety for consumers.

zh: 在快节奏的都市生活中，便捷的盒饭已成为许多上班族的常态选择。
pinyin: Zài kuài jiésòu de dūshì shēnghuó zhōng, biànjié de héfàn yǐ chéngwéi xǔduō shàngbānzú de chángtài xuǎnzé.
en: In the fast-paced urban life, convenient boxed meals have become a common choice for many office workers.

zh: 作为一名教师，他始终致力于通过创新的教学方法激发学生的潜能。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng jiàoshī, tā shǐzhōng zhìlì yú tōngguò chuàngxīn de jiàoxué fāngfǎ jīfā xuéshēng de qiánnéng.
en: As a teacher, he has always been committed to stimulating students' potential through innovative teaching methods.

zh: 通过深入的聊天儿，我逐渐领悟到他那独特的人生哲学与价值观念。
pinyin: Tōngguò shēnrù de liáotiānr, wǒ zhújiàn lǐngwù dào tā nà dútè de rénshēng zhéxué yǔ jiàzhí guānniàn.
en: Through in-depth conversation, I gradually realized his unique philosophy of life and values.

zh: 随着人工智能的飞速发展，很多传统行业在创新方面已经无法跟上。
pinyin: Suízhe réngōng zhìnéng de fēisù fāzhǎn, hěnduō chuántǒng hángyè zài chuàngxīn fāngmiàn yǐjīng wúfǎ gēn shàng.
en: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, many traditional industries can no longer keep pace in terms of innovation.

zh: 在商务谈判中，首席代理人必须谨慎行事以维护委托人的核心利益。
pinyin: Zài shāngwù tánpàn zhōng, shǒuxí dàilǐrén bìxū jǐnshèn xíngshì yǐ wéihù wěituōrén de héxīn lìyì.
en: In business negotiations, the chief agent must act cautiously to safeguard the principal's core interests.

zh: 那个受人尊敬的诗人吟诵着优美的诗篇，仿佛一位古代的行吟诗人。
pinyin: Nàge shòu rén zūnjìng de shīrén yínsòngzhe yōuměi de shīpiān, fǎngfú yī wèi gǔdài de xíngyín shīrén.
en: The respected poet recited beautiful verses, much like an ancient bard.

zh: 由于长期饮食习惯的差异，有些人对这种麻辣的刺激感到难以适应。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī yǐnshí xíguàn de chāyì, yǒuxiē rén duì zhè zhǒng málà de cìjī gǎndào nányǐ shìyìng.
en: Due to differences in long-term dietary habits, some people find it difficult to adapt to this kind of spicy and numbing stimulation.

zh: 尽管现在的饮食选择非常丰富，许多人依然对传统的馒头情有独钟。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiànzài de yǐnshí xuǎnzé fēicháng fēngfù, xǔduō rén yīrán duì chuántǒng de mántou qíngyǒudúzhōng.
en: Although there is now a rich variety of food options, many people still have a special preference for traditional steamed buns.

zh: 即便是在这种经济环境下，商场依然通过提供特价优惠来刺激消费。
pinyin: Jíbiàn shì zài zhè zhǒng jīngjì huánjìng xià, shāngchǎng yīrán tōngguò tígōng tèjià yōuhuì lái cìjī xiāofèi.
en: Even in this economic environment, shopping malls still stimulate consumption by offering special price discounts.

zh: 为了能够诠释好这个角色，演员在开拍前深入体验了当地人的生活。
pinyin: Wèile nénggòu quánshì hǎo zhège juésè, yǎnyuán zài kāipāiqián shēnrù tǐyàn le dāngdì rén de shēnghuó.
en: In order to interpret this role well, the actor experienced the local people's lives in depth before filming started.

zh: 凭借在科研领域的卓越贡献，他获得了由基金会提供的丰厚奖学金。
pinyin: Píngjiè zài kēyán lǐngyù de zhuóyuè gòngxiàn, tā huòdé le yóu jījīnhuì tígōng de fēnghòu jiǎngxuéjīn.
en: By virtue of his outstanding contributions to the field of scientific research, he received a generous scholarship provided by the foundation.

zh: 在这场残酷的商业竞争中，由于资金链断裂，那家企业最终完蛋了。
pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng cánkù de shāngyè jìngzhēng zhōng, yóuyú zījīnliàn duànliè, nà jiā qǐyè zuìzhōng wándàn le.
en: In this brutal business competition, because the capital chain broke, that enterprise was eventually done for.

zh: 在激烈的市场竞争中，各家企业争先恐后地研发新技术以抢占先机。
pinyin: Zài jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng, gèjiā qǐyè zhēngxiānkǒnghòu de yánfā xīn jìshù yǐ qiǎngzhàn xiānjī.
en: In the fierce market competition, companies strive to be first and fear to be last to develop new technologies to seize the initiative.

zh: 他对于这个问题的看法与我不谋而合，只是在细节上略微有些出入。
pinyin: Tā duìyú zhège wèntí de kànfǎ yǔ wǒ bùmóu'érhé, zhǐshì zài xìjié shàng lüèwēi yǒuxiē chūrù.
en: His views on this issue coincide with mine, with only a little bit of discrepancy in the details.

zh: 在那段充满挑战的岁月里，每一个细微的转机都足以让人感到欣喜。
pinyin: zài nà duàn chōng mǎn tiǎo zhàn de suì yuè lǐ, měi yī gè xì wēi de zhuǎn jī dōu zú yǐ ràng rén gǎn dào xīn xǐ.
en: During those challenging years, every tiny turning point was enough to make one feel happy.

zh: 这座城市沉浸在狂欢的氛围中，仿佛正在举行一场全球瞩目的嘉年华。
pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì chénjìn zài kuánghuān de fēnwéi zhōng, fǎngfú zhèngzài jǔxíng yī chǎng quánqiú zhǔmù de jiā nián huá.
en: The city is immersed in a festive atmosphere, as if it were holding a world-renowned carnival.

zh: 虽然他仪表堂堂，确实是个不可多得的人才，但在工作中却不够果断。
pinyin: Suīrán tā yíbiǎo tángtáng, quèshí shì gè bùkě duōdé de réncái, dàn zài gōngzuò zhōng què bùgòu guǒduàn.
en: Although he has a striking appearance and is truly a rare talent, he is not decisive enough at work.

zh: 说白了，如果缺乏创新的动力，企业就很难在激烈的市场竞争中立足。
pinyin: shuō bái le, rúguǒ quēfá chuàngxīn de dònglì, qǐyè jiù hěn nán zài jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng lìzú.
en: To put it frankly, if there is a lack of motivation for innovation, it is difficult for an enterprise to establish a foothold in fierce market competition.

zh: 如果不及时遏制这股犯罪势力，他们必定会无恶不作，危害社会治安。
pinyin: Rúguǒ bù jíshí èzhì zhè gǔ fànzuì shìlì, tāmen bìdìng huì wú è bù zuò, wēihài shèhuì zhì'ān.
en: If this criminal force is not contained in time, they will surely stop at nothing to commit crimes and endanger social security.

zh: 在关键时刻，他毫不犹豫地摒弃了个人偏见，为团队做出了最优决策。

zh: 在这场突如其来的灾难中，许多人不仅丢失了财产，还与亲人失散了。

zh: 他具备高度的自律性，总是能在闹钟响起的第一时间起床，从不拖延。

zh: 他在庆典上宣读了政府部门发来的贺信，表达了对该项目的诚挚祝贺。

zh: 面对诸多困难，他依然保持乐观，一共在艰苦的环境中坚持了整整十年。

pinyin: zhèng fǔ xuān bù jiāng tiáo zhěng jià rì ān pái, yǐ cù jìn dāng dì lǚ yóu yè de fā zhǎn fā zhǎn.
en: The government announced that it will adjust the holiday schedule to promote the development of local tourism.

zh: 这位歌唱家以其洪亮且富有感染力的歌声赢得了赞誉。
pinyin: Zhè wèi gēchàngjiā yǐ qí hóngliàng qiě fùyǒu gǎnrǎnlì de gēshēng yíngdéle zànyù.
en: This singer won acclaim for their loud, clear, and infectious singing voice.

zh: 随着工业化的快速发展，森林资源已经变得十分紧缺。
pinyin: suí zhe gōng yè huà de kuài sù fā zhǎn zhǎn, sēn lín zī yuán yǐ jīng biàn dé shí fēn jǐn quē.
en: With the rapid development of industrialization, forest resources have become very scarce.

zh: 这部史诗作品被公认为人类文明史上不可多得的瑰宝。
pinyin: Zhè bù shǐshī zuòpǐn bèi gōngrèn wéi rénlèi wénmíng shǐ shàng bùkě duō dé de guī bǎo.
en: This epic work is recognized as a rare treasure in the history of human civilization.

zh: 通过临床试验，该疗法已被证实具有显著的治疗功效。
pinyin: tōngguò línchuáng shìyàn, gāi liáofǎ yǐ bèi zhèngshí jùyǒu xiǎnzhù de zhìliáo gōngxiào.
en: Through clinical trials, this therapy has been proven to have significant therapeutic efficacy.

zh: 该问卷的设计旨在调查受访者对环保政策的真实态度。
pinyin: Gāi wènjuàn de shèjì zhǐ zài diàochá shòufǎngzhě duì huánbǎo zhèngcè de zhēnshí tàidù.
en: The design of this questionnaire aims to investigate the respondents' true attitudes toward environmental protection policies.

zh: 由于偏远地区医疗资源匮乏，当地民众就医十分困难。
pinyin: Yóuyú piānyuǎn dìqū yīliáo zīyuán kuífá, dāngdì mínzhòng jiù yī shífēn kùnnán.
en: Due to the lack of medical resources in remote areas, it is very difficult for local residents to seek medical treatment.

zh: 由于双方在谈判中互不相让，场面一度变得十分难看。
pinyin: Yóuyú shuāngfāng zài tánpàn zhōng hùbùxiāngràng, chǎngmiàn yīdù biàn de shífēn nánkàn.
en: Because both sides refused to yield during the negotiations, the scene became very unsightly for a while.

zh: 由于海平面上升，许多低洼的岛屿面临被淹没的威胁。
pinyin: Yóuyú hǎipíngmiàn shàngshēng, xǔduō dīwā de dǎoyǔ miànlín bèi yānmò de wēixié.
en: Due to rising sea levels, many low-lying islands face the threat of being submerged.

zh: 老师傅手法娴熟，包出来的卷子馅料饱满且外皮酥脆。
pinyin: lǎoshīfu shǒufǎ xiánshú, bāo chūlái de juǎnzi xiànliào bǎomǎn qiě wàipí sūcuì.
en: The veteran master has skillful techniques; the spring rolls he wraps are full of filling and the outer skin is crispy.

zh: 尽管吸毒的危害众所周知，仍有人因好奇而陷入深渊。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xī dú de wēihài zhòngsuǒzhōuzhī, réng yǒu rén yīn hàoqí ér xiànrù shēnyuān.
en: Although the harm of taking drugs is well known, some people still fall into the abyss out of curiosity.

zh: 该方案仅为暂时性的补充措施，后续还需进一步优化。
pinyin: Gāi fāng'àn jǐn wèi zànshíxìng de bǔchōng cuòshī, hòuxù hái xū jìnyībù yōuhuà.
en: This proposal is merely a temporary supplementary measure and requires further optimization in the future.

zh: 湖面上的龙舟雕刻精美，彰显出皇家不可侵犯的威严。
pinyin: Húmiàn shàng de lóngzhōu diāokè jīngměi, zhāngxiǎn chū huángjiā bùkě qīnfàn de wēiyán.
en: The carvings on the imperial boat on the lake are exquisite, manifesting the inviolable majesty of the royalty.

zh: 那片桃树林在春风的吹拂下，宛如一片粉红色的云霞。
pinyin: Nà piàn táo shù lín zài chūnfēng de chuīfú xià, wǎnrú yī piàn fěnhóngsè de yúnxiá.
en: The peach orchard, fanned by the spring breeze, looked just like a pink cloud.

zh: 海风吹过，带来一阵清新宜人的气息，令人心旷神怡。
pinyin: Hǎifēng chuīguò, dàilái yīzhèn qīngxīn yírén de qìxī, lìng rén xīnkuàngshényí.
en: The sea breeze blew over, bringing a fresh and pleasant scent that was refreshing and delightful.

zh: 由于日程安排极其紧凑，大家只能在途中以快餐充饥。
pinyin: Yóuyú rìchéng ānpái jíqí jǐncòu, dàjiā zhǐnéng zài túzhōng yǐ kuàicān chōngjī.
en: Due to the extremely tight schedule, everyone could only satisfy their hunger with a quick meal on the way.

zh: 尽管大家都知道奶茶含糖量极高，但它依然风靡全国。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn dàjiā dōu zhīdào nǎichá hántángliàng jí gāo, dàn tā yīrán fēngmí quánguó.
en: Even though everyone knows milk tea has an extremely high sugar content, it remains popular nationwide.

zh: 这件艺术品是由一位经验丰富的木匠精心雕刻而成的。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yìshùpǐn shì yóu yī wèi jīngyàn fēngfù de mùjiàng jīngxīn diāokè ér chéng de.
en: This piece of art was carefully carved by an experienced carpenter.

zh: 政府呼吁广大市民尽早接种疫苗，以遏制病毒的传播。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ hūyù guǎngdà shìmín jǐnzǎo jiēzhǒng yìmiáo, yǐ èzhì bìngdú de chuánbō.
en: The government urges citizens to get vaccinated as early as possible to curb the spread of the virus.

zh: 面对这件稀世珍宝，行家们展开了激烈的鉴赏与辩论。
pinyin: Miànduì zhè jiàn xīshì zhēnbǎo, hángjiāmen zhǎnkāi le jīliè de jiànjiànshǎng yǔ biànlùn.
en: Facing this rare treasure, the connoisseurs began an intense appraisal and debate.

zh: 为了应对通货膨胀，银行提高了利率以抑制物价上涨。
pinyin: Wèi le yìng duì tōng huò péng zhàng, yín háng tí gāo le lì lǜ yǐ yì zhì wù jià shàng zhǎng.
en: To combat inflation, the bank raised interest rates to curb rising prices.

zh: 由于遭遇不可抗力，该项目的施工周期不得不大幅延长。
pinyin: Yóuyú zāoyù bùkěkànglì, gāi xiàngmù de shīgōng zhōuqī bùdébù dàfú yáncháng.
en: Due to force majeure, the construction period of the project had to be significantly extended.

zh: 为了此次锦标赛，他不仅刻苦训练，还动员了全队参赛。
pinyin: wèi le cǐ cì jǐn biāo sài, tā bù jǐn kè kǔ xùn liàn, hái dòng yuán le quán duì cān sài.
en: For this championship, he not only trained hard but also mobilized the whole team to participate.

zh: 随着社交媒体的普及，短视频创作掀起了一股全民热潮。
pinyin: Suízhe shèjiāo méitǐ de pǔjí, duǎnshìpín chuàngzuò xiānqǐ le yī gǔ quánmín rècháo.
en: With the popularization of social media, short video creation has sparked a nationwide wave of enthusiasm.

zh: 这部作品不仅结构严谨，而且艺术表现手法也近乎完美。
pinyin: Zhè bù zuòpǐn bùjǐn jiégòu yánjǐn, érqiě yìshù biǎoxiàn shǒufǎ yě jìnhū wánměi.
en: This work is not only rigorously structured, but its artistic expression is also near perfect.

zh: 由于该零件结构复杂，厂家采用了特制的模具进行生产。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi língjiàn jiégòu fùzá, chǎngjiā cǎiyòng le tèzhì de mújù jìnxíng shēngchǎn.
en: Due to the complex structure of the part, the manufacturer used a specially made mold for production.

zh: 巨大的瀑布从悬崖上倾泻而下，发出了震耳欲聋的声音。
pinyin: Jùdà de pùbù cóng xuányá shàng qīngxiè ér xià, fāchū le zhèn'éryùlóng de shēngyīn.
en: The massive waterfall poured down from the cliff, making a deafening sound.

zh: 教授的讲解深入浅出，让原本枯燥的理论变得生动有趣。
pinyin: Jiàoshòu de jiǎngjiě shēnrùqiǎnchū, ràng yuánběn kūzào de lǐlùn biàn dé shēngdòng yǒuqù.
en: The professor's explanation was profound yet simple, making the originally dull theory lively and interesting.

zh: 经过深思熟虑，总部最终采纳了各部门提交的优化建议。
pinyin: jīng guò shēn sī shú lǜ, zǒng bù zuì zhōng cǎi nà le gè bù mén tí jiāo de yōu huà jiàn yì.
en: After careful consideration, the headquarters finally adopted the optimization proposals submitted by the various departments.

zh: 作为一名优秀的领导者，他拥有卓越的洞察力和决断力。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng yōuxiù de lǐngdǎozhě, tā yōngyǒu zhuóyuè de dòngchálì hé juéduànlì.
en: As an excellent leader, he possesses outstanding insight and decisiveness.

zh: 作为一种全身性的运动，划船对增强心肺功能大有裨益。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī zhǒng quánshēn xìng de yùndòng, huáchuán duì zēngqiáng xīnpèi gōngnéng dà yǒu bìyì.
en: As a full-body exercise, rowing is highly beneficial for enhancing cardiopulmonary function.

zh: 鉴于局势复杂，政府建议相关企业谨慎前往该地区投资。
pinyin: Jiànyú júshì fùzá, zhèngfǔ jiànyì xiāngguān qǐyè jǐnshèn qiánwǎng gāi dìqū tóuzī.
en: Given the complex situation, the government advises relevant enterprises to be cautious about heading to that region for investment.

zh: 事故发生后，目击者向交通部门提供了肇事车辆的车号。
pinyin: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, mùjīzhě xiàng jiāotōng bùmén tígōng le zhàoshì chēliàng de chē hào.
en: After the accident, the witness provided the vehicle number of the offending car to the traffic department.

zh: 社区决定在幼儿园增设一系列体育设施以促进幼儿健康。
pinyin: Shè qū jué dìng zài yòu ér yuán zēng shè yī xì liè tǐ yù shè shī shè yǐ cù jìn yòu ér jiàn kāng.
en: The community decided to add a series of sports facilities to the kindergarten to promote children's health.

zh: 即使内心翻涌，他依然保持着喜怒哀乐不形于色的淡定。
pinyin: Jíshǐ nèixīn fānyǒng, tā yīrán bǎ yīrán bǎochí zhe xǐnùāilè bù xíng yú sè de dàndìng.
en: Even though his heart was turbulent, he remained calm and did not show his emotions on his face.

zh: 这部文学作品凭借深刻的思想性收获了各界的广泛好评。
pinyin: Zhè bù wénxué zuòpǐn píngjiè shēnkè de sīxiǎngxìng shōuhuòle gèjiè de guǎngfàn hǎopíng.
en: This literary work garnered widespread favorable criticism from various circles due to its profound ideological depth.

zh: 面对繁琐且冗长的行政手续，他不禁流露出厌烦的神色。
pinyin: Miàn duì fánsuǒ qiě rǒngcháng de xíngzhèng shǒuxù, tā bùjīn liúlù chū yànfán de shénsè.
en: Facing the tedious and lengthy administrative procedures, he couldn't help but reveal a look of boredom.

zh: 他攀登过不少崇山峻岭，也游览过许多平缓的丘陵地带。
pinyin: tā pān dēng guò bù shǎo chóng shān jùn lǐng, yě yóu lǎn guò xǔ duō píng huǎn de qiū líng dì dài.
en: He has climbed many high mountains and steep ridges, and also toured many gentle hilly regions.

zh: 受全球气候变化的影响，许多物种的生存能力显著减弱。
pinyin: shòu quánqiú qìhòu biànhuà de yǐngxiǎng, xǔduō wùzhǒng de shēngcún nénglì xiǎnzhù jiǎnruò.
en: Influenced by global climate change, the survival ability of many species has significantly weakened.

zh: 由于该系统的防御机制存在漏洞，最终被黑客成功破解。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi xìtǒng de fángyù jīzhì cúnzài lòudòng, zuìzhōng bèi hēikè chénggōng pòjiě.
en: Due to vulnerabilities in the system's defense mechanism, it was eventually successfully cracked by hackers.

zh: 尽管会议厅里人声鼎沸，他还是向各位嘉宾打招呼致意。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn huìyìtīng lǐ rénshēngdǐngfèi, tā háishì xiàng gèwèi jiābīn dǎ zhāohū zhìyì.
en: Despite the din in the conference hall, he still greeted the distinguished guests.

zh: 该评论员对国际局势的深度剖析赢得了公众的高度赞誉。
pinyin: Gāi pínglùnyuán duì guójì júshì de shēndù pōuxī yíngdé le gōngzhòng de gāodù zànyù.
en: The commentator's in-depth analysis of the international situation won high praise from the public.

zh: 为了能够顺利升空，热气球驾驶员需要精确地控制火焰。
pinyin: Wèile nénggòu shùnlì shēngkōng, rèqìqiú jiàshǐyuán xūyào jīngquè de kòngzhì huǒyàn.
en: In order to take off smoothly, the hot air balloon pilot needs to precisely control the flame.

zh: 通过严密的逻辑推导，他证明了关于该三角的几何定理。
pinyin: Tōngguò yánmì de luójí tuīdǎo, tā zhèngmíngle guānyú gāi sān jiǎo de jǐhé dìnglǐ.
en: Through rigorous logical deduction, he proved the geometric theorem regarding the triangle.

zh: 随着城市化的推进，私人车辆的保有量呈逐年上升趋势。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshìhuà de tuījìn, sīrén chēliàng de bǎoyǒuliàng chéng zhúnián shàngshēng qūshì.
en: With the advancement of urbanization, the ownership of private vehicles is showing a year-on-year upward trend.

zh: 尽管尝试了多种方案，但目前只有这一项政策初显奏效。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chángshì le duō zhǒng fāng'àn, dàn mùqián zhǐyǒu zhè yī xiàng zhèngcè chū xiǎn zòuxiào.
en: Although multiple schemes were attempted, only this one policy has shown initial effectiveness so far.

zh: 随着那阵急促的铃声响起，吵闹的教室终于停下了喧哗。
pinyin: Suízhe nà zhèn jícù de língshēng xiǎngqǐ, chǎonào de jiàoshì zhōngyú tíng xià le xuānhuá.
en: As the urgent bell rang, the noisy classroom finally ceased the clamor.

zh: 专家组针对该复杂课题制定了一套切实可行的战略方案。
pinyin: Zhuānjiāzǔ zhēnduì gāi fùzá kètí zhìdìngle yītào qièshí kěxíng de zhànlüè fāng'àn.
en: The expert group formulated a practical and feasible strategic plan for this complex project.

zh: 长期摄入高糖分的汽水可能导致肥胖及其他代谢性疾病。
pinyin: Chángqī shèrù gāo tángfèn de qìshuǐ kěnéng dǎozhì féipàng jí qítā dàixièxìng jíbìng.
en: Long-term consumption of high-sugar soda may lead to obesity and other metabolic diseases.

zh: 这种工业啤酒的味道通常比较清淡，不太适合细细品味。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng gōng yè pí jiǔ de wèi dào tōng cháng bǐ jiào qīng dàn, bú tài shì hé xì xì pǐn wèi.
en: The taste of this type of industrial beer is usually quite light and not very suitable for savoring carefully.

zh: 无论岁月如何变迁，这份跨越国界的情谊始终坚不可摧。
pinyin: Wúlùn suìyuè rúhé biànqiān, zhè fèn kuàyuè guójiè de qíngyì shǐzhōng jiān bù kě cuī.
en: No matter how time changes, this friendship that transcends borders remains unbreakable.

zh: 竞争加剧使得该行业内不少缺乏竞争力的企业相继倒闭。
pinyin: Jìngzhēng jiājī jiājù jiājù jiājù shǐde gāi hángyè nèi bùshǎo quēfá jìngzhēnglì de qǐyè xiāngjì dǎobì.
en: Intensified competition has caused many uncompetitive companies in the industry to go bankrupt one after another.

zh: 尽管遭受了巨大的打击，但市场并未显露出崩溃的迹象。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zāoshòu le jùdà de dǎjī, dàn shìchǎng bìng wèi xiǎnlù chū bēngkuì de jìxiàng.
en: Despite suffering a huge blow, the market did not show signs of collapse.

zh: 该地区的平均气温约为零下二十摄氏度，气候极其严寒。
pinyin: Gāi dìqū de píngjūn qìwēn yuē wéi língxià èrshí shèshìdù, qìhòu jíqí yánhán.
en: The average temperature in that region is about minus twenty degrees Celsius, and the climate is extremely cold.

zh: 由于豆腐具有高蛋白的特性，它常被视为素食者的首选。
pinyin: Yóuyú dòufu jùyǒu gāo dànbái de tèxìng, tā cháng bèi shìwéi sùshí zhě de shǒuxuǎn.
en: Due to the high-protein nature of tofu, it is often regarded as the first choice for vegetarians.

zh: 作者通过细腻的笔触刻画了主人公复杂多变的心理活动。
pinyin: Zuòzhě tōngguò xìnì de bǐchù kèhuàle zhǔréngōng fùzá duōbiàn de xīnlǐ huódòng.
en: The author used delicate brushstrokes to depict the protagonist's complex and changing psychological activities.

zh: 观众通过网络平台收看那场演出的盛况，反响极其热烈。
pinyin: Guānzhòng tōngguò wǎngluò píngtái shōu kàn nà chǎng yǎnchū de shèngkuàng, fǎnyǎng jíqí rèliè.
en: The audience watched the grand occasion of the performance through the online platform, and the response was extremely enthusiastic.

zh: 据悉，这项旨在促进可持续发展的倡议已获得广泛关注。
pinyin: Jù xī, zhè xiàng zhǐzài cùjìn kěchíxù fāzhǎn de chàngyì yǐ huòdé guǎngfàn guānzhù.
en: According to reports, this initiative aimed at promoting sustainable development has gained widespread attention.

zh: 该社区的居民不仅注重环保，还积极参与各类慈善活动。
pinyin: Gāi shèqū de jūmín bùjǐn zhùzhòng huánbǎo, hái jījí cānyù gèlèi císhàn huódòng.
en: The residents of this community not only prioritize environmental protection but also actively participate in various charitable activities.

zh: 由于市场波动剧烈，投资者不得不谨慎处理每一笔交易。
pinyin: Yóuyú shìchǎng bōdòng jùliè, tóuzīzhě bùdébù jǐnshèn chǔlǐ měi yī bǐ jiāoyì.
en: Due to violent market fluctuations, investors have to handle every transaction carefully.

zh: 各界人士纷纷发表评论，猛烈抨击这种不负责任的行为。
pinyin: Gèjiè rénshì fēnfēn fābiǎo pínglùn, měngliè pēngjī zhè zhǒng bù fù zérèn de xíngwéi.
en: People from all walks of life expressed their opinions, fiercely attacking this irresponsible behavior.

zh: 这道佳肴色香味俱全，不仅精致，更是出乎意料的好吃。
pinyin: Zhè dào jiāyáo sè xiāng wèi jùquán, bùjǐn jīngzhì, gèng shì chūhūyìliào de hǎo chī.
en: This dish is perfect in color, aroma, and taste; it is not only exquisite but unexpectedly delicious.

zh: 该省位于我国西南边陲，拥有丰富的自然资源和人文景观。
pinyin: Gāi shěng wèiyú wǒguó xīnán biānchuí, yōngyǒu fēngfù de zìrán zīyuán hé rénwén jǐngguān.
en: The province is located on the southwestern border of our country and possesses rich natural resources and cultural landscapes.

zh: 经过多方验证，这套预防措施在应对突发状况时极为管用。

pinyin: Zhè méi jiǎngpái bùjǐn xiàngzhēngzhe róngyù, gèng jìlùle tā jiānkǔ zhuójué de xùnliàn lìchéng.
en: This medal not only symbolizes honor, but also records his arduous training journey.

zh: 这片土地土壤肥沃，无论栽种什么果木，往往都能如期结实。
pinyin: Zhè piàn tǔdì tǔrǎng féiwò, wú lùn zāizhòng shénme guǒmù, wǎngwǎng dōu néng rúqī jiēshí.
en: This land has fertile soil; no matter what fruit trees are planted, they usually bear fruit on schedule.

zh: 这种传统艺术通过扭秧歌展现了劳动人民对美好生活的向往。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chuántǒng yìshù tōngguò niǔ yāngge zhǎnxiànle láodòng rénmín duì měihǎo shēnghuó de xiàngwǎng.
en: This traditional art displays the working people's yearning for a better life through the Yangge dance.

zh: 该大棚采用了自动化灌溉系统，极大改善了作物的生长环境。
pinyin: Gāi dàpéng cǎiyòngle zìdònghuà guàngài xìtǒng, jídà gǎishànle zuòwù de shēngzhǎng huánjìng.
en: The greenhouse adopts an automated irrigation system, which significantly improves the crop growth environment.

zh: 为了巩固皇权，皇帝在宫廷中实施了一系列严格的规章制度。
pinyin: Wèile gǒnggù huángquán, huángdì zài gōngtíng zhōng shíshī le yīxìliè yángé de guīzhāng zhìdù.
en: To consolidate imperial power, the emperor implemented a series of strict rules and regulations within the court.

zh: 为了避免发生事故，施工人员在路边设立了醒目的警示标志。
pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng shìgù, shīgōng rényuán zài lùbiān shèlìle xǐngmù de jǐngshì biāozhì.
en: In order to avoid accidents, construction workers set up eye-catching warning signs by the roadside.

zh: 双方在争执不下时，应设身处地为对方考虑，从而达成共识。
pinyin: Shuāngfāng zài zhēngzhí bù xià shí, yīng shèshēnchǔdì wèi duìfāng kǎolǜ, cóng'ér dáchéng gòngshí.
en: When both sides are in a stalemate, they should put themselves in the other person's shoes to reach a consensus.

zh: 在缺乏关键线索的情况下，警方依然凭借敏锐的观察力破案了。
pinyin: zài quē fá guān jiàn xiàn suǒ de qíng kuàng xià, jǐng fāng yī rán píng jiè mǐn ruì de guān chá lì pò àn le.
en: In the absence of key clues, the police still managed to solve the case thanks to their keen observation.

zh: 为了应对突发的金融危机，中央银行决定在中旬召开紧急会议。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì túfā de jīnróng wēijī, zhōngyāng yínháng juédìng zài zhōngxún zhàokāi jǐnjí huìyì.
en: In order to cope with the sudden financial crisis, the central bank decided to hold an emergency meeting in the middle of the month.

zh: 国庆假期高速公路实行免费通行政策，导致交通变得非常拥挤。
pinyin: Guóqìng jiàqī gāosù gōnglù shíxíng miǎnfèi tōngxíng zhèngcè, dǎozhì jiāotōng biànde fēicháng yōngjǐ.
en: The policy of toll-free travel on highways during the National Day holiday resulted in very congested traffic.

zh: 随着城市化的推进，大型商场已成为现代都市生活的核心载体。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshìhuà de tuījìn, dàxíng shāngchǎng yǐ chéngwéi xiàndài dūshì shēnghuó de héxīn zàitǐ.
en: With the advancement of urbanization, large shopping malls have become the core carrier of modern urban life.

zh: 经过激烈的辩论，委员会最终决定取消这项不合理的规章制度。
pinyin: Jīngguò jīliè de biànlùn, wěiyuánhuì zuìzhōng juédìng qǔxiāo zhè xiàng bù hélǐ de guīzhāng zhìdù.
en: After fierce debate, the committee finally decided to cancel this unreasonable rule and regulation.

zh: 为了应对寒潮，政府呼吁市民采取有效措施做好防寒保暖工作。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì háncháo, zhèngfǔ hūyù shìmín cǎiqǔ yǒuxiào cuòshī zuò hǎo fánghán bǎonuǎn gōngzuò.
en: In order to cope with the cold wave, the government appealed to citizens to take effective measures to keep warm and guard against the cold.

zh: 为了应对年底激增的业务需求，工厂提前储备了大量的原材料。
pinyin: wèile yìngduì nián dǐ jīzēng de yèwù xūqiú, gōngchǎng tíqián chǔbèi le dàliàng de yuáncáiliào.
en: In order to cope with the surging year-end business demand, the factory reserved a large amount of raw materials in advance.

zh: 在这片广袤的土地上，辛勤的耕耘终于换来了累累硕果与丰收。
pinyin: Zài zhè piàn guǎngmào de tǔdì shàng, xīnqín de gēngyún zhōngyú huànláile lěilěi shuòguǒ yǔ fēngshōu.
en: On this vast land, diligent cultivation has finally brought forth abundant fruits and a bumper harvest.

zh: 这家酒店的服务堪称无微不至，让每一位房客都感到宾至如归。
pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn de fúwù kānchēng wúwēi-bùzhì, ràng měi yī wèi fángkè dōu gǎndào bīnzhì-rúguī.
en: The service at this hotel is truly in every possible way, making every guest feel at home.

zh: 根据上下文，这段文字括号中的内容是对前面术语的详细注释。
pinyin: Gēnjù shàngxiàwén, zhè duàn wénzì kuòhào zhōng de nèiróng shì duì qiánmiàn shùyǔ de xiángxì zhùshì.
en: According to the context, the content within the parentheses in this passage is a detailed annotation of the preceding terminology.

zh: 这种新型复合材料的厚度仅为传统材料的一半，但强度却更高。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīnxíng fùhé cáiliào de hòudù jǐn wéi chuántǒng cáiliào de yībàn, dàn qiángdù què gèng gāo.
en: The thickness of this new type of composite material is only half that of traditional materials, but its strength is higher.

zh: 在快节奏的都市生活中，人们渴望去郊外寻觅一份宁静与闲适。
pinyin: Zài kuài jiésòu de dūshì shēnghuó zhōng, rénmen kěwàng qù jiāowài xúnmì yī fèn níngjìng yǔ xiánshì.
en: In the fast-paced urban life, people yearn to seek a sense of tranquility and leisure in the outskirts.

zh: 经过长期的刻苦训练，排球队终于在这次锦标赛中获得了冠军。
pinyin: Jīngguò chángqī de kèkǔ xùnliàn, páiqiúduì zhōngyú zài zhè cì jǐnbiāosài zhōng huòdéle guànjūn.
en: After long-term hard training, the volleyball team finally won the championship in this tournament.

zh: 鉴于学业压力沉重，他打算利用寒假期间进行系统的学术调研。
pinyin: Jiànyú xuéyè yālì chénzhòng, tā dǎsuàn lìyòng hánjià qījiān jìnxíng xìtǒng de xuéshù diàoyán.
en: Given the heavy academic pressure, he intends to utilize the winter vacation to conduct systematic academic research.

zh: 在这个虚拟现实系统中，用户可以通过感应手套触摸数字影像。
pinyin: Zài zhège xūnǐ xiànshí xìtǒng zhōng, yònghù kěyǐ tōngguò gǎnyìng shǒutào chùmō shùzì yǐngxiàng.
en: In this virtual reality system, users can touch digital images via sensor gloves.

zh: 相关部门已针对该客户的投诉发送了正式的电子邮件予以回应。
pinyin: Xiāngguān bùmén yǐ zhēnduì gāi kèhù de tóusù fāsòngle zhèngshì de diànzǐ yóujiàn yǔyǐ huíyìng.
en: The relevant department has sent a formal email to respond to the customer's complaint.

zh: 尽管面临巨大的舆论压力，他依然拒绝停止其激进的政治主张。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn miànlín jùdà de yúlùn yālì, tā yīrán jùjué tíngzhǐ qí jījìn de zhèngzhì zhǔzhāng.
en: Despite facing enormous public opinion pressure, he still refused to stop his radical political advocacy.

zh: 权威专家的观点，未必就完全正确，也不见得放之四海而皆准。
pinyin: Quánwēi zhuānjiā de guāndiǎn, wèibì jiù wánquán zhèngquè, yě bùjiàn de fàng zhī sìhǎi ér jiē zhǔn.
en: The views of authoritative experts are not necessarily entirely correct, nor are they necessarily applicable everywhere.

zh: 为了庆祝新年，当地居民纷纷在墙上张贴年画以增添节日气氛。
pinyin: Wèile qìngzhù xīnnián, dāngdì jūmín fēnfēn zài qiáng shàng zhāngtiē nián huà yǐ zēngtiān jiérì qìfēn.
en: To celebrate the New Year, local residents posted New Year pictures on the walls one after another to add to the festive atmosphere.

zh: 作为首批获准进入该领域的企业，我们要承担相应的社会责任。
pinyin: Zuòwéi shǒupī huòzhǔn jìnrù gāi lǐngyù de qǐyè, wǒmen yào chéngdān xiāngyìng de shèhuì zérèn.
en: As the first batch of enterprises approved to enter this field, we must assume corresponding social responsibilities.

zh: 政府正在积极筹划基础设施的建设，以促进经济的可持续发展。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài jījí chóuhuà jīchǔ shèshī de jiànshè, yǐ cùjìn jīngjì de kě chíxù fāzhǎn.
en: The government is actively planning the construction of infrastructure to promote sustainable economic development.

zh: 由于航空运输需求的激增，该机场已启动了新一轮的扩建工程。
pinyin: Yóuyú hángkōng yùnshū xūqiú de jīzēng, gāi jīchǎng yǐ qǐdòngle xīn yī lún de kuòjiàn gōngchéng.
en: Due to the surge in air transport demand, the airport has launched a new round of expansion projects.

zh: 面对团队的创新提案，主管不应一味地泼冷水，而应给予指导。
