pinyin: miàn duì tuán duì de chuàng xīn tí àn, zhǔ guǎn bù yīng yī wèi de pō lěng shuǐ, ér yīng jǐ yǔ zhǐ dǎo.
en: Faced with the team's innovative proposal, the manager shouldn't just dampen their enthusiasm, but provide guidance instead.

zh: 政府正致力于改善该国南部的基础设施，以促进当地经济发展。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèng zhìlì yú gǎishàn gāiguó nánbù de jīchǔ shèshī, yǐ cùjìn dāngdì jīngjì fāzhǎn.
en: The government is committed to improving the infrastructure in the southern part of the country to promote local economic development.

zh: 为了维护地区和平与稳定，邻国之间保持着密切的沟通与协作。
pinyin: Wèi le wéi hù dì qū hé píng yǔ wěn dìng, lín guó zhī jiān bǎo chí zhe mì qiè qiè de gōu tōng yǔ xié zuò.
en: In order to maintain regional peace and stability, neighboring countries maintain close communication and cooperation.

zh: 通过精密的医学仪器，专家对患者的面部神经进行了详细评估。
pinyin: Tōngguò jīngmì de yīxué yíqì, zhuānjiā duì huànzhě de miàn bù shénjīng jìnxíngle xiángxì pínggū.
en: Using precise medical equipment, experts conducted a detailed evaluation of the patient's facial nerves.

zh: 为了筹备这场盛大的展览，主办方确保所有辅助设备一应俱全。
pinyin: Wèile chóubèi zhè chǎng shèngdà de zhǎnlǎn, zhǔbànfāng quèbǎo suǒyǒu fǔzhù shèbèi yīyīngjùquán.
en: To prepare for this grand exhibition, the organizers ensured that all auxiliary equipment was fully provided.

zh: 为了筹备这次全国性的大赛，主办方投入了大量的资金与人力。
pinyin: Wèile chóubèi zhè cì quánguó xìng de dàsài, zhǔbànfāng tóurù le dàliàng de zījīn yǔ rénlì.
en: In order to prepare for this nationwide grand contest, the organizers invested a lot of capital and manpower.

zh: 古老的广场上矗立着一座雕刻精美的喷泉，见证了岁月的流逝。
pinyin: Gǔlǎo de guǎngchǎng shàng chùlìzhe yī zuò diāokè jīngměi de pēnquán, jiànjiànzhèngle suìyuè de liúshì.
en: A beautifully carved fountain stands on the ancient square, witnessing the passage of time.

zh: 这项政策旨在保障公民的合法权益，或者提供必要的社会福利。
pinyin: zhè xiàng zhèng cè zhǐ zài bǎo zhàng gōng mín de hé fǎ quán yì, huò zhě tí gōng bì yào de shè huì fú lì.
en: This policy aims to protect citizens' legal rights or provide necessary social welfare.

zh: 那扇沉重的防盗门不仅能够防范非法入侵，还能起到隔音作用。
pinyin: Nà shàn chénzhòng de fángdàomén bùjǐn nénggòu fángfàn fēifǎ rùqīn, hái néng qǐdào géyīn zuòyòng.
en: That heavy security door can not only prevent illegal entry but also provide sound insulation.

zh: 那家老字号饭馆在当地享有盛誉，吸引了无数美食家慕名而来。
pinyin: Nà jiā lǎozìhào fànguǎn zài dāngdì xiǎngyǒu shèngyù, xīyǐnle wúshù měishíjiā mù míng ér lái.
en: That time-honored restaurant enjoys a high reputation locally, attracting countless gourmets who come for its fame.

zh: 许多社会问题都需要我们共同关注，譬如环境保护与贫富差距。
pinyin: Xǔduō shèhuì wèntí dōu xūyào wǒmen gòngtóng guānzhù, pìrú huánjìng bǎohù yǔ pínfù chājù.
en: Many social issues require our shared attention, for example, environmental protection and the wealth gap.

zh: 该项目在严峻的施工环境下如期竣工，展现了卓越的工程质量。
pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù zài yánjùn de shīgōng huánjìng xià rúqī jùngōng, zhǎnxiànle zhuóyuè de gōngchéng zhìliàng.
en: The project was completed on schedule under harsh construction conditions, demonstrating excellent engineering quality.

zh: 作为一名医生，他不仅医术精湛，而且在业界享有极高的声望。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng yīshēng, tā bùjǐn yīshù jīngzhàn, érqiě zài yèjiè xiǎngyǒu jí gāo de shēngwàng.
en: As a doctor, he is not only skilled in medicine but also enjoys a very high reputation in the industry.

zh: 随着社会文明的进步，残疾人的各项权益日益受到法律的保障。
pinyin: Suízhe shèhuì wénmíng de jìnbù, cánjírén de gèxiàng quányì rìyì shòudào fǎlǜ de bǎozhàng.
en: With the progress of social civilization, the rights and interests of disabled people are increasingly protected by law.

zh: 由于投资环境的改善，当地房地产市场呈现出持续繁荣的态势。
pinyin: Yóuyú tóuzī huánjìng de gǎishàn, dāngdì fángdìchǎn shìchǎng chéngxiàn chū chíxù fánróng de tàishì.
en: Due to the improvement of the investment environment, the local real estate market shows a trend of sustained prosperity.

zh: 该高科技企业致力于核心芯片的研发，以打破长期的技术垄断。
pinyin: Gāi gāokējì qǐyè zhìlì yú héxīn xīnpiàn de yánfā, yǐ dǎpò chángqī de jìshù lǒngduàn.
en: The high-tech enterprise is committed to the research and development of core chips to break long-term technological monopolies.

zh: 随着城市化进程的加快，许多珍贵的四合院正面临拆迁的困境。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshìhuà jìnchéng de jiākuài, xǔduō zhēnguì de sìhéyuàn zhèng miànlín chāiqiān de kùnjìng.
en: With the acceleration of urbanization, many precious courtyard houses are facing the dilemma of demolition.

zh: 原本以为比赛输了，没想到我们竟然反败为胜，大家喜出望外。
pinyin: Yuánběn yǐwéi bǐsài shūle, méi xiǎngdào wǒmen jìngrán fǎnbàiwéishèng, dàjiā xǐchūwàngwài.
en: I thought we lost the game, but unexpectedly we turned the tide to victory, and everyone was overjoyed.

zh: 这出话剧以诙谐的语言讽刺了社会现实，堪称一部杰出的喜剧。
pinyin: Zhè chū huàjù yǐ huīxié de yǔyán fěngcìle shèhuì xiànshí, kānchēng yī bù jiéchū de xǐjù.
en: This play satirizes social reality with witty language and can be called an outstanding comedy.

zh: 在收到那封措辞严厉的投诉信后，他开始反思自己的管理方式。
pinyin: Zài shōu dào nà fēng cuòcí yánlì de tóusù xìn hòu, tā kāishǐ fǎnsī zìjǐ de guǎnlǐ fāngshì.
en: After receiving that strongly worded letter of complaint, he began to reflect on his management style.

zh: 考古队经过长期的艰苦挖掘，终于发现了这座沉睡千年的古城。
pinyin: Kǎogǔ duì jīngguò chángqī de jiānkǔ wājué, zhōngyú fāxiànle zhè zuò chénshuì qiānnián de gǔchéng.
en: After a long period of arduous excavation, the archaeological team finally discovered this ancient city that had been sleeping for a thousand years.

zh: 为了应对紧急公共卫生事件，商铺执行了为期一周的停业措施。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì jǐnjí gōnggòng wèishēng shìjiàn, shāngpù zhíxíng le wéiqī yī zhōu de tíngyè cuòshī.
en: To cope with the public health emergency, the shops implemented a one-week closure measure.

zh: 这副球拍不仅做工精良，而且采用了符合人体工程学的手柄设计。
pinyin: Zhè fù qiúpāi bùjǐn zuògōng jīngliáng, érqiě cǎiyòngle fúhé réntǐ gōngchéngxué de shǒubǐng shèjì.
en: This pair of rackets is not only well-crafted, but also adopts an ergonomic handle design.

zh: 他似乎在故意回避关于公司裁员的敏感议题，不愿做出正面回应。
pinyin: Tā sìhū zài gùyì huíbì guānyú gōngsī cáiyuán de mǐngǎn yìtí, búyuàn zuòchū zhèngmiàn huíyìng.
en: He seems to be deliberately avoiding the sensitive issue of company layoffs, unwilling to provide a direct response.

zh: 随着汽车工业的飞速发展，车展已成为衡量市场趋势的关键窗口。
pinyin: Suízhe qìchē gōngyè de fēisù fāzhǎn, chēzhǎn yǐ chéngwéi héngliáng shìchǎng qūshì de guānjiàn chuāngkǒu.
en: With the rapid development of the automotive industry, the auto show has become a key window for measuring market trends.

zh: 随着工业化的快速发展，这座古老的城市逐渐失去了往日的宁静。
pinyin: Suízhe gōngyèhuà de kuàisù fāzhǎn, zhè zuò gǔlǎo de chéngshì zhújiàn shīqù le wǎngrì de níngjìng.
en: With the rapid development of industrialization, this ancient city has gradually lost its former tranquility.

zh: 政府致力于改善牧民的生活条件，并提供必要的医疗和教育资源。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhìlì yú gǎishàn mù mín de shēnghuó tiáojiàn, bìng tígōng bìyào de yīliáo hé jiàoyù zīyuán.
en: The government is committed to improving the living conditions of the herdsmen and providing necessary medical and educational resources.

zh: 经理陷入了繁琐的事务中，甚至顾不上处理那些迫在眉睫的危机。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ xiànrù le fánsuǒ de shìwù zhōng, shènzhì gùbushàng chǔlǐ nàxiē pòzàiméijié de wēijī.
en: The manager was caught up in trivial affairs and could not even attend to handling those imminent crises.

zh: 这一带的建筑大多已经破旧不堪，政府计划进行全面的拆迁改造。
pinyin: Zhè yīdài de jiànzhù dàduō yǐjīng pòjiù bùkān, zhèngfǔ jìhuà jìnxíng quánmiàn de chāiqiān gǎizào.
en: Most of the buildings in this area are dilapidated and shabby; the government plans to carry out comprehensive demolition and renovation.

zh: 该事务所凭借其卓越的声誉，成功获得了多个大型项目的代理权。
pinyin: Gāi shìwùsuǒ píngjiè qí zhuóyuè de shēngyù, chénggōng huòdéle duō gè dàxíng xiàngmù de dàilǐquán.
en: By virtue of its excellent reputation, the firm successfully obtained the agency rights for several large-scale projects.

zh: 那名水手熟练地挥动船桨，使木船在波涛汹涌的海面上平稳前行。
pinyin: nà míng shuǐ shǒu shú liàn de huī dòng chuán jiǎng, shǐ mù chuán zài bō tāo xiōng yǒng de hǎi miàn shàng píng wěn qián xíng.
en: The sailor skillfully wielded the oar, making the wooden boat move steadily across the turbulent sea surface.

zh: 该企业通过此次参展，成功地展示了其自主研发的高新技术产品。
pinyin: Gāi qǐyè tōngguò cǐ cì cānzhǎn, chénggōng de zhǎnshìle qí zìzhǔ yánfā de gāo xīn jìshù chǎnpǐn.
en: Through this exhibition, the enterprise successfully showcased its self-developed high-tech products.

zh: 由于当地政府采取了有效措施，动荡的局面终于恢复了正常秩序。
pinyin: Yóuyú dāngdì zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔle yǒuxiào cuòshī, dòngdàng de júmiàn zhōngyú huīfùle zhèngcháng zhìxù.
en: Due to the effective measures taken by the local government, the turbulent situation finally restored normal order.

zh: 她那充满矛盾的性格，时而表现得温柔体贴，时而显得冷漠疏离。
pinyin: tā nà chōng mǎn máo dùn de xìng gé, shí ér biǎo xiàn dé wēn róu tǐ tiē, shí ér xiǎn dé lěng mò shū lí.
en: Her contradictory personality occasionally appears gentle and considerate, and occasionally appears cold and distant.

zh: 无论血缘关系多么疏远，我们依然保持着与这位亲戚的紧密联系。
pinyin: Wúlùn xuèyuán guānxì duōme shūyuǎn, wǒmen yīrán bǎochí zhe yǔ zhè wèi qīnqi de jǐnmì liánxì.
en: No matter how distant the blood relation is, we still maintain a close connection with this relative.

zh: 随着生活节奏的加快，越来越多的家庭选择雇佣保姆照看婴幼儿。
pinyin: suí zhe shēng huó jié zòu de jiā kuài, yuè lái yuè duō de jiā tíng xuǎn zé gù yōng bǎo mǔ zhào kàn yīng yòu ér.
en: As the pace of life accelerates, more and more families choose to hire nannies to care for infants.

zh: 每当回忆起往事，老太太眼中总会流露出对那段峥嵘岁月的怀念。
pinyin: Měidāng huíyì qǐ wǎngshì, lǎotàitai yǎnzhōng zǒng huì liúlòuchū duì nà duàn zhēngróng suìyuè de huáiniàn.
en: Whenever she reminisces about the past, my mother's eyes always reveal a nostalgia for those extraordinary years.

zh: 这家初创企业正在艰难地筹措启动资金，以应对市场的激烈竞争。
pinyin: Zhè jiā chūchuàng qǐyè zhèngzài jiānnán de chóucuò qǐdòng zījīn, yǐ yìngduì shìchǎng de jīliè jìngzhēng.
en: This startup is struggling to raise seed capital to cope with the fierce market competition.

zh: 尽管他试图用华丽的辞藻来掩饰真相，但那终究不过是一句谎话。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn tā shì tú yòng huá lì de cí zǎo lái yǎn shì zhēn xiàng, dàn nà zhōng jiù bú guò shì yī jù huǎng huà.
en: Although he tried to cover up the truth with flowery language, it was ultimately nothing more than a lie.

zh: 面对日益严重的不正之风，相关部门应当采取果断措施进行整顿。
pinyin: Miànduì rìyì yánzhòng de bù zhèng zhī fēng, xiāngguān bùmén yīngdāng cǎiqǔ guǒduàn cuòshī jìnxíng zhěngdùn.
en: Facing increasingly serious unhealthy tendencies, the relevant departments should take decisive measures to rectify them.

zh: 由于长期的气候演变，该地区的原始景观已经发生了显著的改变。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī de qìhòu yǎnbiàn, gāi dìqū de yuánshǐ jǐngguān yǐjīng fāshēngle xiǎnzhù de gǎibiàn.
en: Due to long-term climate evolution, the original landscape of the area has undergone significant changes.

zh: 这座历史悠久的建筑正位于繁华的地铁站出口处，显得格外显眼。
pinyin: Zhè zuò lìshǐ yōujiǔ de jiànzhù zhèng wèiyú fánhuá de dìtiězhàn chūkǒu chù, xiǎnde géwài xiǎnyǎn.
en: This historic building is located right at the exit of the busy subway station, appearing particularly conspicuous.

zh: 作为一名资深内科专家，他致力于研究慢性疾病的临床治疗方案。
pinyin: zuò wéi yī míng zī shēn nèi kē zhuān jiā, tā zhì lì yú yán jiū màn xìng jí bìng de lín chuáng zhì liáo fāng àn.
en: As a senior expert in internal medicine, he is committed to researching clinical treatment plans for chronic diseases.

zh: 专家预测，随着产业结构的调整，该地区的失业率将会趋于稳定。
pinyin: zhuān jiā yù cè, suí zhe chǎn yè jié gòu de tiáo zhěng, gāi dì qū de shī yè lǜ jiāng huì qū yú wěn dìng.
en: Experts predict that with the adjustment of industrial structure, the unemployment rate in the region will stabilize.

zh: 旧社会里，仆人们不得不忍受主人的责骂，小心翼翼地伺候在侧。
pinyin: Jiù shèhuì lǐ, púrénmen bùdébù rěnshòu zhǔrén de zémà, xiǎoxīnyìyì de cìhou zài cè.
en: In the old society, servants had to endure the owner's scolding and attend to them cautiously by their side.

zh: 这位老运动员尽管已经退役，但依然时刻关注着体育事业的发展。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo yùndòngyuán jǐnguǎn yǐjīng tuìyì, dàn yīrán shíkè guānzhùzhe tǐyù shìyè de fāzhǎn.
en: Although this veteran athlete has already retired, he still pays close attention to the development of the sports industry.

zh: 由于长期的刻苦钻研，他终于能够自如地运用日语进行商务谈判。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī de kèkǔ zuānyán, tā zhōngyú nénggòu zìrú de yùnyòng Rìyǔ jìnxíng shāngwù tánpàn.
en: Due to long-term diligent study, he is finally able to use Japanese freely for business negotiations.

zh: 即使拥有导航软件，有时我们仍需通过问路来获取更准确的资讯。
pinyin: Jíshǐ yōngyǒu dǎoháng ruǎnjiàn, yǒushí wǒmen réng xū tōngguò wèn lù lái huòqǔ gèng zhǔnquè de zīxùn.
en: Even with navigation software, sometimes we still need to ask the way to get more accurate information.

zh: 由于双方在经营理念上存在分歧，这家合资企业最终走向了瓦解。
pinyin: Yóuyú shuāngfāng zài jīngyíng lǐniàn shàng cúnzài fēnqí, zhè jiā hézī qǐyè zuìzhōng zǒuxiàng le wǎjiě.
en: Due to differences in management philosophy between the two sides, the joint venture eventually collapsed.

zh: 过度放牧不仅破坏了当地的生态平衡，还导致了牲畜生产力的下降。
pinyin: Guòdù fàngmù bùjǐn pòhuàile dāngdì de shēngtài pínghéng, hái dǎozhìle shēngchù shēngchǎnlì de xiàjiàng.
en: Overgrazing has not only damaged the local ecological balance but also led to a decline in livestock productivity.

zh: 人生往往充满了未知的变数，仿佛是一个永远无法完全破解的谜语。
pinyin: Rénshēng wǎngwǎng chōngmǎn le wèizhī de biànshù, fǎngfú shì yīgè yǒngyuǎn wúfǎ wánquán pòjiě de míyǔ.
en: Life is often full of unknown variables, as if it were a conundrum that can never be fully solved.

zh: 在环境保护方面，政府部门应当以身作则，引导公众参与绿色生活。
pinyin: Zài huánjìng bǎohù fāngmiàn, zhèngfǔ bùmén yīngdāng yǐshēnzuòzé, yǐndǎo gōngzhòng cānyù lǜsè shēnghuó.
en: Regarding environmental protection, government departments should set an example and guide the public to participate in a green lifestyle.

zh: 挖掘考古遗址时，工作人员需要使用精确的铲子和刷子来保护文物。
pinyin: Wājué kǎogǔ yízhǐ shí, gōngzuò rényuán xūyào shǐyòng jīngquè de chǎnzi hé shuāzi lái bǎohù wénwù.
en: When excavating an archaeological site, staff need to use precise shovels and brushes to protect the artifacts.

zh: 由于在辩论赛中表现出色，他显得得意扬扬，全然不顾对手的感受。
pinyin: Yóu yú zài biàn lùn sài zhōng biǎo xiàn chū sè, tā xiǎn dé dé yì yáng yáng, quán rán bù gù duì shǒu de gǎn shòu.
en: Due to his excellent performance in the debate, he appeared triumphant, completely disregarding the feelings of his opponent.

zh: 他在处理这件复杂的案件时表现得十分细心，考虑到了每一个细节。
pinyin: Tā zài chǔlǐ zhè jiàn fùzá de ànjiàn shí biǎoxiàn dé shífēn xìxīn, kǎolǜ dàole měi yīgè xìjié.
en: He behaved very meticulously while handling this complex case, taking every detail into account.

zh: 公众舆论时刻关注着政府官员的一举一动，以确保权力的公开透明。
pinyin: Gōngzhòng yúlùn shíkè guānzhùzhe zhèngfǔ guānyuán de yī jǔ yī dòng, yǐ quèbǎo quánlì de gōngkāi tòumíng.
en: Public opinion constantly keeps an eye on every move of government officials to ensure the transparency of power.

zh: 行人若是在红灯期间横穿马路，不仅极其危险，而且违反交通规则。
pinyin: Xíngrén ruòshì zài hóng dēng qījiān héngchuān mǎlù, bùjǐn jíqí wēixiǎn, érqiě wéifǎn jiāotōng guīzé.
en: If pedestrians cross the road during a red light, it is not only extremely dangerous but also violates traffic rules.

zh: 这次商务宴请旨在招待来自世界各地的合作伙伴，促进双方的交流。
pinyin: Zhè cì shāngwù yànqǐng zhǐ zài zhāodài láizì shìjiè gèdì de hézuò huǒbàn, cùjìn shuāngfāng de jiāoliú.
en: This business banquet aims to host partners from all over the world and promote communication between both sides.

zh: 他深陷自责，认为自己的失职辜负了信任，实在对不起公司的重托。
pinyin: Tā shēnxiàn zìzé, rènwéi zìjǐ de shīzhí gūfù le xìnrèn, shízài duìbuqǐ gōngsī de zhòngtuō.
en: He was deeply remorseful, believing his negligence betrayed the trust, truly letting the company's great commission down.

zh: 面对复杂多变的市场环境，一味地刻舟求剑只会导致企业陷入困境。
pinyin: Miànduì fùzá duōbiàn de shìchǎng huánjìng, yīwèi de kè zhōu qiú jiàn zhǐ huì dǎozhì qǐyè xiànrù kùnjìng.
en: Facing a complex and volatile market environment, blindly adhering to old ways will only lead the enterprise into a dilemma.

zh: 在这场艰苦卓绝的战役中，战士们始终没有退缩，顽强地坚守阵地。
pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng jiānkǔzhuójué de zhànyì zhōng, zhànshìmen shǐzhōng méiyǒu tuìsuō, wánqiáng de jiānshǒu zhèndì.
en: In this arduous battle, the soldiers never shrank back and tenaciously held their positions.

zh: 这种新型抗生素在抑制组织炎症反应方面表现出了显著的临床疗效。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīnxíng kàngshēngsù zài yìzhì zǔzhī yánzhèng fǎnyìng fāngmiàn biǎoxiàn chūle xiǎnzhù de línchuáng liáoxiào.
en: This new type of antibiotic has shown significant clinical efficacy in inhibiting inflammatory tissue responses.

zh: 由于个人经历不同，每个人对幸福的定义往往带有很强的主观色彩。
pinyin: Yóuyú gèrén jīnglì bùtóng, měi gèrén duì xìngfú de dìngyì wǎngwǎng dàiyǒu hěn qiáng de zhǔguān sècǎi.
en: Due to different personal experiences, everyone's definition of happiness often carries a strong subjective color.

zh: 随着科技的飞速发展，越来越多的自助终端取代了传统的人工服务。
pinyin: Suízhe kējì de fēisù fāzhǎn, yuè lái yuè duō de zìzhù zhōngduān qǔdàile chuántǒng de réngōng fúwù.
en: With the rapid development of technology, more and more self-service terminals have replaced traditional manual services.

zh: 在遭受严重的创伤后，必须密切监测患者是否会出现循环系统休克。
pinyin: Zài zāoshòu yánzhòng de chuāngshāng hòu, bìxū mìqiè jiāncè huànzhě shìfǒu huì chūxiàn xúnhuán xìtǒng xiūkè.
en: After suffering severe trauma, it is essential to closely monitor the patient for the potential onset of circulatory shock.

zh: 两国回顾了建交以来的合作历程，并就未来加强双边协作达成共识。
pinyin: Liǎng guó huígù le jiàn jiāo yǐlái de hézuò lìchéng, bìng jiù wèilái jiāqiáng shuāngbiān xiézuò dáchéng gòngshì.
en: The two countries reviewed the history of cooperation since the establishment of diplomatic relations and reached a consensus on strengthening bilateral collaboration in the future.

zh: 入乡随俗是指到了一个新的地方，就要尊重并适应当地的风俗习惯。
pinyin: Rùxiāngsuísú shì zhǐ dàole yīgè xīn de dìfāng, jiù yào zūnzhòng bìng shìyìng dāngdì de fēngsú xíguàn.
en: 'When in Rome, do as the Romans do' means that when you arrive in a new place, you should respect and adapt to local customs.

zh: 对于这些争议，我们不妨保持客观的态度，深入探究其背后的根源。
pinyin: Duìyú zhèxiē zhēngyì, wǒmen bùfáng bǎochí kèguān de tàidù, shēnrù tànjiū qí bèihòu de gēnyuán.
en: Regarding these controversies, there is no harm in maintaining an objective attitude and deeply exploring their underlying roots.

zh: 在继父的悉心教导下，他逐渐克服了性格中的弱点，变得更加成熟。
pinyin: Zài jìfù de xīxīn jiàodǎo xià, tā zhújiàn kèfú le xìnggé zhōng de ruòdiǎn, biàn dé gèngjiā chéngshú.
en: Under his stepfather's careful guidance, he gradually overcame the weaknesses in his personality and became more mature.

zh: 尽管调查仍在进行中，但相关部门负责人对案件细节依旧无可奉告。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn diàochá réng zài jìnxíng zhōng, dàn xiāngguān bùmén fùzérén duì ànjiàn xìjié yījiù wú kě fèng gào.
en: Although the investigation is still ongoing, the person in charge of the relevant department still has no comment regarding the details of the case.

zh: 为了维护各自的尊严，他们在众人面前争吵得面红耳赤，互不相让。
pinyin: wèile wéihù gèzì de zūnyán, tāmen zài zhòngrén miànqián zhēngchǎo de miàn hóng ěr chì, hù bù xiāng ràng.
en: In order to maintain their respective dignity, they quarreled in front of everyone until they were flushed with anger, neither willing to yield.

zh: 这对双胞胎从小性格迥异，却在艺术领域展现出了同样卓越的天赋。
pinyin: Zhè duì shuāngbāotāi cóng xiǎo xìnggé jiǒngyì, què zài yìshù lǐngyù zhǎnxiàn chūle tóngyàng zhuóyuè de tiānfù.
en: These twins have had distinct personalities since childhood, yet both have shown equally outstanding talent in the field of art.

zh: 由于全球气候变化，极端天气的频繁出现正逐渐演变为一种新常态。
pinyin: Yóuyú quánqiú qìhòu biànhuà, jíduān tiānqì de pínfán chūxiàn zhèng zhújiàn yǎnbiàn wéi yī zhǒng xīn chángtài.
en: Due to global climate change, the frequent occurrence of extreme weather is gradually evolving into a new normal state.

zh: 通过多年的刻苦钻研，他终于能够流利地使用阿拉伯语进行学术交流。
pinyin: Tōngguò duōnián de kèkǔ zuānyán, tā zhōngyú nénggòu liúlì de shǐyòng Ālābóyǔ jìnxíng xuéshù jiāoliú.
en: Through years of diligent study, he is finally able to conduct academic exchanges fluently in Arabic.

zh: 航海家们利用指南针在茫茫大海上辨别方向，从而避免了触礁的危险。
pinyin: Hánghǎijiā men lìyòng zhǐnánzhēn zài mángmáng dàhǎi dàhǎi shàng biànbié fāngxiàng, cóng'ér bìmiǎn le chùjiāo de wēixiǎn.
en: Navigators used compasses to distinguish directions on the vast ocean, thereby avoiding the danger of running aground.

zh: 互联网的普及不仅极大地方便了生活，也使得获取知识变得随时随地。
pinyin: Hùliánwǎng de pǔjí bùjǐn jídà de fāngbiànle shēnghuó, yě shǐdé huòqǔ zhīshí biàn dé suíshísuídì.
en: The popularization of the internet has not only greatly facilitated daily life but has also made acquiring knowledge possible anytime and anywhere.

zh: 作为中国汽车行业的领军企业，吉利在全球范围内的影响力日益扩大。
pinyin: Zuòwéi Zhōngguó qìchē hángyè de lǐngjūn qǐyè, Jílì zài quánqiú fànwéi nèi de yǐngxiǎnglì rìyì kuòdà.
en: As a leading enterprise in China's automotive industry, Geely's influence is expanding globally day by day.

zh: 考虑到我们的长期合作关系，我可以向经理申请给予您更优惠的折扣。
pinyin: Kǎolǜ dào wǒmen de chángqī hézuò guānxì, wǒ kěyǐ xiàng jīnglǐ shēnqǐng jǐyǔ nín gèng yōuhuì de zhékòu.
en: Considering our long-term partnership, I can apply to the manager to grant you a more favorable discount.

zh: 人们对这项政策的反应不尽相同，有的表示支持，有的则持保留意见。
pinyin: Rénmen duì zhè xiàng zhèngcè de fǎnyìng bù jìn xiāngtóng, yǒude biǎoshì zhīchí, yǒude zé chí bǎoliú yìjiàn.
en: People's reactions to this policy vary; some express support, while others hold reservations.

zh: 针对当前体制中存在的弊端，相关部门正在积极制定相应的补救措施。
pinyin: Zhēnduì dāngqián tǐzhì zhōng cúnzài de bìduān, xiāngguān bùmén zhèngzài jījí zhìdìng xiāngyìng de bǔjiù cuòshī.
en: Addressing the systemic problems existing in the current system, relevant departments are actively formulating corresponding remedial measures.

zh: 由于他在社交场合表现得体，很多人主动索要他的名片以求日后合作。
pinyin: Yóuyú tā zài shèjiāo chǎnghé biǎoxiàn détǐ, hěnduō rén zhǔdòng suǒyào tā de míngpiàn yǐ qiú rìhòu hézuò.
en: Because he behaved appropriately in social settings, many people took the initiative to ask for his business card for future cooperation.

zh: 作为一名外交官，他一年到头奔波于各国之间，致力于促进国际交流。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng wàijiāoguān, tā yī nián dào tóu bēnbō yú gè guó zhī jiān, zhìlì yú cùjìn guójì jiāoliú.
en: As a diplomat, he travels between countries all year round, dedicated to promoting international exchanges.

zh: 这瓶橙汁不仅口感纯正，而且富含维生素，非常适合作为早餐的搭配。
pinyin: Zhè píng chéngzhī bùjǐn kǒugǎn chúnzhèng, érqiě fùhán wéishēngsù, fēicháng shìhé zuòwéi zǎocān de dāpèi.
en: This bottle of orange juice not only tastes pure but is also rich in vitamins, making it a perfect accompaniment to breakfast.

zh: 尽管暑假期间天气酷热，但依然无法阻挡同学们参加社会实践的热情。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shǔjià qījiān tiānqì kùrè, dàn yīrán wúfǎ zǔdǎng tóngxuémen cānjiā shèhuì shíjiàn de rèqíng.
en: Although the weather is scorching during the summer vacation, it still cannot dampen the students' enthusiasm for participating in social practice.

zh: 由于各部门之间缺乏有效的沟通，工作流程的衔接出现了严重的漏洞。
pinyin: Yóuyú gè bùmén zhī jiān quēfá yǒuxiào de gōutōng, gōngzuò liúchéng de xiánjiē chūxiàn le yánzhòng de lòudòng.
en: Due to a lack of effective communication between departments, there were serious flaws in the coordination of work processes.

zh: 他不仅是一位才华横溢的歌手，还是一位热衷于慈善事业的公众人物。
pinyin: Tā bùjǐn shì yī wèi cáihuá héngyì de gēshǒu, hái shì yī wèi rèzhōng yú císhàn shìyè de gōngzhòng rénwù.
en: He is not only a talented singer but also a public figure passionate about charity work.

zh: 在激烈的辩论之后，两名候选人按照礼仪握手，以此展现他们的风度。
pinyin: Zài jīliè de biànlùn zhīhòu, liǎng míng hòuxuǎnrén ànzhào lǐyí wòshǒu, yǐ cǐ zhǎnxiàn tāmen de fēngdù.
en: After the intense debate, the two candidates shook hands according to protocol to demonstrate their grace.

zh: 尽管身体残疾，这位盲人钢琴家依然凭借坚韧的毅力取得了巨大的成就。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shēntǐ cánjí, zhè wèi mángrén gāngqínjiā yīrán píngjiè jiānrèn de yìlì qǔdé le jùdà de chéngjiù.
en: Despite his physical disability, this blind pianist achieved great success through his perseverance.

zh: 在公共交通系统日益完善的今天，依赖私家车出行已不再是唯一的选择。
pinyin: Zài gōnggòng jiāotōng xìtǒng rìyì wánshàn de jīntiān, yīlài sījiāchē chūxíng yǐ bù zài shì wéiyī de xuǎnzé.
en: Today, as public transport systems are becoming increasingly perfect, relying on private cars for travel is no longer the only option.

zh: 在数字化时代，信息传递的效率愈来愈高，但也带来了隐私保护的挑战。
pinyin: Zài shùzìhuà shídài, xìnxī chuándì de xiàolǜ yù lái yù gāo, dàn yě dài lái le yǐle yǐnsī bǎohù de tiǎozhàn.
en: In the digital age, the efficiency of information transmission is increasing, but it also brings challenges for privacy protection.

zh: 尽管面临重重困难，科研团队在疫苗研发方面还是取得了突破性的进展。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn miànlín chóngchóng kùnnán, kēyán tuánduì zài yìmiáo yánfā fāngmiàn háishì qǔdéle tūpòxìng de jìnzhǎn.
en: Despite facing numerous difficulties, the scientific research team still achieved breakthrough progress in vaccine development.

zh: 面对竞争对手的挑衅，他以爱理不理的态度作为回应，展现了极高的修养。
pinyin: Miànduì jìngzhēng duìshǒu de tiǎoxìn, tā yǐ ài lǐ bù lǐ de tàidu zuòwéi huíyìng, zhǎnxiànle jí gāo de xiūyǎng.
en: Facing the provocation from his competitor, he responded with a standoffish attitude, demonstrating great self-restraint.

zh: 这道异国风情的烤肉，不仅保留了食材的原汁原味，还融入了独特的香料。
pinyin: Zhè dào yìguó fēngqíng de kǎoròu, bùjǐn bǎoliúle shícái de yuánzhīyuánwèi, hái róngrùle dútè de xiāngliào.
en: This exotic barbecued meat not only preserves the original juices of the ingredients but also incorporates unique spices.

zh: 他慷慨地将珍贵的字画赠送给了当地的博物馆，以表达对文化事业的支持。
pinyin: Tā kāngkǎi de jiāng zhēnguì de zìhuà zèngsòng gěile dāngdì de bówùguǎn, yǐ biǎodá duì wénhuà shìyè de zhīchí.
en: He generously gifted the precious calligraphy and paintings to the local museum to express his support for cultural undertakings.

zh: 随着电子商务的普及，许多传统的线下专卖店不得不寻求经营模式的转型。
pinyin: Suízhe diànzǐ shāngwù de pǔjí, xǔduō chuántǒng de xiànxià zhuānmàidiàn bùdébù xúnqiú jīngyíng móshì de zhuǎnxíng.
en: With the popularization of e-commerce, many traditional offline specialty stores have to seek a transformation of their business models.

zh: 尽管网络视频很流行，但去电影院体验那种震撼的效果仍是很多人的首选。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wǎngluò shìpín hěn liúxíng, dàn qù diànyǐngyuàn tǐyàn nà zhǒng zhènhàn de xiàoguǒ réng shì hěnduō rén de shǒuxuǎn.
en: Although online videos are very popular, going to the cinema to experience that stunning effect is still the top choice for many people.

zh: 啦啦队的每一个动作都整齐划一，展现出了极高的竞技素养与团队协作精神。
pinyin: Lā lā duì de měi yī gè dòngzuò dōu zhěngqí huàyī, zhǎnxiàn chū le jí gāo de jìngjì sùyǎng yǔ tuánduì xiézuò jīngshén.
en: Every movement of the cheerleading squad was perfectly synchronized, demonstrating a high level of athletic proficiency and team spirit.

zh: 为了能够入场观看这场备受瞩目的演出，观众们不惜在寒风中排队几个小时。
pinyin: Wèile nénggòu rùchǎng guānkàn zhè chǎng bèishòu zhǔmù de yǎnchū, guānzhòngmen bùxī zài hánfēng zhōng páiduì jǐ gè xiǎoshí.
en: In order to be able to enter and watch this much-anticipated performance, the audience did not hesitate to line up in the cold wind for several hours.

zh: 尽管医生一再告诫滥用安眠药的危害，他还是选择通过这种方式来缓解失眠。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yīshēng yīzài gàojiè lànyòng ānmiányào de wēihài, tā háishì xuǎnzé tōngguò zhè zhǒng fāngshì lái huǎnjiě shīmián.
en: Although the doctor repeatedly warned about the dangers of abusing sleeping pills, he still chose to relieve his insomnia this way.

zh: 这种过度爱面子的心理不仅会阻碍个人进步，有时还会导致不必要的经济负担。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng guòdù ài miànzi de xīnlǐ bùjǐn huì zǔ'ài gèrén jìnbù, yǒushí hái huì dǎozhì bù bìyào de jīngjì fùdān.
en: This psychology of being overly concerned with one's image not only hinders personal progress but sometimes leads to unnecessary financial burdens.

zh: 虽然学习中文的过程充满了挑战，但通过不断的钻研，我终于领悟了其中的精髓。
pinyin: Suīrán xuéxí Zhōngwén de guòchéng chōngmǎnle tiǎozhàn, dàn tōngguò bùduàn de zuānyán, wǒ zhōngyú lǐngwùle qízhōng de jīngsuǐ.
en: Although the process of learning Chinese is full of challenges, through constant deep study, I have finally grasped its essence.

zh: 他凭借多年积累的实践经验，在辩论中引经据典，论证起来头头是道，令人折服。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè duōnián jīlěi de shíjiàn jīngyàn, zài biànlùn zhōng yǐnjīngjùdiǎn, lùnzhèng qǐlái tóutóushìdào, lìng rén zhéfú.
en: Relying on years of accumulated practical experience, he cited classics in the debate and argued so logically that he was convincing.

zh: 由于长期忽视身体健康，他终于生病住院了，这让他深刻反思了以往的生活方式。
pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī hūshì shēntǐ jiànkāng, tā zhōngyú shēngbìng zhùyuàn le, zhè ràng tā shēnkè fǎnsī le yǐwǎng de shēnghuó fāngshì.
en: Due to long-term neglect of his health, he finally fell ill and was hospitalized, which made him deeply reflect on his past lifestyle.

zh: 随着移动支付的普及，很多人已经习惯了不带现金，甚至很少再去银行柜台取款。
pinyin: Suízhe yídòng zhīfù de pǔjí, hěnduō rén yǐjīng xíguàn le bù dài xiànjīn, shènzhì hěn shǎo zài qù yínháng guìtái qǔkuǎn.
en: With the popularity of mobile payments, many people are used to not carrying cash and rarely go to the bank counter to withdraw money anymore.

zh: 一个人能否取得卓越的成就，往往不仅取决于自身的才华，有时还需要一点运气。
pinyin: Yī gè rén néng fǒu qǔdé zhuóyuè de chéngjiù, wǎngwǎng bùjǐn qǔjué yú zìshēn de cáihuá, yǒushí hái xūyào yīdiǎn yùnqi.
en: Whether a person can achieve remarkable success often does not only depend on their own talent, but sometimes also requires a bit of luck.

zh: 尽管她在异国他乡面临诸多挑战，但为了女儿的前途，她始终坚持不懈，奋斗不息。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā zài yìguótāxiāng miànlín zhūduō tiǎo zhūduō tiǎozhàn, dàn wèile nǚ'ér de qiántú, tā shǐzhōng jiānchí bùxiè, fèndòu bùxī.
en: Although she faces many challenges in a foreign land, she remains perseverant and continues to strive for the sake of her daughter's future.

zh: 由于初次步入这家豪华的酒店，他显得有些拘束，不停地左顾右盼，观察着周围的环境。
pinyin: yóuyú chūcì bùrù zhè jiā háohuá de jiǔdiàn, tā xiǎnde yǒuxiē jūshù, bùtíng de zuǒ gù yòu pàn, guānchá zhe zhōuwéi de huánjìng.
en: Because it was his first time entering this luxury hotel, he seemed a bit reserved, constantly glancing around and observing the surroundings.

zh: 将军策马扬鞭，骏马如闪电般冲向敌阵。
pinyin: Jiāngjūn cèmǎ yángbiān, jùnmǎ rú shǎndiàn bān chōngxiàng dízhèn.
en: The general whipped his horse, and the steed charged toward the enemy lines like lightning.

zh: 远离城市的喧嚣，乡居生活变得愈发令人向往。
pinyin: Yuǎnlí chéngshì de xuānxiāo, xiāngjū shēnghuó biàndé yùfā lìngrén xiàngwǎng.
en: Far from the city's hustle and bustle, country life is becoming increasingly desirable.

zh: 夕阳的余晖把整个海面渲染成了一抹浓郁的黄色。
pinyin: Xīyáng de yúhuī bǎ zhěnggè hǎimiàn xuànrǎn chéng le yī mǒ nóngyù de huángsè.
en: The afterglow of the setting sun dyed the entire sea surface a rich yellow.

zh: 管理层必须严惩怠工者，以维护职场的竞争机制。
pinyin: Guǎnlǐcéng bìxū yánchéng dàigōngzhě, yǐ wéihù zhíchǎng de jìngzhēng jīzhì.
en: Management must strictly punish those who slack off to maintain workplace competition.

zh: 这件红木书柜不仅工艺精湛，而且极具收藏价值。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn hóngmù shūguì bùjǐn gōngyì jīngzhàn, érqiě jí jù shōucáng jiàzhí.
en: This mahogany bookcase is not only exquisitely crafted but also has great collection value.

zh: 由于近期盗窃案件频发，警方已采取紧急戒备措施。
pinyin: Yóuyú jìnqī dàoqiè ànjiàn pínfā, jǐngfāng yǐ cǎiqǔ jǐnjí jièbèi cuòshī.
en: Due to frequent recent thefts, the police have taken emergency precautionary measures.

zh: 夕阳的余晖洒在雕梁画栋上，闪烁着朱红色的光泽。
pinyin: Xī yáng de yú huī sǎ zài diāo liáng huà dòng shàng shàng, shǎn shuò zhe zhū hóng sè de guāng zé.
en: The sunset glow spilled over the carved beams and painted rafters, shimmering with a vermilion luster.

zh: 该学术报告将研究对象分为若干类别以作详细分析。
pinyin: Gāi xuéshù bàogào jiāng yánjiū duìxiàng fēn wéi ruògān lèibié yǐ zuò xiángxì fēnxī.
en: The academic report divides the research objects into several categories for detailed analysis.

zh: 这名患者被紧急送往急诊室，以治疗一氧化碳中毒。
pinyin: Zhè míng huànzhě bèi jǐnjí sòngwǎng jízhěnshì, yǐ zhìliáo yīyǎnghuàtàn zhòngdú.
en: The patient was rushed to the emergency room to be treated for carbon monoxide poisoning.

zh: 荷花以其出淤泥而不染的品质受到文人墨客的赞颂。
pinyin: Héhuā yǐ qí chū yūní ér bù rǎn de pǐnzhì shòudào wénrénmòkè de zànsòng.
en: The lotus is praised by scholars and writers for its quality of remaining unstained despite growing out of the mud.

zh: 这对双胞胎在出生时通过基因鉴定被确认为同卵双生。
pinyin: Zhè duì shuāngbāotāi zài chūshēng shí tōngguò jīyīn jiàndìng bèi quèrèn wéi tóngluǎn shuāngshēng.
en: The twins were confirmed to be identical through genetic testing at birth.

zh: 实验中需要精确测量五毫升化学试剂并将其注入容器。
pinyin: Shíyàn zhōng xūyào jīngquè cèliáng wǔ háoshēng huàxué shìjì bìng jiāng qí zhùrù róngqì.
en: In the experiment, it is necessary to accurately measure 5 milliliters of chemical reagent and inject it into the container.

zh: 人体内的免疫系统能够精准地识别并清除侵入的病毒。
pinyin: réntǐ nèi de miǎnyì xìtǒng nénggòu jīngzhǔn de shíbié bìng qīngchú qīnrù de bìngdú.
en: The human immune system can accurately identify and eliminate invading viruses.

zh: 这位享誉世界的建筑大师为城市留下了许多经典之作。
pinyin: Zhè wèi xiǎngyù shìjiè de jiànzhù dàshī wèi chéngshì liúxiàle xǔduō jīngdiǎn zhī zuò.
en: This world-renowned great master of architecture has left many classics for the city.

zh: 为了确保测量的精确度，需将试管置于绝对水平状态。
pinyin: Wèile quèbǎo cèliáng de jīngquèdù, xū jiāng shìguǎn zhìyú juéduì shuǐpíng zhuàngtài.
en: To ensure the accuracy of the measurement, the test tube must be placed in an absolutely horizontal state.

zh: 鉴于市场供需波动，该服务机构决定调整其收费标准。
pinyin: Jiànyú shìchǎng gōngxū bōdòng, gāi fúwù jīgòu juédìng tiáozhěng qí shōufèi biāozhǔn.
en: In view of the fluctuations in market supply and demand, the service agency has decided to adjust its fee standards.

zh: 该企业因未能依法缴纳保险金而面临严厉的行政制裁。
pinyin: Gāi qǐyè yīn wèinéng yīfǎ jiǎonà bǎoxiǎnjīn ér miànlín yánlì de xíngzhèng zhìcái.
en: The company faces severe administrative sanctions for failing to pay insurance premiums in accordance with the law.

zh: 该公约旨在维护全球范围内的生态平衡与可持续发展。
pinyin: Gāi gōngyuē zhǐzài wéihù quánqiú fànwéi nèi de shēngtài pínghéng yǔ kě chíxù fāzhǎn.
en: The convention aims to maintain ecological balance and sustainable development on a global scale.

zh: 由于过度砍伐，当地的原始森林木材资源已所剩无几。
pinyin: Yóuyú guòdù kǎnfá, dāngdì de yuánshǐ sēnlín mùcái zīyuán yǐ suǒshèngwújǐ.
en: Due to excessive logging, the local primeval forest timber resources are nearly exhausted.

zh: 该组织诚邀各界精英加盟，共同推动环保事业的发展。
pinyin: Gāi zǔzhī chéngyāo gèjiè jīngyīng jiāméng, gòngtóng tuīdòng huánbǎo shìyè de fāzhǎn.
en: The organization sincerely invites elites from all walks of life to join and jointly promote the development of environmental protection.

zh: 为了避免洪涝灾害，当地政府决定疏通这段河流的河道。
pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn hónglào zāihài, dāngdì zhèngfǔ juédìng shūtōng zhè duàn héliú de hédào.
en: In order to avoid floods, the local government decided to dredge the river channel.

zh: 在选购洗衣粉时，应优先考虑环保标准以减轻环境负担。
pinyin: Zài xuǎngòu xǐyīfěn shí, yīng yōuxiān kǎolǜ huánbǎo biāozhǔn yǐ jiǎnqīng huánjìng fùdān.
en: When purchasing laundry detergent, one should prioritize environmental standards to reduce the burden on the environment.

zh: 该地区独特的宗教演变过程常被描述为某种程度的绿化。
pinyin: Gāi dìqū dútè de zōngjiào yǎnbiàn guòchéng cháng bèi miáoshùshù wéi mǒu zhǒng chéngdù de lǜhuà.
en: The region's unique religious evolution is often described as a degree of Islamization.

zh: 她织的这件毛衣针脚细密，图案复杂，确实堪称工艺品。
pinyin: Tā zhī de zhè jiàn máoyī zhēnjiǎo xìmì, tú'àn fùzá, quèshí kānchēng gōngyìpǐn.
en: The sweater she knitted has fine stitches and a complex pattern; it is truly a work of art.

zh: 企业往往倾向于雇佣具有跨文化沟通能力的复合型人才。
pinyin: Qǐyè wǎngwǎng qīngxiàng yú gùyōng jùyǒu kuà wénhuà gōutōng nénglì de fùhéxíng réncái.
en: Enterprises often tend to employ interdisciplinary talents who possess cross-cultural communication skills.

zh: 烘焙时，若面粉的筋度过高，口感可能会变得过于坚韧。
pinyin: hōng bèi shí, ruò miàn fěn de jīn dù guò gāo, kǒu gǎn kě néng huì biàn de guò yú jiān rèn.
en: When baking, if the gluten content of the flour is too high, the texture may become overly tough.

zh: 经过精心培育的草莓，每一颗都蕴含着令人愉悦的甜头。
pinyin: jīngguò jīngxīn péiyù de cǎoméi, měi yī kē dōu yùnhánzhe lìng rén yúyuè de tián tou.
en: Each carefully cultivated strawberry contains a delightful sweet taste.

zh: 该物种的演化过程标志着生命从海洋向陆地的重大跨越。
pinyin: Gāi wùzhǒng de yǎnhuà guòchéng biāozhìzhe shēngmìng cóng hǎiyáng xiàng lùdì de zhòngdà kuàyuè.
en: The evolutionary process of this species marks a major leap for life from the ocean to dry land.

zh: 由于珠宝柜台的安保措施极其严密，窃贼始终无法下手。
pinyin: Yóuyú zhūbǎo guìtái de ānbǎo cuòshī jíqí yánmì, qièzéi shǐzhōng wúfǎ xiàshǒu.
en: Due to the extremely tight security measures at the jewelry counter, the thieves were unable to take action.

zh: 他试图通过捏造事实来吓唬对手，以达到某种政治目的。
pinyin: Tā shìtú tōngguò niēzào shìshí lái xiàhu duìshǒu, yǐ dádào mǒu zhǒng zhèngzhì mùdì.
en: He attempted to scare his opponents by fabricating facts to achieve a certain political goal.

zh: 这项决议一旦通过，所有相关文件必须立即被拿走归档。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng juéyì yīdàn tōngguò, suǒyǒu xiāngguān wénjiàn bìxū lìjí bèi ná zǒu guīdàng.
en: Once this resolution is passed, all relevant documents must be taken away immediately for filing.

zh: 该地区缺乏降水，因此必须依赖人工灌溉才能维持耕作。
pinyin: gāi dì qū quē fá jiàng shuǐ, yīn cǐ bì xū yī lài rén gōng guàn gài cái néng wéi chí gēng zuò.
en: The area lacks precipitation, so it must rely on artificial irrigation to maintain farming.

zh: 尽管鳄鱼看起来行动缓慢，但它们在捕猎时却异常敏捷。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn èyú kàn qǐlái xíngdòng huǎnmàn, dàn tāmen zài bǔliè shí què yìcháng mǐnjié.
en: Although crocodiles seem slow, they are exceptionally agile when hunting.

zh: 鉴于该剧场设施陈旧，管理部门决定对其进行全面修缮。
pinyin: Jiànyú gāi jùchǎng shèshī chénjiù, guǎnlǐ bùmén juédìng duì qí jìnxíng quánmiàn xiūshàn.
en: In view of the outdated facilities of the theater, the management department decided to carry out a comprehensive renovation.

zh: 这种特殊的物理治疗手段旨在通过排毒来促进人体出汗。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng tèshū de wùlǐ zhìliáo shǒuduàn zhǐ zài tōngguò páidú lái cùjìn réntǐ chūhàn.
en: This special physical therapy aims to promote perspiration in the human body through detoxification.

zh: 这幅水墨画勾勒出芦花在寒风中摇曳的姿态，极为传神。
pinyin: Zhè fú shuǐmòhuà gōulè chū lú huā zài hánfēng zhōng yáoyè de zītài, jíwéi chuánshén.
en: This ink painting outlines the swaying posture of the reed flowers in the cold wind, which is extremely vivid.

zh: 该项目组致力于编写详尽的行业分析报告，以供决策参考。
pinyin: Gāi xiàngmùzǔ zhìlìyú biānxiě xiángjìn de hángyè fēnxī bàogào, yǐ gōng juécè cānkǎo.
en: The project team is committed to compiling a detailed industry analysis report for decision-making reference.

zh: 教练决定调整双打搭档，以期在下周的锦标赛中取得突破。
pinyin: Jiàoliàn juédìng tiáozhěng shuāngdǎ dādàng, yǐqī zài xià zhōu de jǐnbiāosài zhōng qǔdé túpò.
en: The coach decided to adjust the doubles partners in hopes of making a breakthrough in next week's tournament.

zh: 由于原有名称容易产生歧义，委员会慎重建议该组织改名。
pinyin: Yóuyú yuányǒu míngchēng róngyì chǎnshēng qíyì, wěiyuánhuì shènzhòng jiànyì gāi zǔzhī gǎi míng.
en: Due to the fact that the original name was prone to ambiguity, the committee cautiously recommended that the organization change its name.

zh: 在那场激烈的战役中，装甲部队派遣了大量坦克进行增援。
pinyin: zài nà chǎng jī liè de zhàn yì zhōng, zhuāng jiǎ bù duì pài qiǎn le dà liàng tǎn kè jìn xíng zēng yuán.
en: In that intense battle, the armored forces dispatched a large number of tanks for reinforcement.

zh: 由于文化差异，外籍专家在跨国公司沟通时常需更加审慎。
pinyin: Yóu yú wén huà chā yì, wài jí zhuān jiā zài kuà guó gōng sī gōu tōng shí cháng xū gèng jiā shěn shèn.
en: Due to cultural differences, foreign experts often need to be more cautious when communicating in multinational corporations.

zh: 企业若为了削减成本而牺牲产品安全，最终必将得不偿失。
pinyin: Qǐyè ruò wèile xuējiǎn chéngběn ér xīshēng chǎnpǐn ānquán, zuìzhōng bìjiāng débùchángshī.
en: If an enterprise sacrifices product safety to cut costs, it will inevitably find the gains do not make up for the losses in the end.

zh: 该停车场采用了智能化管理系统，能实时显示剩余车位数。
pinyin: gāi tíng chē chǎng cǎiyòng le zhìnénghuà guǎnlǐ xìtǒng, néng shíshí xiǎnshì shèngyú chēwèi shù.
en: This parking lot uses an intelligent management system to display the number of remaining parking spaces in real time.

zh: 用户需要精确输入每一个参数，以确保实验结果的准确性。
pinyin: Yònghù xūyào jīngquè shūrù měi yī gè cānshù, yǐ quèbǎo shíyàn jiéguǒ de zhǔnquèxìng.
en: Users need to precisely input every parameter to ensure the accuracy of the experimental results.

zh: 随着经济的飞速发展，内地各省市的城市化进程不断加快。
pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì de fēisù fāzhǎn, nèidì gè shěngshì de chéngshìhuà jìnchéng bùduàn jiākuài.
en: With the rapid economic development, the urbanization process in various provinces and cities in mainland China is constantly accelerating.

zh: 随着共享经济的发展，租赁模式在各行各业变得愈发普遍。
pinyin: Suízhe gòngxiǎng jīngjì de fāzhǎn, zūlìn móshì zài gè háng gè yè biàn de yùfā pǔbiàn.
en: With the development of the sharing economy, rental models have become increasingly common across various industries.

zh: 政府鼓励民间力量投身于慈善公益领域，以促进社会和谐。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ gǔlì mínjiān lìliàng tóushēn yú císhàn gōngyì lǐngyù, yǐ cùjìn shèhuì héxié.
en: The government encourages non-governmental forces to devote themselves to charity and public welfare in order to promote social harmony.

zh: 这项科研成果充分展示了人类在探索未知领域的雄心壮志。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng kēyán chéngguǒ chōngfèn zhǎnshìle rénlèi zài tànsuǒ wèizhī lǐngyù de xióngxīn zhuàngzhì.
en: This scientific research achievement fully reveals human ambition in exploring unknown fields.

zh: 这项科研成果被详细地记录在索引卡片上，以便后续查阅。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng kēyán chéngguǒ bèi xiángxì de jìlù zài suǒyǐn kǎpiàn shàng, yǐbiàn hòuxù cháyù.
en: This scientific research result was recorded in detail on index cards for subsequent reference.

zh: 与其沉溺于虚拟网络，不如到户外游玩以获得真实的快乐。
pinyin: Yǔqí chénnì yú xūnǐ wǎngluò, bùrú dào hùwài yóuwán yǐ huòdé zhēnshí de kuàilè.
en: Rather than indulging in virtual networks, it is better to go outdoors to amuse oneself and find real joy.

zh: 鉴于最近流感病例急剧增加，卫生部门建议市民接种疫苗。
pinyin: Jiànyú zuìjìn liúgǎn bìnglì jíjù zēngjiā, wèishēng bùmén jiànyì shìmín jiēzhǒng yìmiáo.
en: In view of the sharp increase in flu cases recently, the health department advises citizens to get vaccinated.

zh: 当地政府正致力于将该景点打造成国际一流的文化旅游胜地。
pinyin: Dāngdì zhèngfǔ zhèng zhìlì yú jiāng gāi jǐngdiǎn dǎzào chéng guójì yīliú de wénhuà lǚyóu shèngdì.
en: The local government is committed to developing this tourist attraction into a world-class cultural tourism destination.

zh: 企业应建立严格的质量监督机制，以确保产品符合国际标准。
pinyin: Qǐyè yīng jiànlì yángé de zhìliàng jiāndū jīzhì, yǐ quèbǎo chǎnpǐn fúhé guójì biāozhǔn.
en: Enterprises should establish strict quality supervision mechanisms to ensure that products meet international standards.

zh: 这家画廊不仅陈列着名家的杰作，还经常举办各类学术讲座。
pinyin: Zhè jiā huàláng bùjǐn chénlièzhe míngjiā de jiézuò, hái jīngcháng jǔbàn gèlèi xuéshù jiǎngzuò.
en: This gallery not only displays masterpieces by famous artists but also frequently hosts various academic lectures.

zh: 尽管医学界反复强调抽烟的危害，仍有许多人难以克服烟瘾。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yīxuéjiè fǎnfù qiángdiào chōuyān de wēihài, réng yǒu xǔduō rén nányǐ kèfú yānyǐn.
en: Although the medical community repeatedly emphasizes the dangers of smoking, many people still find it difficult to overcome their nicotine addiction.

zh: 这一系列的变故让企业陷入危机，后来经过改革才得以复苏。
pinyin: Zhè yī xìliè de biàngù ràng qǐyè xiànrù wēijī, hòulái jīngguò gǎigé cái déyǐ fùsū.
en: This series of accidents caused the company to fall into crisis; afterwards, through reform, it was able to recover.

zh: 政府通过提供补贴来鼓励农民改善生态养殖模式以保护环境。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tōngguò tígōng bǔtiē lái gǔlì nóngmín gǎishàn shēngtài yǎngzhí móshì yǐ bǎohù huánjìng.
en: The government encourages farmers to improve eco-friendly farming models to protect the environment by providing subsidies.

zh: 司长审阅了相关部门提交的年度预算方案并提出了修改意见。
pinyin: sī zhǎng shěn yuè le xiāng guān bù mén tí jiāo de nián dù yù suàn fāng àn bìng tí chū le xiū gǎi yì jiàn.
en: The bureau chief reviewed the annual budget proposal submitted by the relevant department and proposed amendments.

zh: 他眺望远处地平线上的点点灯火，心中涌起一股莫名的感慨。
pinyin: Tā tiàowàng yuǎn chù dìpíngxiàn shàng de diǎndiǎn dēnghuǒ, xīnzhōng yǒng qǐ yī gǔ mòmíng de gǎnkǎi.
en: He gazed at the twinkling lights on the distant horizon, a surge of inexplicable emotion rising in his heart.

zh: 这一严峻的现实再次为各界敲响了警钟，呼吁采取紧急措施。
pinyin: Zhè yī yánjùn de xiànshí zàicì wèi gèjiè qiāoxiǎng le jǐngzhōng, hūyù cǎiqǔ jǐnjí cuòshī.
en: This grim reality has once again sounded an alarm bell for all sectors, calling for urgent measures.

zh: 组委会将秉持公正公开的原则，对候选项目进行严谨的评选。
pinyin: Zǔwěihuì jiāng bǐngchí gōngzhèng gōngkāi de yuánzé, duì hòuxuǎn xiàngmù jìnxíng yánjǐn de píngxuǎn.
en: The organizing committee will uphold the principles of fairness and transparency to conduct a rigorous selection of candidate projects.

zh: 尽管电影上映后口碑两极分化，但其票房成绩依然十分亮眼。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn diànyǐng shàngyìng hòu kǒubèi liǎngjí fēnhuà, dàn qí piàofáng chéngjì yīrán shífēn liàngyǎn.
en: Although the movie received polarized reviews after its release, its box office performance remains very impressive.

zh: 为了应对日益严重的沙漠化，政府鼓励当地居民种植防风林。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì rìyì yánzhòng de shāmòhuà, zhèngfǔ gǔlì dāngdì jūmín zhòngzhí fángfēnglín.
en: In order to cope with increasingly serious desertification, the government encourages local residents to plant windbreak forests.

zh: 他凭借敏锐的洞察力，成功抓住了这一转瞬即逝的商业契机。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè mǐnruì de dòngchálì, chénggōng zhuāzhùle zhè yī zhuǎnshùnjíshì de shāngyè qìjī.
en: With his keen insight, he successfully grasped this fleeting business opportunity.

zh: 尽管传统习俗有所改变，人们依然热衷于以独特的方式过节。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chuántǒng xísú yǒu suǒ gǎnbiàn, rénmen yīrán rèzhōng yú yǐ dútè de fāngshìngshì guòjié.
en: Despite changes in traditional customs, people are still keen on celebrating the festival in unique ways.

zh: 他刚刚在讲台上那番充满激情的演讲，令全场观众深感震撼。
pinyin: Tā gānggang zài jiǎngtái shàng nà fān chōngmǎn jīqíng de yǎnjiǎng, lìng quánchǎng guānzhòng shēngǎn zhènhàn.
en: His passionate speech on the podium just a moment ago deeply shocked the entire audience.

zh: 虽然生活匆匆，但我们仍应审视内心，追寻属于自己的宁静。
pinyin: Suīrán shēnghuó cōngcōng, dàn wǒmen réng yīng shěnshì nèixīn, zhuīxún shǔyú zìjǐ de níngjìng.
en: Although life passes by hurriedly, we should still examine our inner selves and seek our own tranquility.

zh: 随着城市化进程的加快，旧村庄逐渐被现代化的楼房所取代。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshìhuà jìnchéng de jiākuài, jiù cūnzhuāng zhújiàn bèi xiàndàihuà de lóufáng suǒ qǔdài.
en: With the acceleration of urbanization, old villages are gradually being replaced by modern buildings.

zh: 本届奥运会由该国成功举办，极大地促进了当地旅游业的发展。
pinyin: běn jiè ào yùn huì yóu gāi guó chéng gōng jǔ bàn, jí dà de cù jìn le dāng dì lǚ yóu yè de fā zhǎn.
en: This Olympic Games was successfully held by the country, which greatly promoted the development of local tourism.

zh: 在清晨的薄雾中，那只公鸡昂首挺胸，仿佛在巡视自己的领地。
pinyin: Zài qīngchén de bówù zhōng, nà zhī gōngjī ángshǒutǐngxiōng, fǎngfú zài xúnshì zìjǐ de lǐngdì.
en: In the morning mist, the cock held its head high, as if inspecting its territory.

zh: 由于圆珠笔结构简单且携带方便，它在日常办公中被广泛应用。
pinyin: Yóuyú yuánzhūbǐ jiégòu jiǎndān qiě xiédài fāngbiàn, tā zài rìcháng bàngōng zhōng bèi guǎngfàn yìngyòng.
en: Due to its simple structure and convenience, the ballpoint pen is widely used in daily office work.

zh: 通过检测唾液样本，科学家能够分析出人体内的各项生理指标。
pinyin: Tōngguò jiǎncè tuòyè yàngběn, kēxuéjiā nénggòu fēnxī chū réntǐ nèi de gè xiàng shēnglǐ zhǐbiāo.
en: By testing saliva samples, scientists can analyze various physiological indicators in the human body.

zh: 通过优化产业结构和改善民生，可以有效挖掘巨大的内需潜力。
pinyin: Tōngguò yōuhuà chǎnyè jiégòu hé gǎishàn mínshēng, kěyǐ yǒuxiào wājué jùdà de nèixū qiánlì.
en: By optimizing industrial structure and improving people's livelihoods, the enormous potential of domestic demand can be effectively tapped.

zh: 在漫长的冬季里，猎人们必须凭借精湛的狩猎技巧来维持生计。
pinyin: Zài màncháng de dōngjì lǐ, lièrénmen bìxū píngjiè jīngzhàn de shòuliè jìqiǎo lái wéichí shēngjì.
en: During the long winter, the hunters must rely on their superb hunting skills to make a living.

zh: 救护车呼啸着穿过十字路口，迅速将伤者送往附近的急救中心。
pinyin: Jiùhùchē hūxiào zhe chuānguò shízìlùkǒu, xùnsù jiāng shāngzhě sòngwǎng fùjìn de jíjiù zhōngxīn.
en: The ambulance whizzed through the intersection, quickly taking the injured to the nearby emergency center.

zh: 各高校纷纷出台优惠政策，以吸引优秀人才通过自主招生入学。
pinyin: Gè gāoxiào fēnfēn chūtái yōuhuì zhèngcè, yǐ xīyǐn yōuxiù réncái tōngguò zìzhǔ zhāoshēng rùxué.
en: Universities have introduced preferential policies to attract talented students to enroll through independent admission.

zh: 由于公司业务调整，原定的公休假期被迫取消，改为轮流放假。
pinyin: Yóuyú gōngsī yèwù tiáozhěng, yuándìng de gōngxiū jiàqī bèi pò qǔxiāo, gǎiwéi lúnliú fàngjià.
en: Due to company business adjustments, the originally scheduled public holiday was forced to be cancelled and changed to rotating shifts.

zh: 由于该行业存在严重的行政垄断，新兴企业难以进入市场竞争。
pinyin: yóuyú gāi hángyè cúnzài yánzhòng de xíngzhèng lǒngduàn, xīnxīng qǐyè nányǐ jìnrù shìchǎng jìngzhēng.
en: Due to serious administrative monopolies in that industry, emerging enterprises find it difficult to enter the market for competition.

zh: 该组织通过非法途径获取了大量资金，遭到了相关部门的彻查。
pinyin: Gāi zǔzhī tōngguò fēifǎ tújìng huòqǔ le dàliàng zījīn, zāodào le xiāngguān bùmén de chèchá.
en: The organization acquired a large amount of funds through illegal channels and was thoroughly investigated by relevant departments.

zh: 作为这起案件唯一的目击者，你必须出庭做证以维护公平正义。
pinyin: Zuòwéi zhè qǐ ànjiàn wéiyī de mùjīzhě, nǐ bìxū chūtíng zuòzhèng yǐ wéihù gōngpíng zhèngyì.
en: As the only witness to this case, you must appear in court to testify in order to uphold fairness and justice.

zh: 春天的气候宜人，正是郊游踏青、领略大自然风光的绝佳时机。
pinyin: Chūntiān de qìhòu yírén, zhèngshì jiāoyóu tàqīng, lǐnglüè dà zìrán fēngguāng de juéjiā shíjī.
en: The climate in spring is pleasant; it is the perfect time for outings, excursions, and appreciating the beauty of nature.

zh: 尽管周围十分嘈杂，他依然神情专注地注视着手中的精密仪器。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn zhōu wéi shí fēn cáo zá, tā yī rán shén qíng zhuān zhù de zhù shì zhe shǒu zhōng de jīng mì yí qì.
en: Although the surroundings were very noisy, he was still looking attentively and with full concentration at the precision instrument in his hands.

zh: 这件文物在战乱中遗失，至今下落不明，无人知晓其确切去向。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn wénwù zài zhànluàn zhōng yíshī, zhìjīn xiàluò bùmíng, wú rén zhīxiǎo qí quèqiè qùxiàng.
en: This cultural relic was lost during the war and its fate remains unknown; no one knows its exact whereabouts.

zh: 尽管实验过程挫折不断，研究人员仍保持积极心态，绝不气馁。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shíyàn guòchéng cuòzhé bùduàn, yánjiū rényuán réng bǎochí jījí xīntài, juébù qìněi.
en: Although there were constant setbacks during the experiment, the researchers maintained a positive mindset and were never discouraged.

zh: 如果在公众场合这样歇斯底里地发作，会让他人感到十分尴尬。
pinyin: rú guǒ zài gōng zhòng chǎng hé zhèng chǎng hé zhè yàng xiē sī dǐ lǐ de fā zuò, huì ràng tā rén gǎn dào shí fēn gān gà.
en: Having such a hysterical outburst in public will make others feel very awkward.

zh: 随着禁放规定的推行，许多城市已经禁止燃放爆竹以保护环境。
pinyin: suí zhe jìn fàng guī dìng de tuī xíng, xǔ duō chéng shì yǐ jīng jìn zhǐ rán fàng bào zhú yǐ bǎo hù huán jìng.
en: With the implementation of the ban, many cities have prohibited the setting off of firecrackers to protect the environment.

zh: 为了应对突发状况，外交部立即派遣了紧急救援小组前往灾区。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì tūfā zhuàngkuàng, wàijiāobù lìjí pàiqiǎn le jǐnjí jiùyuán xiǎozǔ qiánwǎng zāiqū.
en: In order to deal with the emergency, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs immediately dispatched an emergency rescue team to the disaster area.

zh: 尽管这名孤儿身处逆境，但他始终保持着积极乐观的人生态度。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè míng gū'ér shēnchǔ nìjìng, dàn tā shǐzhōng bǎochí zhe jījí lèguān de rénshēng tàidù.
en: Although this orphan is in adversity, he always maintains a positive and optimistic attitude toward life.

zh: 由于这种金属具有严重的铅污染风险，政府已经下令禁止使用。
pinyin: Yóuyú zhè zhǒng jīnshǔ jùyǒu yánzhòng de qiān wūrǎn fēngxiǎn, zhèngfǔ yǐjīng xiàlìng jìnzhǐ shǐyòng.
en: Due to the serious risk of lead contamination, the government has ordered a ban on its use.

zh: 这种矿泉水富含多种对人体有益的微量元素，深受消费者青睐。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng kuàngquánshuǐ fùhán duō zhǒng duì réntǐ yǒuyì de wēiliàng yuánsù, shēn shòu xiāofèizhě qīnglài.
en: This type of mineral water is rich in various trace elements beneficial to the human body and is highly favored by consumers.

zh: 作为一个优秀的领导者，他擅长洞察市场趋势并制定长远规划。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yīgè yōuxiù de lǐngdǎozhě, tā shàncháng dòngchá shìchǎng qūshì bìng zhìdìng chángyuǎn guīhuà.
en: As an excellent leader, he is good at discerning market trends and making long-term plans.

zh: 博物馆安排了一位资深研究员为访客详细解说文物背后的历史。
pinyin: Bówùguǎn ānpái le yī wèi zīshēn yánjiūyuán wèi fǎngkè xiángxì jiěshuō wénwù bèihòu de lìshǐ.
en: The museum arranged for a senior researcher to provide a detailed explanation of the history behind the artifacts for the visitors.

zh: 许多传统的老字号正面临着全球化带来的严峻挑战与激烈竞争。
pinyin: Xǔduō chuántǒng de lǎozìhào zhèng miànlínzhe quánqiúhuà dàilái de yánjùn tiǎozhàn yǔ jīliè jìngzhēng.
en: Many traditional time-honored brands are facing severe challenges and fierce competition brought about by globalization.

zh: 尽管他表面上看起来很冷静，但内心深处却依然难掩嫉妒之情。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā biǎomiàn shàng kàn qǐlái hěn lěngjìng, dàn nèixīn shēn chù què yīrán nányǎn jídù zhī qíng.
en: Although he appears calm on the surface, he cannot hide his feelings of jealousy deep down.

zh: 尽管外面风雪交加，但走进温暖的屋子，我顿时感到全身放松。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wàimiàn fēngxuē jiāojiā, dàn zǒujìn wēnnuǎn de wūzi, wǒ dùnshí gǎndào quánshēn fàngsōng.
en: Although there was a snowstorm outside, walking into the warm room, I immediately felt completely relaxed.

zh: 举办此次博览会旨在促进各国之间的经济贸易往来与文化交流。
pinyin: Jǔbàn cǐ cì bólǎnhuì zhǐ zài cùjìn gèguó zhī jiān de jīngjì màoyì wǎnglái yǔ wénhuà jiāoliú.
en: The purpose of hosting this exposition is to promote economic and trade relations as well as cultural exchanges between countries.

zh: 对于许多武术爱好者而言，前往少林寺朝圣是他们毕生的愿望。
pinyin: Duìyú xǔduō wǔshù àihàozhě ér yán, qiánwǎng Shàolínsì cháoshèng shì tāmen bìshēng de yuànwàng.
en: For many martial arts enthusiasts, making a pilgrimage to Shaolin Temple is their lifelong wish.

zh: 这位播音员凭借其抑扬顿挫的表达方式，赢得了观众的一致好评。
pinyin: Zhè wèi bōyīnyuán píngjiè qí yìyángdùncuò de biǎodá fāngshì, yíngdéle guānzhòng de yīzhì hǎopíng.
en: The broadcaster won unanimous praise from the audience thanks to their expressive and rhythmic way of speaking.

zh: 虽然竞争日益激烈，但该公司凭借卓越的品质维持了稳定的销量。
pinyin: Suīrán jìngzhēng rìyì jīliè, dàn gāi gōngsī píngjiè zhuóyuè de pǐnzhì wéichíle wěndìng de xiāoliàng.
en: Although the competition is increasingly fierce, the company has maintained stable sales volume by virtue of its excellent quality.

zh: 为了营造健康的舆论环境，平台禁止用户发布暗示性内容或开车。
pinyin: Wèile yíngzào jiànkāng de yúlùn huánjìng, píngtái jìnzhǐ yònghù fābù ànshìxìng nèiróng huò kāichē.
en: In order to foster a healthy public opinion environment, the platform prohibits users from posting suggestive content or sexual material.

zh: 鉴于其卓越的专业素养，董事会一致推举他出任新一届执行董事。
pinyin: Jiànyú qí zhuóyuè de zhuānyè sùyǎng, dǒngshìhuì yīzhì tuījǔ tā chūrèn xīn yī jiè zhíxíng dǒngshì.
en: In view of his outstanding professional qualities, the board of directors unanimously elected him to take up the post of the new executive director.

zh: 尽管环境恶劣，那只久经训练的猎犬依然出色地完成了追踪任务。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn huánjìng èliè, nà zhī jiǔjīng xùnliàn de lièquǎn yīrán chūsè de wánchéng le zhuīzōng rènwù.
en: Despite the harsh environment, the well-trained hound still excellently completed the tracking mission.

zh: 作为一名公民，通过参与听证会来行使监督权是民主社会的基石。
pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng gōngmín, tōngguò cānyù tīngzhènghuì lái xíngshǐ jiāndūquán shì mínzhǔ shèhuì de jīshí.
en: As a citizen, exercising the right of supervision by participating in hearings is the cornerstone of a democratic society.

zh: 工程师熟练地挥动着锤子，将那颗钉子严丝合缝地敲进了木板里。
pinyin: Gōngchéngshī shúliàn de huīdòngzhe chuízi, jiāng nà kē dīngzi yánsīhéféng de qiāojìnle mùbǎn lǐ.
en: The engineer skillfully swung the hammer and nailed the nail into the wooden board seamlessly.

zh: 尽管那名影星在荧幕上光芒四射，但他在现实生活中却十分低调。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn nà míng yǐngxīng zài yíngmù shàng guāngmáng sìshè, dàn tā zài xiànshí shēnghuó zhōng què shífēn dīdiào.
en: Although that film star shines brightly on the screen, he is very low-key in real life.

zh: 这枚戒指不仅价值不菲，而且对他而言具有极其贵重的纪念意义。
pinyin: Zhè méi jièzhi bùjǐn jiàzhí bùfěi, érqiě duì tā ér yán jùyǒu jíqí guìzhòng de jìniàn yìyì.
en: This ring is not only expensive, but it also holds extremely precious commemorative significance for him.

zh: 这次展览汇集了世界各地的珍稀花卉，吸引了大量游客驻足观赏。
pinyin: Zhè cì zhǎnlǎn huìjí le shìjiè gèdì de zhēnxī huāhuì, xīyǐn le dàliàng yóukè zhùzú guānshǎng.
en: This exhibition brought together rare flowers and plants from all over the world, attracting a large number of tourists to stop and admire them.

zh: 肥胖不仅影响个人形象，更会对心血管系统造成严重的负面负担。
pinyin: féi pàng bù jǐn yǐng xiǎng gè rén xíng xiàng, gèng huì duì xīn xuè guǎn xì tǒng zào chéng yán zhòng de fù miàn fù dān.
en: Obesity not only affects personal appearance, but also imposes a serious negative burden on the cardiovascular system.

zh: 尽管两项实验采用了同样的流程，但最终结果仍存在微妙的差异。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn liǎng xiàng shíyàn cǎiyòngle tóngyàng de liúchéng, dàn zuìzhōng jiéguǒ réng cúnzài wēimiào de chāyì.
en: Although the two experiments used the same process, there were still subtle differences in the final results.

zh: 工程师通过精密的计算，优化了车辆传动系统与车轴的连接结构。
pinyin: gōngchéngshī tōngguò jīngmì de jìsuàn, yōuhuà le chēliàng chuándòng xìtǒng yǔ chē zhóu de liánjiē jiégòu.
en: The engineer optimized the connection structure between the vehicle's transmission system and the axle through precise calculations.

zh: 精密仪器的组装要求极高，任何细微的部件偏差都可能导致失败。
pinyin: jīng mì yí qì de zǔ zhuāng yāo qiú jí gāo, rèn hé xì wēi de bù jiàn piān chā dōu kě néng dǎo zhì shī bài.
en: The assembly of precision instruments has extremely high requirements; any slight deviation in parts may lead to failure.

zh: 该企业的市场占有率明显大于竞争对手，展现出极强的竞争优势。
pinyin: Gāi qǐyè de shìchǎng zhànyǒulǜ míngxiǎn dàyú jìngzhēng duìshǒu, zhǎnxiàn chū jí qiáng de jìngzhēng yōushì.
en: The company's market share is significantly greater than its competitors, demonstrating a very strong competitive advantage.

zh: 她亲手制作的果酱不仅口感细腻，而且没有添加任何化学防腐剂。
pinyin: tā qīn shǒu zhì zuò de guǒ jiàng bù jǐn kǒu gǎn xì nì, ér qiě méi yǒu tiān jiā rèn hé huà xué fáng fǔ jì.
en: The jam she made herself is not only smooth in texture, but also free of any chemical preservatives.

zh: 在现代化管理中，企业的规章制度是维持工作秩序与纪律的基石。
pinyin: Zài xiàndàihuà guǎnlǐ zhōng, qǐyè de guīzhāng zhìdù shì wéichí gōngzuò trzhù yǔ jìlù de jīshí.
en: In modern management, corporate regulations are the cornerstone for maintaining work order and discipline.

zh: 在瞬息万变的市场环境下，我们需要调整战略以向优势资源靠拢。
pinyin: Zài shùnxīwànbiàn de shìchǎng huánjìng xià, wǒmen xūyào yào tiáozhěng zhànlüè yǐ xiàng yōushì zīyuán kàolǒng.
en: In a rapidly changing market environment, we need to adjust our strategy to move closer to superior resources.

zh: 有机蔬菜不仅营养丰富，而且没有农药残留，因此价格通常较高。
pinyin: Yǒujī shūcài bùjǐn yíngyǎng fēngfù, érqiě méiyǒu nóngyào cánliú, yīncǐ jiàgé tōngcháng jiào gāo.
en: Organic vegetables are not only rich in nutrition but also free of pesticide residues, so the price is usually higher.

zh: 那里的自然风光独具一格，吸引了无数游客前来领略其独特风景。
pinyin: Nàlǐ de zìrán fēngguāng dújùyīgé, xīyǐn le wúshù yóukè qiánlái lǐnglüè qí dútè fēngjǐng.
en: The natural landscape there is unique, attracting countless tourists to come and appreciate its distinctive scenery.

zh: 科学家们正在研究该湖泊的生态系统，以评估其生物多样性状况。
pinyin: Kēxuéjiāmen zhèngzài yánjiū gāi húbō de shēngtài xìtǒng, yǐ pínggū qí shēngwù duōyàngxìng zhuàngkuàng.
en: Scientists are studying the ecosystem of the lake to assess the status of its biodiversity.

zh: 宇航员在执行任务期间，必须时刻保持冷静以应对各种突发状况。
pinyin: Yǔhángyuán zài zhíxíng rènwù qījiān, bìxū shíkè bǎochí lěngjìng yǐ yìngduì gèzhǒng tūfā zhuàngkuàng.
en: During the mission, astronauts must remain calm at all times to deal with various emergencies.

zh: 随着城市化进程的加快，郊区正逐渐被纳入市中心的发展规划中。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshìhuà jìnchéng de jiāokuài, jiāoqū zhèng zhújiàn bèi nàrù shì zhōngxīn de fāzhǎn guīhuà zhōng.
en: With the acceleration of urbanization, the suburbs are gradually being incorporated into the development plan of the city center.

zh: 该剧院决定在非黄金时段放映一批具有先锋艺术色彩的独立电影。
pinyin: gāi jù yuàn jué dìng zài fēi huáng jīn shí duàn fàng yìng yī pī jù yǒu xiān fēng yì shù sè cǎi de dú lì diàn yǐng.
en: The theater decided to screen a batch of avant-garde independent films during non-prime hours.

zh: 该实验室通过低温物理实验，旨在探索物质在极端条件下的特性。
pinyin: Gāi shíyànshì tōngguò dīwēn wùlǐ shíyàn, zhǐzài tànsuǒ wùzhì zài jíduān tiáojiàn xià de tèxìng.
en: The laboratory aims to explore the properties of matter under extreme conditions through low-temperature physics experiments.

zh: 无论外面环境多么嘈杂，婴儿总是能安然地睡觉，丝毫不受打扰。
pinyin: Wú lùn wài miàn huán jìng duō me cáo zá, yīng ér zǒng shì néng ān rán de shuì jiào, sī háo bù shòu dǎ rǎo.
en: No matter how noisy the environment outside is, the baby can always sleep peacefully, completely undisturbed.

zh: 无论综艺节目的竞争多么激烈，优质内容的收视率始终保持稳定。
pinyin: wú lùn zōng yì jié mù de jìng zhēng duō me jī liè, yōu zhì nèi róng de shōu shì lù shǐ zhōng bǎo chí wěn dìng.
en: No matter how fierce the competition among variety shows is, the ratings for high-quality content remain stable.

zh: 鉴于市场竞争日益激烈，该企业正致力于优化其原材料的购买渠道。
pinyin: Jiànyú shìchǎng jìngzhēng rìyì jīliè, gāi qǐyè zhèng zhìlì yú yōuhuà qí yuáncáiliào de gòumǎi qúdào.
en: In view of the increasingly fierce market competition, the enterprise is committed to optimizing its raw material procurement channels.

zh: 酒店在露天平台设置了优雅的就餐环境，以满足客人的多样化需求。
pinyin: Jiǔdiàn zài lùtiān píngtái shèzhìle yōuyǎ de jiùcān huánjìng, yǐ mǎnzú kèrén de duōyànghuà xūqiú.
en: The hotel has set up an elegant dining environment on the outdoor terrace to meet the diverse needs of guests.

zh: 由于白色污染日益严重，政府呼吁市民尽量避免使用一次性塑料袋。
pinyin: Yóuyú báisè wūrǎn rìyì yánzhòng, zhèngfǔ hūyù shìmín jǐnliàng bìmiǎn shǐyòng yīcìxìng sùliàodài.
en: Due to the increasingly serious white pollution, the government calls on citizens to avoid using disposable plastic bags as much as possible.

zh: 由于持续的高烧，医生决定立即为他安排输液以补充水分和电解质。
pinyin: Yóuyú chíxù de gāoshāo, yīshēng juédìng lìjí wèi tā ānpái shū yè yǐ bǔchōng shuǐfèn hé diànjiězhì.
en: Due to the persistent high fever, the doctor decided to immediately arrange an IV infusion for him to replenish fluids and electrolytes.

zh: 这家老字号餐厅坚持采用传统手工拉制面条儿，因此口感极其筋道。
pinyin: Zhè jiā lǎozìhào cāntīng jiānchí cǎiyòng chuántǒng shǒugōng lāzhì miàntiáoer, yīncǐ kǒugǎn jíqí jīndào.
en: This long-established restaurant insists on using traditional handmade techniques for their noodles, resulting in an extremely chewy texture.

zh: 清明节期间，民间常有踏青、植树等习俗，以此寄托对春天的希冀。
pinyin: Qīng míng jié qī jiān, mín jiān cháng yǒu tà qīng, zhí shù děng xí sú, yǐ cǐ jì tuō duì chūn tiān de xī jì.
en: During the Qingming Festival, there are folk customs such as spring outings and tree planting, which express hopes for the spring.

zh: 奥运会的精神在于超越自我、促进各国人民之间的友谊与和平交流。
pinyin: ào yùn huì de jīng shén zài yú chāo yuè zì wǒ, cù jìn gè guó rén mín zhī jiān de yǒu yì yǔ hé píng jiāo liú.
en: The spirit of the Olympic Games lies in surpassing oneself and promoting friendship and peaceful exchanges among people of all nations.

zh: 由于经济形势严峻，许多应届毕业生在求职过程中面临巨大的压力。
pinyin: Yóuyú jīngjì xíngshì yánjùn, xǔduō yìngjiè bìyèshēng zài qiúzhí guòchéng zhōng miànlín jùdà de yālì.
en: Due to the grim economic situation, many fresh graduates face immense pressure during the job seeking process.

zh: 尽管冷战时期充满了紧张局势，但双方始终避免了直接的武装冲突。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn lěngzhàn shíqī chōngmǎn le jǐnzhāng júshì júshìshì, dàn shuāngfāng shǐzhōng bìmiǎn le zhíjiē de wǔzhuāng chōngtū.
en: Although the Cold War period was full of tension, both sides consistently avoided direct armed conflict.

zh: 牧民们在风雪交加的夜晚收拢了帐篷，准备迁徙到水草丰美的地方。
pinyin: Mùmínmen zài fēngxuějiāojiā de yèwǎn shōulǒng le zhàngpeng, zhǔnbèi qiānxǐ dào shuǐcǎo fēngměi de dìfāng.
en: The herdsmen folded their tents on the snowy and windy night, preparing to migrate to a place with abundant water and grass.

zh: 该政策旨在进一步优化营商环境，从而有效推动外贸的高质量发展。
pinyin: Gāi zhèng cè zhǐ zài jìn yī bù yōu huà yíng shāng huán jìng, cóng ér yǒu xiào tuī dòng wài mào de gāo zhì liàng fā zhǎn.
en: The policy aims to further optimize the business environment, thereby effectively promoting the high-quality development of foreign trade.

zh: 虽然战争已经结束，但这场冲突给双方民众留下了惨重的心理创伤。
pinyin: Suīrán zhànzhēng yǐjīng jiéshù, dàn zhè chǎng chōngtū gěi shuāngfāng mínzhòng liúxià le cǎnzhòng de xīnlǐ chuāngshāng.
en: Although the war has ended, this conflict left the people on both sides with disastrous psychological trauma.

zh: 望着橱窗里陈列的精美糕点，我不禁垂涎欲滴，口水都要流出来了。
pinyin: Wàngzhe chúchuāng lǐ chénliè de jīngměi gāodiǎn, wǒ bùjīn chuíxiányùdī, kǒushuǐ dōu yào liú chūlái le.
en: Looking at the exquisite pastries displayed in the window, I couldn't help but salivate, with mouth watering.

zh: 教育部旨在促进教育公平，并致力于提升各级各类学校的教学质量。
pinyin: jiào yù bù zhǐ zài cù jìn jiào yù gōng píng, bìng zhì lì yú tí shēng gè jí gè lèi xué xiào de jiào xué zhì liàng.
en: The Ministry of Education aims to promote educational equity and is committed to improving the teaching quality of all types of schools at all levels.

zh: 该机构已经在海外各大城市建立了联络办事处，旨在促进文化交流。
pinyin: Gāi jīgòu yǐjīng zài hǎiwài gè dà chéngshì jiànlìle liánluò bànshìchù, zhǐ zài cùjìn wénhuà jiāoliú.
en: The organization has established liaison offices in major overseas cities, aiming to promote cultural exchange.

zh: 那名资深向导凭借丰富的经验，带领探险队穿越了危险的原始森林。
pinyin: Nà míng zīshēn xiàngdǎo píngjiè fēngfù de jīngyàn, dàilǐng tànxiǎnduì chuānyuè le wēixiǎn de yuánshǐ sēnlín.
en: The experienced guide used his wealth of expertise to lead the expedition team through the dangerous primeval forest.

zh: 在当今竞争激烈的社会中，单纯依靠体力劳动挣钱变得越来越困难。
pinyin: Zài dāngjīn jìngzhēng jīliè de shèhuì zhōng, dānchún yīkào tǐlì láodòng zhèngqián biàn de yuè lái yuè kùnnán.
en: In today's highly competitive society, it is becoming increasingly difficult to make money relying solely on manual labor.

zh: 尽管工厂竭尽全力提高产能，该精密仪器依然处于供不应求的状态。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gōngchǎng jiéjìnquánlì tígāo chǎnnéng, gāi jīngmì yìqì yīrán chǔyú gōngbùyìngqiú de zhuàngtài.
en: Although the factory is doing its utmost to increase production capacity, the precision instrument remains in short supply.

zh: 该景区凭借其得天独厚的地理优势，吸引了无数游客前来观光旅游。
pinyin: Gāi jǐngqū píngjiè qí détiāndúhòu de dìlǐ yōushì, xīyǐnle wúshù yóukè qiánlái guānguāng lǚyóu.
en: Relying on its unique geographical advantages, the scenic area attracts countless tourists for sightseeing.

zh: 随着文明的演进，人类逐渐放弃了依靠打猎来维持生计的生活方式。
pinyin: suí zhe wén míng de yǎn jìn, rén lèi zhú jiàn fàng qì le yī kào dǎ liè lái wéi chí shēng jì de shēng huó fāng shì.
en: With the evolution of civilization, humans gradually abandoned the lifestyle of relying on hunting to sustain their livelihood.

zh: 面对原材料价格上涨的压力，厂长正设法优化生产流程以降低成本。
pinyin: Miànduì yuáncáiliào jiàgé shàngzhǎng de yālì, chǎngzhǎng zhèng shèfǎ yōuhuà shēngchǎn liúchéng yǐ jiàngdī chéngběn.
en: Faced with the pressure of rising raw material prices, the factory director is trying to optimize production processes to reduce costs.

zh: 为了确保工程质量，在正式动工前必须对施工现场进行严密的勘测。
pinyin: Wèile quèbǎo gōngchéng zhìliàng, zài zhèngshì dònggōng qián bìxū duì shīgōng xiànchǎng jìnxíng yánmì de kāncè.
en: To ensure engineering quality, the construction site must undergo rigorous surveying before construction officially begins.

zh: 随着电子商务的蓬勃发展，处理海量订单已成为企业的核心竞争力。
pinyin: Suízhe diànzǐnzǐ shāngwù de péngbó fāzhǎn, chǔlǐ hǎiliàng dìngdān yǐ chéngwéi qǐyè de héxīn jìngzhēnglì.
en: With the booming development of e-commerce, processing massive orders has become the core competitiveness of enterprises.

zh: 长期大量食用薯片不仅会导致肥胖，还可能引发一系列代谢综合征。
pinyin: Chángqī dàliàng shíyòng shǔpiàn bùjǐn huì dǎozhì féipàng, hái kěnéng yǐnfā yīxìliè dàixiè zōnghézhēng.
en: Consuming large quantities of potato chips over a long period not only leads to obesity but may also trigger a series of metabolic syndromes.

zh: 他凭借敏锐的洞察力，成功识破了对手设下的圈套，从而化险为夷。
pinyin: Tā píngjiè mǐnruì de dòngchálì, chénggōng shìpòle duìshǒu shè xià de quāntào, cóng'ér huàxiǎn-wéiyí.
en: With his sharp insight, he successfully saw through the trap set by his opponent, thereby turning danger into safety.

zh: 今年恰逢该学术机构成立一百周年诞辰，相关部门举行了隆重的庆典。
pinyin: Jīnnián qiàféng gāi xuéshù jīgòu chénglì yībǎi zhōunián dànchén, xiāngguān bùmén jǔxíngle lóngzhòng de qìngdiǎn.
en: This year happens to mark the centenary of the founding of this academic institution, and the relevant departments held a grand celebration.

zh: 在那部文学名著中，作者通过细腻的描写塑造了一位绝代美女的形象。
pinyin: Zài nà bù wénxué míngzhù zhōng, zuòzhě tōngguò xìnì de miáoxiě sùzào le yī wèi juédài měinǚ de xíngxiàng.
en: In that literary classic, the author created the image of a peerless beauty through delicate descriptions.

zh: 那种华而不实的玩意儿，无论怎么包装也掩盖不了其质量低劣的本质。
pinyin: Nà zhǒng huá ér bù shí de wányìr, wúlùn zěnme bāozhuāng yě yǎngàibuliǎo qí zhìliàng dīliè de běnzhì.
en: That kind of flashy but useless gadget, no matter how it is packaged, cannot cover up its poor quality.

zh: 这家工厂曾面临严峻的挑战，但最终凭借卓越的技术创新实现了转型。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng céng miànlín yánjùn de tiǎozhàn, dàn zuìzhōng píngjiè zhuóyuè de jìshù chuàngxīn shíxiànle zhuǎnxíng.
en: This factory once faced severe challenges, but eventually achieved transformation through excellent technical innovation.

zh: 随着企业规模的不断扩大，原有的食堂已经难以满足员工的用餐需求。
pinyin: Suízhe qǐyè guīmó de bùduàn kuòdà, yuányǒu de shítáng yǐjīng nányǐ mǎnzú yuángōng de yòngcān xūqiú.
en: As the scale of the enterprise continues to expand, the existing dining hall can no longer meet the dining needs of the employees.

zh: 为了应对市场竞争，老板果断地解雇了那些未能达到绩效标准的员工。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì shìchǎng jìngzhēng, lǎobǎn guǒduàn de jiěgù le nàxiē wèi néng dádào jìxiào biāozhǔn de yuángōng.
en: In order to cope with market competition, the boss decisively dismissed those employees who failed to meet performance standards.

zh: 他那一贯严谨的态度与今天的失误形成了鲜明对比，令大家倍感诧异。
pinyin: Tā nà yīguàn yánjǐn de tàidù yǔ jīntiān de shīwù xíngchéng le xiānmíng duìbǐ, lìng dàjiā bèigǎn chàyì.
en: His consistently rigorous attitude stood in sharp contrast to today's mistake, which left everyone feeling astonished.

zh: 该项目的成功不仅产生了直接收益，还带动了相关产业链的协同升级。
pinyin: Gāi xiàngmù de chénggōng bùjǐn chǎnshēngle zhíjiē shōuyì, hái dàidòngle xiāngguān chǎnyèliàn de xiétóng shēngjí.
en: The success of the project not only generated direct revenue but also spurred the coordinated upgrading of the relevant industrial chain.

zh: 为了缓解市中心的交通压力，政府决定修建一条环绕城市的高速公路。
pinyin: Wèile huǎnjiě shì zhōngxīn de jiāotōng yālì, zhèngfǔ juédìng xiūjiàn yītiáo huánrào chéngshì de gāosù gōnglù.
en: In order to alleviate traffic pressure in the city center, the government decided to build an expressway encircling the city.

zh: 合同中明确规定了管理费的支付标准与违约责任，双方必须严格遵守。
pinyin: Hétóng zhōng míngquè guīdìngle guǎnlǐfèi de zhīfù biāozhǔn yǔ wéiyuē zérèn, shuāngfāng bìxū yángé zūnshǒu.
en: The contract clearly stipulates the payment standards for management fees and the liabilities for breach of contract, which both parties must strictly adhere to.

zh: 在那座繁华的都市里，酒吧文化已成为年轻人社交不可或缺的一部分。
pinyin: Zài nà zuò fánhuá de dūshì lǐ, jiǔbā wénhuà yǐ chéngwéi niánqīngrén shèjiāo bùkě huòquē de yībùfèn.
en: In that bustling metropolis, bar culture has become an indispensable part of young people's social life.

zh: 人生充满了不确定性，与其忧心忡忡，不如保持平和的心态顺其自然。
pinyin: Rénshēng chōngmǎnle bù quèdìngxìng, yǔqí yōuxīnchōngchōng, bùrú bǎochí pínghé de xīntài shùn qí zì rán.
en: Life is full of uncertainties; rather than worrying constantly, it is better to maintain a peaceful mindset and let nature take its course.

zh: 在考古发掘现场，破碎的陶器残片比比皆是，展现了古人的生活痕迹。
pinyin: Zài kǎogǔ fājué xiànchǎng, pòsuì de táoqì cánpiàn bǐbǐjiēshì, zhǎnxiànle gǔrén de shēnghuó hénjì.
en: At the archaeological excavation site, broken pottery fragments can be found everywhere, revealing traces of ancient people's lives.

zh: 对于这种突发状况，我们必须立即作出反应，以避免造成更大的损失。
pinyin: Duìyú zhè zhǒng tūfā zhuàngkuàng, wǒmen bìxū lìjí zuòchū fǎnyìng, yǐ bìmiǎn zàochéng gèng dà de sǔnshī.
en: Regarding this emergency situation, we must react immediately to avoid causing greater losses.

zh: 尽管经历了巨大的心理创伤，受害人依然选择了通过司法途径寻求正义。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn jīnglì le jùdà de xīnlǐ chuāngshāng, shòuhàirén yīrán xuǎnzé tōngguò sīfǎ tújìng xúnqiú zhèngyì.
en: Despite experiencing significant psychological trauma, the victim still chose to seek justice through judicial channels.

zh: 面对突发的舆论危机，公关部门必须迅速采取有效的公关策略进行应对。
pinyin: Miànduì tūfā de yúlùn wēijī, gōngguān bùmén bìxū xùnsù cǎiqǔ yǒuxiào de gōngguān cèlüè jìnxíng yìngduì.
en: Facing a sudden public opinion crisis, the public relations department must quickly adopt effective public relations strategies to respond.

zh: 尽管听众早已显露出疲惫之色，他依然一长一短地沉浸在自己的讲述中。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tīngzhòng zǎoyǐ xiǎnlù chū píbèi zhī sè, tā yīrán yī cháng yī duǎn de chénjìn zài zìjǐ de jiǎngshù zhōng.
en: Although the audience had long since shown signs of fatigue, he remained immersed in his endless talking.

zh: 面对时代发展的潮流，任何阻碍都显得软弱无力且不可避免地会被淘汰。
pinyin: Miànduì shídài fāzhǎn de cháoliú, rènhé zǔ' zǔ'ài dōu xiǎnde ruǎnruò wú lì qiě bù kě bì miǎn de huì bèi táotài.
en: Faced with the trend of the times, any obstacle appears weak and will inevitably be eliminated.

zh: 尽管这双高跟鞋款式独特，但穿起来并不舒适，甚至还会导致脚部疲劳。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè shuāng gāogēnxié kuǎnshì dútè, dàn chuān qǐlái bìng bù shūshì, shènzhì hái huì dǎozhì jiǎobù píláo.
en: Although this pair of high-heeled shoes has a unique style, it is not comfortable to wear and can even cause foot fatigue.

zh: 这部小说不仅获得了广泛的赞誉，也让作者如愿以偿地实现了文学梦想。
pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō bùjǐn huòdé le guǎngfàn de zànyù, yě ràng zuòzhě rúyuànyǐcháng de shíxiàn le wénxué mèngxiǎng.
en: This novel not only won widespread praise but also allowed the author to fulfill their literary dream.

zh: 为了适应市场的需求，公司决定对原有的业务部门进行重组和深度切割。
pinyin: wèile shìyìng shìchǎng de xūqiú, gōngsī juédìng duì yuányǒu de yèwù bùmén bù jìnxíng chóngzǔ hé shēndù qiēgē.
en: In order to adapt to market demands, the company decided to reorganize and deeply cut the existing business departments.

zh: 尽管遭受了暴风雪的阻挠，搜救队依然竭尽全力赶往失事地点展开搜寻。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zāoshòu le bàofēngxuě de zǔnáo, sōujiùduì yīrán jiéjìn quánlì gǎn wǎng shīshì dìdiǎn zhǎnkāi sōuxún.
en: Despite the obstruction of the snowstorm, the search and rescue team still did their utmost to hurry to the crash site to carry out the search.

zh: 尽管他的脾气有时显得十分暴躁，但他处理突发状况的能力却令人钦佩。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn tā de pí qi yǒu shí xiǎn dé shí fēn bào zào, dàn tā chǔ lǐ tū fā zhuàng kuàng de néng lì què lìng rén qīn pèi.
en: Although his temper sometimes appears quite irascible, his ability to handle emergencies is admirable.

zh: 尽管未来充满挑战，我依然渴望通过不懈的努力达成目标，实现心想事成。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wèilái chōngmǎn tiǎozhàn, wǒ yīrán kěwàng tōngguò bùxiè de nǔlì dáchéng mùbiāo, shíxiàn xīn xiǎng shì chéng.
en: Although the future is full of challenges, I still yearn to achieve my goals through unremitting efforts and see my wishes come true.

zh: 尽管面临社交挑战，他还是毅然选择了转学，追求更适合自己的学术发展。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn miànlín shèjiāo tiǎozhàn, tā háishì yìrán xuǎnzé zhuǎn xué, zhuīqiú gèng shìhé zìjǐ de xuéshù fāzhǎn.
en: Despite facing social challenges, he resolutely chose to change schools to pursue academic development that better suits him.

zh: 身为一名严谨的学者，他坚持所有研究结论都必须基于可靠的第一手文献。
pinyin: Shēnwéi yī míng yánjǐn de xuézhě, tā jiānchí suǒyǒu yánjiū jiélùn dōu bìxū jīyú kěkào de dì yī shǒu wénxiàn.
en: As a rigorous scholar, he insists that all research conclusions must be based on reliable first-hand documents.

zh: 由于资源有限，这项方案很难兼顾各方利益，做到真正意义上的面面俱到。
pinyin: Yóuyú zīyuán yǒuxiàn, zhè xiàng fāng'àn hěn nán jiāngù gè fāng lìyì, zuò dào zhēnzhèng yìyì shàng de miàn miàn jù dào.
en: Due to limited resources, it is difficult for this plan to balance all interests and be comprehensive in the true sense.

zh: 他在学术领域展现出的严谨治学精神，为年轻一代学者树立了光辉的榜样。
pinyin: Tā zài xuéshù lǐngyù zhǎnxiàn chū de yánjǐn zhìxué jīngshén, wèi niánqīng yīdài xuézhě shùlìle guānghuī de bǎngyàng.
en: The rigorous academic spirit he demonstrated in the field of research has set a brilliant example for the younger generation of scholars.

zh: 为了表达诚挚的谢意，他特意起身逐桌敬酒，感谢大家多年来的鼎力支持。
pinyin: Wèile biǎodá chéngzhì de xièyì, tā tèyì qǐshēn zhú zhuō jìng jiǔ, gǎnxiè dàjiā duōnián lái de dǐnglì zhīchí.
en: In order to express his sincere gratitude, he specifically stood up to offer a toast at each table, thanking everyone for their strong support over the years.

zh: 这家老字号商店凭借其诚信经营的理念，赢得了广大消费者的信赖与青睐。
pinyin: Zhè jiā lǎozìhào shāngdiàn píngjiè qí chéngxìn jīngyíng de lǐniàn, yíngdéle guǎngdà xiāofèizhě de xìnlài yǔ qīnglài.
en: Relying on its philosophy of honest operation, this time-honored store has won the trust and favor of vast consumers.

zh: 随着经济全球化的推进，华人企业家在国际舞台上扮演着愈发重要的角色。
pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì quánqiúhuà de tuījìn, Huárén qǐyèjiā zài guójì wǔtái shàng bànyǎn zhe yùfā zhòngyào de juésè.
en: With the advancement of economic globalization, ethnic Chinese entrepreneurs are playing an increasingly important role on the international stage.

zh: 尽管他竭力辩解，但证据表明他无疑是此次大规模金融诈骗案的罪魁祸首。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā jiélì biànjiě, dàn zhèngjù biǎomíng tā wúyí shì cǐ cì dà guīmó jīnróng zhàpiàn àn de zuìkuíhuòshǒu.
en: Although he tried his best to defend himself, the evidence indicates that he is undoubtedly the mastermind behind this large-scale financial fraud case.

zh: 科学家们正在研究如何利用海水进行淡化处理以解决干旱地区的用水问题。
pinyin: Kēxuéjiāmen zhèngzài yánjiū rúhé lìyòng hǎishuǐ jìnxíng dànhuà chǔlǐ yǐ jiějué gānhàn dìqū de yòngshuǐ wèntí.
en: Scientists are studying how to desalinate seawater to solve the water usage problem in arid regions.

zh: 面对记者的连番追问，他显得有些局促不安，下意识地摇了摇头拒绝回答。
pinyin: miànduì jìzhě de liánfān zhuīwèn, tā xiǎnde yǒuxiē júcùbù'ān, xiàyìshí de yáo le yáo tóu jùjué huídá.
en: Facing the reporter's barrage of questions, he appeared somewhat uneasy and instinctively shook his head to decline answering.

zh: 尽管俄语语法结构相当复杂，他还是凭借坚韧不拔的毅力克服了各种障碍。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn éyǔ yǔfǎ jiégòu xiāngdāng fùzá, tā háishì píngjiè jiānrènbùbá de yìlì kèfú le gè zhǒng zhàng'ài.
en: Although Russian grammatical structure is quite complex, he still overcame various obstacles by virtue of his perseverance.

zh: 尽管在这个行业竞争激烈，她依然凭借独特的气质成长为了一名顶级模特儿。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zài zhège hángyè jìngzhēng jīliè, tā yīrán píngjiè dútè de qìzhì chéngzhǎng wéi le yī míng dǐngjí mótèr.
en: Although competition is fierce in this industry, she still grew into a top model by virtue of her unique temperament.

zh: 在离婚协议中，双方就抚养费的数额达成了一致，并承诺严格履行支付义务。
pinyin: Zài líhūn xiéyì zhōng, shuāngfāng jiù fǔyǎngfèi de shù'é dáchéng le yīzhì, bìng chéngnuò yángé lǚxíng zhīfù yìwù.
en: In the divorce agreement, both parties reached a consensus on the amount of child support and promised to strictly fulfill their payment obligations.

zh: 在中国文化中，筷子的使用不仅是一种饮食习惯，更蕴含着深刻的礼仪规范。
pinyin: zài zhōng guó wén huà zhōng, kuài zi de shǐ yòng bù jǐn shì yī zhǒng yǐn shí xí guàn, gèng yùn hán zhe shēn kè de lǐ yí guī fàn.
en: In Chinese culture, the use of chopsticks is not only a dietary habit, but also embodies profound etiquette norms.

zh: 面对严峻的挑战，我们更需要脚踏实地的行动，而不是夸夸其谈的空洞口号。
pinyin: miànduì yánjùn de tiǎozhàn, wǒmen gèng xūyào jiǎotàshídì de xíngdòng, ér bùshì kuā kuā qí tán de kōngdòng kǒuhào.
en: Facing severe challenges, we need down-to-earth actions more than boastful, empty slogans.

zh: 为了追求艺术梦想，他毅然放弃了高薪工作，尽管他并不舍得那份稳定的生活。
pinyin: Wèile zhuīqiú yìshù mèngxiǎng, tā yìrán fàngqì le gāoxīn gōngzuò, jǐnguǎn tā bìng bù shěde nà fèn wěndìng de shēnghuó.
en: In order to pursue his artistic dreams, he resolutely gave up his high-paying job, even though he was reluctant to part with that stable life.

zh: 那里的气候异常恶劣，常年维持在零下四十度，极大地考验着探险队员的意志。
pinyin: Nàlǐ de qìhòu yìcháng èliè, chángnián wéichí zài língxià sìshí dù, jídà de kǎoyàn zhe tànxiǎn duìyuán de yìzhì.
en: The climate there is exceptionally harsh, remaining at forty degrees below zero year-round, which greatly tests the willpower of the expedition members.

zh: 由于地缘政治格局的剧烈演变，两国之间的传统同盟关系正在面临严峻的考验。
pinyin: Yóuyú dìyuán zhèngzhì géjú de jùliè yǎnbiàn, liǎng guó zhī jiān de chuántǒng tóngméng guānxì zhèngzài miànlín yánjùn de kǎoyàn.
en: Due to the drastic evolution of the geopolitical landscape, the traditional alliance between the two countries is facing a severe test.

zh: 随着一阵刺耳的闹钟声，他从深度睡眠中惊醒，意识到自己必须立刻赶往机场。
pinyin: Suízhe yīzhèn cì'ěr de nàozhōng shēng, tā cóng shēndù shuìmián zhōng jīngxǐng, yìshí dào zìjǐ bìxū lìkè gǎnwǎng jīchǎng.
en: With the piercing sound of an alarm clock, he woke up from a deep sleep, realizing he had to rush to the airport immediately.

zh: 尽管期末繁重的学业压力令他感到有些疲惫，但他依然保持着极高的学习效率。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn qī mò fán zhòng de xué yè yā lì lìng tā gǎn dào yǒu xiē pí bèi, dàn tā yī rán bǎo chí zhe jí gāo de xué xí xiào lǜ.
en: Although the heavy academic pressure at the end of the term makes him feel a bit exhausted, he still maintains a very high learning efficiency.

zh: 那场突如其来的变故令他陷入了沉默，他在角落里一言不发，眼神显得格外忧郁。
pinyin: Nà chǎng tūrúqílái de biàngù lìng tā xiànrù le chénmò, tā zài jiǎoluò lǐ yī yán bù fā, yǎnshén xiǎnde géwài yōuyù.
en: That sudden incident plunged him into silence; he sat in the corner without saying a word, his eyes looking exceptionally melancholic.

zh: 一个国家的综合国力不仅体现在经济和军事方面，还深刻地蕴含在其软实力之中。
