pinyin: Yīgè guójiā de zōnghé guólì bùjǐn tǐxiàn zài jīngjì hé jūnshì fāngmiàn, hái shēnkè de yùnhán zài qí ruǎnshílì zhī zhōng.
en: A country's comprehensive national power is not only reflected in economic and military aspects, but is also profoundly embodied in its soft power.

zh: 作为探月工程的重要组成部分，嫦娥系列的成功发射标志着我国航天技术的飞跃。
pinyin: Zuòwéi tànyuè gōngchéng de zhòngyào zǔchéng bùfèn, Cháng'é xìliè de chénggōng fāshè biāozhì zhe wǒguó hángtiān jìshù de fēiyuè.
en: As an important part of the lunar exploration project, the successful launch of the Chang'e series marks a leap in our country's aerospace technology.

zh: 尽管由于工作的缘故我们经常聚少离多，但我老婆依然毫无怨言地支持我的事业。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yóuyú gōngzuò de yuángù wǒmen jīngcháng jùshǎolíduō, dàn wǒ lǎopó yīrán háowúyuànyán de zhīchí wǒ de shìyè.
en: Although we are often apart due to work, my wife still supports my career without any complaints.

zh: 随着汉语在国际交流中的作用日益凸显，越来越多的人开始关注这门语言的规范化问题。
pinyin: Suízhe Hànyǔ zài guójì jiāoliú zhōng de zuòyòng rìyì tūxiǎn, yuè lái yuè duō de rén kāishǐ guānzhù zhè mén yǔyán de guīfànhuà wèntí.
en: As the role of Chinese in international exchange becomes increasingly prominent, more and more people are beginning to pay attention to the standardization of this language.

zh: 为了保持核桃的口感，应将其置于阴凉干燥处储存。
pinyin: Wèile bǎochí hétáo de kǒugǎn, yīng jiāng qí zhìyú yīnliáng gānzào chù chǔcún.
en: In order to maintain the texture of the walnuts, they should be stored in a cool and dry place.

zh: 仰望星空，山顶的空气显得格外清冽，令人心旷神怡。
pinyin: Yǎngwàng xīngkōng, shāndǐng de kōngqì xiǎnde géwài qīngliè, lìng rén xīnkuàngshényí.
en: Looking up at the starry sky, the air at the hilltop felt exceptionally crisp and clear, making one feel relaxed and happy.

zh: 夕阳下，湖面上的游船勾勒出一幅宁静而唯美的画卷。
pinyin: Xīyáng xià, húmiàn shàng de yóuchuán gōulè chū yī fú níngjìng ér wěiměi de huàjuàn.
en: Under the sunset, the pleasure boats on the lake outline a quiet and beautiful picture.

zh: 这篇课文虽然篇幅不长，但其蕴含的哲理却发人深省。
pinyin: zhè piān kèwén suīrán piānfú bù cháng, dàn qí yùnhán de zhélǐ què fārénshēnxǐng.
en: Although this text is not long, the philosophy it contains is thought-provoking.

zh: 许多跨国外企倾向于建立扁平化的管理模式以提高效率。
pinyin: Xǔduō kuàguó wài qǐ qīngxiàng yú jiànlì biǎnpínghuà de guǎnlǐ móshì yǐ tígāo xiàolǜ.
en: Many multinational foreign enterprises tend to establish flat management models to improve efficiency.

zh: 该研究所致力于人工饲养濒危物种，以保护生物多样性。
pinyin: gāi yánjiū suǒ zhìlì yú réngōng sìyǎng bīn'wēi wùzhǒng, yǐ bǎohù shēngwù duōyàngxìng.
en: The research institute is committed to the artificial rearing of endangered species to protect biodiversity.

zh: 在制定政策时，政府更侧重于保障民生与促进社会公平。
pinyin: Zài zhìdìng zhèngcè shí, zhèngfǔ gèng cèzhòngyú bǎozhàng mínshēng yǔ cùjìn shèhuì gōngpíng.
en: When formulating policies, the government places more emphasis on guaranteeing people's livelihoods and promoting social equity.

zh: 他原本享有极高的社会名声，却因一时贪念而毁于一旦。
pinyin: tā yuán běn xiǎng yǒu jí gāo de shè huì míng shēng, què yīn yī shí tān niàn ér huǐ yú yī dàn.
en: He originally enjoyed a high social reputation, but ruined it instantly due to a moment of greed.

zh: 由于城市化的迅速扩张，该地区的地下水资源已濒临枯竭。
pinyin: Yóuyú chéngshìhuà de xùnsù kuòzhāng, gāi dìqū de dì xià shuǐ zīyuán yǐ bīnlín kūjié.
en: Due to the rapid expansion of urbanization, the groundwater resources in this region are on the verge of depletion.

zh: 艺术创作往往需要博采众长，而非单纯地效仿前人的笔触。
pinyin: Yìshù chuàngzuò wǎngwǎng xūyào bócǎi zhòngcháng, ér fēi dānchún de xiàofǎng qiánrén de bǐchù.
en: Artistic creation often requires drawing on the strengths of others, rather than simply imitating the brushwork of predecessors.

zh: 他作为一名享誉国际的作家，经常受邀参加各类文学论坛。
pinyin: Tā zuòwéi yī míng xiǎngyù guójì de zuòjiā, jīngcháng shòuyāo cānjiā gèlèi wénxué lùntán.
en: As an internationally renowned author, he is often invited to participate in various literary forums.

zh: 深秋时节，枯萎的树叶纷纷飘落，铺成了一层厚厚的毯子。
pinyin: Shēnqiū shíjié, kūwěi de shùyè fēnfēn piāoluò, pūchéngle yī céng hòuhòu de tǎnzi.
en: In late autumn, the withered leaves fluttered down, covering the ground like a thick blanket.

zh: 由于经营不善，他不得不沿街兜售各类小零食以维持生计。
pinyin: Yóuyú jīngyíng bùshàn, tā bùdébù yánjiē dōushòu gèlèi xiǎo língshí yǐ wéichí shēngjì.
en: Due to poor management, he had to hawk various snacks along the street to make a living.

zh: 由于持续干旱，该地区的水位已经降至低于警戒线的水平。
pinyin: Yóuyú chíxù gānhàn, gāi dìqū de shuǐwèi yǐjīng jiàng zhì dīyú jǐngjièxiàn de shuǐpíng.
en: Due to the persistent drought, the water level in that region has dropped to a level lower than the warning line.

zh: 政府呼吁民众积极接种疫苗，从而在社区内建立起免疫屏障。
pinyin: zhèng fǔ hū yù mín zhòng jī jí jiē zhǒng yì miáo, cóng ér zài shè qū nèi jiàn lì qǐ miǎn yì píng zhàng.
en: The government calls on the public to actively get vaccinated, thereby establishing an immune barrier within the community.

zh: 他不仅在专业领域造诣颇深，而且懂得如何平衡事业与家庭。
pinyin: Tā bùjǐn zài zhuānyè lǐngyù zàoyì pō shēn, érqiě dǒngde rúhé pínghéng shìyè yǔ jiātíng.
en: He is not only highly accomplished in his professional field but also understands how to balance career and family.

zh: 据档案记载，这位遇姓家族曾在这片土地上繁衍了数个世纪。
pinyin: Jù dàng'àn jìzǎi, zhè wèi Yù xìng jiāzú céng zài zhè piàn tǔdì shàng fányǎn le shù gè shìjì.
en: According to the archives, this family surnamed Yu had thrived on this land for centuries.

zh: 由于超负荷运转，老旧机器的零件受损导致金属表面开花了。
pinyin: Yóuyú chāofùhè yùnzhuǎn, lǎojiù jīqì de língjiàn shòusǔn dǎozhì jīnshǔ biǎomiàn kāihuā le.
en: Due to overloading, the parts of the old machine were damaged, causing the metal surface to crack and burst.

zh: 敌军在撤退时烧毁了所有的军事设施，试图掩盖其战略意图。
pinyin: Díjūn zài chètuì shí shāohuǐ le suǒyǒu de jūnshì shèshī, shìtú yǎngài qí zhànlüè yìtú.
en: The enemy forces destroyed all military facilities while retreating, attempting to conceal their strategic intentions.

zh: 无论出于何种动机，杀害无辜者的行径都应受到法律的严惩。
pinyin: Wúlùn chūyú hé zhǒng dòngjī, shāhài wúgūzhě de xíngjìng dōu yīng shòudào fǎlǜ de yánchéng.
en: Regardless of the motive, the act of murdering innocent people should be severely punished by the law.

zh: 公司始终秉持客户至上的经营理念，以提供优质服务为核心。
pinyin: Gōngsī shǐzhōng bǐngchí kèhù zhìshàng de jīngyíng lǐniàn, yǐ tígōng yōuzhì fúwù wèi héxīn.
en: The company always upholds the business philosophy of 'customer first,' focusing on providing high-quality service.

zh: 在这座静谧的山峰上，远眺天边如火的彩霞，令人心旷神怡。
pinyin: Zài zhè zuò jìngmì de shānfēng shàng, yuǎntiào tiānbiān rú huǒ de cǎixiá, lìng rén xīnkuàngshényí.
en: Standing on this tranquil mountain peak, gazing at the fiery sunset clouds on the horizon makes one feel relaxed and happy.

zh: 由于海拔极高，登山者不得不依赖便携式氧气装置来维持生命。
pinyin: Yóu yú hǎi bá jí gāo, dēng shān zhě bù dé bù yī lài biàn xié shì yǎng qì zhuāng zhì lái wéi chí shēng mìng.
en: Due to the extreme altitude, climbers have to rely on portable oxygen devices to sustain life.

zh: 书法家通过临摹古代碑帖，精准地掌握了繁体字的结构与韵味。
pinyin: Shūfǎjiā tōngguò línmó gǔdài bēitiě, jīngzhǔn de zhì zhǎngwò le fántǐzì de jiégòu yǔ yùnwèi.
en: Calligraphers accurately grasp the structure and charm of traditional Chinese characters by copying ancient stone inscriptions.

zh: 由于前方道路施工，所有车辆需强制减速行驶以确保交通顺畅。
pinyin: Yóuyú qiánfāng dàolù shīgōng, suǒyǒu chēliàng xū qiángzhì jiǎnsù xíngshǐ yǐ quèbǎo jiāotōng shùnchàng.
en: Due to road construction ahead, all vehicles are required to slow down to ensure smooth traffic flow.

zh: 这项改革措施虽然面临挑战，但却深受广大民众的支持与拥护。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé cuòshī suīrán miànlín tiǎozhàn, dàn què shēnshòu guǎngdà mínzhòng de zhīchí yǔ yōnghù.
en: Although this reform measure faces challenges, it is deeply supported and endorsed by the general public.

zh: 有些超市会把临近保质期的酸奶进行打折处理以减少库存积压。
pinyin: Yǒuxiē chāoshì huì bǎ línjìn bǎozhìqī de suānnǎi jìnxíng dǎzhé chǔlǐ yǐ jiǎnshǎo kùcún jīyā.
en: Some supermarkets discount yogurt nearing its expiration date to reduce excess inventory.

zh: 比起那种固步自封的思维模式，我们应当秉持开放包容的态度。
pinyin: Bǐ qǐ nà zhǒng gùbùzìfēng de sīwéi móshì, wǒmen yīngdāng bǐngchí kāifàng bāoróng de tàidù.
en: Compared with that stagnant mindset, we should uphold an open and inclusive attitude.

zh: 作为一名具有社会责任感的富豪，他积极投身于各类慈善事业。
pinyin: zuò wéi yī míng jù yǒu shè huì zé rèn gǎn de fù háo, tā jī jí tóu shēn yú gè lèi cí shàn shì yè.
en: As a wealthy person with a sense of social responsibility, he actively participates in various charity projects.

zh: 为了购买那件心仪已久的礼物，他开始省吃俭用，积攒零花钱。
pinyin: Wèile gòumǎi nà jiàn xīnyí yǐ jiǔ de lǐwù, tā kāishǐ shěngchījiǎnyòng, jīzǎn línghuāqián.
en: In order to buy the gift he had long desired, he started living frugally to save up his pocket money.

zh: 由于化学性质的差异，某些化合物难以在普通溶剂中充分溶解。
pinyin: yóu yú huà xué xìng zhì de chā yì, mǒu xiē huà hé wù nán yǐ zài pǔ tōng róng jì zhōng chōng fèn róng jiě.
en: Due to differences in chemical properties, some compounds are difficult to dissolve fully in common solvents.

zh: 他竟敢在众目睽睽之下篡改公司的核心数据，简直是胆大妄为。
pinyin: Tā jìnggǎn zài zhòngmùkuíkuí zhī xià cuàngǎi gōngsī de héxīn shùjù, jiǎnzhí shì dǎndàwàngwéi.
en: He actually dared to tamper with the company's core data in full view of everyone; that is nothing short of reckless audacity.

zh: 为了应对挑战，企业必须不断研发新型材料以维持核心竞争力。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì tiǎozhàn, qǐyè bìxū bùduàn yánfā xīnxíng cáiliào yǐ wéichí héxīn jìngzhēnglì.
en: In order to meet the challenge, the enterprise must constantly develop new types of materials to maintain its core competitiveness.

zh: 该设备通过精密工艺将水源净化，从而提供符合标准的纯净水。
pinyin: Gāi shèbèi tōngguò jīngmì gōngyì jiāng shuǐyuán jìnghuà, cóng'ér tígōng fúhé biāozhǔn de chúnjìngshuǐ.
en: The equipment purifies the water source through precise processes, thereby providing purified water that meets standards.

zh: 许多工业生产过程产生的废弃物会对土壤造成不可逆转的污染。
pinyin: Xǔduō gōngyè shēngchǎn guòchéng chǎnshēng de fèiqìwù huì duì tǔrǎng zàochéng bùkě nìzhuǎn de wūrǎn.
en: Waste products generated by many industrial production processes can cause irreversible pollution to the soil.

zh: 跨国企业往往会在海外分支机构设立专门的法律部门以规避风险。
pinyin: Kuàguó qǐyè wǎngwǎng huì zài hǎiwài fēnzhī jīgòu shèlì zhuānmén de fǎlǜ bùmén yǐ guībì fēngxiǎn.
en: Multinational corporations often set up specialized legal departments in overseas branches to mitigate risks.

zh: 尽管处境极其恶劣，他依然表现得镇定自若，毫无惊慌失措之态。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chǔjìng jíqí èliè, tā yīrán biǎoxiàn de zhèndìng zìruò, háowú jīnghuāngshīcuò zhī tài.
en: Although the situation was extremely dire, he still remained calm and composed, without showing any sign of panic.

zh: 尽管课业负担沉重，他依然坚持每周去补习，以此巩固课堂所学。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn kèyè fùdān chénzhòng, tā yīrán jiānchí měizhōu qù bǔxí, yǐ cǐ gǒnggù kètáng suǒ xué.
en: Despite the heavy academic burden, he persists in attending extra lessons every week to consolidate what he learned in class.

zh: 该企业致力于制造环保型的建筑材料，以响应可持续发展的号召。
pinyin: Gāi qǐyè zhìlì yú zhìzào huánbǎoxíng de jiànzhù cáiliào, yǐ xiǎngyìng kě chíxù fāzhǎn de hàozhào.
en: The enterprise is committed to manufacturing eco-friendly building materials to respond to the call for sustainable development.

zh: 导演坚持要在凌晨拍摄那场关键的戏份，以追求极致的视觉效果。
pinyin: dǎoyǎn jiānchí yào zài língchén pāishè nà chǎng guānjiàn de xìfèn, yǐ zhuīqiú jízhì de shìjué xiàoguǒ.
en: The director insisted on filming the crucial scene at dawn to pursue the ultimate visual effect.

zh: 该门户网站的主页通过一系列交互式组件展示了最新的新闻资讯。
pinyin: Gāi ménhù wǎngzhàn de zhǔyè tōngguò yī xìliè jiāohùshì zǔjiàn zhǎnshìle zuìxīn de xīnwén zīxùn.
en: The portal's home page displays the latest news via a series of interactive components.

zh: 由于原声演员的档期冲突，剧组不得不重新寻找合适的配音人选。
pinyin: Yóuyú yuánshēng yǎnyuán de dàngqī chōngtū, jùzǔ bùdébù chóngxīn xúnzhǎo héshì de pèiyīn rénxuǎn.
en: Due to scheduling conflicts with the original actors, the production team had to find suitable replacements for dubbing.

zh: 广场中央矗立着一根高大的旗杆，国旗在蓝天之下显得格外庄严。
pinyin: Guǎngchǎng zhōngyāng chùlìzhe yī gēn gāodà de qígǎn, guóqí zài lántiān zhī xià xiǎndé géwài zhuāngyán.
en: A tall flagpole stands in the center of the square, and the national flag looks especially solemn under the blue sky.

zh: 该系统集成了多种功能，市民持有一卡通即可享受便捷的公共服务。
pinyin: Gāi xìtǒng jíchéngle duō zhǒng gōngnéng, shìmín chíyǒu yīkǎtōng jíkě xiǎngshòu biànjié de gōnggòng fúwù.
en: The system integrates multiple functions, allowing citizens to enjoy convenient public services by holding an all-in-one card.

zh: 面对秋天的萧瑟景象，文人墨客常常会借景抒情，感慨时光的流逝。
pinyin: Miànduì qiūtiān de xiāosè jǐngxiàng, wénrénmòkè chángcháng huì jièjǐngshūqíng, gǎnkǎi shíguāng de liúshì.
en: Faced with the bleak scenery of autumn, writers and poets often express their emotions through the landscape, lamenting the passage of time.

zh: 通过改良土壤结构，当地农民成功培育出了抗病性极强的白菜品种。
pinyin: Tōngguò gǎiliáng tǔrǎng jiégòu, dāngdì nóngmín chénggōng péiyù chūle kàngbìngxìng jí qiáng de báicài pǐnzhǒng.
en: By improving soil structure, local farmers successfully cultivated a highly disease-resistant variety of bok choy.

zh: 许多尖端科技最初都是为了军事目的研发，后来才推广至民用领域。
pinyin: Xǔduō jiānduān kējì chūcǐ dōu shì wèile jūnshì mùdì yánfā, hòulái cái tuīguǎng zhì mínyòng lǐngyù.
en: Many cutting-edge technologies were initially developed for military purposes and later promoted to the civilian sector.

zh: 哪怕他在这个领域深耕多年，其敏锐的洞察力依然比不上那位专家。
pinyin: Nǎpà tā zài zhège lǐngyù shēngēng shēngēng duōnián, qí mǐnruì de dòngchálì yīrán bǐ bù shàng nà wèi zhuānjiā.
en: Even if he has been deeply cultivated in this field for many years, his keen insight still cannot compare with that expert.

zh: 那盏精致的宫灯灯笼不仅是照明工具，更是一种富有底蕴的艺术品。
pinyin: Nà zhǎn jīngzhì de gōngdēng dēnglóng bùjǐn shì zhàomíng gōngjù, gèng shì yī zhǒng fùyǒu dìyùn de yìshùpǐn.
en: That exquisite palace lantern is not just a lighting tool, but also a work of art with rich cultural connotations.

zh: 由于市场环境恶化，该集团被迫进行大规模的资产重组以维持运营。
pinyin: Yóuyú shìchǎng huánjìng èhuà, gāi jítuán bèi pò jìnxíng dàguīmó de zīchǎn chóngzǔ yǐ wéichí yùnyíng.
en: Due to the deteriorating market environment, the group was forced to undergo large-scale asset restructuring to maintain operations.

zh: 优秀的商人往往具备独特的商业嗅觉，能够捕捉到稍纵即逝的机遇。
pinyin: Yōuxiù de shāngrén wǎngwǎng jùbèi dútè de shāngyè xiùjué, nénggòu bǔzhuō dào shāozòngjìshì de jīyù.
en: Excellent businessmen often possess a unique business sense, enabling them to capture fleeting opportunities.

zh: 这种侥幸心理往往会导致人们对购买彩票产生一种近乎病态的依赖。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiǎoxìng xīnlǐ wǎngwǎng huì dǎozhì rénmen duì gòumǎi cǎipiào chǎnshēng yī zhǒng jìnhū bìngtài de yīlài.
en: This kind of fluke mentality often leads people to develop an almost pathological dependence on buying lottery tickets.

zh: 该企业致力于优化供应链，以确保原材料供应的稳定性与可持续性。
pinyin: Gāi qǐyè zhìlì yú yōuhuà gōngyìngliàn, yǐ quèbǎo yuáncáiliào gōngyìng de wěndìngxìng yǔ kěchíxùxìng.
en: The enterprise is committed to optimizing the supply chain to ensure the stability and sustainability of raw material supply.

zh: 该地区虽然蕴藏着丰富的矿产，但开采条件艰苦，难以大规模开发。
pinyin: gāi dìqū suīrán yùncángzhe fēngfù de kuàngchǎn, dàn kāicǎi tiáojiàn jiānkǔ, nányǐ dàguīmó kāifā.
en: Although the area is rich in mineral deposits, the mining conditions are harsh, making large-scale exploitation difficult.

zh: 该社论以其敏锐的洞察力和严谨的逻辑阐述了国家发展的宏伟蓝图。
pinyin: Gāi shèlùn yǐ qí mǐnruì de dòngchálì hé yánjǐn de luójí chǎnshùle guójiā fāzhǎn de hóngwěi lántú.
en: The editorial expounded on the grand blueprint for national development with its keen insight and rigorous logic.

zh: 阳光透过细小的雨滴发生折射，从而在天际勾勒出一道绚丽的彩虹。
pinyin: yáng guāng tòu guò xì xiǎo de yǔ dī fā shēng zhé shè, cóng ér zài tiān jì gōu lè chū yī dào xuàn lì de cǎi hóng.
en: Sunlight refracts through tiny raindrops, thereby outlining a brilliant rainbow in the horizon.

zh: 她动作娴熟地为伤员清理创面并进行包扎，展现出极高的专业素养。
pinyin: tā dòng zuò xián shú de wèi shāng yuán qīng lǐ chuāng miàn bìng jìn xíng bāo zā, zhǎn xiàn chū jí gāo de zhuān yè sù yǎng.
en: She skillfully cleaned the wound and bandaged the patient, demonstrating a high level of professional competence.

zh: 尽管现实生活十分残酷，人们依然渴望在童话般的世界里寻求慰藉。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiànshí shēnghuó shífēn cánkù, rénmen yīrán kěwěngé zài tónghuà bān de shìjiè lǐ xúnqiú wèijiè.
en: Although real life is very cruel, people still long to seek comfort in a fairy-tale world.

zh: 他对于新鲜事物的探索总是表现得极其起劲，这种求知欲令人佩服。
pinyin: tā duì yú xīn xiān shì wù de tàn suǒ zǒng shì biǎo xiàn de jí qí qǐ jìn, zhè zhǒng qiú zhī yù lìng rén pèi fú.
en: He always shows great energy in exploring new things; this thirst for knowledge is admirable.

zh: 尽管网络上充斥着关于他的各种绯闻，但他依然保持沉默，不予置评。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wǎngluò shàng chōngchìzhe guānyú tā de gèzhǒng fēiwén, dàn tā yīrán bǎochí chénmò, bùyǔ zhìpíng.
en: Although the internet is flooded with all kinds of scandals about him, he remains silent and refuses to comment.

zh: 在极其艰苦的自然条件下，红军凭借顽强的意志完成了史诗般的长征。
pinyin: Zài jíqí jiānkǔ de zìrán tiáojiàn xià, Hóngjūn píngjiè wánqiáng de yìzhì wánchéng le shǐshībān de Chángzhēng.
en: Under extremely harsh natural conditions, the Red Army completed the epic Long March with tenacious willpower.

zh: 在这个特殊时期，佩戴口罩已成为人们日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。
pinyin: Zài zhège tèshū shíqī, pèidài kǒuzhào yǐ chéngwéi rénmen rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng bùkě huòquē de yībùfèn.
en: In this special period, wearing a mask has become an indispensable part of people's daily life.

zh: 无论遭遇何种困境，他都时刻保持冷静，从不抱怨何时才能迎来转机。
pinyin: Wúlùn zāoyù hé zhǒng kùnjìng, tā dōu shíkè bǎochí lěngjìng, cóng bù bàoyuàn hé shí cáinéng yínglái zhuǎnjī.
en: Regardless of what kind of predicament he encounters, he always remains calm and never complains about when a turning point will arrive.

zh: 面对竞争对手无理的挑衅，公司决定采取强硬的应对措施以维护尊严。
pinyin: Miànduì jìngzhēng duìshǒu wúlǐ de tiǎoxìn, gōngsī juédìng cǎiqǔ qiángyìng de yìngduì cuòshī yǐ wéihù zūnyán.
en: Facing the unreasonable provocation of the competitor, the company decided to take strong countermeasures to maintain its dignity.

zh: 随着声呐技术的革新，该潜艇的隐蔽性和作战能力均得到了显著提升。
pinyin: Suízhe shēngnà jìshù de géxīn, gāi qiántǐng de yǐnbìxìng hé zuòzhàn nénglì jūn dédàole xiǎnzhù tíshēng.
en: With the innovation of sonar technology, the stealth and combat capability of the submarine have been significantly improved.

zh: 面对公司裁员的困境，他毅然决然地呈上了一份辞呈，选择另谋高就。
pinyin: Miànduì gōngsī cáiyuán de kùnjìng, tā yìrán juérán de chéngshàng le yī fèn cíchéng, xuǎnzé lìng móu gāojiù.
en: Facing the predicament of company layoffs, he resolutely submitted his resignation, choosing to seek better opportunities elsewhere.

zh: 为了缓解繁忙时段的交通压力，相关部门决定在该线路增开几趟快车。
pinyin: wèile huǎnjiě fánmáng shíduàn de jiāotōng yālì, xiāngguān bùmén juédìng zài gāi xiànlù zēng zēngkāi jǐ tàng kuài chē.
en: To alleviate traffic pressure during busy hours, the relevant departments decided to add a few express trains on that line.

zh: 随着传媒技术的革新，各家卫视都在努力通过数字化转型提升竞争力。
pinyin: suízhe chuánméi jìshù de géxīn, gè jiā wèishì dōu zài nǔlì tōngguò shùzìhuà zhuǎnxíng tíshēng jìngzhēnglì.
en: With the innovation of media technology, every satellite TV station is striving to enhance its competitiveness through digital transformation.

zh: 尽管经历了长途跋涉，他那双原本湿润的眼眶依然闪烁着坚定的光芒。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn jīnglìle chángtú báshè, tā nà shuāng yuánběn shīrùn de yǎnkuàng yīrán shǎnshuòzhe jiāndìng de guāngmáng.
en: Despite the long journey, his once moist eyes still shone with a firm light.

zh: 那位员工因不满薪资待遇而选择不辞而别，给公司造成了巨大的损失。
pinyin: Nà wèi yuángōng yīn bùmǎn xīnzī dàiyù ér xuǎnzé bù cí ér bié, gěi gōngsī zàochéngle jùdà de sǔnshī.
en: That employee chose to leave without notice due to dissatisfaction with the salary, causing huge losses to the company.

zh: 尽管西红柿的价格有所上涨，但它依然是家庭餐桌上不可或缺的蔬菜。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xīhóngshì de jiàgé yǒu suǒ shàngzhǎng, dàn tā yīrán shì jiātíng cānzhuō shàng bùkěhuòquē de shūcài.
en: Although the price of tomatoes has risen, they remain an indispensable vegetable on the family dining table.

zh: 幸好他深谋远虑，预见到了可能发生的危机，并提前制定了应急预案。
pinyin: Xìnghǎo tā shēnmóuyuǎnlǜ, yùjiàndàole kěnéng fāshēng de wēijī, bìng tíqián zhìdìngle yìngjí yù'àn.
en: Fortunately, he was far-sighted, anticipated the potential crisis, and formulated an emergency plan in advance.

zh: 面对突发状况，她始终能够控制音量，以小声且冷静的语调进行沟通。
pinyin: Miànduì túfā zhuàngkuàng, tā shǐzhōng nénggòu kòngzhì yīnliàng, yǐ xiǎo shēng qiě lēng qiě lěngjìng de yǔdiào jìnxíng gōutōng.
en: Faced with an emergency, she was always able to control her volume and communicate in a low, calm tone.

zh: 他那滔滔不绝的辩才令人叹为观止，最终成功说服了在场的所有董事。
pinyin: Tā nà tāotāo bù jué de biàncái lìng rén tànwéiguānzhǐ, zuìzhōng chénggōng shuōfú le zàichǎng de suǒyǒu dǒngshì.
en: His torrent of eloquent arguments was breathtaking, and he ultimately succeeded in persuading all the directors present.

zh: 该型号汽车在出厂交付之前，必须符合相关部门制定的各项安全标准。
pinyin: Gāi xínghào qìchē zài chūchǎng jiāofù zhīqián, bìxū fúhé xiāngguān bùmén zhìdìng de gèxiàng ānquán biāozhǔn.
en: Before this model of car is delivered from the factory, it must meet all safety standards set by the relevant departments.

zh: 随着社会的发展，家政服务已成为人们日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。
pinyin: Suízhe shèhuì de fāzhǎn, jiāzhèng fúwù yǐ chéngwéi rénmen rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng bùkě huòquē de yībùfèn.
en: With the development of society, housekeeping services have become an indispensable part of people's daily lives.

zh: 为了应对日益增长的物流需求，市政府决定扩建这座历史悠久的码头。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì rìyì zēngzhǎng de wùliú xūqiú, shì zhèngfǔ juédìng kuòjiàn zhè zuò lìshǐ yōujiǔ de mǎtou.
en: In order to cope with the growing logistics demand, the municipal government decided to expand this historic wharf.

zh: 各界精英齐聚一堂，在本次高峰论坛上就经济转型展开了深入的剖析。
pinyin: Gèjiè jīngyīng qíjù yītáng, zài běn cì gāofēng lùntán shàng jiù jīngjì zhuǎ zhuǎnxíng zhǎnkāile shēnrù de pōuxī.
en: Elites from all walks of life gathered together to conduct an in-depth analysis of economic transformation at this summit forum.

zh: 她在聚光灯下展现出的那种收放自如的台风，令台下的观众深感震撼。
pinyin: Tā zài jùguāngdēng xià zhǎnxiàn chū de nà zhǒng shōufàngzìrú de táifēng, lìng táixià de guānzhòng shēngǎn zhènhàn.
en: The effortless and poised stage presence she displayed under the spotlight deeply stunned the audience.

zh: 面对日益激烈的竞争，企业必须寻求长足的发展空间以确保持续竞争力。
pinyin: miàn duì rì yì jī liè de jìng zhēng, qǐ yè bì xū xún qiú cháng zú de fā zhǎn kōng jiān yǐ què bǎo chí xù jìng zhēng lì.
en: Facing increasingly fierce competition, enterprises must seek remarkable room for development to ensure sustained competitiveness.

zh: 这套古籍不仅印刷精美，而且内容丰富，令学者们爱不释手，反复研读。
pinyin: Zhè tào gǔjí bùjǐn yìnshuā jīngměi, érqiě nèiróng fēngfù, lìng xuézhěmen àibùshìshǒu, fǎnfù yándú.
en: This collection of ancient books is not only beautifully printed but also rich in content, making scholars unable to put them down as they study them repeatedly.

zh: 由于持续刮风，海边的气温迅速下降，原本平静的海面也变得波涛汹涌。
pinyin: Yóuyú chíxù guāfēng, hǎibiān de qìwēn xùnsù xiàjiàng, yuánběn píngjìng de hǎimiàn yě biàn de bōtāo xiōngyǒng.
en: Due to the continuous wind, the temperature at the seaside dropped rapidly, and the originally calm sea became turbulent.

zh: 营销部门针对不同客户群体制定了差异化的促销方案，旨在最大化利润。
pinyin: Yíngxiāo bùmén zhēnduì bùtóng kèhù qúntǐ zhìdìngle chāyìhuà de cùxiāo fāng'àn, zhǐ zài zuìdàhuà lìrùn.
en: The marketing department developed differentiated promotional plans for different customer groups, aiming to maximize profits.

zh: 经过缜密的科学调研，专家建议通过适度的午睡来改善大脑的认知功能。
pinyin: Jīngguò zhěnmì de kēxué diàoyán, zhuānjiā jiànyì tōngguò shìdù de wǔshuì lái gǎishàn dànǎo de rènzhī gōngnéng.
en: Following meticulous scientific research, experts suggest improving cognitive brain function through moderate afternoon naps.

zh: 政府通过调整相关政策，以确保退休金的发放能够维持基本的生活水准。
pinyin: zhèng fǔ tōng guò diào zhěng xiāng guān zhèng cè, yǐ què bǎo tuì xiū jīn de fā fàng néng gòu wéi chí jī běn de shēng huó shuǐ zhǔn.
en: The government is adjusting relevant policies to ensure that the distribution of retirement pensions can maintain a basic standard of living.

zh: 攀登长城不仅需要强健的体魄，更需要一种不畏艰难、持之以恒的精神。
pinyin: Pāndēng Chángchéng bùjǐn xūyào qiángjiàn de tǐpò, gèng xūyào yī zhǒng búwèi jiānnán, chí zhī yǐ héng de jīngshén.
en: Climbing the Great Wall requires not only a strong physique but also a spirit of perseverance and fearlessness in the face of hardship.

zh: 那家机构聘请了专业人士担任其全球代言人，以提升企业的国际影响力。
pinyin: Nà jiā jīgòu pìnqǐng le zhuānyè rénshì dānrèn qí quánqiú dàiyánrén, yǐ tíshēng qǐyè de guójì yǐngxiǎnglì.
en: That organization hired a professional to serve as its global spokesperson to enhance the company's international influence.

zh: 尽管周围有许多竞争对手，全家依然凭借其高效的服务占据了市场份额。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhōuwéi yǒu xǔduō jìngzhēng duìshǒu, Quánjiā yīrán píngjiè qí gāoxiào de fúwù zhànjùle shìchǎng fèn'é.
en: Despite many competitors nearby, FamilyMart still occupies market share by virtue of its efficient service.

zh: 随着全球化的深入，外语能力的培养已成为教育体系中不可或缺的一环。
pinyin: Suízhe quánqiúhuà de shēnrù, wàiyǔ nénglì de péiyǎng yǐ chéngwéi jiàoyù tǐxì zhōng bùkě huòquē de yī huán.
en: With the deepening of globalization, the cultivation of foreign language ability has become an indispensable part of the education system.

zh: 尽管医学技术在不断进步，但癌症依然是威胁人类生命的主要疾病之一。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yīxué jìshù zài bùduàn jìnbù, dàn áizhèng yīrán shì wēixié rénlèi shēngmìng de zhǔ zhǔyào jíbìng zhī yī.
en: Although medical technology is constantly advancing, cancer remains one of the main diseases that threaten human life.

zh: 为了保障居民的生命财产安全，该建筑配备了完备的消防自动报警系统。
pinyin: Wèile bǎozhàng jūmín de shēngmìng cáichǎn ānquán, gāi jiànzhù pèibèi le wánbèi de xiāofáng zìdòng bàojǐng xìtǒng.
en: To ensure the safety of residents' lives and property, the building is equipped with a complete automatic fire alarm system.

zh: 人工智能具有强大的运算能力，另一方面它在情感理解方面仍有局限性。
pinyin: Réngōng zhìnéng jùyǒu qiángdà de yùnsuàn nénglì, lìng yī fāngmiàn tā zài qínggǎn lǐjiě fāngmiàn réng yǒu júxiànxìng.
en: Artificial intelligence has powerful computing capabilities; in another aspect, it still has limitations in emotional understanding.

zh: 尽管面临严密的安保措施，激进分子依然试图通过暗杀手段来颠覆政权。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn miànlín yánmì de ānbǎo cuòshī, jījìn fènzǐ yīrán shìtú tōngguò ànshā shǒuduàn lái diānfù zhèngquán.
en: Despite facing tight security measures, the radicals still attempted to subvert the regime through assassination.

zh: 该实验室通过精密的核心技术，研制出了具有自主知识产权的创新材料。
pinyin: gāi shí yàn shì tōng guò jīng mì de hé xīn jì shù, yán zhì chū le jù yǒu zì zhǔ zhī shí chǎn quán de chuàng xīn cái liào.
en: Through precise core technology, the laboratory researched and manufactured innovative materials with independent intellectual property rights.

zh: 尽管公共交通系统日趋完善，但很多人依然倾向于通过预约平台打车出行。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gōnggòng jiāotōng xìtǒng rìqū wánshàn, dàn hěnduō rén yīrán qīngxiàng yú tōngguò yùyuē píngtái dǎ chē chūxíng.
en: Although public transport systems are becoming more perfect, many people still prefer to take a taxi via booking platforms.

zh: 尽管拍摄过程极其艰苦，但他始终保持着高度的热情，全心投入到拍戏中。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn pāishè guòchéng jíqí jiānkǔ, dàn tā shǐzhōng bǎochízhe gāodù de rèqíng, quánxīn tóurù dào pāixì zhōng.
en: Although the shooting process was extremely arduous, he always maintained a high level of enthusiasm and was fully devoted to filming.

zh: 尽管面临文化差异的挑战，他依然选择在异国他乡定居并融入了当地社会。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn miàn huánmiàn wénhuà chāyì de tiǎozhàn, tā yīrán xuǎnzé zài yìguó tāxiāng dìngjū bìng róngrùle dāngdì shèhuì.
en: Despite the challenges of cultural differences, he still chose to settle in a foreign land and integrated into the local society.

zh: 由于未能及时采取预防措施，导致多名员工集体患病，引发了公司的担忧。
pinyin: Yóuyú wèinéng jíshí cǎiqǔ yùfáng cuòshī, dǎozhì duō míng yuángōng jítǐ huànbìng, yǐnfā le gōngsī de dānyōu.
en: Due to the failure to take preventive measures in time, multiple employees fell ill collectively, sparking concerns within the company.

zh: 尽管该品牌通常不打折，但为了回馈忠实顾客，他们偶尔会举行促销活动。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gāi pǐnpái tōngcháng bù dǎzhé, dàn wèile huíkuì zhōngshí gùkè, tāmen ǒu'ěr huì jǔxíng cùxiāo huódòng.
en: Although the brand usually does not offer discounts, they occasionally hold promotional events to reward loyal customers.

zh: 上周的金融研讨会汇集了各界的杰出学者，旨在探讨经济危机的缓解机制。
pinyin: Shàng zhōu de jīnróng yántǎohuì huìjíle gèjiè de jiéchū xuézhě, zhǐzài tàntǎo jīngjì wēijī de huǎnjiě jīzhì.
en: Last week's financial seminar gathered prominent scholars from various fields, aiming to explore mitigation mechanisms for the economic crisis.

zh: 尽管现在的饮食习惯逐渐多元化，仍有不少年轻人习惯以方便面作为宵夜。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiànzài de yǐnshí xíguàn zhújiàn duōyuánhuà, réng yǒu bùshǎo niánqīng rén xíguàn yǐ fāngbiànmiàn zuòwéi xiāoyè.
en: Although dietary habits are gradually diversifying nowadays, many young people are still accustomed to having instant noodles as a late-night snack.

zh: 为了筹集那笔昂贵的医疗费，全家人不得不节衣缩食，生活过得十分拮据。
pinyin: Wèile chóují nà bǐ ángguì de yīliáo fèi, quánjiārén bùdébù jiéyīsuōshí, shēnghuó guò de shífēn jiéjū.
en: In order to raise that expensive medical fee, the whole family had to save on food and clothing, living in very straitened circumstances.

zh: 尽管科技在不断进步，但这部分基础设施的更新依然处于严重滞后的状态。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn kējì zài bùduàn jìnbù, dàn zhè bùfèn jīchǔ shèshī de gēngxīn yīrán chǔyú yánzhòng zhìhòu de zhuàngtài.
en: Although technology is constantly advancing, the renewal of this part of the infrastructure is still in a state of severe lag.

zh: 为了保持食材的鲜美，他精心钻研卤味的配方，力求呈现出最地道的口感。
pinyin: Wèile bǎochí shícái de xiānměi, tā jīngxīn zuānyán lǔwèi de pèifāng, lìqiú chéngxiàn chū zuì dìdào de kǒugǎn.
en: In order to preserve the freshness of the ingredients, he meticulously studied the recipe for braised food, striving to present the most authentic texture.

zh: 这位教授在演讲中不仅引用了大量数据，还通过举例将复杂的理论通俗化。
pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu zài yǎnjiǎng zhōng bùjǐn yǐnyòngle dàliàng shùjù, hái tōngguò jǔlì jiāng fùzá de lǐlùn tōngsúhuà.
en: In his lecture, the professor not only cited a large amount of data but also simplified complex theories by giving examples.

zh: 通过整合供应链，这家连锁店成功地降低了运营成本并提高了市场竞争力。
pinyin: Tōngguò zhěnghé gōngyìngliàn, zhè jiā lián suǒ diàn chénggōng de jiàngdī le yùnyíng chéngběn bìng tígāo le shìchǎng jìngzhēnglì.
en: By integrating the supply chain, this chain store has successfully reduced operating costs and improved market competitiveness.

zh: 为了维系这段脆弱的友谊，他不得不放下自尊去迁就对方的各种无理要求。
pinyin: Wèile wéixì zhè duàn cuìruò de yǒuyì, tā bùdébù fàngxià zìzūn qù qiānjiù duìfāng de gèzhǒng wúlǐ yāoqiú.
en: In order to maintain this fragile friendship, he had to set aside his self-respect and yield to the other party's various unreasonable demands.

zh: 该公司未能及时调整经营策略，因此在激烈的市场竞争中逐渐丧失了优势。
pinyin: Gāi gōngsī wèinéng jíshí tiáozhěng jīngyíng cèlüè, yīncǐ zài jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng zhújiàn sàngshī le yōushì.
en: The company failed to adjust its business strategy in time, thus it gradually lost its advantage in the fierce market competition.

zh: 无论面对多么复杂的局势，这位资深外交官总能保持冷静，妥善处理危机。
pinyin: Wú lùn miàn duì duō me fù zá de jú shì, zhè wèi zī shēn wài jiāo guān zǒng néng bǎo chí lěng jìng, tuǒ shàn chǔ lǐ wēi jī.
en: No matter how complex the situation, this senior diplomat always remains calm and handles crises properly.

zh: 这位青年企业家凭借其卓越的才能和优秀的管理理念，成功开拓了国际市场。
pinyin: Zhè wèi qīngnián qǐyèjiā píngjiè qí zhuóyuè de cáinéng hé yōuxiù de guǎnlǐ lǐniàn, chénggōng kāituò le guójì shìchǎng.
en: This young entrepreneur successfully opened up the international market by virtue of his outstanding talent and excellent management philosophy.

zh: 尽管这项提议在专家委员会中引起了巨大争议，但目前尚未收到正式的异议。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè xiàng tíyì zài zhuānjiā wěiyuánhuì zhōng yǐnqǐ le jùdà zhēngyì, dàn mùqián shàngwèi shōudào zhèngshì de yìyì.
en: Although this proposal caused great controversy within the expert committee, no formal objections have been received yet.

zh: 在那场盛大的婚礼上，每一位嘉宾都收到了一份包装精美的喜糖作为伴手礼。
pinyin: Zài nà chǎng shèngdà de hūnlǐ shàng, měi yī wèi jiābīn dōu shōudào le yī fèn bāozhuāng jīngměi de xǐtáng zuòwéi bànshǒulǐ.
en: At that grand wedding, every guest received a beautifully packaged wedding candy as a gift.

zh: 社会应当建立完善的激励机制，以鼓励公民在危难时刻挺身而出、见义勇为。
pinyin: Shèhuì yīngdāng jiànlì wánshàn de jīlì jīzhì, yǐ gǔlì gōngmín zài wēinàn shíkè tǐngshēn ér chū, jiàn yì yǒng wéi.
en: Society should establish a sound incentive mechanism to encourage citizens to stand up and act bravely for justice in times of danger.

zh: 经过多轮激烈的竞争与选拔，他终于脱颖而出，获得了前往总部深造的机会。
pinyin: Jīngguò duō lún jīliè de jìngzhēng yǔ xuǎnbá, tā zhōngyú tuōyǐng'érchū, huòdéle qiánwǎng zǒngbù shēnzào de jīhuì.
en: After multiple rounds of fierce competition and selection, he finally stood out and gained the opportunity to further his studies at the headquarters.

zh: 随着现代工业的飞速发展，工科教育在国家创新战略中扮演着举足轻重的角色。
pinyin: Suízhe xiàndài gōngyè de fēisù fāzhǎn, gōngkē jiàoyù zài guójiā chuàngxīn zhànlüè zhōng bànyǎn zhe jǔzúqīngzhòng de juésè.
en: With the rapid development of modern industry, engineering education plays a pivotal role in the national innovation strategy.

zh: 探险队员深入原始森林，在那片未受破坏的土地上发现了许多珍贵的奇花异草。
pinyin: tànxiǎn duìyuán shēnrù yuánshǐ sēnlín, zài nà piàn wèishòu pòhuài de tǔdì shàng fāxiànle xǔduō zhēnguì de qíhuāyìcǎo.
en: The expedition members ventured deep into the primeval forest and discovered many precious and rare flowers and herbs on that pristine land.

zh: 在面对挫折时，如果一味地逃避，不仅无法摆脱困境，反而会失去成长的契机。
pinyin: zài miàn duì cuò zhé shí, rú guǒ yī wèi de táo bì, bù jǐn wú fǎ bǎi tuō kùn jìng, fǎn ér huì shī qù chéng zhǎng de qì jī.
en: When facing setbacks, if one persistently avoids them, one will not only fail to escape the predicament but will also lose the opportunity for growth.

zh: 随着农业科技的进步，种植红薯的规模不断扩大，已成为当地重要的经济支柱。
pinyin: Suízhe nóngyè kējì de jìnbù, zhòngzhí hóngshǔ de guīmó bùduàn búduàn kuòdà, yǐ chéngwéi dāngdì zhòngyào de jīngjì zhīzhù.
en: With the advancement of agricultural technology, the scale of sweet potato cultivation has continuously expanded, becoming an important economic pillar for the local area.

zh: 为了应对突发的危机，他们举行了紧急会议，于是制定了一套全新的应急预案。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì túfā de wēijī, tāmen jǔxíng le jǐnjí huìyì, yú shì zhìdìng le yītào quánxīn de yìngjí yù'àn.
en: To deal with the sudden crisis, they held an emergency meeting, thereupon they formulated a brand new contingency plan.

zh: 这两座城市在经济结构上差异巨大，相比之下，它们在文化底蕴方面却不分伯仲。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng zuò chéngshì zài jīngjì jiégòu shàng chāyì jùdà, xiāngbǐzhīxià, tāmen zài wénhuà dǐyǐyùn fāngmiàn què bùfēn-bójhòng.
en: These two cities have huge differences in economic structure; by comparison, they are evenly matched in terms of cultural heritage.

zh: 这项技术能够极大地提高我们的生产效率，让我们共同探讨一下儿它的应用前景。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù nénggòu jídà de tígāo wǒmen de shēngchǎn xiàolǜ, ràng wǒmen gòngtóng tǎntǎo yī xià r tā de yìngyòng qiánjǐng.
en: This technology can greatly improve our production efficiency; let us discuss its application prospects together.

zh: 经过一番激烈的思想斗争，他终于意识到自己应该下车，不再执着于错误的道路。
pinyin: Jīngguò yīfān jīliè de sīxiǎng dòuzhēng, tā zhōngyú yìshí dào zìjǐ yīnggāi xiàchē, bù zài zhízhuó yú cuòwù de dàolù.
en: After a fierce internal struggle, he finally realized that he should 'get off' (quit the path he was on) and no longer persist on the wrong road.

zh: 在这个信息化时代，数字化办公极大地提高了工作效率，使得信息交流愈发便捷。
pinyin: Zài zhège xìnxīhuà shídài, shùzìhuà bàngōng jídà de tígāo le gōngzuò xiàolǜ, shǐdé xìnxī jiāoliú yùfā biànjié.
en: In this information age, digital office work greatly improves work efficiency, making information exchange increasingly convenient and fast.

zh: 随着中医药文化的传播，越来越多外国人开始尝试通过针灸和中药来治疗慢性疾病。
pinyin: Suízhe zhōngyīyào wénhuà de chuánbō, yuè lái yuè duō wàiguórén kāishǐ chángshì tōngguò zhēnjiǔ hé zhōngyào lái zhìliáo mànxìng jíbìng.
en: With the spread of traditional Chinese medicine culture, more and more foreigners have begun to try treating chronic diseases through acupuncture and traditional Chinese medicine.

zh: 元宵节期间，各地民俗活动丰富多彩，充分展现了中华民族的非物质文化遗产魅力。
pinyin: Yuánxiāojié qījiān, gèdì mínsú huódòng fēngfù duōcǎi, chōngfèn zhǎnxiànle Zhōnghuá mínzú de fēiwùzhì wénhuà yíchǎn mèilì.
en: During the Lantern Festival, local folk activities are rich and colorful, fully demonstrating the charm of the Chinese nation's intangible cultural heritage.

zh: 他在宴会上那番出其不意的即兴演说，令在座的各位宾客哄堂大笑，气氛极其融洽。
pinyin: Tā zài yànhuì shàng nà fān chūqíbùyì de jíxìng yǎnshuō, lìng zàizuò de gèwèi bīnkè hōngtángdàxiào, qìfēn jíqí róngqià.
en: His unexpected impromptu speech at the banquet made all the guests present roar with laughter, and the atmosphere was extremely harmonious.

zh: 在激烈的商业竞争中，企业应当秉持道德底线，拒绝一切损人利己的不正当竞争行为。
pinyin: Zài jīliè de shāngyè jìngzhēng zhōng, qǐyè yīngdāng bǐngchí dàodé dǐxiàn, jùjué yīqiè sǔn rén lì jǐ de bù zhèngdàng jìngzhēng xíngwéi.
en: In fierce business competition, companies should uphold ethical boundaries and reject all forms of unfair competition that harm others for personal gain.

zh: 尽管他精通机械原理，但面对这辆古董自行车，修车对他来说依然是一项艰巨的任务。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā jīngtōng jīxiè yuánlǐ, dàn miànduì zhè liàng gǔdǒng zìxíngchē, xiū chē duì tā lái shuō yīrán shì yī xiàng jiānjù de rènwù.
en: Although he is proficient in mechanical principles, repairing this antique bike remains a daunting task for him.

zh: 在这个风景优美的山谷中，每年都会举办盛大的热气球节，吸引了无数游客前来观赏。
pinyin: Zài zhège fēngjǐng yōuměi de shāngǔ zhōng, měinián dūhuì jǔbàn shèngdà de rèqìqiú jié, xīyǐnle wúshù yóukè qiánlái guānshǎng.
en: In this scenic valley, a grand hot air balloon festival is held every year, attracting countless tourists to come and watch.

zh: 国产客机的研发标志着我国在航空工业领域取得了重大突破，打破了长期的垄断局面。
pinyin: Guóchǎn kèjī de yánfā biāozhìzhe wǒguó zài hángkōng gōngyè lǐngyù qǔdé le zhòngdà tūpò, dǎpò le chángqī de lǒngduàn júmiàn.
en: The research and development of domestically produced passenger aircraft marks a major breakthrough in our country's aviation industry, breaking the long-term monopoly.

zh: 与其在毫无意义的争论上浪费时间，不如去做些更有建设性的事，这样争论下去实在是不值。
pinyin: Yǔqí zài háowú yìyì de zhēnglùn shàng làngfèi shíjiān, bùrú qù zuò xiē gèng yǒu jiànshèxìng de shì, zhèyàng zhēnglùn xiàqù shízài shì bù zhí.
en: Instead of wasting time on meaningless arguments, it's better to do something more constructive; continuing such an argument is really not worth it.

zh: 实验室的传感器能够实时监测并调节恒温箱内的水温。
pinyin: shí yàn shì de chuán gǎn qì néng gòu shí shí jiān cè bìng tiáo jié héng wēn xiāng nèi de shuǐ wēn.
en: The laboratory's sensors can monitor and regulate the water temperature inside the incubator in real time.

zh: 若该变量的取值小于预设阈值，程序将自动终止运行。
pinyin: Ruò gāi biànliàng de qǔzhí xiǎoyú yùshè yùzhí, chéngxù jiāng zìdòng zhōngzhǐ yùnxíng.
en: If the value of the variable is less than the preset threshold, the program will terminate automatically.

zh: 该国政府计划将首都迁往地理位置更为优越的内陆地区。
pinyin: Gāi guó zhèngfǔ jìhuà jiāng shǒudū qiān wǎng dìlǐ wèizhì gèngwéi yōuyuè de nèilù dìqū.
en: The government plans to relocate the capital to an inland region with a more favorable geographical location.

zh: 登上山顶，俯瞰那片广袤而碧绿的草原，令人心旷神怡。
pinyin: Dēngshàng shāndǐng, fǔkàn nà piàn guǎngmào ér bìlǜ de cǎoyuán, lìng rén xīnkuàngshényí.
en: Climbing to the mountain top and looking down at that vast and dark green grassland, one feels relaxed and happy.

zh: 在哨所守卫的士兵们轮流执勤与下岗，以维持防线的稳固。
pinyin: Zài shàosuǒ shǒuwèi de shìbīngmen lúnliú zhíqín yǔ xiàgǎng, yǐ wé, yǐ wéichí fángxiàn de wěngù.
en: The soldiers guarding the post take turns coming on and off duty to maintain the stability of the defense line.

zh: 这种酱油不仅色泽诱人，且口感醇厚，是烹饪时的绝佳佐料。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiàngyóu bùjǐn sèzé yòurén, qiě kǒugǎn chúnhòu, shì pēngrèn shí de juéjiā zuǒliào.
en: This kind of soy sauce is not only attractive in color but also has a mellow taste, making it an excellent seasoning for cooking.

zh: 这种久负盛名的盒子不仅皮薄馅大，而且制作工艺极其讲究。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiǔfùshèngmíng de hézi bùjǐn pí báo xiàn dà, érqiě zhìzuò gōngyì jíqí jiǎngjiu.
en: This renowned hezi not only has thin skin and large filling, but the production process is also extremely meticulous.

zh: 企业应当秉持诚信经营的理念，赢取广大顾客的信赖与赞誉。
pinyin: Qǐyè yīngdāng bǐngchí chéngxìn jīngyíng de lǐniàn, yíngqǔ guǎngdà gùkè de xìnlài yǔ zànyù.
en: Enterprises should uphold the philosophy of honest operation to win the trust and acclaim of the vast number of customers.

zh: 在那战乱频发的年代，无数百姓流离失所，被迫投奔偏远山区。
pinyin: Zài nà zhànluàn pínfā de niándài, wúshù bǎixìng liúlíshīsuǒ, bèipò tóubèn piānyuǎn shānqū.
en: In those years of frequent war, countless common people were displaced and forced to seek shelter in remote mountainous areas.

zh: 经过多位权威人士的反复鉴定，这件瓷器被确认为宋代的珍品。
pinyin: Jīngguò duō wèi quánwēi rénshì de fǎnfù jiàndìng, zhè jiàn cíqì bèi quèrèn wéi Sòngdài de zhēnpǐn.
en: After repeated authentication by multiple authorities, this piece of porcelain was confirmed as a treasure from the Song Dynasty.

zh: 由于该物种濒临灭绝，人类的捕杀行为直接威胁到了它们的生存。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi wùzhǒng bīnlín mièjué, rénlèi de bǔshā xíngwéi zhíjiē wēixié dào le tāmen de shēngcún.
en: As the species is on the verge of extinction, human hunting activities are directly threatening their survival.

zh: 该企业的运作必须严格遵循行业内部的各项法律法规及相关条例。
pinyin: Gāi qǐyè de yùnzuò bìxū yángé zūnxún hángyè nèibù de gèxiàng fǎlǜ fǎguī jí xiāngguān tiáolì.
en: The operation of the enterprise must strictly comply with the industry's internal laws, regulations, and relevant provisions.

zh: 一个人若总是瞧不起同僚，最终只会让自己陷入孤立无援的境地。
pinyin: Yīgè rén ruò zǒng shì qiáo bù qǐ tóngliáo, zuìzhōng zhǐ huì ràng zìjǐ xiànrù gūlì wúyuán de jìngdì.
en: If a person always looks down on colleagues, they will eventually find themselves isolated.

zh: 他沉溺于这种日复一日的平庸生活，逐渐丧失了当初的雄心壮志。
pinyin: Tā chénnì yú zhè zhǒng rì fù yī rì de píngyōng shēnghuó, zhújiàn sàngshīle dāngchū de xióngxīn zhuàngzhì.
en: Indulging in this mediocre life day after day, he gradually lost his original ambition.

zh: 由于生态环境的持续改善，仙鹤的种群数量呈现出稳步增长的态势。
pinyin: Yóuyú shēngtài huánjìng de chíxù gǎishàn, xiān hè de zhǒngqún shùliàng chéngxiàn chū wěnbù zēngzhǎng de tàishì.
en: Due to the continuous improvement of the ecological environment, the population of red-crowned cranes shows a trend of steady growth.

zh: 那位老教授在讲座间隙小憩片刻，以防自己因劳累而在台下打盹儿。
pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo jiàoshòu zài jiǎngzuò jiànxì xiǎoqì piànkè, yǐ fáng zìjǐ yīn láolèi ér zài táixià dǎ dǔn r.
en: The old professor took a short nap during the break in the lecture to prevent himself from dozing off due to fatigue.

zh: 全球气候变暖导致南极冰川迅速融化，引起了国际社会的广泛关注。
pinyin: Quánqiú qìhòu biànnuǎn dǎozhì Nánjí bīngchuān xùnsù rónghuà, yǐnqǐ le guójì shèhuì de guǎngfàn guānzhù.
en: Global warming has caused the rapid melting of glaciers in the South Pole, attracting widespread attention from the international community.

zh: 这种新型材料不仅具备优异的抗压性能，并且具有良好的耐腐蚀性。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīnxíng cáiliào bùjǐn jùbèi yōuyì de kàngyā xìngnéng, bìngqiě jùyǒu liánghǎo de nàifǔshíxìng.
en: This new type of material not only possesses excellent compression resistance but also has good corrosion resistance.

zh: 他摒弃了优越的物质生活，义无反顾地投身于艰苦的偏远地区建设。
pinyin: tā bìng qì le yōu yuè de wù zhì shēng huó, yì wú fǎn gù dì tóu shēn yú jiān kǔ de piān yuǎn dì qū jiàn shè.
en: He abandoned a comfortable material life and unhesitatingly devoted himself to the construction of arduous, remote areas.

zh: 在法定节假日期间，政府部门会统筹安排公共服务以保障民生需求。
pinyin: zài fǎ dìng jié jià rì qī jiān, zhèng fǔ bù mén huì tǒng chóu ān pái gōng gòng fú wù yǐ bǎo zhàng mín shēng xū qiú.
en: During statutory public holidays, government departments coordinate public services to ensure the needs of people's livelihoods are met.

zh: 财务部门对这笔账目进行了严密的复查，以排除任何潜在的舞弊嫌疑。
pinyin: Cáiwù bùmén duì zhè bǐ zhàngmù jìnxíngle yánmì de fùchá, yǐ páichú rènhé qiánzài de wǔbì xiányí.
en: The finance department conducted a rigorous re-examination of these accounts to rule out any potential suspicion of fraud.

zh: 在艺术作品中，凤凰常被描绘成姿态优雅的灵鸟，象征着祥瑞与高贵。
pinyin: Zài yìshù zuòpǐn zhōng, fènghuáng cháng bèi miáohuì chéng zītài yōuyǎ de língniǎo, xiàngzhēngzhe xiángruì yǔ gāoguì.
en: In works of art, the phoenix is often depicted as a graceful spirit bird, symbolizing auspiciousness and nobility.

zh: 这台精密的炉灶不仅提升了烹饪效率，还配备了先进的自动控温装置。
pinyin: zhè tái jīng mì de lú zào bù jǐn tí shēng le pēng rèn xiào lǜ, hái pèi bèi le xiān jìn de zì dòng kòng wēn zhuāng zhì zhì.
en: This sophisticated stove not only improves cooking efficiency but is also equipped with advanced automatic temperature control devices.

zh: 面对肆虐的洪水，勇敢的救援人员并未畏惧，尽管最终有人因此丧生。
pinyin: Miànduì sìnüè de hóngshuǐ, yǒnggǎn de jiùyuán rényuán bìng wèi wèijù, jǐnguǎn zuìzhōng yǒurén yīncǐ sàngshēng.
en: Facing the rampant flood, the brave rescue workers did not fear, although some eventually died because of it.

zh: 各种各样的社会问题往往源于复杂的因素，例如经济差距或文化差异。
pinyin: Gèzhǒng gèyàng de shèhuì wèntí wǎngwǎng yuányú fùzá de yīnsù, lìrú jīngjì chājù huò wénhuà chāyì.
en: Various social problems often stem from complex factors, for example, economic disparities or cultural differences.

zh: 在扑朔迷离的案件中，证人的供词往往半真半假，需要侦探仔细甄别。
pinyin: Zài pūshuò-mílí de ànjiàn zhōng, zhèngrén de gòngcí wǎngwǎng bàn zhēn bàn jiǎ, xūyào zhēntàn zǐxì zhēnbié.
en: In a bewildering case, the witness's testimony is often half true and half false, requiring the detective to carefully discern the truth.

zh: 行人若违规占用机动车道或在人行道上摆摊，将面临相关的行政处罚。
pinyin: xíngrén ruò wéiguī zhànyòng jīdòngchēdào huò zài rénxíngdào shàng bǎitān, jiāng miànlín xiāngguān de xíngzhèng chǔfá.
en: Pedestrians who illegally occupy the motor vehicle lane or set up stalls on the sidewalk will face corresponding administrative penalties.

zh: 这种集成式办公平台极大地优化了工作流程，为员工提供了诸多便宜。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jíchéng shì bàngōng píngtái jídà de yōuhuà le gōngzuò liúchéng, wèi yuángōng tígōng le zhūduō biànyí.
en: This integrated office platform has greatly optimized the workflow and provided many conveniences for employees.

zh: 该型号的卡车凭借其卓越的马力，在崎岖的山路上行驶依然游刃有余。
pinyin: Gāi xínghào de kǎchē píngjiè qí zhuóyuè de mǎlì, zài qíqū de shānlù shàng xíngshǐ yīrán yóurènyǒuyú.
en: Relying on its superior horsepower, the truck of this model still drives with ease on rugged mountain roads.

zh: 相关部门严格按照法律程序进行招标，以确保工程质量符合规范要求。
pinyin: Xiāngguān bùmén yángé ànzhào fǎlǜ chéngxù jìnxíng zhāobiāo, yǐ quèbǎo gōngchéng zhìliàng fúhé guīfàn yāoqiú.
en: Relevant departments conduct bidding in strict accordance with legal procedures to ensure that project quality meets regulatory requirements.

zh: 为了保持最佳状态，博物馆内的恒温恒湿系统必须精确调节空气湿度。
pinyin: wèi le bǎo chí zuì jiā zhuàng tài, bó wù guǎn nèi de héng wēn héng shī xì tǒng bì xū jīng què tiáo jié kōng qì shī dù.
en: To maintain optimal conditions, the constant temperature and humidity system inside the museum must precisely regulate the air humidity.

zh: 尽管这项技术具有革命性的意义，但是其潜在的环境风险仍不容忽视。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè xiàng jìshù jùyǒu gémìngxìng de yìyì, dànshì qí qiánzài de huánjìng fēngxiǎn réng bùróng hūshì.
en: Although this technology has revolutionary significance, its potential environmental risks cannot be ignored.

zh: 相关部门已介入调查，以确定这起严重的工业废料中毒事件的责任归属。
pinyin: Xiāngguān bùmén yǐ jièrù diàochá, yǐ quèdìng zhè qǐ yánzhòng de gōngyè fèiliào zhòngdú shìjiàn de zérèn guīshǔ.
en: Relevant departments have intervened in the investigation to determine liability for this serious industrial waste poisoning incident.

zh: 大雁那井然有序的编队飞行不仅是一种壮丽的景象，更是自然界的奇观。
pinyin: dàyàn nà jǐngrányǒuxù de biānduì fēixíng bùjǐn shì yī zhǒng zhuànglì de jǐngxiàng, gèng shì zìránjiè de qíguān.
en: The wild geese's orderly formation flying is not only a magnificent sight but also a marvel of the natural world.

zh: 经过激烈的角逐，这场精彩的半决赛最终以平局收场，双方将择日重赛。
pinyin: Jīngguò jīliè de juézhú, zhè chǎng jīngcǎi de bàn jué sài zuìzhōng yǐ píngjú shōuchǎng, shuāngfāng jiāng zérì chóngsài.
en: After fierce competition, this exciting semifinal ended in a draw, and both sides will replay on another day.

zh: 那件艺术品巧妙地利用了贝壳的天然纹理，呈现出一种独特的审美意蕴。
pinyin: Nà jiàn yì shù pǐn qiǎo miào de lì yòng le bèi ké de tiān rán wén lǐ, chéng xiàn chū yī zhǒng dú tè de shěn měi yì yùn.
en: The artwork cleverly utilizes the natural texture of the shells, presenting a unique aesthetic connotation.

zh: 那种忧郁而抑郁的情绪始终笼罩着他，使他难以从丧亲之痛中恢复过来。
pinyin: Nà zhǒng yōuyù ér yìyù de qíngxù shǐzhōng lǒngzhào zhe tā, shǐ tā nányǐ cóng sàngqīn zhī tòng zhōng huīfù guòlái.
en: That melancholic and depressed mood shrouded him, making it difficult for him to recover from his grief.

zh: 学术界普遍认为，加强两岸交流对促进大陆与台湾的共同繁荣至关重要。
pinyin: xué shù jiè pǔ biàn rèn wéi, jiā qiáng liǎng àn jiāo liú duì cù jìn dà lù yǔ tái wān de gòng tóng fán róng zhì guān zhòng yào.
en: Academia generally believes that strengthening cross-strait exchanges is crucial for promoting the common prosperity of mainland China and Taiwan.

zh: 这把剪刀的刀刃虽然经过了精心打磨，但仍然难以应对高强度的切割任务。
pinyin: Zhè bǎ jiǎndāo de dāorèn suīrán jīngguò le jīngxīn dǎmó, dàn réngrán nányǐ yìngduì gāoqiángdù de qiēgē rènwù.
en: Although the blades of these scissors have been carefully polished, they are still difficult to handle high-intensity cutting tasks.

zh: 由于该市房价持续上涨，中心地段的房产价格已经突破了每平方米五万元。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi shì fángjià chíxù shàngzhǎng, zhōngxīn dìduàn de fángchǎn jiàgé yǐjīng tūpò le měi píngfāngmǐ wǔ wàn yuán.
en: Due to the continuous rise in housing prices in the city, property prices in the central area have exceeded 50,000 yuan per square meter.

zh: 如果水源遭到了有毒化学品的严重污染，当地居民的健康将受到极大威胁。
pinyin: Rúguǒ shuǐyuán zāodào le yǒudú huàxué pǐn de yánzhòng wūrǎn, dāngdì jūmín de jiànkāng jiāng shòudào jídà wēixié.
en: If the water source is severely polluted by poisonous chemicals, the health of local residents will be under great threat.

zh: 该航空公司宣布将增加往返两地的直飞航班，以满足日益增长的旅客需求。
pinyin: Gāi hángkōng gōngsī xuānbù jiāng zēngjiā wǎngfǎn liǎng dì de zhífēi hángbān, yǐ mǎnzú rìyì zēngzhǎng de lǚkè xūqiú.
en: The airline announced it will increase direct flights between the two places to meet the growing demand of passengers.

zh: 下棋不仅是一种娱乐活动，更是一种磨炼意志、提升思维能力的博弈艺术。
pinyin: Xià qí bùjǐn shì yī zhǒng yúlè huódòng, gèng shì yī zhǒng móliàn yìzhì, tíshēng sīwéi nénglì de bóyì yìshù.
en: Playing chess is not just a form of entertainment, but also a game of strategy that tempers one's will and enhances cognitive abilities.

zh: 该政策旨在进一步优化营商环境，从而更好地利用外资以推动高质量发展。
pinyin: Gāi zhèngcè zhǐzài jìnyībùyībù yōuhuà yíngshāng huánjìng, cóng'ér gèng hǎo de lìyòng wàizī yǐ tuīdòng gāo zhìliàng fāzhǎn.
en: The policy aims to further optimize the business environment so as to better utilize foreign investment to promote high-quality development.

zh: 为了研究候鸟的迁徙路线，科学家们使用无线电追踪器来捕捉其活动轨迹。
pinyin: Wèile yánjiū hòuniǎo de qiānxǐ lùxiàn, kēxuéjiāmen shǐyòng wúxiàndiàn zhuīzōngqì lái bǔzhuō qí huódòng guǐjì.
en: In order to study the migration routes of migratory birds, scientists use radio trackers to capture their movement patterns.

zh: 在正式的学术写作中，引用文献时通常需要在括弧中标注作者姓名与年份。
pinyin: Zài zhèngshì de xuéshù xiězuò zhōng, yǐnyòng wénxiàn shí tōngcháng xūyào zài kuòhú zhōng biāozhù zuòzhě xìngmíng yǔ niánfèn.
en: In formal academic writing, when citing literature, it is usually required to indicate the author's name and the year in parentheses.

zh: 如果不及时加固桥梁的结构，各个构件之间很可能会出现严重的脱节现象。
pinyin: Rúguǒ bù jíshí jiāgù qiáoliáng de jiégòu, gègè gòujiàn zhījiān hěn kěnéng huì chūxiàn yánzhòng de tuōjié xiànxiàng.
en: If the bridge structure is not reinforced in time, serious disconnection or coming apart is likely to occur between the various components.

zh: 尽管恶劣天气导致能见度极低，搜救队依然坚持在山区巡逻搜寻失踪人员。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn èliè tiānqì dǎozhì néngjiàndù jí dī, sōujiùduì yīrán jiānchí zài shānqū xúnluó sōuxún shīzōng rényuán.
en: Despite the poor visibility caused by extreme weather, the search and rescue team persisted in patrolling the mountainous area to look for missing persons.

zh: 面对人口老龄化的严峻挑战，财政部不得不对养老金制度进行结构性改革。
pinyin: miàn duì rén kǒu lǎo líng huà de yán jù de yán jùn tiǎo zhàn, cái zhèng bù bù dé bù duì yǎng lǎo jīn zhì dù jìn xíng jié gòu xìng gǎi gé.
en: Facing the severe challenge of an aging population, the Ministry of Finance has to carry out structural reforms to the pension system.

zh: 年画作为一种传统的民间艺术，承载着深厚的历史底蕴与独特的审美意趣。
pinyin: Niánhuà zuòwéi yī zhǒng chuántǒng de mínjiān yìshù, chéngzàizhe shēnhòu de lìshǐ dǐyùn yǔ dútè de shěnměi yìqù.
en: As a traditional folk art, New Year pictures carry profound historical accumulation and unique aesthetic interest.

zh: 东北地区凭借其丰富的自然资源，在国家经济版图中占据着举足轻重的地位。
pinyin: Dōngběi dìqū píngjiè qí fēngfù de zìrán zīyuán, zài guójiā jīngjì bǎntú zhōng zhànjùzhe jǔzúqīngzhòng de dìwèi.
en: With its abundant natural resources, the Northeast region occupies a pivotal position in the national economic landscape.

zh: 虽然数字影像技术日新月异，但仍有一些摄影爱好者执着于胶片的独特质感。
pinyin: Suīrán shùzì yǐngxiàng jìshù jìshù jìshù jìshù jìshù jìshù jìshù jìshù rìxīnyuèyì, dàn réng yǒu yìxiē shèyǐng àihàozhě zhízhuó yú jiāopiàn de dútè zhìgǎn.
en: Although digital imaging technology is advancing rapidly, some photography enthusiasts are still persistent about the unique texture of film.

zh: 面对记者的质疑，这位专家不仅一一回应，还列举了大量数据以证实其观点。
pinyin: Miànduì jìzhě de zhìyí, zhè wèi zhuānjiā bùjǐn yī yī huíyìng, hái lièjǔ le dàliàng shùjù yǐ zhèngshí qí guāndiǎn.
en: Facing the reporters' questioning, this expert not only responded one by one but also cited a large amount of data to verify his viewpoint.

zh: 随着城市化进程的加快，密集的便利店网络已深度融入市民的日常生活之中。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshìhuà jìnchéng de jiākuài, mìjí de biànlìdiàn wǎngluò yǐ shēndù róngrù shìmín de rìcháng shēnghuó zhī zhōng.
en: With the acceleration of urbanization, the dense network of convenience stores has been deeply integrated into the daily lives of citizens.

zh: 该机构针对近期的一系列争议发表了正式的公开信，以澄清事实并消除误解。
pinyin: Gāi jīgòu zhēnduì jìnqī de yīxìliè zhēngyì fābiǎo le zhèngshì de gōngkāixìn, yǐ chéngqīng shìshí bìng xiāochú wùjiě.
en: The organization issued a formal open letter regarding the recent series of controversies to clarify the facts and eliminate misunderstandings.

zh: 那个犯罪嫌疑人企图通过频繁更换住址与警方玩捉迷藏，但最终还是落网了。
pinyin: Nàgè fànzuì xiányírén qǐtú tōngguò pínfán gēnghuàn zhùzhǐ yǔ jǐngfāng wán zhuōmícáng, dàn zuìzhōng háishì luòwǎng le.
en: The criminal suspect attempted to play hide-and-seek with the police by frequently changing addresses, but was eventually captured.

zh: 为了应对激烈的市场竞争，公司决定将原本单一的经营模式改为多元化经营。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng, gōngsī juédìng jiāng yuánběn dānyī de jīngyíng móshì gǎi wéi duōyuánhuà jīngyíng.
en: In order to cope with fierce market competition, the company decided to change its original single business model to diversified operations.

zh: 在那座幽静的庭院里，挂着几幅半透明的纱帘子，给人一种朦胧的视觉美感。
pinyin: zài nà zuò yōu jìng de tíng yuàn lǐ, guà zhe jǐ fú bàn tòu míng de shā lián zi, gěi rén yī zhǒng méng lóng de shì jué de shì jué měi gǎn.
en: In that quiet courtyard, several semi-transparent gauze curtains hung, giving a hazy visual sense of beauty.

zh: 这顶透气性良好的蚊帐为孩子们营造了一个舒适且不受蚊虫干扰的睡眠环境。
pinyin: Zhè dǐng tòuqìxìng liánghǎo de wénzhàng wèi háizimen yíngzàole yīgè shūshì qiě bù shòu wénchóng gānrǎo de shuìmián huánjìng.
en: This breathable mosquito net creates a comfortable and insect-free sleeping environment for the children.

zh: 环境保护部门对工厂周边的环境进行了实地勘测，以评估其对生态系统的影响。
pinyin: huánjìng bǎohù bùmén duì gōngchǎng zhōubiān de huánjìng jìnxíng le shí dì kāncè, yǐ pínggū qí duì shēngtài xìtǒng de yǐngxiǎng.
en: The environmental protection department conducted an on-site survey of the area surrounding the factory to assess its impact on the ecosystem.

zh: 由于在公共场合随意丢弃口香糖会影响市容，相关部门制定了严格的罚款规定。
pinyin: Yóuyú zài gōnggòng chǎnghé suíyì diūqì kǒuxiāngtáng huì yǐngxiǎng shìróng, xiāngguān bùmén zhìdìngle yángé de fákuǎn guīdìng.
en: Because discarding chewing gum casually in public affects the city's appearance, the relevant departments have established strict fine regulations.

zh: 面对难以调和的职业倦怠，他毅然选择了辞职，试图寻求一种全新的生活方式。
pinyin: miàn duì nán yǐ tiáo hé de zhí yè juàn dài, tā yì rán xuǎn zé le cí zhí, shì tú xún qiú yī zhǒng quán xīn de shēng huó fāng shì.
en: Faced with irreconcilable professional burnout, he resolutely chose to resign, attempting to seek a brand new lifestyle.

zh: 尽管他竭力掩饰自己的慌张，但面对众人的质疑，他仍显出一副难为情的神色。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā jiélì yǎnshì zìjǐ de huāngzhāng, dàn miànduì zhòng zhòngrén de zhìyí, tā réng xiǎn chū yī fù nánwéiqíng de shénsè.
en: Although he tried his best to hide his nervousness, he still looked embarrassed when faced with everyone's questioning.

zh: 随着经济的发展，全国各地的铁路网日益完善，乘坐火车出行变得越来越便利。
pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì de fāzhǎn, quánguó gèdì de tiělùwǎng rìyì wánshàn, chéngzuò huǒchē chūxíng biànde yuèláiyuè biànlì.
en: With economic development, the national railway network is becoming increasingly perfect, making travel by train more and more convenient.

zh: 尽管路途遥远且交通不便，他依然坚持每逢佳节就去探望并看望那些孤寡老人。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn lù tú yáo yuǎn qiě jiāo tōng bú biàn, tā yī rán jiān chí měi féng jiā jié jiù qù tàn wàng bìng kàn wàng nà xiē gū guǎ lǎo rén.
en: Despite the long journey and poor transportation, he still insists on visiting the elderly who live alone every festive season.

zh: 尽管他具备足够的专业素质，但缺乏必要的沟通技巧，难以胜任这项艰巨的任务。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā jùbèi zúgòu de zhuānyè sùzhì, dàn quēfá bìyào de gōutōng jìqiǎo, nányǐ shèngrèn zhè xiàng jiānjù de rènwù.
en: Although he possesses sufficient professional qualities, he lacks the necessary communication skills, making it difficult for him to handle this arduous task.

zh: 面对突如其来的变故，他不仅没慌乱，反而沉着地站住脚跟，开始寻找应对之策。
pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de biàngù, tā bùjǐn méi huāngluàn, fǎn'ér chénzhuó de zhàn zhù jiǎogēn, kāishǐ xǐ shùnxù zhǎoxún yìngduì zhī cè.
en: Faced with the sudden turn of events, not only did he not panic, but he stood his ground calmly and began looking for a solution.

zh: 为了体现公平，单位坚持多劳多得的薪酬激励机制，从而促进了业务的高效发展。
pinyin: Wèile tǐxiàn gōngpíng, dānwèi jiānchí duōláoduōdé de xīnchóu jīlì jīzhì, cóng'ér cùjìnle yèwù de gāoxiào fāzhǎn.
en: In order to reflect fairness, the unit adheres to the 'more work, more pay' compensation incentive mechanism, thereby promoting the efficient development of business.

zh: 尽管函授教学缺乏面对面的交流，但它为偏远地区的人们提供了宝贵的学习机会。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn hánshòu jiàoxué quēfá miànduìmiàn de jiāoliú, dàn tā wèi piānyuǎn dìqū de rénmen tígōng le bǎoguì de xuéxí jīhuì.
en: Although correspondence education lacks face-to-face communication, it provides valuable learning opportunities for people in remote areas.

zh: 随着劳动力市场的变迁，如何保障农民工的合法权益已成为社会舆论关注的焦点。
pinyin: Suí zhe láo dòng lì shì chǎng de biàn qiān, rú hé bǎo zhàng nóng míng gōng de hé fǎ quán yì yǐ chéng wéi shè huì yú lùn guān zhù de jiāo diǎn.
en: With the changes in the labor market, how to protect the legal rights and interests of migrant workers has become the focus of public opinion.

zh: 这个政策一方面旨在缓解社会矛盾，另一方面则侧重于推动产业结构的优化升级。
pinyin: zhè gè zhèng cè yī fāng miàn zhǐ zài huǎn jiě shè huì máo dùn, lìng yī fāng miàn zé cè zhòng yú tuī dòng chǎn yè jié gòu de yōu huà shēng jí.
en: This policy aims, on the one hand, to alleviate social conflicts, and on the other, it focuses on promoting the optimization and upgrading of the industrial structure.

zh: 尽管现在的时尚潮流变幻莫测，但一件简洁的羊绒背心始终是衣橱里的必备单品。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiànzài de shíshàng cháoliú biànhuàn mòcè, dàn yī jiàn jiǎnjié de yángróng bèixīn shǐzhōng shì yīchú lǐ de bìbèi dānpǐn.
en: Although current fashion trends are unpredictable, a simple cashmere vest has always been a wardrobe essential.

zh: 嫂子那种坚韧不拔的精神深深地感染了全家人，使我们在遭遇挫折时始终保持乐观。
pinyin: Sǎozi nà zhǒng jiānrèn bù bá de jīngshén shēnshēn de gǎnrǎn le quán jiārén, shǐ wǒmen zài zāoyù cuòzhé shí shǐzhōng bǎochí lèguān.
en: My sister-in-law's persevering spirit deeply inspired the whole family, keeping us optimistic even when facing setbacks.

zh: 为了应对日益严峻的生态危机，有关部门正致力于为国宝大熊猫营造适宜的栖息地。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì rìyì yánjùn de shēngtài wēijī, yǒuguān guān bùmén zhèng zhìlì yú wèi guóbǎo dàxióngmāo yíngzào shìyí de qīxīdì.
en: In order to cope with the increasingly severe ecological crisis, relevant departments are committed to creating suitable habitats for the national treasure, the giant panda.

zh: 为了缓解医院临床用血紧张的状况，广大市民踊跃报名，投身于无偿献血的行列中。
pinyin: Wèile huǎnjiě yīyuàn línchuáng yòng xuè jǐnzhāng de zhuàngkuàng, guǎngdà shìmín yǒngyuè bàomíng, tóushēn yú wúcháng xiàn xuè de hángliè zhōng.
en: In order to alleviate the tension in clinical blood supply at hospitals, the general public eagerly signed up and joined the ranks of voluntary blood donors.

zh: 尽管他竭力掩盖那段被历史尘封的真相，但往事终究还是在岁月的灰尘中被挖掘出来。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā jiélì yǎngài nà duàn bèi lìshǐ chénfēng de zhēnxiàng, dàn wǎngshì zhōngjiū háishì zài suìyuè de huīchén zhōng bèi wājué chūlái.
en: Although he tried his best to cover up the truth sealed by history, the past was eventually unearthed from the dust of time.

zh: 准备年夜饭不仅是一种传统习俗，更是寄托了人们对美满生活与和谐团圆的深切期盼。
pinyin: Zhǔnbèi nián yè fàn bùjǐn shì yī zhǒng chuántǒng xísú, gèng shì jìtuōle rénmen duì měimǎn shēnghuó yǔ héxié tuányuán de shēnqiè qīpàn.
en: Preparing the reunion dinner is not only a traditional custom but also embodies people's deep expectations for a happy life and harmonious reunion.

zh: 尽管外部环境恶劣，但他们拒绝向任何势力屈服或妥协，也拒绝接受任何形式的施压。
pinyin: jǐnguǎn wàibù huánjìng èliè, dàn tāmen jùjué xiàng rènhé shìlì qūfú huò tuǒxié, yě jùjué jiēshòu rènhé xíngshì de shī yā.
en: Despite the harsh external environment, they refuse to yield or compromise to any forces, and they also refuse to accept any form of pressure.

zh: 市场上充斥着各式各样的牙刷，但挑选一款适合自己的牙刷对预防牙周疾病至关重要。
pinyin: Shìchǎng shàng chōngchìzhe gèshìgèyàng de yáshuā, dàn tiāoxuǎn yīkuǎn shìhé zìjǐ de yáshuā duì yùfáng yázhōu jíbìng zhìguān zhòngyào.
en: The market is flooded with all kinds of toothbrushes, but selecting one that suits you is crucial for preventing periodontal disease.

zh: 在戏剧舞台上，那个扮演小丑的演员通过夸张的肢体语言完美地诠释了角色的讽刺意义。
pinyin: Zài xìjù wǔtái shàng, nàge bànyǎn xiǎochǒu de yǎnyuán tōngguò kuāzhāng de zhītǐ yǔyán wánměi de quánshìle juésè de fěngcì yìyì.
en: On the drama stage, the actor playing the clown perfectly interpreted the satirical meaning of the role through exaggerated body language.

zh: 即便是在繁忙的工作间隙，他也坚持参加高端管理培训班，以拓宽视野并获取前沿资讯。
pinyin: Jíbiàn shì zài fánmáng de gōngzuò jiànxì, tā yě jiānchí cānjiā gāoduān guǎnlǐ péixùnbān, yǐ tuòkuān shìyě bìng huòqǔ qiányán zīxùn.
en: Even during busy intervals at work, he persists in attending high-end management training classes to broaden his horizons and acquire cutting-edge information.

zh: 那部动画片不仅具备极高的艺术水准，还深刻地揭示了社会现实，引发了广泛的舆论反响。
pinyin: Nà bù dònghuàpiàn bùjǐn jùbèi jí gāo de yìshù shuǐzhǔn, hái shēnkè de jiēshì le shèhuì xiànshí, yǐnfā le guǎngfàn de yúlùn fǎnxiǎng.
en: That animated film not only possesses a high artistic standard but also profoundly reveals social realities, triggering widespread public reaction.

zh: 那部电影不仅票房很高，而且获得了许多奖项，这并非偶然，而是导演精心设计的必然结果。
pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng bùjǐn piàofáng hěn gāo, érqiě huòdéle xǔduō jiǎngxiàng, zhè bìngfēi ǒurán, ér shì dǎoyǎn jīngxīn shèjì de bìrán jiéguǒ.
en: That film not only had a high box office but also won many awards; this was no accident, rather, it was the inevitable result of the director's meticulous design.

zh: 由于尼龙具有优良的耐磨性，它常被用来制造各种绳索和织物。
pinyin: Yóuyú nílóng jùyǒu yōuliáng de nàimóxìng, tā cháng bèi yòng lái zhìzào gèzhǒng shéngsuǒ hé zhīwù.
en: Due to nylon's excellent abrasion resistance, it is often used to manufacture various ropes and fabrics.

zh: 由于货运需求激增，公司决定购置一批重型卡车以提高运输效率。
pinyin: Yóu yú huò yùn xū qiú jī zēng, gōng sī jué dìng gòu zhì yī pī zhòng xíng kǎ chē yǐ tí gāo yùn shū xiào lǜ.
en: Due to the surge in freight demand, the company decided to purchase a batch of heavy trucks to improve transportation efficiency.

zh: 这种珍贵的药水通常被储存在阴凉且干燥的环境中以保持其药效。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhēnguì de yàoshuǐ tōngcháng bèi chǔcún zài yīnliáng qiě gānzào de huánjìng zhōng yǐ bǎochí qí yàoxiào.
en: This kind of precious medicinal water is usually stored in a cool and dry environment to maintain its efficacy.

zh: 虽然这项技术目前仍处于探索阶段，但其潜在的经济价值不可估量。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè xiàng jìshù mùqián réng chǔyú tànsuǒ jiēduàn, dàn qí qiánzài de jīngjì jiàzhí bùkě gūliàng.
en: Although this technology is still in the exploration stage, its potential economic value is immeasurable.

zh: 随着消费升级，消费者愈发倾向于选择营养成分更为均衡的优质奶粉。
pinyin: Suízhe xiāofèi shēngjí, xiāofèizhě yùfā qīngxiàngyú xuǎnzé yíngyǎng chéngfèn gèngwéi jūnhéng de yōuzhì nǎifěn.
en: With the upgrading of consumption, consumers are increasingly inclined to choose high-quality powdered milk with more balanced nutritional components.

zh: 他怀着一颗赤子之心回到了魂牵梦绕的老家，立志带动当地经济发展。
pinyin: Tā huáizhe yì kē chìzǐzhīxīn huí dào le húnqiānmèngrào de lǎojiā, lìzhì dàidòng dāngdì jīngjì fāzhǎn.
en: With a sincere heart, he returned to the native place of his dreams, determined to drive the local economic development.

zh: 随着数字化的普及，纸质日历已逐渐被各种电子日程管理软件所取代。
pinyin: Suízhe shùzìhuà de pǔjí, zhǐzhì rìlì yǐ zhújiàn bèi gè zhǒng diànzǐ rìchéng guǎnlǐ ruǎnjiàn suǒ qǔdài.
en: With the popularization of digitalization, paper calendars have gradually been replaced by various electronic schedule management software.

zh: 尽管户外严寒刺骨，但那件轻便的羽绒服依然提供了极佳的御寒效果。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn hùwài yánhán cìgǔ, dàn nà jiàn qīngbiàn de yǔ róng fú yīrán tígōng le jíjiā de yùhán xiàoguǒ.
en: Although it was bitterly cold outside, that lightweight down jacket still provided excellent protection against the cold.

zh: 尽管前年市场环境恶劣，该企业仍凭借卓越的创新能力实现了逆势增长。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn qiánnián shìchǎng huánjìng èliè, gāi qǐyè réng píngjiè zhuóyuè de chuàngxīn nénglì shíxiàn le nìshì zēngzhǎng.
en: Despite the harsh market environment the year before last, the enterprise still achieved counter-trend growth through excellent innovation capabilities.

zh: 尽管钻石象征着永恒的爱情，但其价格波动依然受市场供需关系的影响。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zuànshí xiàngzhēngzhe yǒnghéng de àiqíng, dàn qí jiàgé bōdòng yīrán shòu shìchǎng gōngxū guānxì de yǐngxiǎng.
en: Although diamonds symbolize eternal love, their price fluctuations are still influenced by market supply and demand.

zh: 虽然他学术造诣深厚，但在处理具体事务时，仍需听取有关专家的建议。
pinyin: Suīrán tā xuéshù zàoyì shēnhòu, dàn zài chǔlǐ jùtǐ shìwù shí, réng xū tīngqǔ yǒuguān zhuānjiā de jiànyì.
en: Although he has profound academic attainments, he still needs to listen to the suggestions of relevant experts when dealing with specific matters.

zh: 在那段充满迷信色彩的历史时期，残酷的殉葬制度要求奴隶为死者陪葬。
pinyin: Zài nà duàn chōngmǎn míxìn sècǎi de lìshǐ shíqī, cánkù de xùnzàng zhìdù yāoqiú núlì wèi sǐzhě péizàng.
en: During that historically superstitious period, the cruel system of human sacrifice required slaves to be buried with the deceased.

zh: 尽管这项研究目前尚未转化为具体成果，但其潜在的学术用处不容忽视。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè xiàng yánjiū mùqián shàngwèi zhuǎnhuà wéi jùtǐ chéngguǒ, dàn qí qiánzài de xuéshù yòngchu bùróng hūshì.
en: Although this research has not yet been translated into concrete results, its potential academic usefulness cannot be ignored.

zh: 该报社聘请了多位领域的专家，旨在提升其学术专栏的专业深度与影响力。
pinyin: Gāi bào shè pìn qǐng le duō wèi lǐng yù de zhuān jiā, zhǐ zài tí shēng qí xué shù zhuān lán de zhuān yè shēn dù yǔ yǐng xiǎng lì.
en: The newspaper hired several experts in various fields, aiming to enhance the professional depth and influence of its academic column.

zh: 他长期沉溺于这种见不得光的走私情感，最终导致了人生轨迹的彻底崩塌。
pinyin: tā cháng qī chén nì yú zhè zhǒng jiàn bù dé guāng de zǒu sī qíng gǎn, zuì zhōng dǎo zhì le rén shēng guǐ jì de chè dǐ bēng tā.
en: He was long addicted to this illicit affair, which ultimately led to the complete collapse of his life's trajectory.

zh: 相关部门针对该区域的修路计划展开了严格的审核，以确保施工质量及效率。
pinyin: Xiāngguān bùmén zhēnduì gāi qūyù de xiū lù jìhuà zhǎnkāi le yángé de shěnhé, yǐ quèbǎo shīgōng zhìliàng jí xiàolǜ.
en: The relevant departments conducted a strict review of the road repair plan for the area to ensure construction quality and efficiency.

zh: 这家动物园的扩建工程旨在改善动物的栖息环境，从而促进濒危物种的繁衍。
pinyin: Zhè jiā dòngwùyuán de kuòjiàn gōngchéng zhǐ zài gǎishàn dòngwù de qīxī huánjìng, cóng'ér cùjìn bīnwēi wùzhǒng de fányǎn.
en: The expansion project of this zoo aims to improve the habitat for animals, thereby promoting the reproduction of endangered species.

zh: 尽管临床试验尚未发现严重的副作用，但对于药物的长效机制仍需谨慎评估。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn línchuáng shìyàn shàngwèi fāxiàn yánzhòng de fù zuò yòng, dàn duìyú yàowù de chángxiào jīzhì réng xū jǐnshèn píngg pínggū.
en: Although clinical trials have not yet found serious side effects, the long-term mechanism of the drug still needs careful evaluation.

zh: 本届国际研讨会将由权威学术机构联合举行，旨在探讨前沿科技的发展趋势。
pinyin: Běnjiè guójì yántǎohuì jiāng yóu quánwēi xuéshù jīgòu liánhé jǔxíng, zhǐ zài tàntǎo qiányán kējì de fāzhǎn qūshì.
en: This international symposium will be jointly held by authoritative academic institutions, aiming to explore the development trends of frontier technology.

zh: 那位资深记者凭借敏锐的洞察力揭露了该企业的丑闻，引起了舆论的广泛关注。
pinyin: Nà wèi zīshēn jìzhě píngjiè mǐnruì de dòngchálì jiēlù le gāi qǐyè de chǒuwén, yǐnqǐ le yúlùn de guǎngfàn guānzhù.
en: That veteran reporter exposed the company's scandal through sharp insight, drawing widespread public attention.

zh: 菜市场里那种充满烟火气的喧闹声，总能唤起人们对于日常生活的感知与热爱。
pinyin: Cài shì chǎng lǐ nà zhǒng chōngmǎn yānhuǒqì de xuānnào shēng, zǒng néng huànqǐ rénmen duìyú rìcháng shēnghuó de gǎnzhī yǔ rè'ài.
en: The hustle and bustle in the food market, filled with the warmth of daily life, can always evoke people's perception and love for everyday life.

zh: 长期在温室中培育的幼苗一旦直接移栽到室外，往往难以适应恶劣的自然气候。
pinyin: Chángqī zài wēnshì zhōng péiyù de yòumiáo yīdàn zhíjiē yízāi dào shìwài, wǎngwǎng nányǐ shìyìng èliè de zìrán qìhòu.
en: Seedlings cultivated in a greenhouse for a long time often struggle to adapt to harsh natural climates once transplanted directly outdoors.

zh: 在葡萄酒鉴赏会上，专家们仔细品尝每一款佳酿，并对其口感和余韵进行评价。
pinyin: Zài pútáojiǔ jiànshǎnghuì shàng, zhuānjiāmen zǐxì pǐncháng měi yī kuǎn jiāniàng, bìng duì qí kǒugǎn hé yú yúyùn jìnxíng píngjià.
en: At the wine tasting, experts carefully tasted each fine vintage and evaluated its texture and aftertaste.

zh: 随着城市交通拥堵问题的加剧，自行车出行逐渐成为一种低碳环保的生活方式。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì jiāotōng yōngdǔ wèntí de jiājù, zìxíngchē chūxíng zhújiàn chéngwéi yī zhǒng dītàn huánbǎo de shēnghuó fāngshì.
en: With the aggravation of urban traffic congestion, bicycle travel has gradually become a low-carbon and eco-friendly lifestyle.

zh: 相关部门针对特殊群体实施了有针对性的税费减免措施，旨在缓解其经济压力。
pinyin: Xiāngguān bùmén zhēnduì tèshū qúntǐ shíshīle yǒu zhēnduìxìng de shuìfèi jiǎnmiǎn cuòshī, zhǐzài huǎnjiě qí jīngjì yālì.
en: The relevant departments have implemented targeted tax and fee reduction measures for special groups, aiming to alleviate their economic pressure.

zh: 尽管他在事业上取得了巨大成功，但内心深处却始终隐藏着一种难以名状的忧郁。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā zài shìyè shàng qǔdéle jùdà chénggōng, dàn nèixīn shēnchù què shǐzhōng yǐncángzhe yī zhǒng nányǐ míngzhuàng de yōuyù.
en: Although he has achieved great success in his career, deep down he always hides an indescribable sense of sullenness.

zh: 尽管他具备了深厚的学术造诣，但由于缺乏正式的学历认证，求职过程并不顺利。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn tā jù bèi le shēn hòu de xué shù zào zào yì ， dàn yóu yú quē fá zhèng shì de xué lì rèn zhèng ， qiú zhí guò chéng bìng bù shùn lì 。
en: Although he possesses profound academic attainments, due to the lack of formal academic qualification certification, the job hunting process has not gone smoothly.

zh: 那位运动员凭借出色的爆发力和精湛的技巧，成功刷新了该项目的跳高世界纪录。
pinyin: Nà wèi yùndòngyuán píngjiè chūsè de bàofālì hé jīngzhàn de jìqiǎo, chénggōng shuāxīn le gāi xiàngmù de tiàogāo shìjiè jìlù.
en: Relying on his outstanding explosive power and exquisite technique, the athlete successfully refreshed the world record for the high jump in that event.

zh: 尽管网络购物非常便捷，许多人依然倾向于光顾实体店铺以获得更好的购物体验。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wǎngluò gòuwù fēicháng biànjié, xǔduō rén yīrán qīngxiàng yú guānggù shítǐ diànpù yǐ huòdé gèng hǎo de gòuwù tǐyàn.
en: Although online shopping is very convenient, many people still prefer to patronize physical stores to have a better shopping experience.

zh: 尽管该药物在临床试验中表现出显著的疗效，但仍需进一步评估其潜在的副作用。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gāi yàowù zài línchuáng shìyàn zhōng biǎoxiàn chū xiǎnzhù de liáoxiào, dàn réngxū jìnyībù pínggū qí qiánzài de fùzuòyòng.
en: Although the drug has shown significant healing efficacy in clinical trials, its potential side effects still require further evaluation.

zh: 在那次宴会上，主办方精心准备了琳琅满目且十分可口的佳肴，让宾客们赞不绝口。
pinyin: Zài nà cì yànhuì shàng, zhǔbànfāng jīngxīn zhǔnbèile línlángmǎnmù qiě shífēn kěkǒu de jiāyáo, ràng bīnkèmen zànbùjuékǒu.
en: At the banquet, the hosts meticulously prepared an array of very tasty dishes, leaving the guests full of praise.

zh: 每逢国庆佳节，天安门广场都会布置精美的花坛，以表达对祖国繁荣昌盛的深切祝愿。
pinyin: Měiféng Guóqìng jiājié, Tiān'ānmén guǎngchǎng dūhuì bùzhì jīngměi de huātán, yǐ biǎobiǎo dǎ duì zǔguó fánróng chāngshèng de shēnqiè zhùyuàn.
en: Every National Day, Tiananmen Square is decorated with beautiful flower beds to express profound wishes for the prosperity of the motherland.

zh: 作为一名成功的商人，他致力于拓展国际市场，并与多方建立了深厚的合作伙伴关系。
pinyin: zuò wéi yī míng chéng gōng de shāng rén, tā zhì lì yú tuò zhǎn guó jì shì chǎng, bìng yǔ duō fāng jiàn lì le shēn hòu de hé zuò huǒ bàn guān xi.
en: As a successful businessman, he is committed to expanding international markets and has established deep partnerships with many parties.

zh: 在地铁车厢里，即便身心俱疲，他依然坚持为那位孕妇让座，展现了极高的道德修养。
pinyin: Zài dìtiě chēxiāng lǐ, jíbiàn shēnxīn jù pí, tā yīrán jiānchí wèi nà wèi yùnfù ràngzuò, zhǎnxiànle jí gāo de dàodé xiūyǎng.
en: In the subway car, even though he was exhausted physically and mentally, he still insisted on giving up his seat for that pregnant woman, showing high moral cultivation.

zh: 打麻将已不仅仅是一种消遣娱乐，更被视为一种深入了解中国民间社交文化的独特方式。
pinyin: dǎ má jiàng yǐ bù jǐn jǐn shì yī zhǒng xiāo qiǎn yú lè, gèng bèi shì wéi yī zhǒng shēn rù liǎo jiě zhōng guó mín jiān shè jiāo wén huà de dú tè fāng shì.
en: Playing mahjong is not just a form of recreation, but is seen as a unique way to gain deep insight into Chinese folk social culture.

zh: 政府通过完善相关法律法规，进一步规范了企业的纳税行为，旨在营造公平的竞争环境。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tōngguò wánshàn xiāngguān fǎlǜ fǎguī, jìnyībù guīfàn le qǐyè de nàshuì xíngwéi, zhǐ zài yíngzào gōngpíng de jìngzhēng huánjìng.
en: By improving relevant laws and regulations, the government has further standardized corporate tax payment practices, aiming to create a fair competitive environment.

zh: 这种大包大揽的作风不仅压抑了团队成员的积极性，还容易因决策失误造成严重的后果。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng dà bāo dà lǎn de zuò fēng bù jǐn yā yì le tuán duì chéng yuán de jī jí xìng, hái róng yì yīn jué cè shī wù zào chéng yán zhán chéng yán zhòng de hòu guǒ.
en: This style of taking complete charge not only suppresses the enthusiasm of team members but also easily leads to serious consequences due to poor decision-making.

zh: 在选购家具时，他不仅考虑了整体装修风格，还特意挑选了一盏高雅的台灯来点缀客厅。
pinyin: Zài xuǎngòu jiājù shí, tā bùjǐn kǎolǜle zhěngtǐ zhuěngtǐ zhuāngxiū fēnggé, hái tèyì tiāoxuǎnle yī zhǎn gāoyǎ de táidēng lái diǎnzhuì kètīng.
en: When buying furniture, he not only considered the overall decoration style, but also specially selected an elegant table lamp to embellish the living room.

zh: 对于许多在外漂泊的游子而言，春节回家不仅仅是一种习俗，更是一种难以割舍的情结。
pinyin: Duìyú xǔduō zài wài piāobó de yóuzǐ ér yán, Chūnjié huí jiā bùjǐnjǐn shì yī zhǒng xísú, gèng shì yī zhǒng nányǐ gēshě de qíngjié.
en: For many wanderers living away from home, returning home for the Spring Festival is not just a custom, but an inseparable emotional bond.

zh: 经历了一辈子的风风雨雨，他与老伴儿之间的感情愈发深厚，成为了彼此不可或缺的依靠。
pinyin: Jīnglì le yībèizi de fēngfēngyǔyǔ, tā yǔ lǎobànr zhī jiān de gǎnqíng yùfā shēnhòu, chéngwéi le bǐcǐ bùkě huòquē de yīkào.
en: Having experienced a lifetime of ups and downs, the affection between him and his spouse has grown increasingly deep, making them each other's indispensable support.

zh: 这座图书馆不仅收藏了丰富的文献资料，还定期举办各种学术讲座，旨在提升市民的文化素养。
pinyin: Zhè zuò túshūguǎn bùjǐn shōucáng le fēngfù de wénxiàn zīliào, hái dìngqī jǔbàn gèzhǒng xuéshù jiǎngzuò, zhǐzài tíshēng shìmín de wénhuà sùyǎng.
en: This library not only contains a rich collection of documents but also regularly hosts various academic lectures, aiming to enhance the cultural literacy of citizens.

zh: 那一抹斜阳恰似完美的背景，将古城的沧桑衬托得淋漓尽致。
pinyin: Nà yī mǒ xiéyáng qiàsì wánměi de bèijǐng, jiāng gǔchéng de cāngsāng chèntuō dé línlíjìnzhì.
en: That touch of setting sun serves as a perfect backdrop, highlighting the vicissitudes of the ancient city to the fullest extent.

zh: 物业管理处要求业主必须按时交费，以确保社区各项设施的正常运转。
pinyin: Wùyè guǎnlǐ chù yāoqiú yèzhǔ bìxū ànshí jiāofèi, yǐ quèbǎo shèqū gèxiàng shèshī de zhèngcháng yùnzhuǎn.
en: The property management office requires owners to pay fees on time to ensure the normal operation of community facilities.

zh: 尽管数字技术已普及，但他依然沉溺于收集老式磁带带来的独特质感。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shùzì jìshù yǐ pǔjí, dàn tā yīrán chénnì yú shōují lǎoshì cí dài dàilái de dútè zhìgǎn.
en: Although digital technology has become widespread, he is still obsessed with the unique texture brought by old-fashioned magnetic tapes.

zh: 由于该地区处于热带气候，蚊子不仅数量繁多，而且极易传播各类传染病。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi dìqū chǔyú rèdài qìhòu, wénzi bùjǐn shùliàng fánduō, érqiě jíyì chuánbō gèlèi chuánrǎnbìng.
en: Due to the tropical climate in the region, mosquitoes are not only numerous but also easily spread various infectious diseases.

zh: 该罪犯在服刑期满获释后，决心彻底告别曾经的监狱生涯，重新融入社会。
pinyin: Gāi zuìfàn zài fúxíng qīmǎn huòshì hòu, juéxīn chèdǐ gàobié céngjīng de jiānyù shēngyá, chóngxīn róngrù shèhuì.
en: After completing his sentence and being released, the criminal was determined to leave his prison life behind completely and reintegrate into society.

zh: 由于该市交通网络日益完善，政府推行月票制度以缓解高峰期的拥堵状况。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi shì jiāotōng wǎngluò rìyì wánshàn, zhèngfǔ tuīxíng yuèpiào zhìdù yǐ huǎnjiě gāofēngqī de yōngdǔ zhuàngkuàng.
en: Due to the increasingly perfect transportation network in the city, the government implemented a monthly ticket system to alleviate congestion during peak hours.

zh: 经交警现场勘查，此次事故系因货车驾驶员疲劳驾驶，造成严重的追尾碰撞。
pinyin: Jīng jiāojǐng xiànchǎng kānchá, cǐ cì shìgù xì yīn huòchē jiàshǐyuán píláo jiàshǐ, zàochéng yánzhòng de zhuīwěi pèngzhuàng.
en: According to the traffic police's on-site investigation, this accident was caused by the truck driver's fatigue, resulting in a serious rear-end collision.

zh: 为了应对繁重的工作压力，许多职场人士倾向于在周末寻求片刻的宁静与释放。
pinyin: Wèile yìngduì fánzhòng de gōngzuò yālì, xǔduō zhíchǎng rénshì qīngxiàng yú zài zhōumò xúnqiú piànkè de níngjìng yǔ shìfàng.
en: In order to cope with heavy work pressure, many professionals tend to seek a moment of peace and release on the weekend.

zh: 为了保持健康的饮食习惯，我们应该适当减少精制碳水化合物作为主食的比例。
pinyin: Wèile bǎochí jiànkāng de yǐnshí xíguàn, wǒmen yīnggāi shìdàng jiǎnshǎo jīngzhì tànshuǐ huàhéwù zuòwéi zhǔshí de bǐlì.
en: To maintain healthy eating habits, we should appropriately reduce the proportion of refined carbohydrates as a staple food.

zh: 尽管现代餐饮业竞争激烈，那些具有深厚文化底蕴的传统小吃依然深受民众青睐。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiàndài cānyǐnyè jìngzhēng jīliè, nàxiē jùyǒu shēnhòu wénhuà dǐyùn de chuántǒng xiǎochī yīrán shēn shòu mínzhòng qīnglài.
en: Although the modern catering industry is highly competitive, those traditional street foods with profound cultural heritage are still deeply favored by the public.

zh: 春节蕴含着深厚的民族情感，不仅是辞旧迎新的时刻，更象征着家庭的凝聚与和谐。
pinyin: Chūn jié yùnhánzhe shēnhòu de mínzú qínggǎn, bùjǐn shì cíjiùyíngxīn de shíkè, gèng xiàngzhēngzhe jiātíng de níngjù yǔ héxié.
en: The Spring Festival embodies profound national sentiment; it is not only a time to bid farewell to the old and welcome the new, but also symbolizes family cohesion and harmony.

zh: 在缺乏基础设施的边陲地带，当地居民至今仍通过燃烧木材来维持基本的取暖需求。
pinyin: Zài quēfá jīchǔ shèshī de biānchuí dìdài, dāngdì jūmín zhìjīn réng tōngguò ránshāo mùcái lái wéichí jīběn de qǔnuǎn xūqiú.
en: In border areas lacking infrastructure, local residents still maintain basic heating needs by burning wood.

zh: 随着时代变迁，过年的方式也在不断演变，但那份对辞旧迎新的期待始终未曾改变。
pinyin: Suízhe shídài biànqiān, guònián de fāngshì yě zài bùduàn yǎnbiàn, dàn nà fèn duì cíjiù-yíngxīn de qīdài shǐzhōng wèicéng gǎibiàn.
en: With the changing times, the ways of celebrating Chinese New Year are constantly evolving, but the anticipation of bidding farewell to the old and welcoming the new has never changed.

zh: 长期处于高压环境下可能诱发抑郁症，因此学会调节情绪并寻求专业的心理干预至关重要。
pinyin: Chángqī chǔyú gāoyā huánjìng xià kěnéng yòufā yìyùzhèng, yīncǐ xuéhuì tiáojié qíngxù bìng xúnqiú zhuānyè de xīnlǐ gānyù zhìguān zhòngyào.
en: Being in a high-pressure environment for a long time may induce clinical depression; therefore, learning to regulate emotions and seeking professional psychological intervention is crucial.

zh: 在深入调查了企业的不正当竞争手段后，监管机构最终决定依据相关法律条款告诉该涉事集团。
pinyin: Zài shēnrù diàochá le qǐyè de bù zhèngdàng jìngzhēng shǒuduàn hòu, jiānguǎn jīgòu zuìzhōng juédìng yījù xiāngguān fǎlǜ tiáokuǎn gàosù gāi shèshì jítuán.
en: After conducting an in-depth investigation into the company's unfair competition tactics, the regulatory body finally decided to press charges against the involved group in accordance with relevant legal provisions.

zh: 那部宏大的历史剧不仅制作精良，其蕴含深意的主题歌亦令人回味无穷。
pinyin: Nà bù hóngdà de lìshǐjù bùjǐn zhìzuò jīngliáng, qí yùnhán shēnyì de zhǔtígē yì lìng rén huíwèi wúqióng.
