en: That grand historical drama is not only well-produced, but its profound theme song is also endlessly thought-provoking.

zh: 由于信息传播媒介已近乎饱和，受众对碎片化内容产生了显著的审美疲劳。
pinyin: Yóuyú xìnxī chuánbō méijiè yǐ jìnhū bǎohé, shòuzhòng duì suìpiànhuà nèiróng chǎnshēng le xiǎnzhù de shěnměi píláo.
en: Because information dissemination media are nearly saturated, the audience has developed significant aesthetic fatigue toward fragmented content.

zh: 那件剪裁得体的旗袍将她的身材勾勒得淋漓尽致，展现出一种古典的韵味。
pinyin: nà jiàn jiǎncái détǐ de qípáo jiāng tā de shēn jiāng tā de shē tā de shēncái gōulè de línlíjìnzhì, zhǎnxiàn chū yī zhǒng gǔdiǎn de yùnwèi.
en: That well-tailored cheongsam outlines her figure perfectly, revealing a kind of classical charm.

zh: 面对那段充满血腥与屠杀的黑暗岁月，人们呼吁必须捍卫和平并防止悲剧重演。
pinyin: miàn duì nà duàn chōng mǎn xuè xīng yǔ tú shā de hēi àn suì yuè, rén men hū yù bì xū hàn wèi hé píng bìng fáng zhǐ bēi jù chóng yǎn.
en: Facing that dark era full of bloodshed and massacres, people call for defending peace and preventing the tragedy from repeating.

zh: 尽管这双球鞋的款式比较复古，但其卓越的减震功能依然深受运动员们的青睐。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè shuāng qiúxié de kuǎnshì bǐjiào fùgǔ, dàn qí zhuóyuè de jiǎnzhèn gōngnéng yīrán shēn shòu yùndòngyuánmen de qīnglài.
en: Although the style of these athletic shoes is quite retro, their excellent shock-absorption function is still highly favored by athletes.

zh: 清明时节，各地民众纷纷前往陵园扫墓，通过这种传统仪式寄托哀思，缅怀先烈。
pinyin: Qīngmíng shíjié, gèdì mínzhòng fēnfēn qiánwǎng língyuán sǎomù, tōngguò zhè zhǒng chuántǒng yíshì jìtuō āisī, miǎnhuái xiānliè.
en: During the Qingming season, people from various places go to cemeteries to sweep graves, using this traditional ceremony to express their grief and cherish the memory of the martyrs.

zh: 该球星的职业生涯虽然充满坎坷，但他凭借坚韧不拔的意志最终跻身世界顶级行列。
pinyin: Gāi qiúxīng de zhíyè shēngyá suīrán chōngmǎn kǎnkě, dàn tā píngjiè jiānrènbùbá de yìzhì zuìzhōng jīshēn shìjiè dǐngjí hángliè.
en: Although the sports star's career was full of ups and downs, he eventually reached the top level in the world thanks to his perseverance.

zh: 尽管传统的中式烹饪博大精深，但偶尔品尝一下精致的西餐也不失为一种生活情调。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chuántǒng de zhōngshì pēngrèn bódàjīngshēn, dàn ǒu'ěr pǐncháng yīxià jīngzhì de xīcān yě bùshīwéi yī zhǒng shēnghuó qíngdiào.
en: Although traditional Chinese cooking is profound, occasionally tasting exquisite Western food is also a way to enjoy life.

zh: 通过频繁的牙科检查和彻底的刷牙，可以有效预防龋齿的发生，从而维护牙周组织的健康。
pinyin: Tōngguò pínfán de yákē jiǎnchá hé chèdǐ de shuāyá, kěyǐ yǒuxiào yùfáng qǔchǐ de fāshēng, cóng'ér wéihù yázhōu zǔzhī de jiànkāng.
en: Through frequent dental check-ups and thorough brushing, the occurrence of cavities can be effectively prevented, thereby maintaining the health of periodontal tissues.

zh: 即便是在装备极其匮乏的情况下，他依然设法用现有的材料缝制了一个简易睡袋以抵御严寒。
pinyin: Jíbiàn shì zài zhuāngbèi jíqí kuífá de qíngkuàng xià, tā yīrán shèfǎ yòng xiànyǒu de cáiliào féngzhì le yīgè jiǎnyì shuìdài yǐ dǐyù yánhán.
en: Even in situations where equipment was extremely scarce, he still managed to sew a simple sleeping bag using available materials to resist the bitter cold.

zh: 造纸术的改良与推广，极大地优化了书写材料的质量，为史料的记载与传承奠定了坚实的基础。
pinyin: Zàozhǐshù de gǎiliáng yǔ tuīguǎng, jídà de yōuhuàle shūxiě cáiliào de zhìliàng, wèi shǐliào de jìzǎi yǔ chuánchéng diàndìngle jiānshí de jīchǔ.
en: The improvement and popularization of papermaking greatly optimized the quality of writing materials, laying a solid foundation for the recording and inheritance of historical materials.

zh: 随着节庆活动的推向高潮，夜幕被五彩斑斓的焰火点缀得格外璀璨。
pinyin: suí zhe jié qìng huó dòng de tuī xiàng gāo cháo, yè mù bèi wǔ cǎi bān lán de yàn huǒ diǎn zhuì dé gé wài cuǐ càn.
en: As the festival reached its climax, the night sky was adorned brilliantly by colorful fireworks.

zh: 欣赏国画时，我们不仅要关注其笔墨技法，更应体会其中蕴含的深远意境。
pinyin: Xīnshǎng guóhuà shí, wǒmen bùjǐn yào guānzhù qí bǐmò jìfǎ, gèng yīng tǐhuì qízhōng yùnhán de shēnyuǎn yìjìng.
en: When appreciating traditional Chinese painting, we should not only focus on the brushwork techniques, but also appreciate the profound artistic conception contained within.

zh: 由于该地区规划的变动，这栋闲置已久的别墅终于被重新修缮并投入使用。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi dìqū guīhuà de biàndòng, zhè dòng xiánzhì yǐ jiǔ de biéshù zhōngyú bèi chóngxīn xiūshàn bìng tóurù shǐ shǐyòng.
en: Due to changes in regional planning, this long-vacant villa has finally been renovated and put into use.

zh: 通过对基因组序列的精确分析，研究人员揭示了该菌株产生抗药性变异的分子机制。
pinyin: Tōngguò duì jīyīnzǔ xùliè de jīngquè fēnxī, yánjiū rényuán jiēshìle gāi jūnzhū chǎnshēng kàngyàoxìng biànyì de fēnzǐ jīzhì.
en: Through precise analysis of genomic sequences, researchers revealed the molecular mechanism behind the strain's drug-resistant variation.

zh: 由于该剧团享有盛誉，每场公演的入场券都在短时间内被抢购一空，现场场场爆满。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi jùtuán xiǎngyǒu shèngyù, měi chǎng gōngyǎn de rùchǎngquàn dōu zài duǎn shíjiān nèi bèi qiǎnggòu yīkōng, xiànchǎng chǎngchǎng bàomǎn.
en: Due to the troupe's prestigious reputation, tickets for every performance were sold out in a short time, and the venue was filled to capacity for every show.

zh: 尽管现代科技提供了各种驱蚊手段，许多人依然倾向于在夏季使用传统的帐子以求安稳。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiàndài kējì tígōngle gè zhǒng qūwén shǒuduàn, xǔduō rén yīrán qīngxiàng yú zài xiàjì shǐyòng chuántǒng de zhàngzi yǐ qiú ānwěn.
en: Although modern technology provides various mosquito repellent methods, many people still prefer to use traditional mosquito nets in summer for comfort.

zh: 经过多项精密检查，医生认为他的病情虽不危急，但仍需住院观察一段时间以防突发状况。
pinyin: Jīngguò duōxiàng jīngmì jiǎnchá, yīshēng rènwéi tā de bìngqíng suī bù wēijí, dàn réngxū zhùyuàn guānchá yīduàn shíjiān yǐfáng tūfā zhuàngkuàng.
en: After several precise examinations, the doctor believes that although his condition is not critical, he still needs to stay in the hospital for observation for a period of time to prevent any sudden developments.

zh: 尽管现代社会观念有所转变，但在某些传统家庭中，嫁妆依然是婚姻仪式中不可或缺的环节。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiàndài shèhuì guānniàn yǒu suǒ zhuǎnbiàn, dàn zài mǒuxiē chuántǒng jiātíng zhōng, jiàzhuang yīrán shì hūnyīn yíshì zhōng bùkě huòquē de huánjié.
en: Although modern social concepts have shifted, in some traditional families, the dowry remains an indispensable part of the wedding ceremony.

zh: 每逢除夕，漂泊在外的游子无论路途多么遥远，总会设法赶回家中与亲人团聚，共享天伦之乐。
pinyin: Měiféng chúxī, piāobó zài wài de yóuzǐ wúlùn lùtú duōme yáoyuǎn, zǒng huì shèfǎ gǎnhuí jiāzhōng yǔ qīnrén tuánjù, gòngxiǎng tiānlúnzhīlè.
en: Every New Year's Eve, wanderers away from home, no matter how far the journey, will always find a way to return home to reunite with their loved ones and share the joy of family life.

zh: 尽管现在的时尚潮流变幻莫测，但一件简约大方的经典外套依然是衣柜中不可或缺的必备单品。
pinyin: Jǐn guǎn xiàn zài de shí shàng cháo liú biàn huàn mò cè, dàn yī jiàn jiǎn yuē dà fāng de jīng diǎn wài tào yī rán shì yī guì zhōng bù kě huò quē de bì bèi dān pǐn.
en: Despite the unpredictable nature of current fashion trends, a simple and elegant classic jacket remains an indispensable staple in one's wardrobe.

zh: 随着城市化进程的加速，如何平衡高楼大厦与城市绿地之间的矛盾已成为规划者面临的严峻挑战。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshìhuà jìnchéng de jiāsù, rúhé pínghéng gāolóudàshà yǔ chéngshì lǜdì zhījiān de máodùn yǐ chéngwéi guīhuàzhě miànlín de yánjùn tiǎozhàn.
en: With the acceleration of urbanization, how to balance the conflict between high-rise buildings and urban green spaces has become a severe challenge for planners.

zh: 随着工业化进程的加快，城市周边原本广阔的农田，如今已被成千上万公顷的工厂建筑所取代。
pinyin: Suízhe gōngyèhuà jìnchéng de jiākuài, chéngshì zhōubiān yuánběn guǎngkuò de nóngtián, rújīn yǐ bèi chéngqiānshàngwàn gōngqǐng de gōngchǎng jiànzhù suǒ qǔdài.
en: With the acceleration of industrialization, the vast farmland originally around the city has now been replaced by thousands of hectares of factory buildings.

zh: 该养老院不仅提供周全的医疗护理，还致力于丰富入住老人的精神文化生活，深受社会各界赞誉。
pinyin: Gāi yǎng lǎoyuàn bùjǐn tígōng zhōucúan de yīliáo hùlǐ, hái zhìlì yú fēngfù rùzhù lǎorén de jīngshén wénhuà shēnghuó, shēn shòu shèhuì gèjiè zànyù.
en: The nursing home not only provides comprehensive medical care but is also committed to enriching the spiritual and cultural lives of its residents, receiving praise from all walks of life.

zh: 尽管关于味精对健康的潜在影响存在争议，但其作为一种增鲜剂在调味品市场中依然广泛存在。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn guānyú wèijīng duì jiànkāng de qiánzài yǐngxiǎng cúnzài zhēngyì, dàn qí zuòwéi yī zhǒng zēngxiānjì zài tiáowèipǐn shìchǎng zhōng yīrán guǎngfàn cúnzài.
en: Despite the controversy regarding the potential health impacts of MSG, it remains widely present in the condiment market as an umami enhancer.

zh: 过度沉迷于炒股往往不仅无法实现资产增值，反而会因缺乏理性的分析而蒙受巨大的经济损失。
pinyin: Guòdù chénmí yú chǎogǔ wǎngwǎng bùjǐn wúfǎ shíxiàn zīchǎn zēngzhí, fǎn'ér huì yīn quēfá lǐxìng de fēnxī ér méngshòu jùdà de jīngjì sǔnshī.
en: Excessive obsession with stock speculation often not only fails to achieve asset appreciation but instead leads to significant financial losses due to a lack of rational analysis.

zh: 由于该证件涉及重要的个人资质认证，一旦确认遗失，务必采取严格的挂失措施以规避潜在的法律风险。
pinyin: Yóuyú gāi zhèngjiàn shèjí zhòngyào de gèrén zīzhì rènzhèng, yīdàn quèrèn yíshī, wùbì cǎiqǔ yángé de guàshī cuòshī yǐ guībì qiánzài de fǎlǜ fēngxiǎn.
en: Since the document involves important personal qualification certification, once the loss is confirmed, it is imperative to take strict loss-reporting measures to avoid potential legal risks.
